title: Cost-Effective Automated Judging of Natural-Language Mathematical Proofs
summary: Grading natural-language mathematical proofs is a recurring cost in evaluating math-reasoning systems, and frontier LLM judges are expensive. We ask whether cheap open-weight models can serve as reliable judges given a candidate proof, a ground-truth proof, and a human-grading rubric. On a 200-instance validation sample of IMO-GradingBench, three cheap judges (GPT-OSS 120B, DeepSeek-V4 Flash, Gemma-4 31B) agree with human pass/fail decisions at rates statistically indistinguishable from Claude Opus 4.7 and Gemini 3.1 Pro, at up to $100\times$ lower cost. We had expected a majority vote of the three to be the best budget option; it matched the frontier but did not improve on its strongest member. Extending to the full 1000-instance benchmark and exploring consensus rules, we found that requiring unanimous agreement (all-three-pass) reaches the highest pass-agreement and precision and, on four replicate runs, the smallest run-to-run spread. The headline finding is that cheap judges are competitive with the frontier at one to two orders of magnitude lower cost; as a deployable default we recommend all-three-pass, with the caveat that this rule was identified post-hoc and warrants independent replication.

AI.tldr: 本文研究使用廉价开源权重模型作为数学证明评分裁判的可行性。在IMO-GradingBench基准上，三个廉价裁判（GPT-OSS 120B、DeepSeek-V4 Flash、Gemma-4 31B）与人类评分的一致性在统计上与Claude Opus 4.7和Gemini 3.1 Pro等前沿模型相当，但成本降低高达100倍。作者推荐"全三通过"（all-three-pass）的一致规则作为部署默认方案。
AI.motivation: 自然语言数学证明的评分是评估数学推理系统时的经常性成本，而前沿LLM裁判模型使用成本高昂。作者希望探索廉价开源权重模型能否在保持评分可靠性的同时大幅降低成本。
AI.method: 在200个实例的验证样本上比较三个廉价裁判（GPT-OSS 120B、DeepSeek-V4 Flash、Gemma-4 31B）与前沿模型（Claude Opus 4.7、Gemini 3.1 Pro）对IMO-GradingBench的人类通过/失败判定的共识度；随后扩展到全部1000个实例，探索多数投票与全一致（all-three-pass）等不同共识规则。
AI.result: 三个廉价裁判的人类一致性在统计上与前沿模型无显著差异，成本降低两个数量级。多数投票能匹配前沿表现但未超越最强成员。全一致规则（all-three-pass）达到最高通过一致性、精确度和最小重复运行间波动（基于四次重复实验）。
AI.conclusion: 廉价开源裁判在数学证明评分上与前沿模型竞争力相当，成本低一至两个数量级。推荐将all-three-pass作为部署默认规则，但需注意该规则是事后确定的，有待独立重复验证。

title: RubricReviewer: From Direct Critique to Objective and Comprehensive Rubric-Driven Peer Review
summary: Peer review at major venues is under unprecedented submission pressure, motivating the use of large language models (LLMs) as review assistants. Existing LLM-based reviewers, however, face two structural limitations. First, they map manuscripts directly to reviews, leaving the underlying rubric implicit and entangling its derivation with the judgement. Second, the prevailing paradigms each capture only half of a good review: training-free agents gather broad evidence but produce undirected critiques, while training-based reviewers inherit human discriminative judgement together with its noise and uneven coverage. We introduce RubricReviewer, a fully rubric-driven framework that addresses both limitations. It makes rubric generation an explicit intermediate step, so that both review generation and the final assessment are conditioned on paper-adaptive rubrics. It further combines a training-free agent (Scout) that gathers external evidence with a human-aligned trained model (Aligner) that consumes this evidence, fusing the strengths of both supervision sources. Experiments on real-world submissions show that RubricReviewer produces reviews that are markedly more comprehensive and more discriminative than prior systems, and exhibits the strongest robustness against adversarial prompt-injection attacks. Ablation studies further confirm the necessity of each component.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RubricReviewer，一个完全基于评分标准驱动的论文评审框架。它通过将评分标准生成设为显式中间步骤，并融合训练无关的Scout代理（收集外部证据）与训练对齐的Aligner模型（消费证据），同时解决现有LLM评审器在评分标准隐式和监督来源单一两方面的结构性局限。实验表明其在全面性、区分度及对抗提示注入攻击的鲁棒性上均优于现有系统。
AI.motivation: 大型会议同行评审面临前所未有的投稿压力，促使使用LLM作为评审助手。但现有LLM评审器存在两个结构性缺陷：一是将手稿直接映射到评审，底层评分标准隐式化且与判断纠缠；二是现有范式各只捕捉好评审的一半——训练无关代理收集广泛证据但产生无方向性的批评，而训练式评审器继承了人类判别性判断及其噪声和不均匀覆盖。
AI.method: 提出RubricReviewer框架：(1) 将评分标准生成为显式中间步骤，使评审生成和最终评估都基于论文自适应评分标准；(2) 结合训练无关的Scout代理（收集外部证据）与人类对齐的训练模型Aligner（消费这些证据），融合两种监督来源的优势。
AI.result: 在真实世界投稿上的实验表明，RubricReviewer生成的评审比现有系统更全面、更具区分度，并且对对抗性提示注入攻击表现出最强的鲁棒性。消融研究进一步证实了每个组件的必要性。
AI.conclusion: RubricReviewer通过显式评分标准生成和双源监督融合，有效解决了现有LLM评审器的结构性局限，为高质量自动化同行评审提供了新范式。

title: MemoryForge: Synthesize Lifelong Memory for Human-Like LLM Agents
summary: Equipping Large Language Models (LLMs) with human-like personas is crucial for agentic applications, such as role-play and user simulation. Traditional prompt-based methods rely on descriptive conditioning by injecting static textual profiles, which often makes agents show generic behaviors due to a lack of realistic life memory. To fill this gap, we introduce memory-based conditioning, a paradigm inspired by the cognitive psychology, which replaces abstract profiles with an autobiographical memory base, enabling frozen LLMs to dynamically retrieve situation-relevant memory to guide their behaviors. We formalize its enabling task as customized lifelong memory synthesis and propose MemoryForge, a novel framework to synthesize such lifelong memory from brief target personas. MemoryForge has three key components: a context generator for socio-historical grounding, a life organizer for developmental coherence toward the target identity, and a multi-resolution simulator that balances broad temporal summaries with high-fidelity episodic experiences. Experiments on PersonaGym for role-play and SimulatorArena for user-simulation, show that the synthesized memory base by MemoryForge enables frozen LLMs to exhibit more human-like behaviors than strong descriptive conditioning baselines across multiple metrics and LLM backbones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MemoryForge框架，通过记忆条件化（memory-based conditioning）替代传统的提示词式人格描述，为冻结的LLM合成自传体式终身记忆，使其在角色扮演和用户模拟等智能体应用中表现出更类人的行为。
AI.motivation: 传统基于提示词的人格注入方法依赖静态文本描述，缺乏真实生活记忆，导致智能体行为过于泛化、缺乏个性。为此，受认知心理学启发，作者提出用自传体记忆库替代抽象人格描述，让模型动态检索情境相关记忆来指导行为。
AI.method: 提出MemoryForge框架，包含三个关键组件：1）上下文生成器（context generator）用于社会历史背景锚定；2）生活组织器（life organizer）确保记忆发展过程与目标身份连贯一致；3）多分辨率模拟器（multi-resolution simulator），在宏观时间摘要与高保真情景经验之间取得平衡，从简短的目标人格描述合成定制化终身记忆。
AI.result: 在PersonaGym（角色扮演）和SimulatorArena（用户模拟）两个基准上的实验表明，通过MemoryForge合成的记忆库能使冻结LLM在多个指标和多种LLM骨干网络上，均优于强描述条件化的基线方法，展现出更类人的行为表现。
AI.conclusion: 基于记忆的条件化范式比基于描述的条件化更能使LLM展现出类人人格行为，MemoryForge为从简短的persona描述合成真实的终身记忆提供了有效框架，为智能体人格建模开辟了新方向。

title: AgentMemBench: A Systematic Benchmark for Evaluating Long-Term Memory Management Strategies in Conversational AI Agents
comment: 22 pages, 3 figures submitted on Neural Computing and Applications
summary: Long-term memory remains a critical bottleneck for conversational AI agents, whose finite context windows cannot support coherent recall across thousands of turns. We present AgentMemBench, a unified, reproducible benchmark evaluating five memory management strategies under identical conditions: in-context windowing (ICW), external key-value store (EKV), graph-based episodic memory (GEM), compression-based summarisation (CBS), and web-augmented memory (WAM). All are assessed across three public datasets covering long-term multi-session dialogue (LoCoMo), task-oriented document grounding (MultiDoc2Dial), and persona-grounded multi-session chat (MSC), using Recall@k, MRR, nDCG@k, Answer F1, an LLM-judge Faithfulness score, Memory Footprint, and Latency over 491 annotated question turns. Generation and judging both use Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (4-bit), with greedy decoding for determinism. Our results show that (1) EKV dominates on every quality axis (macro Recall@5 0.792, MRR 0.677, F1 0.156, Faithfulness 0.354); (2) long-range recall is decisive: on LoCoMo, where the gold turn lies many sessions back, ICW, WAM, GEM, and CBS retrieve almost nothing (Recall@5 <= 0.005) while EKV alone reaches 0.573, showing that recency windows, summaries, and entity graphs collapse at long horizons and only dense retrieval scales; (3) CBS is the runner-up on retrieval (0.556); (4) WAM equals ICW on in-corpus recall by construction, since external results carry no in-corpus provenance; and (5) EKV's recall advantage carries a footprint cost (~5,100 vs ~300 tokens for ICW/WAM), an explicit accuracy-efficiency trade-off. We additionally evaluate two published memory systems (MemGPT/Letta, HippoRAG) against the same harness, and release all code, environment, and result artefacts for full reproducibility.

AI.tldr: AgentMemBench是一个统一的基准测试框架，在相同条件下评估五种对话AI长期记忆管理策略（ICW、EKV、GEM、CBS、WAM），使用三个公共数据集和491个带标注的问题轮次进行评测。结果显示EKV在所有质量指标上占据主导地位，尤其在长距离回忆任务中表现突出（LoCoMo上Recall@5达0.573，而其他方法几乎为零），但EKV也付出了约5,100 tokens vs 300 tokens的内存足迹代价，揭示了精度与效率间的明确权衡。
AI.motivation: 对话AI体面临长期记忆瓶颈，有限上下文窗口无法支持跨数千轮对话的连贯回忆。现有研究缺乏在完全相同条件下对各种记忆管理策略进行统一、可复现比较的基准。
AI.method: 设计了AgentMemBench基准，在完全相同条件下评估五种记忆管理策略（ICW、EKV、GEM、CBS、WAM），覆盖三个公共数据集（LoCoMo、MultiDoc2Dial、MSC），使用Recall@k、MRR、nDCG@k、Answer F1、LLM-judge Faithfulness、Memory Footprint和Latency七个指标，基于Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct（4-bit量化）生成和评判，采用贪心解码保证确定性。
AI.result: EKV在所有质量维度上占据主导（macro Recall@5 0.792, MRR 0.677, F1 0.156, Faithfulness 0.354）；长距离回忆是决定性因素，在LoCoMo上ICW、WAM、GEM、CBS的Recall@5均<=0.005而EKV达0.573；CBS在检索上排名第二（0.556）；WAM与ICW在语料内回忆上等价；EKV的内存足迹约5,100 tokens远高于ICW/WAM的约300 tokens。
AI.conclusion: 只有密集检索（EKV）能在大时间跨度上有效扩展，近期窗口、摘要和实体图谱在长时间跨度下都会失效；EKV的性能优势伴随显著的存储成本，存在明确的精度-效率权衡。研究还额外评估了MemGPT/Letta和HippoRAG两个已发布系统，并发布全部代码与工件以保证可复现性。

title: ELECTRIC: Evidential Learning-Enhanced CT Reconstruction via Iterative Correction
summary: Here we introduce ELECTRIC (Evidential Learning-Enhanced CT Reconstruction via Iterative Correction), a physics-guided Bayesian formulation. An evidential neural network provides an image proposal and an error-predictive epistemic-uncertainty surrogate. The latter is converted into an adaptive precision field and inserted into a Poisson-weighted MAP update. The resulting image-evidence-precision-reconstruction loop treats prior confidence as a learned state variable of iterative reconstruction. In addition to the formulation and theoretical analysis, we report two simulation studies on image slices from the AAPM Mayo Clinic Low-Dose CT dataset: a mechanism-validation pilot using transparent surrogate estimators, and a feasibility study in which a trained Normal-Inverse-Gamma evidential network drives the full closed loop. On held-out patients, the learned prior mean reduces reconstruction error by roughly 70 percent relative to filtered back-projection, the learned epistemic uncertainty is error-predictive and supports selective trust, and the physics-guided update restores measurement consistency while the adaptive-precision reconstruction matches or exceeds a validation-tuned fixed prior and remains markedly more robust to prior-strength misspecification. Together these results demonstrate the complete ELECTRIC closed-loop pipeline, while identifying formal uncertainty calibration and joint training as the principal directions for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ELECTRIC框架，将证据学习（Evidential Learning）与泊松加权MAP迭代重建相结合，通过误差预测的不确定性代理构建自适应精度场，实现图像-证据-精度-重建的闭环迭代。在AAPM梅奥低剂量CT数据集上，该方法较滤波反投影降低约70%重建误差，且对先验强度误设具有更强的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 低剂量CT重建中，传统迭代重建方法依赖固定先验，难以适应不同图像区域的置信度差异；同时现有深度学习方法缺乏对重建不确定性的量化与反馈机制，导致重建质量与可靠性受限。
AI.method: 采用物理学引导的贝叶斯框架：证据神经网络同时输出图像提议与误差预测的认知不确定性代理；将不确定性转换为自适应精度场，嵌入泊松加权最大后验更新；构建图像-证据-精度-重建的迭代闭环，将先验置信度作为迭代重建的可学习状态变量。
AI.result: 在梅奥低剂量CT数据集上：学习先验均值较滤波反投影降低约70%重建误差；学习的不确定性具有误差预测能力并支持选择性信任；物理引导更新恢复测量一致性；自适应精度重建匹配或超越验证调参的固定先验，并对先验强度误设具有明显更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: ELECTRIC闭环流程整体可行且有效，未来主要方向为形式化的不确定性校准与联合训练。

title: Revisiting Classic Thought Experiments to Measure Consciousness for Artificial Intelligence Safety
summary: This research note revisits Leibniz's mill, Turing's imitation game, and Searle's Chinese Room through the Conservation-Congruent Encoding (CCE) framework. It formalises a toy symbolic setting in which successful behaviour is measured by task performance ($W_{causal,T}$), while the efficiency with which preserved internal structure supports that behaviour is measured by operational consciousness ($κ_T$). Within this setup, an uncompressed lookup system and a compact generative system can in principle achieve comparable behavioural success, yet diverge sharply in $κ_T$: the former relies on an expanding standing store of unreused mappings, whereas the latter reuses compact internal structure. The note therefore reframes classic disputes about understanding by separating outward performance from the organisation that sustains it, and motivates why this distinction may matter for later AI-safety analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文通过守恒一致性编码（CCE）框架重新审视莱布尼茨磨坊、图灵测试和塞尔中文房间论证，提出用任务表现（W_causal,T）和操作意识（κ_T）两个指标来分离外部行为与内部结构组织，表明查表系统与紧凑生成系统可在行为上相当但内部效率差异巨大，从而为AI安全分析提供新视角。
AI.motivation: 经典的心智哲学思想实验（莱布尼茨磨坊、图灵测试、中文房间）长期围绕"理解"之争，但缺乏一个形式化框架来区分外在行为表现与内在结构组织。作者试图通过CCE框架将这一争论转译为可量化的分析工具，并为后续AI安全研究奠定理论基础。
AI.method: 本文提出一个玩具符号设定，通过两个核心指标进行分析：任务性能（W_causal,T）衡量行为成功程度，操作意识（κ_T）衡量保留内部结构支撑该行为的效率。在此框架下对比了无压缩查表系统与紧凑生成系统两种实现方案。
AI.result: 研究表明，无压缩查表系统与紧凑生成系统在行为上可能达到可比的成功水平，但在κ_T上产生显著分歧：查表系统依赖不断扩展且不重复使用的映射存储，而生成系统则复用紧凑的内部结构。由此将关于理解的经典争论重新表述为外部表现与支撑性组织结构之间的分离。
AI.conclusion: CCE框架为理解问题提供了形式化的度量工具，区分了外显行为与内部结构组织效率，并指出这种区分对后续AI安全分析具有潜在的重要性。

title: Noise-Robust Conditional Flow Matching: Generating Clean Samples from Noisy Datasets
summary: Generative models learn the statistical properties of their training data, so high-quality generation depends on clean and representative datasets. In scientific imaging, acquisition often yields noisy measurements, while collecting clean references can be costly, impractical or even unattainable. Training directly on these measurements results in a model that reproduces the corrupted data. This can be circumvented by learning the clean population distribution directly from the noisy data. Conditional flow matching (CFM) combines a simple regression objective with stable training, efficient sampling, and strong image-generation performance, making it a natural framework for this setting. We introduce Noise-Robust Conditional Flow Matching (NR-CFM), an unconditional generator that learns from one corrupted observation per image. NR-CFM provides a closed-form clean endpoint correction for additive white Gaussian noise and learns a data-driven correction for general Gaussian corruptions with more complex covariance structure. Across the evaluated corruption settings, NR-CFM outperforms NR-GAN in most cases and remains competitive with Ambient Diffusion in the high-noise regime. We further evaluate NR-CFM on scientific data at signal-to-noise ratios as low as $0.001$, where it generates plausible particle images from severely corrupted measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出噪声鲁棒条件流匹配（NR-CFM），一种能从每张图像仅一次噪声观测中学习干净数据分布的无条件生成模型，在多种噪声条件下优于或媲美现有方法。
AI.motivation: 科学成像中获取干净参考数据往往成本高昂或不可行，而直接在噪声数据上训练生成模型会复现退化数据。因此需要从噪声观测中直接学习干净的总体分布。
AI.method: 基于条件流匹配（CFM）框架，将回归目标与稳定训练、高效采样相结合。对加性高斯白噪声提供闭式干净端点修正，对更复杂协方差结构的通用高斯退化则学习数据驱动的修正。
AI.result: NR-CFM在多数噪声设置下优于NR-GAN，在高噪声区域与Ambient Diffusion性能相当；在信噪比低至0.001的科学数据上仍能生成合理的粒子图像。
AI.conclusion: NR-CFM为从噪声观测中学习干净分布提供了有效且稳健的解决方案，尤其在极端低信噪比的科学成像场景中展现出生成可行性。

title: AutoFOAM: The Self-Refining Autonomous OpenFOAM Agent
summary: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) plays an important role in modern engineering, but using open-source solvers such as OpenFOAM requires considerable knowledge and skills, as well as time-consuming configuration file setup. To reduce this burden, we propose AutoFOAM - a self-evolving large language model (LLM) agent that creates, evaluates, runs, and evolves its own OpenFOAM simulations based solely on natural-language instructions. Our model is pre-trained on the Qwen-coder 2.5-14B, which is then fine-tuned on 252 text prompts targeting 7 OpenFOAM solvers, 13 parametrized mesh templates, and a y plus-aware numerical policy. The crucial element of the algorithm is a sophisticated evolution loop composed of 7 stages. To prevent model degeneration under repeated self-training, the agent employs three complementary anti-collapse streams: RAG-augmented retry context, surgical dictionary-level patching, and prompt-diversity paraphrasing. By bridging generative artificial intelligence with rigorous fluid simulations, AutoFOAM accelerates rapid prototyping and democratizes advanced CFD workflows.

AI.tldr: AutoFOAM是一个基于大语言模型的自进化智能体，能够仅通过自然语言指令自动创建、评估、运行和迭代OpenFOAM仿真，无需用户具备深厚的CFD知识和手动配置文件经验。该模型基于Qwen-coder 2.5-14B微调，采用7阶段进化循环和三种防退化机制，旨在加速CFD快速原型设计并使其大众化。
AI.motivation: 使用OpenFOAM等开源CFD求解器需要大量的专业知识和技能，且配置文件设置耗时费力，这给非专家用户带来了沉重负担。作者希望通过大语言模型自动化整个仿真流程，降低CFD使用的门槛。
AI.method: 基于Qwen-coder 2.5-14B预训练模型，在252个文本提示（覆盖7个OpenFOAM求解器、13个参数化网格模板和y plus感知数值策略）上进行微调。核心算法是一个包含7个阶段的进化循环，并采用三种互补的防退化机制：RAG增强重试上下文、外科手术式词典级修补、提示多样性改写。
AI.result: AutoFOAM实现了从自然语言指令到完整OpenFOAM仿真的全自动化闭环，通过自我进化机制持续提升仿真生成能力，同时有效防止了重复自训练导致的模型退化问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过将生成式人工智能与严谨的流体仿真相结合，AutoFOAM显著加速了CFD快速原型设计流程，使先进的CFD工作流变得更加民主化，让非专业用户也能轻松使用。

title: Obshazard-bench: Benchmarking Multimodal Foundation Models for Real-Time Disaster Intelligence from Raw Earth Observation Streams
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to interpret Earth observation data, yet their capability to support real-world disaster emergency response remains insufficiently evaluated. Existing remote sensing benchmarks largely rely on static, post-hoc, and expert-processed products, such as gridded reanalysis data, which are difficult to align with operational disaster scenarios where hazards evolve rapidly and decisions must be made under strict time constraints. To bridge this gap, we introduce Obshazard-bench, a real-time, observation-driven benchmark for evaluating disaster intelligence in MLLMs. Unlike image-centric or post-event benchmarks, Obshazard-bench directly integrates raw, high-frequency satellite sounding streams from diverse satellite sensors with concurrent ground-station observations, historical disaster records, and socio-economic indicators, bypassing delayed expert-processing and physical-inversion pipelines. The benchmark covers 8 major disaster categories and 28 sub-categories across more than 60 countries, incorporating over 120 historically documented extreme-event cases and thousands of lifecycle-oriented VQA samples. Moreover, Obshazard-bench further defines a three-stage evaluation taxonomy aligned with the operational disaster workflow: Predictive Crisis Anticipation for pre-disaster risk detection and early forecasting, Active Evolution Reasoning for in-situ disaster tracking and termination prediction, and Multi-faceted Impact Quantification for post-disaster magnitude deduction, humanitarian burden estimation, and socio-economic impact assessment. Experiments on representative general-purpose and Earth-focused foundation models reveal substantial limitations in transforming raw multi-channel physical observations into temporally grounded and decision-relevant disaster reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Obshazard-bench，一个实时、观测驱动的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）灾害智能评估基准，直接整合原始高频卫星探测数据、地面站观测、历史灾害记录和社会经济指标，涵盖8大灾害类别、28个子类别、60多个国家和120多个历史极端事件案例，并定义了三阶段评估体系（预测性危机预警、主动演化推理、多面影响量化），实验表明现有基础模型在将原始多通道物理观测转化为时间敏感和决策相关的灾害推理方面存在显著局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感基准大多依赖静态、事后且经过专家处理的数据产品（如网格化再分析数据），难以匹配实际灾害应急场景中灾害快速演变和严格时间约束的决策需求，因此MLLMs在现实灾害应急响应中的能力尚未得到充分评估。
AI.method: 构建Obshazard-bench基准：直接集成来自多种卫星传感器的原始高频探测流，结合同期地面站观测、历史灾害记录和社会经济指标，绕过延迟的专家处理和物理反演流程；覆盖8个灾害类别和28个子类别；提出与操作化灾害工作流对齐的三阶段评估分类体系，包含数千个面向生命周期的人机问答样本。
AI.result: 对代表性通用型和地球聚焦型基础模型的实验表明，这些模型在将原始多通道物理观测转化为时间上有依据且决策相关的灾害推理方面存在显著不足。
AI.conclusion: Obshazard-bench揭示了现有MLLMs在实际灾害应急场景中的关键能力缺口，为未来构建更强大的灾害智能模型提供了评估基准和方向指引。

title: PhysAgent: A Multi-Agent Framework for Reliable Remote Heart Rate Estimation
summary: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables non-contact heart-rate estimation from facial videos, but its weak physiological signal is easily corrupted by motion, illumination changes, occlusion, skin-appearance variation, and device noise. Existing rPPG methods typically rely on a single model to directly predict heart rate or recover pulse waveforms, while different strong estimators may produce conflicting yet individually plausible candidates for the same video. To resolve these conflicts, we propose PhysAgent, an inference-time multi-agent candidate-verification framework. Unlike direct prediction approaches, PhysAgent neither trains a new base rPPG model nor asks Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to output heart rate directly. In contrast, it treats outputs from multiple base estimators as physiological hypotheses to be verified and uses a lightweight 4B MLLM, Qwen3-VL-4B, to drive multi-agent reasoning over video conditions, signal reliability, and candidate disagreement. A deterministic physiological verifier checks the fusion proposal, and a reproducible numerical fusion process produces the final heart rate. Experimental results on multiple public rPPG benchmarks show that PhysAgent improves fusion stability and reliability across different datasets and source-domain settings, while avoiding the irreproducibility and physiological inconsistency of direct MLLM prediction or unconstrained ensemble fusion. The code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: PhysAgent是一个推理时多智能体候选验证框架，用于远程光电容积描记法（rPPG）心率估计。它不训练新模型，而是将多个基础估计器的输出视为生理学假设，利用轻量级4B多模态大语言模型Qwen3-VL-4B驱动多智能体推理来验证候选结果，并通过确定性生理验证器和可复现的数值融合过程产出最终心率，在多个公开基准上提升了融合稳定性和可靠性。
AI.motivation: rPPG信号微弱易受运动、光照、遮挡等多种因素干扰，现有方法通常依赖单一模型直接预测心率或恢复脉搏波形，但不同的强估计器对同一视频可能产生相互矛盾却又各自合理的候选结果，缺乏有效的冲突消解机制。
AI.method: PhysAgent采用推理时多智能体候选验证框架：不训练新的基础rPPG模型，也不让MLLM直接输出心率；将多个基础估计器的输出视为待验证的生理假设，使用轻量级4B的Qwen3-VL-4B驱动多智能体推理，对视频条件、信号可靠性和候选分歧进行推理分析；随后由确定性生理验证器检查融合提案，最后通过可复现的数值融合过程生成最终心率。
AI.result: 在多个公开rPPG基准上的实验表明，PhysAgent在不同数据集和源域设置下均提高了融合稳定性和可靠性，并避免了直接MLLM预测或无约束集成融合带来的不可复现性和生理不一致问题。
AI.conclusion: PhysAgent通过将多基础估计器输出视为候选假设并利用轻量级MLLM驱动的多智能体验证，有效解决了rPPG中心率估计的冲突消解问题，在保持生理一致性和可复现性的同时提升了融合性能，代码即将开源。

title: What Transfers from Text to Vision? Capability Scaling Laws and Transfer Dynamics for VLMs
summary: Choosing the right large language model (LLM) backbone is the most consequential decision when building a vision-language model (VLM), yet it remains fundamentally unprincipled: compute-based scaling laws fail to generalize across model families, and no framework exists for directly predicting VLM performance before training begins. We propose the Capability-Driven Multimodal Scaling Law, the first cross-family framework that predicts VLM benchmark accuracy from directly observable textual capability. Given a low-dimensional capability score $S$ extracted from LLM textual benchmarks via PCA, we model VLM performance as a function of $S$, with a per-backbone transfer rate and an absorption rate that quantifies data-scaling efficiency. To fit and validate the framework, we train over 150 VLMs on 34 LLMs spanning 7 model families under a strictly controlled recipe. Evaluations on more than 200 textual and 50 multimodal benchmarks show that the law accurately extrapolates transfer rate from models up to 8B parameters to 72B-scale backbones, predicts full VLM training trajectories with high fidelity, and generalizes to entirely held-out model families. Beyond the scaling law, our analysis surfaces actionable insights: certain textual benchmarks negatively correlate with multimodal performance, exposing latent benchmark-gaming behavior; base LLMs outperform instruction-tuned counterparts as VLM backbones due to higher absorption rates and lower data-scaling decay; and different model families occupy distinct positions in the transfer--absorption space. The framework turns backbone selection from costly empirical sweeps into a principled, quantitative decision. Code and data are available at https://github.com/wangq-dev/CDMScaling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种跨模型家族的"能力驱动多模态缩放定律"，通过从LLM文本基准中提取的低维能力分数来直接预测VLM基准精度，无需预训练即可进行骨干模型选择。
AI.motivation: 选择LLM骨干是构建VLM时最重要的决策，但目前缺乏原则性方法：计算量的缩放定律无法跨模型家族泛化，也没有框架能在训练前直接预测VLM性能。
AI.method: 从LLM文本基准中通过PCA提取低维能力分数S，将VLM性能建模为S的函数，包含每个骨干的迁移率和量化数据缩放效率的吸收率。在7个模型家族、34个LLM上训练超过150个VLM以拟合和验证框架。
AI.result: 该定律能准确从8B参数外推到72B规模的骨干迁移率，高保真预测完整VLM训练轨迹，并泛化到完全未见过的模型家族。还发现某些文本基准与多模态性能负相关（暴露基准博弈行为），基础LLM优于指令微调版本作为VLM骨干。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将骨干选择从昂贵的经验扫描转变为原则性的定量决策，提供了跨模型家族的首个直接预测VLM性能的缩放定律。

title: SafeBuild-Bench: A Temporal-Robust Construction Safety Benchmark with Graph-Enhanced Data Mining
summary: Construction-safety models must handle concrete deployment risks, such as a worker standing near a scaffold edge without guardrails, rather than only recognize common objects in curated images. Yet real inspection archives are redundant, long-tailed, and collected across changing sites and months. We introduce SafeBuild-Bench, a metadata-driven benchmark for evaluating multimodal large language models on construction safety under realistic temporal and site variation. It is mined from 100K+ industrial image-text records and contains 3,314 task instances from over 3,000 expert-verified images, covering multiple-choice hazard identification and free-form hazard description. To make expert verification scalable, we develop GEMS, a graph-enhanced multimodal selection pipeline that combines a proxy-model confusion signal with graph-based diversity to identify informative candidates from redundant streams. On public instruction-tuning data, GEMS-selected subsets preserve robustness-oriented performance under small data budgets. On SafeBuild-Bench, current MLLMs remain far from reliable construction-safety understanding, with the best overall score near 60. We release the benchmark, evaluation scripts, and GEMS codebase at https://github.com/safebuild/gems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SafeBuild-Bench基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在建筑施工安全场景下的表现，并开发了GEMS图增强多模态选择流水线，用于从冗余工业数据中高效筛选专家验证样本。
AI.motivation: 现有的施工安全模型仅能识别精选图像中的常见物体，无法处理真实部署风险（如工人站在无护栏的脚手架边缘）。此外，真实检查档案数据冗余、长尾分布、且跨站点跨时间变化大，亟需一个能反映真实部署场景的评估基准。
AI.method: 从10万+工业图像文本记录中挖掘构建SafeBuild-Bench，包含3,314个任务实例和3,000+张专家验证图像，涵盖多项选择危险识别和自由文本危险描述。同时提出GEMS（图增强多模态选择流水线），结合代理模型混淆信号与基于图的多样性来从冗余流中识别信息丰富的候选样本。
AI.result: 在公开指令微调数据上，GEMS选择子集在小数据预算下保持了面向鲁棒性的性能。在SafeBuild-Bench上，当前多模态大语言模型距可靠的施工安全理解仍有较大差距，最佳综合得分仅接近60。
AI.conclusion: 当前MLLMs在施工安全理解上远未达到可靠水平，SafeBuild-Bench为这一方向提供了首个兼顾时间与站点变化的元数据驱动基准，GEMS为大规模数据标注中的高效专家验证提供了可行方案。

title: Energy Efficiency of Locally Deployed LLMs: A Preliminary Quantitative GPU Power Benchmark on Consumer Hardware
summary: The local deployment of large language models (LLMs) is gaining traction due to privacy concerns and the desire for on-premise inference. However, the energy costs on consumer hardware remain poorly characterized, as most benchmarks focus solely on accuracy. This paper presents a reproducible, hardware-level energy benchmark of nine open-source LLMs (1B to 7B parameters) executed on a single consumer GPU (RTX 4060Ti 16GB). Using the Ollama inference engine, GPU power draw was sampled at 2Hz via nvidia-smi across a fixed prompt set. We evaluate mean/peak power, total energy per prompt (J/prompt), energy per output token (J/token), and throughput (tok/s). Our findings suggest that factors beyond raw parameter count, including model architecture and quantization strategy, drive energy efficiency. Specifically, gemma3:1b and llama3.2:1b achieve the lowest energy cost (0.56 J/token and 0.65 J/token) and the highest throughput (>170 tok/s). In contrast, the 7B-Mistral model consumes up to 4.4x more energy per token than the most efficient model. Notably, qwen3.5:2b exhibits anomalously high per-prompt energy due to extended internal reasoning, highlighting the need to distinguish between token generation modes in efficiency metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个可复现的硬件级能源基准测试，在消费级GPU（RTX 4060Ti 16GB）上用Ollama引擎对九个开源LLM（1B到7B参数）进行了能耗评估，发现模型架构和量化策略比参数数量更能影响能源效率，其中gemma3:1b和llama3.2:1b能耗最低（0.56 J/token和0.65 J/token），而7B-Mistral模型的每token能耗是最优模型的4.4倍。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型本地部署日益普及，但消费级硬件上的能耗特征缺乏系统研究，现有基准大多只关注准确率而忽略能源成本，因此需要可复现的硬件级能耗基准来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 在单张消费级GPU（RTX 4060Ti 16GB）上，使用Ollama推理引擎执行9个开源LLM（1B至7B参数），通过nvidia-smi以2Hz频率采样GPU功耗，采用固定提示集，评估平均/峰值功耗、每提示总能耗（J/prompt）、每输出token能耗（J/token）和吞吐量（tok/s）等指标。
AI.result: gemma3:1b和llama3.2:1b实现了最低能耗（0.56 J/token和0.65 J/token）和最高吞吐量（>170 tok/s）；7B-Mistral模型的每token能耗高达最高效模型的4.4倍；qwen3.5:2b因内部延展推理导致每提示能耗异常偏高。
AI.conclusion: 能源效率主要由模型架构和量化策略驱动而非单纯参数数量；效率指标需要区分token生成模式（如推理模式），以更准确地评估模型的实际能源成本。

title: Role Steering of Language Models for Social Simulations
summary: Social simulations built from language-model agents need role-conditioned behavior that can be checked before agents are placed into a simulated population. We introduce an activation-steering screening workflow for role-conditioned agents: define a role profile, extract a role-specific direction, sweep four steering coefficients, evaluate role-profile alignment, and pass or flag each candidate configuration. On OLMo-3-7B-Instruct, we apply the workflow to a mixed 275-role inventory with 228 role-agnostic questions, GPT-4.1-mini prompted role references, and GPT-4.1-mini judges. Role-specific directions receive higher judged role-profile alignment than an assistant-axis directional control from prior persona-vector work, with mean overall scores of 63.2 versus 41.1 across the tested grid. They also preserve high lexical diversity, while the control drops sharply at larger coefficients. The role-level screen is the main practical output: most roles improve as steering increases, but 38 roles decline across all six measured dimensions, showing why simulation builders should choose coefficients per role rather than deploy a uniform high-strength setting. We make our code and evaluation artifacts available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/anonymous-research-code-5F03/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于激活引导（activation steering）的筛选工作流，用于检查语言模型智能体在角色条件行为上的表现。该方法在OLMo-3-7B-Instruct上对275个角色和228个与角色无关的问题进行了测试，发现角色特定方向比以往的人格向量控制方法获得更高的角色对齐评分，并保留了较高的词汇多样性，同时指出大多数角色随引导强度增加而改善，但有38个角色在所有维度上均下降，因此建议按角色选择引导系数而非统一使用高强度设置。
AI.motivation: 社会模拟中的语言模型智能体需要可验证的角色条件行为，以便在将智能体放入模拟人群之前对其进行筛查，确保模拟的可靠性和角色一致性。
AI.method: 提出激活引导筛选工作流：定义角色画像、提取角色特定方向、扫描四个引导系数、评估角色画像对齐度、对每个候选配置进行通过或标记。使用OLMo-3-7B-Instruct模型，配合GPT-4.1-mini生成角色参考和评判。
AI.result: 角色特定方向的平均总体对齐评分为63.2，显著高于作为对照的助手轴方向（41.1）；角色特定方向保留了较高的词汇多样性，而对照方向在较大系数时词汇多样性急剧下降；大多数角色随引导强度增加而改善，但38个角色在所有六个测量维度上均下降。
AI.conclusion: 角色级筛查是主要实际产出：由于不同角色对引导强度的响应不同，模拟构建者应针对每个角色选择引导系数，而不应采用统一的高强度设置。相关工作代码和评估工件已公开。

title: CoT-Core: Accelerating LLM Evaluation via CoT-Aware Coreset Selection
summary: Evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) incurs prohibitive computational overhead during continuous development processes. While coreset selection accelerates evaluation, existing methods either suffer from a severe ``cold start'' bottleneck requiring massive historical logs (e.g., Item Response Theory) or exhibit a surface lexical bias that misses the underlying reasoning manifold of tasks. We propose CoT-Core, a novel training-free core question selection framework. Recognizing that lexically disparate questions can share equivalent underlying logic, CoT-Core prompts LLMs to unroll zero-shot Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning trajectories. Projecting these paths into a latent space effectively clusters questions by intrinsic logical equivalence rather than superficial text similarity. Extensive experiments on GSM8K, MMLU, MMLU-Pro, and GPQA demonstrate that CoT-Core drastically reduces evaluation costs while maintaining high-fidelity score estimation, and delineate the boundary conditions of reasoning-aware pruning, revealing that its efficacy is intrinsically gated by task complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoT-Core，一种无需训练的核心理念问题选择框架，利用零样本思维链（CoT）推理轨迹在潜在空间中对问题按内在逻辑等价性聚类，而非表面文本相似性，从而在降低大规模语言模型评估成本的同时保持高保真度评分估计。实验表明该方法在GSM8K、MMLU等基准上表现优异，且其效果受任务复杂度的门控。
AI.motivation: 大规模语言模型评估在持续开发过程中计算开销巨大。现有核心集选择方法要么面临严重的"冷启动"瓶颈（需要大量历史日志，如项目反应理论），要么存在表面词汇偏差，忽视了任务底层的推理流形。
AI.method: CoT-Core通过提示LLM展开零样本思维链推理轨迹，将这些路径投影到潜在空间中，从而根据问题的内在逻辑等价性（而非表面文本相似性）进行聚类，实现无需训练的的核心问题选择。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、MMLU、MMLU-Pro和GPQA上的大量实验表明，CoT-Core大幅降低了评估成本，同时保持了高保真度的分数估计；研究还揭示了推理感知剪枝的边界条件，发现其有效性本质上受任务复杂度的门控。
AI.conclusion: CoT-Core通过利用思维链推理轨迹来捕获问题的内在逻辑等价性，有效解决了现有核心集选择方法的冷启动和表面文本偏差问题，为大规模语言模型的高效评估提供了新的范式，但需注意其效果高度依赖任务复杂度。

title: Exploring More to Solve More: Boosting Diversity in Text Diffusion Models via Entropy-Based Guidance
summary: Although diffusion models have revolutionized continuous domains like image synthesis through high quality generations and controllable guidance mechanisms, bringing this controllability to the discrete, sequential nature of text remains an open challenge. Meanwhile, current sampling strategies and guidance methods adjust token likelihoods without capturing the broader semantic landscape, leading to a suboptimal balance between fidelity and diversity. In this work, we introduce a novel training-free Semantic-Aware Kernel Entropy (SAKE) guidance method. Our method computes the order-2 Rényi entropy over a kernel Gram matrix that captures both cross-token semantic interactions and relative token positions. By linearizing this objective in the embedding space, we derive a tractable guidance signal that dynamically adjusts the sampling distribution, flattening it to encourage exploration during redundancy and sharpening it for fidelity when diverse. Empirical experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves a superior Pareto frontier between fidelity and diversity, and improves multi-sample performance on reasoning-intensive tasks, such as code and mathematics generation, compared to temperature scaling and discrete guidance baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需训练的语义感知核熵（SAKE）引导方法，通过计算核Gram矩阵上的二阶Rényi熵来捕捉跨token语义交互和相对位置信息，在嵌入空间中线性化该目标以获得可解的引导信号，动态调整采样分布以在冗余时展平分布促进探索，在多样时锐化分布保证保真度，在保真度与多样性之间实现了更优的Pareto前沿，并在代码和数学生成等多步推理任务上提升了性能。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在连续域（如图像合成）已取得革命性成功，但将其可控性迁移到离散、序列化的文本生成仍然是一个未解决的挑战。同时，现有的采样策略和引导方法仅调整token似然，未能捕捉更广泛的语义景观，导致保真度与多样性之间的平衡欠佳。
AI.method: 提出SAKE（Semantic-Aware Kernel Entropy）引导方法：1) 构建核Gram矩阵以同时捕捉跨token语义交互与相对token位置信息；2) 计算该矩阵的order-2 Rényi熵作为目标函数；3) 在嵌入空间中对目标进行线性化，得到可解的引导信号；4) 利用该信号动态调整采样分布——在文本冗余时展平分布促进探索，在文本多样时锐化分布保证保真度。整个过程无需训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在保真度与多样性之间实现了更优的Pareto前沿；在代码生成和数学生成等推理密集型任务上，与温度缩放和离散引导基线相比，多样本生成性能得到改善。
AI.conclusion: SAKE通过语义感知的核熵引导，克服了传统方法仅调整token似然而忽略语义结构的局限，为离散文本生成提供了一种无需训练的、可动态平衡保真度与多样性的有效引导方案。

title: Volcanic Clouds Detection through QCNN and Geostationary Satellite Multispectral Imagery
summary: Recent advances in quantum computing are opening new possibilities for Earth Observation (EO) data analysis. Quantum machine learning (QML) approaches offer novel ways to process information by exploiting quantum phenomena such as superposition and entanglement. These capabilities have motivated the exploration of whether quantum-enhanced models can address long-standing challenges in satellite remote sensing, where complex spectral and spatial signals often require sophisticated feature extraction. Among various fields of application, EO data allow the global monitoring of volcanic clouds and are crucial for aviation safety, hazard assessment, real-time eruption response, and evaluation of volcanic impacts on climate. Yet accurate detection of volcanic clouds remains difficult due to their similarity with meteorological clouds, the variability of eruption signatures, and the coarse spectral sampling of geostationary sensors. In this work, the potential of hybrid quantum convolutional neural networks (QCNNs) for the classification of satellite images containing volcanic clouds was investigated. These architectures integrate quantum computational layers into a classical convolutional framework. Two QCNN variants (with 2 and 4 qubits) have been considered to evaluate their ability to classify a dataset of SEVIRI images, including scenes with volcanic clouds (composed of ash, $SO_2$, or mixed components) as well as non-volcanic backgrounds. Finally, the performance of the hybrid QCNN models was compared with that of purely classical architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了混合量子卷积神经网络（QCNN）在地球观测卫星图像分类中的应用，具体用于检测火山云（包含灰烬、SO₂或混合成分），并与纯经典架构进行了性能对比。
AI.motivation: 量子计算为地球观测数据分析提供新可能，而火山云检测对航空安全、灾害评估和气候影响评估至关重要。然而由于火山云与气象云相似、喷发特征多变以及地球静止传感器光谱采样粗糙，准确检测仍具挑战性，因此探索量子增强模型能否应对这些难题。
AI.method: 将量子计算层整合到经典卷积框架中构建混合QCNN架构，测试了2量子比特和4量子比特两种变体，用于对SEVIRI图像数据集进行分类，该数据集包含火山云场景（灰烬、SO₂或混合成分）和非火山背景场景。
AI.result: 将两种混合QCNN模型的分类性能与纯经典架构进行了比较评估，具体结果细节在摘要中未给出。
AI.conclusion: 研究评估了混合QCNN在火山云卫星图像分类中的潜力，为量子机器学习在地球观测领域的应用提供了实证探索，但其性能相较于经典方法的优劣需结合实验数据进一步判断。

title: Optimization and Constraint Modeling using LLMs with a Retrieval Augmented Generation Process
summary: Both optimization modeling and constraint modeling are non-trivial problems requiring deep domain expertise and proficiency in modeling formalism languages. Despite their importance across logistics, healthcare, and supply chain management, current large language models regularly produce structurally inconsistent or incomplete optimization formulations, particularly in combinatorial settings. This paper evaluates whether a Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline built on a curated synthetic dataset can meaningfully improve LLM optimization modeling performance. A total of 500 optimization problems were synthesized using seed descriptions from the Text2Zinc dataset and professional personas created using an LLM, specified in JSON and associated with validated Python solver scripts. These problems were encoded in a Chroma vector database. For each inference problem, semantically similar problems were retrieved and used as contextual guidance for a LangChain LLM agent. Three benchmark testbeds were used to evaluate the proposed pipeline under the Qwen 3 30B Instruct model. Accuracy rose from 40% to 72% on NL4OPT, 40% to 56% on MAMO Easy, and 32% to 56% on MAMO Complex. The use of semantically validated synthetic examples greatly improves both solution accuracy and structure. The combination of synthetic dataset generation with retrieval augmentation provides an effective alternative to fine-tuning, suggesting that domain-specific synthetic corpora paired with retrieval augmentation can serve as a practical pathway for deploying LLM-based optimization tools in real-world decision-support contexts without costly model retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于检索增强生成（RAG）的管道方法，利用由500个合成优化问题构建的Chroma向量数据库，在Qwen 3 30B Instruct模型上将优化建模准确率从40%提升至72%（NL4OPT）、从40%提升至56%（MAMO Easy）、从32%提升至56%（MAMO Complex），证明合成数据与检索增强结合是微调的有效替代方案。
AI.motivation: 优化建模和约束建模需要深厚的领域专业知识和建模语言熟练度，而当前大语言模型在组合优化场景中经常生成结构不一致或不完整的优化公式，需要探索无需昂贵微调即可提升LLM优化建模能力的可行路径。
AI.method: 基于Text2Zinc数据集的种子描述和LLM生成的专业角色描述，合成了500个优化问题（以JSON格式指定并关联可验证的Python求解器脚本），编码存入Chroma向量数据库。推理时检索语义相似问题作为上下文指导LangChain LLM代理，并在三个基准测试平台上用Qwen 3 30B Instruct模型进行评估。
AI.result: 在NL4OPT上准确率从40%提升至72%，在MAMO Easy上从40%提升至56%，在MAMO Complex上从32%提升至56%。语义验证的合成示例显著提升了求解准确率和结构完整性。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据集生成与检索增强的结合是微调的有效替代方案，领域特定的合成语料库配合检索增强可以作为在真实决策支持场景中部署LLM优化工具的实际路径，无需昂贵的模型重新训练。

title: SLMs as Multi-Agent Routers: A Progressive SFT and Reinforcement Learning Approach
summary: Specialised retrieval agents typically surface higher quality results than general-purpose search, but selecting the optimal agent for a given query remains an open problem. Current approaches route queries based on inferred topic or intent, however intent-based selection is fundamentally limited: it does not incorporate signal from retrieved content, and cannot detect when a topically aligned agent produces low-relevance results. We address this by training a small language model via supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning to jointly perform agent selection and structured parameter generation for downstream tool calls, using a hierarchical reward function grounded in retrieval relevance along with query-agent topic alignment. This enables the model to learn task-dependent agent suitability from retrieval performance: which agents reliably yield high-relevance results for which query distributions, and when to redirect queries away from specialised agents despite surface-level topical overlap. On a targeted subset of such agent-query mismatches, the trained model achieves an NDCG@10 of 0.918 compared to 0.539 and 0.490 for two LLM baselines (Amazon Nova Lite and Claude Haiku 4.5) that route on intent alone. Overall, it achieves a mean NDCG@10 of 0.771 (+0.177 over Nova Lite, +0.219 over Haiku) with a mean selection latency of 120.1ms, an 82.4% reduction over Nova Lite.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过监督微调加强化学习训练一个小语言模型，联合完成检索代理选择和下游工具调用的结构化参数生成，利用基于检索相关性和查询-代理主题对齐的分层奖励函数，解决基于意图的代理路由无法从检索内容中获取信号、无法检测主题对齐但低相关性的问题。在代理-查询不匹配子集上NDCG@10达0.918，整体均值NDCG@10为0.771，选择延迟仅120.1ms。
AI.motivation: 当前将查询路由到专门检索代理的方法基于推断的主题或意图进行选择，但基于意图的选择存在根本性局限：它不利用检索到的内容信号，且无法检测到主题对齐但产生低相关性结果的代理。因此需要一种能从检索性能中学习代理适用性的方法。
AI.method: 训练一个小语言模型，先进行监督微调，再通过强化学习优化。模型联合执行两项任务：(1) 代理选择；(2) 为下游工具调用生成结构化参数。训练使用分层奖励函数，基于检索相关性和查询-代理主题对齐来提供奖励信号，使模型从检索性能中学习哪些代理对哪些查询分布可靠地产生高相关性结果，以及何时应将查询从表面主题重叠的专门代理重定向。
AI.result: 在代理-查询不匹配的定向子集上，模型NDCG@10为0.918，远高于两个LLM基线（Amazon Nova Lite为0.539，Claude Haiku 4.5为0.490）。整体上，模型平均NDCG@10为0.771（比Nova Lite高0.177，比Haiku高0.219），平均选择延迟为120.1ms，比Nova Lite降低82.4%。
AI.conclusion: 通过从检索性能中学习代理适用性而非仅依赖意图推断，可以显著提升代理路由质量，同时大幅降低推理延迟，验证了基于检索相关性信号进行代理选择的可行性。

title: Memory Reward Inflation in Self-Improving LLM Agents
summary: Self-improving LLM agents increasingly learn from experience without updating any weights. Each episode is stored in an external memory, scored, and retrieved for similar future tasks to shape later behavior. Viewed through a reward lens, the stored score is a proxy reward for an implicit, non-parametric policy. Each retrieved episode then becomes a policy-improvement step whose reliability hinges on how that score is produced. In deployment, ground-truth labels are unavailable, so the stored reward is at best an LLM assessment. This substitution creates a failure mode, the *Echo Gap*, across the memory-based self-improving agents and model families studied. Incorrect episodes receive inflated rewards; thus, the agent preferentially reuses the very mistakes it has most confident in. Because the error compounds through memory rather than averaging out and the confirming judge's errors remain correlated with the original self-grading bias, so it cannot identify which memories are overvalued. The missing property is formalized as the *Error-Independence Assumption* (EIA), which we prove is a *necessary* condition for correcting the inflation, not merely a description of a good verifier: a usable signal must track truth *and* decorrelate its error from the memory bias, and the recoverable payoff is a closed-form function of exactly those two quantities. We further show the inflation compounds not only when retrieval ranks by the stored score but also under plain similarity retrieval which is the regime the deployed agent uses. Finally, the answer-free de-inflation algorithm LUCID delivers a consistent end-to-end gain on the BIRD text-to-SQL benchmark. It raises execution accuracy to $56.9\%$, above both a Memento-style self-graded agent ($54.0\%$, a $+2.9$-point mean gain across seeds) and a memory-less agent of identical architecture ($52.4\%$).

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于外部记忆的LLM自我改进智能体，发现存储奖励由LLM自评产生时存在"Echo Gap"失败模式——错误样本被高估并优先复用，且错误通过记忆复合放大。作者形式化了误差独立性假设（EIA）作为纠正奖励膨胀的必要条件，并提出无答案的去膨胀算法LUCID，在BIRD文本转SQL基准上达到56.9%的执行准确率。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体通过外部记忆进行免权重更新的自我改进已日益普遍，但在部署阶段缺少真实标签，存储的奖励只能依赖LLM自评。这种替代可能产生系统性偏差，导致智能体偏好复用自己最有信心的错误记忆，影响自我改进的可靠性。
AI.method: 1) 将记忆评分视为隐式非参数策略的代理奖励，每个检索到的样本构成一次策略改进步骤；2) 形式化"Echo Gap"失败模式，并提出误差独立性假设（EIA）作为纠正奖励膨胀的充要条件，给出可恢复收益的闭式解；3) 证明奖励膨胀在按评分排序检索和纯相似性检索两种机制下都会复合；4) 提出无答案的去膨胀算法LUCID，在BIRD基准上进行验证。
AI.result: 在BIRD文本转SQL基准上，LUCID算法将执行准确率提升至56.9%，优于Memento式自评分智能体（54.0%，跨种子平均提升+2.9点）以及同架构的无记忆智能体（52.4%）。
AI.conclusion: EIA是纠正记忆奖励膨胀的必要条件，而非仅仅是对好验证器的描述。可行的信号必须同时追踪真实性和与记忆偏差的误差去相关。LUCID算法验证了在无真实答案场景下有效去膨胀的可行性，为记忆型自我改进智能体提供了稳健的改进方向。

title: Explainable Multimodal AI for Adaptive Calibration of Archaeological Sensing Workflows
summary: This paper presents a multimodal machine-learning framework for calibration monitoring, quality assessment, and adaptive acquisition support in archaeological digitisation workflows. The proposed approach operates across photogrammetric 3D reconstruction, hyperspectral imaging, X-ray fluorescence spectroscopy, and Raman spectroscopy through a unified pipeline combining deterministic quality indicators, statistical feature representations, machine-learning classification, anomaly detection, and explainable artificial intelligence (XAI). Rather than replacing instrument-level calibration, the framework introduces an additional algorithmic layer that evaluates whether acquisitions are statistically consistent, physically plausible, and suitable for downstream multimodal integration. For each sensing modality, acquisitions are represented through structured feature spaces encoding geometric, spectral, spatial, and statistical properties. These representations are used to identify degradation patterns such as reconstruction artefacts, illumination inconsistencies, spectral distortions, detector instability, baseline fluctuations, and low signal-to-noise conditions. Supervised and unsupervised learning methods are combined with XAI techniques to support both automatic discrimination between acceptable and problematic acquisitions and interpretation of the underlying causes of degradation. The framework additionally supports adaptive feedback and resource-aware acquisition strategies by linking feature-space deviations to acquisition-level corrective actions. Experimental results obtained on multimodal archaeological datasets demonstrate that the proposed methodology captures meaningful acquisition variability and enables robust quality assessment across heterogeneous sensing modalities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多模态机器学习框架，用于考古数字化工作流中的校准监控、质量评估和自适应采集支持。该框架通过统一流程整合摄影测量3D重建、高光谱成像、X射线荧光光谱和拉曼光谱，结合确定性质量指标、统计特征表示、机器学习分类、异常检测和可解释AI（XAI），在不替代仪器级校准的前提下增加算法层评估采集数据的统计一致性、物理合理性和多模态集成适用性。
AI.motivation: 考古数字化涉及多种传感模态（摄影测量、高光谱、XRF、拉曼光谱），各模态在采集过程中容易受到重建伪影、光照不一致、光谱失真、探测器不稳定、基线漂移和低信噪比等退化因素的影响，且现有方法缺乏跨模态统一的质量评估与自适应采集支持机制。
AI.method: 提出统一的多模态机器学习管道，包含五个核心组件：确定性质量指标、统计特征表示、机器学习分类、异常检测和可解释AI（XAI）。每种传感模态通过编码几何、光谱、空间和统计属性的结构化特征空间表示，结合监督与无监督学习方法进行质量判别和退化原因解释，并通过特征空间偏差链接到采集层面的纠正动作以支持自适应反馈和资源感知采集策略。
AI.result: 在考古多模态数据集上的实验结果表明，该框架能够捕捉有意义的采集变异性，并在异质传感模态间实现稳健的质量评估。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为考古数字化提供了可扩展的质量保障层，兼顾自动判别与可解释性，并在不同传感模态间实现统一的质量评估范式。

title: Request-Level Energy Attribution for Batched LLM Serving
summary: Batched LLM serving improves throughput but complicates energy accounting. GPU power telemetry is aggregate, whereas sustainability reporting, chargeback, and workload analysis often require request-level energy charges. Existing inference-energy benchmarks report model-, phase-, or token-level energy, and recent carbon-accounting work motivates Shapley fairness conceptually. Neither provides measured request-level ground truth, so how far the accounting rules used in practice deviate from a fair allocation has remained unknown. We present JouleShare, an attribution framework with two components. An offline harness establishes this ground truth by replaying request subsets under vLLM with a reproducible protocol, integrating GPU power telemetry, and computing exact Shapley energy for each request. A lightweight calibration model, JCalib, then learns to predict Shapley shares from cheap request features for use at serving time. Across 16 model/workload runs, token-proportional attribution differs from exact Shapley by 0.440 normalized L1 on average under static batching and by 0.458 under continuous batching, a gap that reproduces across three data-center GPUs. JCalib reduces this error to 0.116 under static batching and 0.177 under continuous batching, below even a standalone-measurement baseline that is unavailable online, while preserving exact batch-energy efficiency. Sampled Shapley extends the measured reference to larger group sizes, where the gap persists and a single offline calibration remains the most accurate deployable rule. The results show that token attribution is not a reliable proxy for marginal energy under batched execution, and that measured Shapley ground truth can calibrate low-cost request features toward fairer attribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JouleShare框架，通过离线重放请求子集建立请求级能量消耗的Shapley精确基准，并用轻量级校准模型JCalib在服务时预测Shapley能量分摊。实验表明token比例分摊与精确Shapley差异显著（归一化L1误差约0.44-0.46），而JCalib可将误差降至0.12-0.18。
AI.motivation: 批量LLM推理服务虽提升吞吐量，但GPU功耗遥测是聚合级的，无法直接获得请求级能量消耗。现有基准仅提供模型级、阶段级或token级能量数据，缺乏测得的请求级ground truth，导致实际使用的分摊规则与公平分配之间的偏差程度未知。
AI.method: JouleShare包含两个组件：1）离线测试平台，通过vLLM重放请求子集，集成GPU功耗遥测并计算每个请求的精确Shapley能量值；2）轻量级校准模型JCalib，利用廉价请求特征在服务时预测Shapley分摊份额。
AI.result: 在16组模型/工作负载实验中，token比例分摊与精确Shapley的归一化L1误差在静态批处理下平均为0.440，连续批处理下为0.458，该差距在三个数据中心GPU上可复现。JCalib将误差降至静态批处理0.116和连续批处理0.177，优于在线不可用的独立测量基线，同时保持批量能量效率。采样Shapley可将测量参考扩展到更大组规模。
AI.conclusion: token分摊不是批量执行下边际能量的可靠代理，测量的Shapley基准可校准低成本请求特征以实现更公平的能量分摊。

title: Trustworthiness Costs of Domain Adaptation in Small Language Models:A Cross-Architecture Empirical Study
comment: 13 pages, 7 tables, 2 appendices (Reproducibility Checklist; Software and Data Availability). Code, model checkpoints, and datasets publicly available at https://github.com/rbpdlf/slm-trw
summary: Domain adaptation of small language models (SLMs) has emerged as a practical strategy for deploying capable NLP systems in resource-constrained, high-stakes environments including healthcare, legal services, and financial analysis. While performance gains from parameter-efficient fine-tuning are well characterised, the corresponding impact on trustworthiness (factual calibration and adversarial robustness) remains poorly understood. This paper presents the first systematic cross-domain, cross-architecture empirical study quantifying the trustworthiness cost of domain adaptation across three SLM architectures (TinyLlama 1B, Gemma-2 2B, Llama 3.2 1B), three domains (healthcare, legal, finance), two training-data conditions (benign and adversarially perturbed), and four fine-tuning strategies (baseline LoRA, Safety-DPO, Dark Experience Replay, and Task Arithmetic LoRA, TA-LoRA). Trustworthiness is evaluated through TruthfulQA MC2 (factual calibration) and HarmBench ASR (adversarial robustness) across all 216 experimental configurations with three random seeds. Three principal findings emerge. First, baseline QLoRA domain adaptation produces minimal TruthfulQA MC2 change across all model-domain combinations (mean |Delta TQA| < 0.02). Second, adversarially perturbed training data consistently improves domain adaptation quality (Delta loss approximately -0.040) without worsening trustworthiness benchmarks. Third, none of the three safety-preserving strategies reduced adversarial harm susceptibility: Safety-DPO was effectively neutral (mean Delta ASR < 0.001), while Dark ER and TA-LoRA increased mean HarmBench ASR by +0.171 and +0.155 respectively in safety-aligned models (Gemma-2 2B, Llama 3.2 1B), with individual configurations exceeding +0.45. These results challenge the assumption that replay-based and arithmetic-merge strategies transfer alignment to domain-adapted SLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对小型语言模型（SLM）领域自适应中的可信度代价进行系统性跨域、跨架构实证研究，涵盖3种架构、3个领域、2种训练数据条件和4种微调策略（共216个配置），发现基线QLoRA领域自适应对事实校准影响极小，对抗扰动数据能提升适应质量且不损害可信度，但三种安全保持策略均未降低对抗鲁棒性损失，其中Dark ER和TA-LoRA反而显著增加了有害行为风险。
AI.motivation: 虽然参数高效微调在小型语言模型领域自适应中的性能提升已被充分研究，但其对可信度（事实校准和对抗鲁棒性）的影响仍缺乏系统性理解，尤其在医疗、法律、金融等高风险场景中这一缺口尤为关键。
AI.method: 在3种SLM架构（TinyLlama 1B、Gemma-2 2B、Llama 3.2 1B）、3个领域（医疗、法律、金融）、2种训练数据条件（良性vs对抗扰动）和4种微调策略（基线QLoRA、Safety-DPO、Dark Experience Replay、TA-LoRA）下进行全因子实验，使用TruthfulQA MC2评估事实校准、HarmBench ASR评估对抗鲁棒性，共216个实验配置、3个随机种子。
AI.result: 三个主要发现：1）基线QLoRA领域自适应几乎不改变TruthfulQA MC2（平均|Delta TQA|<0.02）；2）对抗扰动训练数据持续改善领域自适应质量（Delta loss≈-0.040）且不损害可信度基准；3）Safety-DPO效果中性（平均Delta ASR<0.001），而Dark ER和TA-LoRA分别使HarmBench ASR均值增加+0.171和+0.155（在已安全对齐的模型中），个别配置增幅超过+0.45。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果挑战了"基于重放和算术合并的策略能将对齐能力迁移至领域自适应SLM"这一假设，表明现有安全保持方法在领域自适应场景中可能失效甚至适得其反，需要重新审视安全对齐策略的迁移性设计。

title: K-space Gaussian Representation for Parallel MRI
summary: Accelerated magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) aims to recover the k-space signal from acquired measurements, where accurate estimation of missing samples is essential for high-fidelity reconstruction. Existing k-space reconstruction methods estimate missing samples through interpolation operators or structure priors defined on discrete sampling grids. Although these formulations effectively exploit local interpolation relationships and global k-space redundancy, they reconstruct only discrete frequency coefficients and therefore do not explicitly model the underlying continuous signal. To overcome this limitation, we propose K-space Gaussian Representation (KGR), the first explicit continuous representation formulated directly in the native k-space domain. Rather than estimating unknown samples on discrete grids, KGR parameterizes the continuous signal using Gabor-Gaussian primitives with shared spatial geometry, yielding a compact representation that naturally preserves inter-coil correlations. Because unconstrained continuous fitting does not necessarily satisfy the intrinsic structural properties of multi-coil signal, the estimated representation is projected onto a low-rank manifold to enforce the algebraic constraints arising from smoothly varying phase and coil redundancy. A frequency-adaptive fitting strategy accommodates the heterogeneous characteristics of different k-space regions. Comprehensive validation across multiple datasets and sampling schemes shows consistent improvements over representative reconstruction baselines in both quantitative metrics and visual quality. These results suggest that explicit continuous parameterization of native k-space provides a principled framework for integrating continuous signal modeling with structured low-rank reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出K空间高斯表示（KGR），首次在原生k空间域中构建显式连续表示，利用Gabor-Gaussian基元参数化连续信号，并通过低秩流形投影和频率自适应拟合策略实现高保真MRI重建。
AI.motivation: 现有k空间重建方法仅在离散采样网格上通过插值算子或结构先验估计缺失样本，虽能利用局部插值关系和全局k空间冗余，但只能重建离散频率系数，未显式建模底层连续信号，限制了重建质量的进一步提升。
AI.method: KGR方法包括三个核心组件：(1) 使用具有共享空间几何的Gabor-Gaussian基元参数化k空间连续信号，形成紧凑表示并天然保持线圈间相关性；(2) 将估计的连续表示投影到低秩流形上，以施加由平滑相位变化和线圈冗余产生的代数约束；(3) 采用频率自适应拟合策略适应不同k空间区域的异质特性。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和多种采样方案上的综合验证表明，KGR在定量指标和视觉质量上均持续优于代表性重建基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 原生k空间的显式连续参数化为整合连续信号建模与结构化低秩重建提供了原则性框架。

title: Motif-Mamba: network motif improved mamba for long-range sequence modeling
comment: 9 pages of main text, 8 pages of appendix, 6 figures. Submitted to NeurIPS 2026
summary: Efficient long-sequence modeling remains a central challenge for large language models, as self-attention scales quadratically with sequence length. Mamba offers a linear-time alternative through selective state space recurrence, but its predominantly diagonal state transitions restrict explicit interactions among state dimensions. We propose Motif-Mamba, a structured state space model that augments Mamba with a motif-constrained low-rank recurrent pathway. Inspired by the dynamics of three-node network motifs, the proposed pathway projects hidden states into a compact dynamical subspace, imposes motif-guided interactions, and maps the resulting dynamics back to the original state space. This design enhances cross-dimensional communication while preserving the linear-time recurrent structure of Mamba. Experiments on long-sequence extrapolation, language modeling benchmarks, and brain--computer interface decoding show consistent improvements over Mamba backbones, suggesting that motif-guided low-rank dynamics provide an effective structural prior for long-range sequence modeling.

AI.tldr: Motif-Mamba是一种结构化状态空间模型，通过在Mamba中引入基于三节点网络基序（motif）约束的低秩循环通路，增强了状态维度间的显式交互，同时保持线性时间复现结构，在长序列外推、语言建模和脑机接口解码任务上均优于原始Mamba。
AI.motivation: Mamba虽然通过选择性状态空间循环提供了线性时间的长序列建模能力，但其接近对角的状态转移矩阵限制了状态维度间的显式交互，导致跨维度信息交流不足，影响模型表达能力。
AI.method: 提出Motif-Mamba结构：在Mamba基础上增加一个由三节点网络基序启发的低秩循环通路。该通路将隐藏状态投影到紧凑的动态子空间，施加基序引导的维度间交互，再映射回原始状态空间，在增强跨维度通信的同时保留线性时间循环结构。
AI.result: 在长序列外推、语言建模基准测试和脑机接口解码实验中，Motif-Mamba相较于Mamba骨干网络均取得了持续一致的效果提升。
AI.conclusion: 基序引导的低秩动态为长序列建模提供了有效的结构先验，证明了引入显式跨维度交互机制能够在不牺牲计算效率的前提下提升状态空间模型的能力。

title: Predicting Startup Exit from Textual Descriptors - A Computational Linguistics Framework
summary: This study shows that textual descriptors alone can predict early-stage startup success, defined as Exit, without relying on contextual, financial, or human capital variables. Using venture capital-curated datasets covering 7,419 startups over 20 years, the research isolates text-based framing variables and engineers 850 features through startup narrative mapping. Data subsets and vector embeddings are evaluated for statistical significance, followed by supervised machine learning experiments across six models. LightGBM achieved the highest predictive performance (F1 = 0.48), while textual descriptors alone achieved F1 = 0.30, confirming the standalone predictive value of founder narratives. Feature analysis shows that optimized densities of hyping markers, including adjectives, jargon, and buzzwords, are associated with higher Exit probability, whereas excessive statement or name length reduces it. The study also introduces a quantifiable Hyping Score for venture capital applications, demonstrating that startup framing provides measurable signals for predicting Exit under conditions of high information asymmetry.

AI.tldr: 本研究证明仅凭文本描述即可预测早期创业公司的成功（Exit），使用7,419家初创公司、20年数据，构建850个文本特征，LightGBM达到最高F1=0.48，纯文本描述F1=0.30，并引入可量化的"Hyping Score"指标。
AI.motivation: 在高度信息不对称的早期创业投资环境中，传统依赖财务、人力资本等变量的预测方法存在局限，研究者希望探索创始人叙事文本本身是否蕴含可预测创业成功（Exit）的独立信号。
AI.method: 使用风险投资精选数据集（7,419家初创公司、20年），排除上下文/财务/人力资本变量，通过创业叙事映射工程化850个文本特征，对数据子集和向量嵌入进行统计显著性检验，并使用六种监督学习模型进行实验比较。
AI.result: LightGBM达到最高预测性能（F1=0.48），纯文本描述符独立达到F1=0.30，证明创始人叙事的独立预测价值。特征分析显示适量（优化密度）的炒作标记（形容词、行话、流行词）与更高的Exit概率相关，而过长的陈述或名称长度会降低Exit概率。
AI.conclusion: 创业公司的文本框架（framing）在高信息不对称条件下提供可测量的Exit预测信号，研究引入的Hyping Score可为风险投资实践提供量化工具。

title: Nova: An End-to-End MLIR Compiler for Deep Learning
summary: The performance of deep learning models at scale relies heavily on how effectively high-level mathematical operations are mapped to underlying physical hardware. While high-level tensor frameworks provide flexible abstractions for model design, their eager execution models inherently lack the whole-graph visibility and granular control over hardware and memory required to maximize physical hardware utilization natively. To bridge this gap, we designed Nova, an automated end-to-end JIT compiler whose defining purpose is to achieve absolute control over this hardware mapping: fusing operations across operation boundaries, optimizing complex memory hierarchies, and tuning execution down to the register level. By capturing eager executions and unifying forward and backward passes into a single value-semantic dialect, Nova unlocks aggressive whole-graph optimizations. It then utilizes an Analytic Configurator to deterministically derive optimal execution schedules based on arithmetic intensity, dropping search time to zero. Backed by a structural hashing runtime, Nova synthesizes fine-grained kernels directly from the computation's structure. In our evaluations on an RTX 3060, Nova matches or modestly exceeds cuBLAS and XLA on TF32 matmuls on most shapes, maintaining a stringent < 5e-4 relative error. At the model level, Nova achieves up to 10.6% greater throughput than PyTorch and 4.4% greater than XLA on a 42-million parameter model, without compromising on numerical fidelity. Crucially, by reducing the memory footprint by up to 29% relative to PyTorch, Nova successfully trains a 144-million parameter model at 17,900 tokens/s where PyTorch encounters Out-Of-Memory (OOM) failures on the same 12 GB consumer GPU.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Nova，一个端到端JIT编译器，通过统一前向和反向传播的价值语义方言、分析配置器（Analytic Configurator）和结构哈希运行时，实现从操作融合到寄存器级调优的全面硬件映射控制，在保持数值精度的同时显著提升吞吐量并降低内存占用。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型规模化时，高层张量框架的即时执行模式缺乏全图可见性和对硬件/内存的细粒度控制，难以最大化物理硬件利用率。
AI.method: Nova通过三个方面实现端到端优化：(1) 捕获即时执行并将前向和反向传播统一为单一价值语义方言，实现激进的全图优化；(2) 利用分析配置器（Analytic Configurator）基于算术强度确定性推导最优执行调度，零搜索时间；(3) 基于结构哈希运行时，直接从计算结构合成细粒度内核。
AI.result: 在RTX 3060上，Nova在大多数TF32矩阵乘法形状上匹配或略微超越cuBLAS和XLA，相对误差小于5e-4；在4200万参数模型上比PyTorch吞吐量提升10.6%，比XLA提升4.4%；相对于PyTorch将内存占用降低最多29%，成功在12GB消费级GPU上以17,900 tokens/s训练了1.44亿参数模型（PyTorch在此场景下OOM失败）。
AI.conclusion: Nova通过确定性调度（非搜索）和结构驱动的内核合成，在无需牺牲数值精度的情况下实现比现有框架更高的吞吐量和更低的内存占用，使更大规模模型能在受限的消费级GPU硬件上完成训练。

title: Neural Circuit Function Inference with LLMs
summary: The success of connectome mapping now shifts the challenge of understanding the nervous system to the interpretation of neural circuits. Here, we devise a new automated method, LLantia (LLM automated neural circuit inference and analysis), to systematically infer neural circuit function and the role of its component neural cell types. Our approach distills descriptions of cell type function from the literature and, in combination with the connectome, then infers the function for all other cell types, which serves as a basis for subsequent neural circuit function inference. Results are structured hierarchically, with different possible circuit functions organised under multiple possible behavioural and physiological contexts, and each circuit function composed of subcircuit descriptions alongside relevant cell types to facilitate both backtracking to known, published information and support further experimental research. We illustrate our method by inferring cell type function for all cell types of the adult fruit fly brain and for select broader circuits within, and validate our findings, including by cross-checking with literature published after the release date of our analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为LLantia的自动化方法，利用大语言模型结合连接组数据，系统地推断神经回路功能及其组成细胞类型的功能。该方法从文献中提取细胞类型功能描述，结合连接组推断所有其他细胞类型的功能，并进一步推断神经回路功能，结果以层级结构组织。作者以成年果蝇大脑的所有细胞类型为例进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 连接组图谱绘制的成功将理解神经系统的挑战转移到了神经回路的解读上，但如何系统性地从连接组数据中推断神经回路功能仍是一个难题，需要自动化方法来应对这一挑战。
AI.method: LLantia方法包括两个主要步骤：首先从文献中提取细胞类型功能的描述，其次将这些描述与连接组数据结合，推断所有其他细胞类型的功能，并以此为基础进一步推断神经回路功能。结果按层级结构组织，将不同的回路功能归入多种可能的行为和生理情境下，每个回路功能由子回路描述和相关细胞类型构成。
AI.result: 该方法被应用于成年果蝇大脑的所有细胞类型以及其中选定的更广泛回路，并进行验证，包括与分析发布日期之后发表的新文献进行交叉核对。
AI.conclusion: LLantia方法能够自动化地推断神经回路功能，其层级结构化的结果既支持回溯到已知的已发表信息，也能为后续实验研究提供支持。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Auditing Spatial Provenance in Visual Token Pruning for OCR-Critical MLLM Inference
comment: 21 pages, including supplementary material. Code and reproducibility artifacts: https://github.com/SouthWinter/spatial-provenance-audit
summary: Visual-token pruning is usually judged by answer quality at a fixed retention budget. For text-rich multimodal large language models (MLLMs), this protocol can miss a distinct failure: an answer remains correct even when no retained token is locally traceable to the small OCR region that supports it. We turn this blind spot into an evidence-risk audit that couples answer behavior with geometric token-origin provenance, interventions, and realized cost; transparent training-free selectors isolate controlled operating points. On locked image-disjoint confirmation, Qwen Target at 30% retention has observed accuracy 0.786 versus 0.783 for Full (paired image-cluster difference +0.003, 95% CI [-0.014, +0.020]), yet same-budget Target, Random, and Grid retain sharply different positive-support coverage: 0.620, 0.270, and 0.318. Across Qwen3-VL-8B, LLaVA-1.5-7B, and InternVL3.5-8B, matched controls, interventions, detector tests, and external methods reveal model-specific quality-risk-traceability frontiers that accuracy alone does not expose. Materialized prefixes yield up to 4.32x batch-prefill speedup and 76.4% lower incremental peak memory; full-validation TextVQA and DocVQA further show that favorable target-verification points do not imply task-general compression. Visual-token pruning should therefore report surviving spatial provenance and realized cost alongside quality and compression.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的视觉token剪枝评估协议——"证据风险审计"，将答案行为与几何token来源追踪、干预和实际成本相结合。研究发现，即使答案质量不变，不同剪枝方法在保留证据覆盖率上差异巨大（Target 0.620 vs Random 0.270 vs Grid 0.318），现有评估标准无法揭示这一盲区。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉token剪枝评估仅在固定保留预算下判断答案质量，但对于文本密集型多模态大语言模型，可能存在"答案正确但没有任何保留token可追溯到支撑答案的OCR区域"的失败模式，即答案与证据脱节，现有协议无法捕捉这一缺陷。
AI.method: 提出"证据风险审计"框架：耦合答案行为与几何token来源追踪、干预测试和实际成本计算；使用透明无训练的剪枝选择器隔离可控工作点；在锁定的图像不相交确认集上，通过配对图像簇差异、95%置信区间、检测器测试和外部方法对比，系统评估模型特定的质量-风险-可追踪性边界。
AI.result: Qwen Target在30%保留率下准确率0.786与Full的0.783相当（差异+0.003），但同预算下Target、Random、Grid的正支持覆盖率差异显著（0.620 vs 0.270 vs 0.318）。跨三个模型验证发现模型特定的质量-风险-可追踪性边界；物化前缀实现最多4.32倍批量预填充加速和76.4%增量峰值内存降低；TextVQA和DocVQA全验证表明目标验证点不意味着任务通用压缩。
AI.conclusion: 视觉token剪枝评估应同时报告保留的空间来源证明（provenance）和实际成本，而不仅仅是质量和压缩率；仅依赖准确率指标会掩盖证据覆盖不足的关键风险。

title: SIRIN: A Unified Toolkit for Detecting Contextual Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented and Memory-Grounded LLM Systems
summary:
SIRIN (Semantic Inconsistency Recognition and Inspection Nexus) is a unified toolkit and interactive web UI for detecting contextual hallucinations (fluent, plausible responses unsupported by the provided evidence) in retrieval-augmented, agentic, and memory-grounded LLM systems. SIRIN unifies three detector paradigms (representation probing, uncertainty estimation, and judge-style verification) and the complementary task of pre-generation query answerability under one interface, configuration system, and evaluation pipeline, supporting response- and span-level inspection in both white-box and black-box settings. The web UI enables live analysis of user-supplied context-query-answer triples through hallucination scores, unsupported-span highlighting, and side-by-side detector comparison, with a lightweight plug-in design for adding new detectors. We demonstrate SIRIN on hallucination detection, query answerability, and as a faithfulness gate within long-term memory systems.
  The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/sb-ai-lab/SIRIN.

AI.tldr: SIRIN是一个统一的工具包和交互式Web界面，用于检测检索增强、智能体和记忆接地LLM系统中的上下文幻觉，统一了三种检测器范式和查询可回答性任务，支持白盒/黑盒设置下的响应级和片段级检查。
AI.motivation: 检索增强、智能体和记忆接地LLM系统容易产生上下文幻觉——即流畅但缺乏证据支持的响应。现有检测方法分散且缺乏统一接口，需要整合不同检测范式并提供实用的交互工具。
AI.method: SIRIN统一了三种检测器范式：表示探测、不确定性估计和裁判式验证；同时集成生成前查询可回答性任务。提供统一接口、配置系统和评估管道，支持白盒与黑盒设置下的响应级和片段级检查。Web UI支持用户上传上下文-查询-答案三元组的实时分析，包括幻觉评分、不支持片段高亮和并排检测器比较，并采用轻量级插件设计便于添加新检测器。
AI.result: 在幻觉检测、查询可回答性以及作为长期记忆系统中的忠实度门控等方面进行了演示，源代码已公开在GitHub上。
AI.conclusion: SIRIN为LLM系统中的上下文幻觉检测提供了一个统一、可扩展且交互友好的解决方案，通过整合多种检测范式并支持可视化分析，有助于提升LLM输出的忠实度和可靠性。

title: LLM-OSDA: An Optimal-Stopping Dynamic Auction for Native Advertising in Multi-Turn LLM Conversations
comment: 14 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to the 41st AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI 2027)
summary: LLM-native advertising embeds sponsored content directly into model-generated responses, shifting the unit of sale from a fixed slot to a moment within an evolving conversation. Existing LLM ad-auction mechanisms primarily operate within a single response, settling the winner but not the timing. The extension is nontrivial: with one native insertion opportunity per session, the stopping time depends on bids, coupling timing with allocation, so static truthfulness arguments no longer apply. We propose the LLM-based Optimal Stopping Dynamic Auction (LLM-OSDA), a dynamic cost-per-click auction that integrates Bellman optimal stopping, winner allocation, and envelope pricing. A bid-independent LLM layer estimates contextual click quality and seamlessly renders the winning ad, while bids enter only the committed auction mechanism. Under an exact Bellman oracle, the expected discounted-click allocation is monotone in each advertiser's bid, and the corresponding envelope payment makes truthful bidding weakly dominant in expectation. For practical deployment, a learned StopNet approximates the Bellman action values. We show that its decisions differ from the optimal policy only near the stopping boundary and bound the resulting incentive loss in terms of its approximation error. Experiments on a simulated conversational advertising corpus show that LLM-OSDA improves net revenue by 11 percent over the strongest fixed-timing baseline while maintaining comparable user retention. Code is at https://github.com/2025Fang2025/llm-osda.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLM-OSDA，一种面向LLM原生广告的动态点击成本拍卖机制，将贝尔曼最优停止与拍卖分配和信封定价相结合，以解决"何时插入广告"与"谁赢得广告位"的耦合决策问题。
AI.motivation: LLM原生广告将广告嵌入模型生成内容中，销售单位从固定广告位转变为对话中动态时刻。现有LLM广告拍卖机制仅在单次响应内运作，确定赢家却不决定插入时机。由于每会话仅有一次原生插入机会，停止时间取决于出价，将时序与分配耦合，使静态真实性论证不再适用，需要新的动态拍卖机制。
AI.method: 提出LLM-OSDA动态每次点击费用拍卖机制，整合三部分：1) 贝尔曼最优停止决定广告插入时机；2) 赢家分配机制；3) 信封定价保证真实性。一个与出价无关的LLM层估计上下文点击质量并渲染广告，出价仅进入承诺的拍卖机制。在精确贝尔曼预言机下，期望折扣点击分配随广告主出价单调，对应信封支付使真实出价成为弱占优策略。实际部署中，StopNet近似贝尔曼动作值，仅在停止边界附近偏离最优策略，其激励损失由近似误差界定。
AI.result: 在模拟对话广告语料上的实验表明，LLM-OSDA相比最强的固定时机的基线方法，净收入提升11%，同时保持可比的用户留存率。
AI.conclusion: LLM-OSDA是首个将最优停止理论融入LLM广告拍卖的机制，在保证真实性约束的前提下解决了"何时展示"与"展示什么"的联合优化问题，为LLM原生广告生态提供了理论基础和可部署方案。

title: Device-First Feedback: Toward Mobile-Native LLM-Driven Neural Architecture Search
summary: Deploying convolutional neural networks generated by large language models (LLMs) on real mobile hardware requires more than GPU validation accuracy: INT8 TensorFlow Lite export, delegate selection, and on-device latency jointly determine whether a model is usable. We present an automated mobile deployment pipeline that closes the loop from QLoRA fine-tuning of an architecture-generating LLM through GPU evaluation, INT8 export, and physical-device benchmarking to gated augmentation of the training corpus. The pipeline is fully scripted and runs cycle-by-cycle without manual intervention, with resume support after interruptions. We evaluate the same frozen protocol on two benchmarks, CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, on a Samsung SM-P613 tablet (seed 42, 20 models per cycle, cycles 0-6). On CIFAR-10, cycle 1 is gate-accepted and improves the mobile deployment score approximately 25.6x over the baseline with a mean quantized accuracy of 46.9%; later cycles raise GPU accuracy but fail the non-decreasing mobile gate. On CIFAR-100, the pre-QLoRA baseline retains the best mobile score; iterative rounds improve GPU accuracy (up to 26.2%) yet cannot surpass cycle 0 on-device, and the training pool stalls at 19 examples after the first accepted round. Together, the two studies show that closed-loop GPU fine-tuning does not guarantee monotonic mobile gains, especially on harder classification tasks, and that multi-dataset, on-device measurement is needed to stress-test deployment objectives. We release per-cycle metrics with 95% confidence intervals, all figures, and complete reproduction commands.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自动化移动端部署流水线，将QLoRA微调架构生成LLM、GPU评估、INT8导出和真实设备基准测试闭环连接起来。在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上的实验表明，闭环GPU微调不能保证移动端性能的单调提升，尤其是在更难的分类任务上。
AI.motivation: 通过LLM生成卷积神经网络并在真实移动硬件上部署时，仅关注GPU验证精度是不够的，INT8 TensorFlow Lite导出、委托选择和设备延迟共同决定模型是否可用。现有方法缺乏从训练到真实设备评估的自动化闭环。
AI.method: 构建全自动移动部署流水线：QLoRA微调架构生成LLM→GPU评估→INT8导出→物理设备基准测试→门控数据增强循环训练语料库。流水线完全脚本化，支持中断恢复，无需人工干预，逐周期运行。在Samsung SM-P613平板上对CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100两个基准执行相同冻结协议（20个模型/周期，周期0-6）。
AI.result: CIFAR-10上，周期1通过门控并被接受，移动部署得分较基线提升约25.6倍，平均量化精度46.9%；后续周期虽提升GPU精度但未通过非递减移动门控。CIFAR-100上，预QLoRA基线保持最优移动分数；迭代轮次提升GPU精度（最高26.2%）但无法超越周期0的设备端表现，训练池在首次接受后停滞在19个示例。
AI.conclusion: 闭环GPU微调不能保证移动端性能的单调提升，尤其是在更难的任务上。多数据集、真实设备端测量对于检验部署目标至关重要。

title: Linguistic Context Recodes Visual Representations in Vision-Language Models
summary: Goal-directed visual processing is a hallmark of human visual intelligence, resulting in representations that support downstream tasks such as categorization or search. Though vision-language models (VLMs) are often faced with these same tasks, their ability to recode visual representations when presented with goal-directed language remains poorly characterized. Indeed, prior work largely treats visual representations in VLMs as static repositories of visual information that are manipulated by language representations. In the present work, we provide evidence for two concrete instances of language-induced recoding of visual representations. First, we identify an abstract reference representation that denotes which objects are goal-relevant under a natural language prompt. We extract contrastive steering vectors corresponding to this reference representation and demonstrate that they are causally implicated in model predictions. These reference representations are abstract in that they generalize to different objects, different task contexts, and even from synthetic to naturalistic images. Second, we demonstrate language-induced attribute modulation: later layers selectively amplify goal-relevant attributes in visual representations of objects. We demonstrate this phenomenon across a range of different prompts. Finally, we provide a causal intervention that demonstrates that attribute modulation mediates a VLM's response distribution. Together, our results support a more dynamic account of cross-modality processing in VLMs -- rather than vision tokens serving as static repositories of information, they are modulated to support queries articulated in language.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了视觉语言模型（VLMs）中语言如何因果性地重新编码视觉表征。研究发现两种具体的语言诱导视觉重编码机制：抽象的参考表示（识别目标相关对象）和属性调制（选择性放大目标相关属性），并通过因果干预证明这些机制确实影响模型预测。
AI.motivation: 以往研究将VLM中的视觉表征视为静态的信息仓库，由语言表征对其进行操作，但语言引导视觉重编码的能力尚未被充分刻画。研究者希望揭示目标导向语言如何动态重塑视觉表征，从而更深入地理解VLM的跨模态处理机制。
AI.method: 研究者提取了对应参考表示的对比梯度向量（steering vectors），通过因果干预实验验证其对模型预测的作用；同时分析了后续层中目标相关属性的选择性强调制现象，并进行了因果干预以证明属性调制介导了VLM的响应分布。
AI.result: 发现了两种语言诱导的视觉表征重编码：一是抽象的参考表示，可泛化到不同对象、不同任务情境，甚至从合成图像泛化到自然图像；二是属性调制，在不同提示下均表现出后层对目标相关属性的选择性放大。因果干预证明了这两种机制均因果地影响模型预测。
AI.conclusion: VLM中的视觉表征并非静态信息仓库，而是会被语言动态调制以支持查询任务。这支持了跨模态处理的动态模型：视觉token会根据语言目标被重编码，以更好地支持下游任务。

title: DiffusionGemma Technical Report
summary: We introduce DiffusionGemma, an experimental open-weight language model that uses discrete diffusion to generate text at exceptionally high speed. Rather than decoding one token at a time, DiffusionGemma iteratively refines blocks of 256 tokens in parallel, avoiding the sequential decoding bottleneck of conventional autoregressive (AR) large language models. Instead of training from scratch, we obtain DiffusionGemma by fine-tuning the mixture-of-experts Gemma 4 model with 3.8B activated and 25.2B total parameters. Our compute-efficient two-stage training pipeline uses fewer than 10% of the starting AR model's total training token budget. The first stage uses supervised fine-tuning to teach bidirectional denoising, while the second stage combines reinforcement learning with sampler distillation to jointly improve generation quality and inference efficiency. DiffusionGemma establishes a new Pareto frontier for the trade-off between generation speed and model capability. Averaged across our full evaluation suite, it generates around 20 tokens per forward pass and achieves roughly 1,500 output tokens per second on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU, which is substantially faster than AR models even with state-of-the-art speculative decoding. DiffusionGemma also retains the starting model's support for thinking mode, multimodal inputs, and long contexts. Despite diffusion fine-tuning, it remains capable of AR generation with only minor performance degradation, suggesting a path toward hybrid diffusion-AR decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DiffusionGemma，一种基于离散扩散的开源语言模型，通过并行迭代细化256个token块而非逐个解码，大幅提升文本生成速度。该模型通过对Gemma 4 MoE模型（3.8B激活参数、25.2B总参数）进行微调获得，训练预算不足原始模型总训练token的10%。采用两阶段训练流程：第一阶段用监督微调教授双向去噪，第二阶段结合强化学习与采样器蒸馏改善生成质量和推理效率。在单个H100 GPU上约每秒生成1500个token，建立了生成速度与模型能力之间的新帕累托前沿。
AI.motivation: 传统自回归（AR）大语言模型逐个token顺序解码，存在推理速度瓶颈（sequential decoding bottleneck）。研究者希望突破这一限制，通过离散扩散模型实现并行解码，同时避免从零训练的高昂成本，利用现有AR模型进行高效微调。
AI.method: 采用两阶段计算高效训练流程：（1）第一阶段使用监督微调（SFT）教授模型双向去噪能力；（2）第二阶段结合强化学习（RL）与采样器蒸馏，联合优化生成质量和推理效率。基础模型为Gemma 4 MoE模型（3.8B激活/25.2B总参数），通过离散扩散机制每次并行迭代细化256个token块。
AI.result: DiffusionGemma在完整评估套件上平均每次前向生成约20个token，在单个NVIDIA H100 GPU上达到约1500输出token/秒，显著快于即使采用最先进推测解码的AR模型，建立了生成速度与能力的帕累托前沿。同时保留思考模式、多模态输入和长上下文支持，且仍能以轻微性能下降进行AR生成。
AI.conclusion: DiffusionGemma验证了通过微调现有AR模型获得高性能扩散语言模型的可行性，为混合扩散-AR解码提供了新路径，表明扩散模型在保持能力的同时可大幅提升生成速度。

title: LeapTalk: Breaking the Latency-Quality Trade-off in Talking Head Generation
summary: Long-form and real-time talking-head generation remains challenging due to a latency-quality trade-off: inefficient multi-step diffusion prohibits streaming generation, whereas real-time autoregressive approaches suffer from error accumulation and identity drift. To address this drawback, we propose LeapTalk, a novel framework that achieves stable and real-time talking-head generation with a single forward step, scaling to arbitrarily long videos. At the heart of our approach lies a single-step bridge distillation scheme. On the one hand, departing from the conventional noise-to-data paradigm, we introduce a data-to-data transport formulation based on a Brownian bridge. Anchored by a persistent reference, this strategy effectively mitigates identity drift and enhances long-term temporal stability. On the other hand, to enable smooth knowledge transfer from a pre-trained diffusion teacher to the student bridge model, we explore a heterogeneous distillation framework with an SNR-aligned time transformation $Φ(τ)$, which bridges the functional discrepancy between the two models. Moreover, we propose an audio-driven classifier-free guidance mechanism to maintain fine-grained lip synchronization under extreme step reduction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves high-fidelity and temporally consistent video generation with only 1 step at up to 200 FPS, significantly outperforming existing approaches in both efficiency and stability. Project Page: https://zhangrongxiang.github.io/leaptalk-page/

AI.tldr: LeapTalk是一个单步桥式蒸馏框架，通过数据到数据的Brownian bridge传输和SNR对齐时间变换，实现了稳定且实时的长视频说话头生成，仅需1步即可达到200 FPS，有效缓解了身份漂移和误差累积问题。
AI.motivation: 长视频和实时说话头生成面临延迟-质量权衡：多步扩散模型推理效率低无法支持流式生成，而实时自回归方法存在误差累积和身份漂移问题。
AI.method: 1) 提出单步桥式蒸馏方案，采用基于Brownian bridge的数据到数据传输范式（而非传统噪声到数据），以持久参考锚定生成过程，缓解身份漂移并增强长期时间稳定性；2) 提出异质蒸馏框架，通过SNR对齐的时间变换Φ(τ)弥合预训练扩散教师与学生桥模型之间的功能差异；3) 提出音频驱动的classifier-free guidance机制，在极端步数缩减下保持细粒度的唇部同步。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法仅需1步推理即可生成高保真和时间一致的视频，速度可达200 FPS，在效率和稳定性上显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: LeapTalk通过创新的桥式蒸馏和异构知识迁移设计，成功打破了长视频说话头生成中实时性与质量之间的权衡瓶颈，为流式长视频生成提供了可行方案。

title: RAG-TESTER: Automated End-to-End Testing of Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to use external and domain-specific knowledge, but its reliability depends on the interaction between the generative model, embedding model, retrieval mechanism, and prompt construction strategy. We present RagTester, an automated end-to-end testing approach for RAG systems. RagTester generates retrieval documents, test inputs, and expected outputs; executes the tests; and evaluates the resulting answers using an LLM as a judge. Its test-generation strategy targets complex passages, unsupported queries, and document-coverage criteria. We evaluate RagTester using eight LLMs and six embedding models, yielding 24 compatible configurations, and compare it with a baseline test-input generator. Across 72,000 test executions, RagTester detected 21,633 failures, 6.6% more than the baseline, and outperformed it in 20 of the 24 configurations. The detected failures include inaccurate retrieval, unsupported answers, incomplete use of retrieved context, and difficulties interpreting complex passages. These results show that coverage-oriented test generation can effectively expose failures caused by the interaction between retrieval and generation components and support the assessment of RAG configurations before deployment.

AI.tldr: RagTester是一个面向RAG系统的自动化端到端测试方法，通过生成检索文档、测试输入和预期输出，利用LLM作为评判者评估答案。在72,000次测试执行中检测到21,633个失败，比基线多6.6%，并在24个配置中的20个上表现更优。
AI.motivation: RAG系统使LLM能够使用外部领域知识，但其可靠性依赖于生成模型、嵌入模型、检索机制和提示构建策略之间的复杂交互。目前缺乏针对这种端到端交互的自动化测试方法。
AI.method: RagTester自动化端到端测试RAG系统，包括：生成检索文档、测试输入和预期输出；执行测试；使用LLM作为裁判评估答案。其测试生成策略针对复杂段落、不支持查询和文档覆盖标准设计。
AI.result: 使用8个LLM和6个嵌入模型构建24个兼容配置进行评估，对比基线测试输入生成器。在72,000次测试执行中，RagTester检测到21,633个失败（比基线多6.6%），在24个配置中的20个上表现更优。检测到的失败包括不准确检索、无根据答案、检索上下文使用不完整以及复杂段落解读困难。
AI.conclusion: 面向覆盖的测试生成能有效暴露检索与生成组件交互引起的失败，支持RAG配置在部署前的评估。

title: A Constitution-Grid Instrument for Data-Efficient RL Alignment (C-Guard)
summary: Conflicting objectives are general in RL alignment, and training on them data-efficiently is hard.
