Training a safety guard with RL means optimizing two objectives that conflict: catch real harm, and do not refuse benign prompts. Our finding is that over-refusal improves 22.4% to 12.8%, while under-refusal on adversarial attacks silently worsens 0.27 to 0.33. We present C-Guard, a constitution-grid instrument that generates the RL training data, and C-LIM, a per-cell learnability score that decides each cell's move: prune, densify, amend, expand. C-LIM flags the dead-weight data region before any training budget is spent: 187 untargeted rows had bought zero gain, and our method lifts the same region's learning impact 0.733 to 0.80. Code and the constitution are open-sourced.

AI.tldr: 本文提出C-Guard与C-LIM框架，用于在RL对齐中高效权衡冲突目标（拒绝有害内容与不过度拒绝良性提示），通过宪法网格生成训练数据，并用可学习性评分决定每个数据单元的处理策略（剪枝、加密、修正、扩展），显著改善了过度拒绝与对抗攻击下的拒绝率平衡。
AI.motivation: RL对齐中存在互相冲突的目标（如安全防护需同时捕获真实危害和避免拒绝良性提示），在这些冲突目标上进行数据高效训练非常困难，现有方法难以兼顾两者。
AI.method: 提出C-Guard（宪法网格仪器）生成RL训练数据，以及C-LIM（逐单元可学习性评分）决定每个单元的动作：剪枝（prune）、加密（densify）、修正（amend）、扩展（expand）；C-LIM可在训练预算投入前识别低价值数据区域。
AI.result: 过度拒绝率从22.4%改善至12.8%；对抗性攻击下的拒绝不足（under-refusal）从0.27恶化至0.33的现象被缓解；187条未被利用的无目标数据行被识别，该区域的学习影响从0.733提升至0.80。
AI.conclusion: C-Guard与C-LIM能有效提升RL对齐中冲突目标的训练数据效率，在训练前即可识别低价值数据区域以节省预算，代码与宪法数据已开源。

title: Beyond Edge Maps: Wavelet-Domain Conditioning for Multi-Adapter Map-to-Satellite Diffusion
summary: Commercial mapping partnerships are often unavailable in low-resource regions, leaving satellite basemaps stale and motivating synthesis of satellite imagery from independently maintained cartographic data. Existing ControlNet-based diffusion methods typically condition on structural signals like edges or segmentation extracted from the target image itself, assuming the imagery already exists and limiting their use exactly where synthesis matters most. Map-conditioned alternatives add cues like edge detection but omit frequency-domain structure. We propose a ControlNet-based diffusion framework conditioned only on cartographic sources obtainable independently of the target imagery: OpenStreetMap (OSM) raster maps and their stationary wavelet transform (SWT) subbands, a conditioning signal previously unexplored for map-to-satellite diffusion. Two ControlNet adapters, trained separately on the map and wavelet representations atop a frozen Stable Diffusion backbone, are fused via MultiControlNet, jointly drawing on spatial structure and frequency detail without retraining a multi-input model. We evaluate on a new paired map-satellite dataset curated for Nepal, a data-scarce, topographically diverse region, alongside the Pix2Pix maps-satellite benchmark. Combined conditioning wins six of eight metric-dataset comparisons -- SSIM and PSNR on both datasets, plus LPIPS (both Alex and VGG backbones) on ours and ties map-only on both Pix2Pix LPIPS backbones while still edging past wavelet-only there. Wavelet-only takes the lowest FID on both datasets, matching the tradeoff between per-image fidelity and distributional realism. We treat this gap cautiously given our modest test-set sizes and FID's known small-sample bias.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于ControlNet的扩散框架，仅依赖可从独立来源获取的制图数据（OSM栅格地图及其静态小波变换子带）来合成卫星影像，无需目标影像本身的结构信号。通过双ControlNet适配器融合空间结构与频率域信息，在尼泊尔等低资源区域的数据集上取得较好效果。
AI.motivation: 商业制图合作在低资源区域往往不可用，导致卫星底图过期，因此需要从独立维护的制图数据合成卫星影像。现有ControlNet方法依赖目标影像自身的结构信号（边缘或分割），限制了其在最需要合成场景中的使用；已有的地图条件方法忽略了频域结构信息。
AI.method: 提出ControlNet扩散框架，仅以OSM栅格地图及其静态小波变换（SWT）子带作为条件信号。两个ControlNet适配器分别在地图和波尔表征上单独训练（基于冻结的Stable Diffusion主干），通过MultiControlNet融合，联合利用空间结构与频率细节，无需重训多输入模型。在尼泊尔新构建的配对地图-卫星数据集及Pix2Pix基准上评估。
AI.result: 组合条件在八个指标-数据集比较中赢得六项：两个数据集的SSIM和PSNR均最佳，自身数据集的LPIPS（Alex和VGG骨干）最佳，并在Pix2Pix的LPIPS上与地图单条件持平；小波单条件在两个数据集上取得最低FID，体现单图保真度与分布真实性之间的权衡。鉴于测试集规模较小和FID小样本偏差，作者对此差距持谨慎态度。
AI.conclusion: 结合地图空间结构与频率域小波信息的地图到卫星影像合成方法在多数指标上优于仅用单类条件的方案，为低资源区域的卫星影像合成提供了可行途径，同时指出FID指标在小样本下的局限性需谨慎解读。

title: Averaging Bias: Human Faithfulness Annotations are not Locally Faithful
summary: Evaluation of faithfulness of text summarization treats a model generated summary as faithful only if every of its sentences is supported by the source document: a strict conjunctive rule under which a single unsupported sentence makes the whole summary unfaithful. Yet most faithfulness benchmarks collect only one global human annotation label per summary. We ask whether such global human labels actually implement the conjunctive rule. We hypothesize that annotators may accept a summary as faithful when most sentences are faithful, not only when all are faithful. To test our hypothesis, we use five large language model (LLM) judges as per-sentence raters across four widely used faithfulness benchmarks. We find that global human labels correlate better with the average of per-sentence LLM judgments than with the implementation of the strict conjunctive rule. A manual review confirms that a substantial fraction of summaries labeled faithful by humans contain genuine local factual errors. We call this tendency Averaging Bias. Our results reveal that human labels on widely used faithfulness benchmarks contain measurable Averaging Bias, calling for carefully structured designs for trustworthy human annotations

AI.tldr: 本文发现广泛使用的文本摘要忠实度基准中，人工标注的全局标签并非严格遵循"逐句全对才忠实"的合取规则，而是更接近对逐句判断取平均的结果，作者将这一现象称为"Averaging Bias"（平均偏差），并呼吁设计更严谨的人工标注方案。
AI.motivation: 文本摘要忠实度评估的黄金标准假设是：摘要忠实当且仅当每一句话都被原文支持（严格合取规则）。然而现有基准仅收集一个全局人工标签，作者质疑这些全局标签是否真正实现了合取规则，并假设人类标注者可能倾向于在"大多数句子忠实"时就判定摘要忠实，而非要求全部句子都忠实。
AI.method: 使用五个大型语言模型（LLM）作为逐句评分器，在四个广泛使用的忠实度基准上，将全局人工标签分别与（1）逐句LLM判断的平均值，以及（2）严格合取规则的实施结果进行相关性比较；同时通过人工复审验证被判定为忠实的摘要中是否包含真实的局部事实错误。
AI.result: 实验发现，全局人工标签与逐句LLM判断的平均值相关性更高，而非与严格合取规则的实施结果相关；人工复审也证实，相当大比例被人类标记为忠实的摘要中确实存在真实的局部事实错误，这表明Averaging Bias在现有基准中普遍存在。
AI.conclusion: 现有忠实度基准中的人类标注存在可测量的平均偏差（Averaging Bias），这与预设的严格合取规则不符，因此需要重新设计人工标注的结构和协议，以获取更可信的忠实度标注数据。

title: From Pixels to PCells: A Neurosymbolic Approach to Photonic Component Creation
summary: We present PixCell, a neurosymbolic system in which multimodal agents convert a visually presented photonic component into a parametric program over a small domain-specific language (DSL) of geometric primitives. A system enabling deterministic visual verification renders evaluation asymmetrically cheaper than the generation attempt. While models using multi-seed sampling and iterative revision reach a mean best-turn IoU of only 0.416, multimodal agents through PixCell's interface and verifier consistently exceed 0.9 mean IoU, with scores reaching 0.974 and 0.955 across eight component targets while also satisfying source contracts. These results demonstrate that frontier multimodal agents can reliably understand and render executable parametric representations from visual targets. Using these live parameters, cross-stack studies on an interferometer reconstruct primitive programs that satisfy an 8.0 nm free spectral range target and the original footprint constraint on modeled 220-nm SOI, 400-nm SiN, and 400-nm TFLN stacks. PixCell further carries a paper-derived splitter from visual reconstruction through SOI full-wave simulation, producing symmetric propagation and balanced outputs. Finally, the same executable verifier supplies a training reward and dataset used to train a Qwen3.6-35B-A3B model with LoRA and GRPO without supervised demonstrations. On eight training-excluded paper figures, its mean champion IoU rises from 0.422 after eight initial attempts to 0.491 after three verifier-guided revision rounds. These results therefore establish a controlled framework for measuring, retargeting, and improving visual-to-parametric photonic component design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PixCell，一种神经符号系统，利用多模态智能体将视觉呈现的光子元件转换为基于几何原语DSL的参数化程序。通过确定性视觉验证器将评估成本降至低于生成成本，系统在多个光子元件目标上平均IoU超过0.9（最高达0.974），远超多种子采样+迭代修正方法的0.416。系统还能跨不同材料平台重构原始程序、从论文图像重建分光器并完成全波仿真验证，并利用可执行验证器为Qwen3.6-35B-A3B模型提供训练奖励和数据集，在无监督演示条件下将IoU从0.422提升至0.491。
AI.motivation: 光子元件设计从视觉目标到可执行参数化表示的转换具有重要价值，但现有方法（多种子采样和迭代修正）效果有限（平均IoU仅0.416）。作者希望建立一种可控框架，使多模态智能体能够可靠地理解和渲染可执行参数化表示，同时支持测量、重定目标和改进视觉到参数的转换过程。
AI.method: PixCell采用神经符号架构：多模态智能体将视觉光子元件转换为DSL（领域特定语言）中的参数化程序；设计确定性视觉验证器使评估比生成更便宜；利用多智能体界面和验证器进行迭代修订；可执行验证器同时作为训练奖励和数据集来源，用于对Qwen3.6-35B-A3B模型进行LoRA和GRPO训练（无需监督演示）。
AI.result: PixCell在八个元件目标上平均IoU超过0.9（最高0.974和0.955）并满足源合约；跨堆栈研究在220-nm SOI、400-nm SiN和400-nm TFLN上成功重构满足8.0 nm自由光谱范围和原始足迹约束的干涉仪程序；论文分光器经重建和SOI全波仿真产生对称传播和平衡输出；经验证器引导的模型训练将平均冠军IoU从0.422提升至0.491。
AI.conclusion: PixCell建立了一个可控框架，用于测量、重定目标和改进视觉到参数化的光子元件设计。实验表明前沿多模态智能体能够可靠理解视觉目标并生成可执行参数化表示，且验证器引导的强化训练能有效提升模型性能，为光子元件自动化设计提供了新的范式。

title: Agentic Coding in the Wild: Characterizing GitHub Copilot Traces at Production Scale
summary:
AI coding agents like GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and Codex interleave multi-step LLM inference with tool execution, creating a workload different from chatbots. We present the first production-scale characterization of this workload using sampled GitHub Copilot traces from June 2026, comprising 3.2M users, 13M sessions, 761M LLM calls, and 95T tokens.
  Our analysis reveals distinctive workload properties with important systems implications. For example, agentic coding sessions consist of sparse user-initiated turns, each unfolding into an autonomous agent loop of LLM calls almost always coupled with tool execution. This structure yields KV cache hit rates averaging 90% within a turn, but falling to 55\% across turn boundaries and drastically invalidated after events like model switches or context compaction. Diverse workflows and user behaviors are observed with variable and long-tailed token consumption, time span, and tool calls. We highlight the difference between quick agentic turnaround times and the minutes-long user idle periods at turn boundaries, and design a lightweight idle-time predictor that captures 86-90\% of total idle time, enabling proactive decisions for efficient resource orchestration. These findings challenge assumptions underlying current LLM-serving systems and provide an empirical foundation for agent-native infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对AI编程代理（如GitHub Copilot）的生产级工作负载进行了大规模特征分析，基于2026年6月采样数据（320万用户、1300万会话、7.61亿次LLM调用、95万亿token），揭示了与聊天机器人截然不同的工作负载特征，并提出了轻量级空闲时间预测器以支持资源编排优化。
AI.motivation: AI编程代理（如GitHub Copilot、Claude Code、Codex）将多步LLM推理与工具执行交织在一起，形成了与传统聊天机器人完全不同的工作负载模式。然而，现有LLM服务系统大多基于聊天场景设计，缺乏对这种新型工作负载的量化和分析，因此需要对其特征进行系统性刻画，为代理原生基础设施的设计提供实证基础。
AI.method: 基于2026年6月从GitHub Copilot采样的生产环境追踪数据（涵盖320万用户、1300万会话、7.61亿次LLM调用和95万亿token），对代理式编码工作负载进行系统性特征分析。分析维度包括：会话结构（用户回合与自主代理循环）、KV缓存命中率（回合内/跨回合/模型切换/上下文压缩场景）、token消耗分布、时间跨度、工具调用模式、往返时延与用户空闲期等，并设计了轻量级空闲时间预测器评估资源编排的可行性。
AI.result: 研究发现：1）代理式编码会话由稀疏的用户回合组成，每个回合展开为自主代理循环，LLM调用几乎总是伴随工具执行；2）回合内KV缓存命中率平均达90%，但跨回合降至55%，在模型切换或上下文压缩后大幅失效；3）工作流和用户行为呈现多样化的长尾分布；4）代理周转时间快速，但回合边界处用户空闲期长达数分钟；5）设计的空闲时间预测器能捕获86-90%的总空闲时间，可支持主动式资源编排决策。
AI.conclusion: 代理式编码工作负载的特征与聊天机器人存在本质差异，现有LLM服务系统的假设已不适用。本研究为代理原生基础设施的设计提供了实证基础，其中回合内高缓存命中率与跨回合缓存失效的矛盾、长尾行为分布以及可预测的用户空闲期，均为系统优化指明了关键方向。

title: DS@GT ARC at MEDIQA-CORE-Task-1 2026: Trimodal Model Fusion with Task-Specific Gates for Brain Tumor Subtype Classification
comment: CLEF 2026 Working Notes, 21 - 24 September 2026, Jena, Germany
summary: Brain tumor diagnosis is a time-sensitive process in which patients may wait weeks for a finalized pathology report. This problem motivates automated systems that classify tumor subtype from multimodal inputs. This paper details the DS@GT ARC team's work for ImageCLEFmed MEDIQA-CORE 2026 Task~1, Brain Tumor Subtype Classification. The task evaluates three glioma classification problems: Level-1 Molecular Type, LGG vs HGG, and WHO Grade. We combine pre-extracted MRI (NeuroVFM) and histopathology (Prov-GigaPath) embeddings with free-text radiology reports. Our team explored two trimodal fusion architectures, two report encoders (RadBERT and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct), and a biologically motivated post-processing stage. We achieve a mean macro-F1 of 0.801 under the Fully Multimodal condition, exceeding the organizers' baseline of 0.796 and ranking second among the teams whose code passed verification. Additional evaluation across modality-dropping conditions shows that this advantage depends heavily on the availability of the histopathology modality, and that our system falls behind the baseline when modalities are missing. Our code is available on GitHub at https://github.com/dsgt-arc/imageclef-mediqacore-2026.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了DS@GT ARC团队在ImageCLEFmed MEDIQA-CORE 2026任务1（脑肿瘤亚型分类）中的工作，通过融合MRI、组织病理学和放射学报告三种模态的嵌入进行胶质瘤分类，在完全多模态条件下达到0.801的平均macro-F1，超过基线并排名第二。
AI.motivation: 脑肿瘤诊断时间敏感，患者可能等待数周才能获得病理报告，因此需要自动化系统从多模态输入中分类肿瘤亚型以加速诊断过程。
AI.method: 将预提取的MRI嵌入（NeuroVFM）、组织病理学嵌入（Prov-GigaPath）与自由文本放射学报告相结合，探索了两种三模态融合架构、两种报告编码器（RadBERT和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct）以及生物学启发式的后处理阶段，针对三种胶质瘤分类问题（分子类型、LGG vs HGG、WHO分级）进行训练。
AI.result: 在完全多模态条件下达到0.801的平均macro-F1，超过组织者基线0.796，在代码通过验证的团队中排名第二。消融实验表明，该优势高度依赖组织病理学模态的可用性，缺少模态时系统性能落后于基线。
AI.conclusion: 三模态融合架构在完全数据条件下表现优异，但系统对组织病理学模态的依赖程度较高，在缺失模态场景下鲁棒性不足，仍需改进。

title: Can LLM Agents Price Competitively? A Dynamic Multi-Attribute Auction Benchmark for Agentic Commerce
summary: Agentic commerce is moving from concept to deployed infrastructure: payment networks, retailers, and AI platforms are setting the stage for agents to transact on behalf of merchants and consumers. Yet whether the LLMs behind these agents can price competently in real markets, where customer preferences are hidden, competitors adapt in real time, and demand can shift without warning, has not been systematically tested. We introduce Bazaar, a dynamic sealed-bid benchmark for multi-attribute auction under these conditions. Despite its dynamics, the benchmark is grounded in closed-form customer utilities, enabling exact evaluation. Across 11 frontier LLMs from four providers, the leading agents on customer acquisition (e.g. Gemini 3.1 Pro) are often not the leading agents on profit (e.g. Opus 4.6). The ranking shifts again under demand shocks: agents that learned fastest pre-shock are typically the slowest to revise their beliefs afterwards, while Gemini 3.1 Pro recovers fastest despite not leading on profit. However, even the strongest agent captures less than a third of hindsight-optimal profit, suggesting current LLMs are progressing in agentic commerce but leave substantial headroom.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍Bazaar基准测试，用于系统评估LLM智能体在多属性密封拍卖中的定价能力。测试发现前沿LLM在客户获取、利润和需求冲击恢复上的表现排名各不相同，且最强智能体也只能达到事后最优利润的三分之一以下。
AI.motivation: 智能体商务正从概念走向实际部署，但LLM智能体在真实市场条件下（隐藏客户偏好、实时竞争、需求突变）能否进行有效定价，尚未被系统测试。
AI.method: 提出Bazaar基准，一种动态密封拍卖基准，用于多属性拍卖测试。基准基于封闭式客户效用函数设计，支持精确评估。对来自四个提供商的11个前沿LLM进行测试。
AI.result: 不同LLM在客户获取、利润和需求冲击恢复上的排名不一致：如Gemini 3.1 Pro在客户获取领先但非利润领先者；需求冲击后学习最快的智能体最慢修正信念，而Gemini 3.1 Pro恢复最快。最强智能体仅捕获不到三分之一的事后最优利润。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在智能体商务方面取得进展，但仍存在显著的提升空间，远未达到最优定价水平。

title: A Few Neurons Reveal When LLMs Misuse Tools: Sparse Detection and Selective Steering for Reliable Tool Use
summary: Agentic LLMs exhibit three consequential tool-use failures: invalid arguments (validity), unnecessary calls (over-calling), and omitted calls when tools are needed (missing). We find that a small, failure-specific set of MLP neurons could distinguish such failures with linearly separable decision boundaries. Building on this observation, we introduce PRISMS (Probing Representations In Support of Monitoring and Steering), a closed-loop framework that shares a failure-specific neuron basis between sparse detection and activation steering. PRISMS selects contribution-critical MLP neurons and fits an L1-regularized detector on their activations. Across six models from the Qwen3, Llama, and Gemma families, over-calling and missing are detected at the pre-generation prompt boundary with ROC-AUC 0.90-1.00, while validity is detected from the generated tool-call span with ROC-AUC 0.86-0.90. These results are achieved with highly sparse readouts: only 1-2 MLP neurons for missing, 2-16 for over-calling, and approximately 128 for validity. These sparse detectors match or outperform dense residual-stream baselines using 23-627 times fewer features. The shared neuron basis also supports bidirectional control over tool-calling behavior, suppressing unnecessary calls and eliciting omitted ones. PRISMS therefore gates intervention on predicted failure risk to mitigate the collateral effects of unconditional steering. Across all six models, PRISMS reduces pooled over-calling rate by 80% (from 0.131 to 0.026) while increasing tool-required accuracy by 14.2 percentage points (from 0.689 to 0.831). PRISMS thus provides lightweight failure detection and selective intervention across model families.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRISMS框架，利用失败特定的MLP神经元实现稀疏检测与激活引导，在六个模型中检测工具调用失败（无效参数、过度调用、缺失调用），并通过预测性门控干预减少80%过度调用、提升14.2个百分点的工具必需准确率。
AI.motivation: Agentic LLM在工具调用中存在三类关键失败模式：无效参数、不必要的过度调用和必要的缺失调用。现有方法缺乏轻量级的失败检测与干预手段，且无条件引导会带来附带损害。
AI.method: 提出PRISMS闭环框架：识别贡献关键的MLP神经元，提取失败特定神经元基座，拟合L1正则化稀疏检测器；共享该神经元基座进行激活引导；根据预测的失败风险进行门控式干预。
AI.result: 在Qwen3、Llama和Gemma六个模型上，过度调用和缺失在生成前提示边界检测ROC-AUC达0.90-1.00，无效参数在工具调用跨度检测ROC-AUC达0.86-0.90；仅需1-2个神经元检测缺失、2-16个检测过度调用、约128个检测无效参数，比稠密残差基线少用23-627倍特征；池化过度调用率降低80%（0.131→0.026），工具必需准确率提升14.2个百分点（0.689→0.831）。
AI.conclusion: PRISMS提供跨模型家族的轻量级失败检测与选择性干预能力，证明失败模式在MLP神经元层面具有线性可分的稀疏表征，为实现可控、高效的工具调用行为提供了可行路径。

title: DODA: A Database of Datasets for Aesthetics Research
summary: With rapid growth in the fields of empirical and computational aesthetics we have seen a vast increase in large image datasets annotated for aesthetics. As the image databases differ widely in many respects (e.g., different standards for annotation), it can be tedious to find the dataset that fits one's research needs best. The absence of a centralized open-science search system causes additional problems. Currently, researchers typically share dataset links in papers or on diverse platforms like OSF, GitHub or Dropbox. Manually searching for details like image quality and content often requires downloading all datasets. Therefore, we present the Database Of Datasets for Aesthetics (DODA), an intuitive Web application in which researchers can browse all important datasets for aesthetics research. DODA provides general information about these datasets (size, resolution, type of annotation, number of annotators, etc.) and for many of them also precomputed quantitative image properties. We discuss relevant criteria for selecting a suitable dataset with DODA and illustrate the benefits of reusing datasets. Our approach facilitates collaboration across the fields of empirical and computational aesthetics. Keywords: empirical aesthetics, computational aesthetics, machine learning, image annotation, quantitative image properties, Open Science

AI.tldr: 本文提出了美学数据集数据库（DODA），一个旨在帮助研究人员浏览和选择美学研究数据集的Web应用。DODA提供了数据集的基本信息（如大小、分辨率、标注类型、标注者数量等）以及许多数据集的预计算量化图像属性，解决了美学领域数据集分散、缺乏集中式搜索系统的问题。
AI.motivation: 随着实证美学和计算美学领域的快速发展，大量美学标注图像数据集涌现，但这些数据集在标注标准等方面差异很大，且缺乏集中化的开放科学搜索系统。研究人员通常需要在论文或OSF、GitHub、Dropbox等平台上手动寻找数据集链接，并且需要下载所有数据集才能了解其细节，效率低下。
AI.method: 构建DODA（Database Of Datasets for Aesthetics），一个直观的Web应用程序，使研究人员能够浏览美学研究的所有重要数据集。DODA提供数据集的一般信息（大小、分辨率、标注类型、标注者数量等），并为许多数据集提供预计算的量化图像属性。论文还讨论了使用DODA选择合适数据集的相关标准，并展示了复用数据集的益处。
AI.result: DODA作为集中式数据集检索平台成功建立，为研究者提供了便捷的数据集浏览和筛选功能，预计算的量化图像属性使用户无需下载整个数据集即可了解图像质量和内容等信息。
AI.conclusion: DODA方法促进了实证美学和计算美学领域的跨领域协作，推动了数据集的复用，解决了美学研究领域中数据集搜索和信息获取的效率问题。

title: Shared Organizational Memory for Enterprise Coding Agents: System Design and Deployment Snapshot
summary: Enterprise coding agents rely on tools and retrieval, yet enterprise knowledge often remains outside public training data and formal documentation: internal DSLs, proprietary platforms, local conventions, recent fixes, and tacit workflows. Existing knowledge interfaces expose stored resources but still depend on agents recognizing and explicitly recording lessons worth reusing, disconnecting capture from the coding workflow and leaving development experience repeatedly rediscovered. We report an ongoing production deployment of a shared organizational memory system that makes capture a platform-level part of coding work: it collects task-adjacent experience with contributor approval, curates it into reusable question-answer memories, gates obvious security and privacy risks, and retrieves memories for future agents. This short paper describes the deployed lifecycle and an operational snapshot. Effects on retrieval and coding tasks remain under evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个企业级编码代理的组织共享记忆系统，将经验捕获作为平台级功能嵌入编码工作流中，通过贡献者批准收集任务相关经验，将其整理为可复用的问答记忆，并过滤安全与隐私风险后供未来代理检索使用。
AI.motivation: 企业编码代理所依赖的领域知识（内部DSL、专有平台、本地约定、近期修复、隐性工作流）往往不在公开训练数据或正式文档中，现有知识接口依赖代理主动识别和显式记录需要复用的经验，导致捕获与编码工作流脱节，开发经验被反复重新发现。
AI.method: 设计并部署了组织级共享记忆系统：(1)在平台层面收集任务相关的编码经验，需经贡献者批准；(2)将收集的经验整理为可复用的问答记忆；(3)对明显的安全与隐私风险进行门控过滤；(4)在未来的编码代理任务中检索并复用这些记忆。
AI.result: 本文报告了系统的生产部署生命周期及运营快照，但对检索效果和编码任务的影响仍在评估中，尚未给出定量实验结果。
AI.conclusion: 该共享记忆系统通过将经验捕获嵌入编码平台层面，解决了知识捕获与编码工作流脱节的问题，但系统对实际编码任务的提升效果仍需进一步评估验证。

title: Cross-Task Dissociation in Frontier Vision-Language Model Theory of Mind
summary: Do frontier vision-language models present a coherent Theory-of-Mind (ToM) profile across tasks, matching the same human reference group, or does that profile fragment from one paradigm to the next? We evaluate a shared panel of nine frontier VLMs on two psychology-derived benchmarks: the Keysar Director Task (visual perspective-taking under egocentric interference) and the Frith-Happé animated triangles scored with the Castelli rubric (intention attribution from pure motion). On the Director Task, without chain-of-thought, the panel makes the egocentric error on 78\% of trials like children rather than adults; variation is substantial across models, and reasoning rescues several models. On the triangles, the panel under-attributes intention: its ToM profile sits more than three times closer to the high-functioning-autistic-adult (HF-ASD) mean than to the typical-development-adult (TD) mean, while Goal-Directed and Random stay near TD. No model is nearest TD on both tasks; the model that looks adult-like on the Director Task falls on the HF-ASD side on the triangles, and the most TD-like model on the triangles is child-like on the Director Task. We report group-level descriptions, not diagnostic labels for any model.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了九个前沿视觉语言模型在两个心理学基准任务（Keysar导演任务和Frith-Happé动画三角形任务）上的心理理论（ToM）表现，发现模型在不同范式间的ToM画像并不一致：在导演任务上模型表现像儿童（78%的自我中心错误），在三角形任务上更接近高功能自闭症成人而非典型发育成人，没有模型能在两个任务上都接近典型发育成人。
AI.motivation: 现有研究大多在单一任务上评估VLM的ToM能力，但ToM是否在不同范式间保持一致尚不清楚。作者希望探究前沿VLMs是否能呈现连贯的心理理论画像，以及这种画像是否与人类参照群体匹配。
AI.method: 选取九个前沿VLMs，在两项心理学衍生基准上进行评估：Keysar导演任务（视觉视角采择，测试自我中心干扰）和Frith-Happé动画三角形任务（用Castelli评分量表评估从纯运动中的意图归因）。比较模型的ToM画像与不同人类参照群体（儿童、典型发育成人、高功能自闭症成人）的差异。
AI.result: 在导演任务上，无链式思考时模型面板在78%的试验中犯自我中心错误（类似儿童而非成人），模型间差异显著，推理能挽救部分模型。在三角形任务上，模型整体低估意图归因，其ToM画像距离高功能自闭症成人均值比距离典型发育成人均值近了3倍以上，而目标导向和随机运动则接近典型发育成人。没有任何模型在两个任务上都最接近典型发育成人。
AI.conclusion: 前沿VLMs的ToM能力在不同任务范式间呈碎片化状态，缺乏连贯的人类-like画像。研究强调应谨慎对待模型在单一任务上的"成年人-level"表现，并指出这种不一致性对AI系统可靠理解和推理他人心理状态的能力构成警示。

title: Video Models as Native 4D Renderers: World-Grounded Conditioning from Animated Mesh
summary: Pretrained video diffusion models can act as renderers when the desired scene state is already specified by an animated mesh, a camera trajectory, and a reference image. This 4D generative rendering setting raises a representation question: what image-format condition lets a video backbone obey both camera motion and scene-internal animation? We propose DAR, a reference-guided renderer that extends Wan2.2 camera control from Plücker rays alone to a joint camera-plus-geometry interface. DAR projects a neural 4D G-buffer (tracking, world position, and normal) from the animated mesh and injects it through a widened control adapter while preserving the pretrained image-to-video prior. The central design choice is the pair of tracking and world position. Tracking identifies the persistent surface element that should carry appearance; world position gives its current scene-coordinate state; normal supplies local shape. Depth plus calibrated rays can recover 3D in principle, but depth is a camera-dependent chart in which camera and object motion are mixed. On the 68-case DAR-4D benchmark, LoRA DAR reaches PSNR 23.22, SSIM 0.895, and LPIPS 0.134, improving over off-the-shelf Wan2.2-Depth by 1.54 dB PSNR; a full fine-tune reaches PSNR 25.36 and SSIM 0.917. Matched ablations show that replacing world position by depth reduces PSNR by 1.26--1.55 dB at every checkpoint, supporting tracking+world-position correspondence as a practical 4D rendering condition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DAR，一种参考引导的四维生成渲染器，通过将神经4D G-buffer（跟踪、世界位置和法线）投影到动画网格并注入控制适配器，扩展了Wan2.2相机控制能力，使视频扩散模型能同时遵循相机运动和场景内部动画。在DAR-4D基准上，LoRA版本达到PSNR 23.22，全微调版本达到PSNR 25.36。
AI.motivation: 预训练视频扩散模型已在动画网格、相机轨迹和参考图像指定场景状态时充当渲染器，但存在一个表示问题：什么样的图像格式条件能让视频主干网络同时服从相机运动和场景内部动画？现有方法使用深度加校准光线虽可恢复3D，但深度是相机相关的图表，相机运动和物体运动被混杂在一起。
AI.method: DAR将Wan2.2的Plücker射线相机控制扩展为联合相机加几何接口。具体而言，从动画网格投影神经4D G-buffer（包含跟踪、世界位置和法线），通过加宽的控制适配器注入，同时保留预训练的图像到视频先验。核心设计是跟踪与世界位置配对：跟踪标识持久的表面元素以承载外观，世界位置给出当前场景坐标状态，法线提供局部形状。
AI.result: 在68个案例的DAR-4D基准上，LoRA版DAR达到PSNR 23.22、SSIM 0.895、LPIPS 0.134，比现成的Wan2.2-Depth高出1.54 dB PSNR；全微调版本达到PSNR 25.36、SSIM 0.917。消融实验显示，用深度替换世界位置在每个检查点都会使PSNR降低1.26-1.55 dB。
AI.conclusion: 跟踪加世界位置的对应关系是实用的四维渲染条件，优于深度等相机相关的表示方式，能更有效地让视频扩散模型同时遵从相机运动和场景内部动画。

title: AgentStream: How Well Do Self-Evolving LLM Agents Perform Under Streaming Tasks?
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can self-evolve by continually improving from their own accumulated experience. However, existing studies predominantly adopt independent evaluation. Consequently, the behavior of self-evolving agents in realistic streaming settings, where agents adapt to diverse and complex task streams, remains poorly understood. To address this gap, we introduce AgentStream, a unified framework that evaluates self-evolving agents spanning diverse evolution components by organizing agentic benchmarks into a configurable task stream and instantiating the \texttt{Isolated}, \texttt{Sequential}, and \texttt{Interleaved} streaming scenarios at test time, which progressively vary the scope and domain composition of the stream. Over these scenarios, we combinatorially evaluate five representative self-evolving methods across three frontier foundation models, disentangling how model capability, method architecture, and streaming scenario jointly shape self-evolution. Our results show that self-evolution reliability varies across streaming scenarios, the benefit of self-evolution is gated by model capability and non-monotonic in model strength, and no single method dominates across models and scenarios. These findings offer concrete guidance for selecting self-evolving methods across models and streaming scenarios. Overall, we advocate that self-evolving agents should be evaluated under realistic task streams rather than isolated single-task settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgentStream框架，用于在真实流式任务场景下评估自进化LLM智能体，通过配置任务流和三种流式场景（隔离、顺序、交替），对五种自进化方法在三个前沿基础模型上进行了组合评估。
AI.motivation: 现有自进化智能体研究大多采用独立评估方式，忽略了真实场景中智能体需要适应多样化、复杂任务流的实际情况，导致对自进化智能体在流式环境中的行为理解不足。
AI.method: 提出AgentStream统一框架，将智能体基准组织为可配置的任务流，并在测试时实例化三种流式场景（隔离、顺序、交替），渐进改变任务的规模范围和领域组成，从而对五种自进化方法和三个前沿基础模型进行组合评估。
AI.result: 自进化可靠性在不同流式场景间存在差异；自进化收益受模型能力门槛限制，且与模型强度呈非单调关系；没有单一方法能在所有模型和场景中占据主导地位。
AI.conclusion: 自进化智能体应在真实任务流而非孤立单任务设置下进行评估，研究结果为不同模型和流式场景下选择自进化方法提供了具体指导。

title: Logographic Character Visual Pretraining via Semantic-based Contrastive Learning
summary: Current deep learning-based character vision studies, e.g., text recognition, character image denoising, and historical text completion, are offering new solutions for learning, managing, and utilizing character resources. However, the performance of these studies peaks only with large and balanced datasets, which is a rarity with real-world character datasets, especially for logographic character languages, e.g., Chinese. The imbalance in data distribution of logographic characters is a common issue due to differences in character usage frequency and new characters being continuously created. In this paper, we propose a novel method for logographic character recognition, which introduces a multi-modal learning approach using visual semantics and contextual semantics of characters. A novel pre-training strategy is designed to enhance deep visual representations, especially for datasets suffering from issues of imbalanced and rare instances, by extracting the contextual semantics of each character from the corresponding language models. We conduct experiments across various datasets to evaluate our character recognition method and further validate the contrastive pre-training strategy by several downstream tasks. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of our method compared to state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向语素文字（如表意文字）识别的多模态学习方法，通过结合视觉语义和上下文语义，并设计新颖的预训练策略来增强深度视觉表征，有效缓解了语素文字数据集中常见的类别不平衡和稀有实例问题。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习字符视觉研究依赖大规模且类别均衡的数据集，但现实中的语素文字（如中文）数据集常因使用频率差异和新字符的持续产生而存在严重的数据分布不平衡问题，导致模型性能受限。
AI.method: 提出一种多模态学习方法，融合字符的视觉语义与上下文语义；设计新颖的对比预训练策略，从对应语言模型中提取每个字符的上下文语义，以增强深度视觉表征，尤其针对不平衡和稀有实例的数据集。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上进行了字符识别实验，并通过多项下游任务验证了对比预训练策略的有效性。实验结果表明该方法优于现有最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的多模态学习与对比预训练策略能够有效提升语素文字识别性能，特别是在数据分布不平衡的现实场景下，展现出优于现有方法的显著优势。

title: TRACE-TS: Attribution-Grounded and Traceable Sensor-Language Reasoning for Human Activity Understanding
summary: Wearable sensors capture fine-grained motion patterns that support rich behavioral understanding, yet most existing methods reduce these signals to activity labels. Recent LM-based approaches generate natural-language explanations for sensor data, but their reasoning is weakly grounded in the underlying signal, leading to fluent yet unverifiable explanations. We introduce TRACE-TS (Traceable Reasoning with Attribution-Grounded Evidence), a framework for structured and signal-grounded reasoning over wearable time series. TRACE-TS uses attribution from an expert classifier to identify salient spatio-temporal sensor regions, uses them to construct DAG reasoning traces with explicit evidence provenance, and trains a compact language model to generate these traces through gated cross-attention over sensor memory tokens. At inference, the adapted model jointly outputs the activity prediction and its reasoning trace, without requiring attribution computation or teacher guidance. We introduce Semantic Node Match(SNM), an LLM-as-judge metric that diagnoses reasoning fidelity at the observation, inference, and synthesis levels, localizing hallucinated observations and broken evidence chains missed by standard NLG metrics. Across seven wearable benchmarks, TRACE-TS achieves the best average accuracy and F1 among all evaluated methods (84.43%/81.24%), and outperforms the best LLM-based baseline by 17.96% in F1. Our code is available at https://github.com/SparshRastogi/TRACE-TS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRACE-TS框架，通过专家分类器的归因机制识别可穿戴传感器数据中的关键时空区域，构建基于证据溯源的有向无环图推理轨迹，并训练紧凑语言模型通过门控交叉注意力生成这些轨迹，实现活动预测与可验证推理的联合输出。
AI.motivation: 现有基于语言模型的可穿戴传感器数据解释方法缺乏对底层信号的强约束，生成流畅但不可验证的解释。作者旨在解决推理过程与传感器信号脱节的问题，提供结构化且信号接地（signal-grounded）的推理。
AI.method: 1) 利用专家分类器的归因机制识别显著的时空传感器区域；2) 基于这些区域构建带有明确证据来源的DAG推理轨迹；3) 训练紧凑语言模型通过门控交叉注意力在传感器记忆令牌上生成推理轨迹；4) 在推理阶段联合输出活动预测和推理轨迹，无需归因计算或教师指导；5) 提出SNM（语义节点匹配）评估指标，基于LLM裁判在观察、推理、综合三个层面诊断推理保真度。
AI.result: 在七个可穿戴基准数据集上，TRACE-TS取得最佳平均准确率（84.43%）和F1分数（81.24%），相比最优的基于LLM的基线方法在F1上提升17.96%。
AI.conclusion: TRACE-TS通过证据归因和可溯源的DAG推理轨迹，有效提升了可穿戴时间序列数据的推理可验证性和预测性能，为构建可信赖的可穿戴智能分析提供了新范式。

title: Personalizing Large Language Model Agents with Small Policy Models
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can retrieve memory, call tools, ask clarifying questions, and vary response style, yet adapting these execution decisions to an individual user remains difficult. Fine-tuning a separate LLM is costly or impossible for proprietary systems, while prompts and memory primarily expose user information to the agent rather than adapt its execution decisions from feedback. We formulate personalization of a frozen agent as online learning of a per-user execution policy from scalar feedback observed only for the executed action. We propose FABLE (Factorized Adaptive Bandit Layer for Execution), a lightweight policy layer outside a potentially black-box host agent. FABLE factorizes memory, information-acquisition, and response decisions so feedback updates related choices; filters actions through an externally specified feasible set before exploration; and learns user-specific residual preferences relative to a fixed default-and-cost score via Bayesian contextual Thompson sampling. Under a linear residual-reward model, a calibrated variant inherits an expected-regret bound against the best feasible action. We also characterize preferences unidentifiable under persistent feasibility constraints and provide anytime-valid false-promotion control. Across personalized-reasoning, controlled-feedback, and executable tool-use evaluations, FABLE improves several preference-sensitive behaviors relative to rule-only control while remaining competitive on end-to-end task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FABLE（因子化自适应Bandit执行层），在冻结的黑盒LLM智能体外增加一个轻量级策略层，通过在线学习将智能体的执行决策（记忆检索、信息获取、响应风格）个性化到单个用户，无需微调LLM。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体虽然能检索记忆、调用工具、提问和调整响应风格，但将这些执行决策适配到个体用户仍然困难。微调单独LLM成本高或对专有系统不可行，而提示和记忆主要只是向智能体暴露用户信息，并不能从反馈中调整执行决策。
AI.method: FABLE将个性化问题形式化为从标量反馈（仅针对已执行动作）在线学习每个用户的执行策略。它通过因子化分解记忆、信息获取和响应决策，使反馈更新相关联的选择；通过外部指定的可行集过滤动作后再探索；并使用贝叶斯上下文Thompson采样学习用户相对于固定默认-成本评分的特定残差偏好。
AI.result: 在线性残差奖励模型下，校准变体继承了针对最优可行动作的期望遗憾界。FABLE还刻画了在持续可行性约束下无法识别的偏好，并提供任意时刻有效的虚假提升控制。在个性化推理、受控反馈和可执行工具使用的评估中，FABLE相比纯规则控制提升了多个偏好敏感行为，同时在端到端任务性能上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: FABLE通过轻量级、可解释的策略层实现了冻结LLM智能体的个性化执行决策，在理论保证和实验效果上均验证了其有效性，为不能微调的黑盒智能体提供了可行的个性化路径。

title: SeDeM: Selective Decompression of Hidden-State Memories for Long-Context Question Answering
summary: Long-context inference with large language models (LLMs) is costly: self-attention during prefill scales quadratically with sequence length, and the key-value (KV) cache grows with the number of processed tokens. Larger context windows also do not ensure reliable evidence use. Context compression reduces this cost, but many soft-compression methods use LLMs as compressors and rely on compact memory tokens both to preserve information and to condition the decoder. We propose SeDeM, a selective decompression framework that decouples compact memory storage from decoder conditioning. An LLM extracts hidden states from a chosen intermediate Transformer layer, a lightweight compressor stores them as memory blocks, a query-conditioned selector selects relevant blocks, and a decompressor expands only the selected blocks into hidden states compatible with an intermediate decoder layer. Thus, the decoder avoids both full-context processing and direct generation from highly compressed memory slots. On four long-context QA benchmarks, SeDeM achieves higher QA scores than the evaluated compression baselines in both 1B and 3B same-backbone settings, and with the 3B backbone exceeds full-context fine-tuning on three datasets. The learned selector uses block-level evidence supervision during training. SeDeM also reduces online time-to-first-token and improves autoregressive decoding throughput relative to ICAE.

AI.tldr: 提出SeDeM框架，通过选择性解压将紧凑记忆存储与解码器条件解耦，在四个长上下文QA基准上优于现有压缩基线，同时降低了首个令牌延迟并提升了解码吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理中LLM成本高昂：自注意力在预填充阶段随序列长度二次方增长，KV缓存随处理令牌增加而膨胀；此外，较大的上下文窗口并不能保证可靠的证据使用。现有软压缩方法依赖LLM作为压缩器并使用紧凑记忆令牌，但效果有限。
AI.method: SeDeM框架将紧凑记忆存储与解码器条件解耦。具体流程为：LLM从选定的中间Transformer层提取隐藏状态，轻量级压缩器将其存储为记忆块，基于查询条件的选择器挑选相关块，解压器仅将选中块扩展为与中间解码器层兼容的隐藏状态。训练时选择器使用块级证据监督。
AI.result: 在四个长上下文QA基准上，SeDeM在1B和3B同骨干设置下均获得比评估的压缩基线更高的QA分数；3B骨干在三个数据集上超过全上下文微调。同时降低了在线首个令牌延迟，并相对ICAE提升自回归解码吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: SeDeM通过选择性解压策略有效平衡了长上下文推理中的效率和效果，证明将压缩存储与解码条件解耦是降低推理成本同时保持甚至提升性能的可行方向。

title: What Carries the Signal in Pathology Foundation-Model Atlases? A Patient-Level Controlled Benchmark in Breast Cancer
comment: 40 pages, 7 figures, 10 tables. Supplementary Information (16 pages) included as an ancillary file. Segmentation outputs obtained under the Aignostics Research Access Programme; OpenTME data at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Aignostics/OpenTME
summary:
Pathology foundation models are reported to encode molecular programmes in tissue morphology, but the evidence is usually a cohort-wide ranked gene list rather than a prediction for a held-out patient. We rebuild such an analysis with the patient as the unit of evidence and ask which pipeline component carries signal.
  Across 11 frozen backbones, four pre-specified gene programmes and 285 TCGA-BRCA patients with paired slides and RNA-seq (44 cells; GroupKFold by patient, all preprocessing fitted inside the fold), ridge regression on mean-pooled embeddings predicts held-out programme scores at Spearman rho = 0.25-0.56, UNI2 strongest on all four (immune 0.556). A matched permutation null gives raw p ~ 1e-4 at 10,000 permutations for every cell; Holm-adjusted p = 0.0044.
  The signal is real but not uniformly morphological. Against competing models on the same patients and folds, embeddings beat tissue composition for ER/luminal, proliferation and immune (+0.280, +0.284, +0.479; p <= 0.003) but not basal, where compartment fractions alone reach 0.469 against the embedding's 0.493 (p = 0.77). Fifty-four interpretable cell-count features come within 0.043-0.085 on every programme.
  The geometric machinery contributes nothing measurable, and we identify why: the geodesic graph selects neighbours by Euclidean nearest-neighbour search and only reweights edges already chosen, so the topology is Euclidean by construction (Riemannian minus Euclidean = +0.0010, 95% CI [-0.0007, +0.0029]). Applied consistently the geometry is worse (-0.0117). Ridge regression beats the graph-and-metric decoder by +0.097 (CI [+0.069, +0.127]). The driver-count metric common in this literature is near-uninformative here: 91.8% of random six-gene panels recover >=5/6 drivers.

AI.tldr: 该研究以患者为证据单元，重新评估了病理基础模型从组织形态学预测分子程序的能力。在11个冻结骨干网络、4个基因程序和285例TCGA-BRCA患者中，岭回归在均值池化嵌入上预测留出患者程序得分可达Spearman rho=0.25-0.56（UNI2最强），置换检验证实信号真实（Ho
AI.motivation: 现有文献声称病理基础模型能编码组织形态中的分子程序，但证据通常是队列级别的排序基因列表，缺乏针对留出患者的个体预测验证。作者希望以患者为分析单元，系统解构流水线各组件（嵌入、几何、解码器）各自贡献的信号量。
AI.method: 使用11种冻结骨干网络、4个预设基因程序和285例TCGA-BRCA配对患者数据（44个细胞），采用GroupKFold按患者分组交叉验证，所有预处理在折内拟合。对比均值池化嵌入上的岭回归、组织构成特征、54个可解释细胞计数特征、图-度量解码器及黎曼几何方法。
AI.result: 嵌入预测留出患者程序得分rho=0.25-0.56，UNI2在四程序上均最强（免疫0.556）。置换检验p=1e-4，Holm校正后p=0.0044。嵌入在ER/腔面、增殖和免疫上优于组织构成（+0.280至+0.479），但基底程序无显著差异。几何机制无贡献（黎曼减欧氏=+0.0010，95%CI含零），岭回归优于图-度量解码器+0.097。
AI.conclusion: 信号真实但不完全由形态决定。嵌入特征携带主要预测信号，几何机制因欧氏最近邻构建拓扑而无实质贡献，驱动计数指标在该数据集上近乎无信息量。

title: More Debate, Same Evidence: Structural Limits of Homogeneous Multi-Agent Groundedness
summary: Large language model (LLM) judges are increasingly organized as multi-agent panels under the assumption that exchanging critiques improves judgment quality. We test this assumption for \emph{groundedness verification}, where a judge must determine whether a claim is supported by the supplied evidence. We evaluate a homogeneous three-agent panel on six public fact-verification and hallucination-detection benchmarks. Relative to a fixed single-agent reference, the panel's system-level accuracy difference ranges from $+8.5$ to $-4.4$ percentage points: two datasets show reliable gains, one shows a reliable loss, and three are statistically inconclusive. Because the reference and panel use different model variants, these differences characterize the complete systems rather than isolate a causal debate effect.

AI.tldr: 本文测试了多智能体LLM评审团在事实核查（groundedness verification）任务中的有效性假设，发现相比单一智能体基线，三智能体评审团的系统级准确率差异从+8.5到-4.4个百分点不等：两个数据集有可靠提升，一个数据集有可靠下降，三个数据集结果在统计上不显著。由于参考模型和评审团使用不同模型变体，该差异反映的是完整系统表现而非纯粹的讨论（debate）因果效应。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM评审团被越来越多地用于评估任务，其核心假设是智能体之间交换批评意见能提升判断质量。作者希望检验这一假设在事实核查/幻觉检测场景下是否成立，以填补对该假设缺乏系统性验证的研究空白。
AI.method: 在六个公开的事实核查和幻觉检测基准数据集上，评估一个同构（homogeneous）三智能体评审团，并与固定的单一智能体参考系统进行对比，计算系统级别的准确率差异。
AI.result: 评审团相比单一智能体参考的准确率差异区间为+8.5至-4.4个百分点：两个数据集呈现可靠的正向提升，一个数据集呈现可靠的负向下降，另有三个数据集结果在统计上无法得出明确结论。此外，由于参考和评审团使用了不同的模型变体，这些差异表征的是完整系统差异，而非纯粹的讨论效应。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体评审团的优势并非普适的：其效果因数据集而异，存在提升、下降和不确定三种情况。研究还指出，实验结果不能简单归因于“讨论”这一机制本身，需要更严谨的实验设计来隔离因果效应。

title: CurveShift: Is Agent Progress Scalar? Separating Level from Shape
comment: 25 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Data and code: https://github.com/harvenstar/CurveShift
summary: Progress in large language models is often summarized using a single scalar measure, such as a time horizon, a latent ability estimate, or an aggregate benchmark score. These summaries capture the overall performance, but they do not test whether progress is distributed differently across task difficulty. We find that most of the apparent shift in gains toward harder tasks does not reflect a change in the shape of the difficulty-response curve. On METR time-horizon data, a single Rasch model with rising ability reproduces this pattern, so it is largely explained by ceiling effects rather than a qualitative change in capability. This echoes how the choice of metric can make claimed emergent abilities look like a property of the models themselves. We then identify a smaller hard-task effect that survives this control. Isolating it is difficult on agentic benchmarks, because newer models are usually run with newer agentic harnesses, so a gain on hard tasks cannot be assigned to the model or its scaffold. We break the confound with LiveCodeBench, a public competitive programming benchmark that runs no agentic scaffold while pairing dated models with an exogenous difficulty ordering. After accounting for the rise in overall ability, models released after September 2024 still gain on the hardest problems beyond what their easy and medium performance predicts, by about +0.40 logits under our most conservative assumption, raising the hard-problem solve rate from roughly 18% to 25%. The effect is led by the strongest reasoning models and holds for hard tasks that need only short reasoning, not autonomy over long horizons. We present this as a result specific to competitive programming, since our clean identification rests on a single coding benchmark. We release the LiveCodeBench Difficulty Panel (66 dated models x 1,055 problems) and our analysis code.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大语言模型性能提升是否在任务难度维度上呈均匀分布。作者发现大部分"硬任务增益"的表象实际上源于Rasch模型中能力提升带来的天花板效应，而非能力曲线形状的质变。通过LiveCodeBench（一个无代理框架的公开竞赛编程基准）打破混淆后，他们发现2024年9月后发布的最强推理模型在难题上仍存在约+0.40 logits的超额增益，使难题解决率从18%提升至25%。
AI.motivation: 现有研究中常用单一标量（如时间跨度、能力估计或聚合基准分数）来总结LLM进展，但这些指标无法检验进展在任务难度维度上是否分布不均。作者希望区分"表面上的硬任务增益"与"实质上的能力曲线形状变化"，避免将度量选择或天花板效应误判为模型能力的质变。
AI.method: 作者首先使用Rasch模型（单参数项目反应理论模型）拟合METR时间跨度数据，检验"硬任务增益"是否能被能力提升+天花板效应解释。随后，他们使用LiveCodeBench基准（66个带日期的模型×1,055个问题，无代理框架）来打破模型与代理框架的混淆，并以外部难度排序作为自变量，在控制整体能力上升后，检验新模型在难题上的超额表现。
AI.result: 在METR数据上，单一Rasch模型加上能力上升即可复现大部分"硬任务增益"模式，表明这主要是天花板效应所致。在LiveCodeBench上，2024年9月后发布的模型在难题上仍有超出其简单/中等题表现预测的增益，最保守估计约为+0.40 logits，难题解决率从约18%提升到25%。该效应主要由最强推理模型驱动，且存在于需要短推理的难题而非长自主性的任务。结果特定于竞赛编程领域。
AI.conclusion: LLM的大部分"硬任务进展"是度量选择的假象，但存在一个较小且可辨识的真实硬任务效应，尤其在最强推理模型的竞赛编程表现中。作者强调这一结论的领域特定性，并公开了LiveCodeBench难度面板数据与分析代码以促进进一步研究。

title: Distill What RGB Can Recover: Privileged 3D Evidence for RGB-Only Vision-Language Models
summary: 3D scene understanding requires reasoning about entity existence, spatial layout, and object relations, yet RGB images alone often provide insufficient 3D cues. Existing 3D-VLMs commonly rely on depth or 3D-position-aware inputs at inference time, introducing additional acquisition, reconstruction, or annotation costs that limit RGB-only deployment. We therefore study how training-time 3D evidence can be converted into spatial reasoning capabilities retained under RGB-only inference. We propose a privileged-evidence distillation framework that constructs a distillable teacher through a unified evidence interface and controlled residual injection, and transfers its knowledge to a deployable student receiving only RGB images and questions through logit and structured representation distillation. To avoid imitating teacher signals unsupported by RGB, we further introduce evidence-sensitivity-guided distillation, which uses corrupted evidence to identify highly evidence-dependent targets and down-weight their supervision. We also define a recoverability decomposition based on the matched baseline, teacher, and student, separating privileged gains into RGB-recoverable improvements and residual teacher advantages. Across four benchmarks, the teacher achieves the best result on 7 of 11 reported metrics among the compared methods. The RGB-only student outperforms its matched baseline on all 11 metrics, including gains of 10.4 ScanQA CIDEr and 19.1 Scan2Cap CIDEr@0.5, without additional inference-time inputs. These results validate the effectiveness of training-time privileged 3D evidence distillation for both teacher performance and deployable RGB-only spatial reasoning. Separately, our matched baseline-teacher-student analysis characterizes privileged-gain transfer across evidence types and spatial skills.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种特权证据蒸馏框架，在训练时利用3D证据增强教师模型，通过证据敏感引导蒸馏将空间推理能力转移给仅接收RGB图像和问题的学生模型，无需推理时的额外输入。在四个基准上，RGB-only学生模型在所有11项指标上均超过匹配基线。
AI.motivation: 现有3D-VLM通常依赖深度或3D位置感知输入，在推理时需要额外获取、重建或标注成本，限制了仅凭RGB图像的部署。作者希望研究如何将训练时的3D证据转化为RGB-only推理下的空间推理能力。
AI.method: 提出特权证据蒸馏框架：(1) 通过统一证据界面和受控残差注入构建可蒸馏的教师模型；(2) 通过logit蒸馏和结构化表示蒸馏将知识转移给仅接收RGB图像和问题的学生模型；(3) 引入证据敏感引导蒸馏，用损坏证据识别高度依赖证据的目标并降低其监督权重；(4) 定义基于匹配基线、教师和学生模型的可恢复性分解，区分RGB可恢复改进与教师残余优势。
AI.result: 在四个基准上，教师模型在11项指标中的7项上取得最优结果。RGB-only学生模型在所有11项指标上均优于匹配基线，包括ScanQA CIDEr提升10.4和Scan2Cap CIDEr@0.5提升19.1，且无需额外推理时输入。
AI.conclusion: 训练时的特权3D证据蒸馏对教师性能和可部署的RGB-only空间推理均有效。匹配的基线-教师-学生分析揭示了不同类型证据和空间技能之间特权增益的迁移特征。

title: Geometric Self-Supervised Pre-training for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
summary:
Neural Combinatorial Optimization (NCO) techniques have emerged as a highly efficient alternative to traditional exact algorithms for solving routing problems such as the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP). However, the generalization capabilities of these Reinforcement Learning-based models are severely hindered when scaling to high-dimensional instances. This issue has been mitigated in other domains, like computer vision and natural language processing, by adopting a self-supervised pre-training strategy. Nevertheless, its application to routing graphs, which lack complex topological attributes beyond 2D spatial coordinates, remains a challenge. In this paper, we propose a geometric self-supervised pre-training framework specifically designed to capture spatial invariance and global relative distance distributions. By applying isometric transformations, such as rotations and axial reflections, the model learns robust structural representations prior to the policy optimization phase. Empirical results demonstrate that this strategy consistently outperforms models trained from scratch (baselines), achieving a 7.23\% improvement in tour length for massive zero-shot extrapolation scenarios (TSP1,000). Furthermore, the proposed model exhibits remarkable computational efficiency, delivering speedups of up to two orders of magnitude over the exact solver Concorde at massive scales.
  The source code and pre-trained models are publicly available at https://github.com/davidaguadocosano/TSP-GeoPretrain.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对路由问题的几何自监督预训练框架，通过等距变换（旋转和轴向反射）捕捉空间不变性和全局相对距离分布，在策略优化前学习鲁棒的图结构表示。该框架在TSP1,000等大规模零样本外推场景下比从头训练的基线模型提升7.23%的游程长度，且相比精确求解器Concorde在超大规模下实现高达两个数量级的加速。
AI.motivation: 神经组合优化（NCO）方法在处理TSP等路由问题时，基于强化学习的模型在扩展到高维实例时泛化能力严重受限。虽然在计算机视觉和自然语言处理领域，自监督预训练策略已成功缓解了类似问题，但应用于仅含2D空间坐标、缺乏复杂拓扑属性的路由图仍具挑战性。作者旨在将自监督预训练思想引入路由问题的几何特征学习中。
AI.method: 提出一个几何自监督预训练框架，核心思想是应用等距变换（如旋转和轴向反射）来捕捉空间不变性和全局相对距离分布。该框架在策略优化（强化学习）阶段之前进行，通过预训练使模型学习到鲁棒的几何结构表示，从而提升后续策略学习的泛化能力。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提出的预训练策略在TSP1,000的大规模零样本外推场景中，相比从头训练的基线模型实现了7.23%的游程长度改进。同时，该模型在超大规模问题上表现出卓越的计算效率，相比精确求解器Concorde获得了高达两个数量级的加速。
AI.conclusion: 几何自监督预训练是提升神经组合优化模型泛化能力的有效手段，特别适用于缺乏复杂拓扑特征但具有空间几何结构的路由问题。该方法不仅提升了求解质量，还大幅提高了计算效率，为NCO在超大规模路由问题上的实际应用提供了可行路径。

title: Deep Research Pretraining via Predictive Navigation
comment: working in progress; correspondence to {ucaswu,maxwellyu}@tencent.com or wuxing@iie.ac.cn
summary: Deep research agents are often trained on expensive, environment-grounded tool-use trajectories that require repeated retrieval, document inspection, and report evaluation. We introduce Deep Research Pretraining (DRP), an offline framework that derives predictive navigation supervision from naturally occurring evidence structures. Given a citation-bearing or hyperlinked passage, DRP constructs a proxy research objective, recovers linked evidence and graph-related alternatives, and converts them into search-open-write trajectories. This teaches models what to search for, which documents to inspect, and how to synthesize evidence, without a live retrieval environment or executed policy rollout. We instantiate DRP on scholarly citation graphs (DRP-Paper) and Wikipedia hyperlinks (DRP-Web), continually pretrain separate Qwen3-14B-Base models on 1B tokens, and fine-tune them on controlled fractions of 13K agent trajectories. Across five independently sampled subsets at each low-data budget, both variants consistently outperform matched no-DRP models on DeepResearch Bench. With one quarter of the SFT data, DRP-Web even surpasses a fixed no-DRP full-data checkpoint, with gains transferring to ResearchQA, WebWalkerQA, and SimpleQA. Starting from matched low-data SFT checkpoints, the DRP-Web advantage also persists through subsequent agentic RL. Source-matched and evidence-mismatch controls indicate that these improvements arise from evidence-conditioned navigation rather than domain exposure or agent-format imitation. DRP thus provides a promising complementary approach to trajectory-based agent training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出深度研究预训练（DRP）框架，通过从引文或超链接等自然存在的证据结构中构建代理研究目标，将引用段落转化为搜索-阅读-写作轨迹，使模型无需真实检索环境或策略回滚即可学习深度研究导航能力。实验表明，DRP在低数据预算下显著优于基线模型，且DRP-Web在仅使用1/4监督微调数据时即可超过全量数据基线。
AI.motivation: 深度研究智能体通常依赖昂贵的、基于环境交互的工具使用轨迹进行训练，需要反复检索、文档检查和报告评估，训练成本高昂且难以扩展。作者旨在探索一种无需实时检索环境或执行策略回滚的离线预训练方法，利用自然存在的证据结构（如引文和超链接）来提供预测性导航监督。
AI.method: DRP框架从引文或超链接段落中构建代理研究目标，恢复链接证据和图相关替代项，并将其转化为搜索-打开-写作轨迹。作者在学术引文图（DRP-Paper）和维基百科超链接（DRP-Web）上实例化该方法，使用1B token对Qwen3-14B-Base模型进行持续预训练，并在13K条智能体轨迹的受控子集上进行微调。同时设置源匹配和证据不匹配的对照实验以验证改进来源。
AI.result: 在五个独立采样的低数据预算子集上，DRP两种变体在DeepResearch Bench上均始终优于无DRP的匹配模型。DRP-Web仅用四分之一SFT数据即超过固定无DRP全量数据检查点，且收益可迁移至ResearchQA、WebWalkerQA和SimpleQA。该优势在后续智能体强化学习阶段依然保持。
AI.conclusion: DRP提供了一种有前景的补充性方法，可与基于轨迹的智能体训练互补，证明了证据条件化导航（而非领域暴露或智能体格式模仿）是性能提升的关键来源。

title: Counting the Cost of War Under Satellite Embargo: Zero-Shot Estimation of Impacted Infrastructure
summary: Rapid estimation of impacted structures - critical for conflict-zone humanitarian response - is frequently hindered by post-strike satellite data embargoes and imagery blackouts. We bypass this operational bottleneck by reframing impacted building mapping as a zero-shot geometric projection task on archival, pre-strike maps. Using coordinate and incident text from LiveUAMap and ArcGIS, Large Language Models extract weapon payloads (W) to project kinetic blast perimeters via Hopkinson-Cranz scaling (R_base = Z * W^(1/3)). To count exposed structures within these zones without post-strike imagery, we introduce two technical innovations: Adaptive Field-of-View to eliminate resolution (zoom) bias in 2D segmentation (SAMGeo), and 2.5D pseudo-height depth maps combined with segmentation masks to help Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) resolve overlapping, dense rooftops. Evaluated on 2026 Middle East conflict data, depth-augmented LVLMs dramatically outperform traditional segmentation in congested urban centers. This establishes a powerful hybrid paradigm for zero-shot crisis mapping: ultra-fast 2D segmentation for sparse rural zones, and depth-augmented LVLMs for dense urban environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种零样本危机制图新范式：利用大规模语言模型从LiveUAMap等来源提取武器载荷，通过霍普金森-克兰茨缩放定律预测动能爆炸影响范围，无需依赖打击后的卫星图像。在预打击档案地图上，通过自适应视场消除缩放偏差的2D分割（SAMGeo），以及2.5D伪高度深度图辅助大视觉语言模型解决密集屋顶重叠问题，实现了冲突区域受影响建筑的快速估算。
AI.motivation: 冲突区域人道主义响应中，受影响建筑的快速估算至关重要，但常因打击后卫星数据禁运和影像中断而受阻。现有方法过度依赖打击后的高分辨率影像，在数据不可用时难以运作。
AI.method: 将受影响建筑映射重构为零样本几何投影任务：（1）使用LLM从LiveUAMap和ArcGIS的坐标与事件文本中提取武器载荷W；（2）通过Hopkinson-Cranz缩放定律R_base = Z * W^(1/3)投射动能爆炸周界；（3）引入自适应视场消除2D分割（SAMGeo）中的分辨率偏差；（4）将2.5D伪高度深度图与分割掩码结合，帮助LVLMs解决密集屋顶的重叠识别。
AI.result: 在2026年中东冲突数据上的评估显示，深度增强的LVLMs在城市拥挤区域的表现显著优于传统分割方法。该混合范式实现了零样本危机制图：超快速2D分割适用于稀疏乡村区域，深度增强LVLMs适用于密集城市环境。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了强大的混合范式，成功绕过了打击后卫星影像不可用的运营瓶颈，为冲突区域人道主义响应提供了一种无需实时影像即可快速估算受影响建筑的新途径。

title: RF-HOI: Recognize Human-Object Interaction with Radio Frequency Signals
summary: Recognizing Human-Object Interactions (HOI) is essential for intelligent systems, underpinning applications in virtual and augmented reality, embodied AI, and assistive robotics. However, vision-based HOI methods face challenges in privacy concerns and poor light conditions. In this work, we introduce RF-HOI, the first framework that only uses radio frequency (RF) signals for HOI recognition. A key challenge of RF-HOI is that single-modality RF sensing is insufficient to recognize both actions and the objects being interacted with. RF-HOI addresses this through a novel modality fusion that combines mmWave radar and RFID, enabling simultaneous action recognition and target identification. Another challenge is limited training data across diverse setups, which impairs the generalizability of the recognition model. To overcome this, we develop a simulator that synthesizes multimodal RF data for diverse HOIs at scale, allowing us to fine-tune with only a small amount of real-world data. Experiment results show that RF-HOI outperforms all baselines, approaching vision model performance, and that our diverse synthetic training data can significantly boost our system's performance on real-world scenarios. These results highlight the potential of multimodal RF sensing for robust and privacy-preserving HOI recognition as well as the effectiveness of our RF data synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RF-HOI，首个仅使用射频（RF）信号进行人机交互（HOI）识别的框架，通过融合毫米波雷达与RFID实现动作识别和目标识别，并结合合成数据模拟器增强模型泛化能力，实验表明其性能接近视觉方法且具备隐私保护优势。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉的HOI识别方法存在隐私泄露和光照条件差的问题，而单模态RF感知不足以同时识别交互动作和交互对象，亟需一种隐私保护且鲁棒的多模态RF解决方案。
AI.method: RF-HOI通过新颖的模态融合机制将毫米波雷达与RFID相结合，实现动作识别与目标识别的同步进行；同时开发了一个能够大规模合成多样化多模态RF数据的模拟器，仅需少量真实数据即可进行微调。
AI.result: 实验结果表明RF-HOI在所有基线上表现更优，性能接近视觉模型；多样化的合成训练数据能显著提升系统在真实场景中的表现。
AI.conclusion: 多模态RF感知在隐私保护且鲁棒的HOI识别方面具有巨大潜力，同时验证了RF数据合成方法的有效性。

title: AdaMTP: An Adaptive Training Paradigm for Multi-Token Prediction
summary: Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) has emerged as an effective paradigm that augments a shared Large Language Model backbone with auxiliary heads, training the model to predict several future tokens in parallel to enrich its supervision signal and accelerate inference. However, existing training frameworks adopt a rigid, fixed-length prediction horizon, disregarding the highly non-uniform information density of natural language and code. Forcing the auxiliary heads to predict across high-entropy semantic boundaries injects noisy, conflicting training signals; because these heads share the backbone's latent representations, the resulting gradients backpropagate and interfere with the model's core capabilities. We propose AdaMTP, an adaptive training paradigm that dynamically aligns the prediction horizon with the intrinsic predictability of the sequence. At its core, an entropy-based segmentation algorithm leverages the base model to detect sudden surges in uncertainty as semantic boundaries, partitioning sequences into variable-length groups. Each token is assigned an adaptive prediction depth, and a dynamically masked MTP objective suppresses the loss for predictions that cross these boundaries, attenuating the noisy gradients that degrade the backbone. Across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and general benchmarks on three backbones (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B, Gemma-3-12B), AdaMTP consistently outperforms standard MTP in both task performance and inference speedup.

AI.tldr: AdaMTP是一种自适应多令牌预测训练范式，通过基于熵的分割算法动态调整预测视界，使其与序列的内在可预测性对齐，从而避免跨语义边界注入噪声训练信号，在多个骨干模型上同时提升任务性能和推理加速。
AI.motivation: 现有的多令牌预测（MTP）训练框架采用固定长度的预测视界，忽略了自然语言和代码中高度非均匀的信息密度。强制辅助头跨越高熵语义边界进行预测会注入噪声和冲突的训练信号，这些信号通过共享的骨干表示反向传播，干扰模型的核心能力。
AI.method: AdaMTP的核心是基于熵的分割算法，利用基础模型检测不确定性的突然激增作为语义边界，将序列划分为变长分组。每个令牌被分配自适应预测深度，并通过动态掩码的MTP目标函数抑制跨边界的预测损失，从而衰减损害骨干的噪声梯度。
AI.result: 在数学推理、代码生成及通用基准测试上，使用三个骨干模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B、Gemma-3-12B）进行评估，AdaMTP在任务性能和推理加速两方面均一致优于标准MTP。
AI.conclusion: 自适应地对齐预测视界与序列内在可预测性是提升MTP训练范式的有效途径，能够同时改善模型能力并加快推理速度。

title: SERL-SQL: Selective Hindsight Distillation for Text-to-SQL Reinforcement Agentic Learning
summary: Recent Text-to-SQL systems increasingly rely on multi-turn interaction, execution feedback, and reinforcement learning. However, most existing methods use execution correctness only as a trajectory-level reward, which provides limited guidance for identifying the SQL decisions responsible for success or failure. We propose SERL-SQL, a selective execution-grounded reinforcement learning framework for multi-turn Text-to-SQL agents. SERL-SQL samples on-policy SQL interaction trajectories and uses a training-only teacher to re-score student actions with execution feedback. The resulting teacher--student likelihood gap is converted into bounded, masked weights that reweight GRPO advantages only on SQL and tool-action tokens. In this way, task rewards preserve the optimization direction, while execution hindsight provides localized credit assignment. Experiments on BIRD, Spider, and cross-domain benchmarks show that SERL-SQL achieves competitive performance, reaching 76.56% execution accuracy on BIRD-Dev and 89.92% on Spider-Test. Moreover, our reward-based selection strategy closely approaches the oracle Best-of-N upper bound and consistently outperforms consistency-based selection, showing that SERL-SQL produces high-quality candidates that can be reliably identified by lightweight execution-grounded rewards. Our code will be released at https://github.com/Ffunkytao/SERL-SQL.

AI.tldr: SERL-SQL提出了一种基于选择性执行反馈的强化学习框架，用于多轮Text-to-SQL智能体。它通过训练专用的教师模型对学生的SQL动作进行重新打分，并将教师-学生似然差距转化为有界掩码权重来重加权GRPO优势，从而实现对SQL和工具动作令牌的局部信用分配。在BIRD和Spider基准上分别达到76.56%和89.92%的执行准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL系统大多使用执行正确性作为轨迹级奖励，这仅能提供粗粒度的反馈信号，无法精确识别导致成功或失败的SQL决策，限制了模型的学习效率和性能提升。
AI.method: SERL-SQL采用选择性执行增强的强化学习框架：(1) 采样on-policy的SQL交互轨迹；(2) 使用仅训练阶段的教师模型基于执行反馈对学生的动作重新评分；(3) 将教师-学生似然差距转换为有界掩码权重；(4) 仅在SQL和工具动作令牌上重加权GRPO优势，实现局部信用分配。
AI.result: 在BIRD-Dev上达到76.56%的执行准确率，在Spider-Test上达到89.92%；奖励基选择策略接近oracle Best-of-N上界，且优于基于一致性的选择方法。
AI.conclusion: SERL-SQL通过细粒度的执行反馈信用分配显著提升了多轮Text-to-SQL智能体的性能，且其奖励基候选选择策略能够可靠地识别高质量候选，展现出良好的可扩展性和实用性。

title: CrystalMem: Elastic Memory for Self-Evolving LLM Agents via Knowledge Crystallization
summary: Memory for self-evolving large language model (LLM) agents is often provisioned as if its byte budget only grows. Cloud platforms, however, adjust quotas with load and cost, and we show that capability does not follow the budget back up: after a squeeze-and-recover cycle, the agent settles below its pre-squeeze level, a gap we call memory hysteresis. The cause is structural. Deletion and one-way compression discard the material needed for later rebuilding, and we prove that any policy that only keeps or drops entries carries a residual-deficit floor. We propose CrystalMem (Crystallized Memory), an elastic memory sidecar that demotes entries across four fidelity states under a crystallization-energy schedule, orders demotions by advantage-weighted influence with dependency coupling, and recovers capability through verified recrystallization under explicit compute and byte caps. Across seven environments, seventeen methods, and six backbones, with multi-tenant serving and a physical edge-cloud deployment, CrystalMem achieves the highest restored capability in every setting and closes the loop left open by every baseline. From a 50% byte budget, CrystalMem matches the strongest budgeted baseline at full provision on every environment; at equal budgets, it leads by +4.6 pp on average.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CrystalMem，一种弹性记忆sidecar系统，解决LLM智能体在内存预算压缩-恢复周期后能力无法回到原有水平（称为"记忆迟滞"）的问题。通过四级保真度状态降级、优势加权影响力排序和依赖耦合，以及显式计算与字节上限下的再结晶恢复，在七个环境、十七种方法和六个骨干模型上均取得最优恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 云端平台会根据负载和成本调整LLM智能体的内存配额，但现有记忆管理假设字节预算只增不减。研究发现，当内存被压缩再恢复后，智能体能力无法回到压缩前水平（记忆迟滞现象），根本原因在于删除和单向压缩会丢弃后期重建所需的材料，且仅做保留或丢弃的策略存在固有的残余赤字下限。
AI.method: CrystalMem采用弹性记忆sidecar架构：1) 将条目在四种保真度状态间按"结晶能量调度"进行降级；2) 使用优势加权影响力并耦合依赖关系来确定降级顺序；3) 在显式计算和字节上限约束下通过验证性再结晶恢复能力。
AI.result: 在七个环境、十七种方法、六个骨干模型、多租户服务和物理边缘云部署中，CrystalMem在所有设置下均取得最高恢复能力。在50%字节预算下，CrystalMem在每种环境中都匹配了最强基线在完全供给时的表现；在相同预算下平均领先4.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: CrystalMem解决了所有基线未解决的记忆迟滞问题，在弹性内存管理方面实现了最优的能力恢复，证明了通过精细的保真度管理而非简单的保留/丢弃策略，可以有效克服LLM智能体记忆系统的结构性缺陷。

title: The methodology of Constructing the Large-Scale Dataset for Detecting Presuicidal and Anti-Suicidal Signals in Social Media Texts in Russian
summary: The suicide is a terrifying act of a person who is misled by his own mental state. This problem arises across many countries. Sadly, Russia also has quite high number of persons who committed suicide. Luckily, a subset of these people writes their struggles in social media, allowing a way to find them and help. However, these valuable texts disappearing in many irrelevant texts which is considerably slowing down the decision process about person's suicidal risk. To tackle this problem, in this work we have presented a detailed methodology of building the dataset for detecting texts that describe presuicidal and anti-suicidal signals. This methodology describes the process of instruction and class table creation, the process of annotation, verification and post-annotation correction. Guiding by this methodology, we collect and annotate a large-scale Russian dataset with more than 50 thousand texts from social media. We provide a count statistic of the dataset as well as common problems in annotation. We also conduct basic experiments of building the classification models to show the on go performance on different levels of annotation. Furthermore, we make the dataset, code and all materials publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套构建俄语自杀倾向检测数据集的方法论，收集并标注了超过5万条来自社交媒体的文本，区分自杀前信号和反自杀信号，并提供了基础分类实验结果及公开资源。
AI.motivation: 俄罗斯自杀率较高，部分有自杀倾向的人会在社交媒体上表达挣扎，但这些有价值文本被大量无关内容淹没，影响了自杀风险评估决策的效率，亟需一个高质量数据集来训练检测模型。
AI.method: 提出了完整的数据集构建方法论，包括指令和类别表创建、标注流程、验证及标注后修正；基于此方法论从社交媒体收集并标注了超过5万条俄语文本，并进行了基础分类模型实验。
AI.result: 构建了包含5万+俄语文本的大规模数据集，提供了数据集统计信息和标注中常见问题，并展示了不同标注层级上的分类模型性能。数据集、代码及所有材料均公开可用。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一套可复用的自杀信号检测数据集构建流程和公开资源，有助于提升社交媒体中自杀风险评估的效率，为后续研究和实际应用奠定了基础。

title: Manifold-GS: Certified Hybrid Assets via Varifold-Conservative Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) gives high-quality novel-view synthesis, but its adaptive radiance primitives are not directly usable as structured assets: opacity is not an additive area measure, refinement can change the induced geometry, and watertight mesh extraction can hallucinate collision surfaces in unobserved regions. We introduce Manifold-GS, a certified hybrid asset layer for Gaussian scenes. The method separates appearance opacity from geometric quadrature mass, represents surface-like Gaussians as a discrete unoriented varifold, and exports only confidence-certified open surface patches while retaining uncertified content as residual splats. It provides refinement-conservative mass transport, local realizability diagnostics, source-preserving patch bindings, and conservative collision candidates. On three DTU scenes, a frozen asset benchmark shows zero patch-defined edit leakage, texture round-trip PSNR of 30.1/35.3/33.7 dB, and lower collision floater area than official 2DGS meshes on all scenes, with large gaps on two scenes. The result is a precision-coverage tradeoff rather than a universal reconstruction claim. External-region annotations, phantom-collision probes, and 5k-face simplification further support the certified asset interpretation, while RGB-only experiments show that local realizability is not sufficient for sparse-view surface identifiability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Manifold-GS，一种用于3D高斯泼溅场景的认证混合资产生成层。该方法将外观不透明度与几何积分质量分离，将类表面高斯表示为离散无向变体，仅导出置信度认证的开放表面补丁，未认证内容保留为残差溅射，实现零编辑泄漏、高纹理往返PSNR和更低的碰撞浮点数区域。
AI.motivation: 3DGS提供高质量新视角合成，但其自适应辐射基元不能直接作为结构化资产使用：不透明度不是可加面积度量，细化可能改变诱导几何，且水密网格提取可能在未观测区域产生幻觉碰撞表面。
AI.method: Manifold-GS将外观不透明度与几何积分质量分离，将类表面高斯表示为离散无向变体，只导出置信度认证的开放表面补丁，未认证内容保留为残差溅射。提供细化保守质量传输、局部可实现性诊断、源保持补丁绑定和保守碰撞候选。
AI.result: 在三个DTU场景上的冻结资产基准测试中，实现了零补丁定义编辑泄漏，纹理往返PSNR为30.1/35.3/33.7 dB，在所有场景上碰撞浮点区域低于官方2DGS网格，其中两个场景差距较大。
AI.conclusion: 该方法的成果是精度-覆盖率权衡而非通用重建声明。外部区域注释、幻影碰撞探测和5k面简化支持认证资产解释；RGB-only实验表明局部可实现性不足以实现稀疏视角表面可识别性。

title: Trust and Its Betrayal under Three Representational Strategies
summary: Trust is a propositional attitude of a distinctive kind: to trust is to rely on another under conditions where reliance could be disappointed, and the disappointment of trust---betrayal---differs qualitatively from the disappointment of a prediction. We treat trust as a \emph{subjunctive} epistemic state: $A$ trusts $B$'s competence when $A$ believes that \emph{were $P$ true, $B$ would know it}, and $B$'s integrity when $A$ believes that \emph{were $B$ to know $P$, he would disclose it to $A$}. We develop three representations of this state---as lexicographic \emph{assumption} as \emph{ordinal closeness} in a Lewis--Stalnaker sphere system , and as \emph{strong belief} in a conditional probability system and for each we ask whether the Brandenburger--Keisler impossibility on common belief survives when the assumption of rationality is replaced by an assumption of trustworthiness. The three representations agree that every \emph{finite} depth of common trust is realizable while the \emph{completed} common-trust fixed point is the locus of difficulty, but they differ sharply in \emph{how} the difficulty manifests, and---our organizing finding---in how each survives a concrete betrayal. W show that the same betrayal refutes an agent's \emph{level ordering} under the lexicographic representation, contaminates her \emph{closeness ordering} in proportion to the betrayer's deliberateness under the ordinal representation, and merely \emph{shifts her operative conditioning hypothesis} while leaving her belief structure coherent under the strong-belief representation.

AI.tldr: 该论文将信任形式化为一种虚拟条件句式的认识状态（分为能力信任与诚信信任），发展出三种表示方式（词典序假设、序数接近度、强信念），并考察在信任替代理性假设后，Brandenburger–Keisler共同信念不可能性结果是否仍然成立。三种表示一致认为有限深度的共同信任是可实现的，但完整共同信任不动点是困难所在；且面对具体背叛时三种表示的行为表现截然不同。
AI.motivation: 信任不同于普通的预测性依赖，其失望（背叛）在质上与预测落空不同。作者希望将信任作为一种独特的命题态度加以形式化，并探讨在信任假设取代理性假设后，博弈论中的共同信念不可能性结果（Brandenburger–Keisler）是否仍然成立。
AI.method: 作者将信任定义为虚拟条件句的认识状态：A信任B的能力意味着"若P为真，B会知道"；信任B的诚信意味着"若B知道P，他会告诉A"。在此基础上提出三种形式化表示：(1) 词典序假设（lexicographic assumption）；(2) Lewis–Stalnaker球系统中的序数接近度（ordinal closeness）；(3) 条件概率系统中的强信念（strong belief）。对每种表示，考察共同信任的不可能性问题。
AI.result: 三种表示一致表明：任何有限深度的共同信任都可实现，但完整的共同信任不动点（fixed point）是困难所在。然而三种表示在困难如何显现上存在显著差异：在词典序表示下，一次具体背叛会反驳代理人的层级排序；在序数表示下，背叛会按其蓄意程度污染接近度排序；在强信念表示下，背叛仅转移其操作性的条件化假设，而信念结构保持连贯。
AI.conclusion: 信任的虚拟条件句形式化揭示了共同信任与共同理性的深层结构差异。虽然三种表示在有限与无限深度上达成一致，但其对背叛的不同反应说明信任建模在表示选择上的关键敏感性——不同表示捕捉了信任状态的不同本质侧面。

title: Learning How Much, Not Just What: Cross-Patient Burden Order for CT Vision-Language Pretraining
summary: Volumetric CT vision-language pretraining learns 3D representations from scan-report pairs, but global and anatomy-aware objectives supervise only correspondence: they establish what is present and leave how much unconstrained. Nothing separates a mild from an extensive case of the same finding along a consistent direction, so the graded burden language in reports collapses into a present/absent signal. Longitudinal supervision would supply this order, but patient-matched CT pairs are scarce at scale; cross-sectional cohorts already encode weak burden cues across different patients. We introduce Spectrum, an anatomy-conditioned framework that represents each study at whole-study and organ scopes. For each organ-mapped pathology, a rule-based scorer mines confidence-filtered lower-to-higher pairs of different patients, and Burden-Direction Alignment (BDA) aligns the pathology-conditioned image delta with the report delta at each scope, separating that direction from its reverse. Because the endpoints are different people, a target-conditioned aligner first makes them comparable, so the delta reflects burden rather than between-patient variation. BDA further separates the selected direction from its reverse, anchors it to the observed higher-burden endpoint, and enforces consistency across ordered triplets. Since every pair is drawn within a single pathology, BDA is designed to constrain intra-class structure that image-report contrast alone never touches. Spectrum attains 85.6 zero-shot AUROC on CT-RATE and 72.7 on external RAD-ChestCT, with consistent gains in linear probing and retrieval. Weak cross-patient order is thus a scalable complement to anatomy-aware correspondence, yielding burden-aware CT representations without longitudinal data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Spectrum框架，利用跨患者间的弱负担排序信号来学习CT影像中疾病严重程度的3D表示，无需纵向配对数据，在CT-RATE和RAD-ChestCT上分别达到85.6和72.7的零样本AUROC。
AI.motivation: 现有的CT视觉-语言预训练方法（如全局对齐和器官感知目标）只能区分"有无"疾病，无法区分同一发现中的"轻症与重症"。纵向监督数据稀缺，而横断面队列中已隐含着不同患者间的弱负担线索未被利用。
AI.method: 提出Spectrum框架：(1) 在整研究尺度和器官尺度上表示每个研究；(2) 对每个器官映射的病理，用基于规则的评分器挖掘经置信度过滤的不同患者间的低-高负担样本对；(3) Burden-Direction Alignment (BDA) 将病理条件化的影像差异与报告差异对齐，分离负担方向与其反向；(4) 通过目标条件化对齐器消除患者间变异，使差异反映负担而非个体差异；(5) BDA还锚定高负担端点，并在有序三元组上强制执行一致性约束。
AI.result: Spectrum在CT-RATE上达到85.6零样本AUROC，在外部RAD-ChestCT上达到72.7，在线性探测和检索任务中也获得一致性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 弱跨患者排序是解剖感知对应关系的可扩展补充，能够在无需纵向数据的情况下获得负担感知的CT表示。

title: Learning to Coordinate Symbolic Tools: LLM Agents for Verified Sum-of-Squares Certificates
summary: Tool calling allows large language models (LLMs) to invoke external computation during problem solving, a useful capability in various fields including AI for mathematics. We study this setting through weighted sum-of-squares (SOS) decomposition, a machine-checkable route to proving polynomial nonnegativity and hence polynomial inequalities. A candidate decomposition can be checked exactly, but finding one requires choosing among non-unique regroupings and coordinating multiple symbolic transformations. We develop an agent that combines algebraic task training, symbolic tools, and verifier-grounded optimization for this task. Rather than training only on the composite SOS task, we construct 1.35 million synthetic examples covering eight supporting polynomial tasks together with weighted-SOS decomposition. We first apply supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to direct algebra problems and simulated symbolic traces, and then use Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with task-specific symbolic rewards. The SFT corpus contains no native tool-calling messages; at evaluation, the agent uses native SymPy calls for expansion, collection, reordering, and factorization. Every final SOS answer is checked by exact expansion and coefficient comparison. On held-out, same-generator synthetic problems, the full SFT+GRPO+tools system is the strongest of four evaluated configurations, reaching 78.96% verified success on weighted SOS, compared with 44.73% for the base model with the same tools, and 91.75% macro accuracy across nine polynomial tasks. Within this controlled setting, our work provides a case study of combining domain-specific skill training, executable tools, and verifier feedback, and may inform the design of tool-calling agents in other domains with exactly checkable outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型在数学领域中通过工具调用完成加权平方和（SOS）分解的任务，构建了一个结合代数任务训练、符号工具和验证器反馈的智能体系统，在合成测试集上达到78.96%的验证成功率。
AI.motivation: 工具调用是大语言模型解决数学问题的重要能力，而加权SOS分解虽然可以被精确验证，但找到候选分解需要处理非唯一的重组选择和多种符号变换的协调，这对LLM提出了独特的挑战。
AI.method: 该方法构建135万个涵盖八种支撑多项式任务及加权SOS分解的合成训练样本，先进行监督微调（SFT）训练代数问题和模拟符号轨迹，再使用GRPO算法配合任务专属符号奖励进行强化学习。评估时智能体使用原生SymPy调用进行展开、合并、重排和因式分解，最终SOS答案通过精确展开和系数比较验证。
AI.result: 在保序生成的合成测试集上，完整的SFT+GRPO+工具系统在四种配置中表现最强，加权SOS验证成功率达78.96%（基线模型仅44.73%），九个多项式任务的宏平均准确率达91.75%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作在可控设定下展示了结合领域技能训练、可执行工具和验证器反馈的有效性，为其他具有可精确检查输出的领域中设计工具调用智能体提供了参考案例。

title: Rethinking and formalising the state across languages: a unified computational learning theory account
summary: The linguistic notion of state has traditionally been restricted to the construct (annexation) state of Afroasiatic languages and treated as a language-specific morphosyntactic phenomenon. This article argues instead that the state is a systemic, context-dependent morphosyntactic mechanism that selects grammatical templates across synthetic languages. Within the Template-Based Modular Cognitive framework, taking Riffian as its primary empirical basis, the proposed theory provides a unified explanation for diverse nominal marking patterns traditionally analysed independently and is formalised as a symbolic computational model in which the state is represented by a set-valued function over grammatical templates. A learning algorithm based on finite-set operations acquires and predicts state-dependent grammatical configurations. Beyond nominal morphology, the framework has broader implications for theories of nominal structure and lexical cognition, in particular offering a unified analysis of determiner-noun structure. These results suggest that the state constitutes one instance of a broader class of syntactically conditioned dependencies that also includes agreement and grammatical case.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"状态"（state）不应仅被视为亚非语系语言中特有的附着（annexation）形态句法现象，而应被重新定义为跨综合语中一种系统性的、依赖语境的形态句法机制。作者基于Template-Based Modular Cognitive框架，以Riffian方言为主要实证基础，将状态形式化为一个集合值函数，并提出了基于有限集合运算的学习算法来获取和预测状态依赖的语法配置，从而统一解释传统上被独立分析的各种名词标记模式。
AI.motivation: 传统语言学将"状态"概念局限于亚非语系语言（如闪米特语族）的附着态/领属态，视其为语言特定的形态句法现象，缺乏跨语言的系统性和理论统一性。作者希望证明状态是一种普适性的系统性机制，而非个别语言的特殊现象，同时为名词标记模式提供统一的理论解释框架。
AI.method: 论文在Template-Based Modular Cognitive框架内提出理论模型：将"状态"形式化为一个定义在语法模板集合上的集合值函数；基于Riffian方言丰富的名词标记现象进行实证分析；提出基于有限集合运算的学习算法，能够自动获取并预测状态依赖的语法配置；并将该框架扩展到限定词-名词结构以及更广泛的句法条件依赖（如一致关系和语法格）。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，该框架能够统一解释多种传统上被独立分析的名词标记模式；所提出的集合值函数形式化和学习算法可以有效地获取和预测状态依赖的语法配置；该理论对名词结构和词汇认知理论产生了广泛影响，特别是为限定词-名词结构提供了统一分析。这些发现还暗示状态可能属于更广泛的句法条件依赖类别，与一致关系和语法格并列。
AI.conclusion: "状态"应被重新概念化为跨语言的系统性形态句法机制，而非亚非语系特有的局域现象。该理论不仅为Riffian语的名词标记提供了统一解释，还暗示了一个更广泛的语法依赖类别——包含状态、一致关系与语法格在内的句法条件依赖。这为综合语研究和形态句法理论提供了新的理论视角和计算模型工具。

title: RMSWeb: Reflection, Failure-Mode Mining, and Salvage-DS for Web Agent Reinforcement Learning
comment: 15 pages, 9 figures, and 6 tables. Includes appendices
summary: Compact web agents can reduce deployment cost, but training them poses challenges in both data collection and post-SFT reinforcement learning (RL). Successful trajectories are expensive to collect and often contain inefficient detours. After supervised fine-tuning (SFT), full trajectory corpora are dominated by routine states; moreover, when group-relative RL is applied to web actions, inadequately designed action-level rewards can yield weak or misleading relative updates, while groups rejected as unsuitable for such updates receive no fallback learning signal. We present RMSWeb, a three-part recipe for Qwen3-VL-Instruct at 8B and 32B. Reflection-conditioned retries increase collection yield and shorten successful trajectories; failure-mode mining concentrates offline RL on critical states exposed by the SFT policy; and Salvage-DS combines an action-semantic polarized reward, contrast-and-competence-gated dynamic sampling, and an action-only anchor for rejected groups. Policies trained with reflection-collected data use up to 19.7% fewer action steps on solved tasks. On WebVoyager, Online-Mind2Web, and WebTailBench, RMSWeb improves over SFT by 2.4-7.0 points at 8B and 1.2-7.7 points at 32B. Our 8B model also achieves the strongest reported Online-Mind2Web result among similarly sized open-weight models in our comparison and a leading reported accuracy-cost trade-off on WebVoyager and WebTailBench, with the caveat that external evaluation protocols differ.

AI.tldr: RMSWeb是一种针对紧凑型Web智能体的三部分训练配方，通过反射条件重试、失败模式挖掘和Salvage-DS（动作语义极化奖励、对比-能力门控动态采样、仅动作锚点）来提升数据收集效率和强化学习效果，在8B和32B规模的Qwen3-VL模型上显著优于SFT基线。
AI.motivation: 紧凑型Web智能体虽然能降低部署成本，但训练面临两大挑战：成功轨迹收集昂贵且常含低效绕路；SFT后全轨迹语料被常规状态主导，且组相对RL中不恰当的动作级奖励会导致弱或误导性的相对更新，被拒绝的组缺乏回退学习信号。
AI.method: RMSWeb由三部分组成：(1) 反射条件重试（Reflection-conditioned retries）提高收集产出并缩短成功轨迹；(2) 失败模式挖掘（Failure-mode mining）将离线RL聚焦于SFT策略暴露的关键状态；(3) Salvage-DS结合动作语义极化奖励、对比-能力门控动态采样和针对被拒绝组的仅动作锚点。
AI.result: 在WebVoyager、Online-Mind2Web和WebTailBench上，RMSWeb相比SFT在8B规模提升2.4-7.0点，32B规模提升1.2-7.7点。反射收集的数据在已解决任务上最多减少19.7%的动作步骤。8B模型在Online-Mind2Web上达到同类开源权重模型中最强结果，并在WebVoyager和WebTailBench上取得领先的准确率-成本权衡。
AI.conclusion: RMSWeb通过针对性的数据收集改进和精细化的RL奖励设计，有效解决了紧凑型Web智能体训练中的数据稀缺和奖励信号质量问题，展示了在保持低部署成本的同时实现高性能的可行性。

title: S$^4$R: Selective Sampling, Subspaces, and Sparse Reconstruction for Compressed Long-Context KV Caching
summary: The growth of context window lengths in Large Language Models (LLMs) significantly enhances their long-context capabilities but incurs prohibitive memory costs due to the Key-Value (KV) cache. Although low-rank compression of KV cache is a promising remedy, existing methods face a dilemma: offline approaches depend on external calibration data, whereas online approaches incur substantial compute for full-prompt decomposition and reconstruction. In this paper, we propose S$^4$R, which builds low-rank subspaces from selectively sampled tokens and computes attention over a sparsely reconstructed KV representation. S$^4$R uses prompt-aware initialization to build initial key/value bases from a representative prompt subset, trading off calibration-data dependence against prefilling cost. Because fully reconstructing the cache at every decoding step is prohibitively expensive and hurts throughput, we further adopt sparse reconstruction to retain only informative positions during decoding. Extensive experiments on LongBench and RULER with Llama and Qwen model families show that S$^4$R achieves up to 5$\times$ KV compression with near full-cache accuracy, combining the efficiency of fixed compression with the adaptability of prompt-dependent methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出S⁴R方法，通过选择性采样构建低秩子空间并在解码时进行稀疏重建，实现了高达5倍的KV缓存压缩，同时保持接近全缓存的精度，兼顾了离线方法的效率与在线方法的适应性。
AI.motivation: LLM长上下文能力增强但KV缓存内存开销巨大；现有低秩压缩方法存在两难困境：离线方法依赖外部校准数据，而在线方法因全提示分解与重建导致计算开销过高。
AI.method: S⁴R方法包含三个关键设计：(1) 从选择性采样的token构建低秩子空间；(2) 使用提示感知初始化，从代表性提示子集构建初始键值基，权衡校准数据依赖与预填充成本；(3) 采用稀疏重建策略，在解码阶段仅保留信息量高的位置，避免全量重建带来的吞吐量下降。
AI.result: 在LongBench和RULER基准上，使用Llama和Qwen模型家族进行广泛实验，S⁴R实现了高达5倍的KV压缩，同时保持接近全缓存的精度。
AI.conclusion: S⁴R成功结合了固定压缩方法的效率与提示依赖方法的适应性，在保持高精度的前提下实现了显著的KV缓存压缩，解决了现有低秩压缩方法的效率-适应性矛盾。

title: Attention-Steered Vision-Language Models for Sign Language Translation
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as a powerful framework for multimodal video understanding. However, they remain limited in the sign language translation task, where we identify a key failure mode of existing VLMbased translators: poor spatial-temporal visual grounding. In particular, we find that standard next-token cross-entropy does not directly provide signal for where and when the model should attend, causing models to overlook sign-relevant regions and frames. To address this challenge, we propose AttnSign, a VLM-based spatial-temporal attention steering framework for sign language translation. AttnSign first introduces spatial attention supervision for sign-relevant regions, such as face and hands, in each frame; then develops an RL-based motion-cadence steering method that encourages the model to explore and focus on sign-level keyframes. Experimental results on How2Sign and OpenASL benchmarks show that our proposed AttnSign consistently outperforms existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AttnSign，一种基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的空间-时间注意力引导框架，用于解决手语翻译中VLM存在的空间-时间视觉定位不足问题，通过在帧内对脸部/手部等关键区域进行空间注意力监督，并利用基于强化学习（RL）的运动节奏引导方法聚焦关键帧，在How2Sign和OpenASL基准上超越了现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的VLM在手语翻译任务中表现受限，核心问题在于模型缺乏空间-时间视觉定位能力——标准的next-token交叉熵损失无法直接为模型提供"应该关注哪里、何时关注"的信号，导致模型忽略与手语相关的关键区域和关键帧。
AI.method: 提出AttnSign框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) 空间注意力监督——对每一帧中与手语相关的区域（如脸部、手部）施加注意力监督信号；(2) 基于RL的运动节奏引导——通过强化学习鼓励模型探索并聚焦于手语级别的关键帧。
