AI.result: 在How2Sign和OpenASL两个基准数据集上的实验结果表明，AttnSign在性能上持续优于现有的手语翻译方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式地对模型的空间和时间注意力进行引导，可以有效提升VLM在手语翻译任务中的表现，验证了注意力引导机制在跨模态视频理解中的有效性。

title: Bayesian and Motivated Reasoning in AI Agents
summary: AI agents increasingly perform open-ended tasks in settings where their conclusions can guide consequential decisions. We provide evidence that AI agents draw different conclusions from identical numerical data when the substantive framing changes. We demonstrate this behavior in high-stakes domains in medicine, election forensics, and geopolitical forecasting by holding the evidence fixed while changing the scenario in which the evidence appears. Across twelve agent-domain comparisons, agents' conclusions are strongly influenced by their prior beliefs. They are more likely to reach an affirmative conclusion when it is framed around a proposition they already regard as likely, while the reverse holds when the framing conflicts with their prior. The framing also changes how some agents work: they search more extensively, choose different analytical specifications, and evaluate the same evidence differently. These results identify a particular risk of delegating decision-making to AI agents, as their decisions may depend on prior beliefs that are neither specified in the task nor visible in the decision record.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现AI智能体在处理相同数值数据时，会因问题框架的不同而得出不同结论。在医学、选举预测和地缘政治预测等高风险领域中，通过十二项智能体-领域对比实验，发现智能体的结论强烈受其先验信念影响——当结论与智能体认为可能的前提一致时更倾向于肯定回答，反之则相反。框架还会改变智能体的工作方式，包括搜索范围、分析规范和证据评估。这揭示了将决策委托给AI智能体的特定风险。
AI.motivation: 随着AI智能体越来越多地处理开放式任务并影响关键决策，需要考察其是否能在相同证据下保持结论的一致性。作者希望识别AI智能体在决策过程中可能引入的、任务之外且不可见的偏见风险。
AI.method: 在医学、选举预测和地缘政治预测三个高风险领域，固定数值证据不变，仅改变证据出现的情境框架，设计十二项智能体-领域对比实验，系统观察智能体结论是否随框架变化而改变。
AI.result: 智能体结论强烈受先验信念影响：当框架与先验一致时更倾向于得出肯定结论，相反则更倾向于否定。框架还影响智能体的工作过程，包括更广泛的搜索、不同的分析规范选择以及对相同证据的不同评估。
AI.conclusion: AI智能体在决策中可能依赖于任务中未指定的先验信念，这些信念既不在任务规范中也不在决策记录中可见，这对将决策委托给AI智能体构成特定风险。

title: Native Multilingual Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Low-Resource Southeast Asian Languages
summary: Large Language Models have achieved substantial progress in reasoning capabilities. Yet in low-resource native settings, many suffer from cross-lingual collapse, reverting to English during intermediate steps that require complex logical reasoning. This presents a cold-start bottleneck for policy optimization, whereas standard fine-tuning risks catastrophic forgetting due to cross-lingual representation drift. To address these challenges, we introduce the Onramp-Sequence Cross-Distillation (OSCD), a post-training algorithm that projects high-resource reasoning trajectories into low-resource vocabulary subspaces during generative training rollouts via an integrated translator agentic loop, ensuring the stable and efficient translation of dynamically generated reference samples for fine-tuning. This is coupled with joint-embedding semantic alignment of both reference and target-language reasoning traces, thereby bridging the pairwise cross-lingual representational gaps. Comprehensive evaluations using the AIME25 and HMMT25 benchmarks demonstrate that OSCD yields up to 3.2 times overall improvements in native Southeast Asian languages for mathematical reasoning, of which the joint-embedding semantic alignment component contributes up to 6.4% improvements in linguistic debiasing over translation-only baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出OSCD后训练算法，通过翻译代理循环将高资源语言推理轨迹投影到低资源语言词汇子空间，并结合联合嵌入语义对齐，解决低资源语言中LLM的跨语言推理崩塌问题，在AIME25和HMMT25基准上实现高达3.2倍的数学推理性能提升。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在推理能力上取得显著进展，但在低资源母语环境中常出现跨语言崩塌现象（复杂推理中间步骤回退到英语）。标准微调存在灾难性遗忘风险，策略优化面临冷启动瓶颈，亟需一种稳定的后训练方法来解决低资源语言的推理能力提升问题。
AI.method: OSCD包含两个核心组件：(1) 通过集成的翻译代理循环，在生成式训练rollout期间将高资源语言的推理轨迹投影到低资源语言词汇子空间，实现动态生成参考样本的稳定高效翻译；(2) 联合嵌入语义对齐，对参考语言和目标语言推理轨迹进行语义对齐，桥接跨语言表示差距。
AI.result: 在AIME25和HMMT25基准上，OSCD在东南亚本土语言的数学推理任务中实现高达3.2倍的整体性能提升；其中联合嵌入语义对齐组件相较于仅翻译的基线，在语言去偏方面贡献了高达6.4%的改进。
AI.conclusion: OSCD通过翻译代理循环与联合嵌入语义对齐的组合方案，有效缓解了低资源语言环境下的跨语言崩塌问题，为低资源语言的推理能力后训练提供了可行路径，验证了语义对齐在语言去偏中的关键作用。

title: Gene Ontology-Guided Hierarchical Spatial Gene Expression Prediction from Histopathology Images
comment: Accepted by ACM MM 2026. Code: https://github.com/NozomiMizore/MSGR
summary: Predicting spatial gene expression from histopathology images enables large-scale transcriptomic profiling without the cost of direct measurement. Existing methods decode the target gene set as a flat, unstructured vector, ignoring the inter-gene dependencies arising from shared biological pathways and regulatory programs. Without explicit structural guidance, models must infer these dependencies entirely from limited paired data, constraining prediction quality. We propose MSGR (Multi-Scale Gene Refiner), which bridges this gap by incorporating the Gene Ontology (GO), a curated functional hierarchy of genes, as an explicit structural prior. MSGR organizes target genes into a four-level GO tree. Its GO-guided decoder then progressively refines predictions from coarse functional domains to fine individual genes via residual corrections under scale-weighted supervision. Operating solely on the gene side, the GO-guided decoder serves as a seamless plug-in replacement that consistently improves existing architectures without requiring any image-side modifications. Extensive experiments on nine datasets from the HEST-1k benchmark provide empirical evidence for two central claims: GO-structured decoding consistently outperforms flat decoding, even against a state-of-the-art generative baseline, and the gain is attributable to biological ontology structure rather than hierarchical decomposition per se, as confirmed by a +0.027 margin over a structurally equivalent random hierarchy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MSGR（多尺度基因精炼器），将基因本体（Gene Ontology）作为显式结构先验，把目标基因组织成四层GO树，通过GO引导的解码器从粗粒度功能域到细粒度个体基因逐步精炼预测。在HEST-1k基准的九个数据集上，GO结构化解码一致优于平面解码，且增益归因于生物本体结构本身而非层级分解，较随机层级结构有+0.027的提升。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将目标基因集解码为扁平的无结构向量，忽略了由共享生物通路和调控程序引起的基因间依赖关系。缺乏显式结构引导时，模型必须完全从有限的配对数据中推断这些依赖，限制了预测质量。
AI.method: MSGR利用基因本体（GO）——一个经过整理的基因功能层级——作为显式结构先验。将目标基因组织为四层GO树，GO引导解码器在尺度加权监督下通过残差校正从粗粒度功能域逐步精炼预测到细粒度个体基因。该解码器仅作用于基因侧，可作为即插即用的替换模块，无需修改图像侧。
AI.result: 在HEST-1k基准的九个数据集上进行广泛实验，验证了两个核心结论：GO结构化解码一致优于平面解码（甚至优于最先进的生成基线）；增益归因于生物本体结构而非层级分解本身，与结构等效的随机层级相比有+0.027的净提升。
AI.conclusion: MSGR证明了将基因本体作为显式结构先验可以有效提升从组织病理学图像预测空间基因表达的准确率，且提供了一种无需修改图像架构的通用改进方案。

title: DE-NER : Zero-shot Named Entity Recognition via Dialogue Elicitation of Large Language Models
summary: Recent advancements of zero-shot Named Entity Recognition (NER) establish strong baselines by formulating sequence labeling into question answering where Large Language Models (LLMs) can be naturally adopted. However, existing LLM-based zero-shot NER methods suffer from the limitations of prompt and demonstration engineering. To address these issues with minimal human interventions, we introduce DE-NER, a dialogue elicitation framework which elicits the chatting ability of LLMs to fully extract the knowledge encoded in LLMs. Our experiments demonstrate that the proposed method outperform the competitive baselines in zero-shot settings across multiple benchmarks, with an average improvement of 3.75\% F1 points. Codes are released in https://github.com/kkkenshi/DE-NER.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DE-NER框架，通过对话引导方式激发大语言模型的聊天能力来执行零样本命名实体识别，无需复杂的提示词和示例工程，在多个基准上平均提升3.75% F1分数。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于大语言模型的零样本NER方法将序列标注转化为问答形式，但严重依赖提示词和示例工程的设计，存在人工干预多、泛化能力受限的问题。
AI.method: 提出DE-NER（对话引导框架），利用对话式引导（dialogue elicitation）来激发大语言模型的聊天能力，从而充分挖掘LLM中编码的知识来完成零样本NER任务，减少对提示词和示例工程的人工依赖。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的零样本设置下，DE-NER优于竞争基线方法，平均F1分数提升3.75个百分点。
AI.conclusion: DE-NER通过对话引导策略有效克服了传统提示词工程的局限性，为零样本NER提供了一种更少人工干预且性能更优的解决方案，代码已开源。

title: Semantically Calibrated Evidence Composition for CT Vision-Language Learning
summary: Learning transferable representations from CT-report pairs requires combining whole-volume context with anatomy-specific evidence. Existing methods typically emphasize either global CT-report alignment or fine-grained anatomy-level correspondence. Global alignment preserves broad study context but leaves the contribution of localized evidence implicit, whereas anatomy-level alignment explicitly grounds local findings but does not specify how independently represented evidence should interact, acquire study-level meaning, and contribute to a global CT representation. To address this gap, we propose SCOPE (Semantic Calibration Of comPosed Evidence), a framework for semantically calibrated evidence composition in CT vision-language learning. Under organ-specific report supervision, mask-guided queries with fixed anatomical identities extract context-aware organ evidence from shared, uncropped volumetric features, while an unrestricted global query retains access to whole-volume context. The global query then drives Local-Global Coupling to compose the organ evidence into a unified evidence representation. The composed evidence is subsequently calibrated using the diagnostic summary, providing study-level semantic supervision beyond local organ descriptions, and is finally integrated as a controlled residual into a context-preserving whole-volume representation aligned with the complete report. This progressive pathway connects localized evidence with study-level semantics without reducing the CT representation to a predefined set of organs. On CT-RATE and RadChestCT, SCOPE achieves macro AUCs of 85.0 and 72.2, respectively, outperforming the previous SOTA by 7.2 and 4.2, while also yielding substantial gains in linear probing and cross-modal retrieval. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of semantically calibrated evidence composition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCOPE框架，用于CT视觉-语言学习中的语义校准证据组合。通过掩码引导查询提取器官级证据，全局查询驱动局部-全局耦合组成统一证据，再用诊断摘要进行语义校准，最后以受控残差形式整合进保留上下文的整体表征中。在CT-RATE和RadChestCT上分别达到85.0和72.2的macro AUC，超越此前SOTA 7.2和4.2。
AI.motivation: 现有CT-报告表征学习方法存在两种范式：全局对齐保留整体语境但隐式处理局部证据；解剖级对齐显式定位局部发现但未说明独立证据如何交互、获得研究级语义并贡献于全局CT表征。为解决这一缺口，需要一种既保留全卷语境又显式组合局部证据的框架。
AI.method: SCOPE框架包含三个关键步骤：(1) 在器官特定报告监督下，使用带固定解剖身份的掩码引导查询从未裁剪的共享体积特征中提取上下文感知的器官证据，同时保留不受限制的全局查询访问全卷上下文；(2) 全局查询通过局部-全局耦合机制将器官证据组合为统一的证据表征；(3) 组合证据经诊断摘要校准后，作为受控残差整合进保留上下文的整体表征中，实现渐进式从局部证据到研究级语义的连接。
AI.result: 在CT-RATE和RadChestCT数据集上，SCOPE的macro AUC分别达到85.0和72.2，较此前SOTA分别提升7.2和4.2；在线性探针和跨模态检索任务中也取得了显著提升。
AI.conclusion: SCOPE通过语义校准的证据组合，有效弥合了局部解剖证据与整体研究级语义之间的鸿沟，在不将CT表征降维为预设器官集合的前提下实现了局部证据与全局语境的有机结合，验证了该框架的有效性。

title: Where did the ambiguity go? Examining how multimodal models interpret polysemous words
summary: Human language is highly polysemous. Many common words (e.g., 'bank' or 'palm') carry several distinct meanings that shape what humans communicate and imagine. Large language models (LLMs) have been shown to understand this multiplicity of meaning, but much less is known about how polysemy surfaces in other modalities such as images. We study this across 17 text-to-image and 15 text-generation models by giving each a polysemous word with no context to fix its meaning and measuring which senses are produced over many samples. We find a clear multimodal gap, where within every model family, generated images settle on far fewer senses than generated sentences (normalized entropy 0.10 vs. 0.25), and both are far less varied than what people imagine for the same words (normalized entropy 0.47). However, when we instead ask a model to list how often it would generate outputs corresponding to each possible meaning of a word, it predicts distributions that are more diverse than the actual space of outputs. These results reveal a multimodal gap in how foundation models express meaning, and how their understanding may not transfer faithfully nor equally across modalities.

AI.tldr: 本研究跨17个文生图模型和15个文本生成模型，考察多义词在图像和文本两种模态中的语义多样性表达，发现图文之间存在明显的模态差距：图像生成比文本生成覆盖更少的词义，且两者都远低于人类想象的多义性。
AI.motivation: 人类语言高度多义，虽然已知大语言模型能理解词的多重含义，但对多义词在其他模态（如图像）中如何体现知之甚少，需要系统性地量化这种跨模态的多义性表达差异。
AI.method: 对32个模型（17个文本到图像模型和15个文本生成模型），给出不带上下文的歧义词，多次采样并测量生成的词义分布，计算归一化熵来量化多样性，并与人类想象的多义分布进行对比。
AI.result: 存在明显的多模态差距：图像生成的归一化熵仅0.10，文本生成0.25，而人类想象为0.47。此外，当模型被要求预测自己会生成哪些含义时，其预测的分布比实际输出更丰富多样。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型在多义词表达上存在模态间不一致，模型对词义的理解无法忠实地、平等地跨模态迁移，这揭示了多模态基础模型在语义表达方面的局限性。

title: Loanword or Switch? The Annotation Boundary, Not the Model, Drives Kazakh-Russian Code-Switching Identification
comment: 5 pages. Preprint. Submitted to W-NUT 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/naadgob/KazNLP
summary: Off-the-shelf LID and letter heuristics over-label Kazakh-Russian social text as mixed: Russian loanwords inside Kazakh look like code-switching under a shared Cyrillic script. We release a document-level gold LID set whose guideline keeps integrated borrowings as Kazakh and reserves mixed for clause-level switches, plus a mixed-only sentiment pool used after LID in a filter-first cascade. On a shared LID test, FastText, Lingua, raw and windowed HeLI, character-trigram NB, and XLM-R range from weak to strong performance. The gap shows the bottleneck is the loanword-vs-switch annotation boundary, not model class alone.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现成语言识别（LID）工具在哈萨克-俄语社交媒体文本上过度标记为"混合语言"，原因是西里尔字母共享导致俄罗斯借词被误判为语码转换。作者发布了一个文档级金标准LID数据集（将整合借词归为哈萨克语，仅将从句级转换视为混合），以及一个混合情感语料库，采用"先LID过滤，再情感分析"的级联流程。多个LID模型在该测试集上表现从弱到强各不相同，揭示瓶颈在于借词与语码转换的标注边界，而非模型类别本身。
AI.motivation: 现成的语言识别工具无法准确区分哈萨克语中的俄语借词与真正的语码转换，导致社交媒体文本被错误标记为混合语言，影响下游情感分析等任务。
AI.method: 构建文档级金标准LID数据集，标注准则将整合借词归为哈萨克语、仅从句级切换视为混合；同时构建仅含混合文本的情感语料库，采用LID过滤后的级联流水线；在共享测试集上评估FastText、Lingua、HeLI、字符三元组朴素贝叶斯和XLM-R等模型。
AI.result: 各LID模型在共享测试集上表现从弱到强差异显著，性能差距揭示核心瓶颈在于借词与语码转换的标注边界问题，而非单纯模型类别的局限。
AI.conclusion: 解决哈萨克-俄语混合文本识别的关键不在于更换更强的模型，而在于建立更精细的标注规范，明确区分整合借词与真正的语码转换。

title: MDWD: A Street-Level Dataset for Municipal Solid Waste Detection in Dense Urban Environments
comment: Accepted for publication at the 14th IEEE European Conference on Visual Information Processing (EUVIP 2026). 6 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables
summary: Automated visual monitoring of urban environments is a growing Computer Vision research area, but municipal solid waste detection remains under-represented in dedicated benchmark resources. Existing waste-related datasets predominantly address individual litter detection, aerial imagery, or image-level classification, and none simultaneously provide street-level imagery, instance-level localization, and categorization of domestic waste streams within a structured municipal collection context. This paper introduces the Maltese Domestic Waste Dataset (MDWD), a street-level benchmark comprising 3,697 high-resolution images and 11,461 manually annotated instances across five domestic waste categories representative of Malta's municipal collection system. The dataset captures substantial variation in location, illumination, object scale, occlusion, and urban context. To establish reproducible baselines, a cross-architecture benchmark is conducted across multiple generations of the YOLO family and a transformer-based detector. On the test set, RF-DETR-M achieves the strongest overall performance with an mAP50 of 94.49% and an F1-score of 93.56%, whilst smaller-capacity variants maintain competitive accuracy at substantially reduced parameter counts. These results indicate that MDWD supports effective training across both compact real-time detectors and transformer-based models, establishing a benchmark for future research in vision-based municipal waste monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了马耳他生活垃圾数据集（MDWD），这是一个包含3,697张街道级高分辨率图像和11,461个手动标注实例的基准数据集，涵盖五类生活垃圾。通过跨架构基准测试，RF-DETR-M在测试集上取得了最佳性能（mAP50为94.49%，F1分数为93.56%），验证了该数据集对紧凑型实时检测器和基于Transformer的模型均具有良好的训练支持能力。
AI.motivation: 城市环境自动化视觉监控是计算机视觉领域日益增长的研究方向，但生活垃圾检测在专用基准资源中代表性不足。现有废弃物数据集主要针对单个垃圾检测、航空影像或图像级分类，没有数据集能够同时提供街道级影像、实例级定位和面向市政收集背景的国内废弃物分类。
AI.method: 构建了马耳他生活垃圾数据集（MDWD），包含3,697张高分辨率街道级图像和11,461个手动标注实例，覆盖五类具有马耳他市政收集系统代表性的废弃物类别，并捕捉了地点、光照、物体尺度、遮挡和城市环境等方面的显著变化。同时进行了跨架构基准测试，涵盖多代YOLO系列模型和基于Transformer的检测器。
AI.result: 在测试集上，RF-DETR-M取得了最佳整体性能，mAP50达到94.49%，F1分数为93.56%；较小容量变体在显著减少参数数量的情况下仍保持了具有竞争力的精度。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明MDWD能够有效支持紧凑型实时检测器和基于Transformer模型的训练，为未来基于视觉的市政废弃物监测研究建立了基准。

title: SymboUQ: Symbolic Uncertainty Quantification for Spatial Reasoning in LLMs
summary: Although large language models (LLMs) can produce fluent spatial reasoning traces, their intermediate relations may fail to support the final conclusion, making token-level confidence insufficient for final-answer reliability estimation. Existing formal verifiers provide stronger semantic evidence, but their applicability is partial: a parsed claim need not yield a definite semantic verdict. To address this issue, we introduce SymboUQ, a symbolic uncertainty quantification framework that estimates final-answer reliability from reasoning traces by distinguishing symbolizability, whether a claim can be represented in the verifier's formal language, from semantic determinacy, whether its execution yields an entailed or contradicted verdict rather than an unknown or not-evaluable outcome. SymboUQ comprises (i) a Layout Auditor that executes ordered spatial claims and extracts feasibility, conflict, and repair evidence; (ii) a label-free Determinacy Profile that characterizes effective executable coverage; and (iii) a Determinacy-Aware Reliability Composer that integrates constraint-based, representation-based, and decoding-based scores according to verifier applicability. Extensive experiments on five spatial reasoning benchmarks with four frozen LLM backbones show that SymboUQ achieves approximately an 8% relative improvement in AUROC and a 7% relative reduction in class-balanced Brier loss over the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SymboUQ，一种符号化不确定性量化框架，通过区分"可符号化性"与"语义确定性"来估计大语言模型在空间推理任务中最终答案的可靠性，在五个基准上相对最强基线AUROC提升约8%、类平衡Brier损失降低约7%。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型生成的空间推理轨迹虽然流畅，但中间关系可能无法支撑最终结论，仅凭token级置信度不足以可靠估计最终答案的置信度。现有形式化验证器虽能提供更强的语义证据，但适用范围有限，因为解析后的声明不一定能产生确定的语义判定结果。
AI.method: SymboUQ包含三个核心组件：(i) Layout Auditor——执行有序空间声明并提取可行性、冲突和修复证据；(ii) 无标签的确定性画像——刻画有效的可执行覆盖范围；(iii) 确定性感知的可靠性合成器——根据验证器的适用性整合基于约束、基于表示和基于解码的分数。
AI.result: 在五个空间推理基准上使用四种冻结的大语言模型骨干进行广泛实验，SymboUQ相比最强基线在AUROC上实现约8%的相对提升，在类平衡Brier损失上实现约7%的相对降低。
AI.conclusion: 通过区分"能否被形式化表示"和"执行后能否得到确定语义判定"这两个维度，SymboUQ有效提升了大语言模型空间推理中最终答案可靠性估计的准确性，弥补了token级置信度与形式化验证器之间的适用性缺口。

title: Writing-System-Level Tokenizer Adaptation for Byte-Level BPE
comment: 15 pages. Accepted for poster presentation at the Second Tokenization Workshop (TokShop) at COLM 2026 (non-archival)
summary: Pretrained byte-level BPE tokenizers can segment underrepresented languages inefficiently. Replacing a tokenizer changes the meaning of nearly every token ID, while vocabulary expansion enlarges the model's embedding and output matrices. We study post-hoc adaptation that keeps the model-vocabulary size fixed and preserves most existing token-to-ID assignments as a construction-time compatibility property. Directly transferring tokens from a language-specific tokenizer does not guarantee derivability through the target BPE merge graph: an inserted entry can conflict with the target's greedy merge ranks. We formalize this failure as the merge ordering problem and introduce BPE-guided insertion, which builds each transferred token through a target-reachable decomposition. Our pipeline uses script-aware row selection to limit collateral fragmentation, reconstructs target-script byte-level prerequisites, and applies guided insertion to maintain merge-graph reachability. On Ukrainian adaptations of Nemotron and GPT-OSS, it reduces token counts by 33.5% and 36.6%, keeps changes on English and the evaluated four-language European aggregate within 0.05%, and retains 78.5%/77.3% of original model-vocabulary rows at the same IDs. Constraint-matched global and frequency-based removal achieve similar Ukrainian compression but increase English/European token counts by 0.7-2.2%; fresh same-size retraining compresses Ukrainian slightly more but retains effectively no same-ID rows and increases English token counts by 7.6-8.6%. The reallocation increases token counts on the evaluated three-language Cyrillic micro-aggregate by 6.7%/10.1%. Structural audits find all 28,134/45,398 inserted BPE nodes reachable under ordinary rank-ordered merging and no retained same-ID model-vocabulary entry newly broken. We release all tokenizers and code.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在保持模型词表大小不变且保留大部分原有token-ID映射的前提下，对预训练字节级BPE分词器进行后验适配（post-hoc adaptation）以改善低资源语言的表示效率。作者提出BPE引导插入（BPE-guided insertion）方法，解决从语言专用分词器迁移token时与目标BPE合并图秩冲突的"合并排序问题"，在乌克兰语Nemotron和GPT-OSS适配中分别降低33.5%和36.6%的token数量，同时保持英语及多语言性能几乎不变。
AI.motivation: 预训练字节级BPE分词器在低资源语言上分词效率低下。替换分词器会使几乎所有token ID含义改变，词表扩展又增加模型嵌入和输出矩阵规模。需要一种保持词表大小不变、保留多数既有token-ID分配的适配方案。
AI.method: 提出BPE引导插入方法：1) 形式化"合并排序问题"——直接迁移语言专用分词器的token可能与目标BPE贪心合并秩冲突；2) 通过目标可达分解（target-reachable decomposition）构建每个迁移token；3) 使用脚本感知的行选择减少附带碎片化；4) 重建目标脚本的字节级前置条件并维护合并图可达性。
AI.result: 在乌克兰语Nemotron和GPT-OSS适配中：token数量分别减少33.5%和36.6%；英语和四语言欧洲聚合的性能波动控制在0.05%以内；保留78.5%/77.3%的原始模型词表行于相同ID。对比方法（约束匹配的全局/频率移除）在乌克兰语压缩相似但英语/欧洲token数量增加0.7-2.2%；全新同规模重训练压缩略优但几乎不保留同ID行且英语token数增加7.6-8.6%。结构审计确认所有插入节点在普通秩序合并下可达。
AI.conclusion: BPE引导插入方法能够在不扩大词表、不重训练的前提下有效改善低资源语言的分词效率，同时保持原有token-ID分配的兼容性和多语言性能。该方法的局限在于西里尔文微聚合上token数量增加6.7%/10.1%，相关分词器和代码已开源。

title: Interpretability-Guided Soft Pruning of Attention Heads in Vision Transformers
summary: Vision foundation models, such as DINOv2, learn highly expressive representations but rely on massive, opaque architectures that demand substantial computational power and memory. To provide an interpretable-guided and efficient solution to this issue, we first propose a spectral analysis and new visualization technique for individual attention heads based on the Laplacian eigenvectors of their attention maps. Building upon recent observations regarding the block structure of Vision Transformers, we perform semantic clustering of attention heads and identify functional redundancies. Leveraging these insights, we introduce SAPER (Soft Attention PrunER), an end-to-end differentiable pruning framework based on the LapSum Soft Top-K approach. Extensive experiments on ImageNet-1K demonstrate that SAPER achieves a highly favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off, outperforming the competitive RAPTOR baseline in FLOPs reduction while preserving strong classification performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAPER框架，通过拉普拉斯特征向量对视觉基础模型（如DINOv2）的注意力头进行谱分析和可视化，识别功能冗余并进行语义聚类，最终基于LapSum Soft Top-K实现端到端可微的注意力头剪枝，在ImageNet-1K上取得优异的精度-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 视觉基础模型（如DINOv2）虽然能学习高度表达性的表示，但其架构庞大且不透明，需要大量的计算资源和内存。现有方法缺乏可解释性的引导，难以高效地压缩这些模型。
AI.method: 1）基于注意力图的拉普拉斯特征向量，提出新的谱分析方法和单注意力头可视化技术；2）利用Vision Transformer的块结构，对注意力头进行语义聚类并识别功能冗余；3）提出SAPER（Soft Attention PrunER）框架，基于LapSum Soft Top-K方法实现端到端可微的剪枝。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K上的广泛实验表明，SAPER实现了非常有利的精度-效率权衡，在FLOPs缩减方面优于竞争性的RAPTOR基线，同时保持了较强的分类性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过可解释性引导的谱分析方法，结合语义聚类和端到端可微剪枝框架，SAPER能够有效减少视觉基础模型的计算开销，在保持性能的同时实现更优的模型压缩效果。

title: Mask-Based Priors Are More Persistent than Query-Key Initializations
summary: Transformers do not merely lack data on some Boolean extrapolation tasks; they generalize in a systematically wrong way. Recent work on generalization on the unseen has shown that, despite fitting the observed domain, Transformers often extrapolate according to a simpler minimum-degree interpolator rather than the true target function. These Boolean tasks are not practical applications, but controlled stress tests for understanding Transformer inductive bias. We ask whether this failure mode can be corrected by injecting explicit structural priors into attention. Existing structured-initialization methods alter Transformer inductive bias indirectly, by choosing query and key projections whose similarity scores approximate a desired attention pattern. However, we find that when applied to Boolean extrapolation, these QK-based priors can be rapidly overwritten during training and fail to change the learned extrapolation rule. We propose a simpler alternative: initialize the additive attention mask directly. Unlike standard hard masks used for causality or locality attention, our mask is a finite, learnable attention-logit bias initialized from task-level interaction structure. This separates the structural prior from content-dependent attention scores, allowing it to persist throughout optimization. On Boolean reasoning tasks, mask-based initialization achieves near-perfect extrapolation where vanilla and QK-initialized Transformers remain trapped by the default inductive bias. The same mechanism also improves low-data arithmetic performance and remains competitive on vision and language benchmarks. These results show that attention masks can serve not only as architectural constraints, but as a simple substrate for encoding persistent inductive bias in Transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文发现Transformers在布尔外推任务上不仅缺乏数据，还会以系统性的错误方式进行泛化（倾向于最小次数插值器而非真实目标函数）。作者提出直接用可学习的注意力掩码偏置（attention-logit bias）进行初始化，而非通过QK投影注入结构先验，从而在训练中保持先验不被覆盖，实现近完美的外推性能，并在低数据算术、视觉和语言基准上均有提升。
AI.motivation: 先前工作表明Transformer在未见的布尔外推任务上会以系统性的错误方式泛化（采用更简单的低阶插值器），而非学习真实目标函数。现有通过QK投影注入结构先验的方法在训练中会被快速覆盖，无法改变学习到的外推规则，因此需要一种能够持久保持结构先验的新方法。
AI.method: 作者提出直接初始化可学习的加性注意力掩码（attention mask），该掩码是一个有限的、可学习的注意力logit偏置，从任务级交互结构中初始化。与标准硬掩码（如因果或局部注意力掩码）不同，该掩码将结构先验与内容相关的注意力分数分离，使其在整个优化过程中得以保持。作者对比了vanilla Transformer、QK初始化的Transformer以及mask初始化方案在布尔推理、算术、视觉和语言任务上的表现。
AI.result: 在布尔推理任务上，基于掩码初始化的Transformer实现了近乎完美的外推性能，而vanilla和QK初始化的Transformer仍被默认的归纳偏置困住。该机制同时提升了低数据算术任务的性能，并在视觉和语言基准上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 注意力掩码不仅可以用作架构约束，还可以作为一个简单的载体来编码Transformer中持久的归纳偏置，为修正Transformer在未见数据上的系统性错误外推提供了一种有效方案。

title: Verification Without Sufficiency: Per-Chunk Filtering Fails on Multi-Hop RAG, and Decomposition Repairs It
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 8 tables, 1 algorithm. Code, per-question traces and analysis scripts: https://github.com/iamhero2709/verification-without-sufficiency
summary: Verification for retrieval-augmented generation usually scores each retrieved chunk and drops the ones that fail. We show this cannot work for multi-hop questions, and show what does. Per-chunk scoring assumes one chunk is a sufficient premise for the answer. Multi-hop questions are built so that none is, and the paragraph carrying the answer is the one the question does not name. Entailment scoring reaches 0.643, 0.523 and 0.560 AUC on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA and MuSiQue, against 0.951 on single-hop SQuAD. Seven controls rule out model capacity, premise length, hypothesis template, decision threshold, retriever, answer-matching criterion and prompt. End to end across three datasets, three generator sizes and two prompts, per-chunk gating is significantly worse than not filtering at all in every cell, and its penalty grows with generator capability. The repair is to condition verification on the decomposed sub-question rather than the original query. Using MuSiQue's gold decomposition, entailment on a later hop rises from 0.546, which is chance, to 0.840, a paired lift of +0.355 with a bootstrap interval of [0.331, 0.382]. An off-the-shelf Qwen2.5-7B decomposer, given the question and the top retrieved paragraph, reaches 0.637 and captures 31% of that ceiling; decomposing without retrieval reaches 0.533, below the original question. Iterative retrieval systems already produce such decompositions and discard them before verifying.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了检索增强生成（RAG）中逐块（per-chunk）验证方法在多跳问答任务上失效，因为多跳问题没有任何单一检索块足以作为答案前提。作者提出应基于分解后的子问题而非原始查询进行验证，实验表明该方法显著提升验证性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的RAG验证方法逐个评分检索到的块并丢弃不合格的块，但这种方法假设每个块都是答案的充分前提。多跳问题恰恰构建为没有任何单一块足以支撑答案，因此逐块评分从根本上无法适用于多跳问答场景。作者通过系统实验揭示这一缺陷，并探索何种验证方式才真正有效。
AI.method: 作者在HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA和MuSiQue三个多跳数据集上对比逐块验证与基于子问题分解的验证方法。通过七个控制变量（模型能力、前提长度、假设模板、决策阈值、检索器、答案匹配标准和提示词）排除替代解释，并使用MuSiQue的黄金分解以及Qwen2.5-7B分解器进行端到端验证。
AI.result: 逐块蕴含评分在多跳数据集上仅达到0.523-0.643的AUC（相比之下单跳SQuAD为0.951）。端到端实验中，逐块门控在所有数据集、生成器规模和提示词组合下都显著差于完全不过滤，且惩罚随生成器能力增强而增大。基于子问题分解的验证将后期跳的蕴含分数从0.546提高到0.840（提升+0.355）。使用离线Qwen2.5-7B分解器可达到0.637，捕获了31%的上限提升。
AI.conclusion: 多跳RAG验证的关键修复方法是条件化验证于分解后的子问题而非原始查询。迭代检索系统在验证之前已经产生这些分解结果但将其丢弃，这提示了改进现有系统的简单路径——保留并利用这些分解信息。

title: ORCA: ORgan-Centroid Aggregation for Training-Free 3D CT Visual Token Compression
summary: A 3D CT scan entering a vision-language model produces a long sequence of visual tokens, often thousands to tens of thousands per volume, and this sequence must be compressed before a language model can consume it. Token compression is well studied in general vision, but little of it targets 3D CT specifically. A common baseline is grid average, which pools regular grid cells and can blend distinct anatomy, lesion, and air into one token. We present \textbf{ORCA} (ORgan-Centroid Aggregation), a token compressor for 3D CT. It merges adjacent tokens with organ guidance and adds a sinusoidal encoding of each region's centroid to preserve spatial layout. This preserves the anatomical information a downstream model needs. ORCA is training-free and plug-and-play, producing an adjustable token set without any model change or text query. We evaluate it across two datasets (CT-RATE and Merlin) and five encoders. The evaluation spans two task types: attribute prediction over five families (size, density, location, texture, and disease) and text generation (visual question answering and report generation). At matched token budgets, ORCA improves consistently over existing compression methods. It shrinks the visual context $64\times$ and its KV-cache $50\times$, and is $31\times$ faster to process each volume. Code released at https://github.com/renjie-liang/ORCA-3DCT.

AI.tldr: ORCA是一种针对3D CT扫描的免训练、即插即用的视觉令牌压缩方法，通过器官质心聚合（ORgan-Centroid Aggregation）将相邻令牌按器官引导合并，并引入正弦质心编码保留空间布局，在CT-RATE和Merlin两个数据集上对五种编码器实现优于现有压缩方法的效果，使视觉上下文压缩64倍、KV缓存压缩50倍、处理速度提升31倍。
AI.motivation: 3D CT扫描输入视觉-语言模型时会产生数千至数万个视觉令牌的长序列，必须在语言模型处理前进行压缩。然而现有的令牌压缩方法大多针对通用视觉场景，很少专门针对3D CT。常见的基线方法（如网格平均池化）会混合解剖结构、病灶和空气，导致信息丢失。
AI.method: 提出ORCA（ORgan-Centroid Aggregation），该方法在有器官引导下合并相邻令牌，并为每个区域的质心添加正弦编码以保留空间布局。ORCA无需训练、即插即用，可产生可调的令牌集合，无需修改模型或文本查询。
AI.result: 在两种数据集（CT-RATE和Merlin）和五种编码器上进行评估，覆盖属性预测（大小、密度、位置、纹理、疾病）和文本生成（视觉问答和报告生成）两类任务。在匹配的令牌预算下，ORCA持续优于现有压缩方法，实现视觉上下文压缩64倍、KV缓存压缩50倍，每个体积处理速度快31倍。
AI.conclusion: ORCA通过在压缩过程中保留器官解剖信息和空间布局，有效解决了3D CT大量视觉令牌带来的计算瓶颈，在显著提升压缩率和推理速度的同时保持了甚至提高了下游任务的性能，为3D医学CT的视觉-语言模型应用提供了一种高效、通用的压缩方案。

title: TrAC: Trace-Conditioned Answer Consistency for Efficient Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent reasoning traces that nevertheless lead to incorrect answers, making response-level uncertainty estimation important for abstention, human review, and adaptive compute allocation. Existing approaches generally fall into three categories: passive single-trace methods use token-level confidence signals, sampling-based methods compare multiple complete traces at higher generation cost, and active prefix-based methods probe partial traces to study answer stabilization or preference transitions. However, none actively re-elicits an answer from a completed reasoning trace to measure its consistency with and support for the original answer. To address this gap, we introduce Trace-Conditioned Answer Consistency (TrAC), a correctness-supervised uncertainty quantification framework that combines active and passive signals anchored to one completed reasoning trace. Its active component, Prefix-Conditioned Elicitation (PCE), re-elicits a short answer conditioned on the completed trace and represents both its consistency with the original answer and its token-level probabilistic support. Its passive component, Trace Uncertainty Profile (TUP), summarizes how token-level uncertainty evolves throughout the original generation without additional decoding. A lightweight head then integrates the two representations into a response-correctness score. Across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks and three LLM families, TrAC improves macro AUROC by 1.8% and reduces AURC by 3.4% relative to eight-sample self-consistency, while using one complete reasoning trace and a short cached answer probe. When eight samples are already available, augmenting sample consensus with re-elicitation further improves macro AUROC by 4.3% and reduces AURC by 8.3%, without additional full-trace generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TrAC（Trace-Conditioned Answer Consistency），一种结合主动与被动信号的大语言模型响应级不确定性量化框架，通过前缀条件化再elicitation和整条推理轨迹的不确定性画像来评估答案正确性，在五个数学推理基准和三个LLM家族上，相比八样本自一致性方法在AUROC上提升1.8%，AURC降低3.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM不确定性估计方法分为三类：被动单轨迹方法（基于token级置信度）、采样方法（比较多条完整轨迹但成本高）、主动前缀方法（探测部分轨迹），但没有任何方法通过主动重新elicitation一个已完成推理轨迹的答案来衡量其与原答案的一致性和支持度，缺乏结合主动与被动信号、基于单一完整推理轨迹进行不确定性量化的框架。
AI.method: TrAC框架包含三个组件：（1）主动组件PCE（Prefix-Conditioned Elicitation）——基于已完成的推理轨迹重新elicitation简短答案，表征其与原答案的一致性及token级概率支持；（2）被动组件TUP（Trace Uncertainty Profile）——无需额外解码，总结原始生成过程中token级不确定性的演变；（3）轻量级头——整合两种表示输出响应正确性分数。
AI.result: 在五个数学推理基准和三个LLM家族上，TrAC使用一条完整推理轨迹和一个简短缓存答案探针，将宏AUROC提升1.8%、AURC降低3.4%（相对八样本自一致性）；当已有八个样本时，通过再elicitation增强样本共识可进一步将宏AUROC提升4.3%、AURC降低8.3%，且无需额外的完整轨迹生成。
AI.conclusion: TrAC证明了结合主动再elicitation与被动token级不确定性信号能够以更低的生成成本实现优于多采样自一致性的不确定性估计性能，填补了现有方法在主动重新elicitation已完成推理轨迹答案方面的空白。

title: A Heuristic Perspective on Debiasing Language Models
summary: Language models (LMs) often acquire various biases during pre-training and may express them in interactions, potentially causing social harm. Existing methods often rely on counterfactual augmentation or representation projection. These strategies remain limited in practice due to their high computational costs and difficulty in scaling to larger models. Additionally, many of these strategies require manual data annotation, narrowing their scope to specific cultures and bias categories. To overcome these limitations, we propose HEIMAT, a HEurIstic-style autoMATic debiasing framework for LMs. HEIMAT consists of two main steps: bias disclosure and debiasing fine-tuning. In the first step, it uses simple templates to construct heuristic prompts, which are applied to reveal model biases and generate corresponding context prompts. In the second step, it fine-tunes the model by minimizing the Jensen-Shannon divergence of predictions on these context prompts to reduce bias. Extensive experiments show that HEIMAT effectively mitigates bias in different cultures while maintaining the model's natural language understanding (NLU) performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HEIMAT，一个启发式自动去偏框架，通过模板构造提示词揭示模型偏见，并通过最小化Jensen-Shannon散度进行微调来减少偏见，无需手动数据标注且可扩展至大规模模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的语言模型去偏方法依赖反事实增强或表示投影，存在计算成本高、难以扩展到更大模型、且需要手动数据标注导致适用范围有限的缺陷。
AI.method: HEIMAT包含两个步骤：第一步使用简单模板构造启发式提示词来揭示模型偏见并生成相应的上下文提示；第二步通过最小化这些上下文提示预测之间的Jensen-Shannon散度进行去偏微调。
AI.result: 大量实验表明HEIMAT能有效减轻不同文化背景下的模型偏见，同时保持模型的自然语言理解性能。
AI.conclusion: HEIMAT提供了一种无需人工标注、计算高效且可扩展的去偏方案，克服了现有方法在成本和规模上的局限。

title: Diagnose Before You Compress: Prediction-Independent Bottleneck Witness Refinement for LLM Serving Traces
summary: Production LLM serving generates millions of diverse requests, making full-trace replay across serving configurations increasingly expensive. Existing trace reduction methods mainly preserve workload distributions or representative requests, but bottleneck-revealing workloads may be rare and non-representative. Moreover, evidence for one component cannot compensate for missing evidence in another, while using predicted bottlenecks as target truth creates circular evaluation. These limitations make it necessary to preserve evidence for every bottleneck component rather than rely on workload representativeness alone. We propose Bottleneck-Preserving Witnessing (BPW), a quality-constrained framework for compact and diagnostically reliable LLM serving replay suites. BPW first performs Workload Candidate Nomination using response-blind workload features and closed source-side measurements. This stage identifies workloads that may expose scheduler, prefill, decode, or KV-cache bottlenecks. Coverage-Priority Sequence Construction then organizes multi-component proposals as reusable hyperedges and prioritizes weak and uncovered dimensions. Finally, Bottleneck Truth Verification derives prediction-independent labels solely from direct target-system measurements. The verified results determine the earliest prefix satisfying the direct two-witness requirement for every component. Experiments on BurstGPT, ServeGen, and Mooncake show that BPW reaches the verified gate with a compact workload set and outperforms 16 policies, achieving relative improvements of 2.3% and 16.3% in Mean prefix Macro-F1 and WBRC-AUC, respectively. Stage-resolved and sensitivity analyses confirm the distinct contributions and local stability of its three stages. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/llmllmllm/BPW

AI.tldr: 提出Bottleneck-Preserving Witnessing (BPW)，一种面向LLM服务回放套件的质量约束框架，确保每个瓶颈组件都有直接证据，而非仅依赖工作负载代表性。
AI.motivation: 现有trace缩减方法主要保留工作负载分布或代表性请求，但暴露瓶颈的工作负载可能稀有且不具代表性；且一个组件的证据无法弥补另一组件的缺失，使用预测瓶颈作为真值会造成循环评估。因此需要为每个瓶颈组件保留证据，而非依赖工作负载代表性。
AI.method: BPW包含三个阶段：1) Workload Candidate Nomination：使用响应盲的工作负载特征和封闭源端测量识别可能暴露调度器、预填充、解码或KV缓存瓶颈的工作负载；2) Coverage-Priority Sequence Construction：将多组件提案组织为可复用超边，优先覆盖薄弱和未覆盖维度；3) Bottleneck Truth Verification：从直接目标系统测量中推导预测无关的标签，确定满足每个组件直接双证人要求的最早前缀。
AI.result: 在BurstGPT、ServeGen和Mooncake上的实验表明，BPW以紧凑的工作负载集达到验证门槛，优于16种策略，在Mean prefix Macro-F1和WBRC-AUC上分别实现2.3%和16.3%的相对提升。阶段消融和敏感性分析确认了三个阶段各自的贡献和局部稳定性。
AI.conclusion: BPW通过瓶颈保留见证的视角，解决了LLM服务回放中诊断证据缺失的问题，实现了紧凑且诊断可靠的测试套件，代码已开源。

title: Artificial Intelligence for the Characterization of Particles and Fibers by Optical Microscopy
summary: Optical microscopy of particle and fiber dispersions involves interpreting subtle visual cues influenced by specimen morphology, chemical composition, magnification, and illumination conditions. We introduce an artificial intelligence (AI) distillation framework that extracts semantically rich image embeddings from microscopy images using semantic anchors. A multimodal teacher combines each image's visual embedding with three text embeddings representing illumination modality, magnification, and specimen identity and morphology. Generated by LongCLIP's extended-context text encoder, this yields a 2304-dimensional block-structured teacher vector whose component blocks remain physically interpretable throughout training and inference. A student vision transformer (ViT) with a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) decoder is trained to reconstruct this teacher vector from the image alone, minimizing a mean absolute error (L1) loss that enforces coordinate-level fidelity to the teacher's block structure. A cross-entropy term over pseudo-classes derived from HDBSCAN clustering of the teacher embedding space acts as a collapse-prevention regularizer, enforcing inter-cluster separation without requiring contrastive negative mining. At inference, the student operates on image input alone, producing compact embeddings that recover the full semantic content of the teacher vector. The framework achieves approximately 80% pseudo-class validation accuracy and 75% Recall@1 on fine-grained specimen description labels under leave-one-out nearest-neighbor retrieval. These results demonstrate that semantic anchoring enables a vision-only student to acquire richer and more interpretable representations than image-only training, with direct applicability to retrieval, classification, and exploratory analysis of heterogeneous particle and fiber dispersions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种AI蒸馏框架，通过语义锚定将显微镜图像的多模态信息（光照、放大倍数、样本身份与形态）蒸馏到仅依赖图像的视觉Transformer学生模型中，生成紧凑且可解释的嵌入表示，在细粒度样本描述检索任务上达到75%的Recall@1。
AI.motivation: 光学显微镜下颗粒和纤维分散体的分析依赖于细微的视觉线索，这些线索受样本形态、化学成分、放大倍数和光照条件等多因素影响，现有图像-only训练方法难以获得足够丰富和可解释的表示。
AI.method: 采用多模态教师模型，将图像视觉嵌入与LongCLIP生成的三个文本嵌入（光照模态、放大倍数、样本身份与形态）结合，形成2304维分块结构的教师向量。学生ViT配合MLP解码器仅从图像重建该教师向量，使用L1损失保证坐标级保真度，同时引入基于HDBSCAN聚类的伪类交叉熵正则化防止表示崩塌。
AI.result: 框架在伪类验证上达到约80%准确率，在留一法最近邻检索细粒度样本描述标签上达到75%的Recall@1，证明语义锚定使视觉-only学生能够获得比纯图像训练更丰富和可解释的表示。
AI.conclusion: 语义锚定蒸馏框架能够在不依赖对比负样本挖掘的情况下，使仅图像输入的学生模型恢复教师的多模态语义内容，对异质颗粒和纤维分散体的检索、分类和探索性分析具有直接应用价值。

title: Select-And-Extract: A Lightweight Plugin for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for language model (LM) systems fundamentally has two failure modes: retrieval failure and reading failure. The former fails to recall the right pieces of information from the external corpus, and the latter fails to produce the correct answer although the right information is retrieved. Some methods perform structured indexing for retrieval failure, but may suffer from limited generalization of the fixed structures. Some methods perform query-time structuring for reading failure, but typically require a lot of LM calls and rely heavily on the LM's capability. To this end, we propose Select-ANd-Extract (SANE), a simple yet effective plugin for RAG. For the retrieval failure, we retrieve a wide set of candidates with a semantic retriever, and leverage the LM to select the top candidates based on their synopses, which yields better recall than the original retriever. For the reading failure, we perform blueprint-guided query-time evidence extraction, which allows the generator LM to use only compact and structured key information so that it can perform better reasoning. Empirical results confirm that SANE brings solid improvements, while only introducing modest extra overhead. As a lightweight plugin for RAG, SANE offers a simple alternative to heavier approaches, and suggests a high-performance RAG framework need not be overly complex.

AI.tldr: 提出SANE，一个轻量级RAG插件，通过语义检索加LM选候选解决检索失败，通过蓝图引导的查询时证据提取解决阅读失败，在仅引入适度额外开销的情况下带来稳定改进。
AI.motivation: RAG系统存在两类核心失败模式：检索失败（无法召回正确信息）和阅读失败（虽检索到正确信息但无法生成正确答案）。现有方法要么使用固定结构索引但泛化能力有限，要么进行查询时结构化但依赖大量LM调用和过强的LM能力。
AI.method: SANE包含两个组件：1）针对检索失败，使用语义检索器获取广泛的候选集，然后利用LM基于摘要选择最相关的候选，从而提升召回率；2）针对阅读失败，采用蓝图引导的查询时证据提取，让生成LM只使用紧凑且结构化的关键信息进行推理，从而提高推理能力。
AI.result: 实证结果表明SANE带来了稳定的性能提升，同时仅引入适度的额外计算开销，作为一个轻量级插件，为更重的方法提供了简单有效的替代方案。
AI.conclusion: SANE证明了高性能的RAG框架不需要过于复杂，通过针对两类失败模式进行简单而有效的插件化设计，就能在轻量化的前提下取得良好效果。

title: F-WANDA: Fisher-Reweighted Post-Training Pruning for Sustainable Deployment of Large Language Models
summary: One-shot post-training pruning is the most energy-frugal compression strategy for largelanguage models (LLMs), yet existing approaches trade either quality (WANDA) or compute cost (SPARSEGPT). We introduce F-WANDA, a drop-in modification of WANDA that reallocates the per-row keep budget across output neurons in proportion to the empirical Fisher information of the pre-activation. The Fisher signal is collected in a single additional backward pass over the same calibration corpus WANDA already uses; no weights are updated. On LLAMA-2-7B at 50 % unstructured sparsity, F-WANDA attains WikiText-2 perplexity of 6.85, matches WANDA fluency, and improves 5-shot MMLU by +1.6 pp over WANDA and +1.1 pp over SPARSEGPT, while incurring only one-third of SPARSEGPT pruning wall-clock and energy. The headline trade-off is achieved without extra calibration data or fine-tuning, placing F-WANDA on the Pareto frontier of quality versus pruning cost for sustainable LLM compression.

AI.tldr: F-WANDA是一种对WANDA的即插即用改进方法，通过在单次额外反向传播中收集预激活的Fisher信息，将剪枝保留预算在输出神经元间重新分配，在保持WANDA计算效率的同时显著提升模型质量，位于质量与剪枝成本的帕累托前沿。
AI.motivation: 现有一次性剪枝方法存在质量与计算成本之间的权衡：WANDA效率高但质量有限，SPARSEGPT质量好但计算开销大。作者希望在不增加额外数据或微调的前提下，同时获得高质量和低成本。
AI.method: F-WANDA作为WANDA的直接修改版，将每行的保留预算按预激活的经验Fisher信息比例在输出神经元之间重新分配。Fisher信号通过在WANDA已使用的同一校准语料库上执行一次额外的反向传播收集，不更新任何权重。
AI.result: 在LLAMA-2-7B上50%非结构化稀疏度下，F-WANDA达到WikiText-2困惑度6.85，保持WANDA的流畅度，5-shot MMLU比WANDA提高1.6个百分点、比SPARSEGPT提高1.1个百分点，而剪枝墙钟时间和能耗仅为SPARSEGPT的三分之一。
AI.conclusion: F-WANDA无需额外校准数据或微调即可实现质量与成本的最佳权衡，为可持续的大语言模型压缩提供了新的帕累托最优方案。

title: OpenART: Scaling Agent Red Teaming via Open-Ended Environment Evolution
summary: AI agents operate in persistent environments where early state changes can influence decisions far into the future. Unlike conventional language-model interactions, agent behavior is mediated through a shared state that is repeatedly modified and reused across long-horizon workflows. Current safety benchmarks often fail to capture these cumulative risks because they focus on short, static tasks. To address these limitations, we introduce OpenART, an open-ended arena for scalable agent red teaming through environment evolution. OpenART provides over 10,000 validated stateful scenarios across 50 domains, drawing from a pool of more than 500,000 tools and skills. These tasks require a median of 97 tool calls and enable unified evaluation across 75 different agent-model configurations. To systematically explore these evolving attack surfaces, we propose the Evolutionary Markov Hypergraph Attack (EMHA). EMHA is a black-box policy that performs feedback-driven environment evolution by coordinating authorized state transitions without requiring parameter updates. Throughout the evaluation, task objectives remain fixed while only the environment state changes. Across all configurations, EMHA achieves a pooled Attack Success Rate (ASR) of 85.0%. Its advantage over instruction-only evolution increases from approximately 2% on simple environments to over 17% on the most complex ones, demonstrating that environment evolution increasingly exposes safety failures as task complexity grows. Furthermore, our analysis shows that the specific runtime implementation of an agent explains a significant portion of safety variation beyond the underlying model's capabilities. These results establish OpenART as a scalable foundation for studying agent safety in complex, evolving environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OpenART，一个基于环境演化的开放式智能体红队测试平台，包含超过10,000个有验证的状态化场景（横跨50个领域、50万+工具/技能），并设计了EMHA黑盒攻击策略，通过协调授权的状态转换在无需参数更新的情况下实现环境演化，在75种智能体模型配置上达到85.0%的池化攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有安全基准聚焦于短时、静态任务，无法捕捉AI智能体在持久化环境中因早期状态变化而累积的长期风险，亟需能评估复杂演化环境中智能体安全性的可扩展基准。
AI.method: 提出EMHA（进化马尔可夫超图攻击）黑盒策略，通过反馈驱动的环境演化进行红队测试，协调授权的状态转换而不需要参数更新；任务目标保持不变，仅环境状态发生改变。同时构建OpenART平台，提供超过10,000个验证过的有状态场景，覆盖50个领域和50万+工具/技能。
AI.result: EMHA在所有配置中达到85.0%的池化攻击成功率（ASR）；在简单环境下，其优势仅比仅指令演化高约2%，而在最复杂的环境下优势超过17%；分析还表明智能体的运行时实现比底层模型能力更能解释安全性的变异。
AI.conclusion: 环境演化随任务复杂度增加而愈发暴露安全失败，OpenART可作为研究复杂演化环境中智能体安全的可扩展基础平台。

title: Boosting Generalizable Depth Estimation in Endoscopy by Mixture of Lightweight Experts and Intrinsic Image Alignment
comment: Accepted by MICCAI 2026 @ The Efficient Medical AI (EMA4MICCAI) Workshop (Oral Presentation)
summary: Depth estimation is a significant task for 3D perception in endoscopic surgeries. However, illumination interference and feature diversity in various endoscopic scenes are still challenges for generalizable depth estimation and ego-motion estimation. Based on this, a novel self-supervised framework, EndoMINI, is proposed for depth estimation in endoscopic scenes. Specifically, mixture of low-rank experts (MiLoRE) is proposed to perform parameter-efficient fine-tuning, which can also boost the model adaptation to scenes with different characteristics. Meanwhile, an intrinsic image alignment (IIA) is introduced into the training loss to alleviate the influence of light reflectance in endoscopy with a novel intrinsic image decomposition network. The proposed method is evaluated on SCARED datasets for supervised depth estimation, and two endoscopic datasets, Hamlyn and SERV-CT, for zero-shot depth estimation, compared with state-of-the-art works as well. The experimental results demonstrate outstanding performance of the proposed model and the effects of the main contributions.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为EndoMINI的自监督框架，用于内窥镜场景下的深度估计和自运动估计。该框架引入混合低秩专家（MiLoRE）进行参数高效微调以增强对不同场景的适应性，并提出内在图像对齐（IIA）损失结合内在图像分解网络来缓解内窥镜光照反射的影响。在SCARED、Hamlyn和SERV-CT数据集上的实验验证了方法的优越性。
AI.motivation: 内窥镜手术中的3D感知需要深度估计，但光照干扰和不同内窥镜场景下的特征多样性，对泛化性深度估计和自运动估计提出了挑战。
AI.method: 提出EndoMINI自监督框架，包含两个关键组件：(1) 混合低秩专家（MiLoRE）实现参数高效微调，增强模型对异质场景的适应能力；(2) 内在图像对齐（IIA）引入训练损失中，配合内在图像分解网络，减轻内窥镜中光反射的影响。
AI.result: 在SCARED数据集上进行监督深度估计评估，在Hamlyn和SERV-CT数据集上进行零样本深度估计评估，均与最先进方法对比，实验结果展示了显著的性能优势。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明所提出的EndoMINI框架在各类内窥镜数据集上的深度估计性能表现优异，验证了MiLoRE和IIA两个核心贡献的有效性。

title: The Bayesian Reflex: A Predictive Coding Engine for Artificial Intelligence
comment: From the Bayesian Brain to Artificial Intelligence
summary: Predictive coding offers a powerful theory of cortical computation, but corresponding scalable algorithmic implementations for artificial intelligence have remained elusive. This paper introduces the Bayesian reflex, a computational framework that directly instantiates predictive coding through three pillars: belief maintenance via hierarchical generative models, sequential Bayesian updating via prediction-error minimization, and uncertainty-driven action via active inference. We show that recent breakthroughs---ellipsoidal decomposition for exact $i.i.d.$ sampling, recursive Gaussian processes for deep hierarchical inference, and derivative-aware Bayesian optimization---provide the missing algorithmic ingredients. The resulting framework enables mathematically principled, scalable, and brain-inspired continual learning, perception, and decision-making. We illustrate its versatility through applications ranging from climate model evaluation to prime number discovery, offering a blueprint for truly adaptive artificial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"贝叶斯反射"（Bayesian reflex）计算框架，通过信念维护、序贯贝叶斯更新和不确定性驱动的行动三大支柱直接实例化预测编码理论，并利用椭球分解、递归高斯过程和导数感知贝叶斯优化等近期突破实现可扩展的类脑持续学习、感知与决策。
AI.motivation: 预测编码是皮层计算的强大理论，但一直缺乏可扩展的算法实现来服务于人工智能。本文旨在弥合神经科学与实际AI算法之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 框架包含三大支柱：(1) 基于层次生成模型的信念维护；(2) 通过预测误差最小化实现序贯贝叶斯更新；(3) 通过主动推理实现不确定性驱动的行动。关键算法组件包括椭球分解（用于精确i.i.d.采样）、递归高斯过程（用于深层层次推断）和导数感知贝叶斯优化。
AI.result: 该框架在多个应用场景中展示了广泛的适用性，包括气候模型评估和素数发现等任务，验证了其作为通用自适应AI蓝图的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，结合现代贝叶斯方法论，预测编码可以转化为数学上严谨、可扩展且具有大脑启发性的AI框架，为真正自适应的通用人工智能提供了蓝图。

title: AttnLink: Turning Attention into Schema Links for Text-to-SQL
summary: Schema linking is a critical component of Text-to-SQL systems, but existing approaches often trade off contextual modeling capacity, score-based controllability, and inference efficiency. We introduce AttnLink, an attention-based framework that converts LLMs' internal attention into continuous relevance scores for schema items. AttnLink extracts the attention from the generation-start position to candidate schema spans, enabling all candidates to be ranked in a single prefill pass without autoregressive decoding. We develop two variants: AttnLink-U, which directly probes pretrained attention without parameter updates, and AttnLink-S, which aligns the attention distribution with gold schema items through direct supervision. To improve coverage of multiple relevant schema items, AttnLink-S combines a set-mass objective with an adaptive probability-floor regularizer. The resulting scores support post-hoc precision-recall control through temperature scaling and cumulative-mass selection. Experiments on Spider, BIRD, and Spider2-SQLite show that AttnLink-S achieves mAP scores of 99.22%, 95.95%, and 83.29%, respectively, with millisecond-scale schema-linking latency. It also yields the best or tied-best execution accuracy for downstream SQL generation in seven of nine generator-dataset settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AttnLink，一种基于注意力机制的Text-to-SQL模式链接框架，通过提取LLM内部注意力生成连续相关性评分，实现单次预填充即可完成所有候选模式的排序，无需自回归解码。实验表明其在Spider、BIRD和Spider2-SQLite上取得领先的mAP性能和毫秒级推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL系统中的模式链接方法在上下文建模能力、基于评分的可控性和推理效率之间存在权衡，难以同时兼顾三者。作者希望通过利用LLM内部的注意力机制，打破这种权衡。
AI.method: AttnLink包含两个变体：AttnLink-U直接利用预训练注意力无需参数更新，AttnLink-S通过直接监督将对齐到黄金模式项。AttnLink-S结合集合质量目标与自适应概率下限正则化以提升多模式项覆盖率，并通过温度缩放和累积质量选择支持事后精确率-召回率控制。所有候选在一个prefill pass中完成排名。
AI.result: 在Spider、BIRD和Spider2-SQLite上，AttnLink-S的mAP分别达到99.22%、95.95%和83.29%，推理延迟为毫秒级。在九个生成器-数据集设置中，有七个取得最佳或并列最佳的SQL生成执行准确率。
AI.conclusion: AttnLink通过将LLM内部注意力转化为可解释、可控的模式相关性评分，在性能、可控性和效率三个维度上同时取得优势，为Text-to-SQL的模式链接提供了高效且有效的解决方案。

title: Poplar: A Scalable Pipeline for Human-Centric Image Dataset Synthesis
summary: Recent image generators can synthesize convincing human-centric images, yet producing a useful collection remains different from producing a single successful image. A human-centric dataset must cover varied people and contexts, avoid implausible attribute combinations, preserve an everyday photographic character, and expose quality-control decisions at scale. We present Poplar, a reproducible Specify--Render--Inspect pipeline for human-centric image dataset synthesis. Specify samples structured attributes under commonsense constraints and verbalizes them as photography-oriented prompts. Render uses a realism-adapted image generator across composition-aware aspect ratios and retries obvious technical failures. Inspect applies a single structured vision--language review to each candidate, preserving the original prompt while rejecting intrinsic image defects or material prompt mismatches. Using Poplar, we construct Poplar-9K: 9,401 curated human-centric image--text pairs retained from 11,765 reviewed candidates (79.9\% acceptance). We release the dataset together with the pipeline, configurations, immutable generation prompts, and auditable inspection records as a compact resource for building customizable human-centric collections.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Poplar，一个可复现的"指定-渲染-审查"（Specify-Render-Inspect）流水线，用于合成以人为中心的图像数据集。通过该方法构建了Poplar-9K数据集，包含9,401对精选的人像图像-文本对，并连同流水线、配置和可审计的审查记录一并发布。
AI.motivation: 现有的图像生成器可以合成逼真的人像图像，但生成"有用的数据集"与生成"单张成功图像"是不同的挑战。以人为中心的数据集需要覆盖多样的人物与场景、避免不合常理的属性组合、保持日常摄影风格，并且在大规模生成时暴露质量控制决策，因此需要专门的数据集合成方案。
AI.method: Poplar采用三阶段流水线：1）Specify阶段在常识约束下采样结构化属性并将其转化为摄影导向的提示词；2）Render阶段使用适应真实感的图像生成器，结合构图感知的宽高比并进行技术失败的自动重试；3）Inspect阶段使用统一的结构化视觉-语言审查，在保留原始提示词的同时拒绝存在内在图像缺陷或提示词不匹配的候选样本。
AI.result: 利用Poplar流水线构建了Poplar-9K数据集，从11,765个候选样本中保留9,401个经过精选的人像图像-文本对，接受率为79.9%。
AI.conclusion: Poplar提供了一种可复现、可审计的人像中心数据集合成方案，数据集连同流水线、配置、不可变生成提示词和审查记录一起发布，作为构建可定制人像数据集的小型资源。

title: TaPR: Test-Aware Policy Refinement for Feedback-Conditioned Code Generation
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Aofan Liu and Jingxiang Meng contributed equally; Fangxin Liu and Yongbiao Chen are corresponding authors
summary: Multi-turn code agents rely on execution feedback to repair incorrect programs, yet standard reinforcement learning paradigms optimize and evaluate policy performance primarily using single-shot outcome rewards. This misalignment conflates initial code generation with feedback-driven refinement, discards granular execution signals across intermediate turns, and fails to evaluate whether the policy actually acquires self-repair capabilities. We propose Test-aware Policy Refinement (TaPR), a framework that transforms execution feedback into a dense per-turn test-pass-ratio reward under a consistent multi-turn interaction protocol. Across six models on 219 code-generation problems from LiveCodeBench, TaPR improves the pooled three-turn success rate (Pass@3) by 2.44 percentage points. In the predefined 7B/8B high-headroom slice, pooled accuracy increases from 30.25% to 33.56% (+3.31 pp), with 42 improvements and 13 regressions in paired trials. On a matched Qwen3-8B ablation, the dense reward supplies nonzero feedback in all of the first ten steps and reaches a higher Hard-subset peak than outcome-only GRPO within the tested budget, although GRPO nearly matches pooled Pass@3 by step 300. Our primary contribution is a reward-decomposition framework and a turn-aware evaluation protocol that decouple first-shot generation quality from multi-turn repair competence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Test-aware Policy Refinement (TaPR)框架，将执行反馈转化为稠密的每轮测试通过率奖励，以解决多轮代码智能体中标准强化学习仅使用单轮结果奖励与反馈驱动修复不匹配的问题，在219个LiveCodeBench问题上将三轮回合成功率提升2.44个百分点。
AI.motivation: 多轮代码智能体依赖执行反馈修复错误程序，但标准强化学习主要用单轮结果奖励评估和优化策略，这种错位混同了初始代码生成与反馈驱动的改进，忽略了中间轮的细粒度执行信号，且无法评估策略是否真正获得自我修复能力。
AI.method: 提出TaPR框架，在一致的多轮交互协议下，将执行反馈转化为稠密的每轮测试通过率（test-pass-ratio）奖励信号，从而为策略提供逐轮的梯度更新信息。
AI.result: 在六个模型、219个LiveCodeBench代码生成问题上，TaPR将三轮回合成功率（Pass@3）提升2.44个百分点；在7B/8B高余量切片中准确率从30.25%提升至33.56%（+3.31pp），配对实验中42个改进、13个退步；消融实验中稠密奖励在前十步均提供非零反馈，且在Hard子集达到比纯结果奖励GRPO更高的峰值。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是奖励分解框架和轮次感知评估协议，将首轮生成质量与多轮修复能力解耦，为多轮代码智能体的策略优化提供了更合理的奖励设计范式。

title: Exploiting Intrinsic Duality for Multi-Hop Question Generation
summary: Multi hop question generation (MQG) aims to generate questions from multiple given documents and target answers, whereas question answering (QA) focuses on deriving answers from documents given specific questions. Although MQG and QA are inherently dual tasks, most existing MQG studies largely overlook this intrinsic duality. To address this limitation, we propose QQ, a novel framework that exploits the duality between Question and answer for multi hop Question generation. Specifically, QQ employs a unified architecture functioning simultaneously as both an MQG and a QA model to fully leverage their interdependence. Our framework is driven by two key mechanisms: (i) enforcing bidirectional alignment constraints to ensure strict mutual correspondence between the questions generated by the MQG model and the answers produced by the QA model; and (ii) applying contrastive learning to pull paired question answer representations closer while pushing unpaired ones apart, thereby reinforcing this correspondence. Extensive automatic and human evaluations on the HotpotQA and MuSiQue datasets demonstrate that the QQ framework significantly improves the quality of generated multi hop questions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QQ框架，利用多跳问题生成（MQG）与问答（QA）之间的内在对偶性，通过统一架构联合训练两个任务，并借助双向对齐约束和对比学习增强问题与答案之间的对应关系，在HotpotQA和MuSiQue数据集上显著提升多跳问题生成质量。
AI.motivation: 多跳问题生成（MQG）与问答（QA）本质上是相互对偶的任务，但现有MQG研究大多忽略了这一内在对偶性，未能充分利用两者之间的互补关系来提升问题生成质量。
AI.method: 提出QQ框架，采用统一架构同时充当MQG和QA模型，通过两个关键机制驱动：(i)双向对齐约束，确保MQG模型生成的问题与QA模型产生的答案之间严格互相对应；(ii)对比学习，拉近配对的问题-答案表示、推远未配对表示，从而强化对应关系。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA和MuSiQue数据集上进行的大量自动评估和人工评估表明，QQ框架显著提升了生成的多跳问题的质量。
AI.conclusion: 利用MQG与QA之间的对偶性，通过统一架构和双重机制可以有效提升多跳问题生成的质量，验证了挖掘任务内在对偶性的价值。

title: BayesSeg: A Bayesian Optimization Framework for State Segmentation of Electricity Consumption Time Series
summary: In Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring (NILM), adaptive segmentation of electricity consumption time series is critical for appliance recognition. However, prevailing methods face challenges including heuristic parameter tuning, boundary sensitivity, and metric saturation. This paper proposes BayesSeg, a unified framework integrating time-series segmentation, multidimensional evaluation, and automatic parameter optimization. The segmentation layer employs a dual steady-state criterion based on the tail value and mean of preceding subsequences, combined with a sequential extraction and complement-set parsing strategy, to achieve precise unsupervised partitioning of steady-state and transition-state segments. The evaluation layer maps segmentation results to binary state sequences and formulates a composite metric integrating an event-level F1 score (event_F1) with Normalized Mutual Information (NMI). The event_F1 quantifies switching-event precision and recall via tolerance matching, while NMI captures global structural consistency, jointly overcoming the boundary sensitivity and limited discriminability of point-wise metrics. In the optimization layer, the composite score serves as the objective function for Bayesian optimization, which constructs a TPE surrogate model for efficient global parameter-space exploration. Experiments on the SustDataED2 dataset demonstrate that Bayesian optimization requires only ~100 objective evaluations to locate a parameter region within 0.35% deviation of the exhaustive grid-search optimum. The framework achieves a weighted composite score of 0.7149 and an event_F1 of 0.9340 while reducing optimization latency from ~5300 seconds to under 1 second, a speedup exceeding 5700x. BayesSeg automates segmentation configuration and provides a scalable, efficient solution for time-series analysis in NILM and related domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BayesSeg，一个统一的非侵入式负荷监测（NILM）时间序列自适应分割框架，整合了基于双稳态准则的无监督分割、多维评估（事件级F1 + NMI）和基于TPE的贝叶斯参数自动优化。在SustDataED2数据集上，仅需约100次目标评估即可达到网格搜索最优值0.35%偏差内，加权综合得分0.7149，事件F1达0.9340，优化延迟从约5300秒降至1秒以内（加速超5700倍）。
AI.motivation: 现有NILM中的时间序列分割方法面临三大挑战：启发式参数调优耗时费力、分割边界敏感导致性能不稳定，以及点级评估指标容易饱和缺乏区分度。这些问题的存在使得自适应分割难以在实际应用中高效落地。
AI.method: BayesSeg包含三个层次的框架：1）分割层采用基于前序子序列尾部值和均值的双稳态判别准则，结合顺序提取与补集解析策略，实现稳态段和过渡态段的无监督分割；2）评估层将分割结果映射为二元状态序列，构建融合事件级F1分数（event_F1）和归一化互信息（NMI）的复合指标，利用容差匹配量化开关事件精确率/召回率，同时捕捉全局结构一致性；3）优化层以复合分数为目标函数，使用TPE代理模型的贝叶斯优化在参数空间中高效搜索全局最优。
AI.result: 在SustDataED2数据集上的实验表明：贝叶斯优化仅需约100次目标评估即可定位到与穷举网格搜索最优值偏差0.35%以内的参数区域；框架达到加权综合得分0.7149和事件F1值0.9340；优化延迟从约5300秒降至1秒以内，加速比超过5700倍。
AI.conclusion: BayesSeg通过将分割、评估与参数优化统一到一个框架中，实现了NILM场景下时间序列分割配置的全自动化，提供了可扩展、高效的解决方案，不仅适用于NILM，也可推广到相关时间序列分析领域。

title: Observatorio Lazaro: A self-populating database of anglicism usage in the Spanish press
summary: This paper describes Observatorio Lázaro, a language resource that monitors unassimilated lexical borrowings (predominantly English lexical borrowings or anglicisms) in the Spanish digital press. Since April 2020 the system has automatically processed the daily output of a collection of news outlets, detected borrowings with a neural sequence-labeling model, and made the results available through a public web interface and API. The result is a continuously updated diachronic database which, at the time of writing, records more than two million borrowings across 1.88 million articles and 993 million running tokens of text (2020-2026). The paper documents the resource: we describe the end-to-end pipeline (acquisition, detection, post-processing, storage and access), the data model and the terms of availability; we evaluate the resource through the detector's held-out performance (span-level F1=0.86 for the borrowing class), inter-annotator agreement on the training corpus (Cohen's kappa=0.91) and a manual precision audit of 1,000 spans from the deployed data; and we situate it with respect to Spanish borrowing lexicography, annotated borrowing corpora and neology-monitoring observatories. The data shows that unassimilated anglicisms are used in the Spanish press at a frequency of approximately two anglicisms per thousand tokens, and that this rate remains stable. Our statistical analysis over six years reveals that the anglicism vocabulary in Spanish behaves as an open and growing class, with 58.7% of its types attested only once (53.6% after correcting for detection precision), and that its density is highest in the fashion, technology and lifestyle sections and lowest in political and institutional news. The resource is intended to complement static borrowing dictionaries and one-off annotated corpora by providing a continuously updated record of borrowing in the Spanish press.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Observatorio Lázaro，一个自动监测西班牙数字媒体中外来词（主要是英语借词/英语化词汇）的语言资源系统。自2020年4月以来，该系统通过神经序列标注模型自动处理新闻输出，已在188万篇文章和9.93亿词次的语料中记录了超过200万个借词实例（2020-2026），并通过公共Web界面和API持续更新数据。
AI.motivation: 西班牙语新闻中的英语借词现象日益普遍，但缺乏一个持续更新、大规模监测此类语言现象的数据库。现有的静态借词词典和一次性标注语料无法捕捉借词使用的动态变化，因此需要一个自动化的、持续运行的监测系统来记录西班牙新闻媒体中外来词的使用趋势和分布特征。
AI.method: 系统采用端到端流水线，涵盖数据采集、神经序列标注模型检测、后处理、存储和访问等环节。检测器在保留测试集上对借词类别达到跨度级F1=0.86；训练语料的标注者间一致性达到Cohen's kappa=0.91；还对部署数据中的1000个跨度进行了人工精度审计。系统通过公共Web界面和API提供数据访问。
AI.result: 数据显示未同化的英语借词在西班牙新闻中的使用频率约为每千词两个英语借词，且该比率保持稳定。六年统计分析表明西班牙语中的英语借词词汇是一个开放且不断增长的类别，58.7%的类型仅出现一次（经检测精度校正后为53.6%）。借词密度在时尚、科技和生活方式板块最高，在政治和机构新闻中最低。
AI.conclusion: Observatorio Lázaro作为静态借词词典和一次性标注语料的补充资源，通过持续更新的记录为西班牙新闻中的借词现象提供了动态监测视角，有助于语言学界跟踪借词使用的演变趋势和分布规律。

title: CURE: Local Uncertainty Repair for Block-Parallel Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding mitigates the latency of sequential generation in autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs) by interleaving draft generation with target verification. However, existing parallel drafting backends often suffer from rapid accuracy degradation over long horizons, leading to high rejection rates during verification and suboptimal wall-clock speedups. We observe that drafting errors are not uniformly distributed but typically stem from localized high-uncertainty tokens that destabilize downstream generation trajectories. Motivated by this token error pattern, we propose CURE, a budget-aware dynamic repair tree designed to repair errors at uncertainty focal points without incurring prohibitive tree-verification overheads. Specifically, our method uses predictive confidence margins to dynamically locate candidate error tokens within a block-parallel draft, expands bounded repair paths only at these fragile nodes, and employs a novel repair resynchronization mechanism to realign draft states post-verification. Evaluations on code-generation benchmarks (HumanEval, MBPP, and LiveCodeBench-lite) and mathematical reasoning benchmark (GSM8K) demonstrate that CURE increases the average accepted length by 4.2-7.5% over parallel baselines without repair, translating to an end-to-end speedup of $2.66-3.49\times$ over target-only decoding. Furthermore, we provide a plug-and-play repair module compatible with standard parallel drafting frameworks. We also characterize the trade-off between draft compute and verification efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CURE，一种预算感知的动态修复树方法，通过在并行草稿生成中定位并修复高不确定性token的错误，提升投机解码的接受长度和端到端加速比。在代码生成和数学推理基准上，平均接受长度提升4.2-7.5%，端到端加速比达2.66-3.49倍。
AI.motivation: 现有并行草稿生成后端在长horizon上精度衰减快，导致验证阶段拒绝率高、墙钟加速不理想。作者观察到草稿错误并非均匀分布，而是集中在局部高不确定性token处，这些token会破坏下流生成轨迹，因此需要针对性的错误修复方法。
AI.method: CURE方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 利用预测置信度边际动态定位块并行草稿中的候选错误token；(2) 仅在脆弱节点扩展有界修复路径，避免昂贵的树验证开销；(3) 提出修复重同步机制，在验证后重新对齐草稿状态。同时提供即插即用的修复模块，兼容标准并行草稿框架。
AI.result: 在HumanEval、MBPP、LiveCodeBench-lite和GSM8K基准上，CURE相比无修复的并行基线平均接受长度提升4.2-7.5%，端到端加速比达到2.66-3.49倍（相对仅目标解码）。此外还刻画了草稿计算与验证效率之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: CURE通过精准定位和修复不确定性焦点处的错误，有效改善了并行投机解码的性能，且作为即插即用模块可无缝集成到现有并行草稿框架中，为提升LLM推理效率提供了实用方案。

title: RAGOCR: Optical Compression of Retrieval-Augmented Text via Visual Representation
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become essential for knowledge-intensive question answering, yet scaling RAG pipelines remains challenging due to the prohibitive computational cost of processing lengthy retrieved contexts. Existing compression approaches face a fundamental trade-off: hard compression methods operate online in a query-aware fashion but achieve only modest compression rates and typically require fine-tuning the generative model, while soft compression methods attain higher ratios but rely on costly offline encoding that is entirely agnostic to the input query. To bridge this gap, we introduce RAGOCR, a novel framework that compresses retrieved documents into compact visual representations conditioned on the input query. To further balance compression rate and information fidelity, we introduce a query-aware dynamic resolution mechanism that adaptively allocates visual granularity based on each document's estimated relevance and complexity: highly relevant passages are rendered at higher resolution to preserve fine-grained details, while peripheral documents are aggressively compressed at lower resolution. Experiments on five QA benchmarks using the MedOmniKB retrieval corpus demonstrate that RAGOCR surpasses naive RAG by over 15\% in accuracy while requiring only one-eighth the number of input tokens, and consistently outperforms both hard and soft compression baselines across varying retrieval depths.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAGOCR框架，通过将检索文档压缩为查询条件化的视觉表示，并引入查询感知的动态分辨率机制来平衡压缩率与信息保真度，在五个QA基准上以八分之一的输入token数超越朴素RAG超过15%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG压缩方法存在根本性权衡：硬压缩虽支持在线查询感知但压缩率有限且需微调生成模型；软压缩压缩率高但依赖与查询无关的昂贵离线编码。两者均难以同时兼顾高压缩率与查询感知能力。
AI.method: RAGOCR框架将检索文档压缩为查询条件化的紧凑视觉表示，并设计了查询感知的动态分辨率机制：根据每个文档的估计相关性和复杂度自适应分配视觉分辨率，高相关文档以高分辨率渲染保留细节，边缘文档则以低分辨率激进压缩。
AI.result: 在五个QA基准上使用MedOmniKB检索语料进行实验，RAGOCR比朴素RAG准确率提升超过15%，输入token数仅为其八分之一，并在不同检索深度下均优于硬压缩和软压缩基线。
AI.conclusion: RAGOCR通过视觉化表示和查询感知的动态分辨率，有效弥合了硬压缩与软压缩之间的差距，在显著降低计算成本的同时提升RAG系统在知识密集型问答中的性能。

title: Through the LENS: Local Geometric Decomposition of Vision-Language Model Representations
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) process image patches and text tokens in a shared residual stream, but the local geometry through which the two modalities interact remains poorly understood. Most interpretability methods identify global linear directions, which may miss representations that are globally high-dimensional but locally low-dimensional. We introduce LENS (Local Explanation of Neighborhood Subspaces), a method that decomposes VLM activations into local low-rank Gaussian neighborhoods using a Mixture of Factor Analyzers. Applied to LLaVA-1.5-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B, LENS reveals distinct depth-dependent fusion trajectories consistent with each model's fusion mechanism: LLaVA progressively mixes modalities at later layers, whereas Qwen3-VL mixes them early, partially re-segregates them, and recombines them near the output. An automated multimodal labeling pipeline assigns concise semantic descriptions to these neighborhoods. Interpolating activations toward neighborhood centroids causally redirects generation within and across modalities and outperforms difference-in-means and VL-SAE in most evaluated conditions; in one LLaVA vision-to-vision setting, MFA achieves 5.7 times the VL-SAE score. Human evaluation finds MFA steering competitive with prompting and substantially stronger than the other intervention baselines. Finally, the MFA coefficient space improves Qwen3-VL image-to-rendered-text retrieval at the deepest evaluated layer from 14.9% to 48.6% R@1. Ablations show that the reported fusion trajectories are stable across component counts, local ranks, and modality-purity thresholds. These results support local geometric neighborhoods as useful interpretable and causal units for analyzing cross-modal representations in the evaluated VLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LENS方法，利用混合因子分析器将VLM激活分解为局部低秩高斯邻域，揭示LLaVA和Qwen3-VL中不同的模态融合轨迹，并展示局部几何邻域可作为可解释且因果有效的跨模态表征分析单元。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性方法大多识别全局线性方向，但可能遗漏全局高维而局部低维的表征。视觉-语言模型（VLM）中两种模态在共享残差流中的局部几何交互方式仍未被充分理解。
AI.method: 提出LENS（Local Explanation of Neighborhood Subspaces），使用混合因子分析器（MFA）将VLM激活分解为局部低秩高斯邻域；配合自动多模态标注管道为邻域生成语义描述，并通过向邻域质心插值激活来因果引导生成。应用于LLaVA-1.5-7B和Qwen3-VL-8B两个模型。
AI.result: LENS揭示了两个模型不同的深度依赖融合轨迹：LLaVA在后层渐进混合模态，Qwen3-VL早期混合、部分再分离并在输出端重组。向邻域质心插值在多数条件下优于差均值方法和VL-SAE；在LLaVA视觉到视觉场景中MFA得分是VL-SAE的5.7倍。MFA系数空间将Qwen3-VL图像到渲染文本检索从14.9%提升至48.6% R@1。消融实验表明融合轨迹对组件数、局部秩和模态纯度阈值稳定。
AI.conclusion: 局部几何邻域可以作为分析和干预VLM跨模态表征的有效可解释且因果单元，超越了全局线性方向方法在不同条件下的表现。

title: Distill Where You Fail: Recovering Learning Signals of Negative RL-Groups from Adaptive Teacher Guidance
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard paradigm for post-training large language models (LLMs). While Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely adopted, it suffers from sparse reward signals and loses gradients entirely when all responses within a group receive identical rewards. On-policy distillation (OPD) offers a natural remedy by providing dense, token-level supervision from a teacher model. However, naively combining GRPO with OPD leads to degraded performance, due to three underlying causes: not all samples benefit from distillation; fitting too quickly to the teacher undermines the exploratory capacity of RL; and OPD's advantages are asymmetric, suppressing most tokens. To address these challenges, we propose RSTG (Recovering Learning Signals via Adaptive Teacher Guidance), which applies distillation selectively and precisely where it matters most. At the sample level, OPD is restricted to negative zero-variance prompts with each sample weighted by the teacher's confidence score. At the token level, distillation targets only tokens with high student entropy or large teacher-student divergence. We further augment training with SFT on correct trajectories generated by the teacher model, injecting positive gradient signals where RL yields none. Experiments demonstrate that RSTG substantially outperforms naive GRPO+OPD by +4.02% on math and +3.05% on code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RSTG框架，通过自适应教师引导来恢复强化学习中的学习信号，解决GRPO与on-policy distillation朴素组合时性能下降的问题，在数学和代码任务上分别提升4.02%和3.05%。
AI.motivation: GRPO在LLM后训练中存在稀疏奖励信号问题，当组内所有响应获得相同奖励时梯度完全消失。虽然OPD可以提供密集的token级监督，但简单地将其与GRPO结合会导致性能下降，原因包括：并非所有样本都受益于蒸馏、过快拟合教师模型削弱RL的探索能力、以及OPD的优势具有不对称性会抑制大多数token。
AI.method: RSTG框架采用三级选择性蒸馏策略：1) 样本级别：将OPD限制在负零方差提示上，每个样本根据教师置信度加权；2) token级别：仅对高学生熵或大师生发散度的token进行蒸馏；3) 额外使用教师模型生成的正确轨迹进行SFT增强，在RL无梯度的位置注入正梯度信号。
AI.result: 实验结果表明RSTG在数学任务上比朴素的GRPO+OPD组合提升4.02%，在代码任务上提升3.05%。
AI.conclusion: 选择性、精准地应用蒸馏可以显著改善RLVR范式的训练效果，RSTG有效解决了GRPO与OPD朴素结合的三大弊端，为LLM后训练提供了更优的强化学习框架。

title: Scene2Sound: Auditory-Grounded Soundscape Generation for 3D Gaussian Worlds
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) turns captured or generated imagery into photorealistic 3D world simulations that users can freely explore, yet these worlds remain silent. Because existing audio generation methods condition on a single image or viewpoint, their sound is tied to that observation and cannot stay consistent while a listener moves. We introduce the task of generating a spatially consistent soundscape for a given 3DGS world through auditory grounding, identifying which objects in the world should emit sound and anchoring each to a persistent 3D position, and present Scene2Sound, a training-free framework built on this grounding. From the input world alone, our pipeline selects viewpoints that jointly cover the scene, identifies sound-emitting objects with a vision-language model, and associates the multi-view detections into 3D instances through Gaussian set matching, which measures the overlap between the Gaussian sets that render each detection. Each source then receives generated audio that a standard object-based audio engine spatializes in real time at arbitrary listener poses. We further propose two spatial-consistency metrics, one testing whether rendered audio responds consistently to listener motion and one testing whether the claimed sources are supported by views held out from their placement. On a curated set of generated 3DGS worlds and on 3DGS scenes generated from real-world 360-degree captures, Scene2Sound preserves the audio quality of strong per-viewpoint baselines while remaining spatially consistent where per-viewpoint and single-panorama pipelines do not, and a user study confirms the perceptual benefit. Project page: https://masaki-lmd.github.io/scene2sound/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Scene2Sound框架，实现了3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）虚拟世界的空间一致声景生成。通过听觉接地（audio grounding）识别世界中的发声物体并将其锚定到3D位置，从输入世界中选取覆盖场景的视角，利用视觉语言模型识别发声物体，并通过高斯集匹配将多视角检测关联为3D实例，每个声源由基于对象的音频引擎实时空间化。实验表明，该方法在保持音频质量的同时，实现了比逐视角和单全景方法更强的空间一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有的3DGS技术虽能将图像转化为可自由探索的逼真3D世界，但这些世界是无声的。现有音频生成方法仅基于单张图像或单一视角进行条件生成，导致声音与特定观察绑定，当听众移动时无法保持一致性，缺乏随位置变化的空间连贯音景。
AI.method: Scene2Sound是一个免训练框架，包含三步流水线：(1) 从3DGS世界中选取能联合覆盖场景的视角；(2) 利用视觉语言模型（VLM）识别发声物体；(3) 通过高斯集匹配（测量渲染每个检测的高斯集之间的重叠）将多视角检测关联为持久的3D实例。每个声源生成音频后，由标准基于对象的音频引擎在任意听众姿态下实时空间化。此外还提出了两个空间一致性度量指标。
AI.result: 在生成的3DGS世界和从真实360度拍摄生成的3DGS场景上，Scene2Sound在保持与强逐视角基线相当的音频质量的同时，实现了逐视角和单全景管线无法达到的空间一致性；用户研究也确认了感知层面的优势。
AI.conclusion: 通过听觉接地和3D实例锚定的方式，Scene2Sound验证了无需训练即可为3DGS世界生成空间一致声景的可行性，填补了3D视觉仿真中声音缺失的空白，为沉浸式虚拟体验提供了新的可能。

title: Why Does the Future Branch? Identifiable Closure Tests for Stochastic Physical World Models
summary: Stochastic world models are usually evaluated by the accuracy and calibration of their predicted futures. These criteria leave a decision-relevant ambiguity: the same conditional future distribution can arise because an observation aliases different physical states, or because the dynamics remain random after the declared full state is fixed. We prove that this attribution is not identifiable from ordinary transition data, even with an optimal probabilistic predictor. We introduce ClosurePairs, an interventional evaluation protocol that crosses compatible microstates with repeated exogenous disturbances. A two-way variance decomposition identifies state aliasing, process noise, and their nonlinear interaction; an independent-repeat variant applies when disturbances cannot be reused. On likelihood-equivalent Gaussian systems, paired supervision reduces alias-fraction error 15.96-fold at identical test NLL. Across 18 nonlinear Langevin conditions, it reduces attribution MAE from 0.372 to 0.051 and sensing regret from 0.0138 to 0.0003 without changing NLL. On a pixel-conditioned recurrent model, a frozen shared-state probe reduces alias-fraction MAE against a deep ensemble from 0.584 to 0.130 in distribution and from 0.630 to 0.170 out of distribution over ten seeds. Finally, in a matched-total-variance REFINE/BRANCH test, a total-variance router reaches 66.48 percent plus or minus 1.06 percent accuracy, whereas ClosurePairs reaches 99.99 percent plus or minus 0.02 percent and improves selected NLL from -2.087 to -2.717 over five seeds. ClosurePairs therefore measures why futures branch, information that proper forecast scores cannot identify.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出 ClosurePairs，一种干预性评估协议，用于区分随机世界模型中未来分支的原因：是状态别名（多个物理状态映射到同一观测）还是过程噪声（状态固定后的固有随机性）。
AI.motivation: 传统的随机世界模型评估标准（预测准确性和校准度）存在决策相关的歧义：相同条件未来分布可能源于观测对物理状态的别名化，也可能源于声明状态固定后动力学仍然随机。这种归因无法从普通转换数据中识别，即使使用最优概率预测器也无法解决。
AI.method: ClosurePairs 协议通过对兼容微状态施加重复的外源扰动，进行双向方差分解，从而区分状态别名、过程噪声及二者的非线性交互作用。当扰动无法复用时，采用独立重复变体。
AI.result: 在似然等价的高斯系统上，配对监督将别名分数误差降低15.96倍且测试NLL不变；在18种非线性Langevin条件下，归因MAE从0.372降至0.051，感知遗憾从0.0138降至0.0003；在像素条件循环模型上，别名分数MAE从0.584降至0.130（分布内）和从0.630降至0.170（分布外）；在匹配总方差的REFINE/BRANCH测试中，ClosurePairs达到99.99%±0.02%的准确率，而总方差路由仅达到66.48%±1.06%。
AI.conclusion: ClosurePairs 能够测量未来为何产生分支的信息，这是传统预测评分无法识别的重要信息，弥补了现有评估方法在决策相关歧义方面的不足。

title: OoO-Spec: Out-of-Order Semantic Speculation for Fast Tool Calling
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables; supplementary material included
summary: LLMs generate tool calls token by token, even though the function choice and argument values can often be predicted in parallel from the request and tool schema. ToolSpec reduces this cost by drafting schema tokens and retrieving earlier calls, but cannot propose request-specific values absent from either source. We present OoO-Spec, which computes these missing semantics out of order. At request arrival, a Qwen3-0.6B sidecar predicts the function choice and all schema-defined argument slots in one parallel request-level wave while the target begins ToolSpec decoding. The runtime joins the slot values, renders the resulting call as text, and exposes it to subsequent candidate-construction rounds. The target polls without blocking, re-tokenizes a ready hint with its own tokenizer, and remains the sole verifier and commit authority. The sidecar is trained once with LoRA on Qwen2.5-32B teacher traces and used unchanged across Qwen2.5, Qwen3, and Llama targets, without target-specific drafter training. Across seven fully ranked targets and three benchmarks under greedy batch-one decoding, OoO-Spec is fastest among all evaluated methods in all 21 target-benchmark cells, reaching 2.46x-5.34x over autoregressive decoding with an unweighted mean of 3.89x, versus 2.95x for ToolSpec. It also outperforms every evaluated released learned drafter in each comparable cell. Across Qwen3-4B, 8B, 14B, and 32B targets, the same sidecar improves on ToolSpec by 34.1% on average. Its compact semantic payload averages 85 bytes per request excluding protocol metadata, supporting effective split-GPU overlap.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OoO-Spec，一种用于加速LLM工具调用的投机解码方法。它使用一个小型旁路模型（Qwen3-0.6B）在请求到达时并行预测函数选择和所有参数槽位，同时目标模型正常解码，从而绕过ToolSpec方法无法生成请求特定参数的局限。该方法在21个目标-基准组合中均取得最快速度，加速比为2.46x-5.34x，平均3.89x。
AI.motivation: LLM逐token生成工具调用效率低下，尽管函数选择和参数值通常可以从请求和工具模式中并行预测。现有ToolSpec方法通过草拟模式token和检索历史调用降低成本，但无法为来源中不存在的请求特定值生成语义内容。
AI.method: 在请求到达时，使用Qwen3-0.6B侧车模型通过LoRA在一个Qwen2.5-32B教师模型的轨迹上训练，以并行方式预测函数选择和所有模式定义的参数槽位。运行时将槽值合并，渲染为文本并暴露给后续候选取舍轮次。目标模型轮询非阻塞地获取提示，用自己的分词器重新分词，并始终作为唯一的验证和提交权威。侧车模型训练一次后可直接用于Qwen2.5、Qwen3和Llama目标，无需目标特定的草稿模型训练。
AI.result: 在7个完整排名的目标模型和3个基准的贪心batch-one解码下，OoO-Spec在所有21个目标-基准单元中均为最快方法，达到2.46x-5.34x的加速比（未加权均值3.89x），优于ToolSpec的2.95x。在Qwen3-4B、8B、14B和32B目标上，平均比ToolSpec提升34.1%。语义负载平均仅85字节/请求，支持高效的GPU分割重叠。
AI.conclusion: OoO-Spec通过乱序计算请求特定语义来补充ToolSpec的草稿来源，以轻量级侧车模型实现跨目标模型的通用加速，在不进行目标特定训练的前提下显著提升工具调用解码效率。

title: CrossProjection: Geometric Grounding Beyond Viewpoint Change in Architectural Drawings
comment: Initial controlled diagnostic study on 23 natural drawing sets and three VLMs; broader model, building, repeated-inference, and human coverage is planned for a subsequent version
summary:
