Architectural drawings violate the usual assumption behind multi-view reasoning: plans and sections are cuts, while elevations are facade projections, so corresponding components change appearance in ways camera motion cannot explain. We introduce CrossProjection, an anchor-grounded diagnostic of whether vision-language models preserve component identity and externalize geometry across heterogeneous architectural views. It evaluates Matching, Registration, and Geometric Grounding through categorical judgments, candidate selection, and free point, line, and region localization.
  Across 23 real drawing sets and 1,954 categorical conditions per model, GPT-5.5 scores 82.4%, Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct 62.2%, and GLM-4.5V 57.2%. A matched 200-target study crosses natural and vector-text-suppressed drawings with closed-candidate and free-geometry outputs. Candidate-supported performance is often higher, but free localization remains fragile: on natural drawings, point/region PCK@.05 is 54-76% for GPT, 8-10% for Qwen, and 14-36% for GLM; line endpoint PCK@.05 is 22%, 4%, and 0%. A coordinate grid recovers some GPT point/region precision but not lines. Three architecture-trained participants reach 87.3-93.3% categorical accuracy and 76-92% GT-region hit, supporting task feasibility rather than a population-level human ceiling.
  Because the categorical families do not form a same-item Matching-Registration contrast and interface controls alter multiple burdens, we avoid mechanistic claims. The supported conclusion is narrower: closed-choice or marked-element success does not entail reliable explicit geometric grounding. For drawing-guided CAD/BIM systems, categorical correctness should not be treated as evidence of candidate-free spatial reliability. Reusable on-sheet anchors, fixed-denominator scoring, and hash-locked artifacts establish an audit trail for this gap.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CrossProjection，一个锚定诊断框架，用于评估视觉语言模型在异构建筑图纸（平面图、剖面图、立面图）之间保持组件身份和外在化几何能力。测试显示GPT-5.5得82.4%、Qwen3-VL-32B得62.2%、GLM-4.5V得57.2%；自由几何定位表现脆弱，尤其线条定位极差。作者避免机制性结论，仅支持更窄的结论：分类正确不等于可靠的显式几何定位。
AI.motivation: 建筑制图中的平、剖、立视图是不同类型的投影（切割vs立面投影），违背了多视图推理中相机运动可解释对应关系的常规假设。现有研究中没有系统性诊断工具来检验VLM是否能在此类异构视图间保持组件身份并外化几何信息。
AI.method: 提出CrossProjection诊断框架，通过三类任务（Matching匹配、Registration配准、Geometric Grounding几何定位）进行评估，涵盖分类判断、候选项选择和自由点/线/区域定位。使用23套真实图纸、每个模型1954个分类条件，并设计匹配的200目标研究，对比自然图纸与矢量文本抑制图纸、闭式候选项与自由几何输出，辅以坐标网格和人工参与对照。
AI.result: GPT-5.5达82.4%准确率，Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct为62.2%，GLM-4.5V为57.2%。候选辅助场景表现较好，但自由定位脆弱：自然图纸上点/区域PCK@.05为GPT 54-76%、Qwen 8-10%、GLM 14-36%；线条端点PCK@.05为GPT 22%、Qwen 4%、GLM 0%。三名建筑训练参与者达87.3-93.3%分类准确率和76-92%的GT区域命中率。
AI.conclusion: 闭式选择或标记元素上的成功并不能证明可靠的显式几何定位能力。对CAD/BIM绘图系统而言，分类正确性不应被视为无候选空间可靠性的证据。论文提供了可复用的页上锚点、固定分母评分和哈希锁定工件来建立审计追踪。

title: Escaping Confidence Trap: Evolutionary Decoding for Mathematical Reasoning in Diffusion LLMs
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive LLMs, offering efficient generation through block-wise progressive unmasking. However, their strong general-purpose performance does not necessarily translate into reliable mathematical reasoning, where correctness depends on preserving coherent numerical-symbolic reasoning trajectories. In this work, we analyze the decoding trajectories of LLaDA 2.0 and identify a recurring diffusion confidence trap: local token confidence can become misaligned with global reasoning correctness during progressive block decoding. Our analysis reveals two representative failure regimes: sampling-sensitive failures, where correct paths exist but are unstable, and sampling-consistent failures, where repeated sampling converges to repetitive high-confidence but incorrect continuations. Motivated by this observation, we propose Evolutionary Decoding, a training-free test-time scaling framework that views diffusion decoding as an evolutionary process over candidate reasoning states. The framework combines step-wise selection, which preserves useful numerical-symbolic signals and suppresses repetitive patterns, with block-wise mutation, which introduces structured alternatives to escape incorrect high-confidence basins. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that Evolutionary Decoding improves LLaDA 2.0 over confidence-based decoding, leading to more reliable mathematical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文发现扩散大语言模型（dLLM）在数学推理中存在"扩散置信度陷阱"问题，即局部token置信度与全局推理正确性脱节，并提出了一种无需训练的测试时扩展框架——进化解码（Evolutionary Decoding），通过逐步选择和块级变异来提升数学推理的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 扩散LLM虽然在通用任务上表现出色，但其强大的通用性能并不能直接转化为可靠的数学推理能力。数学推理的正确性依赖于保持连贯的数值-符号推理轨迹，而扩散模型的渐进式块解码过程中存在置信度与正确性错位的问题。
AI.method: 首先对LLaDA 2.0的解码轨迹进行分析，识别出两种代表性失败模式：采样敏感失败（正确路径存在但不稳定）和采样一致失败（重复采样收敛到高置信但错误的重复连续）。基于此提出进化解码框架，将扩散解码视为候选推理状态的进化过程，结合逐步选择（保留有用的数值-符号信号，抑制重复模式）和块级变异（引入结构化替代方案以跳出错误的置信度盆地）。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上，进化解码相比基于置信度的解码方法显著提升了LLaDA 2.0的数学推理可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 进化解码作为一种训练免费的测试时扩展方法，能够有效缓解扩散LLM在数学推理中的置信度陷阱问题，为提升dLLM的推理可靠性提供了新的思路。

title: Exemplars in Disguise: Pure Exemplar Models Mimic Abstraction-First Learning
summary: Whether idiosyncratic, item-specific knowledge is learned before abstract class-level generalizations, or vice versa, is a central question in language learning, with exemplar and abstraction-based theories making opposite predictions. Recent methods have claimed to show that, at least for large language models, abstract knowledge is learned first. We show that these methods fall short: pure memorizer models with no abstract representations can appear, by the same criteria, to learn either item-specific or class-level knowledge first, depending on their sensitivity to individual observations, with the transition point governed by the distributional properties of the input. We further argue that the distinction between item-specific and abstract knowledge may be ill-defined for distributed representations, as a word's class-level properties may not be separable from its item-specific properties.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑了最近声称"大语言模型先学习抽象知识"的研究方法，指出纯记忆模型在相同标准下也可能表现出先学习项目特定或类别层面知识，取决于其对单个观测的敏感度，且过渡点由输入分布特性决定。作者进一步认为，在分布式表示中，项目特定知识与抽象知识的区分本身可能就是不明确的。
AI.motivation: 语言学习中"项目特定知识先学还是抽象类别泛化先学"是核心问题。近期方法声称LLM先学习抽象知识，但本文质疑这些方法存在缺陷，需要验证其结论的可靠性。
AI.method: 通过构建纯记忆模型（不含抽象表示），用相同的评估标准测试其表现，观察模型对单个观测的敏感度如何影响其被判断为先学习项目特定还是类别层面知识，并分析输入分布特性对过渡点的影响。
AI.result: 纯记忆模型在相同标准下可以被错误地判定为先学习项目特定知识或类别层面知识，取决于其敏感性设置；即近期方法的结论可能只是测量工具的假象，而非模型内在的学习顺序。
AI.conclusion: 近期声称LLM先学习抽象知识的方法不可靠；且由于分布式表示中类别属性与项目属性不可分离，"项目特定vs抽象知识"的二分法本身可能是个错误的问题框架。

title: DreamTraj: Generating 6-DoF Object Trajectories by Reading Unrendered Video Diffusion Latents
comment: 17 pages, 8 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://whathappen0.github.io/DreamTraj/
summary: Accurate prediction of object trajectories during manipulation is essential for closing the perception-action loop. Progress is limited on two fronts: available datasets lack fine-grained language-to-motion annotations, and existing predictors either rely on privileged inputs such as video, depth, or CAD models, or recover motion from fully generated videos through costly, error-prone perception pipelines. We close the supervision gap with the MOVE dataset, 5,038 object-centric egocentric trajectories, each paired with a fine-grained natural-language instruction rather than a coarse verb-noun label. We further propose DreamTraj, which predicts a 6-DoF object trajectory from a single RGB image and a task instruction, requiring no video, depth, or CAD model at inference: rather than generating a video, it reads motion from the internal representations of a frozen image-to-video diffusion model at an early denoising step. A lightweight flow-matching Reader decodes query-key attention tracks and pooled hidden states into relative 6-DoF poses. To our knowledge, this is the first approach to directly decode object 6-DoF trajectories from intermediate video diffusion representations rather than generated pixels. DreamTraj sets a new state of the art on both translation and rotation against forecasters that consume multi-frame or privileged inputs, and runs 4.6x faster than generate-then-extract pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MOVE数据集和DreamTraj方法，用于从单张RGB图像和自然语言指令实现6自由度物体轨迹预测，无需视频、深度或CAD模型，通过从冻结的视频扩散模型内部表示中解码运动信息，在翻译和旋转预测上均达到最优性能，且比生成-提取流水线快4.6倍。
AI.motivation: 物体轨迹预测对操作闭环至关重要，但现有研究面临两个瓶颈：缺乏细粒度语言到动作注释的数据集，以及现有预测方法依赖特权输入（如视频、深度或CAD模型）或通过生成视频再提取运动信息的昂贵且有误差的流水线。作者旨在弥合监督差距并摆脱对特权输入的依赖。
AI.method: 1) 构建MOVE数据集：包含5,038条以物体为中心的自我中心轨迹，每条轨迹配有细粒度自然语言指令而非粗粒度动词-名词标签。2) 提出DreamTraj：从单张RGB图像和任务指令预测6-DoF物体轨迹，使用冻结的图像到视频扩散模型，在早期去噪步骤中从内部表示读取运动信息，通过轻量级的流匹配读取器将查询-键注意力轨迹和池化隐藏状态解码为相对6-DoF位姿，而非生成视频再提取运动。
AI.result: DreamTraj在平移和旋转预测上均超越了使用多帧或特权输入的预测方法，达到新最优水平；运行速度比生成-提取流水线快4.6倍。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个直接从中间视频扩散表示中解码物体6-DoF轨迹而非从生成像素中提取的方法，验证了从扩散模型内部表示读取运动信息的可行性和高效性。

title: Pruned BPE: Post-training Visibility Pruning and Token Reallocation for Byte Pair Encoding
summary: Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) is widely used for subword tokenization, but standard BPE exposes every learned merge token to the downstream model, including tokens that mainly serve as intermediate construction units and rarely appear in the final encoded corpus. This paper proposes Pruned BPE, a post-training visibility-pruning and token-reallocation method that separates merge construction from model-visible vocabulary selection. After standard BPE training, tokens are evaluated by final exposure. Low-exposure tokens are retained as internal-only merge nodes, while their visible vocabulary slots are reassigned to better-exposed candidates learned through resumed training. During encoding, internal-only tokens are recursively expanded into visible descendants while the original BPE merge order is preserved. Experiments on two non-overlapping English- and Chinese-dominated corpora and their combination show that Pruned BPE consistently reduces encoded length relative to Standard BPE at the same training corpus, evaluation corpus, and model-visible vocabulary size. At a 40\% exposure threshold, the reduction is approximately 0.27\%--0.36\% on same-corpus evaluations. In a vocabulary-only evaluation using a shared exact minimum-token dynamic-programming encoder, Pruned BPE retains an advantage of approximately 0.23\%--0.31\%, indicating that the improvement arises from a more efficient visible vocabulary. These gains represent a meaningful fraction of the approximately 1.5\%--3.8\% marginal reduction that would otherwise require adding another 2K Standard BPE tokens. Qualitative analysis shows that internal-only tokens include reusable English fragments, Chinese components, partial UTF-8 byte sequences, and structured-text fragments. The results indicate that post-training visibility pruning can improve BPE vocabulary efficiency without increasing the vocabulary exposed to the language model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Pruned BPE，一种后训练可见性剪枝与token重新分配方法，将BPE合并构建与模型可见词汇选择分离。通过将低曝光token保留为内部合并节点并重新分配可见词汇槽位，在相同可见词汇量下显著降低编码长度，提升词汇效率。
AI.motivation: 标准BPE将所有学习到的合并token都暴露给下游模型，其中包括大量主要作为中间构建单元、很少出现在最终编码语料中的token。这些低曝光token浪费了模型可见词汇表的宝贵容量，降低了词汇使用效率。
AI.method: (1) 在标准BPE训练后，根据最终曝光度评估每个token；(2) 低曝光token保留为仅内部使用的合并节点；(3) 将它们的可见词汇槽位重新分配给通过恢复训练学到的高曝光候选token；(4) 编码时内部token递归展开为可见后代，同时保持原始BPE合并顺序。
AI.result: 在英语和中文主导的语料及其组合上，Pruned BPE在相同训练语料、评估语料和可见词汇量下持续降低编码长度。在40%曝光阈值下，同语料评估约降低0.27%-0.36%；纯词汇评估中约降低0.23%-0.31%。这些提升相当于需要额外增加2K标准BPE token才能获得的1.5%-3.8%边际收益的重要部分。
AI.conclusion: 后训练可见性剪枝可以在不增加暴露给语言模型的词汇量的情况下提高BPE词汇效率。内部token包括可复用的英语片段、中文部件、部分UTF-8字节序列和结构化文本片段，说明该方法能有效识别并保留有价值但低曝光的构建单元。

title: Practical Noise Modeling for SPAD Intensity Imaging
summary: Single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) cameras are promising for low-light and high-dynamic-range intensity imaging, but their practical use is limited by complex sensor-specific noise. Unlike time-correlated single-photon counting (TCSPC) systems, SPAD cameras record whether at least one detection occurred in each gate without photon timestamps in intensity imaging mode, making explicit noise decomposition difficult. We present a practical noise modeling and calibration framework for SPAD intensity denoising. Our forward model describes binary-frame accumulation with a Binomial observation process, models signal-independent dark noise as an exposure-dependent pure dark count term plus an exposure-independent dark-frame bias term, and incorporates pixel-wise response non-uniformity. We design a dedicated calibration procedure for the proposed model and use it to build a count-domain noise-synthesis pipeline for network training. For denoising, we further design a SPAD-specific dark-shading correction (SPAD-DSC) to remove most systematic noise before network training. We construct a real-world SPAD intensity dataset for testing. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed noise model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对SPAD强度成像的实用噪声建模与标定框架，包括二项式观测模型、信号无关暗噪声建模、像素响应非均匀性校正，以及专用的暗阴影校正方法，并构建了真实SPAD强度数据集验证了所提噪声模型的有效性。
AI.motivation: SPAD相机在低光和高动态范围成像中具有潜力，但受限于复杂的传感器特定噪声。与TCSPC系统不同，SPAD相机在强度成像模式下只记录每个门控周期内是否至少发生一次检测，缺乏光子时间戳，导致显式噪声分解困难，限制了其实际应用。
AI.method: 提出二项式观测过程描述二进制帧累加的前向模型；将信号无关暗噪声建模为曝光依赖的纯暗计数项加曝光无关的暗帧偏置项；引入像素响应非均匀性。设计专用标定流程，构建计数域噪声合成管线用于网络训练，并设计SPAD专用暗阴影校正(SPAD-DSC)以在训练前去除大部分系统性噪声。
AI.result: 构建了真实SPAD强度数据集进行测试，实验结果证明了所提噪声模型在SPAD强度去噪任务中的优越性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为SPAD强度成像的噪声建模与标定提供了实用解决方案，有效改善了SPAD相机的去噪性能，为SPAD相机的实际部署扫清了部分技术障碍。

title: DASH: Decoupled Adaptive Surrogate - Acquisition Harness for Automated Bayesian Optimization
summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) relies on a surrogate model and an acquisition function, yet the most suitable choices vary across tasks and optimization stages. Automated Bayesian optimization (AutoBO) addresses this variability by adapting BO components online. However, existing AutoBO methods either adapt one component, leaving the other mismatched and creating a bottleneck, or jointly select surrogate--acquisition pairs under a shared criterion, overlooking their distinct roles: surrogate selection depends on predictive reliability, whereas acquisition adaptation should respond to campaign context.In this paper, we propose DASH, a Decoupled Adaptive Surrogate--Acquisition Harness for large-language- model (LLM)-enhanced AutoBO. DASH selects surrogates by predictive reliability, uncertainty calibration, and ranking consistency; its two-stage acquisition controller periodically reallocates quotas across acquisition functions, builds a BO shortlist accordingly, and delegates final selection to an LLM. DASH also incorporates an integrated harness, consisting of knowledge-guided warm start and structured memory, to ground optimization in domain knowledge and accumulated feedback. Across four chemical optimization tasks, DASH outperforms the best AutoBO baseline by 12.51% in trajectory-level Acceleration Factor and 5.00% in endpoint Enhancement Factor. Results remain strong across LLM backbones, and ablations verify the complementary contributions of all components. Full-table and behavioral contamination checks find no detectable evidence that direct benchmark memorization or source-cell leakage explains these gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DASH框架，一种用于大语言模型增强的自动贝叶斯优化的解耦自适应代理-采集器系统。DASH分别基于预测可靠性选择代理模型，并通过两阶段采集控制器（结合LLM决策）自适应分配采集函数配额。在四个化学优化任务中，DASH相比最佳AutoBO基线在轨迹级加速因子提升12.51%，端点增强因子提升5.00%。
AI.motivation: 现有AutoBO方法存在两个缺陷：一是只适配单一组件（代理模型或采集函数），导致另一组件不匹配形成瓶颈；二是联合选择代理-采集对时使用共享标准，忽略了两者截然不同的作用——代理模型选择应依赖于预测可靠性，而采集函数的适配需要响应优化旅程的具体上下文。
AI.method: DASH框架由三部分构成：（1）代理模型选择：基于预测可靠性、不确定性校准和排名一致性进行选择；（2）两阶段采集控制器：周期性地在采集函数间重新分配配额，据此构建BO候选列表，并委托LLM进行最终选择；（3）集成化装置：包括知识引导的冷启动策略和结构化记忆，将领域知识与累积反馈融入优化过程。
AI.result: 在四个化学优化任务上，DASH相比最佳AutoBO基线在轨迹级Acceleration Factor提升12.51%，在Endpoint Enhancement Factor提升5.00%。在不同LLM骨干网络上结果保持稳健，消融实验验证了所有组件的互补贡献。污染检测未发现基准记忆或源数据泄露导致性能提升的证据。
AI.conclusion: DASH通过解耦代理模型与采集函数的适配机制，充分尊重两者各自的评估准则，并借助LLM的决策能力和集成化记忆装置，在化学优化任务上取得了优于现有AutoBO方法的显著性能提升，且结果在不同LLM后端上具有鲁棒性。

title: Practical Online KV Cache Compaction for LLM Agents: An Empirical Study
summary: LLM agents accumulate long trajectories of reasoning steps, tool calls, and environment feedback, making the KV cache a major inference bottleneck. KV cache compaction can reduce this cost, but most prior methods assume a static context where future queries are known or can be approximated offline. Agents instead require online compaction: new information must be compressed before future relevance is known, using proxy queries cheap enough for the inference path. We study online compaction across token eviction (TE) and attention matching (AM), adapting both to compact agent turns and comparing cheap proxy sources such as boundary, repeat-prefill, and delayed future-generation queries. Experiments on BrowseComp-Plus and WideSearch show that immediate compaction often hurts performance, whereas delaying compaction to use the agent's future queries recovers much of the gap. Moreover, TE is often more robust than AM under imperfect proxies. Across models at different scales, TE preserves most of the accuracy while reducing KV cache by 80%, and can improve throughput over the no compaction baseline. These results position proxy-query selection as a core design choice for practical online KV compaction.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM代理场景下的在线KV缓存压缩问题，提出将令牌驱逐（TE）和注意力匹配（AM）两种压缩方法适配到代理对话中，并比较了多种廉价代理查询来源。实验表明，延迟压缩并利用代理未来的查询可以显著恢复性能损失，TE在代理查询不完美时比AM更鲁棒，且能减少80%的KV缓存同时保持大部分准确率并提升吞吐量。
AI.motivation: LLM代理会产生很长的推理轨迹（推理步骤、工具调用、环境反馈），KV缓存成为主要推理瓶颈。现有压缩方法大多假设静态上下文（未来查询已知或可离线近似），但代理场景需要在线压缩——新信息必须在未来相关性未知的情况下被压缩，且代理查询必须足够廉价以适配推理路径。因此需要研究适合代理场景的在线KV压缩方法。
AI.method: 将令牌驱逐（TE）和注意力匹配（AM）两种KV压缩方法适配到代理对话场景中，实现在线压缩。比较三种廉价代理查询来源：边界查询（boundary）、重复预填充（repeat-prefill）和延迟未来生成查询（delayed future-generation），并在BrowseComp-Plus和WideSearch两个基准上评估不同规模模型的表现。
AI.result: 研究发现：1）立即压缩往往损害性能，而延迟压缩以利用代理的未来查询可以恢复大部分性能差距；2）在代理查询不完美的情况下，TE通常比AM更鲁棒；3）在不同规模的模型中，TE在减少80% KV缓存的同时保持大部分准确率，并且在吞吐量上优于无压缩基线。
AI.conclusion: 代理查询的选择是实际在线KV压缩设计的核心决策点。延迟压缩配合未来查询作为代理来源是更优的策略，TE相比AM更适合代理场景下的在线压缩。

title: Image-Space Rule Discovery
summary: Can image-editing models discover visual rules in image space and complete problem-solving end-to-end? We tackle this question in the spirit of a human worksheet test (e.g., an IQ test), using problems that require models to read image-based instructions, recognize the problem, infer the answer, bind it to the correct destination, control output count, suppress unnecessary edits, and preserve the input and format. We introduce WISRD, a Worksheet Image-Space Rule Discovery benchmark with 11 core tasks under eight information conditions, spanning localized marking, filling, copying, counting, and no-edit suppression, together with four supplementary reasoning-stress probes for multi-step spatial manipulation, abstract pattern reasoning, logical inference, and constraint-based problem solving. We identify three key findings as follows. (i) Among the frontier image-editing models evaluated, Nano Banana Pro achieves the highest score. On the shared V0--V3 no-reference subset, the Auto-Strict proxy pass rates are 48.7% for Nano Banana Pro, 13.4\% for Qwen-Image-Edit, 11.5% for FLUX.2 Klein 4B API, 11.3% for FLUX.2 Klein 4B open-weight, and 0.0% for InstructPix2Pix. (ii) Analysis reveals that current image-editing models can partially rely on rendered in-image instructions even when the external prompt is absent or merely generic. (iii) In small supplementary diagnostics, Nano Banana Pro achieves 70.0% on 4-by-4 Sudoku and 22.9% on public RAVEN pattern-discovery items in image space.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了WISRD基准，用于测试图像编辑模型能否直接在图像空间中完成规则发现和问题求解（类似IQ测试）。评估了多个前沿模型，发现Nano Banana Pro表现最佳，但整体准确率仍然较低。
AI.motivation: 探索图像编辑模型是否具备在图像空间中直接发现视觉规则并端到端完成问题求解的能力，类似于人类完成工作表测验（如IQ测试）的过程。
AI.method: 构建WISRD（Worksheet Image-Space Rule Discovery）基准，包含11个核心任务和8种信息条件，涵盖局部标记、填充、复制、计数和抑制编辑等类型；另设4个补充推理压力测试，涉及多步空间操作、抽象模式推理、逻辑推理和基于约束的问题求解。
AI.result: 在评估的前沿图像编辑模型中，Nano Banana Pro得分最高，在V0-V3无参考子集上Auto-Strict代理通过率为48.7%，远高于其他模型（Qwen-Image-Edit为13.4%，FLUX.2 Klein 4B约为11%，InstructPix2Pix为0%）。此外，模型在外部提示缺失或仅含通用提示时仍能部分依赖图像内渲染指令；Nano Banana Pro在4×4数独上达70.0%，在RAVEN模式发现任务上为22.9%。
AI.conclusion: 当前图像编辑模型已具备一定程度的图像空间规则发现能力，能部分利用图像内指令，但整体性能仍有限，尤其在抽象推理和模式发现方面与人类水平差距明显。

title: HetGPS: Scalable Graph Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Physics-Anchored Adaptive Safety for EV Charging
summary: Safety interventions for large populations of network-coupled agents must protect shared constraints without unnecessarily overriding task-oriented policy decisions. We present HetGPS, a hybrid graph-control framework synergizing learned graph risk with physics-anchored correction by separating intervention magnitude from corrective direction. An action-conditioned graph residual model schedules state-dependent intervention authority, while a physics model determines its direction. For electric vehicle (EV) charging, we couple this filter with a parameter-shared heterogeneous graph soft actor-critic policy, enabling topology-aware coordination with a learned model size independent of fleet size. Across five nested distribution networks with 200--3,218 EVs and 100 evaluation days, Adaptive Authority reduces bus--step voltage violations from 3.93--7.74\% without filtering to 0.52--3.44\%, while maintaining 99.06--100\% departure success. Relative to the same physics-directed projection with fixed authority, it improves mean reward on all five networks and lowers the mean safety score on four. The deployed policy-and-risk model contains 383,702 learned parameters at every scale; at 3,218 EVs, a matched centralized SAC actor is about $170\times$ larger. A policy trained on the eight-transformer system transfers zero-shot to the 16- and 32-transformer systems, attaining 0.57--0.75\% violation rates and at least 99.99\% departure success. These results show that learned graph risk can allocate intervention authority at scale while feeder physics anchors corrective action.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HetGPS，一种混合图控制框架，通过分离干预幅度与修正方向来保护网络耦合智能体的共享约束。在电动汽车充电场景中，该方法将电压违规率从3.93-7.74%降至0.52-3.44%，同时保持99%以上的出发成功率，模型参数规模仅为集中式SAC的1/170，并支持零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 针对大规模网络耦合智能体的安全干预，既需要保护共享约束，又要避免过度覆盖任务导向的策略决策。现有的安全过滤方法需要平衡干预力度与策略自由，缺乏可扩展且灵活分配干预权重的机制。
AI.method: HetGPS采用混合图控制框架，核心思想是将干预幅度与修正方向分离：动作条件图残差模型负责调度状态依赖的干预权限（幅度），物理模型负责确定修正方向。在EV充电场景中，将该过滤器与参数共享的异构图软演员-评论家策略结合，实现拓扑感知协调，且学到的模型大小与车队规模无关。
AI.result: 在五个嵌套配电网（200-3,218辆EV、100个评估日）上，自适应权限将母线-步电压违规从无过滤时的3.93-7.74%降低至0.52-3.44%，同时保持99.06-100%的出发成功率。相对于固定权限的物理引导投影，在全部五个网络上提高了平均奖励，在四个网络上降低了平均安全分数。模型参数量为383,702，在3,218辆EV时比匹配的集中式SAC演员约小170倍。在八变压器系统上训练的策略可零样本迁移至16和32变压器系统，违规率0.57-0.75%，出发成功率不低于99.99%。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，学习到的图风险能够在规模上分配干预权限，同时馈线物理模型为修正动作提供锚定。HetGPS展示了将学习式风险分配与物理驱动修正相结合的有效性，为大规模网络耦合智能体的安全干预提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: FinHardBench: Can LLMs Generate Latency-Aware Hardware for Financial Computing?
comment: 16 pages (10 pages main text). Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/owenfucell/FinHardBench
summary: Can large language models generate not just correct, but fast hardware? This paper investigates the question in financial FPGA design, where 5-10 nanoseconds of latency determines competitive advantage and designs iterate continuously as protocols, strategies, and regulations evolve. FinHardBench, a benchmark of 33 financial computing tasks, is presented together with three experiments that mirror the real-world FPGA iteration cycle: generating new modules from specifications, tuning system-level configurations across a 6-stage trading pipeline, and adapting existing modules to specification changes. Evaluation of six LLMs on 1530+ experiment rounds yields three findings: (1) models achieve 19-61% functional correctness with timing degradation up to 13.7$\times$ on specific tasks; (2) in system-level design space exploration, top LLMs converge to the optimal configuration with higher reliability than random search, simulated annealing, and Bayesian optimization baselines (5/5 seeds vs. 0-4/5 at the same 24-round budget); (3) strategy-level specification changes remain unsolved for most models. Across the six models, generation and DSE rankings overlap moderately: the strongest code generator is not the fastest architecture optimizer, and the weakest code generator (MiniMax M2.7) still reaches the system optimum on 4 of 5 seeds. On the tasks in FinHardBench, difficulty tracks training data pattern availability more closely than abstraction level. FinHardBench is released as an open-source benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FinHardBench基准，包含33个金融计算硬件生成任务，系统评估了6个LLM在1530+轮实验中生成FPGA硬件的能力，发现模型在功能正确性上可达到19-61%，但在时序方面最多可退化13.7倍；系统级设计空间探索中顶级LLM比传统优化算法更可靠，而策略级规格变更对大多数模型仍是未解难题。
AI.motivation: 金融FPGA设计中5-10纳秒的延迟差异决定竞争优势，且设计需随协议、策略和法规变化持续迭代。现有LLM生成硬件的研究多关注正确性，很少关注生成硬件的速度/延迟表现，因此需要系统的基准来评估LLM在金融硬件生成中的实际能力。
AI.method: 构建FinHardBench基准（33个金融计算任务），设计三个镜像真实FPGA迭代周期的实验：（1）从规格生成新模块；（2）跨6级交易流水线的系统级配置调优；（3）现有模块的规格变更适配。对6个LLM进行1530+轮实验评估，并与随机搜索、模拟退火和贝叶斯优化等基线对比。
AI.result: 三个关键发现：（1）模型功能正确率为19-61%，但特定任务时序退化最高达13.7倍；（2）系统级DSE中顶级LLM在24轮预算内以5/5种子收敛到最优配置，远超传统基线的0-4/5；（3）策略级规格变更对大多数模型仍未解决。此外代码生成能力与DSE能力排名仅中度重叠，最弱的代码生成器（MiniMax M2.7）仍可在4/5种子达到系统最优。
AI.conclusion: LLM在金融FPGA设计中展现出有前景的能力，尤其在系统级设计空间探索方面优于传统优化方法；但任务难度与训练数据模式可用性相关而非抽象层级，策略级规格变更仍需进一步突破。FinHardBench作为开源基准将促进该领域研究。

title: Optical Flow from Photons
summary: Optical flow remains challenging in high-speed and low-light scenes, where the limited frame rate and sensitivity of conventional cameras lead to motion blur and underexposure. Single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) cameras offer single-photon sensitivity and extremely fine temporal sampling. However, individual slices in these high FPS binary photon streams are too sparse for dense correspondence. Temporal aggregation can provide the spatial cues required by optical flow, but accumulating photons at fixed coordinates blurs moving structures. Motion-aware aggregation can reduce this blur, yet it depends on the flow being estimated. To address this dependency, we propose QuantaFlow, the first method for dense optical flow directly from SPAD streams. Instead of constructing a fixed input representation, QuantaFlow embeds SPAD representation construction into iterative flow refinement. At each iteration, the current flow coarsely aligns the slices within the source and target sub-streams. A photon-flux transformation then constructs multi-scale representations containing intensity and structural cues, while adaptive multi-scale fusion balances photon noise and residual motion blur at each pixel. The fused representations drive a feature-warping flow update, and the refined flow guides representation construction in the next iteration. We further construct a synthetic dataset for SPAD optical-flow training and evaluation. Experiments on the synthetic dataset and real-world SPAD data demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization of QuantaFlow.

AI.tldr: QuantaFlow是首个直接从SPAD光子流估计稠密光流的方法，通过将SPAD表示构建嵌入到迭代光流细化中，实现运动感知聚合与多尺度融合表示构建，在合成和真实SPAD数据上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 高速和低光场景中，传统相机的帧率和灵敏度受限导致运动模糊和曝光不足。SPAD相机虽具备单光子灵敏度和极细时间采样，但高帧率二值光子流的单个切片过于稀疏，难以进行稠密对应估计。现有方案中，固定坐标累加光子的时间聚合会模糊运动结构，而运动感知聚合又依赖未知的光流，形成循环依赖问题。
AI.method: QuantaFlow将SPAD表示构建嵌入迭代光流细化框架中。每次迭代中，当前光流粗对齐源和目标子流内的切片，通过光子通量变换构建多尺度表示（含强度和结构线索），自适应多尺度融合在每像素权衡光子噪声与残余运动模糊，融合表示驱动特征扭曲的光流更新，细化后的光流再指导下一轮表示构建。同时构建了用于SPAD光流训练与评估的合成数据集。
AI.result: 在合成数据集和真实世界SPAD数据上的实验验证了QuantaFlow的有效性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过将表示构建与迭代光流估计联合优化，QuantaFlow破解了运动感知聚合依赖光流估计的循环依赖问题，为高速低光场景下的稠密光流估计提供了新范式。

title: Multi-Dimensional Assessment for AI Cognition (MAAC): A Theoretical Framework for Process-Oriented Cognitive Evaluation of Text-Based AI Systems
summary: Evaluating artificial intelligence systems has historically relied on outcome-based benchmarks that measure task accuracy, robustness, or fairness. While indispensable, these benchmarks provide limited diagnostic insight into the underlying cognitive processes that generate performance-leaving critical questions unanswered about how AI systems reason, integrate memory, manage complexity, or avoid generating false information. This paper introduces the Multi-Dimensional Assessment for AI Cognition (MAAC), a theoretically grounded framework for shifting evaluation from what text-based AI systems produce to how they think. MAAC defines nine cognitively motivated dimensions: Cognitive Load, Tool Execution, Content Quality, Memory Integration, Complexity Handling, Hallucination Control, Knowledge Transfer, Processing Efficiency, and Process-Outcome Alignment. Each dimension is grounded in established cognitive science theory-drawing on Marr's tri-level hypothesis, Baddeley's working memory model, Sweller's cognitive load theory, and unified theories of cognition. Five theoretical analyses provide initial support for the framework's coherence and empirical testability: dimension-to-theory mapping; a coverage matrix assessing breadth and non-redundancy; a formal gap analysis relative to current evaluation practice; a worked diagnostic illustration; and a set of a priori interdependency predictions for future empirical testing. MAAC provides a theoretical and operational framework for principled process-level cognitive assessment of text-based AI systems, complementing existing outcome-based benchmarks with cognitively grounded, multi-dimensional evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个名为MAAC的多维度AI认知评估框架，将评估重点从AI系统的输出结果转向其认知过程。该框架定义了九个基于认知科学理论的维度，并通过五个理论分析验证了其一致性和可测试性。
AI.motivation: 现有的AI评估主要依赖基于结果的基准测试，这些测试虽然在衡量任务准确性、鲁棒性和公平性方面不可或缺，但无法提供对AI系统底层认知过程的诊断性洞察，无法回答AI如何推理、整合记忆、管理复杂性和避免生成虚假信息等关键问题。
AI.method: MAAC框架定义了九个认知驱动的评估维度（认知负荷、工具执行、内容质量、记忆整合、复杂性处理、幻觉控制、知识迁移、处理效率、过程-结果对齐），每个维度都基于既有的认知科学理论（Marr三层次假说、Baddeley工作记忆模型、Sweller认知负荷理论和统一认知理论），并通过五个理论分析来验证框架的连贯性和可测试性。
AI.result: 通过五个理论分析提供了框架的初步支持：维度-理论映射分析、覆盖矩阵评估框架广度和非冗余性、与当前评估实践的形式化差距分析、示例性诊断说明，以及为未来实证测试提出的一组先验的相互依赖预测。
AI.conclusion: MAAC为基于文本的AI系统提供了原则性的过程级认知评估框架，以认知理论基础上的多维度评估补充现有的基于结果的基准测试，推动AI评估从关注"产出什么"转向"如何思考"。

title: SpatialAfford: Teaching Compact VLMs Where to Look and Where to Ground for Affordance
summary: Affordance grounding aims to localize the functional region for interaction, such as the handle to grasp or the button to press, rather than the whole object. This makes it more challenging than generic visual grounding because the target region is smaller, more ambiguous, and more dependent on task context, especially for compact vision-language models (VLMs) used in embodied settings. Recent sequence-level supervision and reinforcement learning improve coordinate prediction quality, yet compact autoregressive VLMs still lack reliable affordance-aware visual focus before coordinate generation: the model can produce better coordinate tokens while its cross-modal attention remains diffuse and weakly anchored to the true affordance evidence. To address it, we propose SpatialAfford, a two-stage framework that first aligns attention to the ground-truth affordance region through Spatial Attention Alignment (SAA), then refines coordinate prediction with Spatial-Aware GRPO. By explicitly teaching the model where to look before optimizing where to ground, SpatialAfford turns affordance grounding from a purely output-constrained objective into attention-grounded spatial reasoning. Across ShareRobot-Bench, ReasonAff, and PartAfford, SpatialAfford consistently improves affordance grounding, with a compact 4B model outperforming stronger 7B+ baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出SpatialAfford两阶段框架，通过空间注意力对齐（SAA）和空间感知GRPO优化，提升紧凑视觉语言模型在具身场景中的affordance grounding能力，4B模型超越7B+基线。
AI.motivation: 紧凑自回归视觉语言模型在进行affordance grounding时，在坐标生成前缺乏可靠的affordance感知视觉关注，跨模态注意力分散且未能锚定真实的功能区域证据，导致定位精度不足。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段通过Spatial Attention Alignment (SAA)将注意力对齐到真实affordance区域；第二阶段使用Spatial-Aware GRPO优化坐标预测。
AI.result: 在ShareRobot-Bench、ReasonAff和PartAfford三个基准上持续提升affordance grounding性能，4B紧凑模型优于7B+更强基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过先教模型"看哪里"再优化"在哪里定位"，将affordance grounding从纯输出约束目标转化为注意力锚定的空间推理过程，显著提升紧凑VLMs的定位能力。

title: When Does LLM Orchestration Pay Off? A Controlled Evaluation of Accuracy, Cost, and Task Difficulty
summary: LLM orchestration is often assumed to improve reasoning by allocating additional inference-time computation, yet its gains may not justify its cost. Existing comparisons also frequently overlook differences in optimization effort, making it difficult to isolate the value of orchestration itself. We conduct a controlled evaluation of Self-Refine, Best-of-$N$, and Debate against task-only and chain-of-thought (CoT) single-call baselines across five LLM backbones and three domains: competitive programming, chess puzzles, and mathematics. For comparability, we optimize each method with GEPA under the same optimization budget and evaluate all methods on the same difficulty-stratified benchmark items. Orchestration yields moderate but benchmark-dependent gains: averaged across backbones within each benchmark, the largest improvement is 4.6 percentage points over optimized CoT inference and 4.5 points over task-only inference, while requiring approximately 2 to 4 times the mean total tokens of task-only inference. Human-derived difficulty is associated with lower absolute accuracy in all three benchmarks, but within-benchmark analyses do not indicate that orchestration effects increase with task difficulty. By contrast, exploratory mixed-effects analyses reveal strong interactions between orchestration method and backbone model across all three benchmarks, showing that orchestration effectiveness depends substantially on the underlying model. Our results suggest that orchestration decisions should be model-specific and account for whether moderate accuracy gains justify the additional inference cost. More broadly, evaluations of LLM orchestrations should control optimization effort and report model-specific accuracy--cost trade-offs rather than treating additional inference-time structure as uniformly beneficial.

AI.tldr: 本文对Self-Refine、Best-of-N和Debate三种LLM编排方法进行了受控评估，在五个LLM骨干模型和三个领域（竞赛编程、国际象棋谜题、数学）中与任务专用和思维链单次调用基线比较，发现编排方法带来中等但依赖基准的准确率提升（最大4.6个百分点），但需2-4倍的token开销，且效果与骨干模型强相关。
AI.motivation: LLM编排（orchestration）通常被认为能通过增加推理时计算来提升推理能力，但其增益可能不值得成本。现有比较常忽视优化努力差异，难以隔离编排本身的价值，因此需要受控评估。
AI.method: 在五个LLM骨干和三个领域（竞赛编程、国际象棋谜题、数学）中，对Self-Refine、Best-of-N和Debate三种编排方法与任务专用和CoT单次调用基线进行比较。所有方法使用GEPA在相同优化预算下优化，并在相同的难度分层基准项上评估。
AI.result: 编排方法带来中等但依赖基准的增益：跨骨干平均，最大提升为较优化CoT推理高4.6个百分点，较任务专用推理高4.5个百分点，但token消耗约为任务专用的2-4倍。人类难度定义与三个基准的绝对准确率降低相关，但编排效果不随任务难度增加而增强。混合效应分析显示编排方法与骨干模型之间存在强交互作用。
AI.conclusion: 编排决策应针对具体模型定制，并权衡中等准确率增益与额外推理成本。更广泛地说，LLM编排评估应控制优化努力，并报告模型特定的准确率-成本权衡，而非将额外推理结构视为普遍有益。

title: Mind the Gap: Zero-Query Jailbreaks via Filter-Generator Discrepancy in Text-to-Image Systems
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) systems typically have prompt-level safety filters before the generator to block unsafe requests, yet such systems remain vulnerable to malicious jailbreak prompts. Transfer-based attacks construct adversarial prompts offline without querying the target, but they tend to overfit to a single surrogate. Moreover, they explore a large search space in which semantic or perceptual similarity alone cannot guarantee both filter evasion and preservation of the unsafe generation intent, wasting effort on low-potential candidates. We observe that the filter and the generator process the same prompt under different objectives and representations, and term this gap the Filter-Generator Discrepancy (FGD), which allows a perturbation to reduce a prompt's perceived risk to the filter while preserving the visual concept needed by the generator. Building on FGD, we propose a zero-query jailbreak framework that screens perturbations into a high-potential candidate set via observable discrepancy rules at the tokenization and semantic stages, and then performs a surrogate-ensemble evolutionary search that requires no access to the target. Experiments on six black-box pipelines and a commercial online service show that our method consistently outperforms representative baselines, raising the average attack success rate to 29.2\% (MHSC) and 33.3\% (Q16) across the six pipelines and improving over the strongest baseline by about 8 and 12 percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于过滤器-生成器差异（FGD）的零查询越狱框架，通过对扰动进行两阶段筛选（tokenization和语义阶段）并采用代理集成的进化搜索，实现对文本到图像系统的黑盒越狱攻击，在六个商业管线中将平均攻击成功率提升至29.2%（MHSC）和33.3%（Q16）。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本到图像系统虽然具有提示级安全过滤器，但仍易受恶意越狱提示攻击。基于迁移的攻击方法容易对单一代理模型过拟合，且在庞大的搜索空间中仅凭语义或感知相似性无法同时保证过滤器逃逸和保留不安全生成意图，导致大量低潜力候选浪费计算资源。
AI.method: 提出Filter-Generator Discrepancy (FGD)概念，即过滤器与生成器对同一提示在不同目标和表示下处理存在差异。基于FGD构建零查询越狱框架：首先通过tokenization和语义阶段的可观测差异规则筛选高潜力扰动候选集，然后进行无需访问目标的代理集成进化搜索。
AI.result: 在六个黑盒管线和商业在线服务上的实验表明，该方法一致优于代表性基线，平均攻击成功率分别达到29.2%（MHSC）和33.3%（Q16），相比最强基线分别提升约8和12个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 过滤器与生成器之间的处理差异可以被利用来构造高效的零查询越狱攻击，通过两阶段筛选和代理集成进化搜索，能够在无需目标查询的情况下实现对多种黑盒T2I系统的有效攻击。

title: Evolutionary Curriculum Learning Improves Biological Sequence Modeling
summary: Variational autoencoders (VAEs) trained on multiple sequence alignments (MSAs) have emerged as powerful generative models for biological sequences, with applications ranging from disease variant prediction to functional RNA design. However, standard biological VAE training treats all sequences as exchangeable, ignoring the rich evolutionary structure that organizes homologous sequences from evolutionarily close to highly divergent. We propose Evolutionary Curriculum Learning (ECL), a training strategy that exploits this structure by progressively exposing the model to sequences of increasing evolutionary distance from sampled anchors, following a power-law expansion schedule. Applied to two architecturally distinct VAE models and two biological domains--protein variant effect prediction with EVE and RNA family sequence generation with RfamGen--ECL improves downstream task performance across five random seeds per configuration. Mean ClinVar classification AUROC rises from 0.981 to 0.989 for p53; for PTEN, ECL attains 1.000 in every seed whereas the baseline is unstable (mean 0.905, falling as low as 0.54). For RNA, ECL raises mean covariance-model bit scores on all three families tested and exceeds its seed-matched baseline in 12 of 15 training runs, though with only three families the effect cannot be established as significant at the family level. Ablation experiments show that progressively expanding the sampled sequences by evolutionary distance outperforms fixed-size neighborhood sampling in addition to uniform random sampling. Evolutionary distance is therefore a useful inductive bias for ordering the training curriculum in biological sequence modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出进化课程学习（ECL）策略，利用同源序列的进化结构信息，按幂律扩展计划渐进式地将进化距离递增的序列暴露给VAE模型，在蛋白质变异效应预测和RNA家族序列生成任务上均提升了性能。
AI.motivation: 标准生物序列VAE训练将所有序列视为可交换的，忽略了同源序列中从进化相近到高度分化的丰富进化结构，未能利用这一先验信息来优化训练过程。
AI.method: ECL通过从锚点序列出发，按照幂律扩展计划逐步扩大采样序列的进化距离范围，使模型渐进式地学习从相似到多样的序列分布。在两种架构不同的VAE模型（EVE和RfamGen）及两个生物领域进行评估。
AI.result: ECL在p53上使ClinVar分类AUROC从0.981提升至0.989；PTEN上达到全部种子的1.000（基线不稳定，均值0.905，最低0.54）；RNA三个家族的平均协方差模型位分数均提升，12/15次训练运行超过种子匹配的基线。消融实验表明渐进扩展优于固定邻域采样和均匀随机采样。
AI.conclusion: 进化距离是生物序列建模中有效的归纳偏置，可用于排序训练课程，为生物序列VAE训练提供了优于传统随机采样的策略。

title: Unsupervised Multidomain Approaches to Named Entity Recognition with Small Datasets
summary: This paper explores the challenges and the methodologies associated with learning quality representations in scenarios with unlabelled small or limited datasets for downstream information extraction task (Multidomain Named Entity Recognition (NER). The study adopts a Transfer Learning on small datasets. Traditional NER systems often rely on large, labelled data, which is impractical for many domains. This study, therefore, applies an unsupervised pre-training approach to precondition and identify entities without annotated datasets, then applies transfer learning models to different simulated limited datasets for a named entity recognition task. Entity Recognition (NER) is essential in natural language processing (NLP), it identifies and classifies related entities within the text. This study addresses the complexities of domain variability, data sparsity, and overfitting and investigates innovative approaches such as data augmentation, few-shot learning, and domain adversarial training. Integrating these techniques promises to enhance the performance and generalizability of NER systems across diverse and resource-constrained domains, paving the way for more efficient and adaptable NLP applications.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在无标注的小规模或有限数据集场景下，如何学习高质量表示以用于下游信息抽取任务（多领域命名实体识别）。研究采用无监督预训练加迁移学习的方法，结合数据增强、少样本学习和领域对抗训练等技术，以应对领域变异性、数据稀疏性和过拟合等挑战。
AI.motivation: 传统NER系统依赖大规模标注数据，这在实际应用中不可行。许多领域缺乏足够的标注数据，因此需要探索在资源受限条件下进行有效实体识别的解决方案。
AI.method: 采用无监督预训练方式对实体进行先验识别（无需标注数据集），然后将迁移学习模型应用于不同的模拟有限数据集上进行NER任务，并整合数据增强、少样本学习和领域对抗训练等技术。
AI.result: 通过整合数据增强、少样本学习和领域对抗训练等技术，预期能够提升NER系统在多种资源受限领域下的性能和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为在数据稀缺条件下构建更高效、更适应性强、更可泛化的NLP应用（尤其是多领域NER）提供了有效途径。

title: DGA$_2$D: Directed Graph-Guided Automated Algorithm Design with Large Language Models
summary: The rapid development of Large Language Models (LLMs) has opened new avenues for Automated Heuristic Design (AHD) for solving NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems (COPs). However, existing LLM-driven AHD methods are largely confined to rigid solver templates, relegating the search process to isolated module tuning. Transitioning to fully autonomous, system-level algorithm design is essential but fraught with low reliability of generated operators, extremely large search spaces, and ineffective credit assignment. To overcome these drawbacks, this paper proposes a Directed Graph-Guided Automated Algorithm Design framework, termed DGA$_2$D. It structures the open-ended program space as a directed graph, where each node represents a functional operator that can be instantiated using one of multiple candidate code implementations, while directed walks constitute complete algorithmic pipelines. A first-order path-dependent credit assignment mechanism is introduced to evaluate code variations strictly based on their topological context. Extensive experiments across 12 distinct COPs, ranging from complex scheduling to routing, demonstrate the consistent empirical advantages of DGA$_2$D. It reduces the average normalized gap by up to 10.96 percentage points compared to state-of-the-art LLM baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DGA₂D框架，将有向图结构与LLM结合，实现NP-hard组合优化问题的全自动算法设计，显著优于现有LLM基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的自动启发式设计方法受限于刚性求解器模板，仅进行孤立模块调优，存在生成算子可靠性低、搜索空间巨大以及信用分配低效等问题，亟需向全自主的系统级算法设计过渡。
AI.method: DGA₂D将有向图结构引入开方式程序空间，节点表示可用多种候选代码实例化的功能算子，有向路径构成完整算法流水线；并引入一阶路径依赖的信用分配机制，根据拓扑上下文评估代码变体。
AI.result: 在12个不同组合优化问题（涵盖复杂调度到路由）上的实验表明，DGA₂D相比最先进的LLM基线方法，平均归一化间隙最多降低10.96个百分点，具有一致的实证优势。
AI.conclusion: 通过有向图引导的自动化算法设计框架，有效解决了LLM驱动AHD方法的可靠性、搜索空间和信用分配三大核心挑战，为NP-hard组合优化问题的全自动算法设计提供了新范式的可行性验证。

title: GuideGround: VLM-guided Semantic Understanding and Viewpoint-aware Reasoning for 3D Visual Grounding
summary: 3D visual grounding aims to localize the target object in a 3D scene from a natural language query, requiring both fine-grained semantic understanding and viewpoint-dependent spatial reasoning. Existing methods typically formulate semantic understanding as an auxiliary closed-set object classification task and rely on multi-view feature aggregation for viewpoint reasoning, limiting semantic generalization and weakening viewpoint-specific evidence. We observe that vision-language models naturally provide complementary capabilities through open-vocabulary semantic understanding and global scene perception. Based on this insight, we propose GuideGround, a VLM-guided framework that complements rather than replaces task-specific grounding models by leveraging VLMs for semantic enhancement and viewpoint-specific hypothesis verification. Specifically, we replace auxiliary closed-set object classification with VLM-generated object semantic descriptions to enhance semantic understanding. Meanwhile, instead of directly aggregating multi-view representations, we preserve viewpoint-specific grounding hypotheses through per-view grounding and explicitly verify them using VLMs across candidate viewpoints. Extensive experiments on the ReferIt3D benchmark demonstrate that GuideGround consistently outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods. Comprehensive ablation studies further confirm the effectiveness of both the proposed semantic understanding and viewpoint reasoning strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GuideGround，一个VLM引导的3D视觉定位框架，利用视觉语言模型增强语义理解和视角推理能力，在ReferIt3D基准上超越现有最先进方法。
AI.motivation: 现有3D视觉定位方法将语义理解视为辅助的闭集对象分类任务，并依赖多视角特征聚合进行视角推理，这限制了语义泛化能力并削弱了视角特定证据。作者观察到视觉语言模型天然具备开放词汇语义理解和全局场景感知能力，可以作为补充。
AI.method: GuideGround框架通过两个核心策略增强任务特定的定位模型：(1)用VLM生成的对象语义描述替代辅助闭集分类来增强语义理解；(2)保留每个视角的定位假设而非直接聚合多视角特征，并通过VLM在候选视角间进行显式验证。
AI.result: 在ReferIt3D基准上的大量实验表明，GuideGround持续优于先前的最先进方法，消融实验也验证了语义理解和视角推理两种策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: VLM作为补充而非替代的方式可以有效提升3D视觉定位性能，开放词汇语义理解和视角特定假设验证是两个关键贡献点。

title: Tracing the Cascade: A Topology-Aware Evaluation Framework for Scientific Agent Hallucinations
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in scientific research, where reliability is critical and the underlying knowledge is densely interconnected. In such settings, hallucinations are particularly damaging: a single erroneous claim on a foundational concept can propagate through multi-step reasoning and corrupt entire trajectories. Existing hallucination benchmarks largely operate at the surface level, treating facts in isolation and relying on uniform accuracy metrics that ignore this topological structure. We address this gap with SCHEMA, the first evidence-grounded, topology-aware evaluation framework for hallucinations in scientific agents. SCHEMA automatically constructs scientific concept graphs from benchmark seeds and literature evidence, synthesizes graph-grounded tasks spanning claim verification, multi-hop reasoning, open-ended explanation, and experimental code generation, and evaluates agents with two complementary diagnostics. A trajectory hallucination pipeline audits intermediate reasoning at scale via a topology-weighted severity score, while a multi-agent counterfactual attribution module pinpoints the causal mechanism behind selected failures. SCHEMA reveals that hallucinations concentrate at a small set of highly connected knowledge hubs, and that final-answer accuracy decouples from trajectory honesty; models often reach correct conclusions through structurally flawed reasoning. These results indicate that for high-stakes scientific applications, terminal accuracy alone is an insufficient signal of agent reliability, motivating mechanism-level evaluation grounded in knowledge topology. Code is available at https://github.com/circles-post/SCHEMA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCHEMA，首个证据驱动、拓扑感知的科学智能体幻觉评估框架，通过构建科学概念图并设计多种任务与双轨诊断机制，揭示幻觉集中于高连通知识枢纽，且最终答案准确性与推理轨迹诚实性脱钩。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体在科学研究中的应用日益广泛，但该领域知识高度互联，幻觉会沿多步推理传播并破坏整条推理链。现有幻觉基准停留在表面层面，孤立对待事实并使用统一准确性指标，忽略了知识间的拓扑结构。
AI.method: SCHEMA从基准种子和文献证据自动构建科学概念图，合成图接地任务（涵盖声明验证、多跳推理、开放解释和实验代码生成），并采用两种互补诊断手段：轨迹幻觉流水线通过拓扑加权严重度评分大规模审计中间推理，多智能体反事实归因模块定位特定失败背后的因果机制。
AI.result: 实验发现幻觉集中在少数高连接度的知识枢纽上，且最终答案准确性与轨迹诚实性相互脱钩——模型常通过结构上有缺陷的推理得出正确结论。
AI.conclusion: 在高风险科学应用中，仅靠终端准确性无法充分反映智能体的可靠性，需要基于知识拓扑进行机制层面的评估。

title: Unleashing the Power of Text: Text-Guided Flow Matching for Image Fusion under Complex Degradations
summary: Infrared-visible image fusion under realistic degradation scenarios is a challenging task, as degradations not only cause a loss of reliable modality-specific information in observed images but also hinder the fusion process. Recent studies indicate that text can provide prior information about degradation characteristics, complementing the limited evidence available from corrupted input images and facilitating fusion. However, existing methods typically inject fixed global text representations into visual features, making it difficult for textual guidance to adapt to spatially varying degradations, local structures, and thermal saliency. To this end, we propose TGFusion, a text-guided latent-space flow matching framework that unifies degradation suppression and cross-modal fusion. TGFusion encodes task, degradation, and generation cues into structured prompts. To fully exploit these priors, we design a Prompt-conditioned Multi-stream Joint Flow Transformer that represents text as an independent semantic stream alongside fusion, visible, and infrared streams. Joint attention enables token-level bidirectional interaction and layer-wise updating among semantic and visual representations, allowing degradation semantics to dynamically guide reliable information selection and fusion latent generation. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks and complex degradation scenarios demonstrate that TGFusion achieves superior or competitive performance in perceptual quality, image naturalness, structural-detail preservation, and infrared-saliency retention, while remaining robust across diverse single and compound degradations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TGFusion，一种文本引导的潜空间流匹配框架，用于在真实退化场景下统一红外-可见光图像的去退化与跨模态融合任务。通过将任务、退化和生成线索编码为结构化提示，并设计提示条件的多流联合流变换器，实现文本语义与视觉特征在Token级别的双向交互和逐层更新，从而自适应地引导融合过程。实验表明TGFusion在感知质量、图像自然度、结构细节保留和红外显著性保持等方面表现优越。
AI.motivation: 红外-可见光图像融合在真实退化场景下面临双重挑战：退化不仅导致观测图像中丢失可靠的模态特定信息，还阻碍融合过程本身。现有方法通常将固定的全局文本表示注入视觉特征，难以使文本引导适配空间变化的退化、局部结构和热显著性，亟需更灵活的文本引导机制。
AI.method: TGFusion采用文本引导的潜空间流匹配框架，将任务、退化和生成线索编码为结构化提示；设计Prompt-conditioned Multi-stream Joint Flow Transformer，将文本表示为独立语义流，与融合流、可见光流和红外流并列，通过联合注意力实现语义与视觉表示之间Token级双向交互和逐层更新，使退化语义动态引导可靠信息选择和融合潜变量生成。
AI.result: 在公开基准和复杂退化场景上的大量实验表明，TGFusion在感知质量、图像自然度、结构细节保留和红外显著性保持方面达到优越或具有竞争力的性能，并在多样化的单一及复合退化场景中保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: TGFusion通过将文本作为独立语义流与视觉流进行联合交互，有效解决了固定文本表示难以适配空间变化退化的问题，验证了文本引导在多流融合框架中的有效性，为退化场景下的红外-可见光融合提供了新的解决思路。

title: AI-Based Thesis Assessment: An Empirical Study of Human Evaluation Priorities and Their Impact on Automated Assessment
comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 7th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education Technology (AIET 2026), Zagreb, Croatia
summary: Rubric-based AI systems for thesis assessment use criterion weights to assign different levels of importance to evaluation criteria. These weights are typically defined through expert judgment, although little empirical evidence exists regarding how thesis supervisors actually prioritize evaluation criteria. Consequently, this study investigates supervisor-derived criterion weights in thesis assessment and evaluates their impact on AI-based assessment. We surveyed 84 thesis supervisors across four academic disciplines and collected weighting data for 35 thesis assessment criteria. Comparison with the default criterion weights of the AI assessment system RubiSCoT [1] revealed substantial divergences between supervisor-derived and default criterion weights. To evaluate the practical implications of these differences, the supervisor-derived weights were integrated into multiple calibration configurations and evaluated on a corpus of 80 German-language theses. The best-performing configuration reduced the mean relative deviation between AI-generated and supervisor-assigned evaluations from 11.18% to 10.85%, although the improvement was not statistically significant. Human supervisors showed substantially stronger agreement with each other, exhibiting a mean inter-supervisor relative deviation of 4.44%. The findings indicate that criterion-weight calibration alone does not substantially improve alignment between AI-generated and human assessments.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了84位论文导师对35个评估标准的权重偏好，并与AI评估系统RubiSCoT的默认权重进行比较。将导师权重集成到系统中后，AI与人工评估的平均相对偏差从11.18%降至10.85%，但改善不显著；而人工导师之间的平均偏差仅为4.44%。结论是仅靠标准权重校准无法显著提升AI评估与人工评估的一致性。
AI.motivation: 基于量规的AI论文评估系统使用标准权重来区分各评估标准的重要性，但这些权重通常由专家主观设定，缺乏关于导师实际如何权衡评估标准的实证证据。本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 调查了四个学科领域的84位论文导师，收集了35个论文评估标准权重数据；将导师导出权重集成到AI评估系统RubiSCoT的多种校准配置中，并在80篇德语论文语料上进行评估。
AI.result: 导师导出的权重与系统默认权重存在显著差异。最佳配置将平均相对偏差从11.18%降至10.85%，但差异不显著。人类导师之间的平均相对偏差仅为4.44%，远低于AI与人类评估之间的偏差。
AI.conclusion: 仅通过校准标准权重并不能显著改善AI生成评估与人类评估之间的一致性，暗示可能需要更根本的方法改进来缩小AI与人类论文评估的差距。

title: DocPO: Advancing Document Policy Optimization via Tailored Step-Aware Rewards
comment: 14 pages. Accepted to the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM Multimedia 2026). Yunhao Wang and Binghong Wu contributed equally
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for document parsing often relies on reference-based rewards rooted in edit distance (e.g., tree edit distance), yet it remains hard to optimize in the high-accuracy regime because such rewards become weakly discriminative: near-correct outputs receive very similar scores, providing limited learning signal for hard cases. We propose Step-Aware Annealing (SAA), a plug-and-play reward sharpening mechanism that progressively increases reward curvature during training, amplifying subtle quality differences among high-scoring samples while preserving stability in early learning. Built on SAA, we introduce DocPO, a document policy optimization framework with element-specific, reference-based rewards anchored by edit-distance signals: normalized string edit distance (NED) for text, tree edit distance similarity (TEDS) for tables, and a hybrid Rubric+edit reward for formulas. Experiments on OmniDocBench and DocElemHard show that SAA consistently improves GRPO-style RL across document elements over non-annealed rewards, without requiring additional human supervision for reward construction.

AI.tldr: 提出了Step-Aware Annealing (SAA)奖励锐化机制和DocPO文档策略优化框架，通过逐步增加奖励曲率来放大高准确率区间内细微的质量差异，解决文档解析强化学习中编辑距离奖励在近正确输出时区分度不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 文档解析中的强化学习依赖基于编辑距离的参考奖励（如树编辑距离），但在高准确率区间这些奖励区分度弱——近乎正确的输出得分相似，导致难例的学习信号有限，难以进一步优化。
AI.method: 提出SAA（Step-Aware Annealing）渐进式奖励锐化机制，在训练过程中逐步增大奖励曲率，放大高分样本间的细微质量差异同时保持早期学习稳定性；基于SAA构建DocPO框架，为不同文档元素设计元素特定的参考奖励（文本用NED、表格用TEDS、公式用混合Rubric+编辑距离奖励）。
AI.result: 在OmniDocBench和DocElemHard基准上，SAA在各类文档元素上一致提升了GRPO风格的强化学习性能，且无需额外人工监督来构建奖励。
AI.conclusion: SAA作为一种即插即用的奖励锐化机制，能有效解决高准确率区间编辑距离奖励区分度不足的问题，显著提升文档解析强化学习的效果。

title: Behavioral Grammar: Detecting Adaptive Malware via Tiny Language Model Priors and Second-Order Temporal Analysis
summary: Modern endpoint detection systems face a fundamental tension: signature-based approaches are trivially evaded by polymorphic or adaptive threats, while heavy deep-learning models resist auditability and deployment at scale. This paper presents Behavioral Grammar, a detection architecture that treats host runtime behavior as a structured language and learns its grammar with a compact 0.88M-parameter causal Transformer (TinyGPT). Each system event is discretized into an 8-token representation spanning event type, process, argument skeleton, path category, parent process, user, destination, and inter-event timing. The model learns the conditional distribution of normal behavior in a purely self-supervised manner, and anomaly scores are derived from per-slot negative log-likelihood (NLL) statistics, yielding a mathematically bounded false-positive rate. We augment this prior with prototype learning for known-attack attribution, second-order temporal analysis for cadence-based detection, self-learning pattern extraction, and a five-network fusion pipeline. Against an Adaptive Adversarial Agent (AAA)--a threat that learns survival strategies under defensive pressure, performs behavioral mimicry, and matches host event rates--our system achieves 93% detection at 3.84% onboarding false-positive rate. The strongest discriminative signal arises not from any single event but from the coefficient of variation of inter-event intervals: the AAA stepping cadence exhibits CV=0.310 versus 9.786 for benign sleep intervals, a 30x separation reflecting a fundamental stealth-functionality trade-off. We frame these findings within a coevolutionary economics model, arguing that behavior-grammar detection shifts the evasion cost from rule circumvention (cheap) to distribution matching (expensive), establishing a structural asymmetry favoring the defender.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Behavioral Grammar架构，将主机运行时行为视为结构化语言，使用仅0.88M参数的轻量Transformer（TinyGPT）学习行为语法。系统将每个系统事件离散化为8个token表示，通过自监督学习正常行为条件分布，基于逐槽位负对数似然统计计算异常分数。针对自适应对抗代理（AAA），系统实现93%检测率，误报率3.84%。关键发现是事件间间隔变异系数是最强判别信号（30倍差异），并将结果置于协同演化经济学框架中解释。
AI.motivation: 现有端点检测系统面临根本性困境：基于签名的方案容易被多态或自适应威胁规避，而重型深度学习模型难以审计且难以规模化部署。需要一种兼具轻量级、可审计性和高检测能力的检测架构。
AI.method: 将主机行为建模为结构化语言：每个系统事件离散化为8个token（事件类型、进程、参数骨架、路径类别、父进程、用户、目的地、事件间时序）。使用0.88M参数因果Transformer（TinyGPT）以纯自监督方式学习正常行为条件分布，异常分数由逐槽位NLL统计推导。在此基础上增强原型学习（已知攻击归因）、二阶时间分析（节奏检测）、自学习模式提取和五网络融合管道。
AI.result: 针对学习生存策略、行为模仿、匹配主机事件率的自适应对抗代理，系统达到93%检测率，3.84%上线误报率。最强判别信号来自事件间间隔变异系数：AAA步进节奏CV=0.310对比良性睡眠间隔CV=9.786，存在30倍分离。
AI.conclusion: 行为语法检测将规避成本从规则绕道（廉价）转变为分布匹配（昂贵），建立结构性不对称优势，有利于防御方。这种攻击者无法轻易规避的检测范式在协同演化视角下具有更持久的防御效能。

title: Opt.Gear Technical Report
summary: We introduce Opt.Gear, a foundation model designed for efficient on-device deployment, real-tim inference, and strong task capability. It includes a dense model (1M, 270M, and 1B) with a context length of 64K. We designed a new hybrid architecture that combines a convolutional key-value gated mixer with local-global attention to reduce the KV-cache memory that tends to increase exponentially with long context. This architecture delivers up to X4.9 faster prefill and decoding speeds on the NPUs compared to models of a similar scale models. From a 2T tokens candidate corpus, Opt.Gear is trained on a curated 0.5T tokens subset without knowledge distillation. This is the most data-efficient of the existing foundation models. All models are released with open weights and deployment binaries for ONNX, Qualcomm NPU, and Apple ANE making Opt.Gear a practical base for edge applications that need fast, memory-efficient inference and strong task capabilities. Furthermore, to expand the ecosystem of on-device generative language models, we are introducing the Opt.Gear-1M that can be deployed on Micro-Controller Units (MCUs), a Tiny Language Model (TLM). Opt.Gear-1M is the first generative language model to achieve 20 TPS with W4A32 quantization on the ARM Cortex-M7 CPU of the STM32H747I-DISCO.

AI.tldr: Opt.Gear是一个面向端侧部署的基础模型系列，包括1M、270M和1B三个规模（参数），支持64K上下文长度。采用卷积键值门控混合器与局部-全局注意力相结合的混合架构以降低KV缓存内存，在NPU上相比同规模模型实现最高4.9倍的预填充和解码加速。仅用精选的0.5T tokens子集（从2T候选语料中筛选）训练即可达到高效数据利用，全部模型开源权重并提供ONNX、Qualcomm NPU和Apple ANE的部署二进制。此外，Opt.Gear-1M作为微型语言模型（TLM）可在STM32H747I-DISCO开发板的ARM Cortex-M7 CPU上实现20 TPS（W4A32量化）。
AI.motivation: 端侧设备部署大语言模型面临推理速度慢、内存占用高（尤其是KV缓存随长上下文呈指数增长）以及数据训练效率低等挑战，现有模型难以在资源受限的边缘设备上实现快速、内存高效且能力强的推理。
AI.method: 设计了一种结合卷积键值门控混合器（convolutional key-value gated mixer）与局部-全局注意力（local-global attention）的混合架构，有效减少长上下文下的KV缓存内存开销；从2T tokens候选语料中精选0.5T tokens子集进行训练（不使用知识蒸馏），实现数据高效训练；提供多平台部署二进制（ONNX、Qualcomm NPU、Apple ANE）。
AI.result: 在NPU上相比同规模模型提升最高4.9倍的prefill和解码速度；Opt.Gear-1M成为首个在ARM Cortex-M7 CPU（STM32H747I-DISCO）上通过W4A32量化实现20 TPS推理速度的生成式语言模型。
AI.conclusion: Opt.Gear通过创新的混合架构和高效数据训练策略，在端侧推理速度、内存效率和任务能力之间取得了良好平衡，为MCU等极低资源环境下的生成式语言模型部署开辟了新路径，且全部开源有助于扩展端侧生成式语言模型生态。

title: Hybrid-Domain Posterior Sampling for Inverse Problems via Latent Flow Matching
summary: Latent Flow Models have revolutionized compressed-space image synthesis, yet their application to high-fidelity inverse problems remains bottlenecked. In this paper, we trace this dilemma to a fundamental geometric limitation of pre-trained autoencoders, which we term \emph{First-Order Manifold Blindness}. Severe decoder compression (e.g., retaining only $\sim\!2\%$ of the original degrees of freedom) produces a rank-deficient Jacobian, rendering high-frequency measurement residuals in its orthogonal complement invisible to latent gradients even when the decoder can represent the target image. To overcome this bottleneck, we propose Hybrid-Domain Posterior Sampling (HDPS), a decoupled inference framework that disentangles physical measurement consistency from semantic prior modeling. HDPS diverges into the pixel space, leveraging Langevin dynamics to absorb precise orthogonal measurement gradients, and subsequently projects these structural corrections back onto the generative manifold. An optimization-based latent alignment is introduced to filter pixel-space artifacts while avoiding the semantic drift of direct encoding. Extensive experiments on diverse inverse problems demonstrate that HDPS establishes a new state-of-the-art, successfully recovering the high-frequency structural precision that latent-only solvers inherently discard. The code is available at \href{https://github.com/74587887/HDPS}{https://github.com/74587887/HDPS}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出混合域后验采样（HDPS）框架，解决潜空间流模型在逆向问题中因自编码器秩亏Jacobian导致的高频信息丢失问题，通过像素空间Langevin动态与潜空间优化对齐相结合，实现了新的最优性能。
AI.motivation: 潜空间流模型虽在压缩空间图像合成中取得突破，但其在高保真逆向问题中的应用受到瓶颈。作者将这一困境追溯到预训练自编码器的几何局限——"一阶流形盲区"：严重解码器压缩（仅保留约2%自由度）产生秩亏Jacobian，使得正交补空间中的高频测量残差对潜空间梯度不可见，即使解码器本身能表示目标图像。
AI.method: 提出混合域后验采样（HDPS）解耦推理框架：将物理测量一致性与语义先验建模分离。首先在像素空间利用Langevin动态吸收精确的正交测量梯度，然后将这些结构修正投影回生成流形；引入基于优化的潜空间对齐以过滤像素空间伪影，同时避免直接编码带来的语义漂移。
AI.result: 在多种逆向问题上的大量实验表明，HDPS达到了新的最先进水平，成功恢复了潜空间求解器固有丢弃的高频结构精度。
AI.conclusion: HDPS通过解耦测量一致性与语义建模，有效克服了潜空间流形盲区问题，为高保真逆向问题求解提供了新的范式。

title: FinDeepIndicator: Benchmarking Deep Research Agents in End-to-End Financial Indicator Construction
summary: Financial indicators are essential tools for transforming raw financial data into interpretable measures for various downstream tasks, such as valuation, risk assessment, and economic analysis. However, existing financial benchmarks largely focus on answer-level accuracy and often assume that relevant data are already provided, leaving the assessment of the intermediate process of indicator construction underexplored. In this work, we propose FinDeepIndicator, the first benchmark dedicated to evaluating Deep Research (DR) agents in end-to-end financial indicator construction. Specifically, FinDeepIndicator evaluates DR agents across four stages in indicator construction: formula specification, data collection, indicator calculation, and answer generation, and covers fundamental, technical, and macroeconomic indicators organized into 21 fine-grained sub-categories. It contains 3,350 curated question-answer (QA) pairs derived from both U.S. and Chinese markets, 10 years of historical financial data, and 800 listed companies. Extensive experiments on search-equipped Large Language Models (LLMs) and DR agents show that, while LLMs generally perform well in formula specification, their accuracy drops substantially during data retrieval and numerical execution. DR agents consistently outperform search-equipped LLMs, yet remain unreliable in realistic financial analysis settings. These findings provide insights for developing more capable and trustworthy DR agents in finance.

AI.tldr: 提出了FinDeepIndicator，这是首个用于评估深度研究（DR）智能体在端到端金融指标构建任务上表现的基准，涵盖公式规范、数据收集、指标计算和答案生成四个阶段，包含3350个QA对及中美市场的10年历史数据。
AI.motivation: 现有金融基准主要关注答案级准确性，且假设相关数据已提前提供，忽略了指标构建这一中间过程的评估，这一空白亟需填补。
AI.method: 构建FinDeepIndicator基准，从公式规范、数据收集、指标计算和答案生成四个阶段评估DR智能体，覆盖基本面、技术面和宏观经济三类指标共21个细分子类，包含3350个问答对、中美两市场10年历史数据及800家上市公司数据，并对搜索增强的LLM和DR智能体进行对比实验。
AI.result: LLM在公式规范方面表现良好，但在数据检索和数值执行阶段准确性显著下降；DR智能体整体优于搜索增强的LLM，但在真实金融分析场景下仍不够可靠。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了金融指标构建中各阶段的能力差距，为开发更强大、更可信的金融领域DR智能体提供了重要洞察和方向。

title: DeBERTa-Sentinel: Toward Transparent and Trustworthy Detection of AI-Generated Text
summary: The rapid spread of large language models (LLMs) across the web raises concerns about misinformation, academic integrity, automated content manipulation, and risks to vulnerable online communities. Existing transformer-based detectors, such as GPT-Sentinel, show promise but struggle to generalize to diverse model outputs and paraphrasing attacks, limiting their role in building trustworthy web ecosystems. This work introduces DeBERTa-Sentinel, a responsible AI-generated text detection framework leveraging DeBERTa-v3's disentangled attention to capture subtle structural irregularities in synthetic content. A central design principle is transparency: unlike black-box commercial detectors, DeBERTa-Sentinel exposes token-level explanations of its decisions, enabling affected stakeholders journalists, educators, and platform trust and safety teams to audit, challenge, and contextualize detection outcomes. Using the GLC-AIText dataset of 28,057 human and LLM-generated samples (GPT, LLaMA, and Claude) with a 60-20-20 split, DeBERTa-Sentinel achieves 98.21\% validation accuracy and surpasses the RoBERTa-Sentinel baseline from NeurIPS 2025, achieving 97.53\% test accuracy, 95.89\% precision, 99.33\% recall, and 99.53\% ROC-AUC, and maintaining a 0.665\% false negative rate. The model's interpretability reveals linguistic markers such as academic phrasing and formal transitions associated with synthetic text, directly supporting stakeholder needs for verifiable, auditable content-authenticity decisions. By advancing responsible detection methods that reduce bias and enhance explainability, DeBERTa-Sentinel promotes trustworthy, ethical, and human-centric AI systems. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Galileo-Galili/HUMAN-VS-AI-TEXT-DETECTION.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeBERTa-Sentinel，一种基于DeBERTa-v3的可解释AI生成文本检测框架，在GLC-AIText数据集上达到97.53%测试准确率，并通过token级解释提升检测透明度。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型的广泛使用引发了对错误信息、学术诚信和内容操纵的担忧，现有检测器（如GPT-Sentinel）难以泛化到不同模型输出和改写攻击，且黑盒检测器缺乏可审计性和透明度。
AI.method: 利用DeBERTa-v3的解纠缠注意力机制捕捉合成内容的细微结构不规则性，并设计token级解释机制，使检测决策可审计、可挑战、可情境化。在包含28,057个样本的GLC-AIText数据集（GPT、LLaMA、Claude生成）上按60-20-20划分进行训练和评估。
AI.result: 验证准确率98.21%，测试准确率97.53%，精确率95.89%，召回率99.33%，ROC-AUC 99.53%，假阴性率0.665%，超越NeurIPS 2025的RoBERTa-Sentinel基线。
AI.conclusion: DeBERTa-Sentinel通过可解释的检测方法提升了AI生成文本检测的准确性和透明度，揭示了学术措辞和正式过渡等语言学标记，有助于构建值得信赖、可审计的内容真实性决策体系。

title: DiffuseAgent-MI: Distributionally-Grounded,Tool-Integrated Self-Evolving Agents for Faithful Visual Reasoning
comment: 11 pages, 9 figures, accepted by ICML 2026 manitrack
summary: Tool-integrated vision-language agents have made remarkable progress on compositional and multi-step visual reasoning. Yet their outputs frequently exhibit unfaithfulness: the stated reasoning path diverges from the computation that actually produced the answer, undermining reliability in safety-critical applications. We present DiffuseAgent-MI, a self-evolving agent whose perceptual grounding is governed by a KL-minimal energy model over feature units, providing a distributional view of visual mechanistic interpretability. The agent learns an energy landscape that softly constrains generated samples to lie near the native prior conditioned on the chosen interpretable unit, closing the gap between the explanation and the internal representation. A verifier then supplies trajectory-level faithfulness rewards, and a repair branch re-conditions the energy when the verifier flags an unfaithful step. On GeoQA, SciVis, VQA-v2 and an in-house multimodal reasoning set, DiffuseAgent-MI improves accuracy by up to 5.1 points over prior self-evolving agents while more than doubling mutual-information faithfulness and human-interpretability agreement. Our analysis shows the energy term and the verifier are complementary: the former guarantees distributional faithfulness, the latter trajectory-level faithfulness, and only their combination closes both gaps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DiffuseAgent-MI，一个自进化视觉语言智能体，通过KL最小能量模型约束感知基础，并使用验证器提供轨迹级忠实度奖励，在多个基准上提升准确率和忠实度。
AI.motivation: 工具集成的视觉语言智能体在组合式和多步视觉推理上取得显著进展，但其输出经常表现出不忠实性——陈述的推理路径与实际产生答案的计算过程相偏离，这在安全关键应用中会破坏可靠性。
AI.method: DiffuseAgent-MI通过学习一个能量景观来软性约束生成样本，使其接近以所选可解释单元为条件的原生先验，从而弥合解释与内部表示之间的差距。一个验证器提供轨迹级忠实度奖励，当验证器标记出不忠实步骤时，修复分支会重新调整能量条件。
AI.result: 在GeoQA、SciVis、VQA-v2和内部多模态推理数据集上，相比之前的自进化智能体，DiffuseAgent-MI的准确率最高提升5.1个百分点，同时互信息忠实度和人类可解释性一致性提升超过两倍。
AI.conclusion: 能量项和验证器是互补的：前者保证分布级忠实度，后者保证轨迹级忠实度，只有两者结合才能同时弥合两方面的差距。

title: Measurement Without Validity: The Compounding Reliability Problem in Agentic AI Evaluation
comment: 22 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to a peer-reviewed journal
summary:
Agentic AI systems are evaluated using automated benchmarks whose scores justify deployment decisions, safety certifications, and regulatory compliance claims. We present an empirical analysis demonstrating that these scores are systematically less trustworthy than current practice acknowledges.
  The problem operates at three compounding layers. First, tasks are increasingly generated by language models: audits of ten popular benchmarks found validity flaws in seven and reporting gaps in all ten. Second, human users are replaced by LLM simulators, but calibration studies document inter-simulator variance up to 9 percentage points and systematic directional miscalibration, particularly for non-Standard American English speakers. Third, our structured survey of 55 papers finds that approximately 82% apply structurally mismatched, incomplete, or absent inter-rater reliability (IRR) metrics.
  These failures compound multiplicatively rather than additively. Under independence, a pipeline retaining 70% of valid signal at task generation, 80% at simulation, and 65% at judgment is at most 36% valid against the intended construct; the bound spans 0.22--0.54 across the empirical estimate range. We formalize this as $V_{\text{total}} \leq V_1 \times V_2 \times V_3$ and show it tightens further under correlated failures when the same model family operates across all three layers.
  We derive eight prescriptions grounded in psychometric science: a simulation calibration floor of $\text{ICC}(A,1) \geq 0.70$; domain-stratified reliability thresholds ($α\geq 0.67$ / $0.70$ / $0.80$ by consequence level); structured IRR metric selection rules based on pipeline design; and IRR as a mandatory reporting field. The measurement tools exist; the field's task is to apply them.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实证分析揭示了智能体AI系统评估基准分数的系统性不可信问题，指出任务生成、人类模拟和判断评分三个环节存在叠加失效，并提出基于心理测量学的八项改进处方。
AI.motivation: 当前AI系统部署决策、安全认证和监管合规都依赖自动化基准评分，但这些分数的可信度缺乏系统检验。作者旨在揭示这些分数比当前实践所承认的更不可信。
AI.method: 三层分析方法：(1)审计十个流行基准的任务有效性；(2)校准研究LLM模拟器替代人类用户的偏差；(3)结构化调查55篇论文的IRR指标使用情况。并通过乘法模型 V_total ≤ V1×V2×V3 量化累积失效。
AI.result: 发现7/10基准存在效度缺陷，全部10个存在报告缺口；模拟器间方差高达9个百分点且存在方向性校准误差；约82%的论文使用不匹配、不完整或缺失的IRR指标。在独立假设下总有效性上限仅36%，相关失效下进一步收紧。
AI.conclusion: 提出八项基于心理测量学的处方，包括ICC(A,1)≥0.70的模拟校准下限、按后果等级分层的信度阈值（α≥0.67/0.70/0.80）、结构化IRR指标选择规则以及IRR作为强制报告字段。强调测量工具已存在，关键在于应用。

title: Attend to Your Own Thoughts: Breaking the Barrier for Post-Training Quantization of Reasoning LLMs through the Lens of 1.58-Bit Quantization
comment: This research work was completed and submitted for publication in early May 2026. The project page: https://github.com/IntelChina-AI/BitTern
summary: We propose ScaleQ-1.58, a scalable ternary post-training quantization (PTQ) framework for reasoning LLMs. Its core insight stems from an empirical finding: although modern LLMs are typically trained to exhibit chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities, in the PTQ regime, even the latest CAT-Q method based on learning-based differentiable ternarization still leads to performance collapse on challenging mathematics and coding tasks when using conventional calibration schemes that ignore the model's reasoning process. Driven by this finding, we introduce a simple calibration approach, Attend to Your Own Thoughts (AYOT), where reasoning traces and final answers generated by the pre-trained high-precision target LLM on a proper set of calibration samples are used as the context input during the ternarization process, along with the corresponding questions. ScaleQ-1.58 is formed by simply integrating AYOT with CAT-Q, which demonstrates several scaling properties: (1) with only 4M calibration tokens, Qwen3-1.7B ternarized by ScaleQ-1.58 reaches over 90.52% of the performance of the prior best BitNet b1.58 2B4T averaged over 4 mathematics and coding tasks, and our ternary Qwen3-4B shows an absolute gain of 8.97%, while requiring 1,000,000x fewer calibration tokens for quantization; (2) ScaleQ-1.58 generalizes well to both dense and MoE architectures, with performance improving as model scale increases (up to 235B parameters); (3) ScaleQ-1.58 demonstrates strong generalization across tasks of varying difficulty levels, including mathematics, coding and scientific logic reasoning, as well as commonsense reasoning and basic language generation; (4) its performance continues to improve as the number of calibration tokens increases. Notably, AYOT also exhibits strong generalization ability across other quantization bit-widths. Code will be available at https://github.com/IntelChina-AI/BitTern.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ScaleQ-1.58，一种面向推理型LLM的可扩展三元后训练量化框架。核心发现是现有量化方法忽略模型的推理链过程会导致数学和编程任务性能崩溃，为此提出"关注自身思维"（AYOT）校准方法，将预训练模型的推理轨迹和最终答案用作量化校准输入。仅需4M校准token即可在多个任务上超越BitNet b1.58 2B4T，且支持最高235B参数规模。
AI.motivation: 尽管现代LLM具备链式思维推理能力，但在后训练量化场景中，即使最新的基于学习可微三元化的CAT-Q方法，在忽略模型推理过程的传统校准方案下，在数学和编程任务上仍会出现性能崩溃。
AI.method: 提出AYOT校准方法：使用预训练高精度目标LLM在适量校准样本上生成的推理轨迹和最终答案作为三元化过程中的上下文输入。将AYOT与CAT-Q简单整合形成ScaleQ-1.58框架。
AI.result: （1）仅用4M校准token，Qwen3-1.7B在数学和编程任务上达到BitNet b1.58 2B4T的90.52%性能，Qwen3-4B获得8.97%绝对提升，校准token数量减少1,000,000倍；（2）对稠密和MoE架构均适用，模型规模最大至235B；（3）在数学、编程、科学逻辑推理、常识推理和语言生成等任务上表现良好；（4）性能随校准token数量增加而提升。AYOT在其他量化位宽下也有强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: ScaleQ-1.58通过利用推理轨迹作为校准输入，解决了推理型LLM在三元量化中的性能崩溃问题，实现了高效、可扩展且泛化能力强的后训练量化方案。

title: Zero-Cost Virtual RNA: Approximating Immunotherapy Signatures via Cross-Modal WSI Retrieval
comment: Accepted to MIDL 2026 Short Paper track
summary: Identifying the ``Inflamed'' immunophenotype in Gastric Adenocarcinoma predicts immunotherapy response but requires an expensive 10-gene RNA signature. While deep learning on standard H\&E slides offers a scalable alternative, conventional binary classifiers oversimplify continuous RNA data and introduce label noise. To resolve this, we propose VITA (VIrtual Transcriptomic Approximation). By aligning H\&E and RNA into a joint latent space during training, VITA requires only standard H\&E at inference to retrieve morphologically similar historical cases and approximate the continuous RNA signature. Achieving 0.72 classification accuracy and a 0.66 Spearman correlation, VITA provides a cost-effective ``virtual transcriptomics'' pre-screening tool that preserves the continuous phenotypic spectrum without requiring genomic sequencing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VITA方法，通过将H&E组织切片与RNA数据对齐到联合潜在空间，在推理时仅需标准H&E染色切片即可近似连续RNA签名，用于预测胃腺癌免疫治疗反应，实现了0.72分类准确率和0.66 Spearman相关性，提供了一种无需基因组测序的低成本"虚拟转录组学"预筛查工具。
AI.motivation: 识别胃腺癌中"炎症"免疫表型可预测免疫治疗反应，但传统的10基因RNA特征检测成本高昂。虽然基于H&E切片的深度学习是可行的替代方案，但传统的二分类器过度简化了连续的RNA数据并引入标签噪声，因此需要一种既能保持连续表型谱又能避免标签噪声问题的可扩展方法。
AI.method: VITA（VIrtual Transcriptomic Approximation）方法：在训练阶段将H&E组织切片与RNA数据对齐到联合潜在空间，推理时仅需标准H&E切片，通过检索形态学相似的历史病例来近似连续RNA签名，从而保留连续表型谱而不需要二值化标签。
AI.result: VITA在分类任务上达到0.72的准确率，在连续相关性上达到0.66的Spearman相关系数，展示了其在分类和连续近似两个维度上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: VITA提供了一种经济高效的"虚拟转录组学"预筛查工具，在不需要基因组测序的情况下保留连续的免疫表型谱，可作为免疫治疗反应预测的低成本解决方案。

title: AgentSLABench: Evaluating and Benchmarking Agentic Systems Under Resource Constraints
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. Code, sealed test sets, and profiling artifacts available at: https://github.com/MeherBhaskar/agentslabench
summary: We present AgentSLABench, a resource-aware evaluation framework for autonomous AI agents that measures correctness alongside latency, cost, compute, memory, and network usage under declared resource budgets. Unlike standard benchmarks that report only accuracy, AgentSLABench produces a multi-dimensional profile per agent per task - the same way systems profilers (perf, pprof, cProfile) measure resource consumption of code, but extended with task correctness as a first-class dimension. AgentSLABench provides 16 task environments across 6 categories (5 core: multi-hop QA, retail substitution, code generation, web shopping, travel planning; 11 extended) with isolated Docker containers, declared CPU/memory/time/network budgets, sealed test sets with SHA256 hashes, and a standardized profiling protocol. We profile 5 general-purpose baseline agents (ReAct, PlanAndSolve, Reflexion, CoT, Random) plus 4 task-specialized agents, finding that specialized agents achieve 100% success on 3/5 core tasks (fact_qa, web_shopping, travel_planning) and 66.7-83.3% on retail and code_gen, while general baselines fail entirely on 4/5 domain tasks. Crucially, we report the Efficiency-Adjusted Success Rate (EASR) - success weighted by resource consumption relative to declared budgets - revealing that high accuracy at unbounded cost is not production-viable. We release the full infrastructure, sealed test sets, and profiling results to enable reproducible, resource-aware agent evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgentSLABench，一个面向自主AI智能体的资源感知评估框架，不仅衡量正确性，还在声明的资源预算下衡量延迟、成本、计算、内存和网络使用情况。框架提供16个任务环境和隔离的Docker容器，并引入效率调整成功率（EASR）指标，揭示无约束成本下的高准确率在生产环境中不可行。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试仅报告准确率，忽略了智能体在实际生产环境中运行时的资源消耗（延迟、成本、计算、内存、网络），导致高准确率但无法在生产环境中落地的智能体无法被有效区分。
AI.method: 构建资源感知评估框架AgentSLABench，提供16个任务环境（6个类别），使用隔离Docker容器和声明的CPU/内存/时间/网络预算，采用SHA256哈希密封测试集，制定标准化性能分析协议，并提出EASR指标将成功率与资源消耗加权综合。
AI.result: 对5个通用基线智能体和4个任务专用智能体进行评测：专用智能体在3/5核心任务上达到100%成功率，在retail和code_gen上达到66.7%-83.3%，而通用基线的4/5领域任务完全失败。EASR指标揭示高准确率在无约束成本下不具备生产可行性。
AI.conclusion: AgentSLABench通过多维度资源感知评估，补充了传统仅关注准确率的基准测试的不足，为智能体评估提供了类似系统性能分析器（perf、pprof、cProfile）的一等公民维度，并开源全部基础设施以支持可复现的资源感知智能体评估。

title: Morphology Aware Reversible Semantic Tokenization and Hierarchical Word Composition for Tamil Language Models
summary:
Statistical subword tokenizers can process arbitrary text, but their units need not align with lexical or grammatical structure. This is especially important for Tamil, where a written word may encode stem changes, case, number, tense, agreement, voice, clitics, and linked verbs. We present a Tamil morphology system extending the open-source ThamizhiMorph analyzer and generator, together with a byte-exact semantic tokenizer and a learned hierarchical word composer. Twelve finite-state transducers analyze words into lemmas and grammatical features, while character and byte fallbacks preserve exact reconstruction.
  We compare a flat morphology tokenizer, a signal-preserving word composer, and tokenizers based on Sarvam-1, AI4Bharat IndicBERTv2, and BrahmicTokenizer-131K. All systems use the same 69,591 Tamil-English training pairs, 18.97-million-parameter encoder-decoder, 40,000 updates, target tokenizer, optimizer, positional method, and generation settings.
  On a protected 3,539-row IN22 and FLORES+ evaluation, morphology-flat achieves the best pooled scores: 10.63 BLEU, 35.26 chrF++, and 0.6276 COMETKiwi. Relative to AI4Bharat, the strongest external-tokenizer baseline, these are improvements of 7.2%, 3.2%, and 2.6%. The word composer scores 10.30, 34.88, and 0.6241, improving on AI4Bharat by 3.8%, 2.1%, and 2.0%.
  The composer reduces mean global source states from 71.48 to 29.08, a 59.3% reduction, and is estimated to require 9-21% fewer inference FLOPs depending on decoder caching. Its remaining quality gap is concentrated in longer FLORES+ sentences. These results show that explicit Tamil morphology improves translation under a fixed small-model budget, while hierarchical composition substantially reduces sequence length and estimated inference cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种扩展的泰米尔语词法分析系统（基于ThamizhiMorph），结合字节精确的语义分词器和分层词合成器，用于泰米尔语-英语机器翻译。在固定小模型预算下，形态学平面分词器在IN22和FLORES+评测中取得最佳成绩（BLEU 10.63, chrF++ 35.26, COMETKiwi 0.6276），相对最强外部分词基线AI4Bharat分别提升7.2%、3.2%和2.6%；词合成器则大幅降低序列长度（减少59.3%全局源状态）和推理FLOPs（9-21%），代价是少量质量损失。
AI.motivation: 统计子词分词器可处理任意文本，但其分词单元未必与词汇或语法结构对齐。泰米尔语书面词可编码词干变化、格、数、时态、一致关系、语态、附着词和连接动词，因此需要显式的词法分析来提升机器翻译质量。
AI.method: 扩展开源ThamizhiMorph分析器和生成器，构建泰米尔语词法系统，包含：(1) 十二个有限状态转换器将词分析为词元和语法特征；(2) 字节精确的语义分词器；(3) 学习的分层词合成器。字符和字节回退机制保证精确重建。比较了平面形态分词器、信号保持词合成器、Sarvam-1、AI4Bharat IndicBERTv2和BrahmicTokenizer-131K等方案，所有系统使用相同的69,591对泰米尔语-英语训练数据、18.97百万参数编码器-解码器、40,000次更新等设置。
AI.result: 在受保护的3,539行IN22和FLORES+评测集上，形态学平面分词器取得最佳总分数：10.63 BLEU、35.26 chrF++、0.6276 COMETKiwi，相对AI4Bharat提升7.2%、3.2%、2.6%。词合成器得分为10.30、34.88、0.6241，提升3.8%、2.1%、2.0%；同时将全局源状态从71.48降至29.08（减少59.3%），估计减少9-21%推理FLOPs。质量差距主要集中在较长FLORES+句子上。
AI.conclusion: 显式泰米尔语词法分析在固定小模型预算下能有效提升机器翻译质量，而分层词合成能显著降低序列长度和推理成本，是一对有价值的互补方案。

title: DrawAI: Agentic Benchmark and Workflow for Making Raster Images Editable
summary: Recent image-generation models and multimodal agents can produce high-quality visuals for increasingly complex visual communication tasks.
