Yet their raster outputs remain difficult to use directly because meaningful content and relationships are flattened into pixels, preventing users from inspecting, modifying, rearranging, or reusing individual components. We formulate image-to-editable reconstruction, which recovers a structured, directly manipulable artifact from a raster image while preserving its visual and semantic content. The central challenge is to jointly satisfy Fidelity and Editability, which often trade off in practice. To study this task, we introduce DrawAI, comprising an agentic benchmark, DrawAI-Bench, and a reconstruction workflow, DrawAI-Flow. DrawAI-Bench spans scientific figures, presentation slides, posters, and diagrams, combining real and AI-generated images to reflect practical visual-creation scenarios. It evaluates Fidelity and Editability through a hybrid protocol of 39 criteria: deterministic rule-based metrics measure properties with direct correspondences, while asset-specific vision-language rubrics capture semantic and perceptual qualities for which exact matching is misleading. Besides, we propose DrawAI-Flow, a two-stage agentic workflow in which a Parser Agent turns extracted elements evidence into an explicit reconstruction plan, and a Reconstruction Agent realizes the plan as executable graphics code through an iterative code-render-validate-revise loop. On DrawAI-Bench, we systematically evaluate thirteen models across five agent harnesses to study the effects of model capability, harness choice, and workflow design. The results show that reconstruction quality and costs vary substantially across model-harness configurations, while DrawAI-Flow consistently improves editable structure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出图像到可编辑重建（image-to-editable reconstruction）任务，并引入DrawAI框架，包含基准测试DrawAI-Bench和代理工作流DrawAI-Flow，用于从栅格图像恢复结构化、可操作的人工制品，同时兼顾保真度和可编辑性。
AI.motivation: 现有图像生成模型和多模态代理能生成高质量的视觉效果，但其栅格输出难以直接使用，因为内容被扁平化为像素，用户无法检查、修改、重排或复用单个组件。
AI.method: 提出DrawAI-Flow，一个两阶段代理工作流：解析代理（Parser Agent）将提取的元素证据转化为明确的重建计划，重建代理（Reconstruction Agent）通过迭代的代码-渲染-验证-修改循环实现为可执行的图形代码。同时构建DrawAI-Bench，包含真实和AI生成图像，采用混合评估协议，涵盖39项标准，包括确定性基于规则度量和基于视觉-语言评分标准。
AI.result: 在DrawAI-Bench上系统评估了13个模型和5种代理框架，结果表明重建质量和成本在不同模型-框架配置间差异显著，而DrawAI-Flow持续改善可编辑结构。
AI.conclusion: 图像到可编辑重建是一个具有挑战性的任务，保真度和可编辑性往往相互权衡；两阶段代理工作流能有效改善可编辑性，但重建质量高度依赖模型-框架的配置选择。

title: Test-Time Curriculum for Open-Set AIGC Detection
summary: AI-generated image detectors deployed in open-world environments inevitably face distribution shifts as new and stronger generative models continue to emerge. Although existing methods improve cross-generator generalization through better representations or training data construction, they typically follow a static train-once-and-deploy paradigm and cannot adapt after deployment. In this work, we study open-set AIGC image detection from a test-time adaptation perspective. We propose Test-Time Curriculum (TTC), a simple and model-agnostic framework that adapts a detector on unlabeled test data through curriculum-based self-training. TTC starts from highly reliable pseudo-labeled samples and progressively incorporates harder yet informative cases, while enforcing class-balanced selection to reduce biased updates under generator shift. To further improve pseudo-label quality, we introduce Cross-Scale Pseudo-Label Refinement, which aggregates complementary evidence across multiple resolutions for more reliable adaptation, and applies noisy-or fusion at inference to strengthen final predictions. In addition, we construct AIGCGuard, a new benchmark containing 3,100 representative real images and 124,000 generated images from 40 of the most advanced open-source and proprietary text-to-image models. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks show that TTC substantially improves overall detection performance under diverse unseen-generator shifts, establishing a practical and effective test-time adaptation framework for open-set generated image detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TTC（Test-Time Curriculum）框架，一种模型无关的测试时自适应方法，用于应对AI生成图像检测器在开放世界环境中面临的生成器分布偏移问题，同时构建了包含40个先进文生图模型、12.4万张生成图像的新基准AIGCGuard。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测器在部署后无法适应不断涌现的新型生成模型所带来的分布偏移，因为它们遵循静态的"一次性训练-部署"范式，缺乏部署后的自适应能力。
AI.method: 提出TTC框架，通过基于课程学习的自训练在未标注测试数据上自适应检测器：从高置信度伪标签样本开始，逐步纳入更难但有信息量的样本，并强制执行类别平衡选择以减少生成器偏移下的偏差更新；引入跨尺度伪标签细化（Cross-Scale Pseudo-Label Refinement）聚合多分辨率证据以提高伪标签质量，推理时采用噪声或融合增强预测。
AI.result: 在五个基准上的大量实验表明，TTC在多种未见生成器偏移下显著提升了整体检测性能，建立了实用的测试时自适应检测框架。
AI.conclusion: TTC证明了测试时自适应对于开放集AI生成图像检测的有效性，为应对动态演化的生成模型环境提供了一种实用的解决方案。

title: The Scaling Paradox in Human-AI Collaboration
summary: The discovery of scaling laws has highlighted the extraordinary potential of AI systems with a striking empirical pattern: as AI systems scale, their capabilities tend to improve predictably. Yet, in real-world applications, AI rarely operates in isolation; instead, it often works alongside humans, raising the question of whether these gains persist in human-AI collaboration. In this work, we develop an analytical model to examine when the empirical scaling benefits of AI translate into improved human-AI joint system performance. We demonstrate that the performance of a human-AI system can scale positively as the AI scales up-provided that humans have an accurate perception of the AI's capabilities. Human misperception, however, can fundamentally alter this relationship: i) when humans over-perceive the AI's capabilities, a scaling paradox may arise, in which greater AI scale reduces overall system performance and amplifies firm-level profit losses, and (ii) when humans under-perceive the AI's capabilities, performance still improves with scale but at a substantially slower rate. We further show that firms can actively manage these distortions through operational policies such as cost internalization and perception alignment, whose effectiveness depends on the economics of AI deployment and the direction of human misperception. These findings suggest that organizations may benefit more from managing the human-AI interface than from simply investing in larger, more expensive AI systems. More broadly, our results suggest that AI scaling should be viewed not only as a technological challenge, but also as a behavioral and operational one, and caution against the view that larger AI systems will automatically lead to better operational outcomes. Whether AI scaling creates value ultimately depends on how increased AI capabilities shape human beliefs and collaborative efforts.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析模型研究AI规模扩展对人机协同系统性能的影响，发现人类对AI能力的准确感知是AI规模化收益转化为协同绩效的关键条件，而人类的过度或不足感知会分别导致"规模化悖论"或性能提升放缓。
AI.motivation: 现实中AI很少孤立运行，而是与人类协作。尽管规模化定律表明AI能力随规模提升而可预测地增长，但需要探究这些收益在人机协同中能否持续存在。
AI.method: 构建分析模型，研究AI规模扩展如何影响人机协同系统的整体性能，并考察人类对AI能力的感知偏差（过度感知与不足感知）对规模化收益的调节作用。
AI.result: 研究发现：人类准确感知AI能力时，人机协作性能可随AI规模正向扩展；人类过度感知AI能力时会出现"规模化悖论"（规模越大、整体性能越差、企业利润损失越大）；人类不足感知时性能仍提升但增速显著放缓。此外，企业可通过成本内部化与感知对齐等运营政策管理这些偏差。
AI.conclusion: 组织从管理人机交互界面中获得的收益可能超过单纯投资更大、更昂贵的AI系统。AI规模化不仅是技术挑战，也是行为与运营挑战，不能想当然地认为更大的AI系统会自动带来更好的运营结果。

title: Beyond Token-Level Cross-Entropy: Fréchet Distributional Post-Training for Autoregressive Image Generation
summary: Autoregressive image generators are commonly pretrained with token-level cross-entropy under teacher forcing, yet evaluated by the distributional quality of decoded images. This creates an objective mismatch, because categorical errors have unequal image-level consequences, and a context mismatch, because inference conditions on model-generated histories. We introduce FD-loss post-training, which adapts a pretrained discrete generator using representation-space Fréchet distance as the sole objective. A dual-pass scheme first constructs detached rollout contexts through gradient-free generation under the model's native inference configuration, then performs differentiable replay with a probability-level straight-through estimator (STE) that preserves hard argmax decoding in the forward pass while propagating image-level gradients through temperature-scaled probabilities. Only the generator is updated, while the tokenizer and feature extractors remain frozen. Across eight completed configurations from four generator families on class-conditional ImageNet at $256\times256$, FD-loss post-training reduces FID and $\mathrm{FD}_{r6}$ by 41.4% and 52.0% on average. The strongest FID result improves from 2.42 to 1.43 without adding parameters or inference steps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FD-loss后训练方法，通过表示空间中的Fréchet距离作为唯一目标，对预训练的自回归图像生成器进行适配，解决了训练目标和评估指标不一致的问题。在ImageNet 256×256上，FD-loss后训练平均将FID降低41.4%，FDr6降低52.0%，最佳FID从2.42提升至1.43，且不增加参数或推理步骤。
AI.motivation: 自回归图像生成器在预训练时使用token级的交叉熵损失（teacher forcing），但评估时关注的是解码图像的分布质量。这存在两个层面的不匹配：一是目标不匹配（分类错误对图像质量的影响不均等），二是上下文不匹配（推理时依赖模型自身生成的历史而非真实token序列）。
AI.method: 提出FD-loss后训练框架：1) 采用双通道方案，先通过无梯度的原生推理配置生成离线的rollout上下文（detached rollout contexts）；2) 再进行可微重放，使用概率级直通估计器（STE），在前向传播中保留硬argmax解码，同时通过温度缩放的softmax概率传播图像级梯度；3) 仅更新生成器参数，tokenizer和特征提取器保持冻结；4) 以表示空间的Fréchet距离作为唯一优化目标。
AI.result: 在四个生成器家族的八个配置上（类条件ImageNet 256×256），FD-loss后训练平均降低FID 41.4%和FDr6 52.0%。最佳FID从2.42提升到1.43，且不增加参数或推理步骤。
AI.conclusion: 通过直接优化与评估指标一致的图像级分布距离，FD-loss后训练有效弥合了自回归图像生成器中预训练目标与评估目标之间的差距，显著提升生成质量且无需引入额外模型容量或推理开销。

title: Isotropy Cliffs: The Geometric Signature of Decision-Making in Large Language Models
summary: We investigate the geometry of decision-making in Multiple Choice Question Answering (MCQA) through the lens of isotropy. Analyzing five open-weight models across diverse datasets, we identify decision-critical transition layers characterized by a shift in isotropy, coinciding with a major representational change and the emergence of task-relevant clusters. We demonstrate that this synchronized geometric behavior is strongly correlated with downstream accuracy ($r\approx0.84$), displaying its relevance for successful decision-making. Furthermore, we show that this transition is robust to prompt variations, suggesting that it reflects a general mechanism of model behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文通过各向同性（isotropy）的视角研究多选题问答（MCQA）中的决策几何特征，发现模型存在决策关键过渡层，该层与各向同性转变、表征变化和任务相关聚类出现同步发生，且与下游准确率高度相关（r≈0.84），并对提示变化具有稳健性。
AI.motivation: 理解大语言模型在MCQA任务中如何进行内部决策，揭示模型决策过程的几何机制，为可解释性和模型分析提供新的视角。
AI.method: 分析五个开放权重模型在多个数据集上的各向同性度量，识别决策关键的过渡层，检测各向同性转变、表征变化和任务聚类之间的同步性，并进行提示扰动实验验证稳健性。
AI.result: 发现了与决策相关的过渡层，该层各向同性发生显著转变，同时伴随表征变化和任务相关聚类出现；这种同步几何行为与下游准确率强相关（r≈0.84），且对提示变化具有稳健性。
AI.conclusion: MCQA决策中存在一个通用的几何过渡层机制，反映了模型从通用表征到任务特定决策的内在转变过程，这为理解LLM内部决策机制提供了新的几何学解释框架。

title: When Words Divide: Diachronic Ideological Polarization in Political Discourse on Social Media
summary: Political polarization has become a defining feature of online discourse, yet its long-term evolution remains poorly understood. We present a longitudinal analysis of ideological polarization in Reddit discussions by measuring semantic differences in the language used by opposing political communities. We construct temporally aligned community-specific word embeddings and quantify ideological polarization as the semantic divergence of political concepts over time. Our analysis shows that ideological polarization has increased substantially during the study period, both at the concept- and topic-level. Unlike prior computational work, which has largely focused on cross-sectional analyses or affective dimensions of polarization at a single point at time, our approach captures the evolution of ideological differences in semantic framing. The proposed framework provides a scalable method for studying the temporal dynamics of ideological polarization in large-scale social media discourse.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建时间对齐的社区特定词嵌入，对Reddit讨论中的意识形态极化进行纵向分析，测量对立政治社区语言的语义分歧，揭示了研究期间意识形态极化在概念和话题层面均显著加剧。
AI.motivation: 政治极化已成为在线话语的显著特征，但其长期演化仍未被充分理解。现有计算研究多聚焦于横截面分析或单一时间点的情感维度，缺乏对意识形态极化时间动态的捕捉。
AI.method: 构建时间对齐的社区特定词嵌入，将意识形态极化量化为政治概念随时间的语义分歧，实现概念层面和话题层面的极化度量。
AI.result: 研究发现研究期间意识形态极化在概念层面和话题层面均显著增加。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一种可扩展的方法，用于研究大规模社交媒体话语中意识形态极化的时间动态。

title: Relax Within, Balance Across: Geometry-Guided Load Balancing for Vision-Language Mixture-of-Experts
comment: 22 pages, including appendices. Code available at https://github.com/ZiangWu-77/ReBA
summary: Vision-language MoE batches contain different numbers of image and text tokens. Image resolution, image count, tiling, and prompt length all change this token mix. We call the standard token-level Switch auxiliary loss Std-Aux. Std-Aux balances only the mixed load, so large image and text load errors can cancel at one mix. On our main model, the same trained router shows more than a fivefold change in load imbalance across image resolutions. We hold the image and text load profiles fixed and derive the exact load curve as the token mix varies. The image-text load gap controls sensitivity to the token mix. Physical preprocessing can also change the conditional profiles. The fixed-profile law excludes such changes. To design a remedy, we examine the router input structure. Image and text occupy distinct regions, while visual tokens group strongly by source image. The modality boundary motivates separate image and text terms. The image boundary motivates one equal-weight routing instance per image. ReBA, or Relax Within, Balance Across, implements both choices. Across four split backbones, ReBA lowers load on every reported benchmark input while keeping mean task accuracy comparable to Std-Aux. ReBA also lowers average load over the tested range and worst physical load under resolution and tiling shifts. Code is available at https://github.com/ZiangWu-77/ReBA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReBA（Relax Within, Balance Across）方法，针对视觉-语言MoE模型中图像与文本token混合导致的负载不平衡问题，通过按模态分别平衡并逐图像分配路由权重，显著降低负载而不损失任务精度。
AI.motivation: 标准token级Switch辅助损失（Std-Aux）只能平衡混合负载，图像与文本的负载误差可能在特定token混合下相互抵消，导致同一路由器在不同图像分辨率下负载不平衡变化超过五倍，需要设计更鲁棒的负载均衡方案。
AI.method: 首先固定图像和文本负载分布推导出精确负载曲线，证明图像-文本负载差距控制对token混合的敏感性。基于路由器输入结构观察（图像与文本占据不同区域，视觉token按来源图像强分组），提出ReBA：按模态分离图像与文本的平衡项（Balance Across），并在每个图像内部采用等权重的路由实例（Relax Within）。
AI.result: 在四个不同结构的backbone上，ReBA在保持与Std-Aux相当的平均任务精度的同时，在所有报告的基准输入上降低了负载；同时在测试的混合比例范围内降低平均负载，并在分辨率和平铺变化下降低最坏物理负载。
AI.conclusion: ReBA通过在模态边界和图像边界上分别设计平衡策略，有效解决了视觉-语言MoE模型中token混合变化引起的负载不平衡问题，且不牺牲模型性能，代码已开源。

title: ShiJianBench: From Dialogue to Decision for Long-Horizon Evaluation of Investment Advisors
summary: Conversational investment advisors influence not only what users know, but also how they make subsequent decisions as market conditions evolve. Existing evaluations primarily assess response quality or observed outcomes, leaving the long-horizon pathway from advisor language to investor behavior difficult to audit. We introduce ShiJianBench, an offline framework for evaluating conversational investment advisors through matched investor trajectories under fixed historical market feedback. At its core is a multi-agent investor simulator with explicit evolving state variables, motive-driven deliberation, long-term memory, and dialogue-grounded updates. The simulator is calibrated against aggregate behavioral patterns from 7,199 real users, and advisor policies are evaluated using separate investor-side, service-side, and content-side metrics under a hard compliance gate. Experiments on Chinese fund-market traces from 2021 to 2026 identify a stable leading group of LLM advisors that combines substantially stronger personalized content with competitive investor-side trajectory outcomes. These results reveal a systematic distinction between producing a high-quality response and delivering an effective long-horizon intervention, motivating trajectory-aware evaluation of conversational advisors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ShiJianBench，一个基于离线框架的对话式投资顾问评估基准，通过多智能体投资者模拟器匹配固定历史市场反馈下的投资者轨迹，从投资者端、服务端和内容端三个维度评估顾问策略，并在2021至2026年中国基金市场数据上识别出兼具个性化内容和竞争性轨迹结果的领先LLM顾问群体。
AI.motivation: 现有对话式投资顾问评估主要考察响应质量或观察到的结果，难以审计从顾问语言到投资者行为的长期影响路径，缺乏统一框架来评估顾问对投资者长期决策轨迹的影响。
AI.method: 构建ShiJianBench离线评估框架，核心是包含显式演化状态变量、动机驱动推理、长期记忆和对话接地更新的多智能体投资者模拟器，基于7,199名真实用户校准；在硬合规门控下，使用投资者端、服务端和内容端三种指标评估顾问策略。
AI.result: 在中国2021至2026年基金市场数据上的实验识别出一组稳定的领先LLM顾问群体，这些顾问将显著更强的个性化内容与有竞争力的投资者端轨迹结果相结合，揭示了高质量响应与有效长期干预之间的系统性差异。
AI.conclusion: ShiJianBench揭示产生高质量响应与实施有效的长期干预之间存在系统性区别，为对话式顾问的轨迹感知评估提供了新的方法论支撑，推动该领域向长期影响可审计的方向发展。

title: Assuming You Knew: Fixing an Epistemic Semantics for Flow Policies Using Agentic AI
summary: Many high-level security requirements are about the allowed flow of information in programs and are difficult to make precise because they involve selective downgrading. Notions from epistemic logic have emerged as a good approach to policy semantics but a robust general framework remains elusive. A paper appearing in CSF 2018, entitled ``Assuming You Know: Epistemic Semantics of Relational Annotations for Expressive Flow Policies'', attempted to provide a unifying framework---but the formalization was sketchy and a correction was announced during the conference presentation. With aid from an agentic AI coding assistant, a corrected formalization has been machine checked in the Rocq proof assistant. The simplicity and generality of the framework may help compare different policy specification styles and enforce them by leveraging existing techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文针对CSF 2018论文《Assuming You Know》中关系注解的认知语义形式化框架存在缺陷的问题，借助智能体AI编码助手，在Rocq证明助手中完成了修正后的形式化机器验证，为表达性流策略提供了一个简洁通用的语义框架。
AI.motivation: 高层安全需求涉及程序中信息流的允许路径，且因涉及选择性降级而难以精确表达。认知逻辑为策略语义提供了良好方法，但缺乏稳健的通用框架。CSF 2018的论文虽尝试提供统一框架，但形式化不够严谨，且在会议报告时已宣布需要修正，因此需要对框架进行修正并通过机器验证确保正确性。
AI.method: 该方法以认知逻辑为基础，对关系注解（relational annotations）的语义进行精确形式化定义，借助智能体AI编码助手辅助形式化工作，并在Rocq证明助手中对修正后的定义和定理进行机器验证，确保框架的正确性和一致性。
AI.result: 修正后的形式化框架已通过Rocq证明助手的机器检查验证，证明了该框架的简洁性和通用性，并展示了其可用于比较不同策略规范风格以及借助现有技术进行策略执行的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作成功修正并验证了认知语义框架，为表达性流策略提供了严格可靠的形式化基础，有助于统一不同策略规范风格的比较与实施，体现了AI辅助工具在形式化验证中的实际价值。

title: Evaluating VLMs on Multimodal Aristotelian Persuasion Tasks
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated exceptional performance across various tasks. However, they have not yet been thoroughly evaluated on more complex tasks. The Persuasion Model, conceived by Aristotle, resembles a triangle shape, which highlights its inherent challenges related to personal biases. To assess the progress of VLMs on these complex tasks, we use the ImageArg datasets, focusing on the Logos, Ethos, and Pathos detection tasks. Our findings indicate that models from the Qwen family achieve improved F1 scores, with Qwen3 performing exceptionally well on the Logos and Pathos tasks, while Qwen2 exhibits competitive performance on the more complex Ethos detection task. We release the code to foster research in this direction.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了视觉语言模型（VLMs）在亚里士多德说服模型（Logos、Ethos、Pathos）检测任务上的表现，发现Qwen系列模型在ImageArg数据集上表现最佳，其中Qwen3在Logos和Pathos任务上表现突出，Qwen2在更复杂的Ethos任务上具有竞争力。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在简单任务上表现出色，但在更复杂的任务上尚未被充分评估。亚里士多德的说服模型（形状类似三角形）涉及个人偏见等固有挑战，需要系统评估VLMs在此类复杂任务上的进展。
AI.method: 使用ImageArg数据集，针对Logos（逻辑诉求）、Ethos（道德/信誉诉求）和Pathos（情感诉求）三个检测任务，对多个视觉语言模型进行系统评估，特别关注Qwen系列模型的表现。
AI.result: Qwen系列模型在F1分数上表现更优，其中Qwen3在Logos和Pathos检测任务上表现卓越，Qwen2在更具挑战性的Ethos检测任务上展现出竞争性表现。
AI.conclusion: 不同VLM模型在处理不同类型说服任务时各有优势，Qwen系列整体表现最佳。作者公开了代码以促进该方向的研究发展。

title: Neuro-Evolved Heuristics for Variable Gapped Common Subsequence Identification
summary:
This study addresses the Variable Gapped Longest Common Subsequence Problem (VGLCSP), a variant of the classical longest common subsequence problem with additional gap constraints and applications in sequence alignment and time-series analysis. While the two-sequence version has been widely studied using dynamic programming, the generalized multi-sequence form is usually solved with beam search-based heuristics, whose hand-crafted designs often lack robustness.
  To overcome this limitation, we propose a learning-based approach for automatically designing more effective data-driven heuristics. The heuristics are represented by a neural network with predefined architecture, whose weights are optimized by a genetic algorithm within a neuro-evolutionary framework. The learning process alternates between weight optimization and evaluation within an iterative multi-source beam search procedure, a state-of-the-art method for the problem. Rather than constructing solutions directly, the neural network learns to guide the search process, producing a neuro-evolved heuristic. We further introduce an ensemble heuristic that combines the scores of learned and the best-performing hand-crafted heuristic. Integrated into the iterative multi-source beam search framework, the resulting hybrid approach outperforms existing methods on both synthetic benchmark instances and newly introduced real-world instances with data-driven gap constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文针对可变间隙最长公共子序列问题（VGLCSP）的多序列形式，提出了一种基于学习的神经演化启发式方法。通过遗传算法优化神经网络权重，在迭代多源束搜索框架中引导搜索过程，并引入集成启发式结合学习型与手工设计的启发式，在合成和真实数据集上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 多序列VGLCSP通常使用基于束搜索的手工设计启发式来解决，但这些手工设计的启发式缺乏鲁棒性，难以适应不同数据分布，因此需要一种能够自动学习更有效数据驱动启发式的方法。
AI.method: 提出一个神经演化框架：使用预定义架构的神经网络表示启发式，通过遗传算法优化其权重；学习过程在权重优化与迭代多源束搜索评估之间交替进行；神经网络不直接构造解，而是学习引导搜索过程；此外引入集成启发式，结合学习到的启发式与最佳手工启发式的得分。
AI.result: 将混合方法集成到迭代多源束搜索框架中，在合成基准实例和新引入的具有数据驱动间隙约束的真实世界实例上均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 神经演化方法能够自动设计出比手工启发式更鲁棒、更有效的搜索引导策略，并且通过集成方式可以进一步融合两类启发式的优势，为VGLCSP提供了一种更优的求解方案。

title: DeltaFlow: Noise-Adaptive Bidirectional Gated Delta Networks for Embedded Language Flows
summary: Embedded Language Flows (ELF) rely primarily on full non-causal attention for iterative denoising, repeatedly incurring quadratic sequence-mixing cost at each sampling step. Gated Delta Networks (GDNs) provide an efficient recurrent alternative, but their standard causal formulation cannot directly capture the bidirectional context required by ELF. We introduce DeltaFlow, a noise-adaptive bidirectional GDN backbone for continuous language denoising. We study two variants: DeltaFlow-A, which alternates scan directions across layers, and DeltaFlow-P, which performs parallel forward and backward scans within each layer. We further introduce noise-adaptive memory control and scheduled Temporal State Consistency (TSC) to stabilize hidden representations across nearby noise levels. On OpenWebText, using a 32-step stochastic differential equation sampler, DeltaFlow-P reduces generated perplexity from 24.218 for the full-attention ELF baseline to 21.228 while maintaining comparable unigram entropy, with 36B training-token exposure compared with 45B for the baseline. In a denoiser-only benchmark, DeltaFlow-P achieves a 2.72x throughput speedup over the full-attention baseline at a sequence length of 16k. These results show that DeltaFlow is a promising alternative to dense attention for efficient continuous language denoising.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeltaFlow，一种基于双向Gated Delta Networks（GDN）的噪声自适应骨干网络，用于连续语言去噪。通过交替或并行双向扫描替代全非因果注意力，配合噪声自适应记忆控制和调度时序状态一致性（TSC），在OpenWebText上以更少的训练数据取得更低的困惑度，并在16k序列长度下实现2.72倍吞吐量加速。
AI.motivation: 嵌入式语言流（ELF）依赖全非因果注意力进行迭代去噪，每一步采样都产生二次方的序列混合计算成本。虽然Gated Delta Networks（GDN）提供了高效的循环替代方案，但其标准因果公式无法直接捕获ELF所需的双向上下文信息。
AI.method: 提出DeltaFlow，包含两个变体：DeltaFlow-A在层间交替扫描方向，DeltaFlow-P在每层内并行执行前向和后向扫描。此外引入噪声自适应记忆控制以及调度时序状态一致性（TSC）来稳定邻近噪声水平下的隐藏表示。
AI.result: 在OpenWebText上使用32步SDE采样器，DeltaFlow-P将生成困惑度从全注意力ELF基线的24.218降至21.228，同时保持可比的单字熵，训练token暴露为36B（基线为45B）。在仅去噪器基准测试中，DeltaFlow-P在16k序列长度下相比全注意力基线实现2.72倍吞吐量加速。
AI.conclusion: DeltaFlow是密集注意力在高效连续语言去噪中的有前景的替代方案，在降低计算成本的同时提升了生成质量。

title: InstancePin: Instance-Addressable Layout-to-Image Diffusion via Coordinate Pinning
summary: Layout-to-image diffusion models have achieved impressive semantic controllability by conditioning generation on category-level segmentation maps. However, such category-aligned control is not necessarily instance-addressable: multiple nearby objects from the same category are often treated as a shared semantic region, leading to ambiguous boundaries, averaged appearances, and feature confusion among instances. This limitation is particularly evident in urban scene synthesis, where small and crowded pedestrians or vehicles require fine-grained instance separation while preserving global scene consistency. In this paper, we propose InstancePin, an instance-addressable layout-to-image diffusion framework that pins each object instance with an explicit coordinate anchor. Instead of directly injecting instance masks into the pretrained backbone, InstancePin introduces an independent instance-aware adapter to preserve the category-level generation prior while learning instance-specific spatial control. For each instance, its center coordinate is encoded with Fourier features and projected into a coordinate token, which serves as a spatial anchor queried by latent image features through coordinate pinning attention. To make these anchors spatially meaningful, we further supervise the coordinate attention maps with instance regions, encouraging each coordinate token to activate its corresponding object area. Finally, an instance-mask guided fusion module routes pretrained backbone features to non-instance regions and adapter features to instance regions, enabling local instance refinement without sacrificing global semantic fidelity. Extensive experiments on Cityscapes demonstrate that InstancePin mitigates instance entanglement in dense layouts and improves both image fidelity and semantic consistency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InstancePin，一个实例可寻址的布局到图像扩散框架，通过为每个对象实例分配显式坐标锚点来解决同类密集物体间的实例纠缠问题，在不牺牲全局语义保真度的前提下实现精细的实例级空间控制。
AI.motivation: 现有布局到图像扩散模型虽然通过类别级分割图实现了语义可控性，但缺乏实例级可寻址能力——同类别邻近物体常被视为共享语义区域，导致边界模糊、外观平均化和特征混淆。这一问题在城市场景合成中尤为突出，因为密集的行人和车辆需要精细的实例分离同时保持全局场景一致性。
AI.method: InstancePin包含三个核心组件：(1) 独立于预训练骨干网络的实例感知适配器，保留类别级生成先验的同时学习实例级空间控制；(2) 坐标锚定机制——将每个实例的中心坐标编码为傅里叶特征并投影为坐标令牌，通过坐标钉扎注意力被潜图像特征查询；(3) 实例掩码引导的融合模块，将骨干网络特征路由到非实例区域、适配器特征路由到实例区域，实现局部实例精化而不牺牲全局语义保真度。此外还通过实例区域监督坐标注意力图，使每个坐标令牌激活其对应对象区域。
AI.result: 在Cityscapes数据集上的大量实验表明，InstancePin有效缓解了密集布局中的实例纠缠问题，同时提升了图像保真度和语义一致性。
AI.conclusion: 实例锚定是解决布局到图像生成中实例纠缠问题的有效途径，独立适配器加坐标注意力机制能够在保持类别级生成先验的同时实现精确的实例级控制。

title: CADIR: A Cross-Backend Editable Intermediate Representation for Agentic CAD Generation
summary: Large language models have made it possible to generate executable computer-aided design (CAD) programs from natural-language descriptions or images. However, existing methods represent modeling processes as backend-specific sequential scripts with implicit dependencies or as static geometry, making it difficult to simultaneously preserve construction history, stable topological references, and feature-level editability across different CAD systems. We present CADIR, an agent-friendly executable intermediate representation for CAD generation and cross-backend editing. Built on the OCCT geometry kernel via OCP, CADIR provides explicit, compositional modeling operations and fine-grained execution diagnostics. During program execution, CADIR records modeling operations, parameter dependencies, constraints, and topology selections in a construction graph. To enable reliable cross-backend reconstruction, we introduce Geometric Signature Matching, which identifies corresponding edges and faces despite parameter changes and backend differences, allowing adapters to reconstruct native editable feature histories in FreeCAD, SolidWorks, and Fusion 360. Building on this representation, we further propose a construction-graph retrieval method for text and image queries that supports both full-graph and subgraph retrieval, enabling agents to leverage complete models and modeling substructures. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CADIR achieves higher geometric fidelity and execution reliability than existing CAD representations, that construction-graph retrieval further improves model generation quality, and that cross-backend editing enables reliable model reconstruction and post-reconstruction editing across multiple CAD environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CADIR，一种面向智能体的可执行中间表示，用于CAD程序生成和跨后端编辑。CADIR基于OCCT几何内核，记录建模操作、参数依赖、约束和拓扑选择到构造图中，并通过几何签名匹配实现跨后端重建原生可编辑特征历史。
AI.motivation: 现有CAD生成方法要么将建模过程表示为带隐式依赖的后端特定顺序脚本，要么表示为静态几何，难以同时保留构建历史、稳定的拓扑引用以及不同CAD系统间的特征级可编辑性。
AI.method: 提出CADIR中间表示，包含三个核心组件：(1) 基于OCCT/OCP的显式组合式建模操作和细粒度执行诊断；(2) 构造图记录建模操作、参数依赖、约束和拓扑选择；(3) 几何签名匹配实现跨后端可靠重建，以及面向文本和图像查询的构造图检索方法（支持全图和子图检索）。
AI.result: 实验表明CADIR在几何保真度和执行可靠性上优于现有CAD表示；构造图检索进一步提升了模型生成质量；跨后端编辑在FreeCAD、SolidWorks和Fusion 360中实现了可靠的模型重建和编辑。
AI.conclusion: CADIR通过显式的中间表示和构造图机制，解决了CAD生成中构建历史保留、拓扑引用稳定性和跨系统可编辑性的核心挑战，为智能体驱动的CAD建模提供了更可靠的基础。

title: RestoreKV: Recovering Full-Cache Behavior Under Aggressive Query-Agnostic KV Cache Eviction
summary: Query-agnostic KV cache eviction compresses a context once and reuses the resulting cache for arbitrary future queries, but performance can collapse under tight budgets. Existing methods primarily improve which original KV pairs are retained. We introduce RestoreKV, which complements this selection-based formulation with learned restoration under the same total KV budget. Our key insight is that, although the information lost through eviction is context-specific, the mechanism for generating its compact complement can be shared across contexts. After context prefill, a few restore tokens attend to the full KV cache in a single LoRA-adapted pass, generating a compact, context-conditioned restore cache. The base importance scorer and eviction rule remain unchanged, and the adapters are disabled for all subsequent queries and decoding. RestoreKV is trained through parameter-efficient self-distillation from the frozen full-cache model, optimizing only $0.4\%$ of the parameters and requiring no task-specific tuning. Across four backbones and four long-context benchmarks, RestoreKV substantially reduces compression-induced degradation. On Qwen3-4B, it improves 59 of 60 paired, budget-matched settings across five base eviction methods; at a $5\%$ budget, it raises KVzip from $38.2$ to $73.2$ on RULER-4K. Applied to KVzip+, RestoreKV reaches $86.4$ RULER accuracy at $16\times$ compression on the KVPress Benchmark, while adding less than $0.5\%$ one-time cache-construction overhead in a 32K-context evaluation. Our project page is available at https://paper.pnu-cvsp.com/RestoreKV/

AI.tldr: RestoreKV提出了一种查询无关的KV缓存恢复方法，在预填充阶段通过LoRA适配的单遍注意力生成紧凑的上下文条件恢复缓存，弥补被驱逐KV的信息损失，显著提升低预算下的缓存压缩性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的查询无关KV缓存压缩方法主要关注如何选择保留下来的原始KV对，但在极低预算下性能会急剧下降。需要一种方法来弥补被驱逐KV信息的损失，而不改变原有的选择策略。
AI.method: 在上下文预填充后，用少量恢复token对完整KV缓存进行一次LoRA适配的注意力传递，生成紧凑的上下文条件恢复缓存；基础重要性评分器和驱逐规则保持不变，适配器在后续查询和解码时禁用；通过参数高效的自我蒸馏（仅优化0.4%参数）从冻结的全缓存模型训练。
AI.result: 在四种主干网络和四个长上下文基准上，RestoreKV显著降低了压缩导致的性能退化。在Qwen3-4B上，60个配对预算匹配设置中改善了59个；在5%预算下，将KVzip在RULER-4K上的准确率从38.2提升至73.2；应用于KVzip+时在16倍压缩下达到86.4的RULER准确率，仅增加不到0.5%的一次性缓存构建开销。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习恢复而非仅依赖选择，可以在相同的总KV预算下有效弥补驱逐带来的信息损失，且恢复机制可以跨上下文共享，训练开销极小，无需任务特定微调。

title: Diagnosing Under-Development of Irreversible Processes in Video Generation
summary: Many physical attributes are \emph{irreversible}: ice melts but does not re-freeze, paper chars but does not un-burn. Do video generators respect this? We show the question is hard to measure, and that what can be measured reliably is \emph{development} rather than reversal. Metrics of local reversal are null-degenerate: a per-clip violation rate scores $0.50$ on pure noise, and a variance-normalized reversal residual sits at its noise ceiling. What survives null-testing is a two-part protocol: progress (a directional attribute correlation) and a stasis rate. Under this protocol, generated video separates cleanly from real footage, and the gap is human-validated. Across seven text-to-video models, real reference footage advances ($ρ{=}{+}0.40$, $35\%$ static) while every generator shows near-zero progress and $92$--$100\%$ stasis; nine annotators rate real footage far above generated ($2.75$ vs.\ $0.99$ on a $0$--$4$ scale). The reliable finding is \emph{under-development}: generators barely advance irreversible attributes rather than reversing them. As a complementary mechanism, we show that post-hoc readout guidance is gameable, whereas enforcing monotonicity by construction in a disentangled attribute latent removes the gameable readout, validated in controlled and semi-synthetic settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视频生成模型是否遵循物理不可逆性（如冰融化不重凝）。由于局部逆转指标在噪声上存在退化问题，作者提出"进展度"（方向性属性相关性）与"停滞率"两部分的验证协议。实验发现真实视频展现出明显的属性进展（ρ=+0.40，35%静止），而七个文生视频模型几乎无进展且92-100%停滞，表明生成器的主要问题是"欠发展"而非"逆转"。此外，事后读出引导可被攻击，而在解耦的属性隐空间中构造性强制单调性可以消除这一问题。
AI.motivation: 物理属性的不可逆性（如冰融化）是自然世界的基本特征，但视频生成模型是否尊重这一特性尚不清楚。作者希望建立一个可靠的评估框架来回答这个问题。
AI.method: 论证了局部逆转指标的空退化问题（噪声上违规率0.50，方差归一化逆转残差达到噪声天花板），提出由两部分组成的稳健协议：进展（方向性属性相关性）和停滞率。在七个文生视频模型上进行测试，并用9名标注者进行人类验证；同时探讨了事后读出引导的漏洞，以及通过解耦属性隐空间构造性强制单调性的替代机制。
AI.result: 真实参考视频在不可逆属性上表现出显著进展（ρ=+0.40，35%静止），而所有生成模型几乎零进展，停滞率达92-100%。人类标注者评分显示真实视频（2.75）远高于生成视频（0.99，0-4分制）。事后读出引导可被利用，而构造性单调性约束在受控和半合成设置中有效。
AI.conclusion: 生成视频的可靠发现是"欠发展"——生成器几乎不推进不可逆属性，而非逆转它们。这揭示了当前文生视频模型在模拟物理不可逆性方面的系统性不足，并指出构造性约束是比事后引导更可靠的改进方向。

title: Modeling Social Dynamics with an LLM-Enabled Agent Based Network-Dynamic (LAND) Model
summary: Social dynamics encode the process in which individual network and discourse interactions aggregate into collective influence, narrative dominance and coordinate behavior. This paper uses the the GhostField architecture, a hybrid LLM-Enabled Agent Based Network-Dynamic (LAND) model as a social simulation framework to build the AuraSight scenario. In the AuraSight scenario, 314,244 heterogeneous cyber social agents and human actors exchange 529,327 messages over 30 days surrounding a fictional international song-writing contest. We methodologically examine emergent social dynamics across four analytical layers: ego-network topology, semantic network evolution, coordination dynamics and influence dynamics. Our results show how generated social simulations do also produce social dynamics, and how the dynamics of coordination and influence emerge not from individual agents but from the recursive interaction between network topology and narrative exchange.

AI.tldr: 本文利用GhostField架构（一种混合LLM驱动的智能体网络动力学模型）构建AuraSight社会模拟场景，在30天内模拟了314,244个异构网络社交智能体和人类参与者之间交换的529,327条消息，围绕一个虚构的国际歌曲创作比赛展开，并从四个分析层面（自我中心网络拓扑、语义网络演化、协调动态和影响力动态）检验涌现的社会动态。
AI.motivation: 理解社会动态如何从个体网络和话语互动中聚合为集体影响力、叙事主导和协调行为是社会科学的重要课题，但实证数据难以捕捉这一过程的全貌，需要生成式社会模拟来系统研究。
AI.method: 采用GhostField架构——一种混合LLM启用的智能体网络动力学（LAND）模型——构建AuraSight社会模拟场景，包含314,244个异构网络社交智能体和人类参与者，在30天内交换529,327条消息，并从四个层面（自我中心网络拓扑、语义网络演化、协调动态和影响力动态）进行方法论分析。
AI.result: 研究表明生成式社会模拟能够产生真实的社会动态，且协调和影响力的动态并非源自个体智能体，而是源于网络拓扑与叙事交换之间的递归交互。
AI.conclusion: 生成式社会模拟可以有效地再现复杂的社会动态，其涌现的协调与影响力行为根植于网络结构与叙事交流的相互作用，而非个体层面的单一驱动因素。

title: ACE-GraphRAG: Agentic Context Engineering for Hierarchical GraphRAG
summary: Hierarchical Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) organizes corpus knowledge at multiple levels of granularity, yet fixed context construction may fail to translate these multi-resolution representations into a context suited to the current query. We identify this mismatch as the representation--inference gap. We propose Agentic Context Engineering for Hierarchical GraphRAG (ACE-GraphRAG), an inference-time context policy layer that supplements and adapts the initial context for generation. ACE-GraphRAG formulates context construction as a policy over gap-aware refinement, retrieval branches, and task-conditioned adaptation. Parallel Differential Retrieval acquires supplementary evidence from depth-oriented factual and breadth-oriented semantic branches. These evidence increments are consolidated with the initial context while preserving provenance and abstraction levels. Full-ACE applies the full policy uniformly within each task family, whereas Adaptive-ACE selects task- and topology-specific policies for individual queries. We evaluate ACE-GraphRAG on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and four UltraDomain subsets across multi-hop QA and query-focused summarization. Full-ACE outperforms the evaluated RAG and GraphRAG baselines across both task families, while Adaptive-ACE further improves multi-hop QA and is preferred over Full-ACE on all four UltraDomain subsets. Ablation and topology analyses support treating context construction as a query- and task-dependent inference policy rather than a fixed procedure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ACE-GraphRAG，一种用于层级GraphRAG的推理期上下文策略层，通过弥合"表示-推理差距"（即多粒度语料表示与当前查询所需上下文之间的不匹配）来动态构建生成上下文。它通过并行差分检索（深度事实分支+广度语义分支）补充初始上下文，并提供Full-ACE（统一策略）与Adaptive-ACE（查询/任务特化策略）两种模式，在多跳QA和查询聚焦摘要任务上均优于现有RAG和GraphRAG基线。
AI.motivation: 现有层级GraphRAG虽然以多粒度组织语料知识，但固定上下文的构造方式无法将这些多分辨率表示转化为适合当前查询的上下文，导致"表示-推理差距"（representation-inference gap）问题。作者认为上下文构造应当是一个查询和任务相关的自适应推理策略，而非固定的流程。
AI.method: ACE-GraphRAG将上下文构造形式化为一个基于差距感知细化（gap-aware refinement）、检索分支（retrieval branches）和任务条件适应（task-conditioned adaptation）的策略。具体包括：并行差分检索（Parallel Differential Retrieval）从深度事实导向分支和广度语义导向分支获取补充证据，并将这些证据增量与初始上下文合并（保留来源和抽象级别）；Full-ACE对每个任务族统一应用完整策略，而Adaptive-ACE针对每个查询选择任务和拓扑特化的策略。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA和四个UltraDomain子集上评估：Full-ACE在多跳QA和查询聚焦摘要两个任务族上均优于现有RAG和GraphRAG基线；Adaptive-ACE进一步提升了多跳QA性能，并在四个UltraDomain子集上都被偏好于Full-ACE。消融实验和拓扑分析支持将上下文构造视为查询和任务依赖的推理策略。
AI.conclusion: 上下文构造不应是固定的流程，而应作为查询和任务依赖的推理策略来对待。ACE-GraphRAG通过推理期上下文策略层有效弥合了层级GraphRAG中表示与推理之间的差距，证明了自适应上下文工程的价值。

title: Where Does Generative Difficulty Reside? An Empirical Study of Target Representations
comment: TL;DR: Across pixels, SD-VAE, DINOv2, and MAE, we find that target representations are not interchangeable: they shift difficulty between contextual modeling, per-token denoising, and guidance, producing distinct optimization and diversity trade-offs
summary: The target representation defines the distribution an image generator must learn, yet it is often treated as an interchangeable interface. This assumption is particularly questionable for continuous masked generators, which combine contextual inference from visible tokens with conditional modeling of each missing token. We study raw pixels, SD-VAE latents and DINOv2 as well as MAE representation-autoencoder features within a unified masked autoregressive rectified-flow model. Under a shared ImageNet training budget, these spaces exhibit distinct optimization and inference regimes. DINOv2 converges fastest in both iterations and computation but benefits strongly from a wider local denoiser and direct context fusion. Pixels optimize substantially more slowly and require a different prediction, masking, and guidance configuration. MAE reconstructs images more faithfully and exhibits clear semantic clustering, yet produces generations substantially worse than DINOv2. The representations also respond differently to classifier-free guidance and occupy distinct precision-recall trade-offs. Together, our results show that compression, reconstruction fidelity, token dimensionality, and visible semantic clustering do not individually predict generative behavior. Instead, target representations redistribute difficulty across contextual modeling, per-token denoising, and inference-time distributional control.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了连续掩码自回归生成模型中不同目标表示（原始像素、SD-VAE潜变量、DINOv2和MAE特征）对图像生成性能的影响，发现这些表示在优化速度、推理配置和生成质量上存在显著差异，且压缩率、重建保真度、token维度和语义聚类等单一指标均无法预测生成行为。
AI.motivation: 目标表示定义了图像生成器必须学习的分布，但常被视为可互换的接口。这一假设对于连续掩码生成器尤为可疑，因为该架构需要结合上下文推理与条件建模。作者希望揭示不同表示空间对生成行为的真实影响。
AI.method: 在统一的掩码自回归整流流（masked autoregressive rectified-flow）模型框架下，将原始像素、SD-VAE潜变量、DINOv2特征和MAE自编码器特征作为目标表示进行对照实验，在共享的ImageNet训练预算下比较各表示的优化收敛速度、推理配置需求以及生成质量，同时分析分类器自由引导（CFG）在不同表示下的响应差异。
AI.result: DINOv2在迭代和计算方面收敛最快，但需要更宽的局部去噪器和直接上下文融合；像素优化速度显著更慢，需要不同的预测、掩码和引导配置；MAE重建图像更忠实且具清晰语义聚类，但生成质量远逊于DINOv2。不同表示对CFG的响应不同，占据不同的精确率-召回率权衡区间。
AI.conclusion: 目标表示的选择会重新分配生成任务中各环节（上下文建模、逐token去噪、推理时分布控制）的难度，压缩、重建保真度、token维度和语义聚类等单一指标均无法单独预测生成行为。

title: PMMC: Prospective Multimodal Memory Compilation for Long-Term LVLM Agents
summary: Long-term memory is essential for LVLM agents to maintain consistency and integrate information across extended multimodal interactions. Existing agent memory systems, however, often reduce visual experiences into textual summaries or rely on static retrieve-then-reason pipelines, which are inefficient at query time and brittle when questions require image-text binding, temporal updates, or visual details. We propose Prospective Multimodal Memory Compilation, a framework that shifts part of the memory reasoning process from query time to memory consolidation time. Given accumulated multimodal interactions, a Questioner predicts future question candidates, a Planner compiles question-conditioned multimodal memory programs, and a Doubter verifies whether the planned evidence path can support the predicted answer. The verified question-program pairs form a structured question bank for efficient query-time routing and evidence retrieval. Experiments on multimodal long-term memory benchmarks show that our method improves answer quality and visual evidence recall while reducing query-time token and latency costs. Extensive ablations analyze the effects of self-feedback, dynamic planning, raw-image access, and question bank coverage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种前瞻性多模态记忆编译框架（PMMC），通过在记忆整合阶段预测未来问题并编译问题条件化的多模态记忆程序，将部分推理从查询时转移至记忆整合时，从而提升LVLM智能体的长期记忆效率与质量。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLM智能体记忆系统要么将视觉体验压缩为文本摘要导致视觉细节丢失，要么依赖静态的检索-推理流水线，在查询时效率低下且在需要图像-文本绑定、时间更新或视觉细节的问题上表现脆弱。
AI.method: 框架包含三个核心组件：Questioner预测未来可能的问题候选；Planner编译问题条件化的多模态记忆程序；Doubter验证规划的证据路径能否支撑预测答案。通过自我反馈验证后形成结构化问题库，用于查询时的高效路由和证据检索。
AI.result: 在多模态长期记忆基准上的实验表明，该方法提升了答案质量和视觉证据召回率，同时降低了查询时的token消耗和延迟成本。消融实验分析了自我反馈、动态规划、原始图像访问和问题库覆盖率的影响。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆推理从查询时转移到记忆整合时是一种有效的范式转变，能够兼顾视觉细节保真、时间更新能力和查询效率，为多模态智能体长期记忆系统提供了新思路。

title: ArabicDialectSafety: A Dialect-Aware Benchmark for Arabic Content Safety Classification
summary: We present ArabicDialectSafety, a human-curated Arabic safety dataset of 25,071 prompts covering six Arabic varieties: Modern Standard Arabic, Syrian, Egyptian, Algerian, Palestinian, and Moroccan. The dataset is annotated with dialect labels and seven fine-grained harm categories. We introduce a dual-task evaluation framework for binary safe/unsafe detection and granular harm classification across dialects. Benchmarking seven supervised and generative models, we find that fine-tuned MARBERTv2 achieves the strongest performance, with Macro-F1 scores of 0.95 for binary classification and 0.90 for granular classification, substantially outperforming prompted frontier LLMs, including Arabic-specialized models. Our analyses show that dialect conditioning is most effective when integrated at the representation level, while significant performance gaps remain for low-resource Maghrebi dialects. We further evaluate seven frontier LLMs as response generators on harmful dialectal Arabic prompts and observe unsafe generation rates below 5 percent across models. We release the dataset and code upon acceptance to support future research on dialect-aware Arabic safety evaluation. Warning: This paper contains examples of harmful and potentially offensive content included solely for research purposes.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了ArabicDialectSafety，一个包含25,071条提示的人类策展阿拉伯语安全数据集，覆盖六种阿拉伯语方言变体，并提出了双任务评估框架用于二元安全/不安全检测和细粒度危害分类。实验表明微调的MARBERTv2表现最佳，Macro-F1达0.95（二元）和0.90（细粒度），优于提示词驱动的前沿LLM。同时发现低资源马格里布方言仍存在显著性能差距。
AI.motivation: 现有的阿拉伯语安全评估数据集和模型缺乏方言层面的细粒度覆盖，导致在六种主要阿拉伯语变体上的安全检测性能不均衡，特别是低资源马格里布方言（如阿尔及利亚语和摩洛哥语）的安全评估存在明显不足。
AI.method: 构建人类策展的25,071条阿拉伯语安全提示数据集，覆盖六种阿拉伯语变体（现代标准阿拉伯语、叙利亚语、埃及语、阿尔及利亚语、巴勒斯坦语、摩洛哥语），标注方言标签和七种细粒度危害类别。提出双任务评估框架（二元安全/不安全检测和细粒度危害分类），对七种监督模型和生成模型进行基准测试。
AI.result: 微调的MARBERTv2在二元分类上达到0.95 Macro-F1，在细粒度分类上达到0.90 Macro-F1，显著优于包括阿拉伯语专门模型在内的提示词驱动前沿LLM。方言条件化在表示层面集成时效果最佳。七种前沿LLM作为响应生成器时，不安全生成率均低于5%。
AI.conclusion: 方言感知的阿拉伯语安全评估仍然面临挑战，尤其是低资源马格里布方言的性能差距需要进一步解决。作者将发布数据集和代码以支持后续研究，推动方言感知的阿拉伯语安全评估领域发展。

title: WiFuse: An Attention Mechanism for Human Activity Recognition using Fused CSI Amplitude and Delay-Doppler Channel Features
summary: Recently, Wi-Fi sensing has played a significant role in Human Activity Recognition (HAR), as it enables the detection of various activities using only Wi-Fi signals, ensuring privacy and remaining non-intrusive for the user. However, environmental characteristics such as reflective surfaces, hardware offsets, and other physical impairments affect recognition by the neural network, subsequently causing errors and significantly reducing model accuracy. To overcome this problem we present the WiFuse framework, a dual-stream Channel State Information (CSI) framework for human activity recognition (HAR) that pairs denoised time-domain amplitude variations with 2D-FFT-derived Delay-Doppler motion representations computed from the sanitized channel phase. The fused representation feeds a hybrid ResNet-Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) neural architecture augmented with channel and spatio-temporal attention, where the ResNet extracts spatial-spectral features and the TCN models long-range temporal dependencies; a decoupled two-stage transfer learning strategy is employed to improve optimization stability and feature reuse. We conduct extensive experiments on two public datasets, including comparisons against state-of-the-art methods and alternative hybrid architectures, ablation studies, and cross-dataset and domain-adaptation evaluations. The proposed framework reaches an overall accuracy of up to 95.28% across the four environments of the XRF55 dataset and up to 98.20% on the multi-user Wi-MIR dataset. Overall, the results indicate that combining amplitude and Delay-Doppler representations within a dual-stream strategy, enhanced by transfer learning, improves recognition performance under conditions that typically degrade deep neural networks, such as class overlap, multipath propagation, noise, and interference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了WiFuse框架，一种双流CSI人类活动识别框架，将去噪的时域幅度变化与基于2D-FFT的Delay-Doppler运动表征相结合，通过混合ResNet-TCN架构并加入通道与时空注意力机制，配合两阶段迁移学习策略，实现了鲁棒的Wi-Fi人体活动识别。
AI.motivation: Wi-Fi感知在人类活动识别中具有隐私保护和低侵入性的优势，但环境特性（如反射面、硬件偏移等物理损伤）会显著降低神经网络识别的准确性，亟需解决这些不利条件下的识别性能退化问题。
AI.method: 提出WiFuse双流CSI框架：一路采用去噪后的时域幅度特征，另一路利用基于2D-FFT从清洗后的信道相位中提取Delay-Doppler运动表征；融合特征输入混合ResNet-TCN网络，其中ResNet提取空间频谱特征，TCN建模长时时间依赖，并集成通道和时空注意力机制；采用解耦的两阶段迁移学习策略以提升优化稳定性与特征复用。
AI.result: 在XRF55数据集的四个环境中总体准确率达95.28%，在多人Wi-MIR数据集上达98.20%；通过对比实验、消融研究、跨数据集和域适应评估，验证了该方法在类别重叠、多径传播、噪声和干扰等条件下优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 将幅度与Delay-Doppler表征结合的双流策略，辅以迁移学习，能够有效提升在通常会使深度神经网络性能退化的条件下（如类别重叠、多径、噪声和干扰）的活动识别性能。

title: TrajWiki: Source-Grounded Memory Trajectories for Long-Horizon Dialogue Agents
summary: Large language model agents have shown strong capabilities in generating coherent and contextually appropriate responses, yet robust long-horizon dialogue remains limited by the lack of external memory that is traceable, updatable, and diagnostically transparent. Existing memory-augmented agents often store memories as isolated records or overwritable states, making it difficult to preserve how information originates, evolves, conflicts, or becomes obsolete over time. We propose TrajWiki, a trajectory-based memory framework for long-horizon conversational agents. Instead of treating memory as static entries, TrajWiki represents each memory as a source-grounded evolution trajectory, maintained through immutable episodic snapshots and claim-level operations such as ADD, REVISE, and DEPRECATE. To reduce fragmentation and retrieval cost, TrajWiki further introduces Memory Wiki, a persistent intermediate layer that incrementally compiles dialogue history into structured and interlinked wiki pages capturing salient entities, events, quantities, topics, and conflicts. At inference time, queries are routed hierarchically from relevant wiki pages to linked memory trajectories, then to corresponding snapshots and source messages for evidence-grounded answer synthesis. Experiments on LoCoMo and MedMT show that TrajWiki improves long-horizon dialogue performance across both open-source and closed-source LLM backbones, while providing greater interpretability and diagnostic visibility into memory evolution, retrieval failures, and answer generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TrajWiki，一种基于轨迹的记忆框架，将记忆表示为源可追溯的演化轨迹，通过不可变快照和ADD/REVISE/DEPRECATE等声明级操作维护，并引入Memory Wiki中间层将对话历史增量编译为结构化wiki页面。在LoCoMo和MedMT上实验表明，TrajWiki在开源和闭源LLM上均提升了长程对话性能，同时增强了可解释性和诊断可见性。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆增强智能体将记忆存储为孤立记录或可覆盖状态，难以追踪信息的来源、演化、冲突和过时过程，限制了长程对话的鲁棒性。需要一种可追溯、可更新、诊断透明的外部记忆机制。
AI.method: TrajWiki将每条记忆表示为源基础化的演化轨迹，由不可变的时序快照维护，支持ADD、REVISE、DEPRECATE等声明级操作。引入Memory Wiki作为持久中间层，增量地将对话历史编译为结构化且互链的wiki页面（涵盖实体、事件、数量、主题和冲突）。推理时，查询从相关wiki页面分层路由到链接的记忆轨迹，再到对应快照和源消息，实现基于证据的答案生成。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo和MedMT基准上，TrajWiki在开源和闭源LLM骨干网络上均提升了长程对话性能，同时提供了更强的可解释性和对记忆演化、检索失败和答案生成的诊断可见性。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆建模为源可追溯的演化轨迹，并辅以wiki式结构化中间层，能够有效解决长程对话中记忆的可追溯性、可更新性和诊断透明性问题，是一种优于静态记忆方案的方法。

title: CrossLex: A Source-Grounded Benchmark for Cross-Jurisdictional Legal Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Legal reasoning is inherently jurisdiction-dependent: the same facts can call for different legal rules and yield different conclusions across legal systems. Yet existing benchmarks rarely evaluate whether large language models (LLMs) can recognize such jurisdiction-specific variation, especially when identical fact patterns lead to divergent legal outcomes.We introduce CrossLex, a same-fact, legal-source-grounded benchmark for evaluating cross-jurisdictional legal reasoning in LLMs across three jurisdictions: China, California, and Germany. Built from authoritative legal sources, CrossLex aligns 55 legal issues spanning contract, consumer, criminal, family, and labor law, and constructs jurisdiction-aligned questions paired with answers and supporting citations. In total, CrossLex contains 6,149 instances organized into 385 fact groups, with all legal issues, answers, and cited authorities reviewed by legal professionals.To disentangle basic legal knowledge from cross-jurisdictional reasoning, CrossLex defines three complementary tasks: single-jurisdiction reasoning (T1), joint cross-jurisdictional comparison (T2), and fine-grained cross-jurisdictional evaluation (T3). We further propose Grounded Joint, a metric that jointly assesses answer correctness and legal-source grounding, and provide a unified evaluation for streamlined benchmarking. Extensive experiments on representative LLMs show that, although current models can often answer legal questions correctly, they struggle to provide accurate cross-jurisdictional legal citations.We hope that CrossLex will facilitate future research on source-grounded cross-jurisdictional legal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CrossLex，一个跨司法管辖区法律推理基准，涵盖中国、加州和德国三个法域，包含6,149个实例、385个事实组和55个法律议题，并定义了三个互补任务（T1-T3）及Grounded Joint指标，实验表明现有LLM虽能正确回答法律问题，但在跨法域法律引用方面表现欠佳。
AI.motivation: 法律推理本质上依赖于司法管辖区，相同事实在不同法域可能适用不同法律规则并得出不同结论，但现有基准很少评估LLM是否能识别这种法域特定的差异，因此需要一个新的基准来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 从权威法律来源构建CrossLex基准，覆盖三个法域、五大法律领域（合同、消费者、刑事、家庭、劳动法），由法律专业人士审核所有内容；定义三个任务：单法域推理（T1）、联合跨法域比较（T2）、细粒度跨法域评估（T3）；提出Grounded Joint指标，同时评估答案正确性和法律来源引用。
AI.result: 在代表性LLM上的大量实验表明，当前模型通常能正确回答法律问题，但在提供准确的跨法域法律引用方面存在困难。
AI.conclusion: CrossLex有望推动基于来源的跨法域法律推理研究，帮助评估和提升LLM在法律领域的跨法域理解和引用能力。

title: PixelSR: Efficient Screen Content Super-Resolution via Pixel Classification
summary: Screen content images are generally composed of texts and graphics. Compared to natural images, these man-made images contain a large quantity of sharp but repetitive structures. However, existing works in screen content super-resolution underutilize the special characteristics of screen content, leaving a large room to improve model performance and speed up. In this paper, we propose PixelSR, a simple yet effective method to improve super-resolution performance but with faster inference speed. To improve model performance, we classify pixels via pixel binning to compute content attention in the training phase. Specifically, after binning pixels into content-dependent groups, content attention is aggregated from pixel features within each group to introduce a content-dependent and non-local receptive field for every pixel. In the testing phase, we utilize the properties of self-repetitiveness and redundancy in screen content to speed up inference without the loss of model performance. We divide targeted high-resolution pixels into three types, which are unique pixels, repeated pixels, and background pixels for each test image. We conduct conventional network processing on unique pixels and cache their predictions in the on-the-fly lookup table. For repeated pixels which have appeared in unique pixels, we directly retrieve prediction results from the lookup table without network processing. For background pixels, we use the nearest neighbor algorithm to generate high-resolution pixels. The on-the-fly lookup table is cleaned and repeats the procedure above for the next test image. Experiments show our PixelSR achieves state-of-the-art performance with shorter inference time in screen content super-resolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PixelSR，一种用于屏幕内容图像超分辨率的简单高效方法。通过像素分箱计算内容注意力来提升性能，并通过将像素分为独特像素、重复像素和背景像素三类来加速推理，利用查找表缓存和最近邻算法避免不必要的网络计算。
AI.motivation: 屏幕内容图像（如文本和图形）包含大量锐利但重复的结构，而现有的屏幕内容超分辨率方法未能充分利用这些特殊特性，导致模型性能不足且推理速度较慢。
AI.method: 训练阶段：通过像素分箱将像素归类到内容相关组中，从组内像素特征聚合内容注意力，为每个像素提供内容相关且非局部的感受野。测试阶段：将高分辨率像素分为三类——独特像素（进行常规网络处理并缓存预测结果到查找表）、重复像素（直接从查找表检索预测结果）、背景像素（用最近邻算法生成）。查找表在处理完每张测试图像后清空并重复此流程。
AI.result: 实验表明PixelSR在屏幕内容超分辨率任务上实现了最先进的性能，同时推理时间更短。
AI.conclusion: 利用屏幕内容的自重复性和冗余性，通过像素分类和查找表缓存策略，在提升超分辨率性能的同时显著加速推理过程。

title: PROGRESS: Coverage-guided RL to Train Search-augmented LLM Agent
summary: Existing search-augmented LLM agents are trained using Reinforcement Learning to boost its reasoning capabilities. However, these approaches primarily rely on outcome-level rewards, which provide little supervision over search behavior and overlook agent's ability to decompose complex queries properly. To mitigate this issue, we propose PROGRESS which utilizes teacher-guided coverage reward to explicitly shape decomposed query generation of the policy model. During training, frozen teacher models are used to decompose complex queries into essential search queries. These essential search queries are utilized to guide the search behavior of the policy model. Integrated into an R1-style training framework, our approach provides lightweight guidance over query decomposition decisions without dense process-level supervision. Experiments show that coverage-guided RL improves overall task performance, highlighting the importance of explicitly supervising search strategies in agentic LLMs.

AI.tldr: PROGRESS通过基于教师模型的覆盖奖励（coverage reward）来显式塑造搜索增强型LLM智能体的查询分解行为，在不依赖密集过程级监督的情况下，通过R1风格训练框架提升任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的搜索增强型LLM智能体通过强化学习训练以提升推理能力，但主要依赖结果级奖励，对搜索行为提供的监督很少，忽略了智能体正确分解复杂查询的能力。
AI.method: 提出PROGRESS框架：利用冻结的教师模型将复杂查询分解为关键搜索查询，并根据这些关键查询设计覆盖奖励（coverage reward）来引导策略模型的搜索行为。该奖励集成到R1风格的训练框架中，在不依赖密集过程级监督的情况下提供轻量级查询分解指导。
AI.result: 实验表明，覆盖引导的强化学习显著提升了整体任务性能，证明了显式监督搜索策略在智能体LLM中的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 显式地监督搜索策略（而非仅依赖结果级奖励）能够有效提升搜索增强型LLM智能体的任务表现，为智能体训练提供了新的方向。

title: RH-RAG: Trustworthy Long-Form Generation for Privacy-Constrained Settings
summary: Generating long-form content from extensive internal reports remains challenging for organizations operating under strict privacy and security constraints, where proprietary cloud-based LLM APIs are often not viable. While locally deployed open-weight models offer a privacy-preserving alternative, existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approaches on smaller models frequently lack effective global planning and accumulate factual inconsistencies over long outputs. To address these limitations, we present RH-RAG, a multi-agent framework for secure and trustworthy long form generation using local language models. RH-RAG decomposes generation into three coordinated stages: a Planner Agent that constructs a global document outline from high-level semantic summaries, a Writer Agent that incrementally generates coherent section-wise content using bounded coherence memory, and a Checker Agent that mitigates hallucinations through natural language inference-based factual verification and an attestation-driven revision loop. The framework further employs a dual-level retrieval index that supports efficient planning and fine-grained contextual generation on consumer-grade hardware. Evaluations across literary, financial, and legal domains demonstrate that RH-RAG consistently improves factual grounding, semantic coherence, and document-level alignment compared to standard and hierarchical RAG baselines, while achieving reliability competitive with proprietary cloud-based systems without compromising data privacy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RH-RAG，一个基于本地语言模型的多智能体框架，用于在隐私受限环境下生成安全可信的长篇内容。该框架通过规划、写作、检查三个协同阶段，结合双层级检索索引，在消费级硬件上实现了与专有云系统相媲美的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 组织在处理长篇幅内部报告生成时面临严格的隐私和安全约束，专有云LLM API不可行；本地开源模型虽然保护隐私，但现有的RAG方法在较小模型上缺乏全局规划能力，且长输出中会累积事实不一致问题。
AI.method: RH-RAG采用三阶段多智能体框架：(1) Planner Agent从高层语义摘要构建全局文档大纲；(2) Writer Agent使用有界一致性记忆增量生成连贯的章节内容；(3) Checker Agent通过基于自然语言推理的事实验证和证明驱动的修订循环来缓解幻觉。此外采用支持高效规划和细粒度上下文生成的双层级检索索引。
AI.result: 在文学、金融和法律领域的评估表明，RH-RAG相比标准和层级RAG基线，在事实接地性、语义连贯性和文档级对齐方面持续改进，且可靠性与专有云系统相当，同时不牺牲数据隐私。
AI.conclusion: RH-RAG证明了在隐私受限环境中，通过多智能体协作和双层级检索，本地小模型也能实现与专有云系统竞争的长篇生成质量，为安全合规场景下的大模型应用提供了可行方案。

title: Geometry-guided Emotion Modulation for Controllable and Photorealistic Emotional Talking Face Generation
summary: Audio-driven emotional talking face generation aims to synthesize realistic videos with expressive facial dynamics. However, existing methods struggle to balance controllability and visual fidelity. Although implicit representations capture rich semantics, they lack structural guidance, often resulting in averaged emotional expressions. In contrast, explicit geometric methods offer better control over facial expressions but tend to sacrifice high-frequency texture details. To address it, we propose GemTalk, a diffusion-based framework that combines the semantic richness of implicit representations with the structural precision of explicit geometric priors. We introduce a Vision-guided Audio Emotion Projection (V-AEP) module to extract implicit emotional lip and expression features. At the same time, a Diffusion-based Geometric Priors Generator (D-GPG) generates identity-aware blendshape coefficients as explicit structural priors. Crucially, our Geometry-guided Emotion Modulation (GEM) module leverages these geometric priors to recalibrate the magnitude of implicit features, enabling precise, continuous control over emotional expressions, especially emotion intensity, without sacrificing visual quality. Extensive experiments show GemTalk achieves superior performance in photo-realism, and facial emotional dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出GemTalk框架，融合隐式表征的语义丰富性与显式几何先验的结构精确性，用于音频驱动的情感说话人脸生成，实现情感强度连续可控且保持高视觉保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有音频驱动情感说话人脸生成方法难以兼顾可控性与视觉保真度：隐式表征缺乏结构引导导致情感表达平均化，显式几何方法虽可控性强但牺牲高频纹理细节。
AI.method: 提出扩散式框架GemTalk，包含三个核心模块：1) Vision-guided Audio Emotion Projection (V-AEP)提取隐式情感嘴唇与表情特征；2) Diffusion-based Geometric Priors Generator (D-GPG)生成身份感知的blendshape系数作为显式结构先验；3) Geometry-guided Emotion Modulation (GEM)模块利用几何先验重新校准隐式特征幅度，实现精确连续的情感表达控制。
AI.result: 大量实验表明GemTalk在照片真实感和面部情感动态方面均取得优越性能，尤其在情感强度控制上表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 通过隐式与显式表征的有机融合，GemTalk有效解决了情感可控性与视觉质量之间的权衡问题，为音频驱动情感说话人脸生成提供了新的解决思路。

title: Search-GRT: Guided Retrieval Training of Search Agents to Optimize for Complex Question Answering
summary: The effective use of search engines by large language models (LLMs) remains a significant challenge, particularly in complex, multi-hop question-answering (MHQA) tasks. These tasks require the model to decompose questions into subqueries, retrieve relevant information, and synthesize answers from multiple sources, often leading to cascading errors due to poor retrieval in early stages. Reinforcement learning (RL) has shown promise in improving LLMs' search capabilities, but it often suffers from sparse rewards during training, hindering the model's ability to learn effectively. To address these challenges, we introduce Guided Retrieval Training (GRT), a novel method that improves the performance of a search agent by restricting the retrieval process during RL training using ground truth information. By focusing on a curated set of relevant documents, GRT provides the model with a stronger learning signal, mitigating the problem of sparse rewards and improving its ability to generate accurate subqueries and synthesize correct answers. Our experimental results demonstrate that GRT achieves consistent performance improvements over existing methods, such as Search-R1, across a wide range of question-answering (QA) tasks. Notably, GRT excels in MHQA tasks, achieving over 40% improvements in performance. Additionally, GRT enhances training efficiency by achieving better QA performance with fewer training steps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出引导式检索训练（GRT）方法，通过利用真实信息限制RL训练中的检索过程，解决LLM在多跳问答任务中的搜索能力不足和稀疏奖励问题，在MHQA任务上取得超过40%的性能提升，并提升了训练效率。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在复杂多跳问答任务中有效使用搜索引擎仍具挑战性。尽管强化学习能改善LLM的搜索能力，但训练过程中存在稀疏奖励问题，阻碍了模型的有效学习。
AI.method: 提出Guided Retrieval Training (GRT)，在RL训练阶段利用ground truth信息限制检索过程，将检索聚焦于一组精选的相关文档，为模型提供更强的学习信号，从而缓解稀疏奖励问题，提升子查询生成和答案综合的能力。
AI.result: 实验结果表明GRT在多种QA任务上优于Search-R1等现有方法。特别在多跳问答任务中实现了超过40%的性能提升，同时在更少的训练步数下获得更好的问答性能，提升了训练效率。
AI.conclusion: GRT通过引导检索过程有效解决了稀疏奖励问题，显著增强了LLM在多跳问答中的搜索与推理能力，验证了利用真实信息约束RL训练过程的有效性。

title: BiCAA: Bidirectional Credit Assignment for Search-Augmented Agent
summary: Multi-step search is a fundamental capability for search agents, enabling them to iteratively acquire, refine, and integrate external evidence for complex reasoning QA. However, vanilla GRPO allocates rewards exclusively based on the model's final outputs, yielding outcome-only supervision with no supervisory signals for intermediate reasoning steps. Such sparse supervision easily causes training instability and redundant search behaviors on multi-step search tasks. To mitigate this limitation, we adopt process reward to deliver stepwise supervision signals. For this process reward, we propose two complementary criteria to judge each search step: whether the step yields new evidence to facilitate problem solving, and whether it forms an efficient, pivotal intermediate decision within the overall reasoning trajectory. Building on this insight, we propose BiCAA: a bidirectional credit assignment framework that delivers dense, distinguishing process rewards for search-augmented agents. BiCAA builds bidirectional process rewards by fusing two complementary signals: forward solvability gain and hindsight success criticality. The former quantifies step-wise improvements in answer plausibility, while the latter evaluates each step's necessity for final success via hindsight outcome-based criticality scoring. We modulate and aggregate the two signals and then fuse them with the outcome reward. Experiments on search-augmented QA benchmarks show that BiCAA stabilizes policy optimization, reduces redundant search behavior, and achieves competitive performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BiCAA框架，通过双向信用分配机制为多步搜索代理提供密集的过程奖励，融合前向可解性增益和事后成功关键性两个互补信号，以解决vanilla GRPO仅依赖最终输出监督导致的训练不稳定和冗余搜索行为问题。
AI.motivation: 多步搜索对于搜索代理至关重要，但vanilla GRPO仅基于最终输出分配奖励，缺乏对中间推理步骤的监督信号，这种稀疏监督在多步搜索任务中容易导致训练不稳定和冗余搜索行为。
AI.method: 提出BiCAA双向信用分配框架，通过两个互补标准判断每个搜索步骤：(1)前向可解性增益——量化步骤对答案合理性的逐步改进；(2)事后成功关键性——通过事后基于结果的关键性评分评估每一步对最终成功的必要性。将两个信号调制、聚合后与结果奖励融合，提供密集且有区分度的过程奖励。
AI.result: 在搜索增强QA基准上的实验表明，BiCAA稳定了策略优化，减少了冗余搜索行为，并取得了具有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: BiCAA通过双向信用分配提供密集过程奖励，有效弥补了GRPO稀疏监督的不足，提升了多步搜索代理的训练稳定性和搜索效率。

title: CopyCat: Improving Fine-Grained Subject Consistency in Subject-to-Image Models within Seconds
summary: Recent subject-to-image models have achieved impressive progress in personalized image generation, yet they still struggle to preserve fine-grained subject-specific details. A major reason is the lack of high-quality fine-grained identity supervision: real paired data are expensive to collect, while synthesized training pairs often preserve only coarse subject appearance and fail to capture subtle subject-specific details. In this work, we propose CopyCat, a lightweight model-refinement framework that improves fine-grained subject consistency within only a few seconds. CopyCat performs a one-time refinement of a pretrained subject-to-image model by attaching a lightweight Fine-grained Consistency LoRA (FCLoRA) and optimizing it using a single proxy image, which is used as both the conditioning image and the reconstruction target. This exact self-reconstruction objective substantially simplifies the optimization task, enabling effective fine-grained refinement within only a few seconds. The refinement is performed only once; the resulting model can be directly applied to diverse unseen reference subjects and prompts without further subject-specific optimization. We further revisit subject-to-image LoRA training in double-stream diffusion transformers and find that adapting only the visual stream consistently improves subject consistency. Extensive experiments on DreamBench and XVerseBench demonstrate consistent improvements in fine-grained subject consistency across representative subject-to-image models under both single- and multi-subject settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CopyCat，一种轻量级模型精炼框架，通过在预训练的主体到图像模型上附加细粒度一致性LoRA（FCLoRA），仅使用单张代理图像进行一次性自重建优化，在数秒内即可提升细粒度主体一致性，无需针对每个新主体额外优化。
AI.motivation: 现有的主体到图像模型在生成时难以保留细粒度的主体特定细节，主要原因是缺乏高质量的细粒度身份监督数据：真实配对数据采集成本高，合成训练对往往只能保留粗略的主体外观，无法捕捉细微的主体特定细节。
AI.method: CopyCat框架包含三个关键设计：(1) 在预训练的主体到图像模型上附加轻量级Fine-grained Consistency LoRA（FCLoRA）；(2) 使用单张代理图像同时作为条件图像和重建目标，通过精确的自重建目标简化优化任务，实现数秒内的细粒度精炼；(3) 精炼只执行一次，得到的模型可直接应用于未见过的不同参考主体和提示词。此外，论文还发现双流扩散Transformer中仅适配视觉流可以持续提升主体一致性。
AI.result: 在DreamBench和XVerseBench上进行了大量实验，在单主体和多主体设置下，多个代表性的主体到图像模型在细粒度主体一致性上都取得了一致的改进。
AI.conclusion: CopyCat证明了通过一次性的轻量级自重建优化，可以快速提升预训练模型对主体细节的保真度，且无需针对每个新主体进行特定的优化，为细粒度主体一致性生成提供了高效可行的解决方案。

title: Passing Coarse Marginal Checks Can Be Cheap: Persona Mixtures and Imprecise Treatment-Response Estimates in an LLM Persona Panel
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures. Project site: https://yoheinakajima.github.io/synthetic-players/ ; code, data, registrations, review record, and zero-call replay capsule: https://github.com/yoheinakajima/synthetic-players
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as synthetic research participants and are often validated by whether their marginal responses resemble human data. We study a fixed panel of sixteen lightweight persona-conditioned GPT-4.1 configurations in repeated strategic games. The panel met preregistered broad-reference condition-mean criteria in three of four repeated-game cells; the sole miss was 0.011 below the lower reference bound. Variation was strongly prompt-indexed, but its share depended on uncertainty assumptions: fixed-panel symmetric-Dirichlet sensitivities produced median between-prompt shares of 63%-71% under Jeffreys alpha=0.5 and 47%-53% under alpha=1, while finite-opportunity plug-in estimates were 85%-96%. Aggregate continuation-probability contrasts were +0.083 and +0.078, with conservative simultaneous 95% intervals [-0.171, +0.330] and [-0.181, +0.330]. The treatment jointly changed the continuation process and its textual representation. A separate wording-and-position operation shifted cooperation from 0/40 to 37/40 in the bare configuration, and a label conflict also revealed representation control. The original persona-level p13 result was not prospectively family-controlled, while a post-adjudication exact gate was structurally underpowered; p13 is therefore a replication target rather than a finding. External review exposed family-error, dependence, construct, and boundary-uncertainty defects, and zero-call reanalysis changed the interpretation without rewriting the historical record. The registered marginal criteria could be passed without precisely estimating the treatment-response object. A public capsule verifies 4,916 confirmatory Phase 3-5 runs with no live model calls. The results concern one fixed model-prompt panel and do not establish human substitutability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了16个轻量级人格条件化GPT-4.1配置在重复策略博弈中的行为，发现其在三个重复博弈单元中通过了预先登记的边际标准，但存在显著的提示词索引变异性问题，且p13结果缺乏前瞻性家族控制，无法作为确定性发现，仅能作为复制目标。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型正越来越多地被用作合成研究参与者，通常通过其边际响应是否与人类数据相似来验证。本研究旨在严格检验这种验证方式的充分性，特别是在重复策略博弈的固定面板设定下。
AI.method: 使用16个轻量级人格条件化GPT-4.1配置组成固定面板，在重复策略博弈中运行。采用预先登记的宽泛参考条件均值标准进行评估，使用对称狄利克雷敏感性和有限机会插件估计来分析提示词间变异性，并检验处理效应（延续概率对比）及其文本表征的变化。
AI.result: 面板在四个重复博弈单元中的三个通过了预登记标准，唯一的未通过项低于参考下限0.011。提示词间变异份额在中位数上为47%-71%（依不确定性假设而异），有限机会插件估计为85%-96%。延续概率对比为+0.083和+0.078，但置信区间宽大。一个措辞与位置操作将合作从0/40提升至37/40，揭示了表征控制效应。
AI.conclusion: 注册的边际标准可以在未精确估计处理响应对象的情况下通过，说明仅凭边际相似性不足以验证LLM作为研究参与者的有效性。p13结果应视为复制目标而非确定性发现，模型结果不能确立人类可替代性。

title: Auditing Discovery Claims: A Two-Sided Criterion for Agentic Science, with the Negative Side Decidable
summary: When a self-improving AI-for-science system claims a new capability, the evidence is usually a benchmark delta, a description-length gate, or a p-value. None separates a real gain from extra search, from a changed verifier, or from adaptation to a fallible oracle. We build a two-sided audit whose negative side is a formal fact: a pseudoknot-free oracle provably cannot represent a crossing base pair, so the prior verifier's range is bounded exactly, offline, before any run. "New" is relative to the agent's prior self, never to the base model. First, how far a single fallible oracle can inflate a capability claim. An invented, solver-free operator solves 43/60 crossing RNA targets under the predictor it optimizes, above a context-free floor of 0/60; under three predictors, 1/60 survives. Paired on the same 43 targets, a predictor the operator never saw confirms 2 of its designs against 26 for a minimum-free-energy solver (p = 8e-7). No statistic computed from the system and its own oracle sees that gap. Second, agent-written procedures can beat a human-written one under a judge no objective can flatter, at a fraction of the compute. Of six frontier models, the two whose operators ran without timeouts carry over at 0.293 against our 0.095 (n = 951 paired units, target-clustered [+0.108, +0.297], p = 5e-5) while spending 4.6-10x fewer oracle calls. Three rungs: difference under an outside adjudicator (reached), not bought with compute (reached, both directions), mechanism identified and transferable (not reached; seven candidates tested, none moves the statistic). The ceiling is the panel itself: its three predictors share nearest-neighbour thermodynamic parameters, two agreeing at kappa = 0.673. The audit is as unsparing about our own system: matched undirected search is an exact zero, and a search-free probe puts 84% of our headline effect on targets a random sequence already solves.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对自我改进型AI科学系统的双向审计方法。该审计通过一个伪结自由预言机（pseudoknot-free oracle）的形式化事实，证明其无法表示交叉碱基对，从而在运行前离线精确界定先前验证器的范围。审计通过外部裁判、计算成本对比和机制迁移三个层级来区分真实能力提升与虚假提升（如额外搜索、修改验证器或适应不可靠预言机）。结果显示：单窗口预言机可显著夸大能力声明；外部裁判下Agent写的程序在更少计算下优于人类写的程序；但机制识别与迁移尚未达成。
AI.motivation: 自我改进型AI科学系统声称新能力时，通常以基准增量、描述长度门槛或p值作为证据，但这些都无法区分真实进步与由额外搜索、修改验证器或适应不可靠预言机造成的虚假提升。需要一个严格的审计框架来识别真实的能力增益。
AI.method: 构建一个双向审计框架：负向侧基于形式化事实（伪结自由预言机无法表示交叉碱基对），精确界定验证器范围；正向侧通过三个层级的检验来评估能力声明（外部裁判下的差异、是否以计算为代价换取、机制是否可识别且可迁移）。同时设计了无搜索探针对照和匹配无向搜索对照来交叉验证自身系统。
AI.result: 第一项实验：一个无求解器的算子成功解决43/60个交叉RNA靶标，但在三个不同预测器下仅1/60存活。第二项实验：Agent写的程序在外部裁判下以0.293对0.095胜出（p=5e-5），且节省4.6-10倍的预言机调用。机制迁移未达成，七个候选测试均未显著改变统计量。对自身系统的审计显示，匹配无向搜索是精确零，84%的头条效果来自随机序列已可解决的靶标。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明：仅从系统与自身预言机计算得到的统计数据无法识别能力虚假性；外部裁判和计算成本审计可在前两个层级检测虚假能力；但审计的天花板在于裁判面板本身——三个预测器共享近邻热力学参数，限制了审计的最终可靠性。需要第三层级（机制识别与迁移）才能真正确认一个能力声明。

title: LongChart VQA: A Comprehensive Benchmark for MLLMs with Complex Multi-Chart Reasoning
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are rapidly evolving with expanded context windows and stronger reasoning capabilities, enabling multi-chart understanding and multi-step inference. These abilities are increasingly important as MLLMs are adopted in complex agentic tasks. However, existing benchmarks largely emphasize single-chart perception, while simple chart-to-chart connections are insufficient to evaluate these capabilities. To capture multi-chart complexity while ensuring consistency and validity, we design a synthesis pipeline supported by latent graphs. Building on this pipeline, we introduce LongChart, a benchmark whose VQA sets contain an average of 6.5 images and 31.2 questions. We evaluate 10 state-of-the-art MLLMs and examine three factors that influence performance: reasoning patterns, auxiliary tools, and robustness to image perturbations. Our results show that MLLM accuracy decreases and varies substantially as computational complexity increases, highlighting directions for future research in multi-chart reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了LongChart基准，通过支持潜在图的合成管道生成包含平均6.5张图像和31.2个问题的多图VQA数据集，用于评估多模态大语言模型在多图表理解和多步推理方面的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要强调单图表感知，简单图表间连接不足以评估MLLMs在多图表理解和多步推理方面的能力，而这些能力在复杂智能体任务中日益重要。
AI.method: 设计了一个由潜在图支持的合成管道来生成多图表VQA数据集LongChart，并评估了10个最先进的MLLMs，考察推理模式、辅助工具和图像扰动鲁棒性三个因素对性能的影响。
AI.result: 随着计算复杂度的增加，MLLM的准确率下降且波动增大，揭示了多图表推理领域的未来研究方向。
AI.conclusion: LongChart为评估MLLMs的多图表理解能力提供了有效基准，实验结果表明当前模型在多图表复杂推理方面仍有显著提升空间。

title: BRIC-Net: Boundary-Reliable Illumination-Color Interaction for Remote Sensing Image Deshadowing
summary: Shadows in remote sensing images obscure surface appearance and disrupt radiometric continuity, reducing the reliability of visual interpretation and downstream analysis. Remote sensing image deshadowing is an ill-posed inverse problem that requires spatially varying illumination recovery while preserving chromatic and radiometric consistency in non-shadow regions. Existing methods commonly rely on hard shadow masks for compensation or directly regress RGB intensities. Hard masks may inadequately model gradual penumbra variations and are sensitive to localization errors, often producing residual shadows or halo artifacts; direct RGB regression entangles illumination recovery with chromatic reconstruction and can introduce color casts. To this end, we propose the Boundary-Reliable Illumination-Color Interaction Network (BRIC-Net), which decouples these failures at different representation levels. A Lightness Reliability Prior (LRP) derives reliability-aware guidance from CIELAB statistics. Boundary-Adaptive Gated Mixing (BAGM) performs gated interpolation between shallow RGB and lightness features around uncertain transitions, while Spatial-Channel Mutual Modulation (SCMM) coordinates deeper spatial and channel responses for appearance-preserving illumination recovery. BRIC-Net achieves 29.46~dB full-image peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) on AeroDS-Syn and 27.96~dB on SRGTA. It also obtains the lowest Perception-based Image Quality Evaluator (PIQE) scores on AISD and AeroDS-Real. Region-wise evaluations and component ablations further support its effectiveness in shadow recovery and non-shadow preservation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BRIC-Net网络用于遥感影像去阴影，通过光照-颜色解耦策略分别在浅层和深层特征层面处理阴影恢复问题，在多个数据集上取得了state-of-the-art的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感影像去阴影方法存在两方面问题：硬阴影掩膜难以建模渐变半影区并易受定位误差影响，产生残留阴影或光晕伪影；直接RGB回归将光照恢复与色彩重建纠缠在一起，容易引入色偏。这促使作者提出解耦策略来分别处理这两个失效模式。
AI.method: 提出Boundary-Reliable Illumination-Color Interaction Network (BRIC-Net)，包含三个关键组件：1) Lightness Reliability Prior (LRP)基于CIELAB统计导出可靠性引导；2) Boundary-Adaptive Gated Mixing (BAGM)在不确定过渡区域执行浅层RGB与亮度特征的门控插值；3) Spatial-Channel Mutual Modulation (SCMM)协调深层空间与通道响应以保外观地去恢复光照。
AI.result: 在AeroDS-Syn上达到29.46 dB全图PSNR，在SRGTA上达到27.96 dB；在AISD和AeroDS-Real数据集上获得最低的PIQE分数。区域级评估和消融实验进一步验证了阴影恢复和非阴影保持的有效性。
AI.conclusion: BRIC-Net通过在不同表示层面解耦光照恢复与色彩重建的失效模式，有效解决了阴影恢复中的边界不确定性和色彩一致性难题，为遥感影像去阴影提供了可靠的解决方案。

title: SCHEDBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Constraint Faithfulness in Natural-Language Combinatorial Scheduling
summary: This paper introduces SCHEDBench, a natural-language benchmark for evaluating combinatorial scheduling constraint faithfulness under surface-form variation. Grounded in canonical scheduling instances and solver-derived feasibility and optimality, SCHEDBench assesses whether large language models (LLMs) generate schedules with the same constraint-feasible behavior across varied natural-language (NL) surface forms. SCHEDBench spans 1,132 instances across job-shop scheduling problems (JSP), single and multi-mode resource-constrained project scheduling problems (RCPSP), nurse rostering/scheduling, and curriculum timetabling problems of varying difficulty. Instances are templated into natural language problems using domain-specific templates, themed entities, lexical-syntactic template rephrasing, and constraint-level surface-form variation, with reference solutions verified for feasibility and objective optimality. Across thirteen frontier and open-weight LLMs, we find that models are not reliably invariant to semantically equivalent renderings of the same scheduling problem. Surface-form variation reduces feasibility and induces above-noise shifts in per-instance hard-constraint violations on matched instances. Among the tested isolated axes, constraint reordering yields the clearest above-noise sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCHEDBench基准，用于评估大语言模型在调度约束满足方面对自然语言表面形式变化的稳健性，涵盖1,132个实例和多种调度问题类型。实验发现13个前沿LLM对语义等价的调度问题表述并不鲁棒，表面形式变化会降低解的可行性和硬约束满足度，其中约束重排序是最显著的影响因素。
AI.motivation: 调度问题在现实中常以不同的自然语言表述呈现，但LLM生成调度方案时是否对这些表面形式变化保持一致行为尚不清楚。现有基准缺乏系统评估LLM调度约束忠诚度对语言变异鲁棒性的研究。
AI.method: 基于规范的调度实例和求解器验证的可行性/最优性构建基准；使用领域特定模板、主题化实体、词汇句法模板改写和约束级别表面形式变化将实例模板化为自然语言问题；参照解通过求解器验证可行性和目标最优性；对13个前沿和开源LLM进行系统性测试。
AI.result: 模型对语义等价的调度问题表述不可靠地保持一致；表面形式变化降低可行性并导致匹配实例上硬约束违例的显著偏移；在测试的孤立变异轴中，约束重排序产生的敏感性最明显。
AI.conclusion: LLM在调度约束满足任务中对自然语言表面形式变化缺乏鲁棒性，需要进一步改进以提高其在真实场景中面对多样表述时的可靠性。

title: Prompt-Induced Waste in Large Reasoning Models: A Preregistered Two-Harness Benchmark of Coding Agents
summary: Large reasoning models used as coding agents incur costs from deliberation, tool calls, and repeated agent turns, yet the causal effect of prompt wording on this spend has not been measured systematically. We present a preregistered benchmark across six large reasoning models, two real agent harnesses, and 24 deterministic coding tasks with hidden evaluators. Across 4,643 valid runs, including screening, stress, holdout, replication, and cross-provider studies, we find that prompt formulation can multiply reasoning cost without improving correctness. Asking the model to develop and compare several approaches is the most consistently wasteful instruction, increasing reasoning tokens by 2.4-7.4x across all models. Generic "think deeply" cues also increase deliberation by 1.6-2.2x, while a bounded-efficiency template specifying scope, acceptance criteria, and a stop condition is cost-neutral and can halve reasoning. Harness choice matters even more: identical model-task-prompt triples cost 5-30x more per success under Claude Code than under pi, mainly because of larger static prefixes and more turns. Misleading architectural hints are far costlier than irrelevant prose, and provider-side caching reduces billed cost without changing behavior, so it must not be treated as efficiency. Replications on Kimi-K3 and Claude Sonnet 5 preserve the main effect directions while revealing model-specific sensitivity to thinking and certainty cues. Overall, prompt wording and harness design materially affect agent cost, often with no gain in task success.

AI.tldr: 本文通过预注册的大规模基准测试（6个推理模型、2个Agent框架、24个确定性编码任务、4643次有效运行），系统测量了提示词表述和Agent框架对代码智能体推理成本的影响。发现某些提示词表述（如"开发并比较多种方案"）可使推理token增加2.4-7.4倍而不提升正确率，框架选择的影响甚至更大（成本差异可达5-30倍）。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型作为编码智能体会产生大量推理、工具调用和多轮交互成本，但提示词表述对这一开销的因果影响此前从未被系统测量过。研究旨在量化提示词措辞和Agent框架设计对编码智能体成本的真实影响。
AI.method: 采用预注册基准测试，涵盖6个大型推理模型、2个真实Agent框架（Claude Code和pi）、24个确定性编码任务（含隐藏评估器）。共进行4643次有效运行，包括筛选、压力测试、留出验证、复制和跨供应商研究。测试了多种提示词模板（如"开发并比较多种方案"、"深度思考"、有界效率模板等）及误导性架构提示的影响。
AI.result: 发现"开发并比较多种方案"的提示是最浪费的，推理token增加2.4-7.4倍；泛化的"深度思考"提示增加1.6-2.2倍推理开销；有界效率模板成本中性且可将推理减半。框架选择影响更大：Claude Code下相同任务比pi贵5-30倍。误导性架构提示比无关文字成本更高。提供商端缓存降低成本但不改变行为，不应视为效率提升。在Kimi-K3和Claude Sonnet 5上的复制研究保持了主要效应方向。
AI.conclusion: 提示词措辞和Agent框架设计会显著影响编码智能体的使用成本，且往往不带来任务成功率的提升。这提示成本和效率优化应同时关注提示词设计和框架层级的选择，而不应仅归因于模型本身的能力。

title: Judging Is Not Enumerating: Silent Omissions in LLM-Authored Acceptable Sets
summary: Language models are increasingly promoted from examinees to examiners: they write the test suites, answer keys, rubrics, and reward functions that define correctness for other systems. We measure the capability that role assumes and find it lacking under the protocol the role is usually deployed with, one-shot greedy authoring with no test-time reasoning.
