Across four reference constructions - two with complete finite truth, one with a hardened executable reference (HumanEval+/MBPP+), one with an explicitly incomplete lexical reference (WordNet) - models judge whether a candidate belongs far better than they author the set itself. On the incompleteness-proof algorithmic construction the gap is +0.34 to +0.29 F1 over a 24x parameter range and does not close; on executable code, models judging at F1 0.74-0.90 author suites admitting only 19-42% of oracle-correct solutions. A control locates the deficit: asked to emit the predicate rather than its extension, the same models reach F1 about 0.99. The failure is not missing knowledge or an inability to specify, but an inability to materialise the region a specification induces. The dominant error is omission, which resists audit: an over-inclusion is a token a reviewer can challenge, a missing member an absence whose discovery is the authoring problem itself. Models detect planted over-inclusions 6-7x more often than planted omissions, and a production deployment of 43,227 items fails omission-first at 10:1. Wired into RLVR, an authored key costs 1.9 points of accuracy against an exact oracle and 18.5 WordNet-relative (six paired seeds, p=0.031). Gating authored verifiers on a known-correct probe cuts false rejection from 58-92% to at most 5%, but keeps only 5-39% of suites. Repairing them instead, by rewriting each wrong expected value to what a reference execution returns, raises yield 3.3-10.6x across four author families.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语言模型从"应试者"转变为"出题者"这一角色的能力，发现模型在一次性、贪心生成且无测试时推理的标准协议下，判断候选答案是否属于某个集合的能力远好于自主创作该集合本身。模型存在系统性遗漏错误（omission），这种错误难以审计，且在实际部署中严重影响性能。
AI.motivation: 语言模型越来越多地被用作"出题者"——编写测试集、答案键、评分标准以及定义其他系统正确性的奖励函数。然而这种角色转变的能力尚未被系统衡量，作者希望探究模型在这类"出题"任务上的真实表现。
AI.method: 在四种参考构架下进行比较实验：(1)两种完整有限真值；(2)带有可执行参考的HumanEval+/MBPP+；(3)显式不完整的词汇参考WordNet。对比模型"判断成员资格"vs"创作集合本身"的能力，并通过控制实验、注入型错误检测实验以及RLVR集成实验进行验证。
AI.result: 模型判断能力显著优于创作能力：不可证明完备的算法构架上F1差距为+0.34到+0.29；可执行代码上模型判断F1达0.74-0.90，但创作的套件只接受19-42%的Oracle正确解。通过控制实验发现，让模型输出谓词而非其外延，F1可达约0.99，说明失败源于无法物化规范所定义的集合区域，而非缺乏知识。遗漏错误比过度包含错误更难被发现（检测率差距6-7倍），实际部署中遗漏优先的失败比达10:1。RLVR中作者键导致准确性损失1.9点；门控可降低误报但保留套件少，修复可提升3.3-10.6倍产出。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型在"出题者"角色下存在系统性的"物化缺陷"：它们能够指定正确的规则（谓词），却无法可靠地枚举出规则所涵盖的完整实例集合。主导错误是遗漏，这种错误天然抵抗审计。需要将已知正确的探针门控或基于参考执行结果的修复作为部署辅助手段。

title: HopRefusalBench: Diagnosing Refusal Failures in Search-Augmented Agents for Multi-Hop Reasoning
summary: Search-augmented large language model agents are increasingly capable of solving knowledge-intensive tasks, but their behavior when a multi-hop question is fundamentally unanswerable remains poorly understood. Existing abstention benchmarks largely expose defects at the surface of single-hop queries and therefore cannot reveal failures that emerge only after valid intermediate reasoning and retrieval. We introduce HopRefusalBench, the first controlled benchmark of refusal within multi-hop search, comprising 889 unanswerable questions constructed from KILT-grounded entity paths. It crosses three causes of unanswerability (answer unknown, false premise, and underspecified context) with root, middle, and terminal topologies, making premise verification, intermediate-bridge validation, and terminal stopping separately observable. We further propose a final-outcome taxonomy spanning target-aware refusal, pseudo-refusal, hallucinated completion, and search-budget exhaustion, together with source-aware trajectory metrics for post-trigger continuation and token waste. Across ten frontier proprietary and open-weight models in search-augmented mode, the best model achieves a target-aware correct halting rate (TCHR) of only 42.9%. Root and middle items are consistently harder than terminal items, and all models attain their highest TCHR on false premises and their lowest on underspecified questions. Yet when pooled across categories, 84.7--98.4% of each model's explicit refusal-like responses identify the correct rationale, localizing the main bottleneck to committing to an appropriate non-answer; failed trajectories instead diverge into hallucination or search-budget exhaustion. These results establish refusal in multi-hop search as a consequential evaluation problem and provide a foundation for diagnosing and improving the reliability of search-augmented agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了HopRefusalBench，首个针对多跳搜索场景下大语言模型智能体拒答行为的受控基准测试，包含889个基于KILT实体路径构建的不可回答问题。研究发现，在十个前沿模型中，最佳模型的目标感知正确中止率（TCHR）仅42.9%，根节点和中节点问题比终端节点更难，而主要瓶颈在于模型无法承诺适当的非答案回应，失败轨迹往往滑向幻觉或搜索预算耗尽。
AI.motivation: 现有拒答基准测试主要暴露单跳查询的表面缺陷，无法揭示仅在有效中间推理和检索后才出现的失败模式。当多跳问题根本不可回答时，搜索增强型大语言模型智能体的行为仍然缺乏理解，因此需要专门的基准来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建HopRefusalBench基准：从KILTgrounded实体路径构建889个不可回答问题，交叉三种不可回答原因（答案未知、错误前提、上下文不充分）与三种拓扑结构（根、中、终端），分别观察前提验证、中间桥梁验证和终端停止。提出最终结果分类法（目标感知拒答、伪拒答、幻觉完成、搜索预算耗尽）以及源感知轨迹指标（触发后延续和令牌浪费）。在十个专有和开源模型中测试搜索增强模式。
AI.result: 最佳模型TCHR仅42.9%。根节点和中节点项目一致比终端项目更难。所有模型在错误前提上TCHR最高，在上下文不充分问题上最低。但综合来看，84.7-98.4%的每个模型的明确拒答式回应识别了正确理由，表明主要瓶颈在于承诺适当的非答案回应，而非识别问题；失败的轨迹则分化为幻觉或搜索预算耗尽。
AI.conclusion: 多跳搜索中的拒答行为是一个重要的评估问题，现有模型的可靠性存在显著不足。该基准为诊断和改进搜索增强智能体的可靠性提供了基础，帮助定位瓶颈在于模型对不可回答问题的承诺与最终决策环节。

title: E2Pano: Learning Event-to-Panorama Image Reconstruction
summary: Event cameras offer microsecond-level temporal resolution and high dynamic range, potentially facilitating motion-blur-free panoramic imaging from fast rotational scanning. Nonetheless, existing optimization-based methods remain computationally demanding, while prior learning-based reconstruction methods are largely designed for perspective imagery and lack geometry-aware support for panoramic outputs. We present E2Pano, a geometry-guided event-to-panorama pipeline with an end-to-end learnable photometric reconstruction stage. Our framework preserves real spherical coordinates from geometric mapping throughout the pipeline, employs a lightweight enhancement module with frequency-domain supervision to bridge the event-image domain gap, and leverages a spherical Transformer with 3D positional embeddings for photometric reconstruction. Experiments on synthetic data and captured rotational scans show improved reconstruction quality and lower photometric reconstruction cost than optimization-based baselines, together with encouraging transfer to real captures under our acquisition protocol despite training purely on synthetic data. Additionally, we construct PanoScan, a dataset with 4,370 synthetic and 30 real-world panoramic scenes paired with event streams. Our dataset and code will be released.

AI.tldr: E2Pano是一个几何引导的事件相机到全景图像重建管线，通过端到端可学习的重建阶段，在合成数据和真实旋转扫描数据上实现了比优化方法更好的重建质量和更低的计算成本。
AI.motivation: 事件相机具有微秒级时间分辨率和宽动态范围，有望实现快速旋转扫描下的无运动模糊全景成像。然而现有优化方法计算开销大，而基于学习的重建方法主要针对透视图像设计，缺乏对全景输出的几何感知支持。
AI.method: E2Pano采用几何引导的事件到全景管线，包含端到端可学习的亮度重建阶段。具体包括：在整个管线中保留几何映射的真实球面坐标；使用带频域监督的轻量增强模块来弥合事件-图像域差距；利用带3D位置嵌入的球形Transformer进行亮度重建。
AI.result: 在合成数据和真实旋转扫描上的实验表明，E2Pano相比优化基线方法具有更好的重建质量和更低的亮度重建成本。尽管仅在合成数据上训练，在采集协议下对真实数据的迁移表现出良好效果。此外构建了包含4,370个合成场景和30个真实世界全景场景及其事件流的PanoScan数据集。
AI.conclusion: E2Pano展示了几何引导的端到端学习方法在事件到全景成像任务中的有效性，为快速旋转扫描场景下的无运动模糊全景成像提供了一种高效且高质量的新途径，同时数据集和代码将公开以促进后续研究。

title: From AI Technical Debt to Agentic Technical Debt: A Systematic Mapping of Root Causes and Manifestations in Agentic AI Systems
comment: 32 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering
summary: The emergence of Agentic AI systems, characterized by autonomous reasoning, multi-agent collaboration, tool orchestration, adaptive decision-making, and persistent memory, represents a fundamental shift from traditional AI pipelines to dynamic software ecosystems. While AI Technical Debt (AITD) has been widely studied in machine learning and software engineering, existing models assume static, component-level architectures and fail to capture the dynamic and emergent behaviors of agentic environments. To address this gap, this paper introduces Agentic Technical Debt (AgTD), defined as technical debt that emerges, accumulates, propagates, and amplifies due to the autonomous and collaborative nature of Agentic AI systems. Building on our prior systematic scoping review of 31 AITDs across seven root-cause categories, we employ a theory-informed transformation methodology to reinterpret these debts in Agentic AI through direct transformation, contextual transformation, and manifestation expansion. We present the first systematic mapping of established AITDs to their agentic manifestations, showing how conventional debts evolve into system-level liabilities, including memory inconsistencies, orchestration fragility, cascading failures, and unsafe autonomous decision-making. Our findings show that technical debt extends beyond software artifacts to encompass agent behaviors, coordination mechanisms, and interactions among agents, tools, and execution environments. We further examine its implications for AI Trust, Risk, and Security Management (AI TRiSM), highlighting impacts on trustworthiness, governance, security, operational resilience, and Sustainability Technical Debt. Overall, this work establishes AgTD as a foundational software engineering construct and provides a transformation framework, taxonomy, and research agenda for managing technical debt in autonomous multi-agent AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"智能体技术债务"(AgTD)这一新概念，将传统AI技术债务(AITD)映射到智能体AI系统中，揭示了技术债务如何从静态组件架构演变为动态系统级责任，并提供了系统性的转换框架、分类体系和未来研究议程。
AI.motivation: 现有AI技术债务模型基于静态、组件级架构假设，无法捕捉智能体AI系统中自主推理、多智能体协作、工具编排等动态涌现行为所带来的技术债务特征，存在明显的研究空白。
AI.method: 基于先前对31种AITD的七类根因的系统性综述，采用理论驱动的转换方法论，通过直接转换、情境转换和表现扩展三种方式将传统技术债务重新诠释为智能体AI语境下的债务形态。
AI.result: 首次系统性地将已建立的AITD映射到智能体化表现，展示常规债务如何演变为系统级责任（如记忆不一致、编排脆弱性、级联故障和不安全的自主决策），并发现技术债务已延伸至智能体行为、协调机制及智能体-工具-执行环境之间的交互层面。
AI.conclusion: AgTD作为基础性软件工程概念得以确立，该工作提供了转换框架、分类体系和未来研究议程，并探讨了其对AI信任、风险与安全管理的影响以及可持续性技术债务的关联。

title: EviSD: Evidence-Conditioned Self-Distillation for Search-Augmented Agents
summary: Outcome-based reinforcement learning enables search-augmented language agents to learn from verifiable final answers, but its trajectory-level credit cannot distinguish the contributions of individual actions in a multi-turn search process. We propose EviSD, an evidence-conditioned self-distillation framework that uses instance-level supporting evidence as privileged information for search actions and golden answers as complementary privilege for answer actions. During training, the student samples actions from the original context, while the same model re-scores them as a privileged teacher under an action-aligned context. EviSD converts the detached teacher--student gap into a bounded correction to the outcome-derived GRPO advantage and applies it only to generated action spans. This design localizes privileged guidance while preserving the update direction determined by the outcome reward, without an auxiliary distillation objective or any change at inference time. Across seven question-answering benchmarks and three backbones spanning model scales and generations, EviSD achieves the highest macro-average Exact Match in all evaluated settings, outperforming the strongest compared methods by 1.3--2.3 points while modulating only 6.7%--15.1% of response tokens. Code is available at https://github.com/JiananXie/EviSD.

AI.tldr: EviSD提出了一种基于证据条件的自蒸馏框架，利用实例级支持证据作为搜索动作的特权信息，将教师-学生差距转化为对GRPO优势的有界修正，在不改变推理过程的情况下提升了检索增强语言代理的多步搜索性能。
AI.motivation: 基于结果的强化学习无法在多变轮搜索过程中区分单个动作的贡献，轨迹级别的信用分配粒度太粗，难以精确定位搜索过程中哪些动作真正有效。
AI.method: 提出EviSD框架，学生从原始上下文采样动作，同一模型在动作对齐的上下文下作为特权教师重新评分；将分离的教师-学生差距转化为对结果派生的GRPO优势的有界修正，仅应用于生成的动作片段上，无需辅助蒸馏目标，推理时不变。
AI.result: 在7个问答基准和3个不同规模与代际的骨干模型上，EviSD在所有设置中均取得最高宏平均精确匹配率，比最强对比方法高出1.3-2.3个百分点，仅调整6.7%-15.1%的响应token。
AI.conclusion: EviSD通过将证据条件化的特权指导局部化在动作片段上，同时保持结果奖励决定的更新方向，有效提升了检索增强语言代理的搜索质量，且不会增加推理开销。

title: Toward Fine-Grained Forgetting:Attribute Unlearning for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) exhibit strong vision--language capabilities but may also memorize and disclose sensitive information. Machine unlearning seeks to remove designated knowledge without retraining from scratch while preserving general utility. Existing privacy-oriented benchmarks primarily adopt profile-level deletion, whereas practical requests are often finer grained: a model should forget a specified attribute while retaining non-sensitive information about the same identity. We therefore introduce attribute-level MLLM unlearning as a finer-grained task and construct a benchmark spanning long-text, numeric, and short-text targets, multiple forget ratios, and diverse question types. Our evaluation reveals that target and retained attributes share identity-specific and visual evidence, making selective forgetting susceptible to residual leakage or collateral degradation; accordingly, existing methods exhibit unstable forgetting--retention trade-offs in this setting. To address this challenge, we propose Causal Localization and Retain-Aware Projection (CLRP), a lightweight training-free framework. CLRP uses activation patching to identify the layer that causally mediates target-attribute disclosure, then applies a retain-aware projection that removes the target-attribute subspace while preserving same-identity evidence. Experiments across multiple widely used MLLMs with distinct architectures and parameter scales demonstrate the effectiveness of CLRP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出属性级多模态大语言模型（MLLM）机器遗忘任务，并构建了涵盖长文本、数值和短文本目标的基准。针对该任务中目标属性与保留属性共享身份特定和视觉证据导致的遗忘-保留权衡不稳定问题，提出了一种轻量级无需训练的CLRP框架（因果定位与保留感知投影），通过激活修补定位因果介导层，再执行保留感知投影去除目标属性子空间同时保留同身份证据，在多种架构和参数规模的MLLM上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有隐私导向的机器遗忘基准主要采用轮廓级（profile-level）删除，而实际请求往往更细粒度——模型应在遗忘指定属性的同时保留同一身份的非敏感信息。因此需要引入属性级MLLM遗忘任务，解决细粒度选择性遗忘中目标与保留属性共享证据导致的残留泄漏和附带退化问题。
AI.method: 提出CLRP（Causal Localization and Retain-Aware Projection）框架，包含两个步骤：首先通过激活修补（activation patching）定位因果介导目标属性披露的层；然后应用保留感知投影，去除目标属性子空间的同时保留同身份证据。该方法为轻量级且无需训练。
AI.result: 构建了覆盖长文本、数值、短文本目标，多种遗忘比例和多种问题类型的属性级遗忘基准。评估发现现有方法在此设置下表现出不稳定的遗忘-保留权衡；CLRP在多种广泛使用的MLLM（不同架构和参数规模）上展示了有效性。
AI.conclusion: 属性级MLLM机器遗忘是一个更细粒度且具有挑战的任务，现有方法难以兼顾遗忘与保留。CLRP通过因果定位与保留感知投影，在不训练的情况下有效解决了目标属性遗忘与同身份信息保留之间的冲突。

title: Language Equality has a Price: A Systematic Investigation of Multi-turn LLM Performance for EU-24+
summary: We evaluate large language models (LLMs) as language agents playing goal-directed dialogue games in self-play across 30 languages: the 24 official EU languages plus six others. Unlike static or preference-based evaluation, this paradigm is multi-turn, reference-free and programmatically scored, and because the game mechanics are language-agnostic it extends to a new language by localising a fixed set of prompt and word-list files. Evaluating nine open-weight and commercial LLMs, we find that no open-weight model covers the EU-24 well: in every official language both commercial systems outscore every open-weight model, and the two weakest average below 40 points across the EU-24. The commercial systems stay ahead even in languages with four orders of magnitude less public web text, showing that linguistic parity is achievable, but not from public crawls alone. A model's home region lifts it without closing the gap: Chinese is the strongest of all 30 languages for two Chinese-developed models, yet the best Chinese score of any model belongs to a US commercial system. Coverage is also not parity of service. Pooled over models and languages, the median non-English language costs 31% more to run than English, and scores 10% lower.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了9个开源和商业大语言模型在30种语言（24种欧盟官方语言+6种其他语言）中作为语言代理进行目标导向对话游戏的自我对弈表现。这类评估是多轮、免参考、程序化评分的。研究发现，没有开源模型能很好地覆盖EU-24语言：在所有官方语言中，商业系统都优于所有开源模型。商业系统即使在公共网页文本少四个数量级的语言中仍保持领先，表明语言均等是可行的，但不能仅靠公共爬虫数据实现。此外，模型的语言覆盖不等于服务均等：非英语语言平均运行成本比英语高31%，得分低10%。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM评估多为静态或基于偏好的方式，无法充分反映模型在多轮对话中的实际能力，且对低资源语言覆盖不足。本文旨在通过一种语言无关的目标导向对话游戏范式，系统性地评估LLM在30种语言中的表现，探究语言覆盖与服务质量均等问题。
AI.method: 采用目标导向的对话游戏自我对弈范式，游戏机制与语言无关，通过本地化固定的提示词和词表文件即可扩展到新语言。评估涵盖30种语言（24种欧盟官方语言+6种其他语言），对9个开源和商业LLM进行了多轮、免参考、程序化评分的评估。
AI.result: 商业系统在所有欧盟官方语言中均优于所有开源模型；两个最强的开源模型在EU-24平均分低于40分。商业系统即使在公共网页文本少四个数量级的语言中仍保持领先。中文是两家中国开发模型最强的语言，但所有模型中的最佳中文成绩属于美国商业系统。非英语语言平均运行成本比英语高31%，得分低10%。
AI.conclusion: 语言均等是可行的，但不能仅依赖公共爬虫数据实现；当前开源模型在多语言覆盖上明显落后于商业系统；模型在母语区域的语言表现虽有提升但不足以弥合差距；语言覆盖的广度和服务的均等性是两个不同维度的问题，需同时关注成本与质量的不平等。

title: AeroLLE: Constrained Pseudo-Supervision for Nighttime Aerial Image Enhancement with the AeroNight-1.5K Benchmark
summary: Nighttime aerial image enhancement is challenged by spatially nonuniform exposure, mixed illumination, and weak structural evidence, while registered normal-light targets are difficult to capture from moving platforms. Generated normal-light images provide practical appearance guidance but may alter geometry or texture. We introduce \aeronight{}, comprising 1,500 real nighttime aerial RGB images: 1,300 inputs are associated with manually screened pseudo-references, and 200 inputs support unpaired evaluation. We propose AeroLLE, a two-stage framework that first recovers visibility with an HVI Base Enhancer and then performs Spatially Adaptive Exposure--Color Calibration (SAECC). After the Base Enhancer is selected and frozen, SAECC predicts bounded, low-resolution RGB gain and bias fields, restricting the magnitude and spatial variation of the second-stage correction. Experiments under complementary pseudo-paired and unpaired protocols demonstrate improved agreement with screened appearance targets, together with more balanced exposure and color correction across diverse nighttime aerial scenes. These results support constrained, stage-specific calibration as a practical strategy for learning from generated appearance guidance when registered aerial references are unavailable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AeroNight数据集（含1,500张真实夜间航拍RGB图像）和AeroLLE两阶段增强框架，通过HVI基础增强器恢复可见度，再以空间自适应曝光-色彩校准（SAECC）进行约束校正，有效应对夜间航拍图像的非均匀曝光和混合光照问题。
AI.motivation: 夜间航拍图像增强面临空间非均匀曝光、混合光照和弱结构证据的挑战，且从移动平台难以获取配准的正常光照参考图像。虽然生成的正常光照图像可提供外观引导，但可能改变几何或纹理，亟需更可靠的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出AeroLLE两阶段框架：第一阶段使用HVI基础增强器恢复图像可见度；第二阶段采用空间自适应曝光-色彩校准（SAECC），预测有界、低分辨率的RGB增益和偏置场，限制第二阶段校正的幅度和空间变化。同时构建包含1,500张真实夜间航拍图像的AeroNight数据集，其中1,300张配有手动筛选的伪参考，200张用于无配对评估。
AI.result: 在互补的伪配对和无配对协议下，AeroLLE显示出与筛选后外观目标更好的一致性，并在多种夜间航拍场景中实现更均衡的曝光和色彩校正。实验结果支持有约束的、分阶段校准策略在缺少配准航拍参考时利用生成外观引导的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 约束式的分阶段特定校准是处理无法获取配准航拍参考时、利用生成外观引导进行夜间航拍图像增强的一种实用策略。

title: FactorJEPA: Factorizing Monolithic Futures into Layout-Agent-Interaction Channels for Crowded and Chaotic Global South Urban Worlds
summary:
World models have attracted significant attention for their ability to capture and predict the structure and dynamics of the physical world. In this emerging landscape, Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) offer a particularly compelling direction.
  We study a largely unexplored regime: populous, crowded, and chaotic Global South urban environments, which we call DENSEWORLD. Unlike the lower-density, lane-structured settings that dominate existing evaluations, these scenes exhibit soft spatial boundaries, extreme agent heterogeneity, persistent occlusion, and rapid social negotiation under mixed traffic. We introduce the first large-scale dataset for this regime: 1,000 hours of drive-through, walk-through, and aerial video across 22 cities. Existing JEPA formulations struggle to preserve dense interaction dynamics under heterogeneity and partial observability.
  We introduce FactorJEPA, which makes world structure a first-class predictive primitive. Rather than encoding the future in a monolithic latent, it composes layout, entities, and interactions, using a visibility gate and separated subspaces to preserve partially observed agents and discourage cross-factor shortcuts. FactorJEPA improves (i) future-latent accuracy (Future-frame L1), (ii) intervention-sensitive prediction (Causal L1), and (iii) robustness to reduced visual evidence (Mask-ratio slope), while exposing (iv) a reproducible motion-information trade-off (Motion cosine). Method rankings replicate across 2B and 1B V-JEPA 2.1 backbones, with rho = 0.895 to 0.978.
  We publicly release the DENSEWORLD-115k dataset (https://huggingface.co/datasets/anonymousML123/denseworld-115k) and the surgery-trained FactorJEPA checkpoints (https://huggingface.co/datasets/anonymousML123/factorjepa-outputs/tree/main/outputs/full/vjepa_2_1_vitg_1B/train/m09c_surgery_3stage_DI_diheavy_encoder).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FactorJEPA，一种将世界结构作为预测原语的联合嵌入预测架构，专为人群密集、混乱的全球南方城市环境（DENSEWORLD）设计，并发布了首个包含1000小时视频的大规模数据集。FactorJEPA通过将未来编码分解为布局、实体和交互三个子空间，并引入可见性门控来保留部分可观察的智能体，在多种指标上优于现有JEPA方法。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型和JEPA架构主要针对低密度、有车道结构的环境进行评估，而忽视了全球南方城市中人口密集、混乱、遮挡严重、异质性高的"拥挤世界"场景。作者希望探索这一未充分研究的领域，并解决现有JEPA公式在异构和部分可观测条件下保持密集交互动力学方面的不足。
AI.method: FactorJEPA将未来编码分解为布局、实体和交互三个分离的子空间，引入可见性门控（visibility gate）来保留部分被遮挡的智能体，并阻止跨因子的捷径学习。同时构建了DENSEWORLD-115k数据集，包含1000小时来自22个城市的行车、步行和航拍视频。
AI.result: FactorJEPA在三个关键指标上均有提升：未来潜在准确率（Future-frame L1）、干预敏感预测（Causal L1）和视觉证据减少的鲁棒性（Mask-ratio slope）。方法排名在2B和1B V-JEPA 2.1骨干网络上具有高度一致性（rho = 0.895至0.978），并揭示了可复现的运动信息权衡（Motion cosine）。
AI.conclusion: FactorJEPA通过显式分解世界结构，显著提升了在拥挤、混乱城市环境下的世界模型预测能力，同时也暴露了运动信息与预测精度之间的内在权衡，为未来在复杂真实世界场景中的世界模型研究提供了新的方向和数据资源。

title: Coverage-Driven Adaptive Keyframe Selection for Video Understanding
summary: Recent advances in large vision-language models (LVLMs) have enabled long-video understanding and analysis. However, processing the large number of frames in a video incurs substantial computational overhead. Existing methods reduce LVLM inference costs by scoring frame-query relevance before inference and selecting keyframes accordingly. Nevertheless, the distribution of relevant frames varies across queries, and these methods often need to score hundreds or thousands of frames. To address this limitation, we propose CSES, a training-free semantic keyframe selector that adaptively determines the numbers of frames to score and keyframes to select. CSES estimates the prominence of the frame-query relevance profile to guide active acquisition and adapt the temporal coverage of each input. It then formulates keyframe selection as a coverage problem that jointly accounts for semantic relevance, temporal redundancy, and visual redundancy. Active acquisition and keyframe selection terminate based on coverage saturation. The selection objective is monotone and submodular, enabling greedy optimization with a standard approximation guarantee. Experiments with four LVLMs on two benchmarks show that our method preserves accuracy while scoring $4$-$13\times$ fewer frames and selecting $18.4\%$-$20.5\%$ fewer input keyframes than existing baselines. CSES further achieves a $3.1$-$5.4\times$ speedup in frame selection over baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CSES，一种无需训练的语义关键帧选择器，通过自适应确定需要评分的帧数量和需要选择的关键帧数量，将关键帧选择建模为覆盖问题，同时考虑语义相关性、时间冗余和视觉冗余，在保持精度的同时大幅减少计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有的长视频理解方法在处理大量视频帧时计算开销巨大，已有方法虽然通过预评分和选择关键帧来降低推理成本，但相关帧的分布因查询而异，且这些方法往往需要对成百上千帧进行评分，效率仍然低下。
AI.method: CSES通过估计帧-查询相关性分布的显著性来指导主动采集并自适应调整时间覆盖范围；将关键帧选择形式化为覆盖问题，同时考虑语义相关性、时间冗余和视觉冗余；主动采集和关键帧选择基于覆盖饱和终止；由于选择目标函数是单调子模的，可采用贪心优化并获得标准近似保证。
AI.result: 在四个LVLMs和两个基准测试上的实验表明，CSES在保持精度的同时，比现有基线少评分4-13倍的帧，少选择18.4%-20.5%的输入关键帧，并且在帧选择上实现了3.1-5.4倍的加速。
AI.conclusion: CSES通过自适应和覆盖驱动的策略有效解决了长视频理解中关键帧选择的计算效率问题，在保持模型性能的同时显著降低了推理成本。

title: Don't Offer What Can't Be Done: Deterministic Executability Gating for LLM Skill Selection at Scale
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures. Preprint. Submitted to the ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD 2027), Applied Data Science Track; currently under review
summary:
Production LLM agents that select from large skill libraries face a limitation that semantic relevance alone cannot resolve: a skill may match a user's topic yet be impossible to execute in the current account state. We present a deployed three-stage selection pipeline for Helpmate, Wix's customer-care assistant. First, a recall-oriented semantic matcher identifies messages related to a ten-skill domain family without consulting account state. Second, a deterministic executability gate removes candidates whose internal hard-stop conditions hold. Because the gate and the skill evaluate the same exit predicates, every blocked candidate would be unable to complete under the same account state, provided predicate parity is preserved and both checks observe fresh authoritative state. Finally, the LLM decides whether to invoke one of the remaining candidates.
  In a post-launch production analysis of 756.6K user messages across 267.6K conversations, semantic matching retained 174,927 messages (23.1%). Within this matched stream, the gate removed 1,039,462 of 1,749,270 skill-message pairs (59.4%), saving 228.8 million skill-description tokens -- 59.1% of the post-semantic skill-description footprint. Together, semantic matching and executability gating reduced skill-description context by 90.5% relative to exposing all ten skills to every message.
  To test whether this pruning affects model behavior rather than context size alone, we replayed a risk-enriched cohort of 1,000 conversations with all ten skills exposed. The model selected a production-blocked skill in 78 conversations (7.8%). This counterfactual result shows that deterministic gating prevents non-executable candidates from influencing model selection, while not claiming downstream tool execution or customer-outcome effects.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Wix客服助手Helpmate中部署的三阶段技能选择流水线：语义匹配、确定性可执行性门控、LLM决策。在生产分析中，该流水线大幅减少了技能描述上下文（90.5%），并通过反事实实验证明门控能防止不可执行技能影响模型选择。
AI.motivation: 生产环境中的LLM代理从大型技能库中选择技能时，仅依赖语义相关性是不够的——一个技能可能在主题上匹配用户问题，但在当前账户状态下无法执行。需要一种机制来过滤掉语义相关但不可执行的技能候选。
AI.method: 提出三阶段选择流水线：(1) 召回导向的语义匹配器识别与十技能领域家族相关的消息，不查询账户状态；(2) 确定性可执行性门控移除满足内部硬停止条件的候选，利用与技能相同的退出谓词和权威状态；(3) LLM在剩余候选中决定是否调用某个技能。
AI.result: 在生产分析中（756.6K用户消息，267.6K对话），语义匹配保留了23.1%的消息；门控在匹配流中移除了59.4%的技能-消息对，节省了228.8M技能描述token（占后语义阶段的59.1%）。整体上下文减少了90.5%。反事实实验显示，若暴露全部十个技能，模型在7.8%的对话中会选择被生产门控阻止的技能。
AI.conclusion: 确定性门控不仅能减少上下文开销，更重要的是能防止不可执行技能对LLM选择产生负面影响，而不声称对下游工具执行或客户结果产生直接效果。

title: Generated Images Are Easier to Forget: A Machine Unlearning Perspective for Synthetic Image Detection
summary: Robust detection of generated images is critical to counter the misuse of generative models. Existing methods primarily depend on learning from human-annotated training datasets, limiting their generalization to unseen distributions. In contrast, large-scale vision models (LVMs) pre-trained on web-scale datasets exhibit exceptional generalization power through exposure to diverse distributions, offering a transformative paradigm for this task. However, our experimental results reveal that LVMs pre-trained on natural-image-dominated data can effectively capture the features of both natural and generated images, yielding comparably low losses and thus limited discriminative capacity between them. This prompts a key question: When and how do LVMs exhibit different behaviors when capturing features of natural and generated images? This investigation reveals an insight: during unlearning, LVMs exhibit disparate forgetting dynamics with feature degradation for generated images escalating faster than natural ones. Inspired by the disparate dynamics, we introduce two detection methods: 1) data-free detection, which prunes model parameters to induce unlearning without data access, and 2) data-driven detection, which optimizes LVMs to unlearn knowledge tied to generated images. Extensive experiments conducted on various benchmarks demonstrate that our unlearning-based approach outperforms conventional detection methods. By recasting the detection task as a problem of machine unlearning, our work establishes a new paradigm for generated image detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于机器遗忘（machine unlearning）的生成图像检测新范式。研究发现大型视觉模型（LVMs）在遗忘过程中，对生成图像的特征退化速度快于自然图像，基于这一差异提出了两种检测方法：无数据检测（通过剪枝诱导遗忘）和数据驱动检测（优化LVMs遗忘生成图像知识），实验证明该方法优于传统检测方法。
AI.motivation: 现有生成图像检测方法依赖人工标注训练集，泛化能力有限。虽然大规模视觉模型（LVMs）具有强大的泛化能力，但实验发现这些模型在自然图像主导的数据上预训练后，对自然图像和生成图像都表现出较低的损失，难以直接区分二者。因此需要探索LVMs在何时以及如何对两类图像表现出不同行为。
AI.method: 1) 通过实验揭示LVMs在遗忘过程中对生成图像的特征退化速度快于自然图像这一关键洞察；2) 提出无数据检测方法，通过剪枝模型参数诱导遗忘，无需访问数据；3) 提出数据驱动检测方法，优化LVMs以遗忘与生成图像相关的知识；4) 将生成图像检测任务重新定义为机器遗忘问题。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，基于遗忘的检测方法在性能上优于传统的生成图像检测方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将检测任务重新定义为机器遗忘问题，本文为生成图像检测建立了一个新的研究范式，展示了利用LVMs遗忘动力学差异进行检测的有效性和优越性。

title: Control Under Compression: Reliability Frontiers for Tool-Using Agents
summary: Tool-using language-model agents are governed not only by task prompts but also by persistent system-side instructions that specify tools, arguments, policies, execution protocols, and recovery. Compressing these agent control contexts (ACCs) can reduce input cost and context use, yet existing prompt-compression evaluations do not reveal whether the resulting control remains operationally reliable. We introduce CompressAgent, an environment-verified benchmark for ACC compression across nine independently constructed ACCs, three task families, three fixed Qwen API model identifiers, six retained-context budgets, and 15,525 runs. We uncover a nonlinear, method-dependent reliability frontier. At 75% retained context, generic rewriting and section-based compression achieve 92.7% and 92.4% success, close to the 93.8% full-context baseline. Between 50% and 35%, methods diverge sharply; at 35%, section-based, obligation-aware, and generic rewriting achieve 47.0%, 39.0%, and 19.9%. At retained-context budgets from 25% to 10%, executable protocols become fragile. Reliability also varies substantially across ACCs, making universal compressor rankings inappropriate and motivating per-context qualification. Failure analysis shows that compression primarily surfaces as tool-execution and action-parsing errors. These findings recast ACC compression from token reduction into a runtime-reliability problem that must be evaluated through executable outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CompressAgent，一个面向代理控制上下文（ACC）压缩的环境验证基准，涵盖9个ACC、3个任务族、3个Qwen API模型、6个保留上下文预算和15,525次运行。研究发现压缩可靠性呈非线性、方法依赖的前沿：75%保留时接近全量基线，50%-35%区间方法表现急剧分化，25%以下可执行协议变得脆弱，且不同ACC间可靠性差异显著，压缩失败主要表现为工具执行和动作解析错误。
AI.motivation: 现有提示压缩评估无法验证压缩后的控制指令是否在运行时保持操作可靠性。代理控制上下文（ACC）作为系统性系统侧指令，其压缩可能牺牲工具执行、策略遵循和恢复协议等关键能力，需要用可执行结果来评估而非仅看token缩减效果。
AI.method: 构建CompressAgent基准，包含9个独立构建的ACC、3个任务族、3个固定的Qwen API模型、6个保留上下文预算，共15,525次运行。通过环境验证方式评估不同压缩方法（通用重写、基于章节的压缩、义务感知压缩等）在不同保留预算下的任务成功率，并进行失败分析和跨ACC可靠性对比。
AI.result: 75%保留上下文时，通用重写和章节压缩分别达到92.7%和92.4%的成功率，接近93.8%的全量基线。在50%-35%区间方法急剧分化：35%时章节压缩47.0%、义务感知39.0%、通用重写19.9%。25%-10%保留区间可执行协议变得脆弱。不同ACC间可靠性差异显著，压缩失败主要为工具执行和动作解析错误。
AI.conclusion: ACC压缩应从token缩减问题重新定位为运行时可靠性问题，必须通过可执行结果进行评估。通用压缩器排名不适用于所有场景，需要进行逐上下文（per-context）的压缩资格验证。

title: Foveated Probes Recover Localized Binding Information in Vision Foundation Models
summary: Frozen vision foundation models are commonly evaluated through a single global image embedding, but this interface can conflate missing information with information lost at readout time. We study this distinction by keeping a pretrained vision encoder frozen and varying only the readout applied to its final patch tokens. We compare standard global readouts against a lightweight foveated readout, which attention-pools patch tokens using a learned or question-conditioned query, and against an oracle readout with access to the annotated target region. We evaluate these interfaces on three localized binding problems: a controlled synthetic color--shape binding task under clutter, a color-free crowded shape-detection variant, and a GQA-derived natural-image task where paired questions ask for the colors of different same-category objects in the same image. Global readouts perform near perfectly when the synthetic target appears alone, but collapse under clutter and counterfactual target edits, whereas the foveated readout recovers most of the oracle-accessible signal. On the GQA-derived task, question-independent global image vectors improve only modestly over question-only priors, while question-conditioned foveation substantially improves paired localized color accuracy. A counterfactual nuisance-to-signal ratio explains the synthetic failures: global pooling dilutes localized label-changing evidence while exposing the probe to nuisance variation from irrelevant objects. These results indicate that apparent spatial blindness in frozen vision models can arise from the global embedding interface rather than from an absence of spatial information in the frozen patch tokens.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了冻结视觉基础模型中"空间盲区"的来源，通过固定编码器、仅改变读出方式（全局读出 vs. 注视点读出 vs. 神谕读出），发现全局嵌入接口会稀释局部信息并暴露于无关干扰，而轻量级的注视点读出能恢复大部分空间信号，表明空间信息其实存在于冻结的patch token中，问题出在读出接口而非模型本身。
AI.motivation: 冻结视觉基础模型通常仅通过单一全局图像嵌入进行评估，但这种接口可能将"信息缺失"与"读出时信息丢失"混为一谈。作者希望厘清这一区分，探究冻结视觉模型表现出的空间盲区究竟是编码器缺乏空间信息，还是全局读出接口本身造成的瓶颈。
AI.method: 保持预训练视觉编码器冻结，仅改变最终patch token上的读出方式：对比标准全局读出、轻量级注视点读出（用学习或问题条件化的query对patch token做注意力池化），以及可访问标注目标区域的神谕读出。在三个局部绑定任务上评估：合成颜色-形状绑定（含杂波）、无颜色密集形状检测变体、以及基于GQA的自然图像任务（配对问题询问同一图像中不同同类物体的颜色）。
AI.result: 全局读出在目标单独出现时表现近乎完美，但在杂波和反事实目标编辑下崩溃；注视点读出恢复了大部分神谕可访问的信号。在GQA任务上，问题无关的全局图像向量仅比问题先验略有提升，而问题条件化的注视点读出显著提升了配对局部颜色准确率。反事实"干扰-信号比"理论解释了合成失败：全局池化稀释了局部标签改变的证据，同时将探针暴露于无关物体的干扰变化。
AI.conclusion: 冻结视觉模型表现出的空间盲区可能源于全局嵌入接口本身，而非冻结patch token中缺乏空间信息。通过轻量级的注视点读出即可恢复大部分空间信号，提示改进读出接口而非重新训练编码器是提升空间感知能力的有效路径。

title: Role-Decoupled Attention Residuals: Separating Matching and Content Retrieval Across Depth
summary: Depth-routing residual architectures allow Transformer layers to retrieve earlier representations instead of inheriting only the immediately preceding state. Existing Block Attention Residuals, however, use a single content-dependent depth mixture to construct the inputs to queries, keys, and values. This design couples two functionally different decisions: queries and keys determine where attention matches, whereas values determine what content is retrieved. We therefore ask whether matching and content retrieval should be forced to read from the same depth. We introduce Role-Decoupled Attention Residuals (RD-AttnRes), a minimal extension that shares one depth route between queries and keys while learning an independent value route over the same residual sources. Tying the two routing queries exactly recovers the parent architecture, while decoupling them adds only one model-width vector per layer and introduces no additional token-to-token attention operation. We evaluate RD-AttnRes using a frozen, paired pretraining protocol on FineWeb-Edu with five matched seeds for both 120M- and 343M-parameter models and a 2.0B-token training budget. RD-AttnRes improves validation negative log-likelihood in all 10 matched comparisons. The mean reductions are 0.0301 and 0.0247, corresponding to perplexity reductions of 2.97 percent and 2.43 percent at 120M and 343M parameters, respectively. Early-budget controls indicate that neither the additional parameter count, duplicated routing execution, nor a fixed value route reproduces the improvement. Routing diagnostics further reveal persistent divergence between the query-key and value depth distributions. These results suggest that, within the evaluated training regime, attention matching and content retrieval benefit from distinct reads over the residual hierarchy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出角色解耦注意力残差（RD-AttnRes），通过为查询/键和值分别学习独立的深度路由，解耦Transformer残差架构中"注意力匹配"与"内容检索"两种功能。在120M和343M参数模型上，10组匹配对比中全部提升，困惑度分别降低2.97%和2.43%。
AI.motivation: 现有Block Attention Residuals使用单一的内容相关深度混合来同时构造查询、键和值，这耦合了两种功能上不同的决策：查询和键决定注意力在哪里匹配，而值决定检索什么内容。作者质疑这两者是否应强制从相同的深度读取信息。
AI.method: RD-AttnRes是现有架构的最小扩展：查询和键共享一条深度路由，同时为值学习独立的深度路由（仅添加每层一个模型宽度向量，无额外token间注意力操作）。将两条路由绑定可精确恢复父架构，解耦则引入独立性。实验采用冻结的配对预训练协议，在FineWeb-Edu上使用5个匹配随机种子对120M和343M参数模型进行2.0B token训练预算的评估。
AI.result: 全部10组匹配对比中RD-AttnRes均优于基线。120M和343M参数下平均负对数似然分别降低0.0301和0.0247，对应困惑度降低2.97%和2.43%。早期预算对照实验排除了参数增加、重复路由执行或固定值路由等替代解释。路由诊断显示查询-键和值的深度分布在持续发生分歧。
AI.conclusion: 在评估的训练机制下，注意力匹配和内容检索确实受益于对残差层级的不同读取，支持将这两种功能在深度路由上进行解耦的设计思路。

title: MDTD-ArtIR: Benchmarking Image Editing and Restoration Models for Art Image Restoration under Texture-Overlay Degradations
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Preprint submitted to Elsevier Journal of Visual Communication and Image Representation
summary: Restoring severely degraded visual media still remains a formidable challenge, as existing methods often hallucinate unnatural textures and contents, struggle with preserving color and texture, or fail to leverage partially retained image information. Existing restoration benchmarks assume known degradation operators and fail to capture the complex characteristics of artistic damage such as cracks, stains, and color/texture deviation. We introduce a controlled benchmark for blind restoration of semantic, semi-transparent image media degradations, accompanied by a new, publicly open degradation alpha texture mask dataset MDTD-Art. We present a new dataset and benchmark evaluating state-of-the-art universal restoration models against image editing and vision-language models across varying mask opacity levels. Our experiments demonstrate that image editing models consistently outperform specialized restoration architectures for arbitrary degradations, with performance gains amplified by structured prompt engineering emphasizing detail preservation and structural consistency. These findings position recoverable semantic information and prompt controllability as critical factors in art image restoration.

AI.tldr: 本文引入了针对盲恢复语义性、半透明图像介质退化问题的受控基准，并发布了新的公开退化Alpha纹理掩码数据集MDTD-Art。实验表明，在任意退化场景下，图像编辑模型始终优于专门的恢复架构，且结构化提示工程可进一步放大性能优势，凸显了可恢复语义信息和提示可控性在艺术图像恢复中的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 现有恢复方法在处理严重退化的视觉媒体时，常产生不自然的纹理和内容，难以保持颜色和纹理一致性，或未能充分利用部分保留的图像信息。此外，现有基准假设退化算子已知，无法捕捉艺术损伤（如裂纹、污渍、颜色/纹理偏差）的复杂特征。
AI.method: 构建了一个针对语义性、半透明图像介质退化的受控基准，配套发布了公开的退化Alpha纹理掩码数据集MDTD-Art，并在不同掩码不透明度水平下，系统评估了最先进的通用恢复模型、图像编辑模型以及视觉-语言模型的表现。
AI.result: 图像编辑模型在任意退化场景下始终优于专门的恢复架构，且通过强调细节保留和结构一致性的结构化提示工程，性能增益被进一步放大。
AI.conclusion: 可恢复的语义信息与提示可控性应被视为艺术图像恢复中的关键因素，为后续恢复方法与基准设计提供了新的方向。

title: Inter-Residue Geometry Attention for Antibody-Specific Epitope Prediction
summary: Antibody-specific epitope prediction aims to identify which antigen residues are recognized by a given antibody, a task that depends on the three-dimensional complementarity between antibody CDRs and the antigen surface. Existing methods usually leverage PLM embeddings and inject structure through additional graph, surface, or point-cloud encoders, where the positional mechanism inside attention remains largely tied to one-dimensional sequence order. For proteins, the analogue of a token offset is not only sequence separation, but also the three-dimensional displacement between residues after folding. This raises a question, can folded residue geometry serve as the positional mechanism of attention itself? We propose Local-Frame 3D Rotary Position Encoding (LF3DRoPE), which expresses inter-residue displacements in backbone-defined local frames and injects them directly into rotary attention. This design preserves continuous directional geometry while ensuring invariance to global $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ transformations. On the AsEP benchmark, LF3DRoPE achieves state-of-the-art $\mathrm{MCC}$ on both ratio and epitope-group splits. Ablations and rigid transformation tests show that local three-dimensional geometry provides information beyond sequence-order attention while preserving invariance to arbitrary global coordinate systems. Mutation ranking results further indicate that LF3DRoPE captures antigen-specific structural compatibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LF3DRoPE，将折叠蛋白质的三维残基几何位移直接嵌入旋转注意力机制作为位置编码，替代传统的一维序列顺序位置编码，在抗体特异性表位预测任务上取得SOTA结果。
AI.motivation: 现有抗体表位预测方法通常依赖PLM嵌入并通过额外的图、表面或点云编码器注入结构信息，而注意力内部的位罝机制仍受限于一维序列顺序。然而对蛋白质而言，残基间的偏移不仅包括序列间隔，还包括折叠后的三维空间位移。作者提出疑问：折叠残基几何能否直接充当注意力的位罝机制？
AI.method: 提出局部框架三维旋转位置编码（LF3DRoPE），在骨架定义的局部坐标系中表达残基间位移，并将其直接注入旋转注意力中。该设计保持连续方向几何信息，同时保证对全局SE(3)变换的不变性。
AI.result: 在AsEP基准上，LF3DRoPE在ratio和epitope-group两种划分下均取得SOTA的MCC指标。消融实验和刚性变换测试表明局部三维几何提供了超越序列顺序注意力的信息，同时保持对任意全局坐标系统的不变性。突变排名结果进一步表明该方法能捕捉抗原特异性结构兼容性。
AI.conclusion: 将蛋白质折叠后的三维残基几何直接作为注意力位置机制是有效的，LF3DRoPE成功利用局部三维几何补充序列顺序注意力，提升了抗体表位预测性能。

title: Two-Stage Bengali Sentiment Classification: Domain Adaptation Through Continual Learning and Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
summary: Understanding sentiment in low-resource languages remains a key challenge for Natural Language Processing (NLP), particularly when domain-specific data is scarce. In this work, we present SentiBanglaBERT, a two-stage Bengali sentiment classification framework combining domain-adaptive continual pretraining and parameter-efficient fine-tuning. The approach enables contextual adaptation to news-style data while remaining computationally efficient through Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). Beyond performance, SentiBanglaBERT integrates SHAP-based interpretability, offering linguistic insights into how Bengali morphological cues, such as negation suffixes and aspectual markers, influence sentiment predictions. Experiments demonstrate stable performance comparable to strong baselines while providing greater transparency and interpretive depth. This framework highlights the potential of domain-adaptive continual learning as a foundation for interpretable, resource-efficient NLP in morphologically rich, underrepresented languages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SentiBanglaBERT，一个两阶段孟加拉语情感分类框架，结合领域自适应持续预训练和参数高效微调（LoRA），并集成SHAP可解释性分析，在低资源语言情感分析任务上达到与强基线相当的性能，同时提供更高的模型透明度和语言学洞察。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言（特别是孟加拉语）的情感分析仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在领域特定数据稀缺的情况下。现有方法在性能与可解释性之间难以兼顾，且缺乏对形态学丰富的低资源语言的有效建模方案。
AI.method: 采用两阶段框架：第一阶段进行领域自适应的持续预训练，使模型适应新闻风格数据；第二阶段使用低秩自适应（LoRA）进行参数高效微调。同时集成SHAP可解释性工具，分析孟加拉语形态学线索（如否定后缀和体标记）对情感预测的影响。
AI.result: 实验表明，该框架在性能上与强基线模型相当且表现稳定，同时提供了更强的模型可解释性和更深层的语言学洞察。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了领域自适应持续学习在形态学丰富且代表性不足的低资源语言中，构建可解释且资源高效NLP系统的潜力。

title: LUT: Latent Utility Training for Visual Reasoning
summary: Multimodal large language models have advanced visual understanding, yet perception-intensive reasoning remains challenging. Recent latent visual reasoning methods introduce hidden-space computation before answering, but they often rely on costly intermediate supervision, such as bounding boxes, sketches, or interleaved rationales. These strategies focus on how latent states should be shaped, but do not explicitly assess whether the latent is useful for the final answer. We propose LUT, a latent reasoning framework trained with only standard VQA pairs. LUT centers training on Latent Utility at two levels. At the trajectory level, we propose Utility-Aware Latent Distillation SFT, which explores answer-relevant latent trajectories, selects qualified trajectories by their information gain, and distills more reliable and learnable supervision through curriculum learning. At the step level, we propose Latent Attribution Policy Optimization, which uses answer-to-latent attribution to differentially optimize latent steps during reinforcement learning. Experiments on perception-intensive visual reasoning benchmarks show that LUT outperforms previous latent reasoning methods and remains competitive with latent-text interleaved methods with lower annotation cost.

AI.tldr: 提出LUT框架，仅用标准VQA对训练，通过轨迹级和步骤级两个层面的"潜在效用"优化，实现无需昂贵中间监督的高效潜在视觉推理。
AI.motivation: 现有的潜在视觉推理方法虽然引入隐藏空间计算，但依赖昂贵的中间监督（边界框、草图、交错推理文本），且只关注潜在状态如何塑造，未显式评估潜在状态对最终答案是否有用。
AI.method: 1）轨迹级：提出Utility-Aware Latent Distillation SFT，探索与答案相关的潜在轨迹，按信息增益筛选合格轨迹，并通过课程学习蒸馏更可靠和可学习的监督；2）步骤级：提出Latent Attribution Policy Optimization，利用答案到潜在状态的归因在强化学习中差异化优化潜在步骤。
AI.result: 在感知密集型视觉推理基准上，LUT优于之前的潜在推理方法，并保持与潜在文本交错方法相当的竞争力，且标注成本更低。
AI.conclusion: 仅使用标准VQA训练数据即可实现高效的潜在视觉推理，验证了"潜在效用"导向训练策略的有效性。

title: MA-HEAD-Net: Adaptive Rule-Guided Multi-Agent DRL for AoI Minimization in UAV-Assisted Emergency Networks
summary: In post-disaster scenarios, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are critical for establishing emergency communication networks. For time-critical rescue missions, information freshness is crucial because decisions based on outdated data may lead to ineffective control actions. This paper investigates age of information (AoI) minimization for UAV-assisted emergency communications with heterogeneous emergency services. We model bursty packet arrivals using a Markov-modulated Poisson process and adopt finite blocklength theory to capture the coupling among transmission duration, packet completion, and AoI evolution. To balance delay-tolerant long-packet transmission and urgent short-packet response, we propose a mini-slot-embedded scheduling mechanism with adaptive checkpoint-interval selection. We formulate the joint optimization of UAV trajectory control, user scheduling, and checkpoint-interval selection as a multi-agent decision problem, and develop MA-HEAD-Net, an adaptive rule-guided multi-agent deep reinforcement learning framework. MA-HEAD-Net incorporates communication-domain rule priors into a gated multi-head policy, where adaptive gates regulate the contributions of rule-prior and learned-policy logits for different subtasks. The policy and gating components are jointly optimized under multi-agent proximal policy optimization. Simulation results show that MA-HEAD-Net improves policy-formation efficiency compared with representative multi-agent deep reinforcement learning baselines and achieves lower AoI than both learning-based and heuristic methods in dynamic UAV-assisted emergency communication scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文研究UAV辅助应急通信中的信息新鲜度（AoI）最小化问题，提出MA-HEAD-Net多智能体深度强化学习框架，通过嵌入式小时间槽调度和自适应检查点间隔选择来平衡长包与短包传输，实现动态场景下的AoI优化。
AI.motivation: 灾后场景中UAV对建立应急通信网络至关重要，而时间关键的救援任务要求信息保持新鲜，过时数据会导致无效的控制决策。已有方法未能有效处理异构紧急服务的突发流量特性和传输时延与信息新鲜度之间的耦合关系。
AI.method: 采用Markov调制泊松过程建模突发数据包到达，利用有限块长理论刻画传输时长、数据包完成与AoI演化的耦合关系；提出小时间槽嵌入式调度机制与自适应检查点间隔选择；将UAV轨迹控制、用户调度和检查点间隔选择联合优化建模为多智能体决策问题；开发MA-HEAD-Net框架，将通信域规则先验融入门控多头策略网络，并在多智能体近端策略优化下联合优化策略与门控组件。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，MA-HEAD-Net相比代表性多智能体深度强化学习基线方法在策略形成效率上有所提升，并且在动态UAV辅助应急通信场景中实现了比基于学习的方法和启发式方法更低的AoI。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的MA-HEAD-Net通过融合通信域规则先验与学习策略，有效提升了多智能体强化学习在UAV应急通信场景中的性能，实现了更优的信息新鲜度保障。

title: DocNavRAG: Document-Structured Graph RAG with Stateful Evidence Construction for Complex Document Question Answering
summary: Answering complex questions over large document collections requires assembling complementary evidence across sections and documents. GraphRAG offers structured retrieval but typically uses fixed traversal, while agentic RAG operates over weakly structured interfaces. Our key insight is that agents should navigate document structure within and across documents rather than repeatedly search from scratch. We introduce DocNavRAG, which organizes document hierarchies and cross-region relations into a navigable graph, exposes graph operations for locating, navigating, expanding, and fetching, and maintains an evolving evidence state to guide retrieval until sufficient evidence is collected. Across four long- and multi-document QA benchmarks, DocNavRAG improves answer quality and context sufficiency over the strongest baseline by 7.8\% and 17.7\% on average.

AI.tldr: DocNavRAG提出将文档层级结构和跨区域关系组织为可导航图，通过图操作（定位、导航、扩展、获取）和动态证据状态来指导复杂文档问答的检索过程，在四个长文档和多文档问答基准上平均比最强基线提升7.8%的答案质量和17.7%的上下文充分性。
AI.motivation: 现有GraphRAG依赖固定路径遍历，结构化检索缺乏灵活性；而agentic RAG在弱结构化接口上反复从头搜索，效率低下且难以有效整合跨文档的互补证据。作者认为智能体应在文档内部及跨文档之间导航结构，而非重复搜索。
AI.method: DocNavRAG将文档层级结构和跨区域关系构建为可导航图，提供定位（locating）、导航（navigating）、扩展（expanding）和获取（fetching）四种图操作，并维护一个持续演化的证据状态来引导检索过程，直到收集到足够证据。
AI.result: 在四个长文档和多文档QA基准上，DocNavRAG相较于最强基线在答案质量上平均提升7.8%，在上下文充分性上平均提升17.7%。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化导航而非重复搜索，DocNavRAG有效提升了复杂文档集合问答的证据整合能力和检索效率，验证了"智能体应在文档结构内导航"这一核心洞见的有效性。

title: ChordVideo: One-Step, Training-Free, Temporally Consistent Video Editing via Low-Energy Transport
summary: One-step text-to-image models enable training-free, inversion-free editing with only 1--2 network function evaluations (NFE), while ChordEdit stabilizes such edits through low-energy smoothing along sampling time. Applied independently to video frames, however, it produces temporal flicker and edit-strength drift. We introduce \textbf{ChordVideo}, which extends the same low-energy principle to video time through shared noise, motion-aligned causal aggregation of per-frame Chord fields, and an optional temporally smoothed proximal correction. We derive a warping-error bound that separates motion bias from stochastic flicker and predicts diminishing returns with larger temporal windows. On TGVE/DAVIS with two one-step backbones, ChordVideo reduces warping error by \textbf{78\%} and flicker by \textbf{49\%}, improves CLIP frame consistency by \textbf{9--10 points}, and increases background PSNR by about \textbf{1.5,dB}, while retaining \textbf{2 NFE/frame}. Compared with seven multi-step editors, it achieves competitive temporal consistency and source preservation using \textbf{10--60$\times$ fewer model steps per clip

AI.tldr: ChordVideo是一种将单步文本到图像编辑模型扩展到视频编辑的方法，通过共享噪声、运动对齐的因果聚合和时域平滑校正，在保持每帧仅2次网络函数评估的条件下，显著减少时间闪烁和编辑强度漂移，相比多步编辑器性能相当且速度快10-60倍。
AI.motivation: 单步文本到图像编辑模型在独立应用于视频帧时会产生时间闪烁和编辑强度漂移问题，现有ChordEdit方法仅针对静态图像设计，无法直接推广到视频编辑场景。
AI.method: 将低能量平滑原理从采样时间扩展到视频时间维度，具体包括：共享噪声、运动对齐的因果聚合每帧Chord场，以及可选的时间平滑近端校正。同时推导了形变误差上界，将运动偏差与随机闪烁分离。
AI.result: 在TGVE/DAVIS数据集上使用两个单步骨干网络，将形变误差降低78%，闪烁降低49%，CLIP帧一致性提升9-10点，背景PSNR提升约1.5dB，同时保持每帧2 NFE。相比七个多步编辑器，推理效率高10-60倍且时间一致性和源保留性能相当。
AI.conclusion: ChordVideo有效解决了单步模型在视频编辑中的时间一致性问题，以极低的计算成本达到甚至超越多步编辑器的性能，理论分析表明更大的时间窗口收益递减。

title: PATH-Bench: Path-Dependent Evaluation of Lifelong Agents
summary: Lifelong LLM agents increasingly adapt through external learning states that store past interactions as retrievable memories or reusable skills, yet existing benchmarks rarely account for how the path of accumulated experience shapes what agents transfer and retain. In this work, we establish PATH-Bench, a benchmark for path-dependent evaluation of lifelong agents. PATH-Bench estimates directed task relationships via multi-model in-context learning, constructs probe-centered sequences with controlled helpful and interfering histories, and repeatedly evaluates probe tasks to measure average performance, forward transfer, backward transfer, and forgetting. We evaluate eight representative agents on single-turn code generation and multi-turn tool-use tasks under positive- and negative-dominant histories. Benchmark results show that experience utility depends jointly on how experience is represented and on the task's interaction structure, that strong transfer does not ensure retention, and that later experience can reshape gains acquired earlier in the learning path. Based on these findings, we propose Selective Experience Use (SEU), an agent harness that regulates how path-accumulated experience influences each new task, admitting helpful items while filtering out potential interference. SEU consistently reduces forgetting while improving forward transfer in the majority of settings. The PATH-Bench provides both a controlled evaluation framework and actionable guidance for designing more selective and robust lifelong agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PATH-Bench基准，用于评估终身学习智能体的路径依赖学习能力，并基于发现提出选择性经验使用（SEU）机制来减少遗忘并提升正向迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有终身学习智能体基准很少考虑经验积累路径如何影响智能体的迁移与保留能力，缺乏对路径依赖效应的系统评估框架。
AI.method: PATH-Bench通过多模型上下文学习估计有向任务关系，构建以探针为中心的序列（包含受控的有利和干扰历史），并反复评估探针任务以测量平均性能、正向迁移、反向迁移和遗忘；在此基础上提出SEU，通过学习路径中积累的经验选择性地影响每个新任务，过滤潜在干扰。
AI.result: 在八个代表性智能体上评估表明：经验效用取决于经验表示方式和任务交互结构的联合作用，强迁移不保证强保留，后期经验可重塑早期获得的收益。SEU在大多数设置中一致减少遗忘并提升正向迁移。
AI.conclusion: PATH-Bench提供了受控的评估框架和设计更选择性、更稳健的终身学习智能体的可操作指导。

title: CADENA: Stepwise CAD Reverse Engineering
summary: Computer-Aided Design (CAD) underpins modern engineering, yet converting existing shapes into editable models still demands substantial expert effort. Most AI systems emit the entire CAD program in a single pass, never inspecting the intermediate geometry. In contrast, human engineers build a part feature by feature, checking after each operation what remains to be modeled. We introduce CADENA (Spanish for "chain"), a model that reconstructs a 3D mesh as a parametric CAD program, growing its sequence of operations one at a time and comparing the target with the currently predicted geometry at every step. We also address the lack of benchmarks for evaluating reverse-engineering methods on mechanical parts, introducing CADENA-Bench, a benchmark that measures performance across categories of mechanical parts. CADENA outperforms prior methods on CADENA-Bench and on the DeepCAD, Fusion 360, and MCB datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/zhemdi/cadena, model weights at https://huggingface.co/kulibinai/cadena, and CADENA-Bench at https://huggingface.co/datasets/kulibinai/cadena-bench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CADENA，一种逐步生成参数化CAD程序的模型，在每一步将当前预测几何与目标网格对比，并引入CADENA-Bench基准来评估机械零件的逆向工程方法，在多个数据集上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有AI系统在将已有形状转换为可编辑CAD模型时，通常一次性生成整个CAD程序，无法在生成过程中检查中间几何。而人类工程师是逐步构建零件、每步检查剩余建模内容。这种"一步到位"的方法缺乏对中间几何的监督，导致重建质量受限。此外，机械零件逆向工程缺乏专门的评估基准。
AI.method: CADENA采用逐步（sequential）方式生成CAD操作序列，每次生成一个操作后即将当前预测几何与目标3D网格进行对比，利用该差异指导后续操作的生成。同时构建了CADENA-Bench基准，按机械零件类别评估逆向工程方法的性能。
AI.result: CADENA在CADENA-Bench以及DeepCAD、Fusion 360和MCB数据集上均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过逐步生成并实时比较中间几何的方法，显著提升了从网格重建参数化CAD程序的准确性，并提供了新的基准以推动机械零件逆向工程研究。

title: The Graph Language: How Knowledge Graphs Speak to Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at reasoning but benefit from grounding provided by Knowledge Graphs (KGs). However, integrating these paradigms is challenging. We introduce GRALAN, which enables KGs to speak directly in the LLM's semantic space through relational tokens that preserve graph structure. GRALAN-s trainable language mediator generates structured tokens for any frozen LLM, creating a foundation for knowledge-intensive applications. We demonstrate its effectiveness in question-answering by re-framing the task as entity classification over question-focused subgraphs. Experiments show that GRALAN significantly outperforms existing methods, particularly on complex multi-hop reasoning tasks, establishing a new paradigm for KG-LLM integration that maintains structural fidelity while leveraging LLMs' reasoning capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRALAN框架，通过可训练的语言中介器将知识图谱转换为LLM语义空间中的关系令牌，使冻结的LLM能够直接理解图结构，并在问答任务中通过实体分类实现显著优于现有方法的多跳推理性能。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在推理方面表现出色，但缺乏知识图谱（KGs）提供的结构化知识支撑。然而，将这两种范式有效整合面临巨大挑战，现有方法难以在保持图结构完整性的同时充分利用LLM的推理能力。
AI.method: GRALAN引入一个可训练的语言中介器（trainable language mediator），将知识图谱中的关系转换为与LLM语义空间对齐的结构化令牌（relational tokens），从而保留图的拓扑结构。在问答任务中，将问题重新框架为基于问题聚焦子图的实体分类任务。
AI.result: 实验表明GRALAN显著优于现有方法，尤其在复杂的多跳推理任务上表现突出，建立了KG-LLM集成的新范式。
AI.conclusion: GRALAN证明了一种在保持图结构保真度的同时利用LLM推理能力进行KG-LLM集成的有效新途径，为知识密集型应用奠定了基础。

title: Semantic Alignment of AI Models: Concept Collapse, Checkpoint Dynamics, and Cross-Lingual Transfer
summary: Language model benchmarking is a difficult task. Outcome reasoning alone does not test the model's conceptualization of language and popular open-source benchmarks are quickly saturated or ingested as training data. It is important to test the model's output, but augmenting these tests by characterizing semantic structure gives more insight to how models relate abstract concepts. However, the high dimensional embedding spaces are not easy to interpret. This work demonstrates how topological methods can be used to rigorously compare these spaces to low dimensional and interpretable baselines like ontologies and curated knowledge graphs. These multi-modal alignment tests make it possible to track model adaptations and test phrase understanding across multiple languages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用拓扑方法将语言模型的高维嵌入空间与低维可解释的基准（如本体论和知识图谱）进行严格对齐比较，从而在传统基准测试之外，通过语义结构表征来更深入地理解模型如何关联抽象概念。
AI.motivation: 语言模型基准测试存在困难：仅测试推理结果无法检验模型对语言的概念化能力，且流行的开源基准测试很快被饱和或作为训练数据被吸收。需要新的方法来测试模型的语义结构理解。
AI.method: 利用拓扑方法将高维嵌入空间与低维可解释基准（如本体论、精选知识图谱）进行多模态对齐比较，通过语义结构表征来评估模型对抽象概念的关联方式。
AI.result: 多模态对齐测试能够追踪模型的适应性变化，并测试跨多种语言的短语理解能力。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑方法为语言模型评估提供了新的维度，超越单纯的结果推理测试，为理解模型概念化语言的能力提供了更深入的洞察。

title: AIMold: An Autonomous AI-based Pipeline for Complex Mold Design
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/tb2-sy/AIMold
summary: Injection molding is the cornerstone of mass-producing plastic components. While current algorithms can automate mold design for basic geometries using standard two-piece molds, complex parts featuring undercuts, side holes, or re-entrant features present a significant challenge. These geometries often necessitate auxiliary components beyond the primary upper and lower molds. In practice, designing these intricate assemblies is a laborious process that relies heavily on expert knowledge. Furthermore, the scarcity of public datasets has hindered the development of effective learning-based solutions. To bridge these gaps, we introduce MoldCAD, a curated dataset that pairs complex single-body CAD parts with industry-standard mold assemblies. Each entry includes the upper and lower molds, parting surfaces, demolding orientations, and necessary auxiliary components. The dataset comprises 4,934 CAD models and over 3,850 mold assemblies, totaling more than 23k individual models. Building upon this dataset, we propose a comprehensive pipeline that predicts demolding orientations, identifies auxiliary components, and constructs parting surfaces to derive a complete, manufacturing-ready mold assembly for downstream CAD/CAM workflows. Our results demonstrate a promising path toward fully automated industrial mold design and contribute to the broader advancement of manufacturing-aware CAD generation.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了MoldCAD数据集，包含4,934个复杂CAD零件及超过3,850套与之配套的工业级模具装配（总计23k+模型），并提出了一个完整的自动化模具设计流水线，能够预测脱模方向、识别辅助组件并构建分型面，从而生成可直接用于下游CAD/CAM流程的模具装配。
AI.motivation: 注塑成型是塑料零件批量生产的基石，但现有自动化算法仅能处理简单几何体的标准两片式模具设计。对于带有侧孔、倒扣或再入特征的复杂零件，需要设计辅助组件，这高度依赖专家经验且过程繁琐。同时，缺乏公开数据集阻碍了基于学习的解决方案的发展。
AI.method: 作者构建了MoldCAD数据集，将复杂单件CAD零件与工业级模具装配配对，每条数据包含上下模、分型面、脱模方向和必要的辅助组件。在此基础上提出一个综合流水线：预测脱模方向、识别辅助组件、构建分型面，最终生成完整的制造就绪的模具装配。
AI.result: 数据集包含4,934个CAD模型和超过3,850套模具装配，总计超过23k个独立模型。提出的流水线在实验中被证明能够生成完整的模具装配，展示了向全自动化工业模具设计迈进的可行路径。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为自动化工业模具设计提供了宝贵的数据资源和可行的方法框架，填补了复杂零件模具设计领域公开数据集的空白，并为制造感知的CAD生成研究提供了新方向。

title: Co-evolution of social reward and punishment under institutional interventions
summary: We investigate how peer and institutional incentives jointly shape the evolution of cooperation, social welfare, and enforcement efficiency in social dilemmas. In a Prisoners Dilemma with four strategies, unconditional cooperators (C), defectors (D), social punishers (SP), and social rewarders (SR), we allow decentralised peer incentives and centralised institutional incentives to act simultaneously, with the institution able to reward or punish any subset of strategies. In infinite well-mixed populations, we analyse the resulting four-strategy replicator dynamics, and in structured populations we use agent-based simulations on square lattices to study spatial effects and network reciprocity. Intervention schemes are evaluated by equilibrium states and evolutionary flow for infinite well-mixed populations, by cooperation levels and social welfare for structured populations, defined as aggregate population payoff net of institutional cost. We find that peer punishment most strongly promotes cooperation, whereas peer reward is more beneficial for social welfare. Institutionally rewarding peer incentive strategies substantially improves both cooperation and welfare, while subsidising unconditional cooperators has little impact. Under institutional punishment, directly penalising defectors is the only consistently effective policy; punishing peer incentive strategies dismantles decentralised incentives, reduces cooperation, and harms social welfare, showing that maximising cooperation does not necessarily optimise overall societal benefit. Our findings provide design principles for institutions seeking to balance cooperation promotion with welfare maximisation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了同伴激励与制度激励如何共同影响社会困境中合作、社会福利和执法效率的演化。通过囚徒困境中的四种策略（合作者、背叛者、社会惩罚者、社会奖励者），结合复制者动力学和基于主体的方格模拟，发现同伴惩罚最促进合作，而同伴奖励更有利于社会福利；制度奖励同伴激励策略可显著提升合作与福利，而制度惩罚同伴激励策略则适得其反。
AI.motivation: 现有研究大多将同伴激励与制度激励分开讨论，缺乏对两者联合作用机制的系统分析，难以回答制度设计应如何与自发的同伴激励协同以兼顾合作促进与社会福利最大化。
AI.method: 构建包含无条件合作者、背叛者、社会惩罚者和社会奖励者四种策略的囚徒困境模型，允许去中心化的同伴激励与中心化的制度激励同时作用；在无限混合种群中采用四策略复制者动力学分析，在结构化种群中采用方格上的基于主体模拟研究空间效应和网络互惠。
AI.result: 同伴惩罚最能促进合作，同伴奖励更有利于社会福利；制度奖励同伴激励策略显著提升合作与福利，而补贴无条件合作者效果甚微；制度惩罚下直接惩戒背叛者才始终有效，惩罚同伴激励策略会破坏去中心化激励、降低合作并损害社会福利。
AI.conclusion: 最大化合作并不必然优化整体社会效益，制度设计需在促进合作与福利最大化之间寻求平衡，为机构提供兼顾两者的设计原则。

title: PICTURE: Enhancing Theory-of-Mind in Large Language Models by Revealing, Not Hiding, Characters' Lack of Knowledge
summary: Simulating human-like Theory of Mind (ToM) has been a longstanding problem in natural language processing (NLP). To address this, existing works introduce a reasoning step of event hiding (a.k.a. perspective-taking), where events unknown to a character are removed before question answering. However, resorting to event hiding for ToM reasoning presents a performance degradation issue due to the strict output format constraints involved in event hiding. To mitigate this issue, we propose generating perspective-taking outputs as free-form explanations without event hiding, but this poses a notable yet underexplored challenge: LLMs need to inhibit responses to events unknown to characters, because the absence of event hiding exposes LLMs to these events throughout reasoning. To address this challenge, we hypothesize and empirically verify that LLMs can achieve such inhibition if a character's lack of knowledge about events is made explicit during reasoning. Based on this finding, we introduce PICTURE, a new prompting method that enables LLMs to generate a character's lack of knowledge within free-form Chain-of-Thought (CoT). Experimental results show that PICTURE outperforms existing prompting methods by an average of 7.3% on false-belief tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PICTURE提示方法，通过让LLM在自由形式的思维链中显式生成角色对事件的无知状态，替代传统的事件隐藏推理步骤，从而在错误信念任务上平均提升7.3%的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于事件隐藏的ToM推理方法因严格的输出格式约束导致性能下降；而直接采用自由形式的视角转换生成又面临LLM难以抑制对角色未知事件做出反应的挑战。
AI.method: 提出PICTURE提示方法，基于"在推理过程中显式化角色对事件缺乏知识能帮助LLM实现抑制"这一假设，让LLM在自由形式思维链（CoT）中生成角色的知识缺失状态。
AI.result: PICTURE在错误信念任务上平均比现有提示方法高出7.3%的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将角色的知识缺乏显式化到自由形式思维链中，可以有效地替代事件隐藏策略，既避免了严格的输出格式约束，又实现了对未知事件的正确抑制，提升了LLM在ToM推理任务上的表现。

title: Models as Tools: An Agentic Coordination Framework for Unified Multimodal Visual Tracking
summary: Most current visual trackers adopt a matching-based architecture trained exclusively on tracking datasets, whose performance gains depend heavily on the length of the input context, and have now reached a bottleneck. While high-performance tracking increasingly relies on foundation models, existing methods use them monolithically, adapting a foundation model into a tracker or modify a segmentation foundation model into a tracking pipeline, which fails to exploit complementary strengths. Matching-based trackers excel at instance-level correspondence but lack semantic discrimination and fine-grained foreground perception, whereas segmentation foundation models produce precise masks yet struggle with instance discrimination and multimodal extension. Both paradigms also lack error-correction capabilities for long-term tracking. To address these issues, we propose ACTrack, an agentic coordination framework that treats heterogeneous models as invocable tools under an event-triggered mechanism. ACTrack coordinates a Tracker-based Instance Matching Tool for target discrimination, a SAM3 Motion Tool for mask-derived motion priors, a SAM3 Perception Tool for detecting distractors and instance-conflict cues, and a VLM Reprompt Tool activated only under persistent conflict to mitigate error accumulation. We design a complete tool-invocation trigger mechanism and an inter-tool coordination mechanism, enabling the complementary strengths of different model tools to be fully integrated. Experiments show that ACTrack substantially surpasses the strongest and the largest trackers on eight RGB benchmarks. Furthermore, a parameter-efficient adaptation strategy enables parameter sharing and reuse across tools, achieving unified multimodal tracking with only 30\% trainable parameters while substantially outperforming prior methods on multimodal benchmarks such as LasHeR, VisEvent, TNL2K, and DepthTrack.

AI.tldr: 提出ACTrack，一种智能体协调框架，将异构模型（匹配追踪器、SAM3分割模型、VLM）作为可调用工具，通过事件触发机制实现协同工作，在RGB和多模态追踪基准上显著超越现有最强追踪器。
AI.motivation: 现有匹配式追踪器依赖追踪数据集训练，性能已到瓶颈；虽然高性能追踪越来越依赖基础模型，但现有方法单块使用基础模型，未能充分利用互补优势——匹配追踪器擅长实例对应但缺乏语义判别和细粒度前景感知，分割基础模型能产生精确掩码但缺乏实例判别和多模态扩展能力，且两者都缺乏长期追踪的纠错能力。
AI.method: ACTrack将异构模型视为可调用工具，通过事件触发机制进行协调：Tracker实例匹配工具负责目标判别，SAM3运动工具提供掩码衍生运动先验，SAM3感知工具检测干扰物和实例冲突线索，VLM重新提示工具仅在持续冲突时激活以缓解误差累积。设计了完整的工具调用触发机制和工具间协调机制，并采用参数高效适配策略实现跨工具参数共享与复用。
AI.result: 在八个RGB基准上大幅超越最强和最大规模的追踪器；通过仅30%可训练参数的参数高效策略实现统一多模态追踪，在LasHeR、VisEvent、TNL2K和DepthTrack等多模态基准上显著优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过智能体协调框架将异构模型的互补优势充分整合，验证了事件触发机制下多工具协作的有效性，并以极低的参数成本实现了多模态追踪的显著性能提升。

title: Humans Are More Diverse: Frontier LLMs Show Extreme Policies in Idealised AI Development Races
summary: An AI development race creates a multi-agent safety dilemma. Each company can develop slowly and safely, or move faster while taking a risk that may remove its final reward. We use this repeated game to study strategic safety behaviour among large language model (LLM) agents in races with two to five players. However, a valid action does not show that an agent understands the game. We therefore place an audit gate before behavioural interpretation. We first verify the game engine, then test rule recall, state tracking, payoff calculation, and stability under different but equivalent task descriptions. We then compare LLM action sequences with an evolutionary game-theory benchmark and published human data, and explore differences across models, risk conditions, personas, and two- to five-player races. The audit shows that strong rule recall can coexist with weak state tracking and expected-payoff calculation. Providing verified arithmetic and changing the response representation can also change later actions, even when the game rules stay fixed. Across seven tested model endpoints, aggregate rates hide large differences in action sequences, responses to opponents, and responses to race position. Patterns across the tested three- to five-player races are also model-specific rather than a single effect of adding competitors. These results show why multi-agent AI-race simulations need validity checks and trajectory-level analysis before their outputs are described as strategic, human-like, or safety-aware. Our findings are exploratory and apply only to the tested models, prompts, and decoding settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多智能体AI开发竞赛中的安全困境，对LLM代理在2-5人竞赛中的战略安全行为进行审计和实验分析。作者发现强大的规则记忆可能伴随薄弱的状态追踪和收益计算能力，简单的算术辅助或响应格式变化就能改变行动，且聚合率掩盖了模型之间的巨大差异。研究强调AI竞赛模拟在解读为"战略性"或"安全感知"前必须进行有效性检验和轨迹级分析。
AI.motivation: AI开发竞赛构成多智能体安全困境，但现有研究常将LLM的有效动作直接解读为"理解游戏"或"具备战略性"。作者希望通过严格的审计门控来验证LLM是否真正理解游戏机制，从而避免对行为的过度解读。
AI.method: 作者建立了一个重复博弈框架：公司可以选择缓慢安全开发或快速冒险开发（可能失去最终奖励）。实验包含2-5名玩家的竞赛，设置审计门控：（1）验证游戏引擎；（2）测试规则记忆、状态追踪、收益计算以及对等价任务描述的稳定性。随后将LLM行动序列与进化博弈论基准和人类数据比较，并跨模型、风险条件、人格和玩家数量进行差异探索。
AI.result: 审计发现强规则记忆可与弱状态追踪和收益计算能力共存；提供已验证的算术或改变响应表示即使游戏规则不变，也会改变后续行动。七个测试模型端点的聚合率掩盖了行动序列、对对手响应以及竞赛位置响应上的巨大差异。3-5人竞赛的模式也具有模型特异性，而非添加竞争者的单一效应。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体AI竞赛模拟在将其输出描述为战略性、类人或安全感知之前，需要有效性检查和轨迹级分析。本研究结果具有探索性，仅适用于测试的模型、提示和采样设置。

title: Not the Dimension, the Norm: What Matters in Gradient-Free Weight Perturbation of Language Models
summary: Adapting a language model to a task no longer requires training all of its weights, and a line of parameter-efficient methods has driven the trainable count from billions down to a handful of scalars. Gradient-free adaptation, which samples random weight perturbations and keeps the ones that score well, has not followed that trajectory and still perturbs every entry of the weight tensor. It is unknown whether that full-weight search is necessary, and more fundamentally which property of a perturbation makes it work at all, because existing methods vary the search space, the perturbation scale, and the aggregation together. We resolve this by intervening on one factor at a time inside a fixed pipeline, holding candidate scoring and voting constant while we vary the search dimension, the subspace that carries the perturbation, and its norm. Perturbing a frozen frame of 12 to 16 scalars stays 1.8 accuracy points behind full-weight search on average across 49 model-benchmark cells, trailing it in 36 of them. Neither the dimension nor the choice of basis explains that performance. A random frame whose Grassmann overlap with the SVD frame is at chance level performs identically once a single scale factor is matched, and at large scales the SVD directions collapse first. What survives is the perturbation norm, whose usable range closes within a factor of five across seven models and stays flat inside. The perturbation norm is therefore the one factor with a failure mode, and its safe region transfers across scale and family. The design question narrows from which subspace to perturb to how hard to shake.

AI.tldr: 本文通过固定流水线中逐一干预单个因素，系统研究梯度无关的权重扰动适应的有效因素。发现扰动范数是唯一具有失败模式的关键因素，其安全区间跨模型和规模可迁移，而搜索维度、基选择和Grassmann重叠均不解释性能差异。
AI.motivation: 现有参数高效方法已将从数十亿训练参数降至几个标量，但梯度无关的自适应方法仍扰动整个权重张量的每个条目。目前不清楚全权重搜索是否必要，也不清楚扰动究竟依靠什么属性起作用，因为现有方法同时改变了搜索空间、扰动尺度和聚合方式。
AI.method: 在固定流水线中逐一干预单个因素：保持候选评分和投票恒定，分别变化搜索维度、承载扰动的子空间及其范数。使用12到16个标量的冻结框架与全权重搜索对比，并在49个模型-基准组合上进行系统评估，包括改变基选择（SVD框架与随机Grassmann框架）和扰动尺度。
AI.result: 标量框架平均落后全权重搜索1.8个准确率点，在49个模型-基准单元中36个落后。维度或基选择不解释性能差异；Grassmann重叠处于随机水平的随机框架在匹配单个尺度因子后表现相同。唯一存活的关键因素是扰动范数，其可用范围在七个模型中收窄到五倍以内并保持平坦。
AI.conclusion: 扰动范数是唯一具有失败模式的因素，其安全区间可跨模型规模和家族迁移。设计问题从"扰动哪个子空间"缩小为"扰动多用力"，为梯度无关自适应方法提供了更清晰的设计方向。

title: Reputation-driven Cooperation in Lattice-based Decentralized Federated Learning through Evolutionary Game Theory
summary: Decentralized Federated Learning (DFL) has emerged as an optimal privacy-preserving solution; however, it remains vulnerable to opportunistic behaviors due to the absence of a central coordinator. While Evolutionary Game Theory (EGT) serves as a powerful framework for analyzing such behaviors, existing studies often assume that agents possess perfect rationality and maintain static strategies. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a novel EGT framework designed to analyze strategic evolution and enhance overall system performance. The primary contributions of this work are threefold: First, we model peer-to-peer (P2P) interactions on a lattice network structure under the assumption of bounded rationality. Second, we formulate a comprehensive payoff matrix incorporating training costs, communication overhead, and cooperative rewards, while tailoring a strategy update rule that captures spatial propagation dynamics. Third, we integrate a reputation-based reward-and-punishment mechanism to effectively deter free-riding behaviors. Simulation results demonstrate that the framework significantly outperforms the baseline. Specifically, it increases average accuracy from approximately 70% to 82%, elevates cooperation frequency to approach 100% (compared to below 5% in the baseline), and drops accuracy variance from around 0.40 to 0.002, thereby accelerating uniform convergence and ensuring system stability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于演化博弈论（EGT）的去中心化联邦学习（DFL）框架，在格点网络结构上考虑有限理性假设，通过构建综合收益矩阵并引入基于声誉的奖惩机制来抑制搭便车行为，显著提升了系统准确率和合作频率，同时大幅降低了准确率方差，保证了系统稳定性。
AI.motivation: 去中心化联邦学习虽然具有隐私保护优势，但缺乏中心协调者使其容易受到机会主义行为的影响。现有基于演化博弈论的研究通常假设智能体具有完全理性并维持静态策略，这与实际场景不符，需要更贴近现实的博弈分析框架。
AI.method: 1) 在格点网络结构上对P2P交互进行建模，采用有限理性假设；2) 构建包含训练成本、通信开销和合作奖励的综合收益矩阵，并设计能捕捉空间传播动态的策略更新规则；3) 集成基于声誉的奖惩机制以有效遏制搭便车行为。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明所提框架显著优于基线：平均准确率从约70%提升至82%；合作频率从低于5%提升至接近100%；准确率方差从约0.40下降至0.002，加速了统一收敛并保证了系统稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 该EGT框架能够有效分析去中心化联邦学习中的策略演化，通过声誉机制和有限理性建模可显著提升系统整体性能与合作水平，为DFL中的机会主义行为治理提供了可行方案。

title: Human-LLM Alignment in Language Attitudes Toward Non-Native Japanese
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly evaluate human writing in high-stakes domains such as hiring and academic assessment, putting non-native speakers at particular risk. Drawing on the language attitudes framework, we compared human and LLM evaluations of parallel L1- and L2-written Japanese emails on three dimensions: fluency, status, and solidarity. Japanese raters rated L2 texts significantly lower on all three dimensions, with a fluency gap roughly twice the size of the status and solidarity gaps. Six LLM judges reproduced the direction of this bias, and five reproduced its ordering across dimensions. The models diverged from humans in two ways: all understated the solidarity gap, the most socially grounded dimension, and all differentiated among learner L1 backgrounds where humans did not. LLM judges thus reproduce native speakers' language attitudes in a structured yet attenuated form, and the language attitudes framework offers a ready-made yardstick for auditing them beyond English.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了人类和LLM对日语母语者与二语学习者所写邮件的评价，发现LLM在流畅性、地位和团结三个维度上复现了人类对二语文本的偏见，但程度有所减弱，且在团结维度上差距被低估，并对学习者母语背景表现出人类不具备的区分度。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地用于高利害场景（如招聘、学术评估）中评价人类写作，非母语写作者面临特别风险。现有研究对LLM语言偏见的理解不足，因此需要系统比较人类与LLM在评价母语者和非母语者写作时的态度差异。
AI.method: 作者基于语言态度框架，对平行语料中的日语母语（L1）和二语（L2）写作邮件，从流畅性、地位和团结三个维度进行评价。人类由日语母语评分者完成评价，同时使用六个LLM作为评判者，比较两者在各维度上的评分差异与排序模式。
AI.result: 人类评分者在三个维度上对L2文本的评分均显著更低，其中流畅性差距约为地位和团结差距的两倍。六个LLM中，全部复现了偏见方向，五个复现了维度间的差距排序。但所有模型都低估了团结维度（最具有社会根基的维度）的差距，且所有模型都对学习者母语背景进行了人类没有的区分。
AI.conclusion: LLM评判者以结构化但衰减的形式复现了母语者的语言态度，语言态度框架为在英语之外的语言中审计LLM偏见提供了一个现成的衡量标准。

title: PhenoStitch: Training-Free Panoptic Crop Mapping from Satellite Image Time Series
summary: Panoptic crop mapping requires both delineating individual agricultural parcels and assigning a crop type to each parcel from satellite image time series. Existing approaches typically rely on dense parcel-level annotations and task-specific model training, which limits their applicability to new regions and growing seasons. We introduce PhenoStitch, a panoptic crop-mapping pipeline that requires no task-specific gradient-based training. A frozen Segment Anything model first oversegments each patch into class-agnostic regions. For each region, optical NDVI and Sentinel-1 backscatter series are summarized by an analytic double-harmonic phenological signature. Adjacent regions are then merged into parcels by minimizing a Potts graph energy, and each parcel is classified by nearest-prototype matching using only (k) labeled parcels per class. A final topology-closure step produces the panoptic map. Under a matched budget of (k=20) parcels per class, corresponding to less than 1% of the available labels, PhenoStitch achieves 20.0 crop mIoU, 76.2 segmentation quality, and 6.2 panoptic quality on PASTIS-R under a 5-fold, 3-seed evaluation. It outperforms the evaluated frozen foundation-model, few-shot, and matched-budget supervised baselines under the same protocol, with a consistent ranking also observed on ZueriCrop. Ablation studies show that radar observations contribute the largest performance gain, while the graph-energy merge and compact phenological signature provide further improvements. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining label-free parcel delineation with few-shot phenological recognition for panoptic crop mapping under limited supervision.

AI.tldr: PhenoStitch是一个无需任务特定梯度训练的泛在作物制图流程，结合冻结的Segment Anything模型进行过分割、解析双谐波物候特征提取、Potts图能量合并以及近邻原型匹配分类，在仅使用每类20个标注地块（不到1%标签）的情况下，于PASTIS-R上取得20.0作物mIoU和6.2泛在质量，超越多种基线。
AI.motivation: 现有泛在作物制图方法依赖密集地块级标注和任务特定模型训练，限制了其在新区域和新生长季节的适用性，亟需一种低标注依赖、无需任务特定训练的解决方案。
AI.method: (1) 用冻结的Segment Anything模型对每个影像块进行类别无关的过分割；(2) 为每个区域提取光学NDVI和Sentinel-1后向散射序列的解析双谐波物候特征；(3) 通过最小化Potts图能量将相邻区域合并为地块；(4) 使用每类仅k个标注地块的近邻原型匹配进行分类；(5) 最后通过拓扑闭合步骤生成泛在作物图。
AI.result: 在PASTIS-R数据集上（5折×3种子评估），每类仅20个标注地块的条件下，取得20.0作物mIoU、76.2分割质量和6.2泛在质量，优于冻结基础模型、少样本和匹配预算监督基线，并在ZueriCrop上保持一致排名。
AI.conclusion: 消融研究表明雷达观测贡献最大性能增益，图能量合并和紧凑物候特征进一步改善效果，证明了无需标签的地块勾画与少样本物候识别相结合在低监督条件下实现泛在作物制图的有效性。

title: Perspectives on Tsallis Statistics for Artificial Intelligence
summary: Tsallis statistics generalizes Boltzmann-Gibbs statistical mechanics through a single real parameter $q$ that controls the weight assigned to rare and frequent events. Originally proposed to describe physical systems with long-range correlations, multifractal geometry, and heavy-tailed fluctuations, the framework has become a recurring ingredient in modern artificial intelligence (AI): it underlies sparse attention mechanisms (\textsc{sparsemax} and $α$-\textsc{entmax}), maximum-entropy reinforcement learning with controllable exploration, robust and heavy-tailed probabilistic models, and a family of generalized loss functions and regularizers. This paper offers a structured perspective on where Tsallis statistics meets AI. We first review the mathematical core: $q$-entropy and its variational (maximum-entropy) foundation, the $q$-exponential and $q$-logarithm, the $q$-central limit theorem, $q$-Gaussian distributions, and their dynamical origin in superstatistics, emphasizing the properties that matter for machine learning. We then survey applications across softmax generalization, reinforcement learning, sequential and graph neural models, generative and probabilistic modeling, loss design, and optimization, extracting the recurring design pattern in each case: a tunable interpolation between dense/uniform and sparse/peaked behavior governed by $q$. We further argue that the heavy-tailed weight spectra and gradient-noise statistics empirically observed in deep networks are themselves nonextensive signatures, placing modern learning dynamics within the scope of $q$-statistics. Finally, we discuss methodological pitfalls, the relationship to information geometry and $q$-exponential families, and open directions, arguing that $q$ should be treated as a learnable inductive bias rather than a fixed hyperparameter.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了Tsallis统计（q-统计）与人工智能的交叉领域，涵盖q-熵、q-指数族等数学基础，综述其在softmax泛化、强化学习、生成模型、损失设计等AI应用中的角色，并指出深度网络中的重尾分布本质上是q-统计的体现，主张将q视为可学习的归纳偏置而非固定超参数。
AI.motivation: Tsallis统计从物理学中发展而来，但已在现代AI中广泛出现（如sparsemax、α-entmax、最大熵强化学习等），然而缺乏一个统一的视角来理解这些散落的应用之间的联系，作者希望通过结构化综述揭示其共同的设计模式和理论基础。
AI.method: 本文采用综述方法：先回顾q-熵、q-指数/q-对数、q-中心极限定理、q-高斯分布、超统计等数学核心；然后对softmax泛化、强化学习、序列与图神经网络、生成与概率建模、损失设计、优化等AI应用进行系统调查，提取以q为参数的稠密/稀疏可调插值这一共性模式；并论证深度网络中的重尾权重谱和梯度噪声是q-统计的实证特征。
AI.result: 揭示了一个贯穿各AI应用领域的统一设计模式：q参数控制均匀/稠密与稀疏/尖峰行为之间的可调插值；论证了深度学习中观测到的重尾现象可从非广延统计视角得到解释；提出了方法论陷阱和与信息几何的关系，并建议将q作为可学习的归纳偏置。
AI.conclusion: Tsallis统计为理解AI中的稀疏性和鲁棒性现象提供了统一的理论框架，未来应将q视为可学习的模型参数而非固定超参数，并进一步探索q-指数族与信息几何的深层联系。

title: RING: Retrieval-Internalized Generation for Continual Large-Scale Knowledge Injection
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves factuality but adds latency and engineering overhead at serving time. We propose RING (Retrieval-Internalized Generation), a holistic paradigm spanning both architecture and training that injects large-scale external knowledge into a \textit{Mixture-of-Memory Experts} and learns parametric search over this internal memory via reinforcement learning, removing the external retriever entirely. Training proceeds in three stages: continued pre-training injects new corpora into a Knowledge Expert via our novel \textit{Dual Causal Attention}; supervised fine-tuning teaches a ``search-then-answer'' pattern; and reinforcement learning with hierarchical rewards optimizes the routing-and-search policy over the parametric memory. Unlike prior parametric injection methods that pair internal memory with a fixed or rule-based retriever, RING {learns} its retrieval policy directly from task signals. We further frame RING theoretically as a search-free approximation to the classical RAG objective. To evaluate large-scale injection of genuinely {new} knowledge without test-time leakage, we further construct News-2025, a benchmark built from news strictly post-dating the base LLM's pretraining cutoff. RING matches or surpasses both search-based RAG and parametric injection baselines in accuracy and efficiency.

AI.tldr: RING（Retrieval-Internalized Generation）提出了一种全新的RAG范式，通过将外部知识注入Mixture-of-Memory Experts架构中，并利用强化学习学习参数化搜索策略，完全移除外部检索器，在准确性和效率上匹配或超越传统基于搜索的RAG方法。
AI.motivation: 传统RAG虽然提升了事实性，但在服务时引入了额外的延迟和工程开销。已有的参数化知识注入方法通常依赖固定或基于规则的外部检索器，缺乏从任务信号中学习检索策略的能力，导致内部记忆的利用效率不高。
