AI.method: RING采用三阶段训练流程：1）通过提出的Dual Causal Attention机制进行持续预训练，将新语料注入知识专家中；2）通过监督微调学习"先搜索后回答"的模式；3）利用分层奖励的强化学习优化内部参数化记忆上的路由与搜索策略。理论上将RING形式化为经典RAG目标的无搜索近似。
AI.result: 在构建的News-2025基准（基于基础LLM预训练截止日期之后的新闻数据，确保无测试时泄漏）上，RING在准确性和效率方面均匹配或超越了基于搜索的RAG和参数化注入基线方法。
AI.conclusion: RING通过端到端的架构与训练范式革新，证明完全内化检索过程是可行的，既消除了外部检索器的延迟和工程负担，又保持了甚至超越了传统RAG的准确性。

title: PeCA: Palette Context Assisted Inference for Test-Time Paint-Bucket Colourisation on Animation Videos
summary: In animation production, paint-bucket colourisation for hand-drawn animation is a labour-intensive procedure that assigns each enclosed region in line sketches a colour from reference design sheets. Recent automatic paint-bucket colourisation pipelines mirror this workflow via region correspondence, but correspondences can be brittle when regions are ambiguous fragments without proper context. In this paper, we propose Palette Context Assisted (PeCA), a new training-free, plug-and-play framework for animation video colourisation that aims to close this gap at test-time via reasoning over spatial and temporal contexts. Extensive experiments on existing benchmarks and a newly introduced long-video test case show consistent performance boosts.

AI.tldr: 提出PeCA框架，一种无需训练、即插即用的动画视频着色方法，通过在测试时推理空间和时间上下文，解决油漆桶着色中区域对应关系脆弱的问题。
AI.motivation: 手绘动画的油漆桶着色是一项劳动密集型工作，现有自动管线通过区域对应关系来模拟此流程，但当区域是缺乏上下文信息的模糊片段时，对应关系可能不稳定，导致着色失败。
AI.method: 提出Palette Context Assisted (PeCA)，一个训练免费、即插即用的框架，在测试阶段通过推理空间和时间上下文来改进动画视频着色，弥合区域对应关系在大背景下脆弱的问题。
AI.result: 在现有基准测试和新引入的长视频测试用例上进行的大量实验显示出一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: PeCA通过利用空间和时间上下文，在测试时即可有效提升动画视频着色性能，无需额外训练，具有即插即用的实用优势。

title: Learning What to Remember and What to Internalize in LLM Self-Evolution via Adaptive Memory-Parameter Coordination
summary: Large language model agents increasingly operate in dynamic environments where tool interfaces, APIs, and user requirements change after deployment. Existing self-evolution methods mainly follow two paradigms: harness-based approaches, which externalize feedback into editable memories or skills for rapid adaptation, and parameter-based approaches, which internalize experience into model parameters for deeper capability improvement. However, using either mechanism alone creates a trade-off between flexibility and performance. This paper asks how an agent can coordinate both channels to achieve robust self-evolution. We present COVE, a unified agent self-evolution framework that combines harness-based and parameter-based learning through task-aware routing, stage-aware scheduling, and knowledge optimization. Through this design, COVE treats self-evolution not as indiscriminate accumulation of experience, but as a coordinated process that matches tasks and knowledge types to appropriate learning mechanisms. Experiments across multiple task categories show that COVE outperforms single-channel evolution strategies, demonstrating more robust and efficient improvement under changing environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出COVE框架，通过任务感知路由、阶段感知调度和知识优化，将基于harness和基于参数的两类自进化机制统一起来，实现智能体在动态环境中的稳健自进化。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体自进化方法分为两类：基于harness的方法（外部化反馈为可编辑记忆或技能，灵活但能力提升有限）和基于参数的方法（将经验内化到模型参数中，能力提升深但适应性差）。单独使用任一机制都会在灵活性和性能之间产生权衡，因此需要一种能协调两种通道的统一框架。
AI.method: 提出COVE（Coordinated self-eVOLution framework），通过三个关键设计实现统一自进化：1）任务感知路由（task-aware routing）——根据任务类型匹配合适的学习机制；2）阶段感知调度（stage-aware scheduling）——根据进化阶段安排学习策略；3）知识优化（knowledge optimization）——对知识进行优化处理以适配不同通道。COVE将自进化视为匹配任务与知识类型到恰当学习机制的协调过程，而非经验的无差别积累。
AI.result: 在多个任务类别上的实验表明，COVE优于单通道进化策略，在变化环境下展现出更稳健且更高效的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: COVE证明了协调harness与参数双通道的自进化方式能够同时兼顾灵活性与性能，为智能体在动态环境中实现稳健自进化提供了统一框架。

title: Style Wins, Substance Loses: A Diagnosis of LLM-as-Judge in Idea Generation
comment: First three authors are co-first authors
summary: However, whether these judges truly evaluate the scientific substance of ideas or are influenced by superficial stylistic presentation remains an open question. To address this question, we propose SciStyleBench, a unified three-component benchmark for diagnosing and mitigating stylistic bias in LLM-based idea evaluation: (i) First, SciStyleStage, a three-stage evaluation environment that applies controlled stylistic perturbations to fixed scientific content across three settings no context, fixed-domain context, and open-domain retrieval context, covering 600 scientific ideas and 15 style variants, with 9,000 evaluation instances per setting; (ii) Second, SciStyleMetrics, a set of quantitative measures, including Style Bias Index (SBI), Substance Recognition Rate (SRR), and Adversarial Win Rate (AWR), to characterize how stylistic variation affects scoring stability, substance discrimination, and ranking robustness; (iii) Third, SciStyleExtractor, a plug-and-play evaluation module that separates presentation style from scientific content by predicting style type and deviation before style-conditioned evaluation, enabling us to assess whether style awareness reduces stylistic bias. Experiments on SciStyleBench show that direct LLM judges remain sensitive to writing style and struggle to distinguish scientific substance. In contrast, SciStyleExtractor reduces SBI from 0.566 to 0.501 while increasing SRR and AWR from 0.504 and 0.554 to 0.759 and 0.899, respectively. These results suggest that robust idea evaluation requires invariance to stylistic variation without sacrificing sensitivity to scientific substance. Overall, SciStyleBench provides a systematic framework for identifying, quantifying, and mitigating stylistic bias in scientific idea evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SciStyleBench，一个三组件基准框架，用于诊断和缓解LLM在科学思想评估中的风格偏差。实验表明直接LLM评判易受写作风格影响，而所提出的SciStyleExtractor模块能有效降低风格偏差指数并提升对科学实质内容的识别能力。
AI.motivation: LLM作为科学思想评审者，其评估结果是否真正基于科学内容本身，还是受到表面写作风格的影响，这一问题尚不明确。需系统性地诊断和量化这种风格偏差。
AI.method: 提出三组件基准：(1) SciStyleStage——三阶段评估环境，对600个科学思想施加15种风格扰动，生成三个设置下各9000个评估实例；(2) SciStyleMetrics——引入风格偏差指数(SBI)、实质识别率(SRR)和对抗胜率(AWR)三个量化指标；(3) SciStyleExtractor——即插即用评估模块，通过预测风格类型和偏差来实现风格条件化评估。
AI.result: 直接LLM评判对写作风格敏感且难以区分科学实质；SciStyleExtractor将SBI从0.566降至0.501，将SRR从0.504提升至0.759，将AWR从0.554提升至0.899。
AI.conclusion: 稳健的思想评估需要对风格变化具有不变性，同时不牺牲对科学实质内容的敏感性。SciStyleBench为识别、量化和缓解科学思想评估中的风格偏差提供了系统框架。

title: Cognitive Demand Steering for Adaptive Meta-Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Recent meta-reasoning frameworks improve LLM reasoning by wrapping chain-of-thought generation in an iterative control loop, allowing more effective backtracking, termination of reasoning loops, and injection of promising reasoning patterns, among other strategy adjustments. Despite promising results, methods often rely on backward-looking reward functions, utilize coarse search actions, or require additional reasoning controller training requiring many-shot supervision. We introduce Cognitive Demand Steering (CDS), a training-free meta-reasoning framework equipped with residual demand assessment: at each step, an LLM-based progress evaluator characterizes the residual reasoning required to arrive at a solution rather than merely evaluating the previous step. This allows a meta-controller to select reasoning interventions comprising both general-purpose exemplars and actions (e.g., general guidance for quantitative reasoning) that directly tackle this forward-looking demand signal. This shift eliminates the need for any trained component while enabling zero-shot transfer across models and tasks with no adaptation. Rather than relying on coarse characterizations, we employ cognitive scales to both design interventions as well as profile initial problem complexity and residual demand signal over 16 dimensions motivated by cognitive science (e.g., attention and scan, learning and abstraction, spatio-physical reasoning), giving the controller a fine-grained vocabulary for diagnosing. Averaged across three frontier LLMs and six reasoning benchmarks, CDS improves accuracy by $21.9\%$ over direct calls and $9\%$ over standard CoT reasoning, with the largest gains on difficult mathematics and coding tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出了认知需求引导（CDS），一种无需训练的元推理框架，通过前向的残差需求评估（而非后向奖励）来引导推理干预，在三个前沿LLM和六个推理基准上平均提升准确率21.9%（对比直接调用）和9%（对比标准CoT）。
AI.motivation: 现有元推理框架存在三个局限：依赖后向奖励函数、使用粗糙的搜索动作、需要大量监督训练额外的推理控制器。这些限制使得方法难以跨模型和任务泛化。
AI.method: CDS框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 基于LLM的进度评估器，在每个步骤评估到达解决方案所需的残差推理量（前向信号而非后向评价）；(2) 元控制器根据前向信号选择推理干预（包括通用示例和动作）。同时引入16个认知科学维度的认知量表来设计干预措施并刻画问题复杂度和残差需求信号。
AI.result: 在三个前沿LLM和六个推理基准上，CDS相比直接调用提升21.9%准确率，相比标准CoT提升9%，在困难的数学和编程任务上增益最大。无需训练组件，支持零样本跨模型和跨任务迁移。
AI.conclusion: 通过前向的残差需求评估替代后向奖励，结合认知维度的精细干预设计，CDS实现了无需训练的、可零样本跨模型/任务迁移的元推理框架，验证了"评估剩余需要的推理"比"评价已有推理"更有效的核心假设。

title: Learning What to Remember: Test-Time Training via Context Distillation
summary: Effective long-context modeling is not merely about retaining more of the past, but about preserving the information that may prove relevant later. Test-time training (TTT) is an appealing approach that performs online parameter updates for long-context modeling, yet existing TTT methods only optimize either reconstruction or online adaptation objectives without considering the future utility of retained information. In this work, we propose \textbf{T}est-\textbf{T}ime \textbf{C}ontext \textbf{D}istillation (TTCD), a TTT framework that introduces a self-supervised objective for allocating limited memory capacity for future use. Specifically, TTCD uses a long-window teacher to supervise the fast weights of a short-window student, where the hidden-state discrepancy between them offers a dense, self-supervised signal guiding the model to memorize the contextual information crucial for future token predictions. We focus on an in-place variant: In-Place TTCD (IP-TTCD), which uses the existing MLP parameters as the fast weights. Experiments on long-context language modeling tasks show IP-TTCD consistently outperforms DeltaNet, Gated DeltaNet, sliding-window attention, and TTT when pre-trained from scratch. Furthermore, IP-TTCD allows pre-trained transformer models to adapt their parameters during inference through continual pre-training, gaining long-context capabilities with only a lightweight architectural augmentation. Our results position TTCD as a step toward architectural continual learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TTCD框架，通过长窗口教师监督短窗口学生的快速权重，利用隐藏状态差异作为自监督信号，在测试时优化记忆分配以保留对未来预测至关重要的上下文信息。
AI.motivation: 现有长上下文建模中的测试时训练（TTT）方法仅优化重建或在线自适应目标，未考虑保留信息的未来效用，导致有限的记忆容量被低效分配。
AI.method: 提出TTCD框架：使用长窗口教师模型监督短窗口学生的快速权重，通过二者隐藏状态差异提供密集自监督信号，引导模型记忆对未来token预测关键的信息。具体变体IP-TTCD将现有MLP参数用作快速权重。
AI.result: 在长上下文语言建模任务中，IP-TTCD从零预训练时一致优于DeltaNet、Gated DeltaNet、滑动窗口注意力和TTT方法；同时允许预训练Transformer模型通过持续预训练在推理时自适应参数，仅需轻量架构增强即可获得长上下文能力。
AI.conclusion: TTCD框架为迈向架构级持续学习迈出一步，展示了测试时通过知识蒸馏式目标进行上下文记忆优化的有效性。

title: G-ReAct: Graph-Guided Deep Search via Structure-State Co-Evolution
summary: Deep search has become a fundamental capability of large language models (LLMs) for solving open-domain complex tasks. However, existing approaches typically rely on linear sequential reasoning for both trajectory generation and inference, making it difficult to consistently preserve intermediate states and constraints throughout long-horizon multi-hop search. Consequently, they often suffer from context forgetting, search drift, and inefficient exploration. To address these limitations, we propose $\textbf{G-ReAct}$, a reasoning framework for deep search that organizes reasoning as $\textbf{state evolution over a fixed-topology query graph}$. The evolving graph state explicitly tracks search progress and guides subsequent decisions, transforming exploratory search driven by textual history into graph-guided reasoning under explicit constraints. G-ReAct supports both training and inference: it generates high-quality deep-search trajectories for supervised fine-tuning and provides structured guidance for inference-time search without additional fine-tuning. Experiments demonstrate that with only 1.9K generated trajectories for fine-tuning, Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 achieves $52.6\%$ accuracy on BrowseComp-ZH and $79.0\%$ on XBench, outperforming comparable open-source methods trained on substantially larger datasets, including RL-enhanced methods. Furthermore, when applied at inference time, G-ReAct consistently improves the performance of existing strong LLMs on deep-search tasks. We will publicly release all code and model weights.

AI.tldr: 本文提出G-ReAct，一种基于固定拓扑查询图的状态演化推理框架，用于解决LLM在深度搜索任务中的上下文遗忘、搜索漂移和低效探索问题，仅用1.9K轨迹微调即可在BrowseComp-ZH和XBench上超越更大规模数据集训练的方法。
AI.motivation: 现有深度搜索方法依赖线性顺序推理，在长时程多跳搜索中难以持续保持中间状态和约束，导致上下文遗忘、搜索漂移和低效探索等问题。
AI.method: G-ReAct将推理组织为固定拓扑查询图上的状态演化，用演化的图状态显式跟踪搜索进度并指导后续决策，将基于文本历史的探索性搜索转化为显式约束下的图引导推理。该方法同时支持训练（生成高质量深度搜索轨迹用于监督微调）和推理（无需额外微调的结构化引导）。
AI.result: 仅用1.9K生成轨迹微调Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507，在BrowseComp-ZH上达到52.6%准确率，在XBench上达到79.0%，优于在更大数据集上训练的可比开源方法（包括RL增强方法）。推断时应用G-ReAct也能一致地提升现有强LLM在深度搜索任务上的性能。
AI.conclusion: G-ReAct通过图状态演化有效解决了深度搜索中的推理退化问题，以极小的训练数据量达到甚至超越大规模训练方法的性能，证明了结构化图引导推理在深度搜索任务中的优越性。

title: Understanding Sparse Attention Selectivity in Long-Context Foundation Models via Counterfactual Evaluation
summary:
Sparse attention is widely deployed in long-context serving stacks, yet no framework audits how discarding blocks changes the influence of specific content on model output. We first establish that the phenomenon is real and causal: Block Sparse Flash Attention (BSFA) route replay across four architectures changes output decisions in 13 of 16 cells, with zero identity-replay label flips. We then introduce a dense-calibrated counterfactual audit using matched probe cards---Gold (carrying the correct answer label), Poison (carrying a target wrong label), and Benign (filler only)---under six-layout position symmetry, isolating the sparsification-specific effect.
  Two patterns compete. Signal concentration: the selector preserves Gold and Poison blocks far above filler-matched Benign blocks (G$\approx$P$\gg$B across all model--task pairs). Integration loss: discarding blocks severs cross-block attention---confirmed by an ablation where isolating the probe block collapses its influence from 4.48 logits to zero. Compression ratio governs the balance: a full sweep from mild ($c=0.25$) to aggressive ($c=0.75$) compression across four model--task pairs reveals that three of four cells move toward stronger sparse amplification at higher compression, with two exhibiting sign reversals.
  Three independent arms---BSFA route replay, controlled block-top-$k$, and KV-cache eviction---converge: sparsification changes content influence in ways aggregate accuracy cannot detect. We provide an open measurement framework deployable on any model exposing block identities.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出并系统审计了稀疏注意力框架中"丢弃块如何改变特定内容对模型输出的影响"这一核心问题。通过块稀疏Flash Attention（BSFA）路由重放实验、密集校准的反事实审计框架，以及三种独立验证方式，证明稀疏化会改变内容影响力且这种改变无法被聚合准确率捕获。
AI.motivation: 稀疏注意力已广泛部署于长上下文服务中，但现有框架无法审计丢弃块如何改变特定内容对模型输出的影响力。作者首先通过实验证实该现象是真实且因果性的：BSFA路由重放在四个架构、16个单元中改变了13个单元的输出决策。
AI.method: 提出了密集校准的反事实审计框架，使用匹配的探针卡（Gold携带正确答案、Poison携带错误标签、Benign仅填充物），在六布局位置对称条件下隔离稀疏化特定效应。发现两种竞争模式：信号集中（选择器保留Gold和Poison块远高于Benign块）和集成损失（丢弃块切断跨块注意力）。通过压缩率扫描（c=0.25到c=0.75）揭示压缩率决定两者平衡。
AI.result: 三个独立验证分支（BSFA路由重放、受控块top-k、KV缓存驱逐）收敛于同一结论：稀疏化改变内容影响力而聚合准确率无法检测。在压缩率扫描中，四个模型-任务对中三个在高压缩下表现出更强的稀疏放大效应，其中两个出现符号反转。消融实验显示隔离探针块会使其影响力从4.48 logits骤降至零。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个开放测量框架，可部署于任何暴露块身份（block identities）的模型上，用于审计稀疏注意力系统中内容影响力的变化。

title: MonitorVLM-v2: A Deployed Vision-Language Framework for Real-Time Safety Violation Detection
summary: Large vision--language models (VLMs) can reason step by step about complex visual scenes, but this open-ended, autoregressive chain-of-thought (CoT) approach is poorly suited to safety-critical, rule-governed settings such as industrial surveillance, where decisions must be bounded, deterministic, and low-latency. Because CoT inference cost scales jointly with reasoning length and the number of concurrent streams, it creates a throughput bottleneck that precludes the real-time, multistream monitoring required for industrial accountability. Here we present MonitorVLM-v2, a deployment-oriented framework that recasts VLM-based safety assessment as probabilistic inference over a finite regulatory decision space, compressing multimodal reasoning into single-step rule-ID predictions and reducing decoding from a variable-length sequence to a single token. We introduce symbolic policy optimization (SymPO), a novel contrastive policy optimization algorithm that sharpens decision boundaries within this finite symbolic space, together with an entropy-driven triage mechanism that routes uncertain predictions to human reviewers for expert confirmation. In a four-month prospective deployment across 10 concurrent camera feeds in an operational underground mining facility, MonitorVLM-v2 achieved a 19.45-fold increase in inference speed and identified 2.78 times as many confirmed violations as the site's routine manual inspection workflow, demonstrating the practical value of compressed symbolic decision-making for real-time, auditable industrial monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MonitorVLM-v2，一个面向工业安全监控的部署框架，将VLM的链式推理压缩为有限监管决策空间中的单令牌概率推断，结合符号策略优化（SymPO）和熵驱动的分流机制，在矿井实地部署中实现了19.45倍推理加速和2.78倍的违规检出提升。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（VLM）的链式推理（CoT）虽然能逐步推理复杂视觉场景，但存在推理成本随推理长度和并发流数量联合增长的问题，导致吞吐量瓶颈，无法满足工业监控中实时、多流、确定性、低延迟和安全关键场景的需求。
AI.method: MonitorVLM-v2将VLM安全评估重构为有限监管决策空间上的概率推断，将多模态推理压缩为单步规则ID预测，把变长序列解码缩减为单令牌解码。引入符号策略优化（SymPO）对比策略优化算法来锐化有限符号空间内的决策边界，并设计熵驱动的分流机制，将不确定性预测路由到人工审查员进行专家确认。
AI.result: 在运营中的地下采矿设施中，对10路并发摄像头进行了为期四个月的实地部署，MonitorVLM-v2实现了19.45倍的推理速度提升，并识别出2.78倍于常规人工检查流程的确认违规数量。
AI.conclusion: 压缩的符号决策制定方法对实时、可审计的工业监控具有实际价值，证明了在安全关键场景中VLM推理压缩的可行性和有效性。

title: 402Pilot: An x402 Decision Layer for Autonomous Agent Micropayments
summary: Programmable-payment protocols such as x402 enable per-request micropayments, but they do not determine which payable service an autonomous agent should buy under a finite wallet. We formulate this buyer-side problem as agent-native payment decision-making: contextual provider selection under wallet pressure, chosen-only paid feedback, and changing market conditions. We propose 402Pilot, a protocol-agnostic buyer-side decision layer between autonomous agents and payment execution that implements purchasing policies for selecting among payable providers. We instantiate it with PA-DCT, a payment-aware discounted contextual Thompson-sampling policy that adapts purchasing decisions under wallet pressure while learning from post-payment feedback. To evaluate buyer-side payment policies, we introduce 402Pilot-Bench, a frozen-replay benchmark spanning 823 tasks, five heterogeneous provider pipelines, and three market regimes, each evaluated over 30 paired seeds. PA-DCT achieves the strongest fixed-wallet adaptive trade-off among non-oracle policies: it maintains competitive service quality while spending only 39 to 43 percent of the wallet and reallocates spending as market conditions change. It attains the best non-oracle PA-gap/T under the price shock and the best mean and worst-case ranks across the nine scenario-metric combinations of quality, ROI, and PA-gap/T. Comparisons with learning baselines and component ablations further support the effectiveness and design of the proposed decision policy. These results suggest that programmable payment must be complemented by buyer-side decision-making capable of learning service value and adapting purchasing decisions accordingly.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了自主代理在有限钱包下如何进行支付决策的问题，提出了402Pilot——一个协议无关的买方侧决策层，以及PA-DCT策略和402Pilot-Bench基准。实验表明PA-DCT在保持服务质量的同时仅花费钱包的39-43%，并在市场变化时自适应调整支出。
AI.motivation: 可编程支付协议（如x402）支持按请求的微支付，但未解决自主代理在有限钱包下应选择哪个可支付服务的问题，即买方侧的支付决策问题。
AI.method: 提出402Pilot买方侧决策层，实例化为PA-DCT（支付感知的折扣上下文汤普森采样策略），在学习支付后反馈的同时自适应钱包压力下的购买决策。构建402Pilot-Bench冻结重放基准，包含823个任务、5个异构提供方流水线和3种市场机制。
AI.result: PA-DCT在非oracle策略中取得最强的固定钱包自适应权衡：维持竞争性服务质量的同时仅消耗钱包的39-43%，并在价格冲击下重新分配支出，在九个场景-指标组合中取得最佳平均和最差情况排名。
AI.conclusion: 可编程支付必须辅以买方侧决策能力，使代理能够学习服务价值并相应调整购买决策。

title: PGMem: Tightly Coupled Persona-Memory Graph for Lifelong Personalized Agents
summary: Long-term personalized dialogue agents must track user preferences as their personas evolve. Existing memory systems organize past events well, but store personas as flat profiles detached from the events that justify them. This loose coupling leads to the memory-persona validity gap and the persona-aware retrieval gap. We propose PGMem, a heterogeneous persona-memory graph that connects event and persona nodes through typed provenance and evidence edges, keeping each persona signal traceable to the events that support or revise it. At retrieval time, PGMem expands from query-relevant seeds and ranks signals by evidential validity. Across three benchmarks with small language model backbones, PGMem consistently outperforms summary-based, persona-aware, graph-structured, and agentic memory baselines, and improves performance as the context grows. The source code of PGMem is available at https://github.com/wonjunchoi23/pgmem/

AI.tldr: 提出PGMem，一种异构人物-记忆图结构，通过类型化来源和证据边将事件节点与人物信号节点连接，解决长期个性化对话代理中人物画像与事件脱节的问题，在三个基准上超越多种基线。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆系统能很好地组织过去事件，但将人物画像存储为扁平档案，与支撑这些画像的事件相分离。这种松散耦合导致了"记忆-画像有效性差距"和"画像感知检索差距"两个问题，使得长期对话代理难以准确追踪用户偏好随时间的演变。
AI.method: 提出PGMem（Persona-Graph Memory），构建异构图结构：1) 通过类型化的来源边（provenance edges）和证据边（evidence edges）将事件节点与人物节点连接，使每个人物信号可追溯到支持或修正它的事件；2) 在检索时，从查询相关的种子节点扩展，并依据证据有效性对人物信号进行排序。
AI.result: 在三个基准测试中，使用小型语言模型作为骨干，PGMem一致性地优于基于摘要、基于画像、图结构和智能体记忆的基线方法，并且随着上下文增长性能持续提升。
AI.conclusion: PGMem通过将人物画像与支撑事件紧密关联，有效缩小了记忆与画像之间的有效性差距，并提高了画像感知检索的准确性，为长期个性化对话代理的人物追踪提供了更可靠的解决方案。

title: Agentic Stage-One Stellarator Optimization: Autonomous Multi-Objective Search for Finite-Beta Equilibria
summary: Stage-one stellarator design searches a high-dimensional family of three-dimensional plasma boundaries and fixed-boundary MHD equilibria for configurations that jointly meet requirements on confinement, field-line topology, force balance, stability proxies, and geometry. These specifications do not provide a general constructive map to a validated finite-beta equilibrium. High-quality targets are commonly developed through iterative numerical optimization whose outcome depends on the initial configuration, active Fourier resolution, objective priorities, and local solver budget. Coordinating this process is computationally costly and expert-intensive, limiting both design throughput and the production of consistently evaluated data. We present a proof of concept for \emph{agentic} stage-one optimization. A bounded language-model agent diagnoses the current equilibrium and selects the next local optimization experiment, while deterministic DESC execution owns prescribed profiles and flux, symmetry, metric evaluation, solver validity, and acceptance. On a common-budget subset from an expanding finite-beta campaign, the number of gate-valid configurations increases from five inputs to nineteen outputs; median Boozer QS RMS decreases from $2.39\times10^{-4}$ to $1.07\times10^{-4}$, and median maximum principal curvature decreases from $62.56$ to $33.00\,\mathrm{m}^{-1}$. A complementary long route achieves a $9.10\times$ QS reduction while repairing magnetic-well and curvature defects. The system also records every attempted local action as transition evidence, yielding 734 structured parent--action--outcome records in the reported experiments. These results show that agentic outer-loop control can sustain finite-beta, multi-objective search and turn repeated optimization into a scalable source of improved equilibria and reusable decision data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于语言模型智能体的"阶段一"恒星器优化方法，通过智能体诊断当前平衡态并选择下一步局部优化实验，结合确定性DESC执行，在有限beta多目标搜索中将门控有效配置从5个提升到19个，同时显著改善准对称性和曲率指标，并生成734条可复用的决策数据。
AI.motivation: 传统阶段一恒星器设计依赖高维参数空间的迭代数值优化，其过程计算成本高、依赖专家经验，初始配置、傅里叶分辨率、目标优先级和局部求解器预算都会显著影响结果，限制了设计吞吐量和一致评估数据的产生。
AI.method: 采用有界语言模型智能体（agentic）框架：智能体负责诊断当前平衡态并选择下一个局部优化实验，而确定性DESC执行器负责固定剖面、通量、对称性、度规评估、求解器有效性和验收条件，两者分工协作形成闭环优化流程。
AI.result: 在有限beta扩展战役的公共预算子集上，门控有效配置从5个输入增加到19个输出；Boozer准对称性RMS中位数从2.39×10⁻⁴降至1.07×10⁻⁴；最大主曲率中位数从62.56降至33.00 m⁻¹；长路径实验实现9.10×的准对称性提升并修复磁阱和曲率缺陷；系统记录了734条结构化父-动作-结果记录。
AI.conclusion: 智能体外环控制能够维持有限beta多目标搜索，将重复优化转化为可扩展的改进平衡态和可复用决策数据来源，展示了agentic方法在恒星器设计中的可行性和潜力。

title: Understanding and Overcoming Cross-modal Fusion Bias in Multimodal Anomaly Detection From A Fisher Information Perspective
summary: Current advancements in Multimodal Anomaly Detection (MAD) are largely driven by enhancing multimodal fusion, particularly through the integration of RGB and Depth data for richer anomaly representation. However, less attention was devoted to analyzing the role of cross-modal fusion bias, a well-known challenge in multimodal learning, in MAD. This gap motivates a key question: can we overcome this bias to break the performance bottleneck of current work? In this paper, we first analyze the impact of cross-modal fusion bias in MAD via the Fisher Information Matrix. Then, grounded in these findings, we propose UCFB, a simple yet effective plug-and-play framework designed to mitigate cross-modal fusion bias in MAD. It achieves this by jointly employing Fisher-information-guided dynamic calibration to adjust modality-specific regularization weights and canonical similarity analysis to improve inter-modal interactions. Extensive experiments on the MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies datasets demonstrate that UCFB achieves consistent improvements in single-class, multi-class, and few-shot settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了UCFB框架，通过Fisher信息矩阵分析并缓解多模态异常检测中的跨模态融合偏差，在MVTec 3D-AD和Eyecandies数据集上实现了单类、多类和少样本场景下的一致性性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有MAD研究多聚焦于增强多模态融合（如RGB与深度数据的集成），却忽视了对跨模态融合偏差的分析。融合偏差作为多模态学习中的已知挑战，可能成为当前MAD工作性能提升的瓶颈，因此探索如何克服这一偏差具有重要意义。
AI.method: 首先利用Fisher信息矩阵分析跨模态融合偏差对MAD的影响；基于分析结果，提出UCFB即插即用框架，包含两个核心组件：1）Fisher信息引导的动态校准，用于调整模态特定的正则化权重；2）典型相关分析，用于改善模态间交互。
AI.result: 在MVTec 3D-AD和Eyecandies两个数据集上的大量实验表明，UCFB在单类、多类和少样本设置下均取得了一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态融合偏差是制约MAD性能的关键因素，通过Fisher信息引导的动态校准和典型相关分析可以有效缓解该偏差，且该方法具有简洁性和即插即用的通用性。

title: Constructing Parallel Multidimensional Chromatic Lexicons for Corpus-Assisted Analysis of Russian and English Texts
summary: This article addresses the relative scarcity of research tools for the corpus-assisted linguistic analysis of colour terms in literary texts. It describes the development of two multidimensional chromatic lexicons: one for Russian (224 entries) and one for English (141 entries). Lexicon construction involved sourcing colour vocabulary from specialised resources and research literature, comparing the two language inventories, manually checking translated candidates, and addressing language-specific morphological features. In addition to identifying colour terms and visual descriptors, the lexicons classify entries according to hue, saturation, and temperature. To demonstrate their practical application, a pilot study was conducted on purposively sampled corpora of poetry by Andrei Bely (20,373 tokens) and Emily Dickinson (28,479 tokens). All retrieved matches were checked in context and classified as Confirmed_chromatic, Ambiguous_visual, or Excluded. The analysis was implemented in two main stages: a strict analysis including confirmed chromatic lexis only, followed by a sensitivity analysis incorporating both confirmed and ambiguous chromatic lexis to determine whether coding decisions about borderline cases affected the main findings. The quantitative results indicated marked differences in the use of colour terms, visual descriptors, hue, saturation, and temperature. Specifically, the analysis revealed that confirmed chromatic terms occurred 3.4 times more frequently in the sampled Bely corpus than in the Dickinson corpus. These findings demonstrate the analytical value of a multidimensional approach, with the main contribution of this study being a transparent and reusable procedure for constructing and applying multilingual chromatic lexicons.

AI.tldr: 本文针对语料库辅助文学文本颜色词分析工具稀缺的问题，构建了俄语（224词条）和英语（141词条）两个多维色度词汇表，并将其应用于别雷和狄金森诗歌语料库的试点研究。结果表明，别雷语料中确认色度词汇的出现频率是狄金森语料的3.4倍，凸显了多维分析方法的分析价值。
AI.motivation: 文学文本中颜色词的语料库辅助语言学分析工具相对匮乏，缺乏透明且可复用的多语言色度词汇表工具。
AI.method: 从专业资源和研究文献中收集颜色词汇，对比两种语言库存，人工核查翻译候选词，处理语言特有的形态特征；构建按色相、饱和度和温度分类的词条；在别雷（20,373词）和狄金森（28,479词）诗歌语料上进行试点分析，采用严格分析和敏感性分析两阶段验证。
AI.result: 构建了俄语224词条和英语141词条的多维色度词汇表；确认色度词汇在别雷语料中的出现频率是狄金森语料的3.4倍；两种语言在颜色词使用、视觉描述词、色相、饱和度和温度方面均存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 多维色度分析方法具有重要分析价值，本研究的主要贡献在于提供了一套透明、可复用的多语言色度词汇表构建与应用流程。

title: Entity-Faithful Repair of Synthetic Supervision for Zero-Shot Image Captioning
comment: Accepted to the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026). 16 pages, 7 figures
summary: Zero-shot image captioning aims to generate image descriptions without annotated image-text pairs. Recent approaches exploit text-to-image models to synthesize training data from text-only corpora, but most focus on improving overall data quality. In contrast, we observe that synthetic image-text misalignment is often structured and fine-grained: pairs may remain globally plausible while containing missing entities or misgrounded attributes, thereby degrading supervision fidelity. As a result, methods based on global similarity for image rematching or regeneration may improve apparent plausibility, but cannot systematically repair entity-level misalignment. To address this issue, we propose ReCap, a plug-and-play framework that shifts synthetic data refinement from implicit global matching to explicit fine-grained realignment. Specifically, ReCap enforces entity-level correspondence by using detected image-supported entities to guide caption rewriting, yielding more faithful synthetic supervision. In addition, we introduce an adaptive dynamic weighted learning strategy to downweight unreliable synthetic pairs during training. As a general framework, ReCap can be integrated into existing synthetic-data pipelines. Extensive experiments show that ReCap consistently improves image-text consistency and achieves state-of-the-art performance on both in-domain and cross-domain zero-shot image captioning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出了ReCap框架，通过显式的细粒度实体级重对齐来修复合成图像-文本数据中的错配问题，提升了零样本图像描述生成性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法利用文本到图像模型合成训练数据，但合成数据常存在结构性、细粒度的图文错配（如实体缺失或属性错位），而基于全局相似度的重匹配或重生成方法无法系统性修复实体级错配。
AI.method: ReCap是一个即插即用框架，通过检测图像支持的实体来引导标题重写，实现显式的实体级对应关系；同时引入自适应动态加权学习策略，在训练中降低不可靠合成对的权重。
AI.result: 在域内和跨域的零样本图像描述基准上，ReCap一致地提升了图文一致性，并取得了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: ReCap从隐式全局匹配转向显式细粒度重对齐，能有效修复合成数据中的实体级错配，是可集成到现有合成数据流程中的通用框架。

title: CRAFTS: Collaborative Role-Adaptive Fine-Tuning of LLM Agents for Chemical Process Simulation
summary: Constructing an executable chemical-process model remains manually intensive. Chemical engineers translate underspecified requests into coupled decisions about unit operations, thermodynamics, streams, specifications, degrees of freedom (DoF), initialization, solver repair, and optimization; one error can invalidate the model. CRAFTS mirrors the staged workflow of chemical engineers by decomposing simulation building into bounded subtasks assigned to seven bounded roles, with deterministic IDAES/Pyomo gates between stages. Given a natural-language request, process flowsheet diagram (PFD) evidence, and curated chemical-engineering knowledge, Input Understanding and Intent recover requirements, constraints, and process semantics; visual, topology, and specification specialists translate them into typed simulator contracts; and Debug and Optimization support bounded repair and eligible optimization. Fine-tuning is applied to the three schema-critical visual, topology, and specification roles, while the remaining roles use untuned Qwen. The resulting VisualGraphIR, TopologyIR, SpecIR, BuildPlan, and SolveReport expose unit, port, thermodynamic, numerical, and execution decisions. Compatible constructors, property packages, and runners are attached only after semantic artifacts pass engineering gates. We introduce OpenIDAES-450, a 450-case IDAES process- simulation dataset, and evaluate the complete seven-role LangChain/LangGraph workflow through solve and eligible optimization on its frozen 82-case held-out split. CRAFTS completes the prescribed validation and execution contract for for 91.5% of cases and achieves unit, stream, and directed-connection F1 scores of 0.815, 0.791, and 0.782. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of role specialization, typed intermediate representations, and deterministic engineering gates for reliable automated process-model construction.

AI.tldr: CRAFTS是一种将化工过程建模分解为七个有界子任务（由七个有界角色执行）的自动化框架，通过确定性IDAES/Pyomo门控验证阶段间的语义产物，并在450个案例的OpenIDAES-450数据集上实现91.5%的执行合同完成率和约0.79的F1分数。
AI.motivation: 构建可执行的化工过程模型仍然高度依赖人工，工程师需要手动处理单元操作、热力学、流股、自由度、初始化、求解器修复和优化等耦合决策，一个错误就可能导致模型失效，亟需自动化方法。
AI.method: CRAFTS模仿化工工程师的分阶段工作流，将仿真构建分解为七个有界子任务分配给七个专门角色，包括输入理解与意图恢复、视觉/拓扑/规格专家（这三个角色经微调）、调试与优化支持；使用确定性IDAES/Pyomo门控验证阶段间产物，并输出VisualGraphIR、TopologyIR、SpecIR、BuildPlan和SolveReport等中间表示。
AI.result: 在OpenIDAES-450数据集的82个冻结留出案例上，CRAFTS完成了91.5%的规定的验证和执行合同；单元、流股和有向连接F1分数分别为0.815、0.791和0.782。
AI.conclusion: 角色专业化、类型化中间表示和确定性工程门控相结合，可以有效实现可靠的自动化过程模型构建。

title: RADAR: Rubric-Aware Dependency and Redundancy Analysis for LLM-as-Judge Evaluation
summary: Rubric-based LLM-as-judge pipelines often assume that evaluation criteria provide independent signals. In practice, however, criteria can be behaviorally coupled: improving one criterion may systematically change scores on another, distorting aggregate scores used in model-release or product-update decisions. We introduce RADAR, a lightweight preflight diagnostic framework for estimating such coupling before large-scale evaluation. Given a rubric, RADAR generates targeted synthetic probes, scores each probe on all criteria, and produces a directional coupling matrix that shows which criteria co-score and how. We validate RADAR on three industry-relevant evaluation settings: NVIDIA HelpSteer2, SumPubMed, and the Yale-Salesforce SummEval benchmark. Using only a small number of probes per criterion, RADAR recovers human inter-criterion correlation structure (Pearson r > 0.84) and provides practitioners with concrete audit signals about redundancy, hierarchy, and aggregation sensitivity before committing to large-scale judging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RADAR，一种轻量级预检诊断框架，用于在大规模评估前估计基于Rubric的LLM裁判流程中不同评估标准之间的行为耦合（相关性），通过生成定向合成探针来构建方向性耦合矩阵。
AI.motivation: 基于Rubric的LLM-as-judge流程通常假设评估标准是相互独立的，但实际中标准之间可能存在行为耦合：改进一个标准可能系统性地改变另一个标准的评分，从而扭曲用于模型发布或产品更新决策的聚合分数。
AI.method: RADAR框架包含三个步骤：1) 根据给定的Rubric生成目标定向的合成探针；2) 在每个探针上对所有标准进行评分；3) 生成一个方向性耦合矩阵，展示哪些标准会共同评分以及如何共同评分。每个标准仅需少量探针即可工作。
AI.result: 在NVIDIA HelpSteer2、SumPubMed和Yale-Salesforce SummEval三个行业相关评估基准上验证，RADAR仅使用每个标准少量探针即可恢复人类标准间相关性结构（Pearson r > 0.84），并为从业者提供关于冗余性、层级性和聚合敏感性的具体审计信号。
AI.conclusion: RADAR能够在投入大规模评估之前，为从业者提供关于评估标准耦合关系的有效诊断，帮助识别标准间的冗余、层级依赖以及聚合分数的敏感性，从而避免因耦合导致的不准确聚合评估结果。

title: Can Humans Dream of Electric Sheep? Human-Written Samples for Fine-Grained Vision-and-Language Hallucination Benchmarking
summary: In an age of rapid model turnover, how do we make hallucination evaluation more perennial? We explore whether human-written hallucination samples could take the place of model-generated hallucinations, in order to make benchmarking detection independent of particular models. To this end, we construct a dataset of 1,600 human-written samples, spanning four languages (Chinese, English, French, Italian), and 18,400 samples from five vision-and-language models, all annotated for hallucinations using a fine-grained span-level labeling scheme. We find that human-written samples result in higher agreement and allow greater control of dataset contents, while remaining distributionally similar to samples derived from vision-and-language samples and providing a reasonable portrayal of detection capabilities - suggesting that human data is a viable substitute for model-based hallucination benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨用人工编写的幻觉样本替代模型生成的幻觉样本，以构建不依赖特定模型的持续性幻觉评估基准，并验证了其可行性和有效性。
AI.motivation: 在模型快速更迭的时代，基于特定模型生成的幻觉评估基准会随着模型退役而过时。作者希望探索人工编写的幻觉样本能否替代模型生成样本，从而使幻觉检测基准不依赖于特定模型，更具持久性。
AI.method: 构建了包含1,600个人工编写样本（覆盖中、英、法、意四种语言）和18,400个来自五个视觉-语言模型的样本的数据集，采用细粒度的跨度级标注方案对幻觉进行标注，并对人工样本与模型样本的分布相似性、标注一致性和检测能力表征进行了系统比较。
AI.result: 人工编写的样本在标注一致性上更高，且对数据集内容有更好的控制力；同时在分布上与基于视觉-语言模型生成的样本保持相似，能够合理反映检测能力。
AI.conclusion: 人工数据可以作为基于模型的幻觉评估基准的有效替代方案，有助于构建不受特定模型限制、更具持久性的幻觉检测基准。

title: CraftAlign: Feature-Grounded Evaluation and Revision Guidance for AI Stories
summary: Large language models can now generate fluent and complete stories, yet many outputs still feel formulaic and unnatural because of cliches, over-explanation, linear causal progression, and stereotyped endings, an immediately recognizable AI flavor. Existing detection and evaluation methods often stop at source labels or holistic scores, while revision methods typically target predefined issues through localized edits, limiting their ability to support multiple plausible revision strategies or guide story-wide changes in information release, causal organization, and ending treatment. We introduce CraftAlign, a framework that aligns AI stories with the craft of human storytelling by both assessing Human/AI writing patterns and providing revision guidance. CraftAlign comprises two learned modules and an inference-time guidance pipeline. A feature estimator built on Qwen3.5-9B predicts 304 explicit writing features spanning style and narrative. A class-conditional energy model scores the resulting feature configuration against Human and AI writing patterns, conditioning on the original writing prompt when available. At inference time, CraftAlign applies schema-valid structured perturbations, selects changes that move the feature configuration toward the Human writing pattern, and converts them into natural-language guidance for a separate editor to rewrite the full story. Experiments show that CraftAlign accurately distinguishes Human and AI writing patterns and that its guidance outperforms revision baselines across editors and in a human study.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CraftAlign框架，通过预测304个写作特征并用类别条件能量模型评分，将AI生成的故事与人类写作模式对齐，并通过结构化扰动和自然语言指导实现全篇故事改写。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽能生成流畅完整的故事，但输出常带有模式化、过度解释、线性因果和刻板结局等明显的"AI味"。现有检测与评估方法停留在来源标签或整体评分层面，修订方法多针对预定义问题进行局部编辑，难以支持多种合理的修订策略或引导故事层面的信息释放、因果组织和结局处理。
AI.method: CraftAlign由两个学习模块和一个推理时引导管道构成：1) 基于Qwen3.5-9B的特征估计器，预测覆盖风格与叙事的304个显式写作特征；2) 类别条件能量模型，在给定原始写作提示的条件下，对特征配置与人类/AI写作模式进行匹配评分。推理时，框架应用模式验证的结构化扰动，选择使特征配置向人类写作模式移动的修改，并将其转化为自然语言指导，交由独立编辑器进行全篇重写。
AI.result: 实验表明CraftAlign能准确区分人类与AI写作模式，其提供的指导在多个编辑器和人类研究中的表现优于修订基线。
AI.conclusion: CraftAlign通过多维特征建模与能量评分相结合的方式，不仅能够评估人类/AI写作模式差异，还能提供可操作的全篇改写指导，有效缓解AI故事的模式化问题。

title: Divergent large language model predictions from convergent representations in ambiguous word pairs
comment: 21 main text pages, 20 pages supplemental, 4 figures
summary: In this work we investigate how decoder-only transformers resolve lexical ambiguity through layer-by-layer analysis of three models spanning three parameter sizes (GPT-2-Small-117M, Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen2.5-32B). For both homonyms and polysemes, we find that representations become maximally distinct in middle layers, then partially reconverge in late layers, while the KL divergence between their next-token predictions reaches its maximum in the final layers. The activation patching experiment provides causal evidence that late-layer representational differences directly determine outputs despite apparent increased similarity in embedding space. Our single-layer ablation experiment indicates that models achieve equivalent disambiguation despite qualitatively different layer-wise vulnerabilities. These findings offer a mechanism for recent observations where models' internal embedding similarities show low correlation with their behavioural outputs despite strong performance. The semantic distinctions therefore remain present but become increasingly invisible to similarity measures over the embeddings, with implications for embedding-based methods such as semantic search, retrieval, and clustering that rely on late-layer cosine similarity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了三种不同规模的纯解码器Transformer（GPT-2-Small-117M、Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen2.5-32B）如何处理词汇歧义。研究发现表征在中层达到最大区分度，随后在深层部分重新收敛，但最终层的KL散度仍达到最大。激活修补实验证明深层差异直接决定输出，单层消融实验显示不同模型存在不同的脆弱层。
AI.motivation: 近期观测表明模型内部嵌入相似度与行为输出之间的相关性低，但模型仍能表现出色地消解歧义。作者希望理解这一矛盾背后的机制——语义区分到底存在于何处，以及为什么嵌入空间的相似度度量无法捕捉到这些区分。
AI.method: 对三种参数规模的解码器Transformer（117M、3B、32B）进行逐层分析，针对同音词和多义词考察表征距离与KL散度变化；使用激活修补实验提供因果证据；设计单层消融实验比较不同模型的层敏感度。
AI.result: 词义表征在中层达到最大区分度后在深层部分重新收敛，而下一词预测的KL散度在最深层达到最大值；激活修补证实深层表征差异直接决定输出；不同模型在消融实验中展现出不同的脆弱层。
AI.conclusion: 语义区分在模型中始终存在，但在深层嵌入空间中变得对相似度度量越来越"不可见"。这一发现解释了嵌入相似度与行为输出低相关的现象，并对依赖深层余弦相似度的语义搜索、检索和聚类等嵌入方法提出了重要警示。

title: Struct-GStream: Towards Efficient Free-Viewpoint Video Streaming at Low-Bitrates with Structured 3D Gaussians
summary: Constructing photorealistic Free-Viewpoint Videos (FVVs) of dynamic scenes from a set of posed 2D images has been an intriguing yet challenging task in computer vision. Methods based on neural rendering achieve high-fidelity image quality in FVV construction. However, most of these methods are unable to achieve real-time rendering and often require complete video sequences to train. Despite the existence of some online training methods capable of rendering FVVs in real time, they struggle to meet the requirements for storage and training time for downstream applications. To overcome this problem, we propose Struct-GStream, which can achieve efficient FVV streaming using structured 3D Gaussians (3DGs). Specifically, we introduce dynamic anchor points to generate structured 3DGs to construct basic scenes and model approximate scene movements based on the assumption of local rigidity in object motion. Besides, we introduce a global free 3DGs patching strategy involving free 3DGs' generation, pruning, and optimization to patch and model deficient areas and emerging objects. Our method achieves fast training at low bitrates while maintaining high rendering quality. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Struct-GStream significantly outperforms existing online training methods for FVV construction in terms of training time, storage, and rendering quality while maintaining competitive rendering speed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Struct-GStream，一种基于结构化3D高斯（3DGs）的高效自由视点视频（FVV）流式构建方法，通过动态锚点生成结构化3DGs建模基础场景，并结合全局自由3DGs修补策略处理缺陷区域和新出现物体，实现低比特率下的快速训练和高渲染质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的神经渲染方法在FVV构建中能达到高保真图像质量，但多数无法实现实时渲染，且需要完整视频序列进行训练。虽然存在一些在线训练方法能实时渲染FVV，但在存储和训练时间上难以满足下游应用需求。
AI.method: 1) 引入动态锚点（dynamic anchor points）生成结构化3DGs构建基础场景；2) 基于物体运动局部刚性的假设建模近似场景运动；3) 提出全局自由3DGs修补策略，包括自由3DGs的生成、剪枝和优化，用于修补缺陷区域和建模新出现的物体。
AI.result: 实验表明Struct-GStream在训练时间、存储和渲染质量上显著优于现有FVV在线训练方法，同时保持了具有竞争力的渲染速度，实现了低比特率下的快速训练。
AI.conclusion: Struct-GStream通过结构化3DGs与自由3DGs修补策略的有机结合，成功解决了FVV流式构建中训练效率、存储占用与渲染质量之间的权衡问题，为实时FVV应用提供了可行方案。

title: Credit the Right Box: Marginal Contribution Assignment for Structured Visual Perception
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly expected to solve structured perception tasks that require visual recognition, language-to-object binding, object cardinality preservation, and precisely localized grounding and segmentation outputs. However, existing group-relative reinforcement learning methods provide only response-level supervision, creating a granularity mismatch for structured multi-object prediction: a single advantage is broadcast to all tokens in a response, without distinguishing individual box contributions. To address this mismatch, we propose MCR-GRPO, a marginal contribution assignment framework that derives box-level credit directly from each sampled response. Specifically, Marginal Contribution Reward (MCR) estimates each predicted box's contribution through a leave-one-out comparison, measuring how the matched set value changes when the box is removed from the response. After within-response normalization, records that improve the set value receive positive credit, while redundant or harmful ones are suppressed. To make marginal attribution stable and informative, we further introduce a Continuous Matched Set Value Evaluator that integrates permutation-invariant matching, count-aware normalization, and graded localization. MCR-GRPO maps normalized box-level marginal advantages to the token spans that generated each box, preserving GRPO's response-level comparison while enabling box-aware optimization of structured multi-object grounding. Experiments across REC, DOD, segmentation, and counting benchmarks show state-of-the-art performance over prior GRPO-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MCR-GRPO框架，通过边际贡献分配机制为多模态大语言模型的结构化多目标预测提供框级别的强化学习监督，解决了传统GRPO方法中响应级奖励与框级预测之间的粒度不匹配问题。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs需要处理结构化感知任务（如视觉识别、语言-物体绑定、目标基数保持、精确定位和分割），但已有的组相对强化学习方法仅提供响应级别的监督信号，单个优势被广播到所有token，无法区分每个预测框的独立贡献，造成粒度不匹配。
AI.method: 提出MCR-GRPO框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 边际贡献奖励（MCR），通过留一法比较来估计每个预测框的贡献，量化移除该框后匹配集值的变化；(2) 连续匹配集值评估器，集成排列不变匹配、计数感知归一化和分级定位，使边际归因稳定且信息丰富。框架将归一化的框级边际优势映射到生成每个框的token跨度上，保留GRPO的响应级比较。
AI.result: 在REC、DOD、分割和计数基准上，MCR-GRPO相较于先前的GRPO基线方法取得了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: MCR-GRPO通过框级别的信用分配，有效解决了结构化多目标预测中强化学习的粒度不匹配问题，证明了在保留GRPO响应级比较优势的同时实现框级优化的可行性和有效性。

title: No Single Neuron of Failure: Distributed Safety Alignment Against White-Box Attacks
summary: With the rapid release of open-weight large foundation models, safety threats are shifting from black-box jailbreaks to neuron-level white-box attacks that directly identify and manipulate safety-related neurons. Existing alignment methods often investigate the safety behavior on a small number of neurons, creating fragile single point of failure with limited redundancy. To address this issue, we propose distributed safety alignment (DSA), which redundantly encodes safety capabilities across multiple computational neurons, ensuring that the model maintains its safety baseline even when critical safety neurons are disrupted. Specifically, we localize the intervention to the inputs of the down-projection layers in language-side feed-forward networks and treat each feature coordinate as the activation of an individual neuron. DSA then combines neuron activations with loss gradients to compute a direction-aware first-order Taylor score that globally identifies the neurons that contribute most to the current refusal behavior of the model. Finally, targeted disruption via deterministic masking and stochastic dropout is coupled, forcing the model to abandon narrow safety neurons and redundantly encode safety behavior across multiple compensatory neurons. Extensive experiments show that DSA substantially improves robustness against white-box neuron-level safety attacks while preserving the model's general language and multimodal utility.

AI.tldr: 提出分布式安全对齐（DSA）方法，将安全能力冗余编码到多个计算神经元中，以抵御白盒神经元级安全攻击，避免传统对齐方法仅依赖少量安全神经元的脆弱性问题。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐方法将安全行为集中在少数安全神经元上，导致单一故障点，缺乏冗余性，容易受到白盒神经元级攻击的破坏。
AI.method: 将干预定位到语言侧前馈网络的降投影层输入，将每个特征坐标视为独立神经元；结合神经元激活与损失梯度计算方向感知的一阶泰勒分数，全局识别对拒绝行为贡献最大的神经元；通过确定性掩码与随机丢弃的联合目标扰动，迫使模型放弃狭隘的安全神经元，将安全行为冗余编码到多个补偿神经元中。
AI.result: 大量实验表明DSA显著提升了模型对白盒神经元级安全攻击的鲁棒性，同时保留了模型的通用语言和多模态能力。
AI.conclusion: 分布式冗余编码安全能力是一种有效的防御策略，能够克服传统对齐方法在神经元级攻击下的脆弱性问题，兼顾安全性与通用性。

title: CRISP: Critical Step Perception for Training Efficient Deep Search Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly extended into deep search agents that solve complex questions through multi-step interaction with external search and browsing tools. However, existing agents often incur substantial computational and interaction costs, generating lengthy trajectories that contain redundant queries, inefficient exploration, and irrelevant observations. Existing efficiency-oriented methods usually encourage agents to use tools less frequently, but treating all tool interactions uniformly may also suppress steps that gather necessary evidence. In this paper, we propose CRISP, a framework for training efficient deep search agents through critical step perception. Unlike prior efficiency methods that uniformly penalize tool use, CRISP distinguishes interactions that gather necessary evidence from redundant ones and shapes the training reward to preserve the former while pruning the latter, improving efficiency without sacrificing the evidence needed for correct answers. Specifically, CRISP first constructs critical-step labels with Backward Evidence Induction: starting from the final answer, a strong model traverses a completed search trajectory backward and judges whether each tool-interaction step provides or preserves evidence for the final answer. We then distill these step-wise judgments into a smaller critical-step recognizer, enabling full-trajectory analysis in a single pass. During policy optimization, an efficiency-aware reward is applied only to successful rollouts. Experiments on BrowseComp and HLE-Verified show that CRISP maintains competitive final-answer accuracy while reducing average interaction turns by 15.1% and 33.2%, respectively, demonstrating substantial improvements in interaction efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CRISP框架，通过关键步骤感知（critical step perception）训练高效深度搜索智能体。与以往统一惩罚工具使用的效率方法不同，CRISP区分必要证据收集与冗余交互，通过反向证据归纳（Backward Evidence Induction）标注关键步骤，并蒸馏到小型识别器中进行策略优化，在保持答案准确率的同时显著减少交互轮次（BrowseComp减少15.1%，HLE-Verified减少33.2%）。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的深度搜索智能体在解决复杂问题时产生大量冗余查询和无效探索，导致高昂的计算与交互成本。已有的效率优化方法通常统一惩罚所有工具使用，但这可能同时抑制了收集必要证据的关键交互步骤，牺牲了答案质量。因此需要一种能够区分必要证据收集与冗余交互的训练方法，在不牺牲答案正确性的前提下提升效率。
AI.method: CRISP框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 使用Backward Evidence Induction构建关键步骤标签——从最终答案出发，让强模型反向遍历完整的搜索轨迹，判断每个工具交互步骤是否为最终答案提供了或保留了证据；(2) 将步骤级判断蒸馏到较小的关键步骤识别器中，使其能够在单次遍历中完成全轨迹分析；(3) 在策略优化阶段，仅对成功rollout应用效率感知奖励，保留必要证据收集步骤同时裁剪冗余步骤。
AI.result: 在BrowseComp和HLE-Verified两个基准上的实验表明，CRISP在保持与基线相当的最终答案准确率的同时，平均交互轮次分别减少了15.1%和33.2%，展示了显著的交互效率提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过区分"必要证据收集"与"冗余交互"而非统一惩罚工具使用，CRISP能够在提升搜索智能体交互效率的同时不牺牲答案准确性，为深度搜索智能体的高效训练提供了一种更精细、更有原则性的方法。

title: Extended KAFR: A kinematic-adaptive paradigm for the efficient analysis of surgical video
summary: Artificial Intelligence is increasingly applied to surgical video analysis for phase segmentation, skill assessment, and workflow optimization. A key challenge is the length of surgical recordings, often one to several hours, creating substantial computational burden. We previously developed Kinematics-Adaptive Frame Recognition (KAFR) for robotic surgery, showing that tracking tool motion effectively identifies informative frames while filtering redundant content. However, laparoscopic surgery introduces additional challenges: manual camera control causes frequent motion artifacts, and image quality is generally lower than robotic systems. This study evaluates whether KAFR generalizes to laparoscopic surgery using the Cholec80 benchmark, comprising 80 laparoscopic cholecystectomy procedures annotated for seven surgical phases. KAFR operates in three stages: a fine-tuned YOLO model detects and segments surgical tools; frames are adaptively selected based on tool displacement or velocity variation; and an X3D model classifies selected frames into surgical phases. KAFR achieved a 91.0\% F1 score using only 0.58\% of frames for phase classification, representing an approximately seven-fold reduction compared to typical 4\% frame sampling, while maintaining performance comparable to LoViT (90.2\%) and Trans-SVNet (89.7\%). These results demonstrate that kinematics-based frame selection transfers effectively to the challenging laparoscopic environment.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了运动自适应帧识别（KAFR）方法在腹腔镜手术视频分析中的泛化能力。在Chole80基准上，KAFR仅使用0.58%的帧即可达到91.0%的F1分数，性能与LoViT（90.2%）和Trans-SVNet（89.7%）相当，同时计算成本降低了约7倍，证明了运动学帧选择方法可有效迁移到更具挑战性的腹腔镜环境。
AI.motivation: 手术视频通常长达数小时，给AI分析带来巨大计算负担。此前KAFR方法已在机器人手术中验证有效性，但腹腔镜手术存在手动镜头控制造成的运动伪影和较低图像质量等额外挑战，需要验证KAFR是否能够在此环境中泛化。
AI.method: KAFR采用三阶段架构：1）微调的YOLO模型检测和分割手术器械；2）基于器械位移或速度变化自适应选择帧；3）X3D模型对所选帧进行手术阶段分类。在包含80例腹腔镜胆囊切除术的Cholec80基准上进行评估。
AI.result: KAFR在仅使用0.58%帧的情况下达到91.0%的F1分数，相比典型4%帧采样实现了约7倍的计算量缩减，性能与LoViT（90.2%）和Trans-SVNet（89.7%）相当。
AI.conclusion: 运动学驱动的帧选择方法能够有效迁移到腹腔镜手术环境，在显著降低计算成本的同时保持与先进方法相当的分割性能，验证了KAFR的泛化能力。

title: Reusing Rollouts under Policy Lag: Prefix-Normalized Policy Optimization for LLM Reinforcement Learning
summary: Autoregressive rollout generation is a major computational cost in reinforcement learning for large language models. Reusing each rollout batch for additional learner updates amortizes this cost, but later updates become increasingly off-policy as the learner departs from the behavior policy. At a token position, exact off-policy correction must account for both the current action and the probability of reaching its prefix. The cumulative importance ratio provides this correction, but its product form can produce an unwieldy dynamic range. We study Prefix-Normalized Policy Optimization (PNPO), which replaces the cumulative ratio with the geometric mean of likelihood ratios along each causal prefix, preserving causal-prefix dependence at each position while compressing the log-weight scale. In controlled long-context mathematical reasoning experiments, we induce two off-policy regimes by using one or four policy-update epochs per rollout batch. PNPO does not consistently outperform GSPO with one epoch. With four epochs, it attains the highest observed Avg@32 on each benchmark; the unweighted mean of the three independently selected benchmark peaks is 50.24, 3.00 percentage points above GSPO. Under a matched 2,400-update budget, four-epoch PNPO reaches a final macro Avg@32 of 49.66 after 150 rollout batches, comparable to the 49.56 reached after 600 batches with one epoch. These results provide preliminary evidence that PNPO can be advantageous as training moves further off-policy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究前缀归一化策略优化（PNPO），一种用于大语言模型强化学习中缓解离策略问题的方法。PNPO用每一因果前缀上似然比的几何均值替代累积重要性比率，在保持因果前缀依赖的同时压缩权重尺度。实验表明，在单轮策略更新下PNPO不优于GSPO，但在四轮更新（更离策略）场景下，PNPO在长上下文数学推理基准上取得最高Avg@32（50.24，比GSPO高3.00个百分点），并在2400次更新预算下用150个rollout批次达到与单轮600批次相当的最终表现。
AI.motivation: 自回归rollout生成是LLM强化学习的重大计算成本。复用rollout批次进行多次学习者更新可以摊销成本，但随着策略偏离行为策略，后续更新越来越离策略。精确的离策略修正需要累积重要性比率，但其乘积形式会导致动态范围过大，难以处理。因此需要一种既能保持因果前缀依赖又能压缩权重尺度的修正方法。
AI.method: 提出前缀归一化策略优化（PNPO），用沿着每个因果前缀的似然比几何均值替代累积重要性比率，保留每个位置的因果前缀依赖同时压缩log权重的尺度。在长上下文数学推理实验中，通过每批rollout使用一轮或四轮策略更新来诱导两种离策略强度，与GSPO对照。
AI.result: 单轮更新时PNPO未持续优于GSPO；四轮更新时PNPO在每个基准上取得最高Avg@32，三个独立选择基准峰值的未加权均值为50.24，比GSPO高3.00个百分点。在匹配2400次更新的预算下，四轮PNPO在150个rollout批次后达到最终宏Avg@32为49.66，接近单轮600批次达到的49.56。
AI.conclusion: 初步证据表明，随着训练进一步偏离策略，PNPO相比GSPO可能具有优势，尤其在多轮策略更新场景下，能在更少的rollout批次下达到与更多批次相当的性能。

title: TRAM: Enhancing Multimodal Reasoning with Trajectory-Derived Auxiliary Memory
summary: Multimodal Large Reasoning Models (MLRMs) have achieved strong performance on tasks requiring visual understanding and multi-step inference. However, as reasoning trajectories grow, models may become less effective at using information established earlier in the context, increasing the risk of reasoning errors. Existing approaches primarily address this problem by sustaining visual grounding throughout reasoning. However, reasoning also transforms visual observations into task-specific relations, constraints, and intermediate conclusions whose influence may weaken over long trajectories. Our attribution analysis suggests that correctness is not consistently separated by image attribution alone, but is more closely associated with whether trajectories retain and integrate such reasoning-derived information across stages. Motivated by this, we introduce TRAM (TRajectory-derived Auxiliary Memory), a training-free method that augments standard decoding with an auxiliary memory pathway derived from the model's own reasoning trajectory. TRAM consolidates completed reasoning into a compact latent memory, updates it online through fast and slow recurrent streams, and feeds it back into selected decoder layers through a lightweight residual pathway. Experiments across four MLRM variants on eight benchmarks show that TRAM improves performance over vanilla decoding on mathematical, scientific, and general visual reasoning tasks without additional training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRAM（轨迹衍生辅助记忆），一种无需训练的推理增强方法，通过将模型自身推理轨迹压缩为潜在记忆并通过快速和慢速循环流在线更新，再以残差路径将记忆反馈回解码器层，从而在多模态大语言推理模型的长轨迹推理中保留和整合推理派生信息，提升数学、科学和通用视觉推理任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言推理模型（MLRMs）在视觉理解和多步推理任务上表现优异，但随着推理轨迹变长，模型可能难以有效利用早期建立的信息，导致推理错误增加。现有方法主要通过在推理过程中维持视觉接地来解决该问题，但推理不仅依赖视觉观测，还会将视觉信息转化为任务特定的关系、约束和中间结论，这些推理派生信息在长轨迹中的影响力会逐渐减弱。归因分析表明，仅靠图像归因无法一致区分正确性，正确性更多与轨迹是否在不同阶段保留和整合推理派生信息相关。
AI.method: TRAM方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 将已完成的推理压缩为紧凑的潜在记忆；(2) 通过快速和慢速两个循环流在线更新记忆；(3) 通过轻量级残差路径将记忆反馈到选定的解码器层。该方法无需额外训练，直接增强标准解码过程。
AI.result: 在四种MLRM变体上对八个基准数据集的实验表明，TRAM相比标准解码（vanilla decoding）在数学、科学和通用视觉推理任务上均取得了性能提升，且无需额外训练。
AI.conclusion: TRAM通过引入从推理轨迹自身衍生的辅助记忆通路，有效解决了长推理轨迹中推理派生信息衰减的问题，为提升多模态推理模型的长期推理一致性提供了一种简单有效的无需训练的解决方案。

title: One Query, Many Scales: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts for Efficient Hierarchical Cross-View Geo-Localization
summary: Cross-view geo-localization (CVGL) retrieves geo-tagged satellite imagery for a ground-view query. Most systems exhaustively search a flat, fixed-resolution gallery, incurring high cost over large areas and adapting poorly to satellite resolution changes. Autoregressive coarse-to-fine alternatives reduce comparisons but bind later predictions to earlier decisions and a predefined hierarchy. We introduce GeoMoE, a sparse mixture-of-experts dual encoder that decouples global multi-scale representation learning from local hierarchical search. Global multi-scale supervision and content-adaptive routing map ground and satellite images across resolutions into a globally comparable embedding space. At inference, each image is encoded once, and probabilistic beam search follows parent--child links to score a small candidate subset. Later levels reuse these descriptors rather than features generated by preceding levels, limiting feature-level error propagation and hierarchy coupling. We further introduce VIGOR-M, a four-city benchmark with an explicit parent--child satellite hierarchy and held-out half-step galleries for single-resolution, cross-resolution, and hierarchical evaluation. GeoMoE achieves 95.78% R@40m on Just Zoom In, 2.77 percentage points above the previous best, and 62.39% R@1 on VIGOR-M. The latter requires 0.885 MMAC/query for descriptor matching, 5.27% of an exhaustive L3 scan, while exceeding the strongest exhaustive baseline by 3.12 percentage points in R@1. One model trained on L1, L2, and L3 also outperforms a matched dense control across all six galleries and transfers to three withheld resolutions. By decoupling globally trained embeddings from local hierarchical search, GeoMoE jointly improves localization accuracy, search efficiency, and cross-resolution transfer.

AI.tldr: GeoMoE提出了一种稀疏混合专家双编码器，解耦全局多尺度表示学习与局部层次化搜索，实现了跨视角地理定位的精度、效率和跨分辨率迁移能力的联合提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的跨视角地理定位（CVGL）系统要么在固定的平面分辨率画廊上穷举搜索，成本高昂且难以适应卫星分辨率变化；要么采用自回归粗到细搜索，但存在早期决策错误传播和预定义层次结构耦合的问题。
AI.method: GeoMoE包含两个核心组件：(1) 全局多尺度监督与内容自适应路由的稀疏混合专家双编码器，将地面和卫星图像映射到全局可比的嵌入空间；(2) 推理阶段的概率束搜索，基于父-子链接只对少量候选子集打分，后续层级复用已有描述符而非重新生成特征，从而限制特征级错误传播和层次耦合。同时引入VIGOR-M基准。
AI.result: GeoMoE在Just Zoom In上达到95.78% R@40m（较此前最优提升2.77个百分点），在VIGOR-M上达到62.39% R@1，描述符匹配仅需0.885 MMAC/查询（仅为穷举L3扫描的5.27%），并在R@1上超过最强穷举基线3.12个百分点。单一模型在全部六个画廊上超越密集对照组，并迁移到三个保留分辨率。
AI.conclusion: 通过将全局训练的嵌入与局部层次化搜索解耦，GeoMoE同时提升了定位精度、搜索效率和跨分辨率迁移能力，验证了稀疏混合专家与层次化搜索结合的可行性。

title: Scoring Rules! Statistical and Strategic Alignment for Text Evaluation Metrics
summary: Reference-based text evaluation metrics, which are widely used to assess natural language generation systems, score a candidate response by comparing it with a reference response. The reliability of an evaluation metric is usually judged by its statistical correlation with human ratings. However, as these metrics are increasingly used as optimization objectives, correlation alone is no longer sufficient: agents may strategically game the evaluation metric. We study this issue through two complementary notions of alignment. A metric is statistically aligned if it correlates with human ratings and strategically aligned if it resists perturbations that do not add task-relevant information. We make two contributions. First, we propose test principles for reference-based metrics consisting of human-rating correlation, degradation sensitivity, and manipulation robustness. These principles evaluate whether a metric agrees with human judgments, penalizes low-effort information loss, and resists strategic score inflation. Second, we develop a unified design framework for mutual-information-based metrics that decomposes existing and new metrics into four choices: information measure, estimation method, text representation, and prediction mechanism. Across peer review, summarization, and question answering, we find that strong human-rating correlation does not imply strategic alignment: LLM-as-a-Judge achieves high correlation but is susceptible to manipulation. In contrast, mutual-information-based metrics substantially improve manipulation robustness. Our framework also uncovers a new metric that achieves the strongest overall robustness in our experiments while remaining competitive on human-rating correlation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于参考的文本评估指标，提出统计对齐（与人类评分相关）与策略对齐（抵抗无信息扰动）两个互补概念，并建立互信息指标的统一设计框架，发现强相关性不等于策略对齐，互信息类指标在操作鲁棒性上显著优于LLM-as-a-Judge。
AI.motivation: 随着评估指标越来越多地被用作优化目标，仅靠与人类评分的相关性来判断指标可靠性已不足够，因为智能体可能策略性地操控评估指标（即"打榜"行为），因此需要系统地研究指标在统计和策略两个维度上的对齐性。
AI.method: 提出三项测试原则：人类评分相关性、退化敏感性（惩罚低质量信息损失）、操作鲁棒性（抵抗策略性分数膨胀）。同时构建统一的互信息指标设计框架，将现有及新指标分解为四个选择维度：信息度量、估计方法、文本表示和预测机制。
AI.result: 在同行评审、摘要生成和问答任务中，发现LLM-as-a-Judge虽然人类评分相关性高但容易被操控；互信息类指标在操作鲁棒性上显著更优。框架还发现了一个新指标，在整体鲁棒性上最强，同时保持competitive的人类评分相关性。
AI.conclusion: 人类评分相关性高并不保证策略对齐性，评估指标需要同时满足统计对齐和策略对齐双重标准；互信息框架提供了一个系统化的设计空间，能够开发出既保持高相关性又具备强操作鲁棒性的指标。

title: ReACT-CLIP: Response-Aware Test-Time Defense for Vision--Language Models
summary: Training-free test-time defenses offer a practical way to improve the adversarial robustness of CLIP-style vision--language models without modifying the pretrained model. However, their correction strength is typically fixed for a narrow range of attack budgets, even though the attack budget is unknown at inference and the required correction varies across samples. We show that this mismatch causes existing defenses to degrade sharply as attacks strengthen. We introduce ReACT-CLIP, a response-conditioned test-time defense that separately determines how strongly each input should be corrected and whether defensive intervention is necessary. Our key observation is that the relative increase in CLIP visual-feature drift between low- and high-noise probes provides a graded, sample-specific proxy for correction demand. ReACT-CLIP maps this relative cross-noise drift to the Gaussian noise scale used to construct a stable, noise-averaged feature anchor, enabling the corrective reach to adapt to each input. To determine whether intervention is necessary, we further observe that clean inputs retain stable class-probability distributions under weak spatial augmentations, whereas adversarial inputs exhibit greater variation. ReACT-CLIP quantifies this variation using a prediction-instability score computed by Jensen--Shannon divergence and combines it with relative cross-noise drift to form the defensive intervention score. ReACT-CLIP requires no model or prompt training, and its correction-strength mapping is calibrated once and fixed across datasets and attack budgets. Across 12 downstream datasets, as well as ImageNet and its distribution-shifted variants, ReACT-CLIP delivers substantial robustness gains across diverse attack types and strengths while largely preserving clean accuracy.

AI.tldr: ReACT-CLIP是一种无需训练的测试时防御方法，通过响应条件化的校正强度自适应处理CLIP模型的对抗样本，在不同攻击预算下均能保持鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有训练无关的测试时防御方法对CLIP模型的校正强度是固定的，仅适用于狭窄的攻击预算范围，而实际推理时攻击强度未知且不同样本所需的校正程度不同，导致防御性能在攻击增强时急剧下降。
AI.method: ReACT-CLIP通过两个关键机制实现自适应防御：(1)利用CLIP视觉特征在低噪声和高噪声探测之间的相对漂移作为样本特定的校正需求代理，映射到高斯噪声尺度以构建噪声平均特征锚点；(2)通过Jensen-Shannon散度计算预测不稳定性分数，结合相对跨噪声漂移形成防御干预分数，判断是否需要干预。
AI.result: 在12个下游数据集、ImageNet及其分布偏移变体上，ReACT-CLIP在多种攻击类型和强度下均取得了显著的鲁棒性提升，同时基本保持了干净样本的准确率。
AI.conclusion: ReACT-CLIP证明响应条件化的测试时防御可以有效解决固定校正强度与未知攻击预算之间的失配问题，无需模型或提示词训练，校正强度映射只需校准一次即可跨数据集和攻击预算使用。

title: MRAFnd: Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Zero-Shot Fake News Detection
comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables, Presented at the MMM 2026
summary: The rapid dissemination of multimodal content has intensified the spread of fabricated news, presenting a substantial threat to social integrity. A formidable challenge for current detection systems is identifying misinformation related to novel events in zero-shot scenarios. Prevailing zero-shot methods typically assess news items in isolation via semantic matching, a strategy that fails to recognize the recycled disinformation tactics from past campaigns and lacks the sophisticated reasoning needed to identify subtle, cross-modal discrepancies. To surmount these deficiencies, we introduce \textbf{MRAFnd}, a novel \underline{\textbf{M}}ultimodal \underline{\textbf{R}}etrieval-\underline{\textbf{A}}ugmented Framework for Zero-Shot \underline{\textbf{F}}ake \underline{\textbf{N}}ews \underline{\textbf{D}}etection. MRAFnd emulates a collaborative team of analysts to verify news veracity. The framework initiates with \textbf{Multimodal Similarity-based News Retrieval} to assemble a corpus of contextually analogous articles from an unlabeled reference database. Subsequently, during the \textbf{Bifurcated Evidential Reasoning} stage, agents perform a dual-directional analysis to extract critical patterns from the retrieved evidence. Finally, a \textbf{Multi-Agent Collaborative Debate}, involving Analyst and Arbiter agents, engages in a structured discourse to arrive at a definitive and robust conclusion. Comprehensive experiments on three benchmark datasets reveal that MRAFnd markedly surpasses state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an accuracy gain of up to 2.35\% on the demanding Weibo-21 dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MRAFnd框架，一种基于多模态检索增强的零样本假新闻检测方法。该框架通过多模态相似性检索、双向证据推理和多智能体协作辩论三个阶段来模拟分析师团队协作，在三个基准数据集上超越现有方法，在Weibo-21数据集上准确率提升达2.35%。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本假新闻检测方法存在两大缺陷：一是孤立地评估新闻内容，未能利用过去虚假信息活动的重复策略；二是缺乏识别跨模态细微差异所需的复杂推理能力。多模态内容的快速传播使得虚假新闻检测更加困难。
AI.method: MRAFnd框架包含三个阶段：(1) 基于多模态相似性的新闻检索，从未标注参考数据库中收集上下文相似的新闻；(2) 双向证据推理阶段，智能体从检索到的证据中提取关键模式；(3) 多智能体协作辩论阶段，分析师和仲裁者智能体通过结构化讨论达成最终结论。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上的综合实验表明，MRAFnd显著超越最先进的基线方法，在具有挑战性的Weibo-21数据集上实现了最高2.35%的准确率提升。
AI.conclusion: MRAFnd通过模拟协作分析师团队的方式，将检索增强机制与多智能体推理相结合，有效解决了零样本场景下多模态假新闻检测中缺乏上下文关联和推理能力不足的问题。

title: Look Ahead Before You Distill: Future Trajectory Validation of Teacher Guidance for Agentic On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides teacher supervision on states visited by the student, reducing the distribution gap between training and inference. However, in multi-turn agentic tasks, student deviations may accumulate over time, gradually moving the trajectory away from states where teacher guidance remains effective. Our quantitative analysis further shows that high-disagreement states offer promising opportunities for teacher guidance, but determining whether such guidance is beneficial requires examining its effect on subsequent student trajectories. We propose FutureBridge-OPD (FTB), which executes a short teacher bridge at a high disagreement state and uses the resulting student continuation to assess whether the bridge increases the density of positive distillation signals relative to the teacher. On ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld, under the main Qwen3-32B teacher to Qwen3-1.7B student setting, FTB outperforms vanilla OPD and TCOD by an average of 16.6 and 7.6 points, respectively, and remains effective across student scales and teacher settings. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/ChenChiShui/FutureBridge-OPD.

AI.tldr: 提出FutureBridge-OPD (FTB)方法，在师生轨迹高分歧状态下执行短期的教师桥接，通过评估学生后续轨迹判断桥接是否增加正向蒸馏信号密度，从而改善多轮智能体任务中的在线策略蒸馏效果。
AI.motivation: 在线策略蒸馏(OPD)在学生访问的状态上提供教师监督以缩小训练与推理的分布差距，但在多轮智能体任务中，学生偏差随时间累积会使轨迹逐渐偏离教师有效指导的状态。高分歧状态虽提供有前景的教师指导机会，但判断其是否有益需考察对学生后续轨迹的影响。
AI.method: FTB在高分歧状态执行短期教师桥接，然后利用桥接后学生的后续轨迹来评估该桥接是否相对于教师增加了正向蒸馏信号的密度，据此决定是否采纳该桥接。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和ScienceWorld基准上，以Qwen3-32B教师蒸馏至Qwen3-1.7B学生为主设定下，FTB相比vanilla OPD和TCOD分别平均提升16.6和7.6个百分点，并且在不同的学生规模和教师设置下均保持有效性。
AI.conclusion: FTB通过前瞻性评估教师桥接的价值，有效解决了多轮任务中蒸馏偏差累积问题，显著优于现有OPD基线方法，且具备跨规模和跨教师设定的泛化能力。

title: PlantRig - From Bones to Branches: Adaptation of Autoregressive Rigging Models for Plant Skeletal Reconstruction
summary: Autoregressive rigging models such as UniRig and SkinTokens perform well on articulated characters, but their ability to generalize to plant structures remains largely unexplored, since plant topologies exhibit highly variable, non-canonical branching patterns that challenge learned skeletal priors. We evaluate these models for plant skeletal reconstruction using synthetic L-system-generated trees and real scanned data spanning monopodial, sympodial, whorled, and vine-like archetypes. Preliminary testing showed UniRig collapsing complex branching into near-linear chains, while SkinTokens preserved topology better but over-segmented branches and produced an unstable output space, so we focused on UniRig for its greater stability. Diagnosis traced the collapse to sampling-level suppression of branch tokens, and further analysis showed the frozen mesh encoder had limited sensitivity to structural variation, pointing to a geometric bottleneck in the tokenization pipeline rather than a purely learned bias. Building on these findings, we applied multi-round fine-tuning over multiple procedurally generated synthetic datasets. Across rounds, the model progressively recovered accurate branching topology and generalized beyond branch-only structures to plants with foliage, a harder case given the zero-thickness, mesh-normal-dependent geometry of leaves. The resulting model generalized well across diverse plant forms without leaf-specific architectural changes, indicating that targeted fine-tuning can substantially close the domain gap between character-rigging priors and plant skeletal structure. As such, our work points toward a viable path for automated plant rigging across both branch topology and foliage type, even those not considered in our findings.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了自回归绑骨模型（UniRig和SkinTokens）在植物骨骼重建任务上的泛化能力。研究发现UniRig在复杂分支结构上会塌缩为近似线性链，而SkinTokens虽能保留拓扑但过度分割且输出不稳定。通过诊断，问题根源在于采样层面的分支token抑制以及冻结的网格编码器对结构变化敏感度不足，属于tokenization管道的几何瓶颈而非纯学习偏差。通过多轮微调，模型逐步恢复了准确的分支拓扑，并能泛化到带叶片的植物结构，表明针对性微调可以有效弥合角色绑骨先验与植物骨骼结构之间的领域差距。
AI.motivation: 自回归绑骨模型在角色绑骨上表现优异，但能否泛化到植物结构尚未被探索。植物拓扑具有高度可变、非规范的分支模式，对学习到的骨骼先验构成挑战，因此需要评估并改进这些模型在植物骨骼重建上的能力。
AI.method: 使用L-system生成的合成树木和真实扫描数据（涵盖单轴、合轴、轮生和藤蔓状原型）评估UniRig和SkinTokens。通过初步测试聚焦UniRig，诊断其分支塌缩问题，然后采用多轮微调策略，在多个程序化生成的合成数据集上逐步训练，最终推广到带叶片的植物结构。
AI.result: 多轮微调后，模型逐步恢复了准确的分支拓扑，并能泛化到带叶片的植物（零厚度、依赖网格法线的叶片几何是更困难的案例）。模型在多样植物形态上表现良好，无需针对叶片进行架构修改。
AI.conclusion: 针对性微调能够显著弥合角色绑骨先验与植物骨骼结构之间的领域差距，为自动化植物绑骨在分支拓扑和叶片类型两方面提供了可行路径，即使对于未在发现中考虑的植物类型也具备泛化潜力。

title: PolymerGPT: Multi-property Optimization with a Decoder-Based GPT Model for Generative Polymer Design
summary: Polymer property prediction and inverse generative design targeting desired properties are two crucial tasks in machine learning-assisted polymer design. While the former has received considerable attention, there have been limited methods developed for the latter. Existing methods focus on single-property optimization in the generative process, whereas accurate prediction of macroscopic material behavior requires simultaneous control of multiple physical properties. In this paper, we provide a transformative framework for direct optimization of a large collection of polymer properties. We propose PolymerGPT, a decoder-based GPT model that incorporates up to 37 commonly used polymer properties into the generative process via learned conditioning prefixes. It also supports a scaffold condition that specifies a desired scaffold for predicted structures. Our experimental results demonstrate that PolymerGPT achieves exceptional performance for unconditional and conditional generation while maintaining high validity, uniqueness, and novelty. Conditioning on five key properties yields generated structures whose predicted values closely match all target properties simultaneously.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PolymerGPT，一种基于解码器GPT架构的聚合物生成模型，通过学习到的条件前缀将多达37种常用聚合物属性融入生成过程，支持多属性同时控制和脚手架条件约束，实现面向目标性能的聚合物逆向设计。
AI.motivation: 现有聚合物逆向设计方法大多只针对单一属性进行优化，而准确预测宏观材料行为需要同时控制多个物理属性。聚合物属性预测已有较多研究，但面向目标属性的逆向生成设计方法非常有限。
AI.method: 采用解码器式GPT架构，将多达37种聚合物属性通过可学习的条件前缀（conditioning prefixes）融入生成过程，同时支持脚手架（scaffold）条件来指定预测结构的期望骨架。
AI.result: PolymerGPT在无条件和条件生成任务中均表现优异，保持了高有效性、独特性和新颖性。在五个关键属性条件下，生成结构的预测值与所有目标属性同时紧密匹配。
AI.conclusion: PolymerGPT提供了一个变革性的框架，能够直接优化大量聚合物属性，实现了多属性同时控制的聚合物逆向设计，填补了该领域方法空白。

title: CompanionBench: A Theory-Anchored, Real-World-Grounded Benchmark for AI Emotional Companionship
comment: 33 pages, 6 figures, 19 tables, 13 appendices. Bilingual (Chinese/English) interactive benchmark; 28 evaluated agents
summary: LLM companions are deployed at scale in personally consequential settings, yet poorly evaluated. Existing benchmarks use hand-authored scenarios and prompted simulators, aggregate empathy into one score, and overlook judge biases such as same-family favoritism and scale drift. We introduce CompanionBench, an interactive bilingual benchmark. To our knowledge, it is the first companion benchmark to ground both its scenarios and a trained user simulator in de-identified real-world data. A hidden disclosure gate branches each persona's trajectory on the agent's own behavior, controlling the interaction state space without scripting dialogue. We operationalize ten capabilities derived from 25 theories across psychology and counseling, four of them not graded explicitly by prior work: holding ambiguity, selfobject responsiveness, positive resonance and calibrated challenge. Agents are assessed on two complementary axes: a subjective ten-capability rubric and a deterministic measure of whether deeper disclosure was earned. A cross-family panel dilutes same-family favoritism; an Item Response Theory model separates agent quality from judge severity. Theory fixes what to measure and how personas are structured; real data supply events, history, and profiles -- coverage from theory, authenticity from data. Rankings are reproducible in both languages (rho = 0.996 ZH / 0.953 EN). Evaluating 28 agents reveals capability-level differences obscured by aggregate scores. Emotion regulation and calibrated challenge remain common weaknesses; holding ambiguity discriminates most. Role-play agents rank near the bottom: immersion does not imply relational competence. Across agents, the dominant failure mode is substituting surface warmth for substantive relational support. We will release 500 Chinese-English parallel pairs and the evaluation code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CompanionBench，一个基于真实去标识化数据构建的中英双语互动式陪伴型LLM基准测试框架，通过隐藏披露门和十项能力维度（源自25种心理学/咨询理论）评估28个智能体，发现情绪调节和校准挑战是普遍弱点，角色扮演智能体排名垫底，核心失败模式是表面温暖替代实质性关系支持。
AI.motivation: LLM陪伴型智能体已大规模部署于个人重要场景中，但现有评估存在四大缺陷：场景依赖手工编写和提示模拟器、将共情聚合为单一分数、忽略评判者偏见（同族偏爱和尺度漂移）。需要一个更严谨、可复现、理论驱动的评估框架。
AI.method: CompanionBench采用双语言（中英）基准设计：1) 场景和训练的用户模拟器均基于真实去标识化数据；2) 隐藏披露门根据智能体自身行为分支人物轨迹，无需脚本对话；3) 将25种心理学/咨询理论操作化为十项能力，其中四项（容忍模糊性、自体客体响应、积极共振、校准挑战）是先前工作未明确评分的；4) 双评估轴：十项能力主观评分标准+确定性深度披露指标；5) 跨家族评审团稀释同族偏爱，项目反应理论（IRT）模型分离智能体质量与评判者严格度。
AI.result: 评估28个智能体，排名在两种语言下均高度可复现（中文rho=0.996，英文rho=0.953）。能力层面的差异被聚合分数掩盖：情绪调节和校准挑战是普遍弱点；容忍模糊性区分度最高；角色扮演智能体排名接近底部（沉浸不等于关系能力）；所有智能体中最主要的失败模式是用表面温暖替代实质性关系支持。将发布500对中英平行对和评估代码。
AI.conclusion: 理论决定衡量内容和人物结构，真实数据提供事件、历史和画像——覆盖度来自理论，真实性来自数据。CompanionBench证明了结合理论驱动的能力框架与真实数据驱动的评估可以显著提升LLM陪伴智能体评估的严谨性和可复现性，并揭示了现有智能体在关系能力上的系统性不足。

title: A New Theory of Value for Post-AGI Economics
summary: Artificial general intelligence (AGI) may weaken scarcities in labour, expertise, information, and productive capability that underpin established theories of economic value. If cognitive work becomes widely automatable, market price, labour input, revealed preference, profit, and gross output may diverge sharply from human and societal benefit. This paper develops Flourishing Value Theory (FVT) as a foundation for post-AGI economics. FVT defines value as the counterfactual, distribution-sensitive contribution of a system, institution, asset, or intervention to the durable capabilities of persons and communities to flourish within social and planetary constraints. It treats societal value as multidimensional, agency-preserving, regenerative, and non-compensatory at critical thresholds. Drawing on the economics of AI, welfare and capability theory, automation, digital valuation, and ecological economics, the paper distinguishes value creation from value capture and retains price, profit, productivity, and GDP as partial signals rather than final measures of progress. It develops the shifts from scarcity to governed abundance, transaction to transformation, and zero-sum rivalry to positive-sum and infinite-game dynamics, with collective expansion of consciousness as an agency-preserving form of regenerative value. Building on Flourishing Metrics and Return on Flourishing (RoF), it proposes a layered architecture for firms, governments, work transitions, AI governance, and national accounting. The central post-AGI economic problem is not how to maximise output, but how to convert abundant intelligence into durable, fairly distributed human, societal, and planetary flourishing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出繁荣价值理论（FVT），作为后AGI时代的经济学基础，将价值定义为对个人和社区在自然与社会约束下实现繁荣的能力的反事实、分布敏感贡献，旨在解决AGI导致传统经济价值衡量标准失效的问题。
AI.motivation: AGI可能削弱劳动、专业知识、信息和生产能力方面的稀缺性，而这些稀缺性支撑着现有的经济价值理论。当认知工作被广泛自动化后，市场价格、劳动投入、显示性偏好、利润和总产出可能与人类和社会福祉严重脱节，亟需新的价值理论框架。
AI.method: 综合借鉴AI经济学、福利与能力理论、自动化研究、数字估值和生态经济学，FVT将价值定义为多维度的、保持能动性的、可再生的、在关键阈值上不可补偿的概念；区分价值创造与价值捕获，将价格、利润、生产率和GDP视为部分信号而非最终衡量标准；提出了从稀缺到治理型丰裕、从交易到转化、从零和对抗到正和与无限博弈的范式转变；基于繁荣指标和繁荣回报率构建分层架构。
AI.result: 构建了FVT的理论框架，涵盖企业、政府、工作转型、AI治理和国民核算的分层架构，阐明了后AGI时代核心经济问题从"如何最大化产出"转变为"如何将丰裕的智能转化为持久、公平分配的人类、社会和地球繁荣"。
AI.conclusion: 后AGI经济学的中心问题不在于如何最大化产出，而在于如何将丰富的智能转化为持久且公平分配的人类、社会与地球繁荣，FVT为此提供了理论基础和可操作的架构。

title: TextNCA: Neural Cellular Automata for Language Modeling via Hierarchical Local Attention
summary: Can a strictly local, iterated, weight-shared computation primitive support language modelling, and which of those three properties actually drives the model's behaviour? We define \textsc{TextNCA}, a 1D causal windowed-attention realisation of the Neural Cellular Automaton primitive, and study a hierarchical variant that cascades three stages with windows $w \in \{8, 32, 128\}$ and $T_s$ shared-weight iterations per stage, all on WikiText-103 at roughly 30M parameters and 60k training steps. The model does not match a parameter-matched Transformer at this scale (Hier-TextNCA $60.3$ vs.\ Transformer-6L $52.8$ and Transformer-12L $44.7$ PPL), so we treat it as an analytical probe rather than a proposed alternative. The behaviour we observe is largely explained by the staged narrow-to-wide schedule: a non-iterating sliding-window Transformer that reuses the same schedule comes within $+4.1$ PPL of the iterated model, while reversing, flattening, or breaking the monotonic ordering of the schedule costs between $+16.7$ and $+70.8$ PPL. Iteration adds a smaller bounded benefit on top of the schedule, with a clear optimum at $T_s{=}4$ and a U-shaped degradation beyond it. The GRU gate and learned per-step embeddings are required for that benefit to appear, and training with random $T_s$ yields an inference-time iteration-count knob at the cost of substantially higher absolute PPL. We position the work as a controlled reading of which parts of NCA-style computation carry the weight in language modelling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TextNCA，一种基于神经细胞自动机（NCA）原语的1D因果窗口注意力模型，用于语言建模。研究发现，该模型的核心行为主要由"窄到宽"的分阶段窗口调度驱动，而非迭代或权重共享；迭代带来的额外收益较小且存在最优迭代次数（T_s=4）。模型性能不及同等规模的Transformer，因此被定位为分析探针而非替代方案。
AI.motivation: 探索严格局部、迭代、权重共享的计算原语是否能够支持语言建模，并厘清这三个属性（局部性、迭代性、权重共享）中哪一个真正驱动模型行为。
AI.method: 定义TextNCA（1D因果窗口注意力版本的神经细胞自动机），构建三阶段级联的层次变体，窗口大小分别为8、32、128，每阶段使用T_s次共享权重迭代。在WikiText-103上以约30M参数和60k训练步进行实验，并与参数匹配的Transformer基线对比。同时设计消融实验：使用非迭代滑动窗口Transformer复用相同调度、反转/展平/打破调度单调性、改变迭代次数、移除GRU门和逐步嵌入、随机T_s训练等。
