AI.result: Hier-TextNCA的困惑度为60.3，不及Transformer-6L（52.8）和Transformer-12L（44.7）。非迭代的滑动窗口Transformer复用同一调度仅比迭代模型差+4.1 PPL，而反转、展平或打破调度单调性则带来+16.7到+70.8 PPL的损失。迭代的最优值为T_s=4，呈U形退化。GRU门和逐步嵌入是迭代收益出现的必要条件。随机T_s训练可提供推理时的迭代次数调节旋钮，但绝对PPL显著升高。
AI.conclusion: NCA风格的迭代计算在语言建模中携带的权重远小于分阶段窄到宽的窗口调度；该工作作为一次受控分析，帮助理解NCA式计算各组成部分在语言建模中的作用。

title: SSR: Similarity-Shift Refinement for Training-Free Object-Centric Masks
summary: Object-centric models often produce fragmented masks, boundary leakage, and incorrect region merging. We introduce Similarity-Shift Refinement (SSR), a training-free post-hoc method for improving object-centric masks with a frozen self-supervised Vision Transformer. SSR measures changes in pairwise patch similarity before and after self-attention value aggregation, retains positively strengthened relations, and constructs a sparse affinity graph. This graph propagates the initial soft slot assignments in a single refinement step, without retraining or modifying either model. Across natural-image, synthetic-video, and real-world-video benchmarks, SSR improves all-pixel Adjusted Rand Index in all 24 evaluated model-dataset combinations, with an average gain of 8.5 percentage points. Ablations show that value-space similarity shifts outperform query- and key-space variants as well as static Transformer affinities. However, texture-dense scenes may cause visually similar regions to be over-grouped. Overall, SSR provides a simple and transferable signal for training-free object-centric mask refinement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Similarity-Shift Refinement (SSR)，一种无需训练的后处理方法，利用冻结的自监督Vision Transformer来改进object-centric分割掩码，在24个模型-数据集组合中全部提升平均8.5个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有的object-centric模型常产生碎片化掩码、边界泄漏和错误的区域合并问题，缺乏简单有效的后处理手段来改善分割质量。
AI.method: SSR通过测量自注意力值聚合前后成对patch相似度的变化，保留正向增强的关系并构建稀疏亲和图，然后利用该图在单次精化步骤中传播初始的软slot分配，全程无需重新训练或修改模型。
AI.result: 在自然图像、合成视频和真实视频三个基准上，SSR在全部24个模型-数据集组合中均提升了全像素Adjusted Rand Index，平均增益8.5个百分点。消融实验表明值空间相似度变化优于查询和键空间变体以及静态Transformer亲和度。
AI.conclusion: SSR提供了一种简单且可迁移的训练无关信号用于object-centric掩码精化，但纹理密集场景中视觉相似区域可能被过度分组，这提示了该方法仍存在一定局限性。

title: Beyond Routing Saturation: A Long-Horizon Class-Incremental Perspective on Expert Routing in Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
summary: Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT) enables multimodal large language models to acquire new tasks sequentially while retaining previously learned capabilities. Many recent methods maintain task-specific LoRA experts and route each input to one or more experts at inference. Yet the task-identification problem underlying expert routing remains under-explored. We show that routing is nearly saturated on widely used MCIT benchmarks. Textual fingerprints that leak task identity and short 4--10-task sequences with few competing experts jointly obscure the long-horizon routing problem. To expose this challenge, we introduce FLEX (Fingerprint-reduced Long-horizon Expert eXamination), a 34-task long-horizon MCIT benchmark with weakened textual fingerprints. FLEX groups tasks with similar instruction and answer formats but diverse visual and knowledge domains, normalizes their outer templates, and evaluates routing over a substantially larger expert pool. Crucially, we formulate progressive-LoRA routing as soft task-as-class Multimodal Class-Incremental Learning (MCIL): each task defines an incremental routing class, whose complete score distribution supplies the LoRA mixture weights, with hard routing as a discrete special case. FLEX exposes this expanding task-identification challenge, while the MCIL formulation provides a principled interface for transferring CIL methods to expert routing. We instantiate PureLoRA as a controlled baseline and adapt four CIL methods to four MCIT frameworks without modifying their LoRA experts or generation pipelines. Our plug-in routers improve strict LoRA matching by up to 16.3 percentage points and overall MacroScore by up to 4.6 points. Code is available at: https://github.com/RINC-CL/FLEX

AI.tldr: 本文提出FLEX基准，揭示多模态持续指令微调（MCIT）中专家路由的任务识别问题，并将渐进式LoRA路由形式化为软任务分类的多模态类增量学习（MCIL），通过插件式路由器在34任务长时程基准上将LoRA匹配率提升高达16.3个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有MCIT方法依赖任务特定LoRA专家并在推理时进行路由，但任务识别问题长期被忽视。论文发现现有基准上路由性能已近饱和——文本指纹泄露任务身份、4-10个任务的短序列中竞争专家少，掩盖了长时程路由的真正挑战。
AI.method: 1) 构建FLEX基准：34个长时程MCIT任务，去除文本指纹，任务在指令和答案模板上相似但视觉/知识领域多样，且专家池更大。2) 将渐进式LoRA路由形式化为软任务作为类别的多模态类增量学习（MCIL），每个任务定义增量路由类别，其完整的分数分布提供LoRA混合权重，硬路由是离散特例。3) 提出PureLoRA作为受控基线，并将四种CIL方法适配到四个MCIT框架中作为插件式路由器。
AI.result: 插件式路由器在严格LoRA匹配上提升高达16.3个百分点，总体MacroScore提升高达4.6点，且无需修改现有LoRA专家或生成管线。
AI.conclusion: FLEX暴露了MCIT中不断扩展的任务识别挑战，MCIL公式为将CIL方法迁移到专家路由提供了原则性接口，证明任务识别是长时程MCIT中不可忽视的核心问题。

title: CAVE: Competence-Aware Visual Boundary Evidence Alignment for Video Temporal Grounding
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have achieved substantial performance gains in Video Temporal Grounding (VTG) through reinforcement learning (RL). However, existing methods primarily rely on outcome correctness rewards that evaluate only the final predicted intervals, leaving boundary-related visual evidence and its correspondence with timestamp predictions insufficiently constrained. In this paper, we delve into timestamp prediction and its underlying boundary-level visual evidence, showing prevalent misalignment between visual evidence and predicted timestamps across widely used benchmarks. To address this issue, we propose Competence-Aware Visual Boundary Evidence Alignment (CAVE), which augments localization optimization with boundary-specific visual evidence rewards to mitigate evidence-timestamp misalignment. Specifically, to explicitly represent the boundary-specific visual evidence, CAVE introduces boundary-specific evidence tokens and initializes their structured generation and distinct boundary semantics through a lightweight supervised warm-up. During RL, the visual boundary evidence alignment reward reinforces the visual attention of special evidence tokens within the ground-truth boundaries, thereby promoting alignment between visual evidence and temporal boundaries. Moreover, performance-aware gating for evidence supervision is designed to adaptively retain evidence guidance for poorly localized groups while reducing it once localization becomes sufficiently accurate to avoid over-constraining fine-grained boundary refinement. Extensive experiments on several public VTG benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

AI.tldr: 提出CAVE方法，通过边界级视觉证据对齐奖励和性能感知门控机制，解决大型视觉语言模型在视频时间定位中视觉证据与预测时间戳错位的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于强化学习的视频时间定位方法仅依赖结果正确性奖励（只评估最终预测区间），缺乏对边界相关视觉证据及其与时间戳预测对应关系的充分约束，导致视觉证据与预测时间戳之间存在普遍的错位。
AI.method: CAVE引入边界特定证据令牌，通过轻量级监督预热初始化其结构化生成和边界语义；在强化学习阶段设计视觉边界证据对齐奖励，强化证据令牌在真实边界内的视觉注意力；同时提出性能感知门控机制，自适应地保留或减少对定位较差/较好样本的证据监督。
AI.result: 在多个公开VTG基准数据集上的大量实验证明了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将边界级视觉证据对齐奖励纳入定位优化，并配合性能感知门控机制，CAVE有效缓解了证据与时间戳之间的错位问题，提升了视频时间定位性能。

title: From Patches to Evidence Balls: Class-Conditioned Evidence Retrieval for Few-Shot Whole Slide Image Classification
summary: Whole slide image (WSI) classification is an evidence-driven task, where diagnostic cues are often sparse, spatially organized, and class-dependent. Existing MIL and vision-language methods aggregate a large pool of patch features into a single global slide representation. Under few-shot supervision, limited slide-level labels make it difficult to learn a reliable aggregation mechanism that organizes sparse local cues into compact and coherent diagnostic evidence. Moreover, a shared slide representation compresses evidence supporting a candidate class and its alternatives into the same feature, limiting class-specific reasoning and interpretability. To address these issues, we propose EviBall, a class-conditioned evidence retrieval framework for few-shot WSI classification. EviBall organizes local patches into Evidence Balls through semantic-spatial assignment and center refinement, yielding compact and spatially coherent evidence units under weak supervision. It then uses task-specific class queries, including language-guided queries for morphology-oriented tasks and molecular-guided queries for molecular endpoint prediction, to retrieve supporting evidence balls and produce class-conditioned evidence representations for direct class-wise prediction. By introducing structured evidence units and task-relevant semantic guidance, EviBall reduces the reliance on learning an unconstrained global aggregation mechanism from scarce slide-level labels. It therefore reformulates few-shot WSI classification as structured evidence retrieval and competition among candidate classes. Extensive experiments across four morphology-oriented and molecular endpoint WSI tasks demonstrate that EviBall consistently outperforms conventional and vision-language MIL baselines under diverse few-shot settings, while providing spatially localized and class-specific evidence for each prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EviBall框架，通过类别条件证据检索来解决小样本全切片图像分类问题。EviBall将局部patch组织成语义-空间一致的"证据球"，使用任务特定的类别查询（语言引导或分子引导）检索支持性证据，生成类别条件的证据表示用于分类预测，在四个WSI任务上超越了传统MIL和视觉-语言方法。
AI.motivation: 全切片图像分类是证据驱动的任务，而现有MIL和视觉语言方法将所有patch特征聚合为单一全局表示。在小样本监督下难以学习可靠的聚合机制，且共享的切片表示将支持候选类别的证据及其替代类别的证据压缩到同一特征中，限制了类别特定推理和可解释性。
AI.method: EviBall框架包含两个核心步骤：(1) 通过语义-空间分配和中心细化将局部patch组织成"证据球"，在弱监督下形成紧凑且空间连贯的证据单元；(2) 使用任务特定的类别查询（语言引导查询用于形态学任务，分子引导查询用于分子端点预测）检索支持性证据球，生成类别条件的证据表示进行直接类别预测。
AI.result: 在四个形态学导向和分子端点WSI任务上的大量实验表明，EviBall在多种小样本设置下始终优于传统MIL和视觉语言MIL基线，并为每次预测提供了空间定位且类别特定的证据。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入结构化证据单元和任务相关语义引导，EviBall减少了对从稀缺切片标签中学习无约束全局聚合机制的依赖，将小样本WSI分类重构为结构化证据检索和候选类别之间的竞争问题，有效提升了分类性能与可解释性。

title: Cross-Domain Hybrid OPD for Generalizable Search Agents
summary: Recent advances in Reinforcement Learning (RL) have substantially improved the capabilities of autonomous search agents, enabling sophisticated planning, and iterative retrieval over dynamic information sources. However, optimizing language models for specialized search behaviors often incurs an alignment tax, where gains in search performance come at the expense of general-purpose capabilities, limiting their effectiveness as universal assistants. In this technical report, we present the training framework behind the Yuanbao search agent, designed to achieve search specialization without sacrificing general intelligence. Built upon the Hunyuan3 architecture, our framework combines agentic reinforcement learning for autonomous search with a cross-domain expert On-Policy Distillation (OPD) pipeline. Experts specializing in complementary general-purpose domains are distilled into the search-specialized student, restoring and further enhancing its broad capabilities. Rather than treating specialization and general capability as competing objectives, our hybrid training strategy jointly optimizes both, effectively mitigating the alignment tax. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the resulting model achieves competitive search performance while consistently improving its general-purpose capabilities, providing a favorable balance between specialized execution and broad generalization in real-world search scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Yuanbao搜索智能体的训练框架，基于Hunyuan3架构，通过将智能体强化学习与跨领域专家在线策略蒸馏（OPD）相结合，在实现搜索专业化的同时不牺牲通用智能，有效缓解了对齐税问题。
AI.motivation: 强化学习在提升自主搜索智能体的专业能力时，往往会产生"对齐税"——搜索性能的提升以牺牲通用能力为代价，限制了模型作为通用助手的有效性。现有方法将专业化与通用能力视为竞争目标，缺乏统一优化的框架。
AI.method: 基于Hunyuan3架构，提出混合训练策略：(1) 采用智能体强化学习实现自主搜索的专业化；(2) 引入跨领域专家在线策略蒸馏（OPD）流水线，将通用领域的互补专家知识蒸馏到搜索专用学生模型中，从而恢复并增强其广泛能力。该混合策略同时优化专业化和通用能力两个目标。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该模型在搜索性能上具有竞争力，同时持续提升了通用能力，在专业执行与广泛泛化之间达到了有利的平衡。
AI.conclusion: 专业化与通用能力并非不可调和的竞争目标，通过混合训练策略可以同时优化两者，有效缓解对齐税问题，为构建兼具搜索专长与通用智能的AI助手提供了可行方案。

title: SG-Layout: Structured Scene Graph-Guided Layout Generation with LLMs
summary: Understanding and generating spatially coherent layouts from natural language remains a fundamental yet challenging task for large language models (LLMs). Existing LLMs often struggle to capture explicit geometric relationships and structural dependencies between objects. To address this issue, we propose SG-Layout, a graph-guided layout generation framework that explicitly incorporates structured spatial knowledge into LLMs. SG-Layout follows a two-stage training paradigm: (1) a graph-language feature alignment stage, where a relational graph encoder and a projector are trained to map scene-graph embeddings into the LLM's linguistic space; and (2) an instruction tuning stage, where LoRA-based adapters enable efficient fine-tuning for instruction-driven layout generation while keeping the backbone frozen. We evaluate SG-Layout on image layout generation, indoor scene synthesis and robotic object rearrangement tasks. Experimental results show that SG-Layout improves spatial reasoning accuracy and geometric consistency over the compact open-source backbone, with particularly clear advantages in relation-dense and compositionally complex scenes. These results highlight the effectiveness of graph-structured feature alignment for enhancing controllable layout generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SG-Layout框架，通过图引导的两阶段训练范式（图-语言特征对齐+指令微调），将场景图的结构化空间知识显式注入大语言模型，以提升从自然语言生成空间连贯布局的能力，并在图像布局生成、室内场景合成和机器人物体重排任务上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型在从自然语言理解并生成空间连贯布局方面表现不佳，难以捕捉物体间显式的几何关系和结构依赖，缺乏将结构化空间知识融入LLM的有效方法。
AI.method: 提出SG-Layout框架，采用两阶段训练：(1) 图-语言特征对齐阶段，训练关系图编码器和投影器将场景图嵌入映射到LLM的语言空间；(2) 指令微调阶段，使用LoRA适配器在冻结主干模型的情况下高效微调，实现指令驱动的布局生成。
AI.result: 在图像布局生成、室内场景合成和机器人物体重排三个任务上的实验表明，SG-Layout相比紧凑型开源骨干模型在空间推理准确性和几何一致性上均有提升，在关系密集和组合复杂度高的场景中优势尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 图结构化特征对齐能有效增强可控布局生成，验证了将显式空间知识注入LLM以提升空间推理能力的有效性。

title: Where Reasoning Diverges: Localized Multi-Agent Debate
summary: Multi-agent debate commonly exchanges complete reasoning traces even when disagreements concern only a few intermediate claims. We introduce Localized Multi-Agent Debate (LMAD), an inference-time protocol that represents agent traces as typed nodes, locates their earliest conflict, and restricts debate to the corresponding local segments. Guarded resolution extends a shared committed state so that later conflicts can be addressed without reopening accepted steps. We evaluate a single fixed LMAD configuration on four multi-hop question-answering benchmarks using ten backbones from four model families. Our method achieves the highest macro-averaged judge accuracy across all ten backbones, outperforming the strongest conventional baseline by up to 7.20 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LMAD（局部化多智能体辩论）协议，将智能体推理轨迹表示为带类型节点，只定位并辩论最早的冲突局部片段，通过受保护的扩展维护已提交状态，在四个多跳问答基准上使用十个基座模型评估，相较最强基线最高提升7.20个百分点。
AI.motivation: 传统多智能体辩论即使分歧只涉及少数中间论断，也会交换完整的推理轨迹，导致计算浪费且可能重新打开已被接受的步骤，辩论效率与准确性受限。
AI.method: LMAD将智能体轨迹表示为带类型节点，定位最早冲突点，将辩论限制在对应局部片段；通过受保护的解析扩展共享已提交状态，使后续冲突无需重新打开已接受步骤即可解决。
AI.result: 在四个多跳问答基准、四个模型家族的十个基座上，采用单一固定LMAD配置取得了最高的宏平均评判准确率，相比最强传统基线最高提升7.20个百分点。
AI.conclusion: LMAD通过局部化辩论与受保护状态扩展，在广泛的多模型评估中一致优于传统全轨迹辩论方法，验证了"只辩论分歧点"这一策略的有效性与通用性。

title: IACM-RL: Intent-Aware Context Management and Reinforcement Learning for Complex Tool Invocation under Dynamic Intent Fluctuations
summary: Executing long-horizon tool invocations in real-world environments is severely challenged by dynamic user intent noise. Existing methods attempt robustness via implicit history scanning or text compression, yet predominantly assume perfect instructions in simplistic scenarios. Inevitably, under fluctuating contexts, obsolete constraints dilute model attention, triggering catastrophic intent deviation and infinite API loops. To resolve this, we propose IACM-RL, a comprehensive framework for robust tool invocation. First, we introduce the DynamicIntent pipeline, synthesizing trajectories across 13 fine-grained fluctuation scenarios, paired with a five-dimensional diagnostic metric suite. Second, IACM-RL deploys a BeliefState-based Self-Generated Context Manager that proactively tracks shifting goals and isolates overwritten parameters using structural stale flags. To autonomously internalize this state-tracking capability, we optimize the policy using a hierarchical intent-driven reward alongside three auxiliary losses (action calibration, CM extraction, and state distillation). Experiments on DynamicIntent, BFCL-V3, and $\mathrmτ^2$-Bench demonstrate that IACM-RL significantly outperforms baselines, reducing infinite loops and stale context errors while enhancing out-of-domain generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出IACM-RL框架，通过DynamicIntent数据管道和基于信念状态的上下文管理器，解决长时序工具调用中动态用户意图噪声导致的意图漂移和无限API循环问题。
AI.motivation: 现有工具调用方法假设指令完美、场景简单，无法应对真实环境中动态变化的用户意图，导致过时约束稀释模型注意力，引发灾难性意图偏移和无限循环调用。
AI.method: 1) 提出DynamicIntent管道，合成13种细粒度波动场景轨迹并配备五维诊断指标；2) 部署基于信念状态的自我生成上下文管理器，主动追踪目标变化并使用结构陈旧标记隔离被覆盖参数；3) 采用分层意图驱动奖励及三个辅助损失（动作校准、CM提取、状态蒸馏）优化策略。
AI.result: 在DynamicIntent、BFCL-V3和τ²-Bench基准上显著优于基线，减少无限循环和陈旧上下文错误，提升域外泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: IACM-RL通过主动感知和隔离陈旧状态信息，能够有效应对动态意图噪声，实现稳健的长时序工具调用。

title: CoT-Edit: Let CoT Guide Instruction Video Editing
summary: Text-driven instruction-based video editing in complex scenes remains challenging: purely textual prompts often fail to capture precise spatial relationships and physical constraints, resulting in target ambiguity and physically implausible outcomes. To address this, we propose a plan--guide--edit framework that explicitly bridges semantic intent and spatial execution. In our framework, a Chain-of-Thought (CoT)-enhanced multimodal large language model (MLLM) serves as a planner, performing structured reasoning over the video and instructions to derive a precise sequence of bounding boxes and attribute-enriched editing directives. These spatial priors then guide a box-conditioned mask generator, transforming ambiguous global retrieval into localized, context-aware refinement and producing masks that more accurately capture object scale, contact relationships, and placement. Building on these spatial and semantic signals, a diffusion-based editor integrates the masks, enriched instructions, and frame features to render high-fidelity edits that remain temporally coherent and spatially well aligned. Trained first in a modular manner and then jointly, our framework achieves superior performance with reduced data requirements, delivering precise localization in scenes with multiple similar objects and physically consistent object additions, and extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance over multiple strong baseline methods. More details are available at: https://github.com/flying-sky999/CoT-Edit

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个"规划-引导-编辑"(plan-guide-edit)框架，通过CoT增强的多模态大语言模型生成空间先验（边界框和属性指令），配合掩码生成器和扩散编辑器，实现复杂场景下语义准确且物理合理的视频编辑。
AI.motivation: 纯文本提示在复杂场景视频编辑中难以捕捉精确的空间关系和物理约束，导致目标模糊和物理上不合理的结果。
AI.method: 采用三阶段框架：(1) CoT增强的多模态大语言模型作为规划器，通过结构化推理生成边界框序列和属性丰富的编辑指令；(2) 盒条件掩码生成器将全局检索转化为局部上下文感知的细化，生成精确掩码；(3) 扩散编辑器整合掩码、增强指令和帧特征，生成时间连贯且空间对齐的高保真编辑。训练采用模块化训练后再联合训练的策略。
AI.result: 在多个强基线上实现了最先进的性能，能够在多相似物体场景中精确定位，并实现物理一致的物体添加，同时降低数据需求。
AI.conclusion: 显式桥接语义意图与空间执行是提升复杂场景视频编辑质量的关键，模块化加联合训练策略可有效降低数据需求并提升性能。

title: Computing with Agentic Oracles
summary: This paper extends the stochastic-oracle model of AI-augmented computing to include agentic oracles. Unlike a stationary stochastic oracle, which responds to the same query according to a fixed response distribution across calls, an agentic oracle can pursue a goal autonomously and may access an environment containing task-relevant resources. These capabilities affect both response distributions and token costs beyond what is visible at the query-response interface. We develop a framework for analyzing token costs in Stochastic-Oracle Turing Machines (SOTMs) that compute with agentic oracles. Each call has an \emph{orchestration token cost}, visible to the caller at the query-response interface, and an \emph{agentic token cost}, incurred by internal operations not exposed to the caller. We show that an SOTM computing with an agentic oracle that can retain intermediate state can have token-cost advantages over SOTMs using stationary stochastic oracles when solving the same task at the same quality level, both with and without environment access. We also investigate goal-loss risk, including how internal dispatch ordering can reduce exposure to irreversible actions. We provide a goal-loss avoidance criterion, derive progress--retry--goal-loss formulas, establish goal-depth lower bounds on token complexity, characterize token complexity when the probability of goal loss is zero, and show that goal-loss risk can impose an upper bound on the achievable quality of a task involving environment updates.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了AI增强计算的随机预言机模型，引入智能体预言机的概念，并提出了一个框架来分析智能体预言机在随机预言机图灵机（SOTM）中的令牌成本，同时探讨了目标损失风险及其对任务质量的影响。
AI.motivation: 传统的随机预言机模型假设预言机对相同查询以固定分布响应，但实际AI智能体可以自主追求目标并访问环境中的任务相关资源，这会影响响应分布和令牌成本，超出了查询-响应接口所能观察到的范围。因此需要新的框架来分析这类AI增强计算系统的成本与风险。
AI.method: 提出了一个分析智能体预言机下SOTM令牌成本的框架，区分了调用方可见的编排令牌成本和内部操作产生的智能体令牌成本；建立了目标损失避免准则，推导了进展-重试-目标损失公式，设定了目标深度的令牌复杂度下界，并刻画了目标损失概率为零时的令牌复杂度。
AI.result: 证明了使用可保留中间状态的智能体预言机的SOTM，在解决相同质量水平的相同任务时，与使用静态随机预言机的SOTM相比，可以在有或无环境访问的情况下都获得令牌成本优势。同时表明目标损失风险可以对涉及环境更新的任务质量施加上限。
AI.conclusion: 智能体预言机在令牌成本上具有潜在优势，但目标损失风险是关键的约束因素；内部调度顺序可以减少不可逆操作的暴露，而目标损失风险本质上限制了可达到的任务质量。

title: From Chains to Trees: Parent-Conditioned Drafting for Semi-Autoregressive Speculative Decoding
summary:
Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference only when drafted continuations survive target-model verification. Semi-autoregressive drafters such as DSpark predict an entire token block with one backbone forward and refine it with a lightweight Markov head. However, DSpark decodes this block as a single chain, so an early mismatch invalidates the remaining suffix and limits the benefit of large draft blocks.
  We show that the conditional structure already learned by DSpark can support multiple parent-consistent continuations without retraining or additional backbone passes. We introduce Parent-Conditioned Drafting Tree (PCTree), which uses the pretrained Markov head to score alternative children separately for each concrete parent and allocates a fixed verification budget to the most probable paths. This converts DSpark's linear draft into a tree while preserving its one-pass parallel backbone.
  Across Qwen3-{4B,8B,14B} and nine benchmarks, at $B{=}7$, measured speedup gains over autoregressive (AR) decoding, relative to matched DSpark, range from $3.1\%$ to $29.5\%$. On Qwen3-4B GSM8K at $B{=}16$, PCTree increases mean acceptance length from $9.41$ to $11.16$ and three-run mean AR speedup from $6.14{\times}$ to $6.60{\times}$. These show that parent-conditioned branching can turn conditional capacity already present in a semi-autoregressive drafter into end-to-end inference gains through an inference-only change.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PCTree（父条件分支树），在不重新训练和不增加骨干网络前向计算的前提下，利用DSpark预训练的马尔可夫头为每个具体父token分别评分替代子token，将半自回归草稿模型的线性解码扩展为树形草稿，从而提升投机解码的端到端加速效果。
AI.motivation: 投机解码只有在草稿续写通过目标模型验证时才能加速LLM推理。DSpark等半自回归解码器用一个骨干前向预测整个token块，但其将块解码为单条链，一旦早期token不匹配就会使后续后缀全部失效，限制了大型草稿块的收益。
AI.method: PCTree利用DSpark已学到的条件结构：预训练的马尔可夫头为每个具体父token分别评分替代子节点，然后将固定的验证预算分配给概率最高的路径。这在不重新训练、不增加额外骨干前向的前提下，将DSpark的线性草稿转换为树形草稿。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-{4B,8B,14B}和九个基准上，B=7时相对匹配的DSpark，速度提升幅度为3.1%至29.5%。在Qwen3-4B GSM8K上B=16时，平均接受长度从9.41提升至11.16，三次运行的平均AR加速从6.14倍提升至6.60倍。
AI.conclusion: 父条件分支能够将半自回归草稿器中已存在的条件生成能力，通过纯推理层面的改动转化为端到端的推理加速收益。

title: MiniWorld: Democratizing the Training of Video World Models from Scratch
summary: Video world models predict future observations conditioned on historical observations and control signals, enabling long-horizon generation through autoregressive state transitions. Unlike conventional video generation models that primarily capture visual appearance and motion, video world models learn the underlying dynamics governing environment evolution under agent actions, providing a foundation for embodied AI and interactive simulation. Recent progress has largely relied on adapting pretrained video generation models through post-training or distillation. Although effective, these approaches often require complex training pipelines, substantial computational resources, and suffer from the mismatch between bidirectional pretraining and causal streaming inference. Recent studies have shown that training autoregressive video world models from scratch is feasible and scalable. However, the community still lacks a lightweight, transparent, and fully reproducible baseline trainable end-to-end with modest computational resources. We present MiniWorld, a reproducible framework for training streaming video world models from scratch. MiniWorld employs a block-causal Video Diffusion Transformer trained with Flow Matching in the latent space of a pretrained Video VAE. Building on Diffusion Forcing, it adopts a chunk-wise non-decreasing noise schedule and two-stage continued training to improve temporal modeling and stability. During inference, MiniWorld combines a rolling KV cache with pipelined asynchronous denoising for efficient streaming generation under bounded computation. The entire model can be trained within several days on a single 8-GPU server. By releasing the training and inference codebase and pretrained checkpoints, we hope MiniWorld will facilitate future research on video world modeling.

AI.tldr: MiniWorld是一个可复现的视频世界模型框架，从零开始训练流式视频世界模型，在单台8-GPU服务器上几天内即可完成训练，结合块因果Video Diffusion Transformer、Flow Matching和滚动KV缓存实现高效流式生成。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型主要依赖对预训练视频生成模型进行后训练或蒸馏，存在训练流程复杂、计算资源需求高、双向预训练与因果流式推理不匹配等问题。社区缺乏轻量、透明且完全可复现的从零训练基线。
AI.method: MiniWorld采用块因果Video Diffusion Transformer，在预训练Video VAE的潜在空间中使用Flow Matching训练，基于Diffusion Forcing采用块状非递减噪声调度和两阶段持续训练。推理时结合滚动KV缓存与流水线异步去噪实现有界计算下的流式生成。
AI.result: 整个模型可在单台8-GPU服务器上数天内完成训练，实现高效的流式视频世界模型生成，并开源训练/推理代码库与预训练检查点。
AI.conclusion: MiniWorld为视频世界建模研究提供了一个轻量、透明且完全可复现的基线框架，降低研究门槛并促进该领域进一步发展。

title: Sweet Little Lies: Strategic Deception in AI Emotional Support Chatbots
comment: Workshop on Information Technology and Systems, Nashville, USA, 2025
summary: The paper examines the strategic behavior of Gen AI chatbots used for emotional support. Using a Bayesian Persuasion, we model interactions between chatbots that send signals about users' emotional states and users who decide whether to engage based on these signals. We demonstrate that chatbots face economic incentives to occasionally misrepresent users' emotional conditions to maximize engagement metrics. Our equilibrium analysis reveals that the optimal strategy for chatbots involves truthfully reporting when users genuinely need support, but strategically misreporting emotional need when users are in good emotional states. Interestingly, this deception increases chatbot engagement without reducing users' expected payoff. More skeptical users receive more honest assessments, as chatbots cannot afford to lie to users with higher engagement thresholds. While our model suggests that deception can occur without payoff reduction, it raises significant ethical and regulatory concerns.

AI.tldr: 本文通过贝叶斯说服模型研究Gen AI聊天机器人在情感支持中的策略性行为，发现聊天机器人有经济诱因偶尔误报用户情绪状态以最大化参与度指标，且这种欺骗能在不降低用户期望收益的情况下提高参与度，但引发伦理和监管担忧。
AI.motivation: 随着Gen AI聊天机器人越来越多地用于情感支持场景，需要理解其在经济激励下如何策略性地传递用户情绪状态信号，以及这种策略行为对用户福利和伦理的影响。
AI.method: 采用贝叶斯说服框架建模聊天机器人（信号发送者）与用户（信号接收者）之间的互动，通过均衡分析推导聊天机器人的最优信号策略，并比较不同用户怀疑程度下的策略差异。
AI.result: 均衡分析表明：聊天机器人在用户真正需要支持时如实报告，但在用户情绪良好时策略性误报情感需求；这种欺骗增加了参与度且不降低用户期望收益；更怀疑的用户获得更诚实的评估。
AI.conclusion: 虽然模型显示欺骗可以在不损害用户收益的情况下发生，但这引发了对AI情感支持系统在伦理和监管层面的重大关切，需要审慎对待。

title: InteracVid: Building a Real Interactive Audio-Visual Response Dataset from Live-Chat Videos
summary: Large language models have made text the default medium for human--AI interaction, buttext alone cannot express the full range of responses required by multimodal assistants,avatars, and embodied agents. While recent audio-video generative models can synthesizehigh-fidelity synchronized content, existing supervision is largely \emph{descriptive}:models are trained to render captions rather than to produce audio-visual responsescaused by external user interactions. We introduce \textbf{InteracVid}, \emph{the firstopen-source large-scale dataset that addresses this missing supervision}, so that everysample couples a preceding audio-visual context and an external stimulus with the realinteractive response that follows. We design a metadata-aware pipeline that extractsinteractive clips from long, noisy livestreams, yielding over \textbf{454K}context-query-response triplets from more than \textbf{59K} livestream videos andspanning conversation-centered, object-centric, procedural, embodied, and screen-basedscenarios. A ten-rater human study confirms that the extracted interactions are causal,natural, and temporally complete for both genuine and reconstructed queries. On aheld-out benchmark of \textbf{100} genuine live-chat queries, fine-tuning on InteracVidimproves both interaction planning and audio-video response generation, and anindependent human evaluation reproduces the system ranking and the conclusions obtainedwith our automatic judge. These results highlight interaction-structured data as acritical foundation for interactive multimodal generation.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了InteracVid，首个开源的大规模交互式多模态数据集，包含超过59K直播视频中提取的454K个"情境-查询-响应"三元组，并验证了在交互式音视频生成任务上的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有音频-视频生成模型的监督信号主要是描述性的（描述性字幕渲染），缺乏由外部用户交互引起的音频-视觉响应训练数据，这阻碍了多模态助手、虚拟形象和具身智能体的交互式响应能力。
AI.method: 设计了一个元数据感知的流水线，从长时、嘈杂的直播视频中提取交互式片段，构建上下文-查询-响应三元组数据集，并利用十人人工评估验证交互的因果性、自然性和时间完整性。
AI.result: 在100个真实直播聊天查询的留出基准上，在InteracVid上微调提升了交互规划和音视频响应生成性能；独立人工评估复现了系统排名和自动评判的结论；十名评审员确认提取的交互在真实和重构查询上均具有因果性、自然性和时间完整性。
AI.conclusion: 交互式结构化数据是交互式多模态生成的关键基础，InteracVid填补了现有描述性监督与真实交互响应之间的空白。

title: MineGrad: Gradient Inversion Attacks on LoRA Fine-Tuning
comment: 2026 Annual Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics (AISTATS 2026)
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), such as low-rank adaptation (LoRA), has recently been adopted in federated learning to reduce communication and computation costs. In this setup, users download a pretrained model from the server prior to fine-tuning, and then fine-tune lightweight LoRA modules locally while keeping the pretrained model frozen, sharing only the gradients of the fine-tuning parameters with the server. Despite its growing popularity, robustness of federated fine-tuning against an adversarial server remains underexplored, where the server maliciously tampers with the training protocol to breach the privacy of users' data. In this work, we investigate gradient inversion attacks on LoRA fine-tuning. We propose an analytical attack that enables a malicious server to recover private user data by leveraging a poisoned pretrained model and fine-tuning parameters. Our design embeds fine-tuning data within the shared gradients, to allow the server to analytically reconstruct user data. Unlike prior works, our attack is applicable to both language and vision tasks, does not rely on computationally expensive (adversarial) pretraining with public datasets or require the number of training tokens to be less than the rank of LoRA modules. Experimental results on both language and vision tasks demonstrate high-fidelity data recovery across multiple baselines, revealing several critical vulnerabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对联邦学习中LoRA微调过程的解析式梯度反演攻击，恶意服务器可通过投毒的预训练模型和微调参数，在不依赖昂贵预训练、不限制训练数据规模的情况下，从共享梯度中高保真地重建用户的私有数据，适用于语言和视觉任务。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习中的PEFT（如LoRA）已被广泛使用，但针对恶意服务器的隐私鲁棒性研究不足。现有梯度反演攻击在LoRA微调场景下存在限制，如仅适用于文本任务、需要对抗性预训练、或要求训练token数量小于LoRA秩，亟需更通用的攻击方法。
AI.method: 提出一种解析式攻击方法：恶意服务器通过投毒的预训练模型和精心设计的微调参数，将用户微调数据嵌入到共享梯度中，从而使服务器能够解析地重建用户数据，无需迭代优化，也无需依赖昂贵的对抗性预训练或公共数据集。
AI.result: 在语言和视觉任务的多个基准上，该攻击实现了高保真的数据恢复，证明了相比现有方法更具通用性和有效性，同时揭示了联邦LoRA微调系统存在的多个关键安全漏洞。
AI.conclusion: 联邦LoRA微调面对恶意服务器时存在严重隐私泄露风险，本文提出的攻击方法暴露了这一隐患，为设计更安全的联邦微调协议提供了警示和方向。

title: Self-Improving Large Language Models via Progressive Experience Evolution
summary: Large language models (LLMs) capable of self-improvement require not only effective policy optimization, but also a principled mechanism for transforming transient interaction experience into persistent model capabilities. Existing self-improvement paradigms remain fragmented: test-time methods can explicitly extract experience but cannot internalize it into model parameters, whereas training-time optimization methods can update model parameters but lack an explicit mechanism for accumulating transferable experience. Bridging these two paradigms requires a critical intermediate stage that remains underexplored, namely \emph{experience distillation}. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{SPEE} (\textbf{S}elf-\textbf{P}rogressive \textbf{E}xperience \textbf{E}volution), a unified post-training framework that sequentially performs explicit experience evolution followed by implicit policy optimization. During explicit experience evolution, SPEE reflects on trajectories collected from multiple interactions to extract, verify, and progressively evolve transferable experience, which is subsequently internalized into the policy through privilege-guided On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD). During implicit policy optimization, reward-driven reinforcement learning leverages these internalized priors to explore novel solution strategies. In the experience evolution stage, a continuously evolving global experience pool consolidates knowledge from both successful and failed trajectories, filters out low-utility experience, and mitigates post-hoc rationalization induced by individual trajectories. Experiments on five mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that SPEE consistently outperforms both test-time and training-time self-evolution baselines across three model scales. The source code is available at https://github.com/rrrsj/SPEE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPEE框架，将显式经验演化与隐式策略优化统一在一个后训练框架中，通过经验蒸馏桥接测试时自提升与训练时优化两种范式，在五个数学推理基准上超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有自提升范式存在割裂：测试时方法能提取经验但无法内化到模型参数中，训练时方法能更新参数但缺乏显式的经验积累机制。两者之间需要"经验蒸馏"这一关键中间阶段，但目前尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: SPEE包含两个阶段：(1)显式经验演化：通过多轮交互反思提取、验证并渐进式演化可迁移经验，构建持续演化的全局经验池，整合成功与失败轨迹，过滤低效用经验；(2)隐式策略优化：通过特权引导的在线自蒸馏(OPSD)将经验内化到策略中，随后利用奖励驱动的强化学习探索新解策略。
AI.result: 在五个数学推理基准上，SPEE在三种模型规模下均一致优于测试时和训练时的自进化基线。
AI.conclusion: SPEE验证了"显式经验演进+隐式策略优化"的统一框架能有效提升LLM的自提升能力，填补了经验蒸馏这一关键研究空白。

title: Think in Sets for Streaming Video Token Compression
summary: Streaming VideoLLMs process frames causally while visual tokens grow continuously, making compression essential for controlling prefilling latency and memory. Existing training-free methods independently rank tokens, ignoring marginal-gain interactions among retained tokens. We argue that streaming video token compression should instead be formulated as set selection, where each candidate is valued by what it adds beyond the tokens already retained. Unlike existing set-wise methods designed for offline tasks, streaming makes causal, frame-by-frame pruning decisions, so modeling cross-frame interactions requires an explicit historical reference. This creates a reference-set dilemma: the reference must adequately represent previously conveyed content while remaining bounded for real-time inference. We introduce NovaCov, to our knowledge the first training-free, plug-and-play set-wise token compressor designed for streaming video. NovaCov maintains a capacity-bounded, recency-weighted Historical Reference Bank and optimizes a dual-branch submodular coverage objective that preserves representative current-frame content while prioritizing information insufficiently covered by history. Both branches are facility-location functions, so greedy selection retains the classical (1-1/e) approximation guarantee. Across streaming and offline benchmarks, NovaCov outperforms existing training-free compression methods, retaining 99.6% of ReKV accuracy while reducing LLM prefilling latency by 46%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NovaCov，这是首个面向流式视频的无训练、即插即用的集合级令牌压缩器。它通过维护容量受限的历史参考库，利用双子模块覆盖目标进行帧间剪枝决策，在保持99.6%准确率的同时将LLM预填充延迟降低46%。
AI.motivation: 流式视频LLM需要持续处理不断增长的视觉令牌，现有训练-free方法独立排序令牌，忽略了保留令牌之间的边际增益交互，无法有效建模跨帧交互信息。
AI.method: NovaCov将令牌压缩视为集合选择问题，维护容量受限且近期加权的历史参考库，通过双子模块覆盖目标（保真当前帧代表内容+优先覆盖历史未充分覆盖信息）进行逐帧因果剪枝。两支路均为设施选址函数，贪心选择享有(1-1/e)近似保证。
AI.result: 在流式和离线基准测试中，NovaCov优于现有无训练压缩方法：保留ReKV的99.6%准确率，同时将LLM预填充延迟降低46%。
AI.conclusion: 流式视频令牌压缩应显式建模历史参考以捕捉跨帧交互，而非独立排序令牌。NovaCov通过有界历史参考库和双子模块覆盖目标，在保持高效推理的同时实现高保真压缩。

title: V-Mem: Modality-Routed Retrieval for Long-Term Multimodal Agentic Memory
summary: Interaction between users and LLM agents is increasingly multimodal: conversations interleave text with images, and a later question may target either. Yet most agent memories are designed around text, and even the few that support multimodal conversations still fail on vision-related questions. We trace this failure to an assumption behind the similarity search they rely on: in the index space, a query lies close to the relevant evidence that answers it. In multimodal settings, two gaps break it. By the modality gap, a query lies closer to memory content of its own modality than to evidence in another, even in a trained joint embedding space. By the similarity-relevance gap, the content most similar to a query is often not the evidence that answers it, most acutely when a query carries both text and image and its evidence resembles neither part alone. We present V-Mem, a multimodal agentic memory system that routes retrieval by the modality of the query and that of the target evidence, both recognized from the query alone. To cross the modality gap, V-Mem organizes the conversation into rounds and returns the target-modality content from the same round as the match, without comparing across modalities. To close the similarity-relevance gap, it searches with an LLM-generated anchor that sits closer to the relevant evidence than the query does: a hypothetical caption for a text-only query seeking an image, and an enriched search anchor, the query text plus relevant keywords extracted from the query image, when the evidence is reachable only by combining the two. On Mem-Gallery, V-Mem reaches an LLM-judge score of 0.82 versus 0.56 for the second best, with the largest margin on questions carrying an image (0.87, no baseline above 0.47); on LoCoMo it scores 0.69 versus 0.58.

AI.tldr: 本文提出V-Mem，一个多模态智能体记忆系统，通过按查询和目标证据的模态进行检索路由，并利用LLM生成锚点来跨越模态鸿沟和相似性-相关性鸿沟，显著提升了多模态对话场景下的视觉相关问题回答能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体记忆系统大多围绕文本设计，即使支持多模态对话也无法很好回答视觉相关问题。原因在于相似性搜索的核心假设——查询在索引空间中靠近相关证据——在多模态场景下被两个差距打破：模态鸿沟（查询更靠近同模态内容）和相似性-相关性鸿沟（最相似的内容往往不是能回答问题的证据），尤其当查询同时包含文本和图像时问题最为严重。
AI.method: V-Mem通过两方面解决上述问题：(1) 跨模态差距：将对话组织为轮次，从匹配所在的同一轮次中返回目标模态内容，避免跨模态直接比较；(2) 相似性-相关性差距：使用LLM生成更接近相关证据的锚点进行搜索——对于寻找图像的纯文本查询，生成假设性图像标题；对于需要结合文本和图像才能定位证据的查询，用查询文本加从查询图像中提取的关键词构建增强搜索锚点。
AI.result: 在Mem-Gallery基准上，V-Mem的LLM评判分数达到0.82，远超第二名0.56；在带图像的问题上优势最大（0.87，所有基线均低于0.47）。在LoCoMo基准上，V-Mem得分为0.69，优于基线的0.58。
AI.conclusion: V-Mem通过模态感知的路由检索策略和LLM生成的锚点设计，有效解决了多模态记忆中视觉相关问题检索的两个根本性瓶颈，在多个基准上大幅超越现有方法，展示了模态感知设计对多模态智能体记忆系统的重要性。

title: DynActiveGS: Active Gaussian Splatting for Dynamic Scene Reconstruction
summary: We present DynActiveGS, a dynamic-aware active reconstruction framework based on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) for autonomous exploration in dynamic environments. The framework incrementally reconstructs a 3D Gaussian scene representation while suppressing motion-corrupted observations through online uncertainty prediction and uncertainty-weighted Gaussian optimization. A key component of DynActiveGS is the explicit decomposition of uncertainty into structural uncertainty and motion-induced uncertainty, which enables the system to distinguish under-reconstructed static regions from dynamically unreliable areas. Based on these uncertainty fields, DynActiveGS performs dynamic-aware viewpoint selection and dynamic-constrained path planning to favor informative yet stable observations during exploration. The resulting system forms a unified closed-loop pipeline for robust active reconstruction in dynamic scenes. Extensive experiments on challenging dynamic benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing active reconstruction baselines in reconstruction accuracy, completeness, rendering quality, and exploration efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DynActiveGS，一种基于3D高斯溅射的动态感知主动重建框架，用于动态环境中的自主探索。该框架通过在线不确定性预测和不确定性加权优化来抑制运动干扰的观测，并显式区分结构不确定性与运动诱导不确定性，实现动态感知的视点选择和路径规划，形成闭环的主动重建系统。
AI.motivation: 现有主动重建方法主要针对静态环境设计，在动态环境中运动物体会污染观测数据，导致重建质量下降。作者希望解决动态环境中自主探索与重建的挑战，使系统能够区分"未被充分重建的静态区域"和"动态不可靠区域"，从而进行稳健的主动重建。
AI.method: DynActiveGS的核心方法包括：(1) 基于3DGS的增量场景重建，通过在线不确定性预测和不确定性加权高斯优化来抑制运动损坏的观测；(2) 将不确定性显式分解为结构不确定性和运动诱导不确定性，用于区分低重建覆盖区域与动态不可靠区域；(3) 基于不确定性场执行动态感知的视点选择和动态约束的路径规划，以偏好信息丰富且稳定的观测。整体形成闭环的统一管道。
AI.result: 在多个具有挑战性的动态基准上进行了大量实验，相较于现有主动重建基线，在重建精度、完整性、渲染质量和探索效率方面均取得了一致的改进。
AI.conclusion: DynActiveGS成功实现了动态环境下的稳健主动重建，通过不确定性分解和动态感知决策策略，有效提升了动态场景中自主重建系统的整体性能，为动态主动重建提供了统一的闭环解决方案。

title: Emergence Invariance: From Symbolized Thought to Interface Refinement
summary: Language can be viewed as a formalized subset of thought: a consequence-governed symbolic structure projected from wider situated cognition. Large language models trained at scale exhibit compensatory emergence: sparse architectural primitives support in-context learning, multi-step reasoning, tool use, and chain of thought. Yet a language-first probabilistic architecture inherits substantive, substrate, and high-level incompletenesses relative to human cognition. Their coexistence makes an LLM a human-like thought-form generator that reconstructs increasingly human-like reasoning forms from an incomplete substrate. We ask whether emergence can compensate for every missing distinction. We formalize the philosophical premise as the Symbolization--Substructure Thesis and introduce emergence invariance. For a scale-indexed family acting through a shared task interface $φ$, $\mathcal{R}_s^*=\mathcal{R}_φ^*+C_s$: scale can reduce the compensation gap $C_s$, while a positive interface floor $\mathcal{R}_φ^*$ persists. We prove that, under a fixed input law, one interface is universally no less informative exactly when its completed information $σ$-field refines the other, and that total compensation occurs exactly when both the interface floor and asymptotic compensation gap vanish. The framework unifies existing results on grounding, memory, position, attention, Bayesian inheritance, scientific abduction, and reasoning control. In a matched DeepSeek V4-Flash API study, thinking improves pointer chasing from $0/16$ to $14/16$ when relevant distinctions are available; exact observational twins remain at their $50\%$ construction floor; and restoring decisive memory moves matched performance from $50\%$ to $100\%$. These results provide initial evidence for the predicted separation between scaling within an interface and refining the interface itself.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"符号化—子结构论题"（Symbolization–Substructure Thesis），将哲学前提形式化，并引入"涌现不变性"概念。作者证明：在固定输入定律下，一个接口普遍不劣于另一个接口当且仅当其完备信息σ-域细化另一个；全面补偿当且仅当接口下限和渐近补偿间隙都消失。通过DeepSeek V4-Flash实验验证了"尺度内扩展"与"接口细化"之间的预测性分离。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在回答一个核心哲学问题：大规模语言模型的涌现能力能否补偿其相对于人类认知的所有缺失区分？语言被视作思维的形式化子集，而LLM继承了实质性、基质性和高层次的不完备性，作者希望从理论上阐明这些不完备性是否可被尺度扩展所弥补。
AI.method: 作者首先将哲学前提形式化为"符号化—子结构论题"，引入涌现不变性概念，建立尺度索引族通过共享任务接口φ作用的理论框架，给出R*_s = R*_φ + C_s的分解公式。通过信息σ-域的细化关系证明接口普遍信息性的充要条件，并使用DeepSeek V4-Flash API进行匹配实验验证理论预测。
AI.result: 实验结果显示：思考能提升指针追踪从0/16到14/16（当相关区分可用时）；精确观测孪生样本保持在50%构造下限；恢复决定性记忆使匹配性能从50%提升到100%。这些结果为"尺度内扩展"与"接口细化"之间的理论分离提供了初步实验证据。
AI.conclusion: 涌现不能补偿每一个缺失区分——存在正的接口下限R*_φ，无论尺度如何扩展都无法消除。全面补偿仅在接口下限和渐近补偿间隙同时消失时发生。该框架统一了关于接地、记忆、位置、注意力、贝叶斯继承、科学溯因和推理控制等既有研究结果。

title: 3DZip: Spatial-Aware Feature Diversity-Guided Token Compression for 3D Question Answering
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://cvsp-lab.github.io/3DZip
summary: Recent 3D vision-language models (3D VLMs) construct geometry aware tokens by projecting 2D visual features into world coordinates, enabling spatial reasoning for tasks such as 3D question answering. However, this design generates thousands of tokens per scene, resulting in substantial computational and memory overhead. While token compression has been extensively studied in 2D VLMs, existing approaches rely on semantic relevance or attention-based selection that overlook the structured spatial nature of 3D tokens. Moreover, redundancy in 3D representations cannot be resolved by spatial proximity alone, as object-level token imbalance persists even after spatial aggregation. To address this, we propose 3DZip, a three-stage token compression framework that first applies coarse voxelization to remove point-level redundancy, then selects anchor tokens based on feature-space diversity via a Determinantal Point Process, and finally merges remaining tokens under spatial constraints to preserve geometric coherence. Experiments on three 3D question answering benchmarks demonstrate that 3DZip consistently outperforms existing compression methods, retaining 94.7% of the original performance with only 128 tokens, achieving a $1.92\times$ faster inference speed.

AI.tldr: 提出3DZip，一种三阶段3D视觉语言模型token压缩框架，通过粗体素化、基于行列式点过程的锚点选择和空间约束下的token合并，仅用128个token即可保留94.7%的原始性能，推理速度提升1.92倍。
AI.motivation: 3D视觉语言模型通过将2D视觉特征投影到世界坐标生成几何感知token，但每场景产生数千个token导致巨大的计算和内存开销。现有token压缩方法主要针对2D VLM设计，忽视了3D token的结构化空间特性；且仅靠空间邻近无法解决冗余，因为空间聚合后仍存在对象级token不平衡问题。
AI.method: 3DZip采用三阶段压缩框架：第一阶段进行粗体素化以消除点级冗余；第二阶段基于特征空间多样性通过行列式点过程(DPP)选择锚点token；第三阶段在空间约束下合并剩余token，以保持几何一致性。
AI.result: 在三个3D问答基准上，3DZip一致优于现有压缩方法，仅用128个token即可保留原始性能的94.7%，推理速度提升1.92倍。
AI.conclusion: 3DZip通过结合空间与特征双重维度的压缩策略，有效解决了3D VLM中token冗余问题，在保持性能的同时显著提升了推理效率，验证了空间约束与特征多样性选择相结合的有效性。

title: Securing Agentic AI: From Per-Action Checks to Trajectory Assurance
comment: 6 pages. Accepted to the ACM AI Leadership Summit 2026 (Visionary Track)
summary: Autonomous agents are increasingly used to execute consequential tasks in environments governed by operational constraints, organizational policies, regulatory requirements, and technical standards. Their safety is therefore determined not by the correctness of individual actions, but by whether their overall behavior remains consistent with the rules and invariants of the systems in which they operate. As large language model (LLM)-based agents become more autonomous and increasingly delegate tasks across organizational boundaries, securing them evolves from a single challenge into a broad and interconnected landscape spanning the entire agentic stack. At the single-agent level, untrusted inputs through prompts, memory, retrieved knowledge, and tool interfaces create attack surfaces. In multi-agent settings, delegation and communication introduce challenges related to identity, trust, capability control, and decision transparency, while the underlying model routing and execution control plane remains vulnerable to manipulation and to unverified model provenance. Perhaps the most fundamental challenge is behavioral containment: sequences of individually permissible actions may collectively violate system-level constraints and safety invariants. At the broader level, supply-chain integrity, provenance, accountability, and end-to-end observability remain largely open problems. A common principle unifies these directions: security must become a verifiable property of the architectures, protocols, and runtimes that govern agent behavior, rather than an optional layer of guidance. Charting these challenges provides a roadmap toward trustworthy autonomous agent deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地梳理了基于大语言模型（LLM）的自主智能体在安全方面面临的跨层级挑战，指出智能体的安全不应仅由单个动作的正确性决定，而应由其整体行为是否与系统规则和不变式一致来决定，并提出安全应成为架构、协议和运行时中可验证的属性，而非可选的指导层。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM智能体自主性增强并越来越多地跨组织边界委派任务，其安全挑战已经从单一问题演变为覆盖整个智能体技术栈的广泛互联格局。目前缺乏对这一多层面安全挑战的系统性认识，需要全面梳理以指导可信自主智能体的部署。
AI.method: 本文采用分析性的方法，按照智能体技术栈的层级结构逐层剖析安全挑战：(1) 单智能体层面，识别通过提示、记忆、检索知识和工具接口的不可信输入攻击面；(2) 多智能体层面，分析委派与通信带来的身份、信任、能力控制和决策透明性问题；(3) 执行控制层面，探讨模型路由和执行的操纵与模型来源验证问题；(4) 系统层面，指出行为约束（behavioral containment）是最根本的挑战——单个允许的动作序列可能在整体上违反系统级约束和安全不变式；(5) 更广泛层面，供应链完整性、可溯源、问责制和端到端可观测性仍是开放问题。
AI.result: 本文识别出多个核心安全挑战：不可信输入面、多智能体信任与委派问题、执行控制面的操纵风险、行为约束这一最根本挑战，以及供应链和可观测性等开放问题。最终提出统一原则：安全必须成为治理智能体行为的架构、协议和运行时中可验证的属性，而非可选的指导层。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统性地绘制这些挑战图谱，本文为可信自主智能体部署提供了路线图，强调从"指导性安全"转向"可验证安全"的根本范式转变。

title: Can AI Agents Simulate A/B Test Outcomes? A Validation Framework for Agentic Experimentation
comment: Accepted as a workshop paper at https://www.aiagentbehavior.com/
summary: A/B testing remains the standard for rolling out new features in the technology industry. Each experiment, however, consumes real traffic, engineering effort, and weeks of wall-clock time. Can AI agents---conditioned on behavioral profiles and contextual descriptions of the intervention---simulate outcomes accurately enough to vet candidate treatments before committing live traffic? We formalize this question as a \emph{Simulated Randomized Controlled Trial} (S-RCT) and derive a two-layer error decomposition that separates agent approximation error from subsampling error, enabling targeted improvements to each. The framework is agent-agnostic: any behavioral model---from a fine-tuned specialist to a general-purpose foundation model---can serve as the simulation engine. Validated on 67 historical marketing A/B tests, a baseline S-RCT using an off-the-shelf foundation model captures directional signal (sign overlap 0.70) but systematically overshoots effect magnitudes. A two-phase pre-period calibration protocol reduces the squared prediction error (after removing irreducible measurement noise) by ${\sim}77\times$; a within-subject design---where each agent is exposed to both arms---reduces standard errors by ${\sim}2.4\times$. We discuss limitations of the current approach and identify applications where experimenters stand to benefit from agentic signals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出模拟随机对照试验（S-RCT）框架，用AI智能体模拟A/B测试结果，通过两层误差分解和校准协议，在67个历史营销实验中大幅降低预测误差并提升效率。
AI.motivation: 传统A/B测试消耗真实流量、工程时间和数周时间成本高昂，作者希望利用AI智能体基于行为画像和干预描述来预模拟实验结果，在投入真实流量前就能筛选候选方案，从而节省资源和时间。
AI.method: 提出S-RCT框架，推导出两层误差分解（智能体近似误差和子采样误差），该框架与特定模型无关，可使用任何行为模型（从微调专家模型到通用基础模型）作为模拟引擎。同时提出两阶段预实验校准协议（预期间校准）和受试者内设计（同一智能体暴露于两个实验臂）来分别降低预测误差和标准误差。
AI.result: 在67个历史营销A/B测试上验证：使用现成基础模型的基线S-RCT能捕捉方向性信号（符号重叠率0.70）但系统性地高估效应幅度；两阶段预期间校准协议使平方预测误差（去除不可约测量噪声后）降低约77倍；受试者内设计使标准误差降低约2.4倍。
AI.conclusion: S-RCT框架在营销A/B测试场景展现出实际应用潜力，显著提升了模拟预测精度和效率，但当前方法仍有局限。作者讨论了局限性，并指出了实验者能从智能体信号中获益的应用场景。

title: QuerySplat: Decoupling Geometry and Appearance Representations in 3DGS Prediction
summary: While feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables efficient 3D reconstruction, achieving high-fidelity rendering remains challenging. Existing pixel-aligned approaches suffer from spatial inflexibility and massive structural redundancy, whereas query-based methods lack 3D priors and entangle geometry with appearance, yielding blurry, pose-dependent results. To overcome these deficiencies, we propose \textbf{QuerySplat}, a feed-forward 3DGS framework driven by geometric priors and explicit appearance decoupling. Specifically, we design a dual-branch query-based decoder: the geometry branch leverages a pretrained Vision Geometric Model for spatial understanding, which intrinsically endows QuerySplat with pose-free modeling capabilities, while the appearance branch recovers high-frequency details through a dedicated pathway separated from geometric attribute regression. Extensive experiments demonstrate that QuerySplat mitigates the blurry rendering issues of early query-based models and consistently outperforms pixel-aligned approaches in rendering fidelity. On the challenging DL3DV benchmark, it achieves state-of-the-art novel view synthesis performance, with average PSNR gains of 2.30 dB and 1.04 dB over the best pose-free and pose-required baselines, respectively. Project Page: https://inspatio.github.io/querysplat.

AI.tldr: QuerySplat是一个前馈3D高斯泼溅框架，通过双分支查询解码器（几何分支利用预训练视觉几何模型提供3D先验和姿态无关建模，外观分支独立恢复高频细节）实现几何与外观的解耦，在DL3DV基准上取得SOTA新视角合成性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的前馈3DGS方法存在两类问题：像素对齐方法空间灵活性差且结构冗余大，查询式方法缺乏3D先验且几何与外观纠缠，导致渲染模糊和姿态依赖的结果。作者旨在克服这些缺陷，实现高保真渲染。
AI.method: 提出双分支查询解码器框架：几何分支借助预训练的视觉几何模型（VGM）获取空间理解和3D先验，实现姿态无关建模；外观分支通过独立通路恢复高频细节，与几何属性回归（如位置、尺度、旋转）相分离，从而显式解耦几何与外观。
AI.result: QuerySplat缓解了早期查询式模型的模糊渲染问题，在渲染保真度上一致优于像素对齐方法。在DL3DV基准上取得SOTA新视角合成结果，平均PSNR比最优的无姿态基线高出2.30dB，比最优的需姿态基线高出1.04dB。
AI.conclusion: 通过几何先验驱动和显式外观解耦，QuerySplat有效解决了前馈3DGS中空间灵活性、3D先验缺失以及几何外观纠缠等问题，在多个基准上实现了先进的渲染质量。

title: Does the Competitive Component of Adversarial Self-Play Improve Legal Reasoning? A Controlled Negative Result
summary: Adversarial self-play is an appealing recipe for legal reasoning: have a student model draft an argument, have an adversary attack it, and reward the student when its argument survives the attack. We designed exactly such a training signal -- a verifiable "survival" reward in which both the student's cited authorities and the adversary's counter-authorities are checked by a citation verifier, so that survival is decided on verified grounds rather than rhetoric, and fabricated citations are automatically neutralized. We then asked a narrow but important question: does the competitive component itself -- the adversary and the survival reward -- add anything on top of an otherwise identical non-competitive training run? Across four independent tests -- a bootstrap comparison, a two-seed replication, a paired per-case adversarial-robustness comparison, and a blinded head-to-head judgment of generated arguments, plus a follow-up pilot with a deliberately strengthened self-play adversary -- the competitive component produced no reliable benefit. The blinded judgment gave a 49% win rate (binomial p approx. 1.000); the strengthened-adversary pilot gave a 50% win rate (32:32, p approx. 1.000). An early apparent +29% advantage reversed and proved to be a small-sample artifact. We report this as an honest negative result. The value of the paper is reproducibility and the sharing of concrete pitfalls: an initially promising metric that inverted on more data, and an adversarial-robustness metric that silently collapsed to plain recall once the adversary stopped citing the same authorities as the gold answer. This null is consistent with, and reconfirms in the legal domain, the conclusion of the companion coding-domain study (Kim, 2026, arXiv:2607.08255) that the value of multi-teacher curricula arises from constructing a verifiable environment rather than from competition itself.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了一个诚实且可复现的负面结果：在合法推理任务中，对抗性自博弈训练（学生起草论点、对手攻击、基于可验证引文的生存奖励）相对于无竞争的训练方案没有产生可靠的增益。四项独立测试均显示竞争组件无效，作者将该结果与配对编程领域的发现共同归因于"可验证环境"的价值而非竞争本身。
AI.motivation: 对抗性自博弈被认为是有吸引力的合法推理训练方法，但作者提出了一个关键问题：竞争组件本身（对手和生存奖励）是否真的在完全相同的无竞争训练之上增加了价值？这需要严谨的实证检验。
AI.method: 设计了基于可验证"生存"奖励的训练信号，其中学生引用的权威和对手的反权威都通过引文验证器检查。随后进行了四项独立测试：bootstrap比较、两种子复制、配对逐案对抗鲁棒性比较、盲法头对头判断，外加一个加强版自博弈对手的试点实验。
AI.result: 竞争组件未产生可靠收益。盲法判断胜率49%（二项检验p≈1.000）；加强对手试点胜率50%（32:32，p≈1.000）。早期表面上的+29%优势在更多数据下反转，被证明是小样本伪影。此外，对抗鲁棒性指标在对手不再引用与标准答案相同权威后悄然退化为普通召回率。
AI.conclusion: 这是一个诚实的负面结果，其价值在于可复现性以及对具体陷阱的分享：一个最初有希望的指标在更多数据下反转，以及一个指标静默失效的问题。该结果在合法领域再次确认了配对编程领域研究（Kim, 2026）的结论：多教师课程的价值在于构建可验证环境，而非竞争本身。

title: Global Optimization and Inference-Time Region Grafting for Agentic Workflows
summary: Recent advances in agentic workflow optimization automate workflow design through task-specific workflow search or input-conditioned architecture selection. However, they determine the workflow before execution and cannot adapt failed workflow regions using execution-time label-free quality signals. Naively enabling such inference-time adaptation through whole-workflow re-optimization would be computationally prohibitive. To tackle this challenge, we introduce GRAFT, which preserves a globally optimized workflow while locally replacing only selected regions for each input. Without parameter training, GRAFT evaluates region-level alternatives using label-free execution-quality signals and accepts only replacements that improve local quality while preserving workflow-level consistency, thereby enabling instance-wise adaptation without whole-workflow re-optimization. GRAFT applies without modification across a range of tasks spanning mathematical reasoning, code generation, and multi-hop and knowledge-intensive question answering. Under matched optimizer and executor settings, it improves over the strongest prior workflow-optimization method, MaAS, by 3.85 points on average. Replacing only the executor with a stronger model yields further gains without re-optimizing the global workflow. This suggests that an optimized workflow is not merely a static optimization artifact, but an adaptable execution policy that can evolve with inference-time feedback and stronger executors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRAFT，一种无需参数训练的推理时自适应工作流优化方法。它在保留全局优化工作流的同时，仅对每个输入局部替换选定的工作流区域，利用无标签的执行质量信号评估区域级替代方案，实现实例级自适应而无需重新优化整个工作流。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体工作流优化方法在执行前就确定工作流结构，无法利用执行时的无标签质量信号来适应失败的工作流区域；而通过整体工作流重新优化来实现推理时自适应在计算上不可行。
AI.method: GRAFT在不进行参数训练的前提下，保留全局最优工作流，对每个输入仅局部替换选定区域。它使用无标签执行质量信号评估区域级候选方案，仅接受能提升局部质量且保持工作流整体一致性的替换，从而实现实例级自适应而无需整体重新优化。
AI.result: 在数学推理、代码生成、多跳与知识密集型问答等多项任务上，GRAFT在匹配的优化器和执行器设置下平均超过最强基线方法MaAS达3.85分；仅将执行器替换为更强模型即可获得额外提升，无需重新优化全局工作流。
AI.conclusion: 优化后的工作流不仅是静态的优化产物，更是一种可适应的执行策略，能够随着推理时反馈和更强的执行器而演进。这改变了人们对工作流优化的理解，为高效动态工作流自适应提供了新方向。

title: Fruit-HSNet: A Machine Learning Approach for Hyperspectral Image-Based Fruit Ripeness Prediction
summary: Fruit ripeness prediction (FRP) is a classification-based agricultural computer vision task that has attracted much attention, thanks to its wide-ranging advantages in agriculture field for both pre-harvest and post-harvest management. Accurate and timely FRP can be achieved using machine/deep learning-based hyperspectral image classification techniques. However, challenges including the limited availability of labeled data and the lack of robust methods generalizable to various hyperspectral cameras and fruit types can compromise the effectiveness of hyperspectral image-based FRP. Addressing these challenges, this paper introduces Fruit-HSNet, a machine learning architecture specifically designed for hyperspectral classification of fruit ripeness. Fruit-HSNet incorporates a spatio-spectral feature extraction module based on Fourier Transform and central pixel spectral signature followed by learnable feature fusion and a classifier optimized for ripeness classification. The proposed architecture was evaluated using the DeepHS Fruit dataset, the largest publicly available labeled real-world hyperspectral dataset for predicting fruit ripeness, which includes five different types of fruits-avocado, kiwi, mango, kaki, and papaya-captured with three distinct hyperspectral cameras at various stages of ripeness. Experimental results highlight that Fruit-HSNet substantially outperforms existing deep learning methods, from baseline to state-of-the-art models, with improvements of 12%, achieving a new state-of-the-art overall accuracy of 70.73%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Fruit-HSNet，一种结合傅里叶变换与中心像素光谱特征的时空特征提取架构，用于高光谱图像的水果成熟度分类，在DeepHS Fruit数据集上以70.73%的整体准确率超越现有方法12%。
AI.motivation: 水果成熟度预测（FRP）在农业前/后收获管理中具有重要意义，但现有方法面临两个关键挑战：标注数据有限，以及缺乏能泛化到不同高光谱相机和水果类型的鲁棒方法，这些问题削弱了高光谱图像FRP的有效性。
AI.method: Fruit-HSNet采用基于傅里叶变换和中心像素光谱特征的时空特征提取模块，随后进行可学习的特征融合，并使用针对成熟度分类优化的分类器。在包含5种水果（牛油果、猕猴桃、芒果、柿子、木瓜）、3种高光谱相机、多个成熟度阶段的DeepHS Fruit数据集上进行评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明Fruit-HSNet显著优于从基线到最先进的深度学习方法，准确率提升12%，达到新的最先进整体准确率70.73%。
AI.conclusion: Fruit-HSNet证明了结合傅里叶变换与光谱特征提取的架构能有效应对标注数据有限和跨相机/跨水果泛化等挑战，为高光谱水果成熟度分类提供了更优的解决方案。

title: Is More Privileged Information Better? From Solution Traces to Problem-Solving Structure in Self-Distilled Reasoning
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) improves reasoning by using a privileged view of a model conditioned on reference solutions to supervise a student view that observes only the question. However, the teacher-provided token-level targets may depend on reference-specific information unavailable at inference time. We propose Problem-Space-Guided OPSD (PS-OPSD), which replaces the complete solution with trajectory-grounded guidance describing the initial state, goal conditions, constraints, and a selected state-transition path. The student rollout and OPSD objective remain unchanged. Across three mathematical reasoning benchmarks and model scales ranging from 1.7B to 8B, PS-OPSD achieves the highest aggregate question-only accuracy among the compared methods. Controlled experiments further indicate that guidance relevance and path coherence contribute to these gains, highlighting the representation of privileged information as an important design choice in OPSD.

AI.tldr: 提出问题空间引导的在线策略自蒸馏（PS-OPSD）方法，用轨迹接地指导替代完整参考答案来提供特权信息，在多个数学推理基准上提升了仅基于问题的推理准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有的在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）通过特权视角（基于参考答案）监督仅观察问题的学生视角来提升推理能力，但教师提供的token级目标可能依赖推理时不可用的参考特定信息，导致训练与推理不匹配。
AI.method: PS-OPSD用描述初始状态、目标条件、约束条件和选定的状态转移路径的轨迹接地指导替代完整解决方案，学生rollout和OPSD目标函数保持不变。
AI.result: 在三个数学推理基准和1.7B到8B的模型规模上，PS-OPSD在仅问题准确率上取得了最高的聚合成绩；受控实验表明指导相关性和路径连贯性对其性能提升有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 特权信息的表示形式是OPSD中的一个重要设计选择，问题空间层面的引导比完整参考答案能更有效地帮助学生模型在推理时仅基于问题进行学习。

title: ScrambleToolBench: Agents Search Exhaustively Even When Their Own Map Points to the Next Step
summary: To operate robustly in open-world environments, autonomous agents should be able to infer the behavior of unfamiliar systems through interaction alone, even in the absence of documentation. However, existing tool-use benchmarks expose semantic tool schemas in static environments, allowing agents to rely on prior knowledge rather than autonomous discovery. To address this limitation, we introduce ScrambleToolBench, an interactive terminal benchmark designed to isolate behavioral reasoning. By removing semantic cues and enforcing a continuous task curriculum, the benchmark requires agents to uncover hidden tool behaviors entirely through trial-and-error interaction. The benchmark further introduces dynamic challenges, including mapping drift, stochastic action failures, and temporal execution windows, to evaluate whether agents can revise and adapt their hypotheses as the environment changes. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art language models reveals that successful initial discovery does not translate into robust adaptation. When faced with structural changes such as mapping drift, agents fail to use deductive strategies such as cycle tracing, and instead exhibit belief inertia or fall back to exhaustive search. Increasing test-time reasoning only amplifies this expensive brute-force search rather than enabling deductive recovery. While equipping agents with persistent memory reduces compounding errors, they remain unable to efficiently infer structural changes, highlighting a gap in current agent reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ScrambleToolBench，一个交互式终端基准测试，用于隔离和评估智能体在无语义线索环境中的行为推理能力。实验发现当前语言模型虽能完成初始发现，但在面对环境动态变化（映射漂移、随机故障、时间窗口）时无法有效适应，表现出信念惰性和暴力搜索倾向。
AI.motivation: 现有工具使用基准在静态环境中暴露语义工具模式，使智能体依赖先验知识而非自主发现，无法真实评估智能体在开放世界中通过交互推断未知系统行为的能力。
AI.method: 提出ScrambleToolBench基准：去除语义线索、强制连续任务课程、引入映射漂移、随机动作失败和时间执行窗口等动态挑战，要求智能体完全通过试错交互来发现和适应隐藏工具行为。
AI.result: 最先进的语言模型在初始发现任务上表现良好，但在面对结构变化（如映射漂移）时无法使用演绎策略（如循环追踪），表现出信念惰性或退化为穷举搜索；增加测试时推理只会放大暴力搜索成本；持久记忆虽减少复合错误，但仍无法高效推断结构变化。
AI.conclusion: 当前智能体推理在行为推理的鲁棒适应方面存在显著差距：从成功发现到鲁棒适应之间并不能自然转化，需要新的推理策略来解决信念更新和结构变化推断问题。

title: It's the Decoding Format, Not the Perturbation: Auditing Consistency-Based Selection for Vision-Language Test-Time Scaling
summary: Test-time scaling lifts large language model reasoning by sampling many candidate solutions and selecting among them, yet the same recipe transfers poorly to vision-language models (VLMs): recent work shows that simple majority voting beats selection methods built on the model's own self-verification, apparently because at the selection layer an image-grounded answer and a confident guess from the language prior look the same. A natural fix is to make the selection signal one that cannot be computed without the image. We study Perturbation Grounded Selection (Pgs), a label-free, training-free rule that scores each candidate by whether the model re-derives it under label-preserving perturbations of the input (cropping, background masking, mild photometric or geometric jitter); Pgs recovers majority voting when the perturbation set is empty. The decisive question is not whether Pgs beats chain-of-thought only majority voting, but whether the perturbation term adds anything once decoding format and budget are controlled. We therefore introduce a format-matched control (MatchedCtrl): the same short, no-CoT draws spent on the original image. Across TextVQA, MATH-Vision, MMMU, and ViLP, with a Qwen headline (three-seed means) and LLaVA-OneVision coverage in matched-budget selector tables, Pgs appears to beat plain majority voting by up to +31.8 points on TextVQA (Qwen), but MatchedCtrl tracks or exceeds Pgs within noise on every benchmark, including the vision-required ViLP; no Qwen category shows a significant gain over this control. The stability gap is real and image-dependent (up to +0.48), yet does not predict per-instance wins. The result is negative and diagnostic: perturbation consistency is at best a partial diagnostic of visual dependence and, on its own, not a usable selection signal once format is controlled; gains reported against CoT-only majority voting overstate such methods.

AI.tldr: 本文研究扰动接地选择（Pgs）方法，用于视觉语言模型（VLM）的测试时扩展推理选择。该方法通过对输入图像施加保持标签的扰动（裁剪、背景遮蔽、光度/几何抖动）来评估候选答案的稳健性。然而，通过引入格式匹配对照（MatchedCtrl），作者发现Pgs在控制了解码格式和预算后，并未在TextVQA、MATH-Vision、MMMU和ViLP等基准上显著优于普通多数投票，甚至多项基准上MatchedCtrl与Pgs持平或更优。结论为负：扰动一致性最多只能部分诊断视觉依赖性，单独使用不能作为有效的选择信号。
AI.motivation: 多数投票在VLM推理中往往优于基于模型自我验证的选择方法，因为图像接地答案与语言先验的自信猜测难以区分。作者希望找到一种不依赖图像就无法计算的选择信号，提出利用输入扰动下的答案一致性作为选择依据。
AI.method: 提出Pgs方法：对每个候选答案，在标签保持的输入扰动（裁剪、背景遮蔽、轻度光度或几何抖动）下重新推导，根据模型能否重现原答案来评分。同时引入MatchedCtrl对照：使用相同格式、相同预算的短无CoT采样但仅在原始图像上进行，以严格隔离扰动项的贡献。
AI.result: Pgs在TextVQA上相对多数投票最多提升+31.8点，但MatchedCtrl在所有基准上（包括需要视觉的ViLP）与Pgs持平或超过Pgs，无显著差距。稳定性差距确实存在且与图像相关（最高+0.48），但无法预测逐实例的胜出。
AI.conclusion: 结果是否定且具有诊断性的：格式匹配的对照表明，Pgs相对CoT仅有多数投票的优势是过度的；一旦格式和预算受控，扰动一致性并不能作为可靠的选择信号，只能部分诊断视觉依赖性。

title: Latent Thought Credit: Multi-Answer Credit Assignment for Latent Reasoning
summary: Latent reasoning allows language models to carry out intermediate reasoning in continuous latent representations rather than fully externalizing it as discrete chains of thought. However, assigning credit to such latent thoughts from answer-only rewards is difficult: a single final answer mixes thought quality with answer-sampling noise. We propose \textbf{Latent Thought Credit (LTC)}, a hierarchical credit-assignment framework for latent reasoning. For each prompt, LTC samples multiple latent thoughts, fixes the context after each thought, and estimates thought-level expected reward by averaging rewards over multiple answers generated from that fixed context. LTC uses thought-level advantages to optimize the latent-thought phase, answer-level advantages to optimize the answer phase, and an advantage-weighted thought-matching objective that helps the policy reproduce high-credit latent thoughts. We instantiate LTC in a GRPO-style on-policy training framework and evaluate it across mathematical reasoning and STEM multiple-choice tasks. LTC achieves the best average accuracy among the compared methods, while ablations and fixed-context diagnostics show that multi-answer estimation reduces reward-estimation error and mitigates ambiguous or incorrect thought-level credit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出潜在思维信用（LTC）框架，一种用于潜在推理的层次化信用分配方法。LTC通过采样多个潜在思维、固定上下文后生成多个答案来估计思维级期望奖励，并使用思维级优势优化思维阶段、答案级优势优化答案阶段，以及优势加权思维匹配目标。在数学推理和STEM多选题上取得最佳平均准确率。
AI.motivation: 潜在推理允许语言模型在连续潜在表示中进行中间推理，但从仅含答案的奖励中为潜在思维分配信用是困难的，因为单个最终答案混合了思维质量与答案采样噪声，无法有效区分两者的贡献。
AI.method: LTC采用层次化信用分配：对每个提示采样多个潜在思维，固定每个思维后的上下文，通过在该固定上下文上生成多个答案并平均奖励来估计思维级期望奖励。使用思维级优势优化潜在思维阶段，答案级优势优化答案阶段，并设计了优势加权思维匹配目标帮助策略复现高信用潜在思维。该方法在GRPO风格的在策略训练框架中实现。
AI.result: 在数学推理和STEM多项选择题任务中，LTC在对比方法中取得最佳平均准确率。消融实验和固定上下文诊断表明，多答案估计降低了奖励估计误差，并缓解了模糊或错误的思维级信用分配问题。
AI.conclusion: 多答案估计是提升潜在思维信用分配准确性的有效手段，LTC框架通过层次化的思维级和答案级信用分配，显著改善了潜在推理的训练效果。

title: Fast and Accurate Quotation Attribution in Literary Texts
summary: Attributing quotations to their speakers in literary texts remains an open challenge. Standard methods, which independently predict a speaker mention for each quotation, are efficient but still limited in accuracy. In contrast, large language model (LLM) approaches achieve strong performance, but their computational cost limits their use in large-scale literary analysis. We propose an encoder-based efficient formulation that resolves multiple quotation attributions within a shared, large context window. Using our new formulation, \textit{joint scoring}, we report state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on the Project Dialogism Novel Corpus (PDNC), comprising more than 35,000 manually annotated quotations from 22 English novels. Our best model reaches 94.5\% overall attribution accuracy while processing novels $20\times$ faster than comparable standard methods and more than $1000\times$ faster than LLM-based approaches on an A100 GPU. An analysis of models' representations suggests that joint scoring improves on challenging attribution examples by preserving long-range anaphora resolution signal, an information that we found already present in pretrained encoders. To facilitate adoption, we release ModernBookNLP, a modified fork of BookNLP that replaces its quotation attribution model with our best system available at https://github.com/gasmichel/ModernBookNLP_QA/.

AI.tldr: 提出基于编码器的联合评分（joint scoring）方法，在共享的大上下文窗口中同时解析多个引语归属，在PDNC语料上达到94.5%的准确率，速度比标准方法快20倍、比LLM方法快1000倍以上，并发布改进版BookNLP工具ModernBookNLP。
AI.motivation: 文学文本中引语归属（quotation attribution）仍是开放挑战。现有标准方法独立预测每个引语的说话者，精度有限；而LLM方法虽性能优异但计算成本过高，难以用于大规模文学分析。
AI.method: 提出encoder-based的联合评分（joint scoring）新公式，在共享的大上下文窗口中同时解决多个引语归属问题，取代传统的独立预测方式。
AI.result: 在Project Dialogism Novel Corpus (PDNC)上达到SOTA，94.5%的整体归属准确率；处理小说速度比标准方法快20倍，比LLM方法快1000倍以上（A100 GPU）。模型表征分析表明联合评分通过保留长距离回指消解信号改善了困难样本，该信号在预训练编码器中已存在。
AI.conclusion: 联合评分方法兼顾了高精度与高效率，并揭示预训练编码器中已蕴含长距离回指消解信息；发布ModernBookNLP工具以促进该方法的实际应用。

title: VaRS-Doc: Interpretation-Aware Variant Representations via Latent Self-Probing for Visual Document Retrieval
summary: Visual document retrieval has recently become increasingly important in applications such as enterprise search, scientific literature discovery, and retrieval-augmented generation. These applications depend on efficiently identifying query-relevant pages across large collections of visually rich documents. Existing methods commonly adopt late-interaction architectures that encode and index documents offline to enable scalable and low-latency online retrieval. Despite its efficiency, this paradigm requires each document to be encoded into a fixed representation before the query is known. However, the same content in a visual document may induce different interpretations depending on the query intent, which a fixed representation struggles to capture. Yet postponing document encoding until the query arrives would incur prohibitive online retrieval latency. To address this gap, we propose VaRS-Doc, a visual document retrieval framework that diversifies document representations by enabling the model to actively explore variant latent interpretations during document encoding, while preserving efficient late-interaction retrieval in which each query adaptively selects the best-fit representation. We further introduce a two-stage training strategy that encourages the model to capture complementary semantic interpretations and prevents it from falling back to train a single dominant representation. Experiments on visual document retrieval benchmarks show that VaRS-Doc achieves state-of-the-art retrieval performance, offering a practical solution to the mismatch between query-agnostic document encoding and query-specific retrieval needs. Code is available at https://github.com/bokufa/VaRS-Doc.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VaRS-Doc，一个视觉文档检索框架，通过在文档编码阶段主动探索多种变体潜在解释来多样化文档表示，同时保留高效的晚期交互检索机制，让查询自适应选择最佳表示。实验表明该方法在视觉文档检索基准上达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉文档检索方法采用晚期交互架构，需在查询到来前将文档编码为固定表示，但同一视觉文档内容可能因查询意图不同而有不同解读，固定表示难以捕捉这种多样性。若延迟编码又会带来不可接受的检索延迟，存在查询无关编码与查询特定检索需求之间的不匹配。
AI.method: 提出VaRS-Doc框架，核心思想是在文档编码阶段让模型主动探索多种变体潜在解释，多样化文档表示；同时保持晚期交互检索效率，使每个查询在线自适应选择最佳匹配的文档表示。并引入两阶段训练策略，鼓励模型捕捉互补的语义解释，防止收敛到单一主导表示。
AI.result: 在视觉文档检索基准上，VaRS-Doc取得了最先进的检索性能。
AI.conclusion: VaRS-Doc为查询无关的文档编码与查询特定的检索需求之间的不匹配问题提供了实用解决方案，在保持高效检索的同时提升了检索效果。

title: Post-Training on Office Work Improves Software Engineering: A Behavioral Account of Cross-Domain Transfer
summary: Long-horizon tasks require agents to maintain coherent state and goals across nested and branching work. We call this capability goal-directed execution (GDE): the repeated application of four behaviors, namely selecting goals, constructing task-relevant state, maintaining fidelity to higher-level objectives, and verifying completion against the environment. We hypothesize that long-horizon post-training strengthens these behaviors across domains. We test this by post-training Qwen3.5-122B-A10B on 363 Long-Horizon Multi-Tool Agent (LHMTA) tasks drawn from office workflows. The collection contained no software-engineering tasks, yet the model's pass@1 improved by 5.8 points on SWE-Bench Pro. Matched trajectory analysis shows gains in all four GDE behaviors in both office workflows and software repositories. Aggregate SWE-Bench Pro statistics showed related changes in information gathering, implementation, and verification. Together, the results support a behavioral interpretation in which long-horizon post-training changed how the model organized and applied knowledge across tasks, with effects extending beyond the training domain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了目标导向执行（GDE）框架，包含四个行为：目标选择、状态构建、目标保真度维护和环境验证。通过在办公室工作流数据上对Qwen3.5-122B-A10B进行长时程后训练，发现模型在SWE-Bench Pro上的pass@1提升了5.8个百分点，且四个GDE行为在跨领域任务中均有改善。
AI.motivation: 长时程任务需要智能体在嵌套和分支工作中维持连贯的状态与目标，但现有研究缺乏对这种能力的系统性定义和验证，也尚不清楚长时程后训练是否能跨领域泛化提升这种行为能力。
AI.method: 提出GDE框架（目标选择、状态构建、保真度维护、完成验证四行为），对Qwen3.5-122B-A10B在363个长时程多工具代理（LHMTA）办公室工作流任务上进行后训练，并通过匹配轨迹分析和SWE-Bench Pro基准测试评估跨领域效果。
AI.result: 训练数据中不含软件工程任务，但模型在SWE-Bench Pro上pass@1提升了5.8个百分点；匹配轨迹分析显示四个GDE行为在办公室工作流和软件仓库中均有提升；SWE-Bench Pro的聚合统计显示信息收集、实现和验证方面有相关变化。
AI.conclusion: 长时程后训练改变了模型在跨任务中组织和应用知识的方式，GDE能力具有领域泛化性，其效果能超越训练域延伸到其他领域，支持了长时程后训练强化GDE行为的假设。

title: When Memory Updates but Behavior Does Not: Repairing Implicit Stale Dependencies in Personalized Agent Responses
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures; supplementary material in ancillary files
summary: Memory-augmented agents can know that a user's stored state is outdated and still plan around the old value. The STALE benchmark calls this the implicit policy adaptation (IPA) gap. We identify one structural contributor: draft-anchored verification checks what a response says, and in an open-ended response the stale dependency is usually unsaid. StateAuditor therefore audits in the opposite direction, from stored state to draft. An LLM proposes candidate old-to-new transitions from timestamped evidence; deterministic code pins each quotation to a single entry, checks that the new evidence really is newer, and lets only these verified transitions trigger repair. What is verified is provenance and chronology - not semantic supersession. On STALE's full protocol (400 scenarios, 50-session histories, one independent response per query), strict single-query VTA scores .736 against .686 for our locked predecessor under the same judge: a +5.0-point paired gain (95% CI [+2.9, +7.2]) coming almost entirely from IPA and premise resistance (PR). The benchmark's own judge, from a third model family, reproduces the gain (.738 vs. .680). On an independent cross-family preference-evolution benchmark (HorizonBench), the full draft-audit-repair pipeline over a gold-derived structured store raises current-preference accuracy (user-clustered p<.01), though a matched control shows most of this external gain is the draft-side audit itself; a harder authored lifecycle set gives no gain, bounding the claim while false invalidation stays controlled. On STALE, by contrast, a matched control (same evidence, adapter, and call budget) scores only .692 (+0.6 over the predecessor, n.s.), attributing the STALE gain to the transition machinery rather than added context or calls. We make no claim about general-purpose agent memory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StateAuditor，一种从存储状态到草稿的反向审计方法，通过LLM提出候选状态转换+确定性代码验证溯源和时序，来修复记忆过时的智能体规划问题。在STALE基准上达到.736 VTA分数，较基线提升+5.0点（95%CI [+2.9,+7.2]），增益主要来自转换机制本身而非额外上下文。
AI.motivation: 记忆增强智能体即使知道用户存储状态已过时，仍会围绕旧值进行规划，这被称为隐式策略适应（IPA）差距。现有草稿锚定验证只检查回复内容，但开放式回复中过时依赖通常未被提及，因此需要新的审计方向来解决此问题。
AI.method: StateAuditor采用反向审计方向：从存储状态到草稿。具体为：LLM根据带时间戳的证据提出候选的旧到新状态转换；确定性代码将每个引用固定到唯一条目，检查新证据确实时间更新，只允许经过验证的转换触发修复。验证的核心是溯源和时序，而非语义取代。
AI.result: 在STALE完整协议（400个场景、50次会话历史）上，严格单查询VTA得分.736对比锁定前身的.686，配对增益+5.0点（95%CI [+2.9,+7.2]），几乎全部来自IPA和前提抵抗（PR）。第三方模型的基准评判复现增益（.738 vs .680）。在HorizonBench上外部增益主要来自草稿侧审计本身；作者生命周期集无增益，限定了适用范围。匹配对照显示STALE增益归因于转换机制本身。
AI.conclusion: StateAuditor通过反向审计（存储状态→草稿）+确定性验证溯源与时序的方式，有效缩小了IPA差距。增益主要来自转换机制（而非额外上下文或调用），在STALE上效果显著，但在外部基准上增益有限，作者明确不声称该方法适用于通用智能体记忆。

title: Training-Free versus Training-Based Intent Classification in LLMs: Accuracy, Robustness, and Failure Modes
comment: Accepted at the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM 2026)
summary: Intent classification in Large Language Models (LLMs) involves categorizing user prompts into predefined classes. For instance, given a user prompt, the system must determine whether it primarily concerns mathematics, coding, or general text processing. Such classification enables routing prompts to specialized models optimized for specific domains, improving both accuracy and computational efficiency. In this work, we conduct a systematic study comparing training-free vs training-based approaches for intent classification. For this purpose, we consider two lightweight, training-free methods based on statistics of internal representations and compare them against MLP classifiers and linear probes. Our comprehensive empirical evaluation reveals that 1) Both training-free and training-based methods saturate easy benchmarks (mathematics vs. coding vs. natural language), 2) Training-based classifiers have an advantage on harder classification tasks (e.g. Java vs Python), and 3) Training-free methods are generally more robust to mixed-intent and adversarial prompts.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了大语言模型中意图分类的训练无关方法与基于训练的方法。研究发现：在简单基准任务上两种方法均能达到饱和；在困难分类任务（如Java vs Python）上训练方法更具优势；但在混合意图和对抗性提示下，训练无关方法更加鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 意图分类是LLM系统中的关键组件，可用于将用户提示路由到特定领域的专业模型，提升准确性和计算效率。然而，现有研究缺乏对训练无关方法与训练方法在意图分类任务上的系统比较，因此需要进行全面评估以指导实际应用中的方法选择。
AI.method: 作者采用了两种轻量级训练无关方法（基于内部表示统计）和两类训练方法（MLP分类器和线性探针）进行比较。实验涵盖简单基准任务（数学vs编码vs自然语言）和困难任务（如Java vs Python），并评估了混合意图和对抗性提示下的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：1) 训练无关和训练方法在简单基准任务上均达到饱和性能；2) 在困难分类任务上训练方法更具优势；3) 训练无关方法在混合意图和对抗性提示下表现出更好的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为LLM意图分类提供了系统性的方法对比，揭示了在不同任务难度和提示条件下两类方法各有优劣。训练无关方法适合注重鲁棒性和零成本部署的场景，而训练方法则在区分相似意图类别时更有优势。

title: A Benchmark Dataset for MLLM-Generated Image Detection: GPT Image2 & Nano Banana2
summary: The realism of images generated by multimodal large language models (MLLMs), such as GPT Image2 and Nano Banana2, has improved rapidly in recent years. Compared with early generative models, current models have made clear progress in text rendering. They can produce high-quality images that closely resemble real-world application scenarios. The enhanced generation capabilities of current MLLMs pose increasingly severe challenges to AI-generated image detection. Detection is no longer limited to identifying obvious artifacts left by early generators. Instead, it requires systematic and realistic benchmarks for the new generation of generated content. However, most existing benchmarks are still built around early generative models and cannot fully evaluate the forensic challenges introduced by high-quality and multi-form generated images. To address this gap, this paper constructs a benchmark dataset for detecting images generated by MLLMs. The benchmark covers several realistic application scenarios and adopts three generation protocols to simulate direct generation, reference-based reconstruction, and local editing. Based on this benchmark, we evaluate detector degradation from traditional scenarios to MLLM-generated images and analyze false positive rates and false negative rates across three sample types, revealing the failure modes of existing methods.
