We further propose a structural-artifact-prior-guided dual-stream prompt framework (SAP-DSP) as a strong baseline. SAP-DSP uses dual-stream prompt learning and structure-aware routing fusion to improve representation learning. Extensive experiments show that the proposed benchmark exposes the performance degradation of existing detectors on high-quality generated images, while SAP-DSP achieves more stable detection results on this benchmark. Our code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/xbrainnet/SAP-DSP.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）生成图像检测问题，构建了一个覆盖多种真实应用场景和三种生成协议（直接生成、参考重建、局部编辑）的新型基准数据集，并提出了基于结构伪影先验的双流提示框架（SAP-DSP）作为强基线，实验证明现有检测器在高质量生成图像上性能显著退化，而SAP-DSP能实现更稳定的检测效果。
AI.motivation: 当前MLLM（如GPT Image2、Nano Banana2）生成图像质量飞速提升，文本渲染能力显著增强，给AI生成图像检测带来严峻挑战。然而现有基准大多基于早期生成模型构建，无法完整评估新一代高质量、多形态生成内容带来的取证挑战，亟需系统性且贴近真实场景的基准数据集。
AI.method: 本文首先构建了一个覆盖多个真实应用场景的MLLM生成图像检测基准数据集，采用三种生成协议模拟直接生成、基于参考的重建和局部编辑。其次提出了SAP-DSP框架，该框架采用双流提示学习和结构感知路由融合机制来改善表征学习，作为该基准下的强基线方法。
AI.result: 大量实验表明：所提出的基准能够暴露现有检测器在高质量生成图像上的性能退化问题；SAP-DSP在该基准上实现了更稳定的检测结果。研究还分析了从传统场景到MLLM生成图像场景下检测器性能退化情况，并揭示了三种样本类型下的误报率和漏报率失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 本文构建的基准填补了MLLM生成图像检测评估的空白，SAP-DSP框架为该任务提供了有效的强基线。数据集和代码已公开，为后续研究提供了重要资源。

title: Salami Attack: Stealthy Collusive Memory Poisoning against OpenClaw
summary: Long-term memory enables LLM agents to retain useful information across sessions, but also creates an attack surface through which adversaries may poison an agent's persistent memory to steer its behavior. Existing memory poisoning attacks mainly rely on individually malicious records, overlooking a compositional threat: multiple benign-looking memories may jointly induce unsafe behavior. In this paper, we introduce MemCollusion, an automated red-teaming framework for constructing collusive memory poisoning attacks. MemCollusion applies salami tactics---a strategy that slices an adversarial objective into small, individually innocuous pieces---to generate memory fragments that are individually benign looking but collectively harmful. It constructs memory coalitions using four design constraints, five theory-informed strategies, and a fine-tuned generator. To assess collusive memory poisoning in a realistic cross-session setting, we develop MoltLab, a controlled research reproduction of Moltbook, in which crafted platform content must first be observed and distilled into persistent memory before influencing the agent's behavior in a separate session. We evaluate MemCollusion on OpenClaw using two backbone models across 48 scenarios. Under the strongest memory-saving setting, MemCollusion achieves an average Memory Save Rate of 81.3% and an Attack Success Rate of 75.0%, and remains effective under both benign memory dilution and memory-level defenses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MemCollusion，一个自动化红队框架，用于构造"共谋性"记忆投毒攻击——将恶意目标切分为多个看似无害的记忆片段，单独无害但组合有害，以此毒化LLM代理的长期记忆并操控其行为。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆投毒攻击主要依赖单个恶意记录，忽视了组合性威胁：多个看似良性的记忆片段可能共同诱导不安全行为。作者希望填补这一空白，探索组合式记忆投毒的漏洞。
AI.method: MemCollusion采用"萨拉米策略"（salami tactics），将对抗目标切分为小的、单独无害的片段来生成记忆片段。它通过四个设计约束、五种基于理论的策略以及一个微调生成器来构建记忆联盟。同时开发了MoltLab，一个对Moltbook的受控研究复现，用于在跨会话场景中评估攻击。
AI.result: 在OpenClaw上使用两个骨干模型、覆盖48个场景的评估中，MemCollusion在最强记忆节省设置下实现了81.3%的平均记忆保存率和75.0%的攻撃成功率，并且在良性记忆稀释和记忆级防御下仍然有效。
AI.conclusion: MemCollusion证明了组合式记忆投毒攻击的可行性与严重性，即使个体的记忆片段看起来完全良性，也能通过联合作用操纵LLM代理行为，这对现有基于单个恶意记录检测的防御机制提出了新的挑战。

title: Rethinking Video Token Compression with a Global Codebook: Learning Once, Compressing Everywhere
summary: Video large language models (Video-LLMs) represent videos as dense sequences of visual tokens, whose length grows with the temporal and spatial extent of the input. These tokens often contain substantial redundancy arising from repeated visual patterns, leading to unnecessary computation in the subsequent language-model processing. Existing token compression methods, including pruning and merging, perform compression online during inference, repeatedly incurring additional computation for each input video and often relying on model-specific designs that limit their generality, we instead rethink this paradigm by shifting the costly compression process offline. We propose \textbf{ONCE}, a plug-in video token compression framework that introduces an offline-to-online paradigm: a frequency-aware global codebook is learned once in the visual feature space and reused for lightweight online compression through codebook lookup and aggregation, reducing repeated per-video computation and the need for model-specific compression designs. Extensive experiments across multiple video understanding benchmarks and against diverse compression baselines demonstrate that our approach achieves a strong accuracy-efficiency trade-off, maintaining competitive performance while achieving the lowest inference latency among compared methods.

AI.tldr: 提出ONCE框架，通过离线学习频率感知的全局码本，实现视频令牌的高效在线压缩，在保持竞争力的同时实现最低推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 视频大语言模型将视频表示为密集的视觉令牌序列，令牌数量随视频时空范围增长且包含大量冗余，导致后续语言模型处理产生不必要的计算开销。现有方法（剪枝和合并）在推理时在线压缩，每次都产生额外计算且依赖特定模型设计，缺乏通用性。
AI.method: 提出ONCE框架，采用离线到在线的新范式：在视觉特征空间中一次性学习一个频率感知的全局码本，在线压缩时仅通过码本查找和聚合实现轻量级压缩，避免了重复的逐视频计算和对特定模型设计的依赖。
AI.result: 在多个视频理解基准测试和多种压缩基线的对比中，ONCE在准确率与效率之间取得了良好的平衡，在保持竞争性能的同时实现了对比方法中最低的推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: ONCE通过将视频令牌压缩过程从在线转移到离线，有效减少了推理时的重复计算开销，为视频令牌压缩提供了一种更通用且高效的解决方案。

title: GISAgentBench: A Practitioner-Sourced Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agents on GIS Tasks
summary: Geographic Information System (GIS) professionals rely on multi-step spatial analysis workflows to support decision-making in urban planning, disaster response, and environmental monitoring. The process is tedious, time-consuming, and error-prone. While recent large language model (LLM) agents equipped with external tools have the potential to automate geospatial analysis, their ability to perform realistic GIS workflows remains largely unexplored. Existing GIS agent benchmarking datasets are mostly drawn from textbooks, tutorials, or LLM-generated seeds and remain limited in size and trajectory depth. More importantly, none provides ground truth outputs. They therefore rely on surrogate signals such as code similarity, trajectory matching, or LLM and VLM judges, which can conflate workflow resemblance with task correctness. To address this gap, we introduce GISAgentBench, a benchmark of 349 multi-step GIS tasks curated from GIS Stack Exchange and instantiated on real public data across six selected geographic areas of interest. Each task ships with an executable reference trajectory and an exact ground truth output file, enabling strict, deterministic, tolerance-aware output matching beyond LLM judging. Evaluations of six LLM models reveal that realistic GIS workflows remain challenging: the best agent completes only 32.7% of tasks under strict tolerance-aware scoring, although most models produce outputs that are close to the ground truth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GISAgentBench，一个包含349个多步GIS任务的基准测试集，数据来源于GIS Stack Exchange并在真实公共数据上实例化。每个任务附带可执行的参考轨迹和精确的地面真值输出文件，支持严格、确定性、容错感知的输出匹配评估。对六个LLM模型的评估显示，最佳代理仅完成32.7%的任务，表明现实GIS工作流仍具挑战性。
AI.motivation: 现有GIS代理基准数据集多来自教科书、教程或LLM生成的种子，规模有限、轨迹深度不足，且缺乏地面真值输出，依赖代码相似性、轨迹匹配或LLM/VLM评判器等替代信号，这些信号可能混淆工作流相似性与任务正确性，无法真实评估GIS代理的能力。
AI.method: 从GIS Stack Exchange整理349个多步GIS任务，在六个选定的地理兴趣区域实例化于真实公共数据上；每个任务附带可执行的参考轨迹和精确的地面真值输出文件，采用严格、确定性、容错感知的输出匹配方式进行评估，超越LLM评判。
AI.result: 对六个LLM模型的评估表明，现实GIS工作流仍然具有挑战性：最佳代理在严格的容错感知评分下仅完成32.7%的任务，不过大多数模型产生的输出与地面真值较为接近。
AI.conclusion: GISAgentBench提供了首个具备精确地面真值输出的GIS代理基准，弥补了现有基准在输出验证方面的不足。评估结果表明当前LLM代理在现实GIS工作流上的表现仍有很大提升空间，为未来GIS自动化研究提供了可靠的评估基础。

title: Cultural Awareness is Represented but Not Decoded: Tracing Mythological Knowledge across 18 Open-Source LLMs
comment: 45 pages, 23 figures, 18 tables. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Aragoner/folkmotif Code: https://github.com/AragonerUA/folkmotif
summary: Open-source LLMs reliably name Zeus, Jupiter, and Thor, but recover their counterparts in less-represented traditions like Finnish, Slavic, Egyptian, or Chinese mythology far less consistently. We ask where inside the model this cultural default is produced. On a parallel cross-cultural substrate of Thompson-motif entities, we instrument 18 open-source LLMs from 8 architecture families with linear probing, logit lens, activation patching, and output extraction. The residual stream cleanly distinguishes cultures, well above a name-string baseline, yet the decoder collapses culturally-specific tokens onto dominant-tradition ones. The failure is at readout, not at representation. Asking the same question in the target culture's native language versus English produces failures that cluster within language but decouple across language: the decoder is gated on prompt language. We release a per-entity (probe, output) decomposition framework, a citation-anchored cross-cultural ground truth, a within- versus cross-mode correlation test for language-conditioned readout, and per-entity predictions for all 18 models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了开源大语言模型在跨文化神话实体（如宙斯、约伯等）命名上的"文化默认偏差"。通过18个开源LLM、8种架构家族，使用线性探测、logit透镜、激活修补和输出提取等工具，发现残差流中文化表示是清晰可分的，但解码器（readout）会将文化特定token坍缩为占主导文化的token。问题出在解码阶段而非表示阶段，且解码器受提示语言门控。
AI.motivation: 当前开源LLM在处理非主流文化（如芬兰、斯拉夫、埃及、中国等）的神话实体命名时表现不一致，存在明显的文化偏差。作者希望定位这种"文化默认值"在模型内部何处产生，从而理解模型的文化偏向机制。
AI.method: 在平行跨文化Thompson母题实体数据集上，对18个来自8个架构家族的开源LLM进行系统性分析。使用四种技术：线性探测（检查表示是否区分文化）、logit透镜（检查解码前logits）、激活修补（定位关键组件）和输出提取（检验最终输出）。并通过跨语言（目标文化母语 vs 英文）条件测试对比解码器行为。
AI.result: 发现残差流能清晰区分不同文化（远超名称字符串基线），但解码器会将文化特定token坍缩到主导文化token上。失败发生在读出阶段而非表示阶段。跨语言实验显示失败在同一语言内聚类，但跨语言时解耦——解码器受提示语言门控。
AI.conclusion: LLM的文化偏差根源在于解码器的读出阶段，而非内部表示阶段。作者发布了完整的分析框架（逐实体探针+输出分解）、引文锚定的跨文化真值基准、语言条件化读出的模式内外相关性检验，以及18个模型的逐实体预测，为未来改进跨文化生成的解码策略提供了基础。

title: Astrolabe: Spherical-Map Guidance Across Diffusion Pipelines for Full-Body Capture from Unconstrained Images
summary: Full-body capture from unconstrained photographs requires global correspondence across arbitrary views, poses, crops, and occlusions. Yet pose, geometry, and foundation features estimated in this setting are too unreliable for dense matching or appearance transfer, while diffusion rectifiers and optimization pipelines expose no common interface for consuming such uncertain correspondence. Our insight is that correspondence need not be locally accurate: its coarse viewpoint and body layout can still organize how a diffusion prior adapts and guides reconstruction. We introduce \emph{Astrolabe}, a host-portable adapter built on frozen viewpoint-guided spherical maps (SPH). A fixed bounded transform converts SPH into a spatial noise shift, which is matched during prior adaptation and reused during downstream denoising or score-distillation guidance in both pipeline categories. When a rectifier exposes a reference router, the same target/reference SPH additionally supplies coarse compatibility scores to select native appearance features; router-free optimization uses only the shared shift path. Astrolabe therefore follows one SPH--shift--adapt--guide process without dense warping or a learned control branch. Across Puzzle-IOI and 4D-Dress, it improves all reported image metrics in both hosts and all paired Puzzle-IOI geometry metrics; image gains extend to rear views, while 4D-Dress geometry remains stable overall.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Astrolabe，一种基于冻结的视角引导球面图（SPH）的宿主可移植适配器，将粗粒度的视角与身体布局对应关系转化为空间噪声偏移，从而引导扩散先验进行重建，无需密集匹配或学习的控制分支。
AI.motivation: 从无约束照片进行全身捕捉时，跨任意视角、姿态、裁剪和遮挡的全局对应关系难以获取。姿态、几何和基础特征在此设定下不可靠，无法支持密集匹配或外观迁移；而扩散修复器和优化管线之间缺乏统一接口来消费这种不确定的对应关系。现有方法依赖局部精确的对应，但实际中难以实现。
AI.method: Astrolabe的关键洞察是对应关系无需局部精确，粗粒度的视角和身体布局即可组织扩散先验的适应与重建引导。具体方法：1）构建冻结的视角引导球面图（SPH）；2）通过固定有界变换将SPH转换为空间噪声偏移；3）在先验适应阶段匹配该偏移，并在下游去噪或分数蒸馏引导中复用；4）若修复器暴露参考路由，则用目标/参考SPH提供粗粒度兼容性分数来选择原生外观特征；5）无路由的优化仅使用共享的偏移路径。整个过程遵循SPH-偏移-适应-引导的统一流程。
AI.result: 在Puzzle-IOI和4D-Dress数据集上，Astrolabe在两种宿主中均提升了所有报告的图像指标，以及所有配对的Puzzle-IOI几何指标；图像增益扩展到后视图，4D-Dress几何整体保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: Astrolabe证明粗粒度对应关系足以有效引导扩散先验进行全身重建，无需密集匹配或复杂的控制分支，在多样化宿主（扩散修复器和优化管线）中均展现出通用性和性能提升。

title: LongCat Sparse Attention: Taming the Lightning via Streaming-aware Hierarchical Cross-Layer Indexing
summary: DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) enables efficient long-context modeling through its Lightning Indexer. However, practical deployment remains constrained by the indexer's expensive $O(L^2)$ scoring overhead and the hardware-inefficient, discontinuous memory-access patterns induced by its outputs. To address these system-level bottlenecks, we introduce LongCat Sparse Attention (LSA), a hardware-algorithm co-designed framework comprising three complementary and orthogonal strategies: (1) Streaming-Aware Indexing, which selectively converts scattered KV entries into hardware-aligned contiguous layouts to enable coalesced HBM access; (2) Cross-Layer Indexing, which amortizes indexing overhead by reusing the results produced by a single layer across consecutive layers, supported by cross-layer distillation; and (3) Hierarchical Indexing, which adopts a coarse-to-fine scoring scheme to progressively narrow the candidate set for each query, thereby substantially reducing indexing computation. Extensive scaling experiments, ranging from 69B-A3B to 560B-A27B models, demonstrate that LSA consistently achieves performance on par with full attention across both general-purpose and long-context benchmarks. Moreover, LSA supports native training with context lengths of up to one million tokens and underpins the development of LongCat-2.0 (1.6T-A48B). To facilitate further research, we also introduce and open-source LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse (69B-A3B), which integrates LSA into LongCat-Flash-Lite and incorporates an updated long-context training corpus.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LongCat Sparse Attention (LSA)，一个硬件-算法协同设计的稀疏注意力框架，通过流感知索引、跨层索引和分层索引三种互补策略，解决了DeepSeek Sparse Attention中Lightning Indexer带来的O(L²)评分开销和硬件低效内存访问问题，支持高达百万token的原生训练。
AI.motivation: DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA)虽能通过Lightning Indexer实现高效长上下文建模，但其索引器存在O(L²)的高昂评分开销，且输出导致硬件低效、不连续的内存访问模式，严重制约实际部署。
AI.method: 提出三种正交互补策略：(1)流感知索引——将散乱的KV条目转换为硬件对齐的连续布局，实现合并HBM访问；(2)跨层索引——通过跨层蒸馏复用单层索引结果，分摊索引开销；(3)分层索引——采用由粗到细的评分方案逐步缩小候选集，大幅减少索引计算。
AI.result: 在69B-A3B到560B-A27B的扩展实验中，LSA在通用和长上下文基准上与全注意力性能持平；支持最长百万token的原生训练，并支撑了LongCat-2.0 (1.6T-A48B)的开发。
AI.conclusion: LSA通过硬件-算法协同设计有效解决了稀疏注意力的系统级瓶颈，在保持模型性能的同时实现了长上下文的高效训练与推理，并开源了LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse供后续研究。

title: LiveMem: Maintaining Memory State Continuity in Long-Running LLM Inference
summary: Long-running assistants and agents consume interaction streams that eventually outgrow the context. Existing context retention, summarization, and retrieval preserve access to selected history, but do not provide a persistent state over the full lifecycle when working context changes. We formulate this missing inference capability as \emph{state continuity under context turnover}: carrying computation forward through a fixed-capacity memory state whose lifetime is independent of the active context. We introduce an intrinsic memory method, \textbf{LiveMem}, which augments a pretrained full-attention LLM with a memory state that preserves the historical information over the whole lifecycle while the main attention path retains a bounded KV window. Context turnover and memory state maintaining, memory-oriented post-training, and state-aware serving jointly make this memory state load bearing after its originating tokens are released. Our experiments show that LiveMem achieves leading overall performance among evaluated systems and other intrinsic memory methods. Experiments on LongMemEval show that LiveMem is able to answer the question based on the memory state, even when the supporting evidence has been removed from the current context, and evidence-distance analysis shows that useful information persists beyond the active window. LiveMem thus establishes state continuity as a distinct and complementary abstraction for continual LLM inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LiveMem方法，通过内在记忆状态增强预训练全注意力大语言模型，在固定容量的记忆状态下保持全生命周期的状态连续性，即使原始上下文令牌被释放，记忆状态仍能承载历史信息。
AI.motivation: 现有的上下文保留、摘要和检索方法虽然能保留选定的历史信息，但无法在工作上下文变化时提供覆盖整个生命周期的持久状态。长时运行的助手和智能体消费的交互流最终会超出上下文窗口，需要一个独立于活动上下文、具有固定容量的记忆状态来实现状态连续性。
AI.method: LiveMem通过三个关键组件实现：1) 上下文轮换与记忆状态维护机制，2) 面向记忆的后训练，3) 状态感知的服务。该方法在预训练的全注意力LLM中增强一个记忆状态，主注意力路径保持有界KV窗口，而记忆状态独立于活动上下文承载全生命周期的历史信息。
AI.result: 在LongMemEval上的实验表明，LiveMem在评估系统和其他内在记忆方法中取得领先的综合性能。即使支持性证据从当前上下文中移除，LiveMem仍能基于记忆状态回答问题。证据距离分析显示有用信息能持续存在于活动窗口之外。
AI.conclusion: LiveMem确立了状态连续性作为持续LLM推理中一个独特且互补的抽象概念，为长时运行的智能体在上下文超出窗口后仍能保持完整历史信息提供了有效方案。

title: TurboClear: One-Step Object-Effect Removal via Region-Calibrated Distribution Matching and Fusion
summary: Recently, diffusion-based removal methods have achieved promising visual quality in removing both target objects and their associated effects. However, they typically rely on multi-step denoising, leading to high inference cost. Directly applying existing one-step distillation methods is also suboptimal, since their global objectives lack explicit region-wise calibration and may weaken the asymmetric edit-and-preserve behavior required by object-effect removal. To address these challenges, we propose TurboClear, a one-step SDXL-based object-effect removal model. During training, we design Region-Calibrated Distribution Matching (RDM) for region-aware distillation to preserve the teacher model's asymmetric edit-and-preserve behavior. Furthermore, we propose Learnable Spatial Fusion (LSF) for lightweight inference-time fusion. Extensive experiments show that TurboClear significantly improves inference efficiency while maintaining competitive visual quality. TurboClear reduces the computational overhead by up to $40.04\times$ compared to ObjectClear, and by up to $665\times$ against the Flux-based method OmniPaint, all while maintaining comparable or better visual removal quality. Code is available at https://github.com/GuoCalix/TurboClear.

AI.tldr: TurboClear是一个基于SDXL的单步对象效果移除模型，通过区域校准分布匹配（RDM）和可学习空间融合（LSF）实现高效推理，相比ObjectClear计算开销降低40.04倍，相比OmniPaint降低665倍，同时保持或提升视觉移除质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于扩散的移除方法虽然视觉质量好，但依赖多步去噪导致推理成本高；直接应用现有单步蒸馏方法因缺乏区域级校准，无法保留对象效果移除所需的非对称编辑-保留行为。
AI.method: 提出TurboClear，一个一步式SDXL对象效果移除模型。训练阶段设计了区域校准分布匹配（RDM）用于区域感知蒸馏，保留教师模型的非对称编辑-保留行为；推理阶段提出可学习空间融合（LSF）实现轻量级融合。
AI.result: TurboClear显著提升推理效率，相比ObjectClear计算开销降低最多40.04倍，相比基于Flux的OmniPaint降低最多665倍，同时保持或优于现有方法的视觉移除质量。
AI.conclusion: TurboClear通过区域校准蒸馏和可学习空间融合，成功实现了单步高效的对象效果移除，在推理速度和视觉质量之间取得了良好平衡。

title: Allocation Before Ranking: Decoupled Token Compression for OmniLLMs
summary: Token compression in OmniLLMs is typically posed as a single saliency-ranking problem: score each multimodal token, keep the top-K. We argue this abstraction is mis-specified. The same attention score simultaneously decides two things: how much retained capacity each modality receives, and which tokens within a modality are kept. A shared top-K rule therefore inherits this audio-favoring allocation prior, spending retained capacity on audio before video tokens have a chance to compete. We propose Macer, a training-free compressor that first assigns explicit audio and video budgets, then performs allocation-normalized ranking within each modality at modality-specific shallow layers. Macer significantly reduces token cost while preserving accuracy across audio-grounded, audio--video joint, visual-dominant, and video-centric benchmarks. At 25 % retention, Macer preserves 98.7 % of full-token performance on Qwen2.5-Omni-7B and 97.3 % on Qwen2.5-Omni-3B. On Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, this 25 % setting reaches OmniZip-level performance at 45 % retention while using lower FLOPs. On OmniVinci-9B, the same allocation-before-ranking principle improves over shared top-K ranking by up to 12.9 points.

AI.tldr: 提出Macer，一种无需训练的OmniLLM令牌压缩方法，通过先分配音视频预算再进行模态内归一化排序，解决共享top-K规则导致的音频偏向分配问题，在更低保真度下保持甚至提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有OmniLLM令牌压缩被简单化为单一显著性排序问题（对每个多模态令牌打分并保留top-K），但注意力分数同时决定了两个维度：各模态获得的保留容量以及模态内保留哪些令牌。共享top-K规则继承了音频偏好的分配先验，导致视频令牌在竞争之前容量已被音频消耗。
AI.method: 提出Macer，一种训练免费的压缩器。核心分为两步：（1）先为音频和视频分配显式的预算；（2）在模态特定的浅层进行分配归一化的模态内排序。通过"先分配再排序"的原则打破共享top-K的模态间耦合。
AI.result: 在25%保留率下，Qwen2.5-Omni-7B保持全令牌性能的98.7%，Qwen2.5-Omni-3B保持97.3%。在Qwen2.5-Omni-7B上25%设置达到OmniZip在45%保留率的性能水平且FLOPs更低。在OmniVinci-9B上较共享top-K排序最高提升12.9个点。
AI.conclusion: 将多模态令牌压缩从"单一全局排序"重构为"预算分配+模态内归一化排序"两阶段问题，能更有效地利用保留容量，在音频接地、音视频联合、视觉主导和视频中心等多样化基准上均显著降低令牌成本并保持精度。

title: UDT: Reconciling U-Nets and Diffusion Transformers with Data-Adaptive Token Reduction
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have emerged as a core architecture in generative modeling due to their scalability and adaptability to multimodal tasks. DiTs comprise isotropic transformer blocks, and learn representations progressively across depth, where the denoising objective drives later layers to focus on fine-detail reconstruction. This results in degraded representation quality and an imbalanced encoder-decoder behavior. Prior approaches such as representation alignment (REPA) mitigate this by encouraging stronger early representations via training regularization. Alternatively, U-Net-style DiT architectures introduce explicit multi-scale encoder-decoder structures for improved convergence. But they build on standard U-Net wisdom via learnable operators for spatial downsampling, which are not well-suited to transformer architectures, introducing inefficiencies and compatibility issues with components such as cross-attention and representation regularization. In this work, we propose UDT, a U-Net diffusion transformer that combines the representation power of DiTs with the encoding-decoding benefits of U-Nets, through data-adaptive token merging for downsampling and upsampling, while preserving the DiT token dimension. Our baseline UDT architecture outperforms existing U-Net DiTs and achieves performance comparable to REPA across all model sizes. Furthermore, using architectural optimization and REPA, UDT outperforms SiT's 7.9 FID at 1400 epochs (w/o CFG) within 40 epochs (~ 40x faster convergence) for XL model size on 256x256 ImageNet. Finally, it achieves strong image generation performance with CFG, reaching FID of 1.38 (320 epochs) with SD-VAE and 1.35 (500 epochs) with VA-VAE, providing a new backbone for DiTs with strong empirical benefits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UDT，一种将U-Net的编码-解码优势与DiT表示能力相结合的新型扩散Transformer架构。通过数据自适应token合并实现上下采样，UDT在40个epoch内即可达到SiT在1400个epoch的表现（FID 7.9），并将收敛速度提升约40倍，同时保持与REPA相当的性能。
AI.motivation: DiTs虽然具有可扩展性和多模态适应性，但其各向同性Transformer块的深层结构导致表示质量退化，存在编码器-解码器行为不平衡的问题。现有解决方案（如REPA的正则化方法或U-Net风格DiT架构）各有局限：REPA仅通过训练正则化缓解问题，而U-Net风格的DiT使用可学习的空间下采样算子，与Transformer架构不兼容，影响交叉注意力和表示正则化的效率。
AI.method: 提出UDT架构，核心创新在于：(1) 将U-Net的编码-解码结构与DiT的表示能力相结合；(2) 使用数据自适应token合并（data-adaptive token merging）实现下采样和上采样，而非传统的可学习空间算子；(3) 保持DiT的token维度不变，确保与交叉注意力和表示正则化等组件的兼容性；(4) 结合架构优化和REPA正则化进一步提升性能。
AI.result: (1) 基线UDT架构优于现有U-Net DiT，性能与REPA相当；(2) 结合架构优化和REPA后，UDT在ImageNet 256x256上以XL模型大小仅40个epoch即超过SiT在1400个epoch的7.9 FID（无CFG），收敛速度提升约40倍；(3) 启用CFG后，SD-VAE下320个epoch达到FID 1.38，VA-VAE下500个epoch达到FID 1.35。
AI.conclusion: UDT为扩散Transformer提供了一种新的骨干架构，通过数据自适应的token合并有效融合了U-Net的编解码优势与DiT的表示能力，在显著加速收敛的同时保持甚至超越现有方法的生成质量，证明了该架构设计思路的有效性。

title: TCPO: Turn-Level Credit Policy Optimization
summary: Verifier-guided reinforcement learning has become a powerful paradigm for improving LLM reasoning. In multi-turn settings, models receive a verifier score after each turn and iteratively refine their outputs. Although such scores provide dense feedback, they do not directly provide dense credit: a score measures the quality of the current output, while credit should measure how the current turn changes the refinement trajectory. We propose TCPO, a turn-level credit assignment method for verifier-guided multi-turn RL. TCPO casts credit assignment as score-to-credit conversion and constructs turn-level advantages through reference-based comparisons: retrospective credit captures immediate progress and regression relative to the best prior state; hindsight delayed credit identifies non-improving turns with later payoff; and selective fixed-history counterfactual estimation refines high-surprisal turns under the same history. Experiments on math reasoning, code generation, and AppWorld agent tasks show that TCPO improves or matches the strongest baselines across model scales, task domains, and verifier types. TCPO achieves the best or tied-best best-turn Pass@8 on Qwen3-4B and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B, reduces turns to success, and improves multi-turn agent performance. These results highlight score-to-credit conversion as a central ingredient for verifier-guided multi-turn policy optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TCPO，一种用于验证器引导的多轮强化学习中回合级信用分配方法。TCPO通过参考比较将验证器得分转化为回合级优势信号，包含回溯信用、延迟信用和选择性反事实估计三种机制，在数学推理、代码生成和智能体任务上优于或匹敌最强基线。
AI.motivation: 在多轮强化学习场景中，验证器在每个回合后提供稠密反馈（分数），但这些分数衡量的是当前输出的质量，而非当前回合对整体优化轨迹的贡献，即缺乏稠密的信用分配信号。现有方法未能有效区分"输出有多好"与"这一回合带来的改进有多大"这两个概念。
AI.method: TCPO将信用分配建模为得分到信用的转换问题，通过三种参考比较机制构建回合级优势函数：1) 回溯信用——捕捉相对于最佳历史状态的即时进展和回退；2) 延迟信用——识别后期才产生回报的非改进回合；3) 选择性固定历史反事实估计——在相同历史条件下细化高惊讶度回合的信用估计。
AI.result: 在数学推理、代码生成和AppWorld智能体任务上，TCPO在不同模型规模、任务域和验证器类型下均达到最优或持平最优基线的表现。在Qwen3-4B和DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B上取得最佳或并列最佳的best-turn Pass@8，减少了达到成功的回合数，并提升多轮智能体性能。
AI.conclusion: 得分到信用的转换是验证器引导多轮策略优化的核心要素，TCPO通过显式区分输出质量评估与回合贡献评估，填补了多轮RL中信用分配的关键空白。

title: Romanized Arabic Across Dialects: Views, Usage Patterns, and Linguistic Variation
summary: Arabizi refers to Arabic written in Latin script. Although previous studies have shown that the prevalence and usage of Arabizi vary by factors such as region and age group, most NLP research on Arabic texts treats it as a temporary phenomenon resulting from limited technological support for the Arabic script. In this work, we engage with Arabic speakers to collect insights on their perceptions and usage of Arabizi. We further examine writing norms among speakers of different dialects, focusing on Algerian, Egyptian, Lebanese, Moroccan, and Tunisian Arabic. To this end, we release two resources. First, a character-level alignment of Arabic words to study inter- and intra-dialectal variation across these five dialects, based on words transliterated by survey participants, finding systematic intra-dialectal regularity and inter-dialectal variation. Second, to study Arabic speakers' ability to identify this stylistic variation at the sentence-level, we build a manually curated parallel corpus of sentences written in Arabic script alongside multiple Arabizi transliterations, collected from speakers of the same five dialects. Our study presents the largest human-centered, cross-dialectal study of Arabizi's perceptions and practices to date.

AI.tldr: 本文对阿拉伯语拉丁化书写（Arabizi）进行了大规模跨方言的人本研究，通过调查五大方言（阿尔及利亚、埃及、黎巴嫩、摩洛哥、突尼斯）的阿拉伯语使用者，收集其感知与使用习惯，并发布了两个资源：字符级对齐数据集用于研究方言内外的书写变体，以及人工构建的平行语料库用于研究句子层面的风格变体识别能力。
AI.motivation: 以往NLP研究多将Arabizi视为因阿拉伯文字技术支持不足而产生的临时现象，忽视了其使用受地域和年龄等社会因素影响的复杂性，缺乏对人视角的理解和跨方言的系统研究。
AI.method: 通过阿拉伯语使用者的调查收集感知与使用见解，构建字符级阿拉伯语单词对齐来研究五种方言的方言内与方言间变体，并构建包含阿拉伯文字句子及多种Arabizi转写的人工平行语料库，以研究句子层面的风格变体识别。
AI.result: 发现了系统性方言内的书写规律性和方言间的书写变体，并发布了两个资源：字符级对齐数据集和人工策展的平行语料库。这是迄今为止最大规模的人本、跨方言Arabizi感知与实践研究。
AI.conclusion: Arabizi是一种具有系统性方言特征的持续书写实践，而非临时现象；该研究提供了迄今为止最全面的人本视角和跨方言资源，为NLP领域对Arabizi的处理提供了新的实证基础。

title: Ranking Image Fusion the Way Humans Do: A Learned Pairwise Preference Metric for Infrared-Visible Fusion Assessment
summary: Infrared-visible image fusion (IVIF) has no ideal fused reference, so fusion algorithms are routinely ranked by scalar objective metrics that formalize different proxies for information transfer, structure, or source similarity. These proxies often disagree with the judgment that ultimately matters: given the same sources, which of two fused results does a human prefer? Direct pairwise comparison is an established reference protocol for relative subjective assessment, but its cost grows quadratically with the number of algorithms, which prevents routine use. We present the Learned Perceptual Image Fusion Measure (LPIFM), a source-conditioned model that operationalizes the human A/B/Tie comparison protocol as a repeatable, scalable surrogate. LPIFM jointly observes the infrared source, the visible source, and two fused candidates, and predicts whether candidate A is better, candidate B is better, or the two are perceptually equivalent. Supervision comes from a new dense preference corpus that covers every unordered comparison among a broad pool of fusion methods on the scenes of a public benchmark, labeled under a blinded, randomized, two-stage protocol with expert adjudication. Across scene- and method-generalization settings, LPIFM tracks human pairwise decisions closely and reproduces the tie-aware Bradley-Terry rankings derived from human labels; on full method pools it surpasses the strongest conventional metric by a wide margin in both pairwise accuracy and ranking correlation. We release the annotated preference dataset, together with the LPIFM model weights, source code, and evaluation code, to support preference-aligned IVIF assessment. LPIFM offers a practical instrument for human-aligned method comparison and ranking at scale.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了LPIFM（学习感知图像融合度量），一种以源图像为条件的模型，用于替代红外-可见光图像融合（IVIF）中昂贵的人工成对比较评估。LPIFM同时观察红外源、可见光源和两个融合候选结果，预测人类偏好（A更好/B更好/二者等价），并在新构建的密集偏好语料库上训练，能够以可扩展的方式复现人类成对决策和Bradley-Terry排名，显著超越传统标量指标。
AI.motivation: IVIF融合算法缺乏理想参照，通常依赖标量客观指标进行排名，但这些指标与人类主观偏好常常不一致。直接的人工成对比较评估虽然可靠，但其成本随算法数量呈二次方增长，无法常规使用。因此需要一种可重复、可扩展的模型来替代人工评估。
AI.method: 提出源条件模型LPIFM，联合观察红外源、可见光源和两个融合候选，预测三分类结果（A更好/B更好/等价）。构建了密集的人工偏好语料库，覆盖公开基准场景下多种融合方法的所有无序比较对，采用盲法、随机化、两阶段标注协议并经过专家裁定。在场景泛化和方法泛化两种设置下评估模型性能。
AI.result: LPIFM在场景和方法泛化设置下均能紧密追踪人工成对决策，复现基于人类标注的容错Bradley-Terry排名。在完整方法池上，LPIFM在成对准确率和排名相关性方面均大幅超越最强的传统标量指标。
AI.conclusion: LPIFM为IVIF评估提供了一种与人类偏好对齐的实用工具，支持大规模的方法比较与排名。论文还公开了标注偏好数据集、模型权重、源代码和评估代码，以促进偏好对齐的IVIF评估研究。

title: When Memory Becomes Authority: Benchmarking Authority Collapse at the Memory Consolidation Boundary
summary:
Persistent memory allows (self-evolving) LLM agents to adapt across tasks by consolidating heterogeneous interaction histories into reusable facts, preferences, observations, and rules. Yet consolidation also imposes an implicit authorization boundary: it determines whether stored information may later be consumed as a user fact, an attested observation, or a standing instruction. We identify authority collapse, in which consolidation preserves a claim while erasing the source constraints governing its authorized use, causing the stored memory to imply greater authority than its source permits. We introduce AuthMem-Bench, a controlled paired benchmark that holds the focal claim and downstream task fixed while varying only source authority. It evaluates write-time collapse, downstream authorization errors, and automatic authority preservation. Across seven consolidators based on widely used agent-memory systems and seven LLM backbones, we observe authority collapse in 48 of 49 evaluated configurations. In a controlled action-grounded evaluation, collapsed memories without authority metadata yield a mean unauthorized-action rate of 50.3%. In an end-to-end evaluation, automatically predicted and persisted authority labels reduce the observed unauthorized-action rate from 16.9% to 0.0%, while benign task success remains essentially unchanged. These findings show that memory-driven adaptation must preserve not only what was
  learned, but also the authority under which it may be reused.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"权威崩塌"（authority collapse）问题：持久化记忆系统在整合交互历史时，保留信息内容却丢失其来源权限约束，导致记忆被以超出原始授权的范围使用。作者构建了AuthMem-Bench基准测试，在49种配置中发现48种存在权威崩塌，并验证了自动保留权威标签可将未授权操作率从16.9%降至0.0%。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型智能体越来越多地依赖持久化记忆进行跨任务自适应，记忆整合过程隐式地决定了存储信息的授权边界。然而，现有整合机制在保留信息内容时往往会丢失来源的权限约束，导致存储记忆比其来源拥有更高的权威性，这可能引发未授权的智能体行为。
AI.method: 作者提出AuthMem-Bench基准，通过受控配对实验固定焦点声明和下游任务不变，仅变化来源权威性，分别评估写入时崩塌、下游授权错误和自动权威保留。实验覆盖7种基于主流智能体记忆系统的整合器和7种LLM骨干模型，并包含受控动作落地评估和端到端评估。
AI.result: 在49种配置中有48种观察到权威崩塌；受控评估中缺乏权威元数据的崩塌记忆产生平均50.3%的未授权操作率；端到端评估中自动预测并持久化的权威标签将未授权操作率从16.9%降至0.0%，同时良性任务成功率基本不变。
AI.conclusion: 记忆驱动的自适应不仅需要保留"学到了什么"，还必须保留"在何种权威下可以复用"。权威信息应与记忆内容一同被保存，以确保智能体行为不超出来源授权范围。

title: AURORA-LM: Autoencoding Unified Representation for Continuous-Latent Diffusion Language Modeling
summary:
Language remains an outlier in generative modeling: while images, video, and audio are increasingly modeled in continuous latent spaces, text generation still relies predominantly on discrete tokens. Existing continuous language models either inherit embedding spaces not designed for joint generation and decoding, or compress autoencoded latents to ease diffusion, sacrificing token-level fidelity. Instead of simplifying the representation to suit the generative model, we preserve a high-capacity, decodable text latent and design the diffusion model to learn its distribution directly.
  We introduce AURORA-LM, a continuous-latent diffusion language model that separates the construction of a decodable text representation from the modeling of its distribution. A Query-based Encoder-Decoder organizes text into a high-capacity, prefix-aligned latent sequence, and a Block-causal Diffusion Transformer learns its distribution through flow matching, generating blocks left to right while denoising positions within each block in parallel. Because such a latent is harder for diffusion to model, AURORA-LM restricts only the noisy-input pathway while retaining the full clean-latent prediction target, accommodating full-width latents without reducing decoder-facing capacity. We further calibrate the noise-level distribution to the latent width, and introduce self-trajectory consistency to bridge independently sampled training noise and iterative denoising at inference.
  AURORA-LM achieves the strongest performance among evaluated continuous and diffusion-based language models on OpenWebText free generation and XSum summarization. Scaling to 1B parameters with about 1500 EFLOPs of total compute yields further gains, surpassing a larger publicly released latent-diffusion language model under a matched evaluation protocol. All experiments are conducted on Ascend NPUs.

AI.tldr: AURORA-LM是一个连续潜空间扩散语言模型，通过分离可解码文本表示的构建与其分布建模，在OpenWebText和XSum上达到最强的连续/扩散语言模型性能。
AI.motivation: 语言建模仍然是生成建模中的异类——图像、视频、音频已越来越多地在连续潜空间中建模，但文本生成仍主要依赖离散token。现有连续语言模型要么继承非为联合生成与解码设计的嵌入空间，要么压缩自编码潜变量以简化扩散过程，牺牲了token级别的保真度。作者主张不应简化表示来适配生成模型，而应保留高容量可解码的文本潜变量，并让扩散模型直接学习其分布。
AI.method: AURORA-LM提出了两个关键组件：(1) Query-based Encoder-Decoder将文本组织为高容量、前缀对齐的潜变量序列；(2) Block-causal Diffusion Transformer通过流匹配学习该分布，从左到右逐块生成，同时并行去噪块内位置。为应对更难建模的潜变量，模型只限制噪声输入通路，保留完整干净潜变量预测目标，不降低解码器容量；还根据潜变量宽度校准噪声水平分布，并引入自轨迹一致性来桥接独立采样的训练噪声与推理时的迭代去噪。
AI.result: AURORA-LM在OpenWebText自由生成和XSum摘要任务上达到了所有评估的连续/扩散语言模型中最强性能。扩展到1B参数、约1500 EFLOPs总计算量后，在匹配的评估协议下超越了更大的公开潜扩散语言模型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，与其简化文本表示来适应生成模型，不如保留高容量可解码的文本潜变量，并设计扩散模型直接学习其分布，这是连续语言模型的有效路径。

title: GABench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agents on Graph Analysis Tasks
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly capable of planning, using tools, and interacting with external environments. They are typically supported by harnesses, which manage state and coordinate multi-step execution. Graph analysis provides a promising setting for evaluating their agentic capabilities, because it requires agents to access data and execute operations in a graph environment. However, existing graph benchmarks for LLMs provide limited coverage of graph tasks and graph types, making it difficult to comprehensively evaluate LLM agents. Moreover, they typically formulate graph analysis as text-based question answering, where graph information is directly provided in the prompt, limiting the evaluation of end-to-end agentic capabilities. To address these limitations, we introduce GABench, a comprehensive benchmark for agentic graph analysis. GABench spans three graph types and covers four graph analysis task categories: graph retrieval, graph theory, graph machine learning, and graph open-ended question answering. GABench also provides 84 executable tools for accessing graph data and performing diverse graph operations. Building on these tools, we develop an agentic graph analysis task generation pipeline and construct 10,400 tasks with verifiable ground truth.Using GABench, we evaluate a range of frontier LLMs and agent harnesses. Our experiments reveal three key findings: (1) Existing LLM agents still struggle with complex graph analysis tasks. (2) Harness choice significantly affects performance, yet existing harnesses remain limited on complex graph tasks. (3) Graph analysis depends more on tool-call quality than quantity. Our findings provide practical insights into the development and evaluation of LLM agents for graph analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GABench，一个全面的智能体图分析基准测试平台，涵盖三种图类型、四类图分析任务和84个可执行工具，构建了10,400个具有可验证真值的任务，用于评估LLM智能体在图分析场景中的端到端能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM图分析基准存在两个关键局限：图任务和图类型的覆盖有限，难以全面评估LLM智能体；同时它们通常将图分析建模为基于文本的问答，图信息直接嵌入提示中，限制了端到端智能体能力的评估。
AI.method: GABench设计了三个方面的创新：(1) 覆盖三种图类型和四类图分析任务（图检索、图理论、图机器学习、图开放式问答）；(2) 提供84个可执行工具用于访问图数据和执行多样化图操作；(3) 开发了智能体图分析任务生成流水线，构建10,400个具有可验证真值的任务。
AI.result: 实验发现三项关键结果：(1) 现有LLM智能体在复杂图分析任务上仍表现不佳；(2) 智能体框架（harness）的选择显著影响性能，但现有框架在复杂图任务上仍存在局限；(3) 图分析性能更依赖工具调用质量而非调用数量。
AI.conclusion: GABench为LLM智能体的图分析能力提供了全面的评估框架，实验发现为开发更强大的LLM智能体及优化智能体框架提供了实践指导，强调了工具调用质量在复杂图分析任务中的关键作用。

title: SPAE: Spectrally Guided Autoencoder for Pretrained Visual Latents
summary: Latents from vision foundation models (VFMs) are semantically rich and well suited for visual understanding. Recent representation autoencoder methods such as RAE have shown that they can provide promising latent spaces for image generation. However, VFM latents remain difficult to model directly: DiT-generated latents exhibit spectral mismatch with encoder latents, especially in high-frequency components. Our channel-wise spectral analysis further reveals that these high-frequency components are diffusely distributed across latent channels and entangled with semantic information, making the latent space difficult for DiT to model. To address these challenges, we propose SPAE, latent adaptation framework for generation. Specifically, SPAE employs a compact bottleneck to distill stable semantic information while suppressing high-frequency components, thereby improving the alignment between DiT-generated latents and encoder latents. In addition, we apply a channel-wise masking strategy to promote the decoupling of semantic information and high-frequency details across bottleneck channels. Experiments show that SPAE achieves a favorable balance among visual understanding, generation quality, and reconstruction fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出SPAE框架，通过紧凑瓶颈和通道级掩码策略适配VFM潜在空间用于图像生成，解决DiT生成潜变量与编码器潜变量之间的谱失配问题。
AI.motivation: 视觉基础模型（VFM）的潜在特征语义丰富，适合视觉理解，但直接用于生成建模时存在困难：DiT生成的潜变量与编码器潜变量存在谱失配（尤其在高频分量），且高频分量在潜变量通道中弥散分布并与语义信息纠缠，导致潜在空间难以被DiT直接建模。
AI.method: 提出SPAE（latent adaptation framework），包含两个核心设计：(1) 紧凑瓶颈（compact bottleneck）用于蒸馏稳定的语义信息同时抑制高频分量，改善DiT生成潜变量与编码器潜变量的对齐；(2) 通道级掩码策略（channel-wise masking）促进瓶颈通道中语义信息与高频细节的解耦。
AI.result: 实验表明SPAE在视觉理解、生成质量和重建保真度之间取得了良好的平衡。
AI.conclusion: SPAE通过潜在空间适配有效地解决了VFM潜在空间用于生成时的高频谱失配与语义纠缠问题，实现了理解与生成的统一性能权衡。

title: Beyond Single-Use Tokens: Durable Authorization State for Replay-Resistant LLM Agent Actions
summary: Tool-using large language model agents frequently replan, retry failed operations, delegate tasks, and resume after crashes. These behaviors can cause one user authorization to be requested and executed multiple times under freshly issued token identifiers, even when each individual token is single-use. We call this failure semantic replay: exceeding the execution budget of a token-independent authorization instance rather than merely reusing an old token identifier. We show that identifier-local token consumption cannot prevent fresh reissuance unless the issuer retains monotonic durable state over the authorized action, confirmation event, and remaining execution budget. We introduce CapLease, an authorization-consumption layer that follows proposal- and authority-level defenses, binds an authenticated user confirmation to a canonical action, and enforces transactional Issue-Prepare-Commit transitions. Across LLM-agent replanning, retry, delegation, concurrency, confirmation-replay, and crash-recovery scenarios, identifier-local tokens permit fresh semantic reissuance, whereas CapLease and an equally stateful Server Ledger prevent duplicate admission and, with an idempotent sink, duplicate external effects. Our results identify durable authorization state, rather than token representation alone, as the systems requirement for replay-resistant agent execution.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有单次使用令牌（single-use token）机制无法防止LLM智能体在执行过程中的语义重放（semantic replay）问题——即同一用户授权因智能体重规划、重试、委派或崩溃恢复而被多次执行。作者提出CapLease，一种基于授权消耗层的方案，通过将用户确认绑定到规范化动作，并采用事务性的Issue-Prepare-Commit状态转换，实现对抗重复授权执行的防护。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体会频繁地重新规划、重试失败操作、委派任务或从崩溃中恢复，这些行为会导致一个用户授权被多次请求和执行。即使每个令牌都是单次使用的，由于每次都用新的令牌标识符重新发起，现有的令牌本地化消费机制无法阻止这种"语义重放"——即超出授权实例执行预算的重复执行，而非简单的旧令牌复用。
AI.method: 提出了CapLease授权消耗层，包含三个关键设计：(1) 遵循提案级和权威级防御；(2) 将经过身份验证的用户确认绑定到规范化动作（canonical action）；(3) 强制执行事务性的Issue-Prepare-Commit三阶段状态转换，确保授权状态具备单调持久性。
AI.result: 在LLM智能体的重规划、重试、委派、并发、确认重放和崩溃恢复等场景中，标识符本地化的令牌允许新的语义重发，而CapLease和同样具有状态性的Server Ledger能够阻止重复准入；配合幂等接收端（idempotent sink），还能防止重复的外部副作用。
AI.conclusion: 持久化的授权状态（durable authorization state）而非仅令牌表示形式本身，才是实现抗重放智能体执行的系统级需求。仅依赖令牌标识的消耗机制不足以解决语义重放问题，必须引入单调持久的授权状态管理。

title: Remember-R1: Mitigating Long-Context Visual Forgetting through Reinforcement Learning
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly rely on long chain-of-thought reasoning for complex tasks. However, as reasoning sequences lengthen, models may gradually rely less on visual evidence and more on accumulated textual context, leading to visual forgetting. Existing approaches do not directly constrain how visual evidence is used and maintained along the original reasoning trajectory, leaving long-context visual forgetting insufficiently addressed. To address this issue, we propose Remember-R1, a reinforcement learning framework that mitigates long-context visual forgetting by applying process-level supervision directly on the original reasoning trajectory. Specifically, Remember-R1 introduces rewards that encourage broader coverage of matched visual keywords, stronger persistence of visual dependence in later reasoning steps, and greater focus on question-relevant image regions. Experiments across multiple model scales and diverse multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that Remember-R1 consistently improves reasoning performance. Additional analyses further show that it slows the decline of visual attention during generation, supporting its effectiveness in mitigating long-context visual forgetting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Remember-R1，一种基于强化学习的框架，通过在原始推理轨迹上施加过程级监督来缓解多模态大语言模型在长链推理中的视觉遗忘问题，并引入三类奖励以增强视觉证据的覆盖率和持续性。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在长链推理中随着推理序列变长，会逐渐减少对视觉证据的依赖而更多依赖已累积的文本上下文，导致视觉遗忘。现有方法未能在原始推理轨迹上直接约束视觉证据的使用与维持，因此长上下文视觉遗忘问题未得到充分解决。
AI.method: 提出Remember-R1强化学习框架，在原始推理轨迹上施加过程级监督，引入三种奖励：鼓励更广覆盖匹配的视觉关键词、增强后续推理步骤中视觉依赖的持续性、以及更大程度聚焦与问题相关的图像区域。
AI.result: 在多种模型规模和多个多模态基准上的实验表明，Remember-R1一致性地提升了推理性能。进一步分析显示该方法减缓了生成过程中视觉注意力的下降，验证了其在缓解长上下文视觉遗忘方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Remember-R1通过过程级奖励直接约束推理过程中视觉证据的使用，有效缓解了多模态模型长链推理中的视觉遗忘问题，并显著提升了推理表现。

title: Constructing Executable Analytical Knowledge Representations for Meta-Analysis Synthesis Using an Agentic Harness
summary: Meta-analysis synthesis highlights a fundamental challenge in knowledge-based scientific analysis: structured evidence does not by itself represent the analytical knowledge required for executable computation. Decisions about evidence assignment, analytical contrasts, outcome and time-point alignment, effect-size formulation, and methodological admissibility must be explicit before statistical execution. Existing automated approaches often embed these decisions in model outputs, generated code, or workflow traces rather than representing them as independently verifiable knowledge. We introduce the Executable Analytical Knowledge Representation (EAKR), a machine-actionable representation of the knowledge required to transform structured evidence into executable meta-analysis. An EAKR represents evidence, relations, numerical inputs, constraints, provenance, and unresolved issues. We operationalise EAKR in MetaSynDec, an agentic harness in which large language models propose structured updates and deterministic services govern schema- and contract-based validation and execution. Across 58 synthesis units, MetaSynDec constructed all EAKRs, with 57 proceeding to statistical execution. Of 56 units with sufficient information to define a reference analysis object, 38 (67.9%) achieved complete object fidelity and 42 (75.0%) exact evidence-set agreement, with a mean Jaccard similarity of 0.909. Generated and published confidence intervals overlapped in 54 of 55 units (98.2%). MetaSynDec outperformed direct LLM generation in reference synthesis-structure agreement (57/58 versus 23/58; p<0.001) and among 23 jointly completed units, exact reference-formulation agreement (23/23 versus 1/23; p<0.001). These findings provide feasibility evidence that EAKR supports formal validation, traceability, statistical execution, and improved methodological agreement relative to direct LLM generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可执行分析知识表示（EAKR），一种将结构化证据转化为可执行元分析所需的机器可操作知识表示，并构建MetaSynDec智能代理框架进行实现。在58个合成单元中，57个成功执行统计，67.9%实现完整对象保真度，98.2%的置信区间重叠，显著优于直接LLM生成。
AI.motivation: 知识驱动的科学分析面临根本性挑战：结构化证据本身并不包含可执行计算所需的分析知识。证据分配、分析对比、结果与时间点对齐、效应量公式和方法学可接受性等决策必须在统计执行前明确。现有自动化方法常将这些决策嵌入模型输出、生成代码或工作流痕迹中，而非将其表示为独立可验证的知识。
AI.method: 提出可执行分析知识表示（EAKR），一种机器可操作的知识表示，涵盖证据、关系、数值输入、约束、来源和未解决问题。通过MetaSynDec智能代理框架实现，其中大型语言模型提出结构化更新，确定性服务负责基于模式和契约的验证与执行。
AI.result: 在58个合成单元中，MetaSynDec构建了所有EAKR，57个进入统计执行。56个具有足够信息的单元中，38个（67.9%）实现完整对象保真度，42个（75.0%）实现精确证据集一致，平均Jaccard相似度为0.909。55个单元中54个（98.2%）生成与已发表置信区间重叠。相比直接LLM生成，在参考合成结构一致性（57/58 vs 23/58）和精确参考公式一致性（23/23 vs 1/23）方面显著更优（p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了可行性证据，表明EAKR支持形式化验证、可追溯性、统计执行以及相比直接LLM生成更高的方法一致性，为知识驱动的科学分析提供了新的表示范式。

title: SphereVideo: Prototype-anchored Hyperspherical Boundary for Continual AI-generated Video Detection
summary: AI-generated video (AIGV) detection aims to distinguish real videos from AI-generated ones. In practice, detectors trained on existing data often fail to generalize to newly emerging generative models, making this task challenging. Therefore, continual learning (CL) is essential for improving the adaptability. However, CL frameworks for this task remain underexplored. To this end, we propose SphereVideo, a novel CL framework for AIGV detection built on two key observations. First, real videos exhibit a compact feature distribution. Based on this, we encourage real video features to cluster around a real prototype on a hypersphere while repelling AI-generated samples, thereby establishing a decision boundary. This prototype serves as a stable anchor for CL, regulating boundary evolution and mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Second, existing methods tend to rely solely on spatial artifacts as shortcuts. To enhance temporal modeling, we introduce a strategy that models the temporal dynamics of real data at both frame and clip levels. By strengthening real data modeling, this strategy further facilitates learning a real prototype and forming a stable decision boundary. Moreover, we construct a comprehensive and challenging benchmark. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SphereVideo achieves an improved plasticity-stability trade-off, outperforming prior methods by 3.08% on seen data and 4.00% on unseen AI-generated data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SphereVideo，一个面向AI生成视频检测的持续学习框架。该框架基于两个关键观察：真实视频具有紧凑的特征分布（通过原型聚类建立决策边界并对抗灾难性遗忘），以及现有方法过度依赖空间伪影（引入帧级和片段级的时间建模策略）。在构建的综合基准上，SphereVideo在已见数据和未见AI生成数据上分别超越先前方法3.08%和4.00%，实现了更好的可塑性-稳定性权衡。
AI.motivation: AI生成视频检测面临严峻挑战：基于现有数据训练的检测器难以泛化到新出现的生成模型，而持续学习（CL）对提升适应性至关重要，但该领域的持续学习框架研究尚不充分。
AI.method: SphereVideo框架包含两个核心部分：(1) 在超球面上鼓励真实视频特征围绕"真实原型"聚类，同时排斥AI生成样本，建立决策边界；该原型作为持续学习的稳定锚点，调控边界演化并缓解灾难性遗忘。(2) 引入帧级和片段级的时间动态建模策略，增强对真实数据时序特征的建模，避免仅依赖空间伪影的短视策略，进一步促进真实原型的学习和稳定决策边界的形成。
AI.result: 在作者构建的综合且具有挑战性的基准上，SphereVideo在已见数据上超越先前方法3.08%，在未见AI生成数据上超越4.00%，展现出更优的可塑性-稳定性权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过原型锚定与多粒度时间建模相结合，SphereVideo有效解决了AIGV检测中的持续学习难题，在保持已有知识的同时实现了对新生成模型的良好适应，为AIGV检测的持续学习方向提供了新的思路和基准。

title: LaCache: Robust Semantic Caching for LLM Serving
summary: Semantic caching, which reuses responses to semantically similar requests via their embeddings, has seen growing adoption in LLM serving, offering faster responses and reduced costs. Yet existing schemes are fundamentally vulnerable to cache-collision attacks, wherein an adversary pollutes the cache by injecting crafted queries, corrupting responses to subsequent legitimate requests. We present LaCache, a novel semantic caching scheme that addresses this vulnerability through a conceptually simple yet principled redesign. The key insight is that while the adversary has full control over the adversarial query, it has far less control over its response, which must simultaneously satisfy multiple semantic constraints. Rather than checking only the cache hit of a query, LaCache additionally checks the cache hit of its first k (speculatively) decoded tokens. This design yields two concrete benefits. First, it provides formally guaranteed resilience against cache-collision attacks: we prove that it is impossible to craft adversarial queries that simultaneously elicit malicious responses and collide with benign queries. Second, the enriched index supplies additional semantic context for cache retrieval, improving response relevance. Empirical evaluation across diverse LLMs and benchmarks validates both LaCache's security guarantees and efficiency gains, pointing to a promising direction for robust semantic caching.

AI.tldr: LaCache是一种新型语义缓存方案，通过在查询语义相似性检查的基础上，额外检查前k个推测解码token的缓存命中情况，从而在理论上保证对缓存碰撞攻击的抵抗力，同时提升缓存检索的语义相关性和响应效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的语义缓存方案虽然在LLM服务中得到了广泛应用，可以有效加快响应速度和降低成本，但它们从根本上容易受到缓存碰撞攻击——攻击者通过注入精心构造的查询污染缓存，从而破坏后续合法请求的响应。这一安全漏洞尚未被现有方案有效解决。
AI.method: LaCache的核心洞察是：攻击者虽然能完全控制其构造的对抗性查询，但对响应的控制力较弱，因为响应必须同时满足多个语义约束。因此，LaCache不仅检查查询的缓存命中，还额外检查其前k个（推测性解码的）token的缓存命中。这种双重检查机制在形式上证明了无法构造既能引发恶意响应又能与良性查询发生碰撞的对抗查询。
AI.result: 在多种不同LLM和基准测试上的实验验证表明，LaCache既能够确保其安全保证（对缓存碰撞攻击的抗性），又能带来效率提升（通过更丰富的索引提供额外的语义上下文，改善了缓存检索的相关性）。
AI.conclusion: LaCache通过概念上简单但原理上严谨的重设计，为鲁棒的语义缓存指明了一个有前景的方向，在安全性和效率之间取得了良好平衡。

title: Asleep at the Wheel: JEPA's Limitations in Evaluating Novel Driving Data
summary: Modern autonomous-driving fleets record far more video than human reviewers can inspect. This motivates the need for an automatic clip triage mechanism, to surface rare and review-worthy clips, so that driving models can be fine-tuned to better handle unideal circumstances. We test a label-free approach that scores clips by the prediction-error "novelty" of a self-supervised joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA); a frozen V-JEPA video encoder is paired with a lightweight predictor head to reconstruct masked clip embeddings, and clips whose embeddings are hard to predict are flagged as interesting. Evaluated under a realistic protocol that trains on one dataset and tests against footage from others, this approach appears highly effective. We show that this apparent success is actually a domain-shift consequence: on a fair benchmark drawn from a single dataset, this mechanism collapses to chance and is on par with simple no-training baselines. A lightly supervised probe on the same frozen embeddings results in almost double the average precision, indicating that the bottleneck is indeed the self-supervised objective, rather than the representation. We present this as a study for evaluating the effectiveness of self-supervised learning, where cross-dataset protocols can silently reward domain separation over novelty.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自动驾驶视频自动分诊（clip triage）问题，发现基于自监督JEPA架构的"新颖性"评分方法在跨数据集协议下看似有效，但实际上只是领域偏移的产物——在单数据集公平基准上该方法与随机猜测无异，而轻量监督探针则性能大幅提升，揭示了跨数据集评估可能误将领域分离当作新颖性的陷阱。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶车队录制的视频远超人工审查能力，需要自动化的片段分诊机制来筛选罕见且值得审查的片段，以便对驾驶模型进行微调以应对不理想的路况。作者希望验证无标签的自监督方法在真实场景下是否真正有效地识别"有趣"片段。
AI.method: 采用无标签方法，使用冻结的V-JEPA视频编码器和轻量预测头对掩码片段嵌入进行重建，将预测误差高的片段标记为"有趣"。评估协议包括跨数据集训练-测试（对某数据集训练，对其他数据测试），以及与单数据集公平基准的对比，并引入轻量监督探针进行对照实验。
AI.result: 在跨数据集协议下该方法看似高度有效，但在单数据集的公平基准上，该机制性能与随机猜测无异，与简单无训练基线相当。而基于相同冻结嵌入的轻量监督探针平均精度几乎翻倍，说明瓶颈在于自监督目标本身而非表示质量。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了自监督学习评估中的一个关键陷阱：跨数据集协议可能静默地奖励领域分离而非真正的新颖性。研究为评估自监督学习有效性提供了重要参考，提示在设计评估协议时需警惕领域偏移对结果的虚假放大。

title: DAPD: Dual-Anchored Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy (self) distillation (OPSD) is increasingly adopted for language-model post-training. It strengthens the teacher with privileged information but can induce a privilege illusion: the student learns privilege-dependent behavior it cannot reproduce from its inference-time context, yet behaves as if the training-time privileged information remained available, ultimately degrading performance. In this paper, we identify information asymmetry between the privileged teacher and the student at inference as the root cause of this failure in OPSD. To resolve this asymmetry, we propose Dual-Anchored Policy Distillation (DAPD), a unified framework with two levels of anchoring. Dual-Path Anchoring (DPA) introduces a self-conditioned bridge and aligns reference and rollout behavior along two matched-information paths, preventing privilege-dependent behavior from being transferred to the inference-time student. Dual-Source Anchoring (DSA) applies these paths in both reference-to-rollout and rollout-to-reference directions, reducing reliance on privileged reference guidance while preserving correctness supervision. Extensive experiments show that DAPD significantly alleviates privilege illusion, outperforming OPSD on Qwen3-4B by +2.00 points on average across tasks. Notably, its gains persist across scales, reaching +2.69 at 4B and +2.78 at 32B.

AI.tldr: 本文针对在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）中的"特权幻觉"问题，提出双锚定策略蒸馏框架（DAPD），通过双路径锚定和双源锚定消除教师与学生之间的信息不对称，在多个模型规模上显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: OPSD在语言模型后训练中被广泛应用，但存在特权幻觉问题：学生学习了依赖训练时特权信息的行為，而这些信息在推理时不可用，导致性能下降。根本原因在于特权教师与推理时学生之间存在信息不对称。
AI.method: 提出DAPD统一框架，包含两个层面的锚定：(1) 双路径锚定（DPA）引入自条件桥接，沿两条信息匹配的路径对齐参考与rollout行为，防止特权依赖行为传递；(2) 双源锚定（DSA）在参考到rollout和rollout到参考两个方向上应用这些路径，减少对特权参考指导的依赖同时保留正确性监督。
AI.result: DAPD显著缓解了特权幻觉问题，在Qwen3-4B上平均超越OPSD +2.00分；增益在不同规模上保持，4B规模达+2.69，32B规模达+2.78。
AI.conclusion: DAPD通过消除信息不对称有效解决OPSD中的特权幻觉问题，且具有跨模型规模的泛化能力，为语言模型后训练中的自蒸馏提供了更可靠的方案。

title: CoEvo-Mem: Co-Evolving Retrieval Policy and Memory Bank for LLM Agents
summary: As memories accumulate across tasks and sessions, the performance of long-term LLM agents depends jointly on query-specific retrieval and continual memory refinement. However, existing methods typically optimize either memory access, through iterative query refinement or adaptive retrieval policies, or memory evolution such as structural update. This separation overlooks a fundamental feedback loop: retrieval determines which memories receive usage signals, while updated memory bank reshape future retrieval. We propose \textbf{CoEvo-Mem}, a closed-loop framework for co-evolving the retrieval policy and memory bank. For each query, a frozen LLM generates route-specific query rewrites and a routing prior, which a lightweight residual router corrects online. The retrieved context serves as the coupling interface between the two learning processes: task outcomes assign credit to routing decisions, while trajectory-conditioned feedback updates memory values and graph relations. These updates alter how memories are ranked and selected for subsequent queries, thereby closing the feedback loop. To mitigate coupling induced non-stationarity, CoEvo-Mem alternates between updating the router with the memory bank fixed and evolving the memory bank with the retrieval policy fixed. Across seven diverse benchmarks, \textbf{CoEvo-Mem} achieves state-of-the-art performance, demonstrating the importance of retrieval-memory coevolution.

AI.tldr: CoEvo-Mem提出了一种闭环框架，通过交替优化检索策略和记忆库来实现长期LLM代理的检索-记忆共同进化，在七个基准上达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常将检索优化和记忆进化分开处理，忽视了它们之间的根本反馈循环：检索决定哪些记忆获得使用信号，而更新后的记忆库又会重塑未来的检索结果。这种分离限制了长期LLM代理的性能上限。
AI.method: CoEvo-Mem采用闭环框架：冻结的LLM为每个查询生成路由特定的查询重写和路由先验，由轻量级残差路由器在线校正；检索到的上下文作为耦合接口，任务结果将信用分配给路由决策，轨迹条件反馈更新记忆值和图关系。通过交替更新路由器（记忆库固定）和进化记忆库（检索策略固定）来缓解耦合引起的非平稳性。
AI.result: 在七个多样化的基准上，CoEvo-Mem取得了最先进的性能，验证了检索-记忆共同进化的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 检索策略与记忆库的协同进化对长期LLM代理至关重要，CoEvo-Mem通过闭环设计和交替优化策略有效解决了这一耦合优化问题。

title: DeVIT: Low-Power Vision Transformer Acceleration Using Delta Computation
summary: The emergence of transformer-based deep learning models has brought unprecedented performance across various domains, particularly in natural language processing and computer vision. However, deploying these models, especially on resource-constrained devices, poses significant challenges due to their high computational complexity and large memory size and bandwidth requirements. This complexity has led researchers to use low-bit model weights to reduce memory usage and improve efficiency. In addition to reducing processing and memory demands, quantization introduces another useful property: value locality, where the extremely large number of parameters are restricted to a limited range of values. To fully take advantage of this locality, this paper presents DeVIT, an acceleration method for vision transformers that leverages differential computation to enable multiplier-less matrix multiplication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeVIT，一种利用差分计算实现无乘法器矩阵乘法的视觉Transformer加速方法，通过低比特权重量化产生的值局部性来提升资源受限设备上的部署效率。
AI.motivation: Transformer模型在NLP和CV领域表现出色，但其高计算复杂度和巨大的内存/带宽需求使其难以部署在资源受限设备上。低比特量化虽能减少内存占用，但仍需进一步利用量化带来的值局部性来加速计算。
AI.method: DeVIT通过利用量化后权重参数的值局部性（参数被限制在有限值范围内），采用差分计算方式实现无乘法器的矩阵乘法，从而加速视觉Transformer的推理过程。
AI.result: 论文展示了DeVIT方法能够利用量化引入的值局部性特性，通过消除乘法运算来提升视觉Transformer的计算效率。
AI.conclusion: DeVIT为视觉Transformer在资源受限设备上的高效部署提供了一种新颖的加速方案，通过差分计算和无乘法器设计解决传统计算瓶颈，兼顾了精度保持与效率提升。

title: MemSIF: From Structured Interactions to Dual-Track Fact Memory for LLM Agents
comment: Submitted to AAAI 2027. 19 pages, 10 figures, 18 tables
summary: Long-term memory is critical for LLM agents operating over long-horizon interactions. However, several persistent limitations of existing memory systems can be traced to two recurring misalignment patterns in long-term interaction settings: Temporal-Structural Misalignment (TSM) and Delayed Utility Manifestation (DUM). TSM arises when temporal proximity does not reliably align with topical or event-level relatedness, whereas DUM arises when write-time salience does not reliably predict future query utility. To mitigate these misalignment patterns, we propose MemSIF (Memory with Structured Interactions and Facts), a structured interaction-to-fact memory framework. Structured Interaction Memory organizes raw interactions into Topical Segments that preserve local topical coherence and Event Trajectories that maintain cross-time event continuity. Dual-Track Fact Memory uses two complementary tracks: CoreFact memory consolidates stable, schema-guided information at write time, whereas ActiveFact memory forms facts on demand and promotes those supported by multiple historical sources and recurring query demand for reuse. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S across five backbone LLMs show that MemSIF achieves the highest Total ACC in all settings, outperforming the strongest baseline by 2.29%-8.79% on LoCoMo and 2.87%-6.15% on LongMemEval-S. These results support the effectiveness of combining Structured Interaction Memory with Dual-Track Fact Memory to mitigate TSM and DUM. Code is available at https://github.com/luoyufeihaha/MemSIF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MemSIF框架，通过结构化交互记忆和双轨事实记忆来缓解长期交互场景中LLM智能体记忆系统的两类错配问题（时间-结构错配TSM和延迟效用显现DUM），在多个基准和五个骨干LLM上均取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体的长期记忆系统存在两个根本性错配问题：一是TSM——时间邻近性与主题/事件关联性不一致；二是DUM——写入时的显著性与未来查询效用不一致。这两个问题导致记忆系统在长期交互场景中效果不佳。
AI.method: 提出MemSIF框架，包含两部分：1）结构化交互记忆——将原始交互组织为主题片段（Topical Segments）以保持局部主题连贯性，以及事件轨迹（Event Trajectories）以维持跨时间的事件连续性；2）双轨事实记忆——CoreFact记忆在写入时整合稳定的、模式引导的事实，而ActiveFact记忆按需形成事实，并对被多个历史来源支持且反复被查询需求引用的事实进行提升以便复用。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S两个基准上、跨越五个骨干LLM的实验中，MemSIF在所有设置下均取得最高的Total ACC：在LoCoMo上比最强基线高出2.29%-8.79%，在LongMemEval-S上高出2.87%-6.15%。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果支持将结构化交互记忆与双轨事实记忆相结合能够有效缓解TSM和DUM两类错配问题，从而提升LLM智能体在长期交互记忆任务上的表现。

title: RL-Lock: Reinforcement Learning for Generating Interlocking Assemblies
summary: An interlocking assembly is an assembly in which component parts are connected purely through their geometric arrangement, without relying on external connectors such as glue and nails. Such assemblies have been widely used in a variety of real-world applications due to their structural stability. The problem of generating interlocking assemblies is generally formulated as a shape decomposition problem, where a target 3D object represented as a voxel grid is partitioned into a prescribed number of interlocking pieces. We observe that generating interlocking assemblies is inherently a sequential decision-making problem, where an agent repeatedly decides which piece each voxel should be assigned to. Inspired by the observation, we propose the first reinforcement learning framework RL-Lock for generating interlocking assemblies, without relying on handcrafted search heuristics as existing works did. RL-Lock combines structured action chunking with MCTS-guided policy-value learning to efficiently navigate the large combinatorial search space for interlocking assembly generation. We demonstrate through experiments that RL-Lock allows effective generation of interlocking assemblies, especially for challenging cases in which existing approaches take too long or even fail to find a valid solution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RL-Lock，首个基于强化学习的互锁装配体生成框架，将体素网格分解问题建模为序列决策问题，结合结构化动作分块与MCTS引导的策略-价值学习，在复杂场景下有效生成互锁装配体。
AI.motivation: 互锁装配体的生成本质上是序列决策问题（逐个决定体素所属的部件），但现有方法依赖手工设计的搜索启发式，在面对复杂案例时耗时长甚至无法找到有效解，亟需更高效的学习驱动方法。
AI.method: 提出RL-Lock框架：将生成互锁装配体建模为强化学习问题，通过结构化动作分块（structured action chunking）减少搜索空间，结合MCTS引导的策略-价值学习（policy-value learning）来高效探索大规模组合搜索空间。
AI.result: 实验表明RL-Lock能够有效生成互锁装配体，尤其在现有方法耗时长或无法找到有效解的挑战性案例中表现出显著优势。
AI.conclusion: RL-Lock验证了强化学习在互锁装配体生成任务中的可行性，无需手工启发式即可应对复杂场景，为该问题提供了新的解决范式。

title: PixVL: Self-Supervised Training of Pixel-Level MLLMs via a Unified Mask--Text Consistency Cycle
summary: Recent studies develop pixel-level multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that support both Region Segmentation and Region Understanding, extending multimodal interaction from whole images to specific objects and regions. However, these methods face two fundamental challenges. First, the scarcity of high-quality mask--text pairs leaves abundant mask annotations without corresponding language supervision. Second, discrepancies in supervision formats and learning-signal densities induce optimization interference between Region Segmentation and Region Understanding. To address these challenges, we propose PixVL, a self-supervised post-training framework that introduces a unified Mask--Text Consistency Cycle, enabling pixel-level MLLMs to generate and self-verify regional descriptions and learn from unlabeled data. We found that direct cycle based solely on geometric reconstruction is unreliable because re-segmentation IoU does not faithfully reflect the semantic quality and referring sufficiency. PixVL therefore introduces confuser-aware semantic verification, which uses the model's confidence when it correctly chooses the target among highly similar candidate regions, and assigns zero reward to an incorrect choice. Meanwhile, PixVL performs cross-view verification using temporally separated video frames or geometrically transformed image views, preventing cyclic learning from collapsing to positional and shape shortcuts. Finally, a quality-coupled bidirectional learning strategy uses the highest-reward description to guide Text-to-Mask learning. This strategy transforms Region Understanding and Region Segmentation from competing tasks into mutual generators and verifiers. Experiments demonstrate that PixVL improves both region understanding task and segmentation task.

AI.tldr: PixVL提出了一种自监督后训练框架，通过"Mask-Text一致性循环"让像素级多模态大语言模型从无标注数据中自生成并自我验证区域描述，同时采用混淆感知语义验证和跨视角验证来确保学习质量，最终实现区域理解和区域分割的相互促进。
AI.motivation: 现有像素级多模态大语言模型面临两大挑战：一是高质量mask-text配对数据稀缺，大量mask标注缺乏对应的语言监督；二是区域分割与区域理解在监督格式和学习信号密度上存在差异，导致优化干扰。
AI.method: PixVL包括三个核心组件：(1) Mask-Text一致性循环，让模型生成区域描述并进行自我验证；(2) 混淆感知语义验证，利用模型在高度相似候选区域中正确选择目标时的置信度作为奖励信号，选错则奖励为零；(3) 跨视角验证（利用时间分离的视频帧或几何变换的图像视图）防止循环学习退化为位置和形状捷径；(4) 质量耦合的双向学习策略，用最高奖励的描述引导Text-to-Mask学习。
AI.result: 实验表明PixVL在区域理解任务和区域分割任务上均取得性能提升，验证了该框架将两项任务从竞争关系转化为相互生成与验证关系的有效性。
AI.conclusion: PixVL通过自监督循环学习和语义验证机制，成功缓解了标注数据稀缺和任务间优化干扰的问题，展示了区域理解与区域分割可以互为监督信号、协同提升的潜力。

title: CORTIVA: Candidate-Score Fusion of Complementary Visual Teachers for EEG- and MEG-to-Image Retrieval
comment: 31 pages, 19 figures; includes supplementary information. Code: https://github.com/Fuyunhan/CORTIVA
summary: Decoding visual experience from non-invasive brain activity is central to neuroscience and brain-computer interfaces. Functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) offers fine spatial detail, but its slow hemodynamics and burdensome acquisition limit temporally resolved decoding. Electroencephalography (EEG) and magnetoencephalography (MEG) provide millisecond resolution, making image retrieval compelling: identify the viewed image from one neural response and a fixed candidate bank. Contrastive alignment to pretrained visual representations enables zero-shot retrieval from EEG and MEG, but most systems collapse heterogeneous visual supervision into a single embedding before ranking. This early consolidation imposes one similarity geometry on every candidate order and removes encoder-specific disagreements from the final ranking. We propose CORTIVA, a candidate-score fusion framework that preserves this complementary evidence. Three decoding routes are aligned to heterogeneous visual targets, score the same indexed candidates independently, and combine only their temperature-scaled score vectors before ranking. On the 200-way THINGS-EEG2 benchmark, CORTIVA reaches 73.5% Top-1 and 95.3% Top-5 across ten participants, exceeding the strongest reported baseline by 10.3 and 5.4 percentage points. With a modality-specific neural encoder, the same fusion principle reaches 42.4% Top-1 on THINGS-MEG. Matched route-removal retraining and four weight controls demonstrate that CORTIVA's gain arises from integrating complementary route scores and persists with uniform weighting, without requiring a specialized weighting rule. Independent DINOv2 analyses further reproduce the local error neighborhoods and posterior neural-visual correspondence. These results establish candidate-score fusion as a simple and testable alternative to embedding-level consolidation for neural image retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CORTIVA，一种候选分数融合框架，用于基于脑电/脑磁图进行神经图像检索。不同于传统方法将多种视觉监督信号在嵌入层面合并，CORTIVA通过三条解码路径分别对候选图像打分，仅在排序前融合温度缩放的分数向量。在THINGS-EEG2基准上达到73.5% Top-1和95.3% Top-5，超出最强基线10.3和5.4个百分点；在THINGS-MEG上达到42.4% Top-1。
AI.motivation: 现有基于EEG/MEG的图像检索系统通常将异构视觉监督信息在嵌入层面合并为单一表示，这会导致不同编码器的互补性信息在最终排序中丢失，限制了检索性能。作者希望保留多种解码路径的互补证据，以提升神经图像检索的准确性。
AI.method: CORTIVA框架包含三条解码路径，分别与异构视觉目标（如不同预训练视觉表示）进行对比对齐。每条路径独立地对候选图像评分，然后通过温度缩放将分数归一化，最后将分数向量融合后进行最终排序。该框架避免了在嵌入层面提前合并多种监督信号，保留了编码器间的分歧信息。
AI.result: 在THINGS-EEG2基准（200分类、10名被试）上达到73.5% Top-1和95.3% Top-5，超过最强基线10.3和5.4个百分点。使用模态特定神经编码器时，在THINGS-MEG上达到42.4% Top-1。路径移除重训练和四个权重控制实验证明性能提升来源于互补分数整合，且均匀权重同样有效。
AI.conclusion: 候选分数融合是一种简单且可验证的替代方案，优于嵌入层面的合并策略。该方法不需要专门的加权规则即可获得性能提升，独立分析进一步验证了错误局部邻域与神经-视觉对应关系的一致性。

title: Leveraging AI for fine-grained food safety risk forecasting in sparse data conditions
summary: Ensuring food safety represents a critical public health challenge, particularly when inspection resources are limited and regional sampling data are sparse. This study proposes a Transformer-based framework capable of forecasting fine-grained, city-level food safety risks by unifying over 11 million inspection records with supplemental demographic, economic, and environmental indicators extracted from the Statistical Yearbook. A three-stage pretraining design leverages partial supervision from the Wilson interval (capturing both safety and risk rankings), together with semi-supervised label refinement, to effectively utilize historical records even when local sample sizes are insufficient. Experimental evaluations on data from 2022 show that the proposed approach outperforms baselines significantly. A subsequent field experiment in collaboration with the Zhejiang Provincial Administration for Market Regulation further demonstrates improved detection rates and more efficient allocation of inspection resources compared to a manually developed plan. Observations of regulatory decision-making reveal a threshold-based heuristic employed by inspectors, hinting that additional training or decision-support interfaces could further enhance the impact of AI-generated risk scores. Overall, these findings underscore that a rigorous integration of large-scale public inspection data, Wilson interval-based confidence modeling, and advanced deep learning can facilitate earlier and more granular identification of food safety threats. By reducing reliance on reactive measures alone, the proposed framework has the potential to advance proactive, data-driven oversight of the global food supply.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于Transformer的细粒度城市级食品安全风险预测框架，融合超过1100万条检查记录与人口、经济、环境等多源数据，通过三阶段预训练（Wilson区间部分监督+半监督标签精炼）应对小样本问题，实验及浙江省实地部署均验证了其显著优于基线方法的效果。
AI.motivation: 食品安全是重大公共卫生挑战，但检查资源有限且区域采样数据稀疏，现有方法难以在数据不足的情况下实现精细化的城市级风险预测，亟需一种能充分利用历史检查记录和大规模公开数据的智能预测框架。
AI.method: 构建Transformer框架，统一融合超1100万条检查记录及统计年鉴中的多维度补充指标；采用三阶段预训练设计：利用Wilson区间提供部分监督（同时捕获安全性与风险排名），并引入半监督标签精炼机制，以在本地样本量不足时有效利用历史数据。
AI.result: 在2022年数据上的实验评估显示该方法显著优于基线；与浙江省市场监督管理局合作开展的实地实验表明，该方法相比人工制定的检查计划能提升检出率并实现更有效的检查资源配置。
AI.conclusion: 将大规模公开检查数据、基于Wilson区间的置信度建模与先进深度学习相结合，能够实现更早期、更细粒度的食品安全风险识别，减少对被动应对措施的依赖，推动全球食品供应链的主动式数据驱动监管。此外，监管决策观察揭示检验人员使用阈值启发式方法，提示可进一步通过培训或决策支持界面增强AI风险评分的实际影响力。

title: Harnessing Adversarial Distillation to Customise Debiased, Disease-Specific Pathology Foundation Models for Breast Cancer
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted to MICCAI 2026 (early accept)
summary: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) provide strong tissue representations and have become central to digital pathology. However, deployment in disease-specific settings is limited by 1) the high computational cost of billion-parameter PFMs and 2) distribution mismatch and non-biological bias inherited from pan-cancer, multi-centre pre-training, including site-specific signatures and imbalanced disease prevalence. These factors can encourage shortcut learning and under-emphasise subtle morphology required for reliable modelling of a specific cancer type. We present SmartStu (a Smart Student), a framework to customise compact, breast-cancer-specific PFMs via distillation whilst mitigating confounding. SmartStu distils representations from multiple teacher PFMs into a lightweight student backbone. Crucially, we introduce adversarial distillation that leverages a dedicated noise model trained to predict nuisance, edge-dominated cues on the distillation set. Using this noise model as a counterexample, the adversarial objective encourages the student to recognise, yet suppress, features predictive of nuisance targets. We further incorporate multi-teacher ensemble distillation and an auxiliary self-supervised objective with artefact injection. We validate SmartStu on three external cohorts (Yale HER2, SLN-Breast, and BRACS) with multiple tiny backbones. SmartStu yields breast-cancer-specific PFMs that are over $30\times$ smaller than general PFMs whilst largely preserving, and sometimes improving, downstream performance measured by balanced accuracy (bAcc) and AUC. Code is available at https://github.com/zwchen03/advDistall.

AI.tldr: SmartStu是一个通过对抗性蒸馏框架，将多个通用病理基础模型（PFM）的知识压缩到轻量级学生模型中，从而定制乳腺癌特异性PFM的方法。该方法在保持性能的同时将模型体积缩小30倍以上，并在三个外部队列上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 通用病理基础模型虽然强大，但在疾病特定场景部署时面临两大挑战：1）十亿级参数带来高昂计算成本；2）来自泛癌种、多中心预训练的分布偏移和非生物学偏差（如站点特异性信号、疾病流行度不平衡）会导致捷径学习和忽略疾病相关细微形态特征，不利于特定癌症类型的可靠建模。
AI.method: SmartStu框架包括三个关键组件：1）多教师集成蒸馏：从多个教师PFM中蒸馏表征到轻量级学生骨干网络；2）对抗性蒸馏：训练一个噪声模型预测干扰性边缘主导线索，以此作为反例，通过对抗目标鼓励学生识别但抑制与干扰目标相关的特征；3）辅助自监督目标：结合伪影注入增强学生的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在三个外部队列（Yale HER2、SLN-Breast和BRACS）上使用多种微型骨干网络验证，SmartStu生成的乳腺癌特异性PFM比通用PFM小30倍以上，同时基本保持甚至有时提升了下游性能（以平衡准确率bAcc和AUC衡量）。
AI.conclusion: SmartStu展示了通过对抗性蒸馏可以有效地将通用PFM压缩为疾病特异性、轻量级模型，在显著降低计算成本的同时减轻非生物学混杂因素的影响，为PFM在特定癌症类型的实际临床应用提供了可行路径。

title: FRAMES: Guarded and Dual-Objective Skill Evolution for Agents in Policy-Governed Enterprise Workflows
summary: LLM agents increasingly run policy-bound enterprise workflows such as document auditing, where they must apply rules consistently, ground every value, and stay auditable. Improving these agents is hard: operational feedback is sparse and unlabeled, edits to one rule can regress unrelated cases, and accuracy must improve without inflating inference cost or losing auditability. We present FRAMES, a closed-loop framework that cold-starts deployable skills from existing assets and then evolves them through consensus-based mutation, Pareto selection over accuracy and cost, and an anti-regression guarantee, all while preserving auditability. Deployed on our internal production system, FRAMES attains the best accuracy-cost trade-off among baselines, with the same gains reproduced on tau-bench.

AI.tldr: FRAMES是一个闭环框架，从现有资产冷启动可部署技能，通过共识驱动的变异、帕累托选择和防回退保证来演进技能，在保持可审计性的同时提升准确率-成本权衡。
AI.motivation: LLM代理在企业工作流（如文档审计）中需要一致应用规则、可审计，但操作反馈稀疏且无标注，编辑一条规则可能使其他无关案例回退，且不能牺牲推理成本或可审计性来提升准确率。
AI.method: FRAMES框架包含四个核心组件：1）从现有资产冷启动部署技能；2）基于共识的变异（consensus-based mutation）；3）在准确率和成本上进行帕累托选择（Pareto selection）；4）防回退保证（anti-regression guarantee），同时全程保持可审计性。
AI.result: 在内部生产系统上部署后，FRAMES在所有基线中取得了最优的准确率-成本权衡，并在tau-bench基准上复现了相同的效果提升。
AI.conclusion: FRAMES能够在不增加推理成本、不损失可审计性的前提下，持续改进策略约束下的LLM代理，且在内部生产环境和公开基准上均验证有效。

title: Understanding Synergistic Interactions among Pathology Foundation Models via Adaptive Fusion
summary: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) provide strong tile-level representations via self-supervised pre-training on large-scale pathology images. Yet, PFMs are developed under diverse and often opaque data, architecture, and objective choices, inducing latent representational biases that limit robustness and obscure what each model specialises in. We present AdaFusion, a lightweight adaptive fusion framework that integrates complementary signals from multiple frozen PFMs through (1) low-dimensional feature compression and (2) a sample-conditioned gating module that reweights model-wise (and optionally channel-wise) contributions. Beyond improving predictive accuracy, AdaFusion provides contribution-driven interpretation that offers evidence consistent with model-specific preferences and synergistic interactions across tissue phenotypes. We evaluate AdaFusion on three public benchmarks spanning treatment response prediction, prostate cancer grading, and spatial gene expression inference. AdaFusion consistently outperforms individual PFMs and other fusion baselines, while providing interpretable tissue visualisation which aligns model preferences with morphological patterns. Code is available at: https://github.com/xyx-98/PathoOracle.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaFusion，一个轻量级自适应融合框架，通过低维特征压缩和样本条件门控模块整合多个冻结病理基础模型（PFMs）的互补信号，在提升预测准确性的同时提供基于贡献度的可解释性分析。
AI.motivation: 病理基础模型（PFMs）通过自监督预训练提供强大的切片级表示，但由于数据、架构和目标函数的多样性且不透明，PFMs存在潜在的表征偏差，限制了鲁棒性并模糊了各模型的专长领域。
AI.method: AdaFusion采用两个核心组件：(1) 低维特征压缩，降低多PFM特征维度；(2) 样本条件门控模块，对模型维度（可选通道维度）的贡献进行动态重加权，从而自适应融合多个冻结PFM的互补信号。
AI.result: 在治疗反应预测、前列腺癌分级和空间基因表达推断三个公开基准上，AdaFusion一致优于单个PFM和其他融合基线，并提供与形态学模式对齐的模型偏好可解释组织可视化。
AI.conclusion: AdaFusion不仅提升了预测精度，还提供了贡献驱动的解释，揭示了模型特定偏好和跨组织表型的协同交互，为病理基础模型的集成提供了一种轻量且可解释的方案。

title: REFLEX: Rethinking MoE Inference as Refinement-Aware Compute Allocation in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models increase parameter capacity by activating only a small subset of experts for each token. This conditional-computation paradigm has enabled autoregressive language models to scale model capacity without a proportional increase in per-token computation. In diffusion language models (DLMs), however, each denoising forward jointly revisits all token positions despite their sharply different refinement demands, while the default fixed token-choice routing assigns them a uniform expert budget, creating a mismatch between expert computation and refinement demand. We argue that MoE inference in DLMs should therefore be viewed as refinement-aware compute allocation across heterogeneous token refinement states. We propose REFLEX (\textbf{RE}finement-aware \textbf{FLEX}ible expert allocation), a training-free method that keeps the default router unchanged while reorganizing expert computation around the evolving refinement process. Specifically, REFLEX introduces a coarse-to-fine hierarchy for expert-budget allocation that aligns computation with block-relative refinement roles while using the Frontier-Progress Score to resolve active-block priorities. Across multiple widely used benchmarks on two representative MoE-based DLMs, LLaDA-MoE and LLaDA2.0-mini, REFLEX reduces allocated expert computation by 15\% on average while preserving or even improving generation quality on most benchmarks relative to default routing. Compared with autoregressive-style variable-expert routing methods, REFLEX also yields a more consistent quality--computation trade-off, further supporting the importance of allocating expert computation according to the heterogeneous refinement demands exposed within each denoising forward.

AI.tldr: 本文提出REFLEX，一种无需训练的方法，通过细化感知的专家预算分配机制，在扩散语言模型的MoE推理中按各token位置的实际细化需求动态分配专家计算资源，在减少15%计算量的同时保持甚至提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）中，每个去噪前向步骤会统一访问所有token位置，尽管它们的细化需求差异很大；而MoE默认的固定token选择路由仅为所有token分配统一的专家预算，造成了专家计算与细化需求之间的不匹配。因此，DLM中的MoE推理应被视为跨异构token细化状态的计算分配问题。
AI.method: REFLEX采用粗到细的层次化专家预算分配机制：首先根据块内相对细化角色对齐计算分配，然后使用Frontier-Progress Score解决活跃块的优先级问题。该方法保持默认路由不变，仅重新组织专家计算分配，无需训练。
AI.result: 在LLaDA-MoE和LLaDA2.0-mini两个代表性MoE-based DLM上，REFLEX平均减少15%的专家计算分配，且在大多数基准上保持甚至提升了生成质量。与自回归式可变专家路由方法相比，REFLEX在质量-计算权衡上表现更一致。
AI.conclusion: REFLEX验证了在扩散语言模型中按细化需求分配专家计算的有效性，表明根据每个去噪前向中暴露的异构细化需求来分配专家计算比自回归风格的可变路由方法更重要。

title: FineMoLA: Towards Fine-Grained Motion-Language Alignment from Clip-Level Supervision
summary: Text-conditioned human motion generation has made rapid progress with the emergence of large-scale motion--language datasets. However, even datasets with rich long-form descriptions typically provide supervision only at the clip level, without explicit temporal correspondence between motion frames and language. This limits fine-grained motion--text grounding and temporally precise generation. We propose FineMoLA, a weakly supervised framework that learns fine-grained frame--phrase correspondence directly from clip-level annotations. Our method first segments long-form descriptions into action-bearing phrases, and then formulates motion--language alignment as an optimal transport problem, which naturally models many-to-many relations between motion frames and text under global constraints. With entropic regularization and Sinkhorn iterations, FineMoLA efficiently infers pseudo frame-level alignments without human labeling. Experiments on SnapMoGen demonstrate that the learned alignments outperform baselines in motion--text grounding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FineMoLA，一种弱监督框架，通过最优传输问题从片段级标注中学习帧级动作-文本对应关系，实现细粒度的运动-文本对齐和时序精确生成。
AI.motivation: 现有大规模运动-语言数据集通常只在片段级别提供标注，缺乏动作帧与语言之间的显式时序对应关系，这限制了细粒度运动-文本定位和时序精确生成的能力。
AI.method: FineMoLA首先将长描述切分为携带动作信息的短语，然后将运动-文本对齐建模为最优传输问题，以自然建模帧与文本之间的多对多关系。通过熵正则化和Sinkhorn迭代，在无需人工标注的情况下高效推断伪帧级对齐。
AI.result: 在SnapMoGen数据集上的实验表明，FineMoLA学习到的对齐在运动-文本定位任务上优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: FineMoLA证明了仅利用片段级弱监督即可实现细粒度的帧-短语对应学习，为运动-文本时序精确生成提供了一种高效的解决方案。

title: Can You Trust the Confidence? ConfBench for Vision-Language Models on Document Extraction
summary: Intelligent document processing (IDP) with vision-language models (VLMs) hinges on confidence scores trustworthy enough to route extractions between automation and human review.
