AI.result: 在三个多跳QA基准上，HALT减少了冗余搜索同时大体保持精确匹配。生成式声明带来较小但仍保持精确匹配的节省，金标准声明显示更大节省。基线比较和消融实验表明行为由声明-证据对齐驱动，而非通用充分性、固定停止位置或词法重叠。开放语料试点表明HALT在覆盖率无法可靠验证时会弃权。
AI.conclusion: 证据覆盖率提供了实用的运行时控制信号，无需重新训练或修改宿主代理即可改进检索增强代理，为多跳问答检索代理的停止问题提供了有效解决方案。

title: Mitigating Visual Degradation in MLLMs via Spatial-Spectral Visual Anchor Learning
comment: This paper has been accepted by ACM MM 2026
summary: Despite the progress of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), they continue to exhibit deficiencies in visual perception. Following visual instruction tuning, internal MLLM representations rapidly deviate from their original semantic states during inference, causing severe information degradation. While existing methods attempt to leverage external vision foundation models (VFMs) to align internal representations, we find that direct alignment with VFMs enhances visual semantics but fails to mitigate representation deviation. To address this, we propose Spatial-Spectral Visual Anchor Learning (SSVAL). The core of SSVAL is Visual Anchor Prompt Injection (VAPI), which introduces prompts that absorb rich knowledge from external VFMs during training, enabling them to serve as stable visual anchors that mitigate representation deviation during inference. Additionally, we incorporate auxiliary spatial and frequency-domain representation alignment losses to provide complementary vision-specific supervision at intermediate LLM layers. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SSVAL significantly outperforms existing methods. Code are available on our \href{https://msls38.github.io/SSVAL/}{project page}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出空间-频谱视觉锚定学习（SSVAL）方法，通过视觉锚定提示注入（VAPI）利用外部视觉基础模型的知识作为稳定锚点，并辅以空间和频域表示对齐损失，来解决多模态大语言模型在视觉指令微调后内部表示发生漂移导致的视觉感知退化问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在视觉指令微调后，内部表示在推理过程中会迅速偏离原始语义状态，造成严重的信息退化。现有方法尝试利用外部视觉基础模型对齐内部表示，但直接对齐虽然增强了视觉语义，却无法缓解表示漂移问题。
AI.method: 提出SSVAL方法，核心是视觉锚定提示注入（VAPI）：在训练阶段注入能够吸收外部视觉基础模型丰富知识的提示，使其在推理时充当稳定的视觉锚点以缓解表示漂移。同时引入辅助的空间域和频域表示对齐损失，在中间LLM层提供互补的视觉特定监督。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SSVAL在性能上显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: SSVAL通过视觉锚点提示注入与空间-频谱多维度对齐损失的结合，有效解决了MLLM表示漂移问题，为多模态大语言模型的视觉感知能力提升提供了新思路。

title: Before Reasoning Fails: Pre-Evidence Procedural Failures in Agentic RAG
summary: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems can fail before evidence-conditioned reasoning is tested: an agent may retrieve candidate snippets but finalize without inspecting them. We study this failure mode as a procedural property of the agent trajectory, decomposing wrong answers into pre-evidence discipline failures and post-gold-read failures using saved tool-call traces, retrieved evidence, read passages, and final answers. Across 12,000 paired trajectories on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue, the two failure types are largely non-redundant: the both-trigger rate is in [11.2%, 13.1%] across regex and spaCy entity extractors. We then evaluate Read-Gate, a minimal runtime invariant requiring an agent to read after search and before finalization. Forced reading improves LLM-Acc by 14.9-19.9 points on trajectories that would otherwise skip reading and by 3.2-9.4 points on full minimal-reasoning cells. Additional diagnostics show that larger hidden thinking budgets do not necessarily increase evidence inspection. Together, these results indicate that evidence-gathering should be evaluated as a trajectory-level control problem, separately from answer-side reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Agentic RAG系统在证据条件推理之前就可能失败的问题——智能体检索到候选片段但未查看就直接给出答案。通过12,000条轨迹将错误分解为"证据前纪律失败"和"黄金证据读取后失败"两类，并提出Read-Gate运行时约束强制读取证据，显著提升准确率（LLM-Acc提升14.9-19.9分）。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG研究主要关注基于证据的推理质量，但忽略了一个更前置的失败模式：智能体检索到证据后可能根本不读取就直接回答。这导致检索增强系统失效，而现有评估框架未将其作为独立的轨迹级属性来研究。
AI.method: 1) 利用保存的工具调用轨迹、检索证据、已读段落和最终答案，将错误答案分解为两类：证据前纪律失败（pre-evidence discipline failures）和黄金证据读取后失败（post-gold-read failures）。2) 提出Read-Gate最小运行时约束，要求智能体在搜索后、最终确定前必须阅读证据。3) 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA和MuSiQue三个数据集上使用正则表达式和spaCy两种实体提取器进行12,000条配对轨迹实验。
AI.result: 两类失败在很大程度上是非冗余的（both-trigger率仅在11.2%-13.1%之间）；Read-Gate强制读取在原本跳过阅读的轨迹上使LLM-Acc提升14.9-19.9分，在完整最小推理单元上提升3.2-9.4分；更大的隐式思考预算并不必然增加证据检查。
AI.conclusion: 证据收集应作为轨迹层面的控制问题单独评估，与答案侧的推理能力分开对待。这为改进Agentic RAG系统的可靠性提供了新的评估视角和运行时干预手段。

title: Dynamic Resolution Routing for Efficient Egocentric Grounding
summary: Egocentric visual grounding requires high-resolution inputs to localize small objects. However, scaling Multimodal Large Language Models to this domain is constrained by the excessive cost of visual token processing. We identify that current efficient strategies based on token reduction are unreliable for selecting object-centric spatial evidence. To overcome this, we propose SmartRes, a framework that performs efficiency optimization in the pixel space via dynamic resolution routing. SmartRes first encodes a low-resolution view for global context and uses a lightweight router to activate high-resolution patches in object-centric regions and constructs an order-preserving visual sequence. To further enable robust routing under severe foreground-background imbalance, we introduce a margin-regularized routing objective that increases foreground-background logit separation and improves foreground recall. Experiments on Ego4D and EgoIntention show that SmartRes reduces visual tokens by up to 67% while retaining 86.4% of full-resolution performance, and achieves up to 1.66X faster inference than state-of-the-art token reduction methods with higher accuracy. Furthermore, strong performance on small object grounding indicates the effectiveness of SmartRes towards egocentric applications. Code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SmartRes框架，通过动态分辨率路由在像素空间进行效率优化，用于第一人称视角（自我中心）视觉定位任务。该方法将低分辨率全局视图与高分辨率目标区域补丁结合，大幅减少视觉token数量，在保持较高性能的同时显著提升推理速度。
AI.motivation: 自我中心视觉定位需要高分辨率输入来定位小物体，但多模态大语言模型在此领域的应用受限于视觉token处理的高昂成本。现有的基于token缩减的高效策略在面对目标区域选择时不可靠，无法有效保留与物体相关的空间证据。
AI.method: SmartRes框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 动态分辨率路由——先编码低分辨率视图获取全局上下文，再用轻量级路由器激活目标中心区域的高分辨率补丁，构建保持顺序的视觉序列；(2) 边距正则化路由目标——针对严重的前景-背景不平衡问题，通过增加前景-背景logit分离度并提升前景召回率来增强路由鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在Ego4D和EgoIntention数据集上，SmartRes最多减少67%的视觉token，同时保留全分辨率性能的86.4%；相比最先进的token缩减方法，推理速度提升最高达1.66倍且准确率更高；在小物体定位上表现出色。
AI.conclusion: SmartRes通过在像素空间而非token空间进行效率优化，有效解决了自我中心视觉定位中高分辨率需求与计算成本之间的矛盾，验证了动态分辨率路由在提升小物体定位性能方面的有效性，代码将公开。

title: HPFA: Hypergraph-Based Paired Failure Attribution for LLM Reasoning
summary: Reflection is a powerful mechanism for LLM reasoning, yet its effectiveness hinges on accurately attributing failures to specific reasoning steps, a capability that current models notably lack. Existing failure attribution methods either require expensive step-by-step counterfactual testing that scales poorly with trajectory length, or treat reasoning traces as flat sequences that ignore the inherent non-linear logical dependencies. We propose a hypergraph-based paired failure attribution (HPFA) framework that attributes the failure root cause by comparing the hyperedges of the targeted failure reasoning path against a reference successful path. By reducing the search space, our method efficiently localizes root causes and enables scalable synthesis of attribution data for training a lightweight attributor model via supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and agentic coding tasks demonstrate that HPFA can dramatically increase attribution accuracy and efficiency, and the trained attributor consistently improves reasoning accuracy at test time, outperforming baselines that lack graph structure or paired analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出基于超图的配对失败归因框架HPFA，通过比较失败推理路径与成功参考路径的超边来定位推理失败根因，并训练轻量级归因模型提升推理准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM反思机制依赖准确归因失败到具体推理步骤，但当前模型缺乏此能力。已有归因方法要么需昂贵的逐步骤反事实测试（难以扩展），要么将推理轨迹视为扁平序列而忽略非线性逻辑依赖。
AI.method: HPFA框架：构建推理路径的超图表示，通过比较目标失败路径与参考成功路径的超边来归因失败根因；缩小搜索空间实现高效根因定位；利用合成归因数据通过监督微调和强化学习训练轻量级归因器模型。
AI.result: 在数学推理和智能体编码任务上，HPFA显著提升了归因准确性和效率；训练得到的归因器在测试时持续改进推理准确性，优于缺乏图结构或配对分析的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 超图结构能够有效捕捉推理中的非线性逻辑依赖，结合配对路径比较可以高效准确地定位失败根因，且归因数据可用于训练轻量级模型以在测试时提升推理性能。

title: CRAFT: Compression via Recursive Adaptive Fusion of Video Tokens for Vision-Language Models
summary: In video understanding, vision-language models (VLMs) must ingest massive numbers of visual tokens, causing the computational and memory cost of the prefill stage to rise sharply. Such visual sequences are highly redundant along the spatio-temporal dimension, yet a high compression ratio is often accompanied by the loss of critical details. Existing token-compression methods either employ heuristic, training-free compression with limited content adaptivity or introduce additional modules that require expensive alignment training, leaving the trade-off between efficiency and adaptivity unresolved. To alleviate this limitation, we propose CRAFT: Compression via Recursive Adaptive Fusion of Video Tokens. CRAFT recursively merges tokens by decoupling parameter-free token selection from learnable token fusion: global similarity determines which tokens to merge, while a position-aware weighting module and a content-adaptive channel-wise gate learn how to fuse them. The whole compression pipeline is query-agnostic. Because every retained token is a linear combination of the original tokens, CRAFT preserves their true spatio-temporal coordinates and stays aligned with the pre-trained language model's input distribution. Experiments on multiple representative video benchmarks show that CRAFT consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art token-compression methods. At about $8\times$ compression, it retains roughly $97\%$ of the backbone's average accuracy and shows significant efficiency improvement.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出CRAFT方法，通过递归自适应融合视频token来压缩视觉序列，在约8倍压缩率下保持骨干网络约97%的平均准确率，同时显著提升计算效率。
AI.motivation: 视频理解中视觉token数量庞大导致预填充阶段计算和内存成本急剧上升。现有token压缩方法要么采用启发式、免训练的方式导致内容自适应性有限，要么引入需要昂贵对齐训练的新模块，效率与自适应性之间的权衡尚未解决。
AI.method: CRAFT通过递归合并token，将无参数token选择与可学习的token融合解耦：全局相似性决定合并哪些token，而位置感知加权模块和内容自适应通道门控学习如何融合。整个压缩流程与查询无关，保留的每个token都是原始token的线性组合，从而保持时空坐标和预训练语言模型输入分布的对齐。
AI.result: 在多个代表性视频基准上的实验表明，CRAFT持续优于现有的最先进token压缩方法。在约8倍压缩率下，保留了骨干网络平均准确率的大约97%，并表现出显著的效率提升。
AI.conclusion: CRAFT有效解决了视频token压缩中效率与自适应性之间的权衡问题，通过将token选择与融合解耦，实现了高压缩率下的信息保留和计算效率提升，且无需昂贵的对齐训练。

title: Cross-Fitted Residual Utility for Primary-Preserving Cognitive Decision Correction in Automatic Modulation Classification
summary: Automatic modulation classification research has largely emphasized representation accuracy, but a cognitive receiver must also decide when heterogeneous evidence justifies overriding a trusted default prediction. We study this post-inference problem through cross-fitted residual utility and a primary-preserving cognitive decision policy. A structured KAN-Fourier classifier supplies the default probability, while neural and non-neural candidates provide observable evidence. Candidate-specific residual utility is learned from train-split out-of-fold predictions, and a disjoint validation split freezes action thresholds, approved transitions, conditional routes, and a unified risk mask before held-out evaluation. On RMLA, RMLB, and HISAR, the complete system improves overall accuracy from 63.632% to 66.332%, 65.161% to 66.168%, and 77.769% to 79.867%, respectively. Controlled comparisons show that the isolated utility target does not uniformly dominate alternative out-of-fold meta-learners; the consistent gain comes from the complete evidence-and-action policy. Paired bootstrap and Holm-corrected McNemar analyses support the controlled gains. A frozen-policy stress test under carrier-frequency offset, I/Q imbalance, and synthetic Rayleigh/Rician fading yields positive gains in all 11 conditions, with every paired 95\% confidence interval above zero.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种认知接收机的后推断决策框架，通过交叉拟合残差效用和"主预测保留"认知决策策略，在保持默认预测的基础上，利用异构证据决定何时覆盖预测。在RMLA、RMLB和HISAR数据集上分别提升准确率2.7%、1.0%和2.1%，并在11种信道退化条件下全部取得正向增益。
AI.motivation: 现有自动调制分类研究过度关注表示精度，而认知接收机还需要解决一个关键问题：何时应当基于异构证据覆盖可信的默认预测。这一后推断决策问题尚未被充分研究。
AI.method: 采用结构化KAN-Fourier分类器生成默认概率，结合神经与非神经候选模型提供可观测证据。通过训练集折外预测学习候选特定的残差效用，并利用独立的验证集冻结动作阈值、批准转换、条件路径及统一风险掩码，最后在留出集上进行评估。
AI.result: 在RMLA、RMLB和HISAR上整体准确率分别从63.632%提升至66.332%、65.161%提升至66.168%、77.769%提升至79.867%。配对bootstrap和Holm校正McNemar检验支持增益显著性。在11种载波频偏、I/Q不平衡及合成瑞利/莱斯衰落条件下，所有配对95%置信区间均高于零。
AI.conclusion: 孤立的效用目标并不始终优于其他折外元学习器，一致的性能提升来源于完整的证据与行动策略。所提出的认知决策框架在多种退化信道条件下具备稳健的增益。

title: StreamSplat: Streaming Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting enables efficient novel-view synthesis without per-scene optimization, but most existing methods assume a fixed set of context views and process them jointly. This limits their applicability to online scenarios where calibrated views arrive sequentially and the scene must be updated causally. We present \emph{StreamSplat}, a streaming feed-forward 3DGS framework that incrementally maintains a persistent geometry-grounded scene state and decodes it into renderable 3D Gaussians after each input chunk. StreamSplat centers on a \textbf{Voxel-Aligned Causal Cache (VACC)}, which stores historical 3D tokens in a memory-bounded voxel structure so that memory grows with explored scene geometry rather than stream length. To better reuse history during causal prediction, we introduce \textbf{History-Projected Depth Anchoring (HPDA)} to project cached geometry as depth guidance for current cost-volume estimation, and \textbf{Cache-Guided Feature Injection (CGFI)} to inject cached latent evidence into Gaussian-token regression. Experiments on DL3DV, RealEstate10K, and ScanNet show that StreamSplat remains competitive with state-of-the-art feed-forward 3DGS methods under sparse causal inputs, despite not using future views or full-scene context. More importantly, it scales to long input streams with 256, 512, and 1024 views where fixed-view baselines run out of memory, yielding sustained improvements in novel-view synthesis quality as more observations arrive. The code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: StreamSplat是一个流式前馈3D高斯溅射框架，通过体素对齐因果缓存（VACC）增量维护持久化的几何锚定场景状态，支持在长序列输入下无需未来视角即可持续更新场景并提升新视角合成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈3D高斯溅射方法假设固定数量的上下文视角并联合处理，无法适用于视角按顺序到达、场景需因果更新的在线场景。作者旨在解决流式场景重建中内存随序列长度增长的问题，以及历史信息在高斯预测中的有效复用。
AI.method: 提出StreamSkat框架，核心为三个组件：(1) Voxel-Aligned Causal Cache (VACC)，以内存受限的体素结构存储历史3D token，使内存随探索几何增长而非流长度；(2) History-Projected Depth Anchoring (HPDA)，将缓存的几何投影为深度指导以辅助当前代价体估计；(3) Cache-Guided Feature Injection (CGFI)，将缓存潜在特征注入高斯token回归过程。
AI.result: 在DL3DV、RealEstate10K和ScanNet上，StreamSplat在稀疏因果输入下与最先进前馈3DGS方法保持竞争力；在256、512和1024视角的长输入流中，固定视角基线出现内存溢出，而StreamSplat持续提升新视角合成质量。
AI.conclusion: StreamSplat证明了流式因果前馈3DGS的可行性，通过几何驱动的缓存机制实现内存随探索场景而非流长度增长，在长序列下持续提升重建质量，且无需未来视角。

title: Ground, Cover, and Refine: Evidence-Centric Frame Selection for Long-Video Question Answering
summary: Long-video question answering requires identifying sparse yet critical evidence from videos containing thousands of frames under a constrained visual-token budget. Existing methods either select query-aware frames in a single pass or rely on timestamped text solely as retrieval guidance, leading to two key limitations. First, selected frames tend to cluster around local relevance peaks, and once the budget is exhausted, omitted evidence cannot be recovered. Second, textual and visual evidence remain weakly aligned. We propose GCR, a training-free framework that casts fixed-budget frame selection as a joint evidence curation problem. Ground converts timestamped text into temporal events, selects query-relevant real frame anchors, and renders each event text onto its temporally aligned frame. Cover supplements grounded events with direct visual anchors for complementary visual evidence and applies global maximal marginal relevance to preserve diverse context. Refine revisits omitted temporal regions and replaces the weakest revisable context frame with a real-frame medoid---but only when the medoid offers greater evidence value. GCR maintains a fixed number of chronologically ordered frames and requires no VLM training or architectural modification. Experiments on LongVideoBench and Video-MME, across three 7B backbones and frame budgets of 8, 32, and 64, demonstrate consistent improvements in long-video QA. With the 7B LLaVA-OV backbone and 32 frames, GCR achieves 64.25% and 62.15% on the two benchmarks, outperforming the strongest reproduced baselines by 2.54 and 1.93 percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GCR框架，一种无需训练的联合证据筛选方法，用于长视频问答中的固定预算帧选择。GCR通过Ground（将时间戳文本转为事件并渲染到帧上）、Cover（补充视觉锚点并应用全局MMR保持多样性）、Refine（回访遗漏区域并用质心帧替换弱证据帧）三个步骤，在不增加VLM训练和架构改动的情况下，显著提升长视频QA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频QA方法存在两个关键问题：一是单次查询感知的帧选择会聚集在局部相关峰周围，预算耗尽后遗漏的证据无法恢复；二是文本证据与视觉证据对齐薄弱，限制了证据的有效利用。
AI.method: GCR框架包含三个模块：1) Ground将时间戳文本转换为时间事件，选择查询相关的真实帧锚点，并将事件文本渲染到时间对齐的帧上；2) Cover通过直接视觉锚点补充接地事件，并应用全局最大边际相关性（MMR）保持多样上下文；3) Refine回访被遗漏的时间区域，仅当质心帧具有更高证据价值时，用真实帧质心替换最弱的可修改上下文帧。系统保持固定数量的按时间顺序排列的帧，无需VLM训练或架构修改。
AI.result: 在LongVideoBench和Video-MME两个基准上，使用三种7B骨干模型和8、32、64三种帧预算，GCR均取得一致性改进。在7B LLaVA-OV骨干和32帧预算下，GCR在两个基准上分别达到64.25%和62.15%，比最强复现基线分别高出2.54和1.93个百分点。
AI.conclusion: GCR通过将帧选择视为联合证据筛选问题，解决了现有方法中证据遗漏和文本-视觉对齐薄弱的问题。该框架无需额外训练且兼容现有VLM架构，为长视频QA提供了一种有效且高效的帧选择方案。

title: Fetch-then-Explore: Decoupling Selection from Extraction over a Persistent Workspace for Search Agents
summary: Search agents now answer questions that take dozens of searches to settle, yet how such an agent reads a page has drawn far less attention than how it finds one. Nearly all of them use one of two document interfaces, and both tie a page to the moment it is opened. \emph{Visit-and-read} injects a reading of the page into the message history at fetch time, fixing that reading before the agent knows which fact it will need. Stateful \emph{browsing} instead extracts on demand from the page in hand, but holds one page at a time and releases it as soon as the agent opens another. Either way, a page that turns out to matter many turns later has to be fetched and rendered into context all over again. We propose \textbf{Fetch-then-Explore}, which separates page selection from evidence extraction and keeps what it selects: pages are recorded in a per-question workspace on the filesystem rather than the context window or a transient session, and evidence is pulled from them on demand later. Selection becomes almost free, extraction can wait until the agent knows what to look for and be repeated as its hypothesis sharpens, and pages are not released when the agent moves on, so evidence accumulates across the trajectory. In a unified ReAct harness with fixed search, we compare Fetch-then-Explore against snippet-only, visit-and-read, and browsing baselines on two open-web benchmarks, BrowseComp and WideSearch, across three agent backbones. It leads BrowseComp accuracy at every backbone and generally matches or exceeds the baselines on WideSearch, and a behavioral analysis traces the gains to the workspace's defining move: returning to a page after leaving it, which it does far more than any transient interface, so evidence missed on a first pass can still be recovered later.

AI.tldr: 提出Fetch-then-Explore方法，将网页选择与证据提取分离，把页面保存在文件系统中而非上下文窗口，允许智能体在轨迹中随时回访页面并按需提取证据，在BrowseComp和WideSearch基准上超越了现有的访问即读和浏览式接口。
AI.motivation: 现有搜索智能体在文档接口设计上存在根本缺陷：无论访问即读还是状态化浏览，都将页面与其打开时刻绑定，导致后续需要时不得不重新获取和渲染页面，造成效率低下和证据遗漏。
AI.method: Fetch-then-Explore将页面选择（Fetch）与证据提取（Explore）解耦：页面被记录在问答工作区的文件系统中而非上下文窗口或会话中，证据按需、可重复地从已保存页面中提取，页面不会因智能体转向其他页面而释放。
AI.result: 在统一的ReAct框架下与三类基线对比，Fetch-then-Explore在BrowseComp上所有骨干模型下均领先，在WideSearch上总体匹配或超越基线；行为分析表明其增益源于远超瞬态接口的页面回访行为。
AI.conclusion: 将页面持久化存储并延迟证据提取是提升搜索智能体推理能力的关键设计，能有效弥补首次阅读时的信息遗漏。

title: FairForensics: Seeing Expressions and Parsing Demographics via Vision-Language Modeling for Generalizable Fair Deepfake Detection
summary: The challenge of fair deepfake detection (FDD) has attracted increasing attention. Existing fairness-enhanced detectors often suffer from suboptimal generalization to unseen manipulations and fairness across demographic groups. They are typically developed and evaluated on demographically imbalanced distributions, resulting in biased predictions toward minority groups. In this paper, we construct a novel demographically balanced FDD benchmark to train and evaluate the fairness of detectors under both balanced and imbalanced population scenarios. Additionally, we introduce a novel expression and demographic perceptual vision-language model, termed FairForensics, for generalizable fair deepfake detection. FairForensics conducts face forgery generalization enhancement and demographic-aware fairness regularization. During face forgery generalization enhancement, built upon the novel observation of significant distribution differences between pristine and forged expression vectors, we design an expression encoder to capture high-level expression-guided forgery patterns, and an expression-perceptual visual encoder that integrates global appearance and expression forgery features while mitigating identity bias using an identity-aware patch perturbation module. Under demographic-aware fairness regularization, we propose a demographic-guided language encoder to extract population-aware global language embeddings, which boosts the decoupling of forgery features from demographic information via vision-language alignment. We devise a population-aware prototype fairness objective to enforce both inter-class separability and intra-class alignment across demographic subgroups. Extensive experiments on our balanced demographic benchmark show that our method achieves the state-of-the-art in terms of generalization and fairness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FairForensics，一个基于视觉语言模型的公平深度伪造检测框架，构建了人口统计平衡的基准数据集，通过表情编码器和人口感知公平正则化，在保证跨操作泛化性的同时提升不同人口群体间的检测公平性。
AI.motivation: 现有公平深度伪造检测方法在未知伪造操作上的泛化能力不足，且常因训练数据在人口统计上分布不均，导致对少数群体的预测存在偏见。
AI.method: 1) 构建人口统计平衡的FDD基准数据集；2) FairForensics包含表情引导的伪造模式编码器与表情感知视觉编码器，结合身份感知补丁扰动模块消除身份偏差；3) 通过人口引导语言编码器和视觉-语言对齐实现人口感知公平正则化；4) 设计人口感知原型公平目标函数，兼顾类间可分性与类内对齐。
AI.result: 在构建的人口统计平衡基准上，FairForensics在泛化能力和公平性方面均达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 通过表情感知的伪造特征提取和人口感知的公平约束相结合，可以有效兼顾深度伪造检测的泛化性能与跨人口群体的公平性。

title: MemArbiter: Decision-Time Memory Arbitration for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents must retain and use cross-step information to act coherently in long-horizon tasks. Existing methods improve memory accessibility, yet action-relevant information may still fail to guide the current decision because it is poorly formed, organized, prioritized, or presented. We call this post-access failure the Memory-Action Gap. We propose MemArbiter, a function-aware memory arbitration framework that addresses the memory-management-induced component of this gap. MemArbiter decomposes interaction histories into atomic items, organizes them into five functional Memory Banks, and combines bank-level demand, item-level relevance, focal-ambient representations, and a temporal presentation gate to dynamically control memory salience. We evaluate MemArbiter on ALFWorld against Flat Retrieval and Flat Recency under unified per-step memory budgets. With an open-weight action-generation model, MemArbiter achieves success rates of 82.8% and 92.5% under 500- and 750-token budgets, outperforming the strongest baseline by 20.9 and 25.4 percentage points, respectively. It also improves post-failure recovery and reduces failed-action repetition and state-action recurrence. These results show that function-aware memory arbitration enables accessible information to guide actions more effectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MemArbiter，一个功能感知的记忆仲裁框架，通过将交互历史分解为原子条目并组织成五种功能记忆库，动态控制记忆显著性，弥合LLM智能体在长程任务中的"记忆-行动鸿沟"。在ALFWorld上，MemArbiter在500和750 token预算下分别达到82.8%和92.5%的成功率，超越最强基线20.9和25.4个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有方法虽然提升了记忆的可访问性，但与行动相关的信息仍可能因为记忆条目的形成、组织、优先级排序或呈现方式不佳而无法有效指导当前决策，这一"后访问失败"被称为记忆-行动鸿沟（Memory-Action Gap）。
AI.method: MemArbiter将交互历史分解为原子条目，组织成五种功能记忆库（Memory Banks），并结合库级需求、条目级相关性、焦点-环境表征和时间呈现门控，动态控制记忆显著性以引导动作生成。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld上，使用开放权重动作生成模型，MemArbiter在500和750 token预算下分别实现82.8%和92.5%的成功率，超越最强基线20.9和25.4个百分点；同时改善了失败后恢复能力，减少了失败动作重复和状态-动作循环。
AI.conclusion: 功能感知的记忆仲裁使得可访问的信息能更有效地指导动作，证明了函数化、结构化的记忆管理方法在弥合记忆-行动鸿沟方面的有效性。

title: Beyond Solution-Centric Search: Adaptive Inquiry and Knowledge Revision for Autonomous ML Engineering
summary: Long-horizon autonomous research tasks such as machine learning engineering require systems to make interdependent decisions under a limited budget. Existing LLM-based agents typically organize candidate-solution improvement through tree, graph, or chain structures, meaning that the search process determines how information is acquired and managed. We call this design solution-centric search and propose instead the information paradigm, in which an evolving information state represents the system's understanding of the task and guides solution improvement. We instantiate this paradigm in Iris, an inquiry-revision loop. For information acquisition, Iris generates local action plans from the current information state and uses epistemic actions to probe decision-critical unknowns without modifying the retained solution. For information management, Iris synthesizes observations across experiments into task knowledge composed of revisable claims with explicit scope and status. It updates this knowledge as new evidence arrives and constructs each decision context from raw evidence, structured summaries, or task knowledge at the required level of detail. On MLE-Bench, Iris attains a 64.9% any-medal rate under a 12-hour budget, the highest among compared systems. Across four tasks spanning harness engineering and model post-training, Iris also demonstrates cross-domain generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出信息范式（information paradigm）替代传统基于解决方案结构（树/图/链）的搜索范式，通过迭代的"探究-修订"循环（Iris）来管理任务信息状态，指导长时域自主研究任务中的解决方案改进，在MLE-Bench上取得最高64.9%的奖牌率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的智能体在长时域研究任务（如机器学习工程）中面临有限预算下需做相互依赖决策的挑战，但传统的树形、图形或链式搜索结构将搜索过程决定信息获取与管理方式，这种"以解决方案为中心"的设计未能充分重视信息本身的演化与管理。
AI.method: 提出信息范式的Iris系统，采用探究-修订循环。信息获取方面，根据当前信息状态生成局部行动计划，使用认知动作（epistemic actions）探测决策关键未知点而不修改已有方案；信息管理方面，将跨实验观察综合为可修订的任务知识（带明确范围和状态的声明），随新证据更新知识，并按需从原始证据、结构化摘要或任务知识构建决策上下文。
AI.result: 在MLE-Bench基准上，Iris在12小时预算下达到64.9%的任意奖牌率，为对比系统中最高；在四个跨任务（涉及工程构建和模型后训练）中展现了跨域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 信息范式是传统以解决方案为中心的搜索范式的有效替代，通过显式管理演化中的信息状态（而非仅组织解决方案候选），能够在大规模自主研究任务中取得更优性能，并展现出良好的跨域泛化能力。

title: Beyond the Mean: Multi-Moment Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning has become a central paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models. Existing methods generally aim to reduce the failure probabilities induced across problems. In this paper, we introduce a moment-based perspective on policy optimization for LLM reasoning by treating the failure probability of a randomly sampled problem as a random variable and characterizing optimization objectives through its moments. Under this perspective, many existing methods optimize only a single moment of the failure-probability distribution, leaving its broader distributional structure largely uncharacterized. We propose \textbf{M}ulti-\textbf{M}oment \textbf{P}olicy \textbf{O}ptimization (MMPO), a novel policy optimization framework that jointly minimizes multiple moments of the failure-probability distribution. MMPO admits a direct operational interpretation as minimizing the expected truncated time required to obtain the first successful response. Beyond MMPO, we further develop a general moment-transformation framework that systematically induces different moment profiles and provides a unified view of a broader family of policy optimization objectives. Experiments across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks and models of different scales demonstrate that MMPO consistently outperforms strong baselines. We hope this moment-based perspective offers new insights into the design of policy optimization objectives for LLM reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多矩策略优化（MMPO）框架，将LLM推理中问题的失败概率视为随机变量，通过联合最小化其多个矩来优化策略，并配套发展了矩变换框架以统一视角看待多种策略优化目标，在五个数学推理基准上超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法通常只优化失败概率分布的单阶矩（如平均值），忽略了失败概率的完整分布结构，无法充分刻画不同问题之间的推理失败差异。
AI.method: 将每个随机采样问题的失败概率视为随机变量，通过矩（moments）对该分布进行表征；提出MMPO框架联合优化多个矩，并解释了其等价于最小化获得首个成功回复的期望截断时间；进一步提出矩变换框架系统性地诱导不同矩分布特性，统一了多种策略优化目标。
AI.result: 在五个数学推理基准和不同规模模型上的实验表明，MMPO在性能上一致优于现有强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 矩视角为设计LLM推理策略优化目标提供了新的理论视角和实用框架，有望启发更丰富的策略优化目标设计。

title: From Simple QA to Deep Research: A Verifiable Benchmark Constructed through Iterative Task Evolution
comment: 6 figures. Includes supplementary material. Code and data are publicly available
summary: Deep research benchmarks require expert-level tasks and reliable evaluation grounded in task-specific knowledge. Existing benchmarks rely heavily on expert authoring or pre-existing human-authored materials, while fully automatic construction struggles to ensure consistent and traceable verification. To address this gap, we introduce a verifiable benchmark of 500 deep research tasks spanning 31 topics and 10 major categories, with three query forms designed to probe complementary capabilities required for deep research. The benchmark is constructed automatically using an iterative Explorer-Formalizer-Challenger pipeline that progressively transforms simple questions into deep research tasks. Each task is represented as a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of atomic steps and associated checkpoints, enabling the query, DAG, and rubrics to evolve together in a controlled manner. Experiments demonstrate that the benchmark clearly discriminates among models and query types, while its fact-grounded pointwise rubrics enable fine-grained, human-aligned, and stable evaluation. Our data, implementation, and results are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个包含500个深度研究任务的可验证基准测试，涵盖31个主题和10大类别，采用三种查询形式，通过自动化的探索者-形式化者-挑战者流水线构建，每个任务以有向无环图表示原子步骤和检查点，实现细粒度、人类对齐且稳定的评估。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究基准测试要么依赖专家编写或预先存在的人工材料，要么全自动构建难以保证一致且可追溯的验证。作者旨在解决这一空白，构建一个既不需要大量人工编写又能确保可靠评估的深度研究基准。
AI.method: 采用迭代式探索者-形式化者-挑战者流水线自动构建基准，将简单问题逐步转变为深度研究任务；每个任务表示为原子步骤和关联检查点的有向无环图，使查询、图和评分标准能够以受控方式协同演化。
AI.result: 实验表明该基准能清晰区分不同模型和查询类型之间的性能差异，基于事实的分点式评分标准实现了细粒度、与人类评估一致且稳定的评估效果。
AI.conclusion: 该基准填补了深度研究评估中自动构建与可靠验证之间的空白，提供了公开可用的数据、实现和结果，为深度研究领域提供了更有说服力和可追溯的评测方案。

title: Entity-Aware Sequence Transduction for Player-Centric Ball Action Spotting
summary: Player-centric ball action spotting requires temporally precise event detection together with actor attribution in crowded, partially observed multi-agent sports videos. Existing Denoising Sequence Transduction (DST) baselines treat the player-role dimension as part of a flattened frame-level representation, which weakens the inductive bias for modeling player-specific temporal evolution and inter-player interactions. To address this limitation, we propose Multi-Entity Denoising Sequence Transduction (ME-DST). ME-DST keeps the role-slot dimension throughout encoding. It uses temporal attention to model the history of each role slot, and spatial attention to exchange information across role slots at each frame. This factorized design gives the model a direct structure for separating within-player evolution from inter-player context. We also add learnable role embeddings, tracking-derived tactical features, and fused visual predictions from X3D-L and Swin3D-S. Experiments on the FOOTPASS dataset show that ME-DST reaches a Micro F1 of 0.778. This improves the strongest official TAAD+DST baseline by 10.3 percentage points. Controlled ablations show that preserving the entity axis and encoding role identity are central to this gain. These results suggest that explicit entity modeling is an effective inductive bias for player-centric sports event understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多实体去噪序列转导（ME-DST）模型，通过在整个编码过程中保留角色槽维度，使用时间注意力建模每个角色的历史演变、空间注意力建模跨角色交互，并在FOOTPASS数据集上达到0.778的Micro F1，比最强基线提升10.3个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有的去噪序列转导（DST）基线方法将玩家角色维度展平为帧级表示，削弱了建模玩家特定时间演变和玩家间交互的归纳偏置，难以在拥挤且部分遮挡的多智能体体育视频中实现精确的球员中心球类事件检测与角色归因。
AI.method: ME-DST在整个编码过程中保留角色槽维度，采用因子化设计：时间注意力建模每个角色槽的历史演变，空间注意力在每帧中跨角色槽交换信息，从而将球员内部演变与球员间上下文分离建模。此外还加入可学习的角色嵌入、跟踪衍生的战术特征，以及融合X3D-L和Swin3D-S的视觉预测。
AI.result: 在FOOTPASS数据集上，ME-DST的Micro F1达到0.778，较最强官方TAAD+DST基线提升10.3个百分点。受控消融实验表明保留实体轴和编码角色身份是性能提升的核心因素。
AI.conclusion: 显式实体建模是球员中心体育事件理解的有效归纳偏置，为拥挤场景下的多智能体事件检测提供了更好的结构化建模方案。

title: From Profiling to Synthesis: Benchmarking Implicit Behavioral Alignment in Personalized LLM Agents
summary: Large Language Models have enabled increasingly capable autonomous agents, yet personalization remains critical for making such agents practically useful. Recent benchmarks have begun evaluating personalization in agents, but they largely rely on static preference snapshots, fixed interaction logs, or question answering over predefined user profiles. Such designs fail to capture the complexity of evolving user preferences and neglect preference-conditioned task execution-a discrepancy we term as the knowledge-to-action gap. To address this challenge, we introduce IBA-Bench, a benchmark for implicit behavioral alignment constructed from longitudinal interaction histories that contain noise, implicit cues, and temporal inconsistencies. Unlike prior work, IBA-Bench evaluates whether an agent can execute tasks while satisfying implicit user constraints inferred from historical interactions. We further propose IBA-Agent, an agent framework that reconciles conflicting priorities through broad retrieval and trajectory-level alignment. Experiment results on IBA-Bench show that effective personalization remains a significant challenge for state-of-the-art LLM agents, and the proposed IBA-Agent substantially improves behavioral alignment in complex scenarios across nine application domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了IBA-Bench基准和IBA-Agent框架,用于评估和提升大语言模型智能体在长期交互历史中进行隐式行为对齐的能力,解决了从知识到行动之间的差距问题。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化智能体基准大多依赖静态偏好快照、固定交互日志或基于预定义用户档案的问答,无法捕捉用户偏好随时间演变的复杂性,也忽视了偏好条件化的任务执行,存在"知识到行动"的差距。
AI.method: 提出IBA-Bench基准,基于包含噪声、隐式线索和时间不一致性的纵向交互历史构建;并提出IBA-Agent代理框架,通过广泛检索和轨迹级对齐来协调冲突的优先级,从而满足从历史交互中推断出的隐式用户约束。
AI.result: 实验结果表明,对最先进的LLM智能体而言,有效的个性化仍然是一项重大挑战;而提出的IBA-Agent在九个应用领域的复杂场景中显著提升了行为对齐性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了现有个性化评估方法的不足,验证了提出的基准和框架的有效性,表明隐式行为对齐是LLM智能体个性化中亟待解决的关键问题。

title: UniSim-SLAM: Feed-Forward SLAM with Unified Sim(3) Optimization
summary: Recent geometric foundation models enable feed-forward inference for SLAM, but their predictions are strongly dependent on the input view set, which leads to geometric inconsistencies and trajectory drift when results are chained over long sequences. Online deployment further exposes a trade-off between the low latency of two-view tracking and the constraint richness of multi-view inference. We introduce UniSim-SLAM, an integrated system that runs lightweight two-view keyframe tracking in the frontend and performs periodic multi-view submap refinement in the backend. To combine predictions defined in heterogeneous local coordinates with inconsistent scales, we formulate a unified multi-level factor graph on $Sim(3)$ that jointly optimizes global keyframe poses and submap poses. The graph integrates temporal view-to-view odometry edges, view-to-submap bridge edges with depth-statistics scale anchoring, and submap-to-submap tie and scale constraints to enforce consistent similarity relations across submaps. Experiments on TUM RGB-D and 7-Scenes show that UniSim-SLAM achieves state-of-the-art accuracy in the uncalibrated setting, reducing trajectory error by $38.5\% $ on TUM RGB-D and $45.9\%$ on 7-Scenes compared to prior best results. Project page: https://vision3d-lab.github.io/unisim-slam/

AI.tldr: 本文提出UniSim-SLAM，一个集成系统，前端运行轻量级两视图关键帧跟踪，后端执行周期性多视图子图精化。通过构建统一的Sim(3)多层级因子图，联合优化全局关键帧位姿和子图位姿，解决几何基础模型在长序列中的几何不一致和轨迹漂移问题。在TUM RGB-D和7-Scenes数据集上达到最先进精度，轨迹误差分别降低38.5%和45.9%。
AI.motivation: 现有的几何基础模型虽然能实现SLAM的前馈推理，但其预测强烈依赖于输入视图集，导致在长序列中链式推理时产生几何不一致和轨迹漂移。同时，在线部署面临两视图跟踪低延迟与多视图推理约束丰富性之间的权衡矛盾。
AI.method: 提出UniSim-SLAM系统：1) 前端采用轻量级两视图关键帧跟踪以保证低延迟；2) 后端执行周期性多视图子图精化提供丰富约束；3) 构建统一的Sim(3)多层级因子图，联合优化全局关键帧位姿和子图位姿；4) 因子图包含时间视图间里程计边、视图-子图桥接边（带深度统计尺度锚定）以及子图间绑定和尺度约束，以强制各子图间的一致性相似关系。
AI.result: 在TUM RGB-D和7-Scenes数据集上的实验表明，UniSim-SLAM在未标定设置下达到最先进精度，相比此前最优结果，TUM RGB-D轨迹误差降低38.5%，7-Scenes轨迹误差降低45.9%。
AI.conclusion: 通过前后端协同架构和统一的Sim(3)因子图优化，UniSim-SLAM有效解决了几何基础模型在SLAM中的视图依赖性问题，在保持两视图跟踪低延迟的同时，利用多视图子图精化提升全局一致性，显著降低了长序列轨迹误差。

title: PAC Approximation and DIRECT Optimization for Parametric Markov Models
summary: In this paper, we consider the parameter synthesis and optimization problem for parametric Markov decision processes (pMDPs), the extension of classical MDPs where exact probability values are replaced by parametric expressions. Computing the rational function $f_{\lsf}$ that maps parameter valuations to the satisfaction value of a PRCTL property $\lsf$ is a computationally expensive task, particularly for pMDPs where the optimal policy may vary across the parameter space. We adopt the \emph{scenario approach} to efficiently synthesize a probably approximately correct (PAC) approximation $\ApproxFunOfProperty{f}$ of $f_{\lsf}$: by sampling parameter configurations and solving a linear program, we obtain a polynomial approximation whose error margin $\margin$ is guaranteed, with prescribed confidence, for all but an $\errorRate$-fraction of the parameter domain under the sampling distribution. We further show how this PAC framework can be combined with statistical model checking (SMC), enabling the analysis of black-box parametric models. Building on the PAC approximation, we integrate the DIRECT (DIviding RECTangles) algorithm for derivative-free global optimization over the parameter space. We establish conditional optimality-gap guarantees: under explicit Lipschitz and PAC-good-set assumptions, the difference between the true optimum $f_{\lsf}(\parameters^{*})$ and the value found by DIRECT is bounded by a partition-diameter term and, in the PAC case, an additional approximation-error term. An empirical evaluation on 2997 benchmarks focuses on the new DIRECT-based optimization component. The results show that DIRECT variants solve fewer instances than the scenario optimizer, but on their common successful instances they often return slightly better objective values and usually run faster, while remaining close to the scenario values within the PAC margin.

AI.tldr: 本文针对参数化马尔可夫决策过程（pMDPs）的参数综合与优化问题，采用场景方法（scenario approach）通过采样参数配置和求解线性规划，获得概率近似正确（PAC）的多项式近似函数，并结合统计模型检验（SMC）支持黑盒参数模型分析。在此基础上集成DIRECT全局优化算法，建立条件最优性间隙保证，并在2997个基准上进行实证评估。
AI.motivation: 计算pMDP中PRCTL属性满足值的有理函数$f_{\mathscr{f}}$计算成本极高，尤其是当最优策略随参数空间变化时，传统精确计算方法不可行，需要高效的近似方法。
AI.method: 1) 采用场景方法采样参数配置并求解线性规划，得到PAC保证的多项式近似；2) 将PAC框架与统计模型检验（SMC）结合以支持黑盒模型；3) 集成DIRECT（分割矩形）算法进行无导数全局优化，并证明在Lipschitz和PAC好集合假设下的最优性间隙保证。
AI.result: 在2997个基准上的实证评估表明：DIRECT变体求解的实例数少于场景优化器，但在共同成功求解的实例上通常获得略优的目标值且运行更快，且结果在PAC误差范围内接近场景方法的值。
AI.conclusion: 基于DIRECT的优化组件在pMDP参数优化中具有竞争力，能在更少实例上求解但提供更优的解质量和更快的运行速度，同时保持PAC保证的有效性。

title: SpatialQuery: Benchmarking Geometry-Grounded Multi-Instance Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong semantic understanding but remain unreliable in metric spatial reasoning, particularly when queries require comparing multiple instances of the same object category. We study this problem through the Closest-Instance Distance Query (CIDQ), where a model must identify the nearest visible candidate to a unique reference object and estimate their gravity-aligned floor-plane distance. We introduce SPATIALQUERY, a training- free framework for CIDQ reasoning from a single RGB image, together with SPATIALQUERY-1M, a benchmark containing over one million RGB-only question-answer pairs from 200 indoor scenes. SPATIALQUERY recovers instance-level metric geometry and transforms it into a canonical Bird's-Eye View through Scene Cubifying, which represents objects as uniformly sized, category-coded blocks to emphasize their relative floor- plane locations. We further propose Uncertainty-Aware Chain-of-Thought (UA-CoT) prompting, which incorporates geometry- derived per-instance uncertainty into the VLM reasoning process. Without task-specific fine-tuning or architectural modification, SPATIALQUERY with Qwen3-VL-8B achieves a Floor-MAE of 0.259 m, an Unc-Acc@0.3 m of 90.5%, and a proximity-decision accuracy of 84.18%, outperforming fine-tuned spatial specialists, general-purpose VLMs, and closed-source frontier models. Code, benchmark resources, and an interactive demo are available at https://namhai1810.github.io/SpatialQuery/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPATIALQUERY，一个无需训练的空间推理框架，用于解决视觉语言模型在度量空间推理（特别是同类多实例最近距离查询）中的不可靠问题，并配套发布了超过百万问答对的基准数据集SPATIALQUERY-1M。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）虽然在语义理解上表现强劲，但在度量空间推理中不可靠，尤其是当查询需要比较同一物体类别的多个实例时。现有模型无法可靠地完成这类需要精确度量信息的空间推理任务。
AI.method: 1) 提出SPATIALQUERY框架，通过Scene Cubifying将实例级度量几何转换为规范的鸟瞰图表示，将物体表示为统一尺寸、类别编码的块以强调其相对地面位置；2) 提出不确定性感知思维链（UA-CoT）提示方法，将几何推导出的逐实例不确定性融入到VLM推理过程中；3) 整个框架无需任务特定微调或架构修改。
AI.result: SPATIALQUERY配合Qwen3-VL-8B在CIDQ任务上取得Floor-MAE为0.259米，Unc-Acc@0.3m为90.5%，邻近决策准确率为84.18%，超越了微调的空间专精模型、通用VLMs以及闭源前沿模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过将实例级度量几何转化为规范的鸟瞰图表示，并结合不确定性感知的推理提示，可以在不进行任务特定训练的情况下，有效提升VLM在度量空间推理任务上的性能，甚至超越微调模型和闭源前沿模型。

title: MEGRAG: Multi-Granular Evidence Graphs for Answer-Aware Multi-Hop RAG
summary: Multi-hop question answering is a fundamental challenge in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), because deriving an answer requires integrating dispersed evidence. Iterative RAG (iRAG) is widely used for this challenge, but existing methods have two limitations. First, most methods still support each reasoning step with single-granularity evidence, making it difficult to balance information density and contextual noise. Second, existing methods often answer the original question only after aggregating evidence retrieved across intermediate steps, so redundant evidence and intermediate retrieval errors may accumulate and degrade the final answer. To address these limitations, we propose MEGRAG, an answer-aware framework that represents multi-hop reasoning as a path-structured multi-granular evidence graph. Offline, MEGRAG links passages to their sentences and extracted triples through a cross-granularity index. Online, it retrieves passages for the current query and selects aligned evidence, starting with compact triples and adding sentence or passage context as needed. MEGRAG uses the resulting intermediate answer and prior reasoning to decide whether the Initial Query has been resolved. If not, it identifies the missing information and formulates a focused next query; otherwise, it stops retrieval and returns the answer. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent gains over a diverse set of RAG baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出MEGRAG，一种面向多跳问答的答案感知框架，通过路径结构的多粒度证据图（跨粒度索引连接段落、句子和三元组）进行检索，并利用中间答案判断初始查询是否已解决，从而灵活决定继续检索或停止并返回答案。
AI.motivation: 现有迭代RAG方法存在两个局限：一是每一步推理仅支持单一粒度的证据，难以平衡信息密度与上下文噪声；二是通常在所有中间步骤检索完成后才回答原始问题，导致冗余证据和中间检索错误累积，降低最终答案质量。
AI.method: MEGRAG包含离线和在线两个阶段。离线阶段通过跨粒度索引将段落与其句子和抽取的三元组关联起来；在线阶段为当前查询检索段落并选择对齐的证据，从紧凑的三元组开始，按需补充句子或段落上下文。利用中间答案和先前的推理判断初始查询是否已解决，若未解决则识别缺失信息并生成聚焦的下一查询，否则停止检索并返回答案。
AI.result: 在多种RAG基线上进行的大量实验表明，MEGRAG取得了持续的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: MEGRAG通过多粒度证据图与答案感知的迭代推理机制，有效解决了多跳问答中信息密度与噪声的平衡问题以及中间检索错误累积问题，验证了该框架在多跳RAG任务中的有效性。

title: STC-Net: Electroluminescence-Based Solar Cell Crack Segmentation for Power Loss Estimation
summary: Accurate crack assessment in electroluminescence (EL) images is important for photovoltaic (PV) reliability analysis, yet existing segmentation methods often fail to capture the thin, elongated, and structurally constrained nature of crack defects. This paper proposes a Solar Topology Crack Network (STC-Net) that incorporates edge priors, spectral priors, and a boundary-topology refinement module to improve crack continuity and boundary preservation. The framework further extends segmentation to power-loss estimation by deriving a crack-associated inactive-area proxy from the predicted masks. Experiments on the PVEL-S dataset show that STC-Net achieves 95.98 MIoU, 98.01 MDice, and 98.00 MAcc during training, and 72.52 MIoU and 80.16 MDice on unseen test samples. These results demonstrate that STC-Net provides accurate crack localization while offering a practical link between EL-based defect segmentation and PV degradation assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STC-Net，一种用于光伏电池电致发光（EL）图像裂纹分割的网络，融合边缘先验、光谱先验和边界-拓扑细化模块，并将分割结果扩展到功率损失估计。
AI.motivation: 现有分割方法难以捕捉裂纹缺陷细长、延伸且受结构约束的特性，导致EL图像中裂纹评估不准确，影响光伏可靠性分析。
AI.method: 提出Solar Topology Crack Network（STC-Net），包含三个核心组件：边缘先验（edge priors）、光谱先验（spectral priors）和边界-拓扑细化模块（boundary-topology refinement module）。此外，从预测掩码中推导出裂纹相关非活性区域代理，将分割结果扩展到功率损失估计。
AI.result: 在PVEL-S数据集上，STC-Net训练阶段达到95.98 MIoU、98.01 MDice和98.00 MAcc；在未见测试样本上达到72.52 MIoU和80.16 MDice。
AI.conclusion: STC-Net能够实现准确的裂纹定位，并为EL缺陷分割与光伏退化评估之间提供了实用桥梁。

title: PosterMELD: Multi-Agent Paper-to-Poster Generation for Controllable Design Diversity with Editable Print-Ready Outputs
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, and 4 tables. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/Shannon4Science/PosterMELD
summary: Scientific poster construction compresses a long multimodal paper into a readable, editable canvas. Existing systems hide request-level failures by scoring only completed outputs; direct image generation is not element-editable, while coding-agent workflows are costly. PosterMELD is a template-conditioned multi-agent pipeline: capacity-aware slots guide writing before rendering, and deterministic gates plus vision-language model (VLM) review route failures to bounded repair. Each accepted request exports editable PowerPoint (PPTX) and Portable Network Graphics (PNG) artifacts; explicit design controls yield same-paper variants. Across 621 papers, Print-Ready Rate (PRR) counts requests passing geometric, readability, asset-integrity, and obvious-factual-error checks, with native editability reported separately. A frozen VLM assigns conditional Craftsmanship-Harmony-Expressiveness (CHE) scores to print-ready outputs. PosterMELD attains 81.3% PRR, 3.4 times P2P's rate and 5.2 times PosterGen's, and the highest conditional CHE among generated methods with multiple print-ready outputs. Native editability and explicit design controls are retained at a mean cost of USD 0.38 per request, 3.5% of Codex+Skill's. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/Shannon4Science/PosterMELD.

AI.tldr: PosterMELD是一个基于模板条件约束的多智能体流水线系统，用于科学海报生成。通过容量感知槽位指导写作、确定性门控加视觉语言模型审查来路由和修复失败请求，最终输出可编辑的PPTX和PNG文件。在621篇论文上达到81.3%的打印就绪率，分别比P2P高3.4倍、比PosterGen高5.2倍，条件CHE分数最高，单次请求成本仅0.38美元。
AI.motivation: 现有科学海报生成系统存在两大问题：一是直接图像生成不可逐元素编辑，二是编码代理工作流成本高昂。此外，现有系统只对完整输出评分，隐藏了请求级失败，无法有效评估和修复生成过程中的错误。
AI.method: PosterMELD采用模板条件化的多智能体流水线：(1)容量感知槽位在渲染前指导文本写作；(2)确定性门控结合视觉语言模型（VLM）审查，将失败请求路由至有界修复流程；(3)每个成功请求导出可编辑的PPTX和PNG文件；(4)提供显式设计控制以生成同论文的不同变体。评估使用打印就绪率（PRR）检查几何、可读性、资产完整性和明显事实错误，并用冻结VLM分配条件CHE得分。
AI.result: 在621篇论文上，PosterMELD实现了81.3%的PRR，是P2P的3.4倍、PosterGen的5.2倍；在生成方法中获得最高的条件CHE分数，可生成多个打印就绪输出。保留了原生可编辑性和显式设计控制，平均每请求成本0.38美元，仅为Codex+Skill成本的3.5%。
AI.conclusion: PosterMELD通过模板条件多智能体流水线有效平衡了科学海报生成的可编辑性、质量和成本，显著提高了打印就绪率，同时保持经济高效，为科学海报自动生成提供了实用的解决方案。

title: When Extreme Darkness Meets Motion Blur: MeanFlow for Unified RAW Restoration
summary: Extremely low-light RAW enhancement aims to recover severely attenuated sensor signals, yet existing methods often focus on illumination and noise while overlooking the motion-induced degradations inherent in practical low-light imaging. We present a framework for robust extremely low-light RAW enhancement under realistic acquisition degradations. First, we introduce See in the Degraded Extremely Dark (SIDED), a new dataset that applies controlled motion degradation to extremely low-light RAW pairs while retaining their original sensor noise. Second, we propose a unified RAW tokenizer equipped with explicit domain-conditioned representation calibration to align extremely low-light and well-exposed RAW data, followed by a MeanFlow that performs enhancement in a single function evaluation. To our knowledge, this is the first work to formulate extremely low-light RAW enhancement under realistic motion-degraded acquisition and address it with MeanFlow. We further introduce a physics-guided refinement model to strengthen illumination--reflectance consistency, pixel fidelity, and color preservation without incurring additional inference cost. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance in extremely low-light RAW enhancement, and robustly handles coupled motion and noise degradations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向真实运动退化场景的极低光RAW图像增强框架，包含新数据集SIDED、统一RAW分词器、MeanFlow增强模块和物理引导的细化模型，在耦合运动和噪声退化下达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有极低光RAW增强方法主要关注光照和噪声，但忽略了实际低光成像中固有的运动退化问题。作者希望解决极低光RAW增强在真实采集退化（运动与噪声耦合）下的鲁棒性问题。
AI.method: 1) 构建SIDED数据集，对极低光RAW对施加受控运动退化并保留原始传感器噪声；2) 提出统一RAW分词器，通过显式域条件表示校准对齐极低光与正常曝光RAW数据；3) 采用MeanFlow在单次函数评估中完成增强；4) 引入物理引导的细化模型增强光照-反射一致性、像素保真度和颜色保持，且不增加推理成本。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该框架在极低光RAW增强任务上达到了最先进的性能，并能鲁棒地处理运动与噪声的耦合退化。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个将极低光RAW增强建模为真实运动退化采集问题并用MeanFlow解决的工作，为实际低光成像场景提供了更鲁棒的解决方案。

title: Trustworthy AI in Digital Health: A Comprehensive Review of Robustness and Explainability
comment: Preprint of the paper published in Progress in Biomedical Engineering. 26 pages, 5 figures
summary: Ensuring trust in AI systems is essential for the safe and ethical integration of machine learning systems into high-stakes domains such as digital health. Key dimensions, including robustness, explainability, fairness, accountability, and privacy, need to be addressed throughout the AI lifecycle, from problem formulation and data collection to model deployment and human interaction. While various contributions address different aspects of trustworthy AI, a focused synthesis on robustness and explainability, especially tailored to the healthcare context, remains limited. This review addresses that need by organizing recent advancements into an accessible framework, highlighting both technical and practical considerations. We present a structured overview of methods, challenges, and solutions, aiming to support researchers and practitioners in developing reliable and explainable AI solutions for digital health. This review article is organized into three main parts. First, we introduce the pillars of trustworthy AI and discuss the technical and ethical challenges, particularly in the context of digital health. Second, we explore application-specific trust considerations across domains such as intensive care, neonatal health, and metabolic health, highlighting how robustness and explainability support trust. Lastly, we present recent advancements in techniques aimed at improving robustness under data scarcity and distributional shifts, as well as explainable AI methods ranging from feature attribution to gradient-based interpretations and counterfactual explanations. This paper is further enriched with detailed discussions of the contributions toward robustness and explainability in digital health, the development of trustworthy AI systems in the era of LLMs, and various evaluation metrics for measuring trust and related parameters such as validity, fidelity, and diversity.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地综述了数字健康领域中可信AI的关键维度，特别是鲁棒性和可解释性，构建了一个涵盖技术方法、挑战与解决方案的结构化框架，并探讨了LLM时代可信AI系统的发展方向。
AI.motivation: 尽管已有大量研究涉及可信AI的不同方面，但针对医疗健康场景、聚焦鲁棒性和可解释性的综合性综述仍然有限，作者希望填补这一空白。
AI.method: 文章分为三部分：首先介绍可信AI的支柱及其在数字健康中的技术和伦理挑战；其次探讨重症监护、新生儿健康、代谢健康等具体领域的信任考量；最后总结提升数据稀缺和分布偏移下鲁棒性的技术进展，以及从特征归因到梯度解释和反事实解释的可解释AI方法。
AI.result: 提供了对数字健康领域鲁棒性和可解释性贡献的详细讨论，构建了LLM时代可信AI系统的开发框架，并提出了衡量信任及有效性、保真度和多样性等相关参数的评估指标。
AI.conclusion: 该综述旨在通过结构化框架支持研究人员和从业者开发可靠且可解释的数字健康AI解决方案，强调了从问题定义到人类交互的整个AI生命周期中信任保障的重要性。

title: G-Skin: Learning to Bind 3D Gaussians with Generative Visual Priors
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting has achieved remarkable success in photorealistic and efficient rendering, leading to a rapid increase in 3D assets represented by 3D Gaussian primitives. Directly rigging these assets with arbitrary skeleton topologies is highly desirable. However, training a feed-forward skinning framework is infeasible due to the lack of high-quality 3D Gaussian rigging datasets. An alternative solution is to transfer mesh-based techniques to 3D Gaussian-based representation, but 3D Gaussian primitives are not restricted to the surface and lack explicit topological connectivity. Moreover, this kind of method suffers from poor generalization to unseen data due to its strong dependence on training data, while acquiring high-quality rigging data is prohibitively expensive. To address this challenging problem, we propose G-Skin, a novel generative skinning framework designed for expressive and high-fidelity animation with 3D Gaussian representation. To overcome this 3D data scarcity, we introduce a skeleton-controllable image generation model leveraging 2D vision foundation models to distill powerful motion priors into pseudo-guidance. Guided by these priors, we formulate an optimization pipeline incorporating geometry-aware regularizations, which stabilizes the learning process and ensures smooth, structurally coherent skinning weights. G-Skin also generalizes flexibly to the augmented variants of 3D Gaussian representation designed to mitigate animation-induced rendering artifacts. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our approach, demonstrating clear advantages over state-of-the-art methods. Project page: https://yaoyx689.github.io/GSkin.html.

AI.tldr: G-Skin是一个针对3D高斯表示的可生成蒙皮框架，通过引入骨架可控的图像生成模型从2D视觉基础模型蒸馏运动先验作为伪指导，配合几何感知正则化的优化管线，在缺乏3D高斯蒙皮数据集的情况下实现了高保真且表达力强的动画蒙皮，优于现有最先进方法。
AI.motivation: 3D高斯溅射在逼真高效渲染方面取得显著成功，但直接对任意骨架拓扑进行绑定蒙皮面临两大挑战：缺乏高质量的3D高斯蒙皮数据集导致前馈蒙皮框架无法训练，且3D高斯原语不受限于表面、缺乏显式拓扑连接，使得基于网格的技术迁移泛化性差。
AI.method: 1) 提出骨架可控的图像生成模型，利用2D视觉基础模型蒸馏强运动先验作为伪指导；2) 在这些先验指导下构建包含几何感知正则化的优化管线，稳定学习过程并确保平滑、结构一致的蒙皮权重；3) 支持扩展到3D高斯表示的增强变体以缓解动画引起的渲染伪影。
AI.result: 大量实验验证了该方法的有效性，在蒙皮质量和动画渲染效果上显著优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: G-Skin通过生成式方法结合2D先验蒸馏有效解决了3D高斯蒙皮数据稀缺和拓扑缺失的问题，为3D高斯表示的蒙皮动画提供了可行的新途径，并具备良好的泛化能力和扩展性。

title: Learning Where to Look and How to Judge: Resolution-agnostic Image Quality Assessment with Quality-aware Saliency
comment: Accepted to the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026
summary: No-reference image quality assessment (NR IQA) has recently benefited from deep and multimodal models, yet many SOTA systems still violate at least one basic requirement: they either discard critical quality cues via aggressive resizing, fail to generalize across resolutions, cannot be jointly trained on heterogeneous IQA datasets with mismatched MOS scales, or require prohibitive computation. We present \textbf{ReLIQS}, a model for \textbf{Re}solution-agnostic \textbf{L}earning for \textbf{I}mage \textbf{Q}uality with \textbf{S}aliency, which is resolution-agnostic, preserves original-resolution quality cues, learns from multiple subjective studies, and remains computationally efficient and budget-adaptive. ReLIQS is a CLIP-based multiscale patch-driven architecture that learns both \emph{where to look} and \emph{how to judge} quality. Fixed-size patches are sampled across multiple resolutions, including the original resolution, and encoded with a CLIP vision backbone. A lightweight Perceptual Importance Estimator then predicts IQA-specific importance maps to select a small set of informative patches, and a Latent Quality Axis Module aggregates their embeddings into a single image-level score. Across authentic, synthetic, and AIGC benchmarks spanning diverse resolutions and distortions, ReLIQS generalizes better than strong CNN-, CLIP-, and MLLM-based baselines with matching or reduced computational cost.

AI.tldr: ReLIQS是一种基于CLIP的多尺度patch驱动架构，用于无参考图像质量评估，能处理任意分辨率、保留原始质量线索、从多个主观研究中联合学习，同时保持计算高效和预算自适应。
AI.motivation: 现有NR IQA方法存在多个基本缺陷：激进缩放丢失质量线索、无法跨分辨率泛化、无法在异构数据集上联合训练、计算开销过大。作者旨在解决这些问题。
AI.method: ReLIQS采用CLIP视觉骨干从多分辨率（含原始分辨率）采样固定大小patch；轻量级感知重要性估计器预测IQA特定重要性图以选择少量信息性patch；潜在质量轴模块聚合patch嵌入为图像级分数。
AI.result: 在真实、合成和AIGC基准上，ReLIQS在多种分辨率和失真类型下优于强CNN、CLIP和MLLM基线，且计算成本匹配或更低。
AI.conclusion: ReLIQS通过同时学习"看哪里"（重要性估计）和"如何评价"（质量判断），实现了分辨率无关且计算高效的SOTA级NR IQA性能。

title: Self-Certification of Representation Adequacy: Sequential Certification at Minimum Task Loss
comment: 108 pages, 3 figures. Full proofs and appendices included. Independent researcher
summary: Agents that act on a compressed representation of their history face a structural risk: if the representation aliases histories with different optimal actions, no rule measurable with respect to the representation can avoid an irreducible per-round loss, and the agent may be unable to detect this from its own transcript. This paper develops a four-layer theory of self-certification of representation adequacy. The static layer defines decision-theoretic adequacy through a Bayes-risk grouping identity and prices a one-shot external verification by an exact total-variation threshold. The sequential layer poses certification as an optimal-stopping problem in the currency of task loss: we define an environment-wise certification complexity constant through a covering linear program, prove an information-task-loss lower bound for every delta-correct strategy, and give a Certification Track-and-Stop policy whose cost matches the bound asymptotically. A final boundary layer gives an explicit kernel-switching example and identifies the open theorem needed to cover policy switching or representation repair; it does not claim that the fixed-kernel guarantees extend to representation revision. The proofs of the two main theorems are given in full in the appendices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种四层理论框架，用于自认证智能体历史压缩表示是否充分，涵盖静态决策充分性、序列最优停止认证、复杂度常数及边界层开放问题。
AI.motivation: 智能体基于压缩历史表示行动时存在结构性风险：若表示对不同最优动作的历史产生别名，则任何基于该表示的可测规则都无法避免不可约的每轮损失，且智能体无法从自身转录中检测到这一问题。
AI.method: 构建四层理论：(1)静态层通过贝叶斯风险分组恒等式定义决策充分性，并用全变差阈值定价一次性外部验证；(2)序列层将认证建模为以任务损失为货币的最优停止问题，通过覆盖线性规划定义环境级认证复杂度常数，证明delta-正确策略的信息-任务损失下界，并提出匹配渐近界的Certification Track-and-Stop策略；(3)边界层给出核切换示例并识别覆盖策略切换或表示修复所需的关键定理。
AI.result: 证明了认证复杂度的信息-任务损失下界，给出渐近最优的Certification Track-and-Stop策略，并指出固定核保证无法直接扩展到表示修正场景。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为表示充分性的自认证提供了系统化的理论框架，但表示修正/策略切换场景仍需开放定理来覆盖，两个主要定理的完整证明见附录。

title: IDraw: Artist Verification from Digital Drawing Images
summary: As digital drawings are increasingly shared online, reliable authorship verification has become important for protecting artists and resolving disputes. Yet when authorship is questioned, verification may have to rely only on the disputed drawing and reference drawings known to be created by the claimed artist. This setting is challenging for two reasons. First, artist-specific drawing behavior, such as pen pressure and movement speed, is informative but is not available from a completed drawing. Second, similarities in the depicted object or scene can obscure similarities arising from the artist. We propose IDraw, a framework that learns from drawings paired with tablet-pen sensor signals collected from separate training artists. This allows IDraw to infer drawing behavior from completed images during a later authorship dispute, without requiring sensor data from the artist being verified. IDraw also reduces the influence of drawing content by identifying information shared by drawings of the same object across different artists and suppressing it before comparing drawings. To support this approach, we construct the first multimodal dataset for digital drawing authorship verification, containing 1,110 drawings from 37 artists and 14 types of tablet-pen sensor signals. Evaluated on previously unseen artists across nine image-encoder backbones, IDraw consistently outperforms standard image-based verification and reduces verification error by up to 40%. These results demonstrate that inferring drawing behavior from completed images and suppressing drawing content improve digital drawing authorship verification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IDraw框架，通过从完成图像中推断绘画行为（如笔压和运动速度），并抑制画面内容干扰，实现数字绘画作者验证。实验表明该方法在未见艺术家上可将验证错误率降低多达40%。
AI.motivation: 数字绘画在线上广泛分享，作者验证对保护艺术家和解决纠纷至关重要。但面临两大挑战：一是绘画行为（笔压、速度等）信息在完成图像中不可直接获取；二是画面内容相似性会干扰对艺术家风格的判断。
AI.method: IDraw框架从配对有平板笔传感器信号的训练画作中学习，从而在验证阶段仅从完成图像推断绘画行为，无需被验证艺术家的传感器数据。同时通过识别并抑制同一物体在不同艺术家画作间的共享信息，减少画面内容对作者识别的干扰。此外构建了首个数字绘画作者验证多模态数据集，包含37位艺术家的1110幅画作和14种传感器信号。
AI.result: 在九个图像编码器骨干上对未见艺术家进行评估，IDraw一致优于标准基于图像的验证方法，验证错误率降低高达40%。
AI.conclusion: 从完成图像中推断绘画行为并抑制画面内容干扰，能够显著提升数字绘画作者验证的准确性。

title: Harness-R1: Learning to Edit Executable Runtime Harnesses from Agent Failure Trajectories
summary: Agents built around large language models continually accumulate interaction trajectories during deployment, yet their behavior typically remains fixed. Beyond updating model weights, these trajectories can improve the agent harness that constructs context, mediates tools, validates actions, and recovers execution. We introduce Harness-R1, the first method, to our knowledge, that makes failure-conditioned, lifecycle-wide editing of an existing executable runtime a learned capability. It post-trains a dedicated harness engineer with online reinforcement learning so that its edits are optimized for the realized task success they produce, rather than proposed by a fixed editor. A separate 9B engineer converts batches of target-agent failures into validated executable patches; fresh same-batch reruns of the frozen target provide outcome rewards, so training updates only the engineer. Cold-start supervised fine-tuning initializes this editing policy, which is then trained online with group-relative policy optimization. Across WebShop, ALFWorld, and DBBench, Harness-R1 raises vanilla Qwen3.5-9B success from 44.3% to 53.6% (+9.3 percentage points). After direct target-agent fine-tuning, a target-specific engineer raises the average further from 59.2% to 64.2% (+5.0 points); because these gains hold both before and after fine-tuning the target, Harness-R1 points toward co-evolving the harness engineer and the target agent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Harness-R1，首个通过在线强化学习训练"harness工程师"模型，对已有可执行运行时进行失败条件驱动的全生命周期编辑的方法。工程师模型将目标代理的失败批次转化为可执行的补丁，以冻结目标的同批次重跑结果作为奖励信号，使编辑策略针对真实任务成功率进行优化。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型代理在部署过程中持续积累交互轨迹，但其行为通常保持固定。除了更新模型权重外，这些轨迹还可以用于改进代理的harness（即构建上下文、中介工具、验证行动和恢复执行的部分），但目前缺乏一种让harness编辑成为可学习能力的方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建一个专门的9B"harness工程师"模型，将目标代理的失败批次转化为可验证的可执行补丁；2) 使用冷启动监督微调初始化编辑策略；3) 通过在线群体相对策略优化（GRPO）训练，以冻结目标代理的同一批次重跑结果作为奖励信号；4) 训练只更新工程师模型，目标代理保持不变。
AI.result: 在WebShop、ALFWorld和DBBench三个基准上，Harness-R1将vanilla Qwen3.5-9B的成功率从44.3%提升至53.6%（+9.3个百分点）。在对目标代理进行直接微调后，目标特定的工程师进一步将平均成功率从59.2%提升至64.2%（+5.0个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: 由于这些增益在目标代理微调前后均能保持，Harness-R1表明可以协同演化harness工程师和目标代理，为代理系统的整体优化提供了新的方向。

title: SPECTRA: Band-Routed Embedding and Stage-Wise LoRA for Cross-Sensor Fine-Tuning of Geospatial Foundation Models
summary: Geospatial foundation models (GeoFMs), pretrained on large-scale geospatial data such as Earth observation (EO), climate, and weather data, have shown promising performance when fine-tuned on diverse downstream tasks. However, there are two challenges of adapting EO-pretrained GeoFMs to practical downstream datasets. The first challenge is how to handle spectral mismatch: pretrained patch embeddings expect a fixed set of input bands, whereas downstream sensors may provide different channels. The second challenge is how to reduce fine-tuning cost and make it efficient. While existing work has made efforts on these challenges individually, jointly improving fine-tuning performance under spectral mismatch while reducing adaptation cost remains underexplored. We propose SPECTRA, a parameter-efficient fine-tuning framework that addresses both spectral mismatch and adaptation cost. To handle spectral mismatch, SPECTRA introduces Band-Routed Embedding (BRE), which maps all available downstream bands into the band space expected by the pretrained GeoFM. By using BRE, all available bands in the downstream dataset are utilized to improve the selected-band input without changing the pretrained patch embedding interface. To reduce adaptation cost, SPECTRA further introduces a Stage-wise Transferability-aware LoRA (ST-LoRA) fine-tuning. ST-LoRA estimates stage-wise transferability before fine-tuning and assigns stage-specific LoRA ranks, concentrating trainable parameters on the stages with high transferability for the target task. Across three EO-pretrained GeoFMs and four downstream segmentation datasets, experiments show that BRE improves performance by utilizing all spectral bands, while ST-LoRA reduces trainable parameters compared with full fine-tuning and standard LoRA. Code is available at https://github.com/big-data-lab-umbc/SPECTRA.

AI.tldr: SPECTRA是一个针对地理空间基础模型（GeoFMs）的参数高效微调框架，通过Band-Routed Embedding（BRE）解决光谱不匹配问题，并利用Stage-wise Transferability-aware LoRA（ST-LoRA）降低微调成本，在三个EO预训练GeoFMs和四个下游分割数据集上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 地理空间基础模型在实际下游任务适配中面临两个核心挑战：一是预训练模型期望固定波段的输入，而下游传感器可能提供不同的光谱通道（光谱不匹配问题）；二是全量微调成本高昂，需要高效的参数微调方案。现有工作分别处理这两个问题，但尚未有工作同时联合解决两者。
AI.method: SPECTRA提出两个核心组件：(1) Band-Routed Embedding（BRE），将所有可用的下游波段映射到预训练GeoFM期望的波段空间，在不改变预训练patch embedding接口的前提下充分利用全部波段；(2) Stage-wise Transferability-aware LoRA（ST-LoRA），在微调前估计各阶段的迁移能力，为不同阶段分配特定秩的LoRA，将可训练参数集中在目标任务迁移能力高的阶段。
AI.result: 在三个EO预训练GeoFMs和四个下游分割数据集上的实验表明，BRE通过利用全部光谱波段提升了性能，ST-LoRA相比全量微调和标准LoRA减少了可训练参数量。
AI.conclusion: SPECTRA首次联合解决了GeoFMs适配中的光谱不匹配和高成本微调两大挑战，通过波段路由嵌入和阶段感知LoRA实现了性能提升与参数效率的兼顾，代码已开源。

title: SKT: Skill-Use Training at Scale via Verified Synthetic Data Generation
summary: Agent skills have become an important mechanism for equipping language-model agents with reusable procedural knowledge. However, providing skills alone does not guarantee that current models can effectively identify, apply, and coordinate them. To improve skill-use capabilities, we introduce SKT, a verified data synthesis pipeline that constructs skill-grounded tasks and executable trajectories from large collections of agent skills. SKT selects suitable single-skill and multi-skill configurations, synthesizes tasks through rule-based and agent-based verification with feedback-guided repair, and retains only successful trajectories that substantially use every required skill. Using 2,000 public skills, SKT produces 4,000 task packages and 27,164 verified trajectories. Based on the same pipeline and a disjoint test pool, we further construct SkillEval, a held-out executable benchmark for evaluating skill use. Experiments across diverse models, benchmarks, and agent harnesses show that supervised fine-tuning on SKT-generated trajectories consistently improves skill-use performance. Verification ablations, cross-harness evaluation, and scaling experiments further demonstrate that these gains depend on high-quality supervision, extend beyond a single agent interface, and increase with broader skill coverage. Together, these results establish verified data synthesis as an effective and scalable approach for skill-use training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SKT，一个经过验证的数据合成流水线，从大规模Agent技能库中构建技能导向的任务和可执行轨迹，用于提升语言模型Agent的技能使用能力；同时构建了SkillEval基准用于评估，实验表明基于SKT轨迹的监督微调能持续提升技能使用性能。
AI.motivation: 仅仅为语言模型Agent提供技能并不能保证模型能够有效地识别、应用和协调这些技能。现有模型在技能使用方面存在能力短板，需要一种可扩展的方式来训练模型更好地使用Agent技能。
AI.method: SKT流水线包括：1) 选择适合的单技能和多技能配置；2) 通过基于规则和基于Agent的验证（含反馈引导修复）合成任务；3) 仅保留成功且充分使用所需技能的轨迹。基于同一流水线和不相交的测试池构建SkillEval基准。
AI.result: 使用2,000个公开技能，SKT生成4,000个任务包和27,164条验证过的轨迹。跨多种模型、基准和Agent框架的实验表明，基于SKT轨迹的监督微调持续提升技能使用性能。验证消融、跨框架评估和扩展实验进一步证明了这些收益依赖高质量监督、可泛化到单一Agent界面之外，并随技能覆盖范围扩大而增加。
AI.conclusion: 验证过的数据合成是提升技能使用训练的有效且可扩展的方法，为Agent技能使用能力的训练提供了高质量的数据基础设施。

title: Shared Prefixes, Better Credit: Adaptive Routing for Multi-Agent Reasoning
summary: Multi-agent reasoning (MAR) improves reasoning reliability through iterative solution exchange and refinement. Existing adaptive MAR methods typically learn routing decisions from query-level labels or trajectory-level returns, but such coarse supervision cannot accurately estimate the state-conditioned utility of individual operators in multi-step collaboration. We propose TreeCredit, a shared-prefix credit assignment framework for efficient adaptive MAR. Its core insight is to estimate operator utility through state-matched downstream comparisons, rather than directly attributing trajectory-level outcomes to preceding decisions. TreeCredit constructs shared-prefix collaboration trees by expanding candidate operators from the same intermediate state and assigns each state--operator pair a correctness-prioritized suffix credit based on the terminal correctness and cumulative additional cost of its complete continuation. These structured credits are converted into state-local operator preferences to train a lightweight pairwise state router, which dynamically selects the next admissible operator during inference. Experiments on six reasoning benchmarks show that TreeCredit modestly improves accuracy while substantially reducing inference cost, achieving a better accuracy--cost trade-off than representative MAR methods.

AI.tldr: 提出TreeCredit，一种共享前缀信用分配框架，通过状态匹配的后继对比来估计多智能体推理中每个操作符的效用，训练轻量级成对状态路由器，在六个推理基准上以更低推理成本获得更好精度-成本权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有自适应多智能体推理方法依赖查询级标签或轨迹级回报学习路由决策，这种粗粒度监督无法准确估计多步协作中单个操作符在特定状态下的效用，导致路由决策不够精准。
AI.method: TreeCredit构建共享前缀协作树，从相同中间状态扩展候选操作符，基于完整后续的终端正确性和累计额外成本为每个状态-操作符对分配正确性优先的后缀信用；将这些结构化信用转化为状态局部操作符偏好，训练轻量级成对状态路由器，在推理时动态选择下一个可采纳操作符。
AI.result: 在六个推理基准上的实验表明，TreeCredit在精度上略有提升，同时大幅降低推理成本，相比代表性多智能体推理方法实现了更好的精度-成本权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过共享前缀信用分配实现了更精准的操作符效用估计，证明了细粒度的状态级信用分配比粗粒度轨迹级分配更有效，可实现高效的自适应多智能体推理。

title: Pixel Ignores, Superpixel Sees: Adverse Weather Image Restoration via Semantic-Center SSM
summary:
Adverse weather image restoration aims to recover clear visibility from degraded images in complex weather conditions.
  Existing works attempt to address this problem by modeling relationships between pixels, however, this paradigm defies the spatially non-uniformity fact of degradations and learns non-discriminative features from semantic-conflict regions.
  In this paper, we propose SSR, a \textbf{S}emantic-center guilded \textbf{S}tate space model for image \textbf{R}estoration.
  The key idea of SSR is to shift the conventional scanning strategy of pixel-serial to semantic-guilded one.
  Specifically, we introduce a Superpixel-guided Selective Scan Mechanism ($\text{S}^3$M), which first partitions the image into perceptually coherent regions via superpixel clustering and then performs relations modeling within the semantic-related regions.
  Moreover, a Region-level Gating Mechanism (RGM) is developed to perform intra-region calibration by modulating degradation outliers within each semantic superpixel unit along the channel dimension.
  Extensive experiments on \textbf{6} well-established benchmarks demonstrate that SSR performs favorably against state-of-the-art models with competitive computational cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SSR（Semantic-center guided State space model for image Restoration），一种基于语义中心引导的状态空间模型用于恶劣天气图像复原。核心创新是将传统的像素序列扫描策略改为语义引导扫描，通过超像素聚类将图像划分为感知一致的语义区域，并在区域内建模关系，同时引入区域级门控机制进行通道维度的退化异常值校准。
AI.motivation: 现有恶劣天气图像复原方法通过建模像素间关系来处理退化，但这一范式忽略了退化在空间上的非均匀性，并且容易从语义冲突区域学习到非判别性特征，导致复原效果不佳。
AI.method: 提出SSR模型，包含两个核心模块：(1) 超像素引导的选择性扫描机制（S³M），通过超像素聚类将图像划分为感知一致的语义区域，并在语义相关区域内建模关系；(2) 区域级门控机制（RGM），沿通道维度对每个语义超像素单元内的退化异常值进行调制校准，实现区域内精细校正。
AI.result: 在6个公认基准数据集上与最先进模型对比，SSR在复原效果上表现更优，同时计算成本具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过将像素级序列扫描转换为语义引导扫描，SSR有效解决了退化空间非均匀性和语义冲突区域特征判别性不足的问题，验证了语义中心引导的状态空间模型在恶劣天气图像复原中的有效性。

title: MechGeo: Autoformalizing and Proving Euclidean Geometry in Lean 4
summary: We present MechGeo, a Mathlib native agentic framework that jointly addresses faithful autoformalization and certified proof construction for Euclidean geometry. In this framework, GeoFormalizer represents informal problems in GeoIR, deterministically translates them into Lean 4, and iteratively repairs candidate statements using structural diagnostics and semantic evaluation. GeoProver constructs geometric proof plans, derives intermediate lemmas, and selectively algebraizes suitable subgoals through a library verified in Lean. Singular or SymPy may generate algebraic certificates, but all resulting proofs and counterexamples are checked by Lean's kernel. Experiments across seven LLM backbones show substantial improvements in autoformalization, particularly for models with weaker direct translation performance. On 43 historical IMO geometry problems, GeoFormalizer generates formal statements that GeoProver proves in 29 cases; for the remaining 14, it constructs counterexamples verified in Lean and proves all repaired statements after expert correction. Together with IMO 2026 Problem 2, this yields, to the best of our knowledge, the largest reported collection of automated, kernel-checked Lean proofs for IMO geometry problems. On the 14 geometry statements in LEAP's Lean-IMO-Bench, MechGeo proves 12 for the first time, formally refutes the remaining two, and proves both repaired statements. These results establish counterexample guided diagnosis, geometric reasoning, and certified symbolic computation as a practical foundation for trustworthy formal geometry.

AI.tldr: MechGeo是一个Mathlib原生的智能体框架，同时解决欧几里得几何的可信自动形式化与认证证明构造问题。该框架通过GeoFormalizer将非形式化问题转换为Lean 4语句，GeoProver构造证明计划并选择性地代数化子目标，所有证明和反例均由Lean内核验证。在43个历史IMO几何问题上证明了29个，在LEAP基准上首次证明了12个并正式反驳了2个。
AI.motivation: 欧几里得几何的形式化推理面临两大挑战：将非形式化问题自动转换为形式化语句（自动形式化）以及构造可被内核验证的证明。现有方法在翻译准确性和证明构建的可靠性上存在不足，尤其是对于直接翻译能力较弱的模型。作者希望建立一个同时处理这两个环节的端到端框架，实现可信的几何推理。
AI.method: MechGeo框架包含两个核心组件：GeoFormalizer使用GeoIR表示非形式化问题，将其确定性地翻译为Lean 4，并通过结构诊断和语义评估迭代修复候选语句；GeoProver构造几何证明计划，推导中间引理，并利用库中验证过的方法选择性地将子目标代数化。代数证书由Singular或SymPy生成，但所有证明和反例最终都经过Lean内核检查。框架还采用反例引导的诊断机制，对无法证明的语句生成经过形式化验证的反例。
AI.result: 在7个LLM后端的实验显示自动形式化能力显著提升，尤其是对直接翻译能力较弱的模型。在43个历史IMO几何问题中，GeoFormalizer生成的语句中有29个被GeoProver成功证明；其余14个生成了Lean验证的反例，并在专家修正后全部证明。在LEAP的Lean-IMO-Bench的14个几何语句中，MechGeo首次证明了12个，正式反驳了剩余2个，并证明了两个修正后的语句。
AI.conclusion: 反例引导的诊断、几何推理与认证符号计算的结合，为可信形式化几何建立了实用基础。MechGeo代表了目前IMO几何问题自动化Lean证明的最大规模集合，证明了该框架在数学推理自动化方面的有效性和可靠性。

title: Trajectories That Segment Themselves: Agent-Declared Boundaries as a Training Unit
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. Includes appendices with full controls and ablations
summary: Long-horizon coding-agent trajectories are poorly matched to the credit units available to train on: a single action has no stable value, an episode label merges productive exploration with abandoned directions, and a fixed window cuts where the logging mechanics fall. We introduce collection-time semantic self-segmentation, in which a declarative contract has the acting agent expose its own boundaries while the trajectory is generated. Instantiated with falsifiable causal hypotheses, successive adoptions expose variable-length semantic phases, and no milestone vocabulary, gold patch, environment replay, teacher logits, or retrospective segmenter places a boundary. Because the agent names its conjecture, a reviewer can negate it by name, which lets our protocol manufacture wrong-cause-then-correction transitions that recorded work rarely contains; one collection then yields four supervised targets, including audit supervision from exactly the failed regions an episode label discards. We then ask what survives deleting the declaration. Given the cut points but not the hypothesis, a model attributes action blocks to their governing hypothesis at over twice chance, beating equal-length blocks over the same trajectories (paired sign test $p = 0.0002$), surviving a lexical control and collapsing under label permutation. Asked instead to place boundaries, a code-blind annotator matches 24 of 40 where random placement matches 11.5, while a mechanical test-event rule beats chance at neither end of a strict-to-permissive sweep. The segments are therefore coherent and not cheaply reproducible. Downstream, DPO on 2,551 phase-boundary pairs changes no decision on 91 adversarial held-out items, while four of 60 change on matched-construction items, all wrong to right, where two controls change none: with 1,825 pairs from one generator, the variable to vary next is corpus diversity, not the boundary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"采集时语义自分割"方法，让编码智能体在轨迹生成过程中基于可证伪的因果假设主动暴露自身的语义边界，从而将长时间编码轨迹分割为可变长度的语义阶段。该方法无需里程碑词汇、黄金补丁或环境回放等外部信号，通过让智能体命名其推测，使评审者可以按名否定，从而生成"错误原因-纠正"的转换数据。实验表明分割具有语义一致性（假设归因超过随机两倍以上，人工标注匹配率明显优于随机），且下游DPO训练中基于该边界对的训练能有效修正错误决策。
AI.motivation: 长时程编码智能体轨迹与可训练的信用单元之间存在根本性错配：单一动作缺乏稳定价值，整段轨迹标签将有效探索与废弃方向混为一谈，固定窗口切分会切断记录机制的自然边界。现有方法依赖外部信号（如里程碑词表、黄金补丁、环境回放、教师logits或回顾性分割器）来界定边界，但这些方法无法触及智能体自身的因果结构。
AI.method: 提出"采集时语义自分割"（collection-time semantic self-segmentation）：在轨迹生成过程中，声明性契约要求智能体主动暴露自身的工作边界，以可证伪的因果假设形式命名推测。每个假设构成一个语义阶段，评审者可按名否定假设，从而生成"错误原因-纠正"过渡。一次采集可产生四种监督目标，包括审计监督（针对被整段标签丢弃的失败区域）。
AI.result: （1）给定分割点但无假设时，模型将动作块归因到其主导假设的准确率超过随机两倍，在相同轨迹上击败等长块（配对符号检验p=0.0002），且通过词汇控制和标签置换检验；（2）编码盲标注者在边界放置任务中匹配24/40（随机为11.5），而机械测试事件规则在严格到宽松的全范围内均不优于随机；（3）在2,551对阶段边界上DPO训练：91个对抗性保留项零变化，60个匹配构造项中4项从错变对（两个对照组均无变化）。
AI.conclusion: 语义分割的段落具有一致性且不易被廉价方法复制，验证了"智能体自我暴露的因果阶段"作为训练信号的可靠性。下游DPO结果证明相边界对能有效修正错误，且当使用1,825对来自单一生成器的数据时，下一步应扩展语料多样性而非边界数量。

title: LiveLight: Real-time Streaming Video Relighting with Interactive Control
comment: Accepted by TOG 2026. Project page: https://living-lighting.github.io
summary: We present LiveLight, the first diffusion-based framework for real-time streaming video relighting with interactive 3D lighting control. Achieving this is non-trivial, as it requires overcoming three critical challenges: effectively injecting dynamic 3D lighting into a diffusion model, maintaining high-fidelity generation under an extremely low NFE (Number of Function Evaluations) budget for real-time speed, and facilitating continuous streaming for interactive control. To address these pain points, we propose three key designs. First, for accurate lighting injection, we propose a lightweight adapter that feeds Multi-Plane Light Irradiance (MPLI) conditions-depth-aware irradiance maps encoding 3D lighting geometry-directly into the diffusion backbone. Second, to prevent rendering quality degradation at low NFEs towards real-time distillation, we introduce a geometry-guided feedback branch. This training-time constraint leverages a frozen geometry estimator to enforce depth- and normal-consistent relighting, ensuring geometrically plausible shading without adding inference overhead. Finally, to enable streaming interaction, we develop a progressive rolling-window strategy that maintains a denoising ladder of latent chunks at varying noise levels. By propagating intermediate states, this strategy guarantees temporal coherence and supports arbitrarily long video relighting with per-frame reference refresh. Extensive experiments on real-world and synthetic benchmarks demonstrate that LiveLight achieves state-of-the-art relighting quality while running at real-time speed, significantly outperforming offline baselines in temporal stability, lighting controllability, and user preference. To foster real-time interactive relighting research, we will publicly release our models, training data, and synthetic data generator.

AI.tldr: LiveLight是首个基于扩散模型的实时流式视频重打光框架，支持交互式3D光照控制，通过轻量级适配器注入多层平面辐照度条件、几何引导反馈分支保证低NFE下渲染质量，以及渐进式滚动窗口策略实现流式交互，在真实与合成基准上达到SOTA质量并实现实时速度。
AI.motivation: 实时视频重打光是一个极具挑战性的任务，现有扩散模型方法难以同时满足三方面需求：动态3D光照注入、极低NFE预算下的高保真生成（以达成实时速度），以及面向交互控制的连续流式处理。这三个痛点制约了实时交互式重打光的发展。
AI.method: 提出三个关键设计：(1) 轻量级适配器将多层平面辐照度（MPLI）条件——深度感知的辐照度图编码3D光照几何——直接注入扩散主干；(2) 几何引导反馈分支，利用冻结的几何估计器在训练时施加深度和法线一致性约束，保证几何合理的着色且不增加推理开销；(3) 渐进式滚动窗口策略，维护不同噪声级别的潜在块去噪阶梯，通过传播中间状态保证时序一致性并支持任意长度视频重打光。
AI.result: 在真实世界和合成基准上的大量实验表明，LiveLight在重打光质量上达到SOTA水平，同时实现实时速度，在时间稳定性、光照可控性和用户偏好方面显著优于离线基线。
AI.conclusion: LiveLight证明了扩散模型可以在实时速度下完成高质量的流式视频重打光，并将公开模型、训练数据和合成数据生成器以促进该方向的研究。

title: Mamba with Hierarchical Memory: Solving Representation Bottleneck in Long Sequence Modeling
summary: Recurrent linear attention models (RLAs) such as Mamba offer efficient linear-time sequence modeling as an alternative to Transformers, yet their fixed-capacity recurrent states limit long-sequence modeling. Drawing inspiration from hierarchical human memory, we propose Hierarchical Memory Mamba (HMM) to address this limitation. Building upon a pre-trained Mamba backbone, HMM integrates a lightweight working memory that extracts slow paragraph-level semantics (PLS) from the fast sensory memory embedded in the backbone's hidden states. The PLS is subsequently compressed into persistent long-term memory for task-relevant retrieval.
